article.articleHeadline: Live Chat: 8 Top Doctors Answer Your Biggest Questions About Chikungunya
article.articleSummary: Chikungunya is making a quiet but painful comeback in India as the mosquito season intensifies. Published 2026-06-15. Unlike dengue, which tends to dominate headlines, chikungunya often gets underestimated until the joint pain sets in. In a special live chat, eight top doctors across infectious diseases, internal medicine, and critical care answer the most searched questions about chikungunya, including how to distinguish it from dengue and how long the joint pain lasts. The session underscores joint pain as a defining symptom and provides practical insights for readers navigating seasonal chikungunya activity in India. The format features expert perspectives from frontline clinicians, offering clarifications on illness recognition and the expected duration of symptoms during the current cycle.

triage.headline_ja: ライブチャット：8人の専門医がチクングニアについてのよくある質問に回答
triage.triage_reason: インドでチクングニアが再発生している異常な状況を示唆するが、具体的な症例数、死亡者数、流行の規模などの定量的データが記事に記載されていない。医学情報提供型の記事であり、疫学的な外出しが不明瞭。
triage.notes: 記事はチクungunya の「静かだが痛みを伴う復活」をインドで報告しており、蚊の季節の強化に伴う再発生の可能性を示唆している。ただし、症例数、入院数、死亡数などの具体的な疫学的指標が記載されていないため、WATCHレベルの判定。続報で具体的な患者数や重症度に関する情報が出現した場合はPICKUP昇格の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Regierungsdaten - Über 780 Ebola-Fälle in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo bestätigt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government Data - Over 780 Ebola Cases Confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Over 780 Ebola virus disease cases have been confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, including 181 deaths among confirmed cases. In the last 24 hours, authorities documented 72 new cases. Three eastern provinces are most affected by the current outbreak. For the Bundibugyo strain of the Ebola virus circulating in this outbreak, there is currently no vaccine or approved therapy. Ebola virus disease is a contagious and life-threatening infection, transmitted through direct contact with an infected person or their bodily fluids. The figures come from government data cited by Reuters. The outbreak's persistence highlights the absence of targeted medical countermeasures for the Bundibugyo strain and underscores the ongoing public health challenge in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: 政府データ - コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルス病の確認症例が780例を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤な公衆衛生上の影響（780例以上、181例の死亡）、異常性（東部3州での集中発生）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを有する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株に対する承認済みワクチンまたは治療法がないことが指摘されており、公衆衛生対策の深刻な課題を示唆している。24時間以内に72例の新規症例が確認されており、流行が進行中である。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: جمهورية الكونغو الديمقراطية.. وفاة 181 شخصا وإصابة 782 بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: 181 dead and 782 infected with the Ebola virus.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 782 confirmed Ebola cases and 181 deaths (40 recoveries; CFR 23.1%). The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo virus), a rare strain with no vaccine or approved treatment. It is concentrated in eastern Ituri Province, which accounts for over 90% of cases, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu, and cross-border transmission to Uganda. The outbreak was officially confirmed on May 15 after weeks of suspicion. Community surveillance has increased, yet contact-tracing coverage is only 56%, down from the prior week. The crisis is compounded by displacement: nearly 1 million people have fled due to conflict in Ituri, hindering tracking in a forested, hard-to-reach region and among migratory artisanal miners. The U.S. has proposed moving exposed travelers to a 50-bed quarantine facility at Kenya’s Laikipia Air Base, a plan that triggered protests and court action.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラウイルスで181人が死亡、782人が感染
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（782確定例、181死亡、CFR 23.1%）、ワクチン・治療薬なしのBundibugyo ebolavirus、ウガンダへの国境越え感染、高い社会政治的関心。IHR基準4つ全て該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは主にDRCにおけるエボラ流行を主題としている。ウガンダへの国境越え感染言及あるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ケニア（Laikipia）は米国の隔離施設計画に関連するが、実際のエボラ発症地ではないため除外。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: WHO rings alarm about children hit by deadly new Ebola virus strain in Central Africa - The Moderate Voice
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri and South Kivu, expanding to North Kivu) with 676 cases and 136 deaths in the DRC and 19 cases, 2 deaths in Uganda as of June 11, 2026. PHEIC declared May 17, 2026. No approved vaccine or targeted treatment. Transmission through direct contact with bodily fluids, contaminated settings, caregiving networks, unsafe burials; early symptoms mimic malaria/typhoid, leading to misdiagnosis and infections among health workers. Children are disproportionately affected, with high malnutrition in Ituri (over half of under-fives malnourished). WHO notes rapid spread across ~1,000 km, 34 health zones affected, new areas in North Kivu. Travel restrictions by the US; WHO advises against travel bans. US has provided $220 million plus $350 million for Ebola response within a $1.8 billion UN relief package; actions include water/hygiene supplies, 100 regional facilities, and 100 border screeners.

triage.headline_ja: WHO、アフリカ中部で子どもたちを襲う新しいエボラウイルス株について警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、PHEICが既に宣言されている重大な多国間感染症イベント。DRC及びウガンダでのBundibugyo Ebola流行は、国際的な拡大リスク、深刻な死亡率、および実質的な国際的対応が報告されている。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはウガンダも記載されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみ記載。PHEICが2026年5月17日に既に宣言されている最高優先度案件。676症例136死亡（DRC）と19症例2死亡（ウガンダ）が報告されており、新しいEbola株（Bundibugyo系統）による急速な地域的拡大が確認されている。子どもたちの過度な罹患と栄養不良の共存が懸念される。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H3N2

article.articleHeadline: Influenza cases on the rise in Ernakulam, four deaths in June
article.articleSummary: As of June 15, 2026, Ernakulam district (Kochi) reports a rise in influenza cases, with four influenza-related deaths and one fever-related death in June. May saw 161 cases; the first 13 days of June recorded 252 cases, up from 41 in April. Experts attribute the surge to changing climate, urbanisation, and the monsoon onset, urging preventive measures to contain spread. Symptoms include fever and body pain, with high-risk groups—elderly and youngsters with lifestyle diseases, cancer, or obesity—at greater risk of complications. Dr. Rajeev Jayadevan, convener of the IMA research cell, Kerala, notes that influenza strains such as H1N1 and H3N2 circulate seasonally and that infection can recur within a year. Influenza is not the common cold, underscoring the need for vigilance and containment.

triage.headline_ja: インドのエルナキュラム地区でインフルエンザ患者が増加、6月に4人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーララ州エルナキュラム地区でH1N1、H3N2を含むインフルエンザが急増し、6月に計5人の死亡者が報告されている。6月中旬で252例が報告されており、IHR基準の異常性・重症度、およびWPRO基準の複数項目を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはインドのケーララ州コーチ（エルナキュラム地区）における明確なインフルエンザ発生事例を報告している。4週間で発症数が大幅に増加（4月41例→6月252例）しており、季節的流行を超える異常性が認められる。死亡例も含まれ、高齢者および免疫力の低い集団での重症化リスクが指摘されている。モンスーン期の気候変動が流行を助長していることが記載されている。

article.articleHeadline: Aumentan los contagios y las muertes por ébola en el Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infections and deaths rise in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of June 13, 2026, Ebola confirmed infections in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have reached 782, with 181 deaths reported. Over the preceding 24 hours, 72 new infections and 32 deaths were recorded, driving the case fatality rate to 23.1%. The outbreak now spans 31 health zones across the Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, underscoring ongoing transmission in eastern Congo. The government indicated that strict adherence to sanitary and preventive measures remains crucial to halt further spread, calling on communities and health facilities to maintain surveillance, rapid isolation, and safe burial practices. These figures were shared by the Ministry of Communications and Media via its social channels, highlighting the persistent severity of this Ebola outbreak in the region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ感染者と死者が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱は極度の公衆衛生危機を示し、CFR 23.1%と高い重症度、複数州での広範な地理的拡大、国際的な流行拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性が明確である。
triage.notes: 過去24時間で72新規感染、32死亡が報告され、患者数782名、死亡181名（CFR 23.1%）に達している。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州の31保健地域に及ぶ広範な地理的拡大を示す。政府が市民や保健施設に対して警戒・隔離・安全埋葬の遵守を呼びかけており、管理能力の限界を示唆。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当し、フルRRAへの進行が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Planeta em Perigo: Surto de ebola na África acende alerta global para nova pandemia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Planet in Peril: Ebola outbreak in Africa raises a global alert for a new pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri) and Uganda, triggering a global health alert as Bundibugyo ebolavirus spreads rapidly. The World Health Organization classifies the event as a global emergency, with no vaccine available. Brazil activated its contingency plan for viral hemorrhagic fevers. The current outbreak has surpassed 900 suspected cases and at least 223 confirmed deaths in Ituri, DR Congo; harsh living conditions impede basic preventive measures such as handwashing. Volunteer physician Raquel Soeiro highlighted barriers to medical care highlighted by past crises (2014–2015) in Liberia and Sierra Leone due to armed conflict. Increased international mobility raises cross-border risk of spread. In Brazil, two suspected cases were investigated but ruled out after testing. Authorities remain vigilant for external threats from this deadly virus, for which there is no proven treatment or vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 危機に瀕する地球：アフリカのエボラアウトブレイクが新たなパンデミアへの世界的警戒を高める
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による200名超の死亡と900名超の疑似症例、WHOによるグローバル・エマージェンシー宣言、複数国への拡大とブラジルを含む国際的な対応が確認される。
triage.notes: Ituri州はDRC内の特定地域。サマリーではDRCとウガンダでのアウトブレイク、リベリア・シエラレオネの過去事例言及があるが、現在の主要アウトブレイク地域はDRCとウガンダ。対象国リストに該当するのはDRCとブラジルのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ワクチン・治療法なし、WHOグローバル・エマージェンシー宣言、ブラジルを含む国際的対応あり。

article.articleHeadline: ارتفاع إصابات "إيبولا" في الكونغو إلى 782 حالة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo rise to 782.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 782 laboratory-confirmed cases and 181 deaths. In the past 24 hours, 72 new confirmed infections were reported, all in Ituri Province, identified as the outbreak's initial hotspot. The outbreak remains confined to three eastern provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—indicating limited geographic spread at this time.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ患者が782人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラは既知の高リスク病原体で、死亡者を伴う確認患者の継続的増加は即時フル評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則(IHR)の常時通知対象疾患。782確認患者・181死亡という規模、3州での流行継続、24時間あたり72新規患者という進行中の拡大パターンは、フルRRA(Rapid Risk Assessment)実施の明確な指標。地域的には東部に限定的だが、DRCの歴史的背景と国際的懸念から高優先度評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dinkes Sumsel prioritaskan skrining keluarga penderita guna cegah tuberkulosis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: South Sumatra Health Office prioritizes screening of TB patients' families to prevent tuberculosis.
article.articleSummary: South Sumatra's Health Office (Dinkes Sumsel) prioritizes screening household members of tuberculosis (TB) patients to curb transmission in Palembang. Head Trisnawarman Saa notes cohabitants face higher exposure to Mycobacterium tuberculosis and should be examined promptly. Prevention hinges on ensuring TB patients receive complete treatment and adhere to the regimen. Screening includes health evaluations and sputum tests for close contacts; if TB is detected, treatment follows standard health-service protocols. Contacts who test negative may receive preventive therapy to reduce progression risk. TB spreads via airborne droplets, with higher risk in poorly ventilated, closed spaces and prolonged close contact with untreated patients. Public health measures include hygiene, healthy living, environmental cleanliness, and masking when sick. Those with a cough lasting more than two weeks should seek care at a puskesmas, clinic, or hospital. Treatment lasts about six months; cure requires three negative sputum results and a favorable chest X-ray.

triage.headline_ja: 南スマトラ州保健局が結核患者の家族スクリーニングを優先課題に - 感染予防を目指す
triage.triage_reason: 南スマトラ州での結核対策に関する地域保健ニュース。予防スクリーニング開始という既知の対策についての情報であり、新たな異常な流行や重症度の急増を示す証拠がなく、IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当しない。
triage.notes: 結核は慢性感染症であり、長期曝露と感染しやすさの特性がある。しかし本記事は南スマトラ州での既知疾患への既存保健対策の開始を報じているもので、新規の異常な流行、重症化、管理困難を示す情報がない。政府保健機関の主導的対応が見られるが、これは通常の公衆衛生活動の範囲である。

article.articleHeadline: Tak Cukup Skrining, IDAI Minta Pasien Hepatitis Dapat Penanganan Jelas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Screening is not enough, IDAI calls for patients with hepatitis D to receive clear treatment.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia's IDAI calls for hepatitis screening under the government's Free Health Check (CKG) program to be paired with clear follow-up care for those diagnosed, rather than mere screening. Speaking at IDAI's 72nd anniversary in Ragunan, Jakarta, on June 14, 2026, Piprim (IDAI leader) emphasized that early detection must be accompanied by defined treatment pathways. Health Minister Budi Gunadi Sadikin has pushed CKG to expand hepatitis B and C screening, aiming to reach 136 million people in 2026 (up from 70 million in 2025) to speed detection of liver diseases caused by hepatitis B and C. IDAI also urged vaccination as prevention, noting hepatitis B vaccination at birth is crucial to avert long-term health issues, and that immunization for hepatitis A and B should be intensified. Screening and vaccination should run in parallel to reduce the burden of hepatitis in Indonesian children.

triage.headline_ja: スクリーニングだけでは不十分、IDAI が肝炎患者への明確な治療を要求
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおける肝炎スクリーニング拡大計画に関する政策・対応の記事。公衆衛生政策の議論ではあるが、急性アウトブレイク報告や異常な死亡増加の記述がなく、具体的な患者数・重症度データが不明。続報の推移を注視すべき。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアの肝炎スクリーニング計画（CKG）の強化と、ワクチン接種・治療体制の整備を求める声の報道。疾患は Hepatitis A, B, D と表記されているが、サマリーではHBおよびHCが主対象。アウトブレイク報告ではなく公衆衛生政策議論であり、患者数増加や異常死亡の明記なし。肝炎は風土病的に存在する疾患であるため「予想外」ではない。スクリーニング拡大による「長期的曝露」と「流行可能性」のカテゴリのみ該当するが、緊急性は低い。

article.articleHeadline: Not even 1% compromise in Nipah response: Kerala Health Minister K Muraleedharan
article.articleSummary: Kerala's Nipah response is defended by Health Minister K Muraleedharan in Kozhikode, who rejects allegations of lapses in treatment and containment. He says a confirmed Nipah patient received Ribavirin on admission and that Remdesivir was promptly procured; the first dose was given after its arrival on Friday night. He asserts the response has not compromised even 1%, and that the Nipah situation remains under control, though the patient arrived in extremely critical condition. Muraleedharan also accused Dr Reena, former director of Health Services, of not informing him promptly of Nipah test results, noting a press conference around 5:30 pm before the test result was confirmed. As of 2026-06-15, the article does not cite further case counts or fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: ニパールウイルス対応に妥協なし：ケーララ州保健大臣K・ムラリーダラン
triage.triage_reason: ニパールウイルス（高致死率の新興感染症）の確認症例が発生しており、州の公衆衛生対応が進行中。異常・予想外の事象であり、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクと国際的な関心の可能性がある。
triage.notes: ニパールウイルスは致死率40-75%の危険な新興感染症。記事では確認症例1件と治療対応が記載されているが、症例数や死亡者数の詳細は明記されていない。ケーララ州での局所的な発生とみられるが、国内および国際的なスクリーニングが必要。過去のニパールアウトブレイク（2018-2019年）の地域での再発であり、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 广州疾控：流感已进入夏季流行期，呼吸道疾病需警惕
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Guangzhou CDC: Influenza has entered its summer peak season; be vigilant for respiratory diseases.
article.articleSummary: Guangzhou, China reports that influenza has entered its summer peak season, with Influenza B (Victoria lineage) predominating, and rising activity of COVID-19 and other respiratory diseases in the area. Despite hot summer weather, fever and cough remain common. Public health guidance from the Guangzhou CDC emphasizes prevention: wear masks in crowded settings such as hospitals, public transit, and shopping venues; practice thorough hand hygiene using soap and running water with the seven-step method after returning home, touching public facilities, or before meals; cover coughs and sneezes with tissues or the elbow; ensure indoor ventilation by opening windows regularly and avoiding direct air from air conditioning. Additionally, maintain good sleep, a balanced diet, and moderate exercise to strengthen immunity.

triage.headline_ja: 広州疾控：インフルエンザは夏季流行期に入り、呼吸器疾病に注意が必要
triage.triage_reason: インフルエンザB型とCOVID-19の夏季流行が報告されており、複数の呼吸器疾患が同時流行している点で異常/予想外の側面がある。ただし、記事は公衆衛生上の勧告に焦点を当てており、重症例や入院・死亡に関する情報が不足している。IHR基準2つ以上の明確な該当がないため、続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は中国（広州、広東省）における複数の呼吸器疾患の夏季流行を報告している。インフルエンザB型（ビクトリア系統）が優位で、COVID-19やその他の呼吸器疾患の活動が増加している点は異常である。ただし、重症度（重症例数、入院率、死亡率）に関する具体的なデータが記事サマリーに記載されていないため、「severity」は「不明」と評価した。地域検証により、実際の発生地は中国（広州）であり、対象国リストの China (1814991) に該当する。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확산...확진자 782명·사망 181명
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo... 782 confirmed cases, 181 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo virus with 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of June 14, 2026; 56 recoveries; case fatality about 23%. First confirmed May 15. Official counts likely undercount true infections. About 90% of cases occur in Ituri Province in eastern DRC, where war-related displacement of over 1 million people complicates contact tracing. Roads are undeveloped and dense jungle hampers surveillance. Armed conflict and distrust of aid agencies have disrupted Ebola containment efforts. The Bundibugyo virus is described as rare, with no vaccine or treatment available. Monitoring is challenging due to conflict and inaccessibility in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴでエボラ拡散...確診者782名・死亡181名
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模発生で深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的な拡大リスク、死亡率23%の重症性が確認される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo virus（稀なエボラウイルス種）による大規模発生。182名の死亡、23%の死亡率、782名の確診者が報告されている。イツリ州（東部DRC）が約90%の症例の発生地。武力紛争による100万人以上の避難民移動、接触者追跡の困難性、ワクチン・治療薬なし、監視・封じ込め対策の大幅な制約がある。国際的支援が緊急に必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in eastern Congo climb to 782, deaths reach 181
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo's Ituri province climbs to 782 confirmed cases with 181 deaths and 56 recoveries; case fatality 23%. The Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or treatment, unlike the Zaire strain. Ituri accounts for over 90% of cases, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border spread to Uganda. The outbreak was confirmed on May 15, weeks after suspected start. Contact tracing coverage is 56%, down from last week. Nearly a million people are displaced in Ituri, complicating tracing amid dense forests, poor roads, and remote villages; artisanal miners moving between sites further challenge surveillance. Attacks on health workers, local skepticism, and armed conflict hinder response. Separately, U.S. plans to move exposed Americans to a Kenya quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base (50 beds) faced protests halted by the courts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部のエボラ患者が782人に増加、死亡者181人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、またWPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラは極めて高い致命性、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境例あり）、深刻な公衆衛生影響を持つシグナル。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州が震源地。記事にはウガンダへの越境例、ケニアのLaikipia基地への米国職員隔離受け入れについても言及されているが、発生地域としては対象国リスト内ではDRCのみが該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・治療法未承認）による大規模流行であり、接触者追跡カバレッジ56%、多数の国内避難民（約100万人）、医療従事者への攻撃、地元の懐疑心、武装紛争による対応阻害など、管理上の重大な課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo Makin Mengkhawatirkan, 782 Kasus Terkonfirmasi dan 181 Orang Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Kongo grows more worrisome, 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo escalates to 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, with the true toll likely higher. Official confirmation came on May 15, weeks after suspected community spread. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a relatively rare strain; there is no vaccine or specifically approved therapy for Bundibugyo, complicating containment versus Zaire-driven outbreaks. The Ministry reports 56 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 23%. The epicenter is Ituri Province, accounting for over 90% of cases, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border spread to Uganda. UN data indicate nearly one million displaced due to Ituri conflict, hindering contact tracing amid dense forests, poor roads, and remote villages. Challenges include mobile artisanal miners, attacks on health workers, and public skepticism. The US plans Ebola quarantine facilities in Kenya at Laikipia Air Base (up to 50 beds), but protests and a court halt have stalled the project.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱流行が深刻化、782例の確定症例と181人の死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の重大な流行で、ワクチンなし、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）、国際的支援が必要（米国の隔離施設計画）。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチンなし）による東部コンゴの大規模流行。ウガンダへの越境感染を確認。国内避難民約100万人が接触追跡を困難にしている。米国がケニアのLaikipia Air Baseに隔離施設を計画中だが、地元の反発で進行中断。ケニアは対象国だが、記事の主題は東部コンゴの流行であるため verified_locations にはDRCのみ含める。

article.articleHeadline: Two babies from Congo orphanage die of Ebola
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak rooted in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Ituri province has expanded to North and South Kivu and across border areas into Uganda. Total confirmed infections exceed 600 with over 110 deaths. Two babies from a Congo orphanage have died of Ebola, underscoring severe impact on vulnerable populations. Health workers face safety risks amid ongoing conflict, while supply shortages and distrust of isolation units erode response capacity. Uganda has reported regional spillover cases, illustrating cross-border transmission and testing international response. International funding remains a critical bottleneck, contributing to delays in deploying vaccination and antiviral measures and complicating logistics. The situation is driven by strained health systems, restricted humanitarian access, and persistent funding gaps; authorities urge monitoring of case counts and rapid funding commitments while containment and vaccination strategies evolve.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの孤児院から2人の赤ちゃんがエボラで死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準5項目すべてに該当する。Bundibugyo株エボラ感染症の確認患者600超・死亡者110超、国境越えの拡大、脆弱層への深刻な影響、国際資金不足による対応障害が明確であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（Ituri、South Kivu州）を主要発生地点として記述し、ウガンダへの国境越え拡大を言及しているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに未含。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。孤児院での小児死亡、保健労働者の安全リスク、供給不足、国際資金不足による対応障害などが強調されており、緊急対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Deaths in Brazil raise concerns about India's dengue vaccine, DengiAll
article.articleSummary: Two deaths in Brazil during its dengue vaccination campaign led to the suspension of Butantan-DV on June 8, prompting scrutiny of India’s forthcoming DengiAll. Both vaccines are live, attenuated, tetravalent dengue vaccines derived from NIH TV003/TV005, intended to protect against DENV-1–4. Antibody-dependent enhancement (ADE) remains a concern: cross-reactive antibodies can block infection at high levels but may enhance disease if those levels wane. In Brazil, 42 vaccine recipients experienced serious side effects; two died and one required intensive care, with severe abdominal pain, vomiting, and bleeding—events not disclosed in published phase 3 data. These cases raise questions about true tetravalency and ADE risk for Butantan-DV and whether DengiAll could face similar issues. Dengvaxia’s history showed serotype-skewed protection and severe adverse events after vaccination. Panacea Biotec’s DengiAll Phase 3 enrolled 10,335 participants, began August 2024, with two-year follow-up; results will inform India’s regulatory review.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルの死亡例がインドのデングワクチン「DengiAll」に懸念をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのデングワクチン（Butantan-DV）で死亡例および重篤有害事象が発生し、インドの承認待ちワクチン（DengiAll）の安全性を含む公衆衛生上の懸念が生じている。予期しない重篤事象、医療・規制上の対応の必要性、国際的な関心の高さがスクリーニング基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 本イベントはワクチン安全性に関する重要なシグナルである。ブラジルでの死亡例・重篤有害事象（42件の重篤副反応、死亡2例、ICU入院1例）、インドで承認待ちのDengiAllとの関連性の懸念、Dengvaxia の過去の問題との比較など、多くの規制・公衆衛生上の課題を含む。国際的な医療・規制当局の関心が高く、インドの規制当局による緊急対応の必要性が予想される。

article.articleHeadline: Locals claim three children hurt in monkey attacks at Manesar society
article.articleSummary: Locals in Lakshmi Society, Manesar report a rising urban monkey menace, with at least three children aged 3–12 bitten or attacked in the past 15 days. The latest incident involved a six-year-old boy attacked while returning from tuition; he received a tetanus shot and the first dose of anti-rabies vaccine and will complete four additional doses. Monkeys reportedly enter the residential complex, parks, balconies and common areas, sometimes entering homes and damaging flowerpots, prompting fear and restricting outdoor activity for children and seniors. Residents filed complaints with the Municipal Corporation of Manesar (MCM) and other departments seeking trapping and relocation; they say action has not been taken, despite months of assurances. MCM joint commissioner Puneet said the matter would be looked into and asked residents to write in; forest department officials declined to comment, noting urban monkeys fall outside their jurisdiction.

triage.headline_ja: マネサル住宅団地の猿による攻撃で3人の子どもが負傷したと住民が主張
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病とテタヌスの潜在的曝露が確認されるが、実際の確定症例がなく、主に都市部の動物被害管理の問題として報告されている。スクリーニング基準複数該当だが情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はマネサル地域での野生猿による複数の咬傷事件を報告しており、狂犬病とテタヌスの潜在的リスクがある。被害者は予防的にワクチンを接種済みだが、確定症例は報告されていない。継続的な曝露リスク（複数の子どもが攻撃される）と自治体の対応遅延が懸念される。地域限定的な獣医衛生・公衆衛生問題であり、国際的拡大リスクは低い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Records 72 New Ebola Cases In 24 Hours
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has reached 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, with 72 new infections recorded in the last 24 hours. The outbreak remains concentrated in Ituri province (over 90% of cases) with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border spread to Uganda. The infection began earlier than confirmed, with first confirmation on 15 May; actual infections are believed higher; contact tracing coverage fallen to 56% week-on-week. As of 12 June, WHO reported 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, signaling a sharp rise in reported figures over two days. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists for Bundibugyo strain; 56 recoveries; case fatality rate around 23%. Nearly one million people displaced by conflict in Ituri, hindering tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国が24時間で72人の新たなエボラ患者を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。重篤な公衆衛生影響（782確定例、181死亡）、予想外の急速な拡大（72時間新規感染）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境感染）、渡航制限リスクを示唆。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（ブンディブギョ株）による大規模アウトブレイク。接触者追跡カバー率が56%に低下、武力紛争により約100万人が国内避難民化しており対応困難。越境感染（ウガンダ）も確認。緊急対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ngày ASEAN phòng, chống sốt xuất huyết: 3 việc cần làm để phòng bệnh hiệu quả
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ASEAN Dengue Prevention and Control Day: 3 Actions to Effectively Prevent Dengue
article.articleSummary: ASEAN Dengue Prevention and Control Day on June 15 emphasizes raising awareness and effective community action against dengue fever. Each year, the day provides Southeast Asian countries an opportunity to boost public awareness and implement preventive measures to curb dengue transmission. To observe the day, individuals should elevate awareness and proactively adopt preventive practices to protect themselves, their families, and society. The article frames the event as a regional effort, with the title noting three actions to prevent dengue, while the text focuses on awareness and practical prevention. It emphasizes awareness-raising and community action rather than reporting outbreak data. Source: Vietnam News Agency (TTXVN/Vietnam+). Published June 15, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ASEAN デング熱予防・制御の日：デング熱を効果的に予防するための3つのアクション
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はASEANのデング熱予防啓発キャンペーン日についての一般的な予防情報であり、具体的なアウトブレイク、異常な患者増加、または感染症危機を報告していない。
triage.notes: 記事はASEAN地域のデング熱予防啓発イベント（毎年6月15日）に関する通常の公衆衛生情報であり、シグナル検知対象ではない。アウトブレイク報告、患者数増加、異常な疾病パターン、または地域的危機の兆候は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Lagos activates operation BioShield against Ebola, says no case recorded
article.articleSummary: Lagos State activates Operation Lagos BioShield, a statewide emergency public awareness campaign to strengthen surveillance and prevent possible importation of Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) amid fresh outbreaks in East and Central Africa. As of 2026-06-15, there is no confirmed EVD case in Lagos or Nigeria, and the campaign is described as preventive to keep the state ahead of any threat. Outbreaks involve the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola in parts of the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, for which there is no widely available licensed vaccine or specific antiviral treatment. Emphasis is placed on prevention, early detection, rapid isolation, and supportive medical care as the most effective safeguards, plus public education to curb panic and stigma. Transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, bodily fluids, or contaminated materials of a symptomatic infected person, not casual contact.

triage.headline_ja: ラゴス州がエボラウイルス対策「オペレーション・バイオシールド」を発動、症例は報告されていないと発表
triage.triage_reason: 東中央アフリカ（DRC、ウガンダ）でのエボラ集団発生は重大だが、ナイジェリア（ラゴス州）では現在症例がなく予防段階。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: ラゴス州での症例なしのため、記事の主題は予防措置であるが、根因となるDRCおよびウガンダでのエボラ発生は重大。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。DRC での Bundibugyo 株の確認は IHR 基準を満たすが、ナイジェリア国内での影響は現在のところ限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Lonjakan Kasus Ebola di Republik Demokratik Kongo Capai 782 Kasus, 181 Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Surge in Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 782 cases, with 181 deaths.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 782 confirmed cases, with 181 deaths, reflecting one of the largest daily increases—72 new cases in 24 hours. The outbreak remains centered in three eastern provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, where transmission appears to be expanding within internal zones. For the first time, confirmed cases have been reported in two health zones outside previous hotspots: Nia-Nia in Ituri and Mabalako in North Kivu. Within provinces, Ituri now reports cases across 20 of its 36 health zones, North Kivu across 10 of 34 zones, and South Kivu in one zone. The spread, though geographically limited to the three provinces, indicates intensified local transmission. The Ebola virus disease is known for high fatality, underscoring sustained public health risk in eastern DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ患者数の急増が782例に達し、181人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で、致死率が高く、地理的拡大が続いている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は致死率が高く（23.1%）、確認患者数が782例で24時間に72例の新規患者が報告されている。発生地域は東部の3州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）に限定されているが、新しい感染地域への拡大が報告されている（Nia-Nia、Mabalako）。国内支援の不十分性と国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus Ebola di Kongo Mencapai 782 Orang, 181 di Antaranya Meninggal Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Kongo have reached 782 people, 181 of whom have died.
article.articleSummary: As of June 15, 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Kongo region has escalated to 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths (approximately 23% fatality), with 56 recoveries. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo virus, a rare strain with no approved vaccine or treatment, unlike Zaire. Confirmed cases began May 15, and contact tracing coverage stands at 56%, down from the prior week. Over 90% of cases are in Ituri province ( eastern Kongo), with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu, and cross-border spread to Uganda. Ongoing conflict in Ituri has displaced nearly one million people, hindering tracing as people move. Attacks on health workers and local mistrust, along with armed clashes, complicate containment. The outbreak remains centered in Ituri but has crossed provincial borders.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例が782人に達し、うち181人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症（Bundibugyo株）の急速な拡大で782例・181死亡、国境を越えてウガンダへ拡大。IHR基準4項目すべて該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響・国際的拡大・予防策不十分と判断される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC内での発生が主題であり、ウガンダへの国境越え拡大は記載されているがウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo株はZaire株と異なり承認されたワクチンがなく、接触者追跡率56%と不十分。紛争による人口流動と保健従事者への攻撃が封じ込めを困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Public Urged to Use Mosquito Nets, Practise Hygiene Against Malaria
article.articleSummary: Malaria prevention urged in Keta Municipality, Volta Region, Ghana, with authorities calling for consistent use of insecticide-treated nets and good personal hygiene to curb transmission. Malaria, caused by Plasmodium parasites and transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes, remains a leading cause of illness and death in Africa, disproportionately affecting children under five and pregnant women. Symptoms include high fever with chills, severe headaches, body pains, nausea, vomiting, sweating, and fatigue. Complications include severe anaemia, cerebral malaria with seizures, kidney and liver failure, and low birth weight or premature delivery in pregnancy, with death more likely in young children. Preventive measures: nets, clearing stagnant water, indoor residual spraying, wearing long sleeves during evenings, and prompt medical care. Pregnant women should receive antenatal care and intermittent preventive treatment, plus iron and folic acid. Avoid self-medication to prevent resistance; authorities will intensify campaigns and net distributions during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: マラリア対策としての蚊帳利用と衛生習慣の実践を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ガーナのケタ自治体でのマラリア予防啓発キャンペーンの記事であり、新規感染症アウトブレイク、異常な事例集積、または重症化傾向を示す証拠がない。既知の地域風土病に対する定期的な予防啓発であり、IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれにも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はガーナのケタ自治体におけるマラリア予防啓発キャンペーンを報道しています。具体的な患者数増加、異常な疫学パターン、国際的拡大の懸念、または重症化の証拠は示されていません。これはアフリカの風土病地域における通常の公衆衛生啓発活動であり、シグナルピックアップの対象外です。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus: कांगो में इबोला के मामले बढ़कर 782 हुए, अब तक 181 लोगों की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Virus: In Congo, Ebola cases have risen to 782, with 181 deaths so far.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Congo has reached 782 confirmed Ebola cases with 181 deaths, according to the Ministry of Health via social media. The outbreak was confirmed on May 15, and authorities warn that the true number of infections may be much higher, as surveillance is imperfect. Contact tracing among exposed individuals stands at 56 percent, a sharp drop from the previous week. This event is caused by the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is currently no approved vaccine or specific treatment. So far, 56 people have recovered, and the case fatality rate is about 23 percent. The report notes uncertainty about when transmission began, suggesting it may have started weeks earlier.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス: コンゴでエボラ患者が782人に増加、これまでに181人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスのアウトブレイクで確認患者782人、死亡181人（致死率約23%）、ワクチン・治療法なし、濃厚接触者追跡が56%に低下している深刻な状況であり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラウイルスは稀な病原体で承認済みワクチン・治療法がない。監視体制が不完全であり実際の感染数がより多い可能性がある。濃厚接触者追跡率の急激な低下（前週比）は対応能力の懸念を示唆する。5月15日に確認されたアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: The Ebola epidemic in the Congo: Nearly 1 month since the declaration of the Public Health Emergency of International Concern
article.articleSummary: May 17, 2026, the World Health Organization declared the Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in central Africa a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. By 2026-06-15, at least 708 confirmed cases and 141 deaths across Uganda and the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC): Uganda with 19 confirmed infections and 2 deaths; DRC with 689 confirmed cases and 139 deaths. Apparent declines in suspected cases reflect surveillance collapse rather than containment, while confirmed case counts rise and contact tracing rates have fallen to as low as 28%. The outbreak’s epicenter is northeastern DRC, with the Bundibugyo virus infiltrating crowded displacement camps such as Kpangba (~30,000 residents), where fatalities have been reported. UN agencies warn of a spike in child infections as transmission shifts to households; malnutrition in Ituri Province and high zero-dose vaccination rates heighten mortality risk. Past studies note unsafe burials can drive transmission, underscoring the explosive potential in densely populated, resource-poor settings.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行：国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言から約1ヶ月
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準の4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo Ebolavirus流行は708確認例・141死亡（致死率19.9%）で重篤であり、WHOが国際的懸念事項の公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言済み。ウガンダとDRCの2ヶ国での確認と国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限の可能性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのBundibugyo Ebolavirus流行を中心に記述。ウガンダでも19例の確認例があるが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれていないため除外。DRCは689確認例・139死亡で流行の94%以上を占める。北東部DRC（Ituri Province）の難民キャンプでの感染拡大、接触者追跡率の低下（28%）、子どもへの感染シフト、予防接種未実施率の高さなどが懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: എബോള വൈറസ്; രോഗബാധിതരും മരണനിരക്കും ഉയർന്നെന്ന് കോംഗോ ആരോഗ്യ മന്ത്രാലയം | Ebola virus; Health ministry of Congolese says cases and deaths are rising
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus; Congolese Health Ministry says the number of infections and the death toll are rising.
article.articleSummary: As of June 15, 2026, an Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 782 confirmed infections and 181 deaths, with international health agencies estimating higher true numbers. Ituri province accounts for about 90% of cases, while North Kivu and South Kivu are also affected; cross-border spread has reached Uganda. The outbreak was officially confirmed on May 15, though authorities say transmission began weeks earlier. The Bundibugyo virus strain circulating currently has no approved vaccines or proven treatments. Recoveries total 56, yielding a case fatality rate of 23%. Internal conflict in Ituri has displaced around 1 million people, and ongoing violence, forests, and poor road access hinder response, contact tracing, and reaching rural communities, complicating containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス；コンゴ保健省は感染者数と死亡者数が増加していると述べている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスの確定症例782件、死亡181件、ウガンダへの国際的拡大を伴う大規模アウトブレイクであり、即座にフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの国際的拡大が記事に明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCにおけるエボラアウトブレイクが記事の主題であり、感染者782名、死亡者181名、ケース死亡率23%、内戦による150万人の避難民、ワクチンと承認済み治療法の欠如など、複数の深刻なリスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला के मामले बढ़कर 782 हुए, अब तक 181 लोगों की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo rise to 782, with 181 deaths so far
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, reports Ebola infections rising to 782 with 181 deaths as of June 15, according to the health ministry on social media. The true toll may be higher, as the outbreak was confirmed on May 15 but transmission likely began weeks earlier. Contact tracing performance has fallen to 56% from the previous week. The latest outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain for which there is no approved vaccine or specific treatment. So far, 56 people have recovered, yielding a case-fatality rate of about 23% for this outbreak. No details are provided on the infection source or exported/imported cases. The information underscores ongoing transmission risk in the DRC and highlights gaps in containment, including surveillance and deployment of countermeasures for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラの症例が782件に増加、これまでに181人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病による複数の死亡例、接触者追跡効果の低下（56%）、ワクチン未承認の希少株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による爆発的な増加傾向が確認され、IHR基準3つ以上該当。国際的な懸念を喚起する重大な公衆衛生事象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（希少株）による爆発流行であり、ワクチン未承認・治療法未確立の点で極めて深刻。接触者追跡効果の劇的な低下（56%）はコントロール喪失の兆候。真の感染者・死亡者数がさらに高い可能性があることも指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Virus: कांगो में इबोला के मामले बढ़कर 782 हुए, अब तक 181 लोगों की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola virus: Ebola cases in Congo have risen to 782, with 181 deaths so far.
article.articleSummary: As of June 15, 2026, Ebola cases in Congo have risen to 782 with 181 deaths and 56 recoveries. The outbreak, confirmed on May 15, is linked to the rare Bundibugyo virus; there is no approved vaccine or treatment. The case fatality rate is about 23%. Contact tracing among contacts stands at 56%, a sharp drop from last week, indicating surveillance gaps. The health ministry said these figures on social media and noted that the true number of infections may be higher because the outbreak is believed to have started weeks earlier. This underscores the ongoing Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス：コンゴのエボラ症例が782件に増加、これまでに181人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された流行で、782例の症例と181人の死亡が報告されている。IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当する重大なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの流行であり、症例数と死亡数が継続増加中。接触者追跡率が56%に低下し、監視体制に懸念あり。実感染者数がさらに多い可能性が報告されており、早急なフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Australia Aids Indonesia in Livestock Disease Fight
article.articleSummary: Australia is assisting Indonesia in responding to an ongoing lumpy skin disease outbreak in Bali. The government is providing up to A$1 million in vaccines and technical support to help protect Indonesia's livestock and reduce the risk of incursion into Australia. Australia has delivered more than 1.4 million lumpy skin disease vaccines to Indonesia since 2022 and invested over A$4 million through CSIRO's Australian Centre for Disease Preparedness to bolster Indonesian laboratories, surveillance, and training for animal diseases in the region. This effort supports the National Lumpy Skin Disease Action Plan and follows Australia’s commitment of substantial biosecurity funding (more than A$2 billion). Delivery by DFAT and technical support by DAFF aim to safeguard Australia's $100 billion agriculture, fisheries and forestry industries, and to mitigate regional threats while LSD is not a human health risk.

triage.headline_ja: オーストラリア、インドネシアの家畜疾病対策を支援
triage.triage_reason: バリ島での口蹄疫様疾病（Lumpy Skin Disease）の発生は対象地域で確認されているが、動物疾病であり人獣共通感染症ではなく、公衆衛生への直接的な影響がない。国際的な家畜防疫対応としての重要性は高いが、感染症危機管理の対象外。
triage.notes: Lumpy Skin Disease（牛疱疹様皮膚炎）は家畜に限定された動物疾病であり、人への感染リスクはない。記事が明示している通り『LSD is not a human health risk』。したがって、感染症危機管理・公衆衛生の観点からはトリアージ対象外。家畜防疫のための国際協力の事例として政治的関心は存在するが、EBS活動の守備範囲外。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo khả năng xuất hiện đại dịch toàn cầu mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: The Potential Emergence of a New Global Pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Diphtheria cases are rising in Australia, marking one of the most notable outbreaks in years. Globally, Ebola has infected hundreds in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with fatalities and ongoing health and security challenges. Avian influenza H5N1 has spread widely among animals and caused some human infections, though there is no proven human-to-human transmission yet; officials continue close monitoring. Epidemiologists estimate the annual risk of a COVID-19–like pandemic at about 2%, with lifetime cumulative risk remaining high. Australia’s post-COVID-19 preparedness—stronger CDC, dedicated isolation facilities, domestic vaccine production, and stockpiles—could enable rapid responses, but experts warn complacency could erode readiness. Challenges include waning vaccination rates, misinformation on social media, and re-emergence of controlled diseases. Kenya emphasizes hospital readiness and rapid-response teams to detect, contain, and limit Ebola outbreaks, though hospital avoidance complicates response.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：新しい世界的パンデミックの出現の可能性
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数の対象国（DRC、ウガンダ）でエボラ出血熱の流行と多数の死亡が報告されており、H5N1ヒト感染も確認。国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事ではオーストラリアのジフテリア、DRC・ウガンダのエボラ出血熱、複数国のH5N1感染が報告されている。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。オーストラリアはジフテリア流行の話題だが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。エボラ出血熱の死亡者報告と継続的な流行で重症度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 'Swat' ops: Yamunanagar brings malaria cases to zero - The Tribune
article.articleSummary: Malaria in Yamunanagar district has been brought to zero so far in 2026, with no cases reported to date, following a steady decline from 21 cases in 2019 to 3 (2020), 4 (2021), 1 (2022), 1 (2023), 2 (2024), and 3 (2025). All 2025 cases were linked to persons arriving from other states, indicating no local transmission. Deputy Civil Surgeon-cum-District Malaria Officer Dr Sushila Saini credits sustained public health interventions, sanitation improvements under Swachh Bharat Abhiyan, and community participation. Vector control includes biological releases of Gambusia fish in 513 ponds (including four urban ponds) to curb larvae, pre-monsoon site identification, and anti-larval measures. The district is also conducting dengue surveillance and deploying 35 domestic breeding checkers from June to November to inspect for Aedes breeding. Residents are urged to eliminate stagnant water, cover storage tanks, and maintain cleanliness to sustain malaria and dengue control.

triage.headline_ja: 「スワット」作戦：ヤムナーナガル地区、マラリア症例をゼロに削減 - The Tribune
triage.triage_reason: マラリア症例が2026年ゼロ件と大幅に削減されており、これは公衆衛生の成功事例である。異常・予想外性、深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、制限措置の必要性のいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: この記事は感染症の流行ではなく、公衆衛生介入による疾病制御の成功を報じている。マラリア症例の削減傾向は継続しており、2026年ゼロ件達成は肯定的な展開である。デング熱のサーベイランス強化も計画段階であり、現在の発生事例なし。シグナル対象外。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو: ارتفاع إصابات الإيبولا إلى 782 حالة و181 وفاة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo: Ebola infections rise to 782 cases and 181 deaths.
article.articleSummary: 782 confirmed Ebola cases and 181 deaths (case fatality rate 23.1%), with 40 recoveries, in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as of 2026-06-15. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment, unlike Zaire. Over 90% of cases are in Ituri Province in eastern DRC, with spillover into North and South Kivu and across the Uganda border. Improved detection stems from community reporting, but contact tracing has dropped to 56%, signaling field challenges since the outbreak was announced on May 15 after weeks of suspicion. Containment is hampered by armed conflict, displacement, limited access to remote villages, weak infrastructure, and movement of artisanal miners.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ：エボラ感染者が782例、死亡者181人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株による大規模多国家流行で、ウガンダへの越境拡大が確認され、管理困難な状況。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC（South Kivu Province, Ituri Provinceなど）での大規模流行が主題。Uganda への越境確認ありがBluedot APIで付与されたUgandaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。Bundibugyo株でワクチン未承認、接触者追跡率56%に低下、武装紛争による管理困難性が深刻。フルRRA実施を強く推奨。

article.articleHeadline: DBD di Indonesia Masih Jadi Ancaman, Pakar UMY Tawarkan Solusi Berbasis Analisis Spasial
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue Fever in Indonesia Still Poses a Threat, UMY Expert Offers Solutions Based on Spatial Analysis.
article.articleSummary: Dengue Fever remains a persistent public health challenge in Indonesia, with traditional control methods focusing on vector elimination, fogging, and patient care. Prof. Tri Wulandari Kesetyaningsih of Universitas Muhammadiyah Yogyakarta presented a spatially explicit approach using Geographically Weighted Regression (GWR) to map dengue risk from an ecological vector perspective, at UMY in Yogyakarta on June 13. She argues that risk is highly local; neighboring areas can have markedly different case timing and intensity due to local environmental, population, cleanliness, and Aedes aegypti vector factors. Uniform policies across districts are thus less effective. GWR enables pinpointing local factors most associated with dengue emergence, guiding targeted distribution of medical logistics, budget allocation, and focal fogging. She also highlights cross-disciplinary collaboration—public health, epidemiology, climatology, and digital mapping—to develop an early warning system that detects potential surges before outbreaks, enhancing rapid preventive action as of 2026-06-15.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシアのデング熱はまだ脅威であり、UMY専門家が空間分析に基づく解決策を提供
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのデング熱は風土病的な公衆衛生課題だが、本記事は専門家による予防的アプローチの学術的提案が中心であり、急性の発生イベント（新規症例数増加、死亡、異常な拡大など）を示す具体的なシグナルが欠けている。情報不足のため経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアのデング熱が継続的な課題であることを述べており、WPROスクリーニング基準の「長期曝露」「流行しやすさ」に該当する。ただし、現在の流行の重症度、症例数、死亡数などの具体的データがなく、専門家による予防法提案が主内容である。急性の発生シグナルではなく、慢性的な公衆衛生課題の認識と対策強化の提案。社会的関心は存在するが、IHR基準は満たさず、情報不足により WATCH 判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: コンゴ反政府勢力の「紛争鉱物」中国で精錬...収入は月1・2億円に　エボラ拡大にも関係か
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo rebel groups' 'conflict minerals' smelted in China... monthly income of 120 million yen; possibly linked to the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Global Witness, in a June 10 report, states that coltan from eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is smelted in China, with the Rubaya mine in North Kivu province under M23 rebel control and routed via Rwanda. Coltan, a tantalum ore used in smartphones, funds rebel activities, and monitoring frameworks to curb conflict minerals are not functioning. The operation is estimated to bring in about 120 million yen per month. The report raises questions about a possible link to the expansion of the Ebola outbreak in the region. The cross-border route implicates Rwanda and China in a supply chain associated with Congo’s resources and conflict dynamics, and highlights concerns over resource diversion to fund conflict.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ反政府勢力の「紛争鉱物」中国で精錬...収入は月1・2億円に　エボラ拡大にも関係か
triage.triage_reason: エボラ発生地域（DRC）の確認と異常性は認められるが、記事の主題は紛争鉱物・違法採掘の経済的問題であり、エボラとの因果関係は「可能性」の指摘に留まっている。感染症イベント情報としての具体的な流行状況、患者数、死亡数などが記載されておらず、公衆衛生インパクトの評価が困難。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ流行との『可能性がある』関係を指摘するが、主要な内容は紛争鉱物・違法採掘活動。エボラの具体的な患者数、発症状況、流行規模の記載がなく、感染症イベント情報としての詳細が不足している。DRC のみが対象国として verified_locations に含まれる（Burundi, Rwanda, China は地政学的に関連するが、記事の主題となるエボラ発生地ではない）。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo khả năng xuất hiện đại dịch toàn cầu mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: The potential emergence of a new global pandemic.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, experts warn of a looming global pandemic. Diphtheria cases are rising in Australia, while the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda report hundreds of Ebola infections with several deaths. The H5N1 avian influenza virus has spread among animals worldwide with some spillovers to humans, though no confirmed human-to-human transmission yet. Epidemiologists estimate the annual risk of a COVID-19-scale pandemic at about 2%, with lifetime risk accumulating over time. Professor Adrian Esterman of the University of Adelaide calls the probability “very high” for the future and says containment measures—border controls, isolation, contact tracing, and lockdowns—could reappear. Australia has strengthened readiness via enhanced CDC activity, isolation facilities, domestic vaccine production, and stockpiles, but challenges remain: uneven vaccination, misinformation, and resurgence risks for controlled diseases. The message is clear: a next pandemic is likely long term; nations must maintain robust health systems, full vaccination, and accurate public information.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：新たな世界的パンデミックの可能性の出現
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。複数の高リスク感染症（Ebola、H5N1、ジフテリア）が同時に報告され、パンデミック警告が発出されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はパンデミック警告であり、実際の感染症イベントはDRC（Ebola数百例+数件の死亡）とウガンダ（Ebola報告）で報告されている。オーストラリアはジフテリア増加を報告しているが、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに未含。H5N1は動物での拡大が主で人での確認事例は明記されていない。Bluedot APIが付与した3国のうち、対象国リストに該当するのはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Chuyên gia cảnh báo nguy cơ đại dịch toàn cầu mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Experts warn of the risk of a new global pandemic.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, experts warn a new global pandemic is likely inevitable. Diphtheria cases are rising in Australia, while DR Congo and Uganda report hundreds of Ebola infections with deaths. Avian influenza H5N1 is widespread in animals worldwide, with several human infections but no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission yet. Epidemiologists estimate roughly a 2% annual risk of a pandemic akin to COVID-19, with lifetime risk accumulating over time. Australia has strengthened post-COVID-19 readiness—CDC-like agency, dedicated quarantine facilities, domestic vaccine production, and stockpiles of medicines and essential equipment—to enable rapid response. Ongoing challenges include declining vaccination in some regions, misinformation, and re-emergence of controlled diseases. The key remains robust health systems, full vaccination, and accurate public information. WHO has reached a principles-based agreement on future pandemic responses, described by Tedros as a “great gift for our grandchildren.”

triage.headline_ja: 専門家が新たな世界的パンデミックのリスクに警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、複数の対象国（DRC、Uganda）でEbola複数例・死亡報告、H5N1の動物界での広がりと人間感染確認により、シグナルとしてフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC、Uganda、Australiaでの複数疾患同時発生を報告しており、Ebolahではなく複合的な感染症危機シグナル。対象国リストのUganda（GeoNames IDなし）は除外。Australiaは対象国外のため除外。DRCのEbola百数十例・死亡は重大なシグナル。H5N1の動物界広がりと人間感染も懸念。WHO合意言及により国際的対応枠組みが進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Tren Kasus Malaria Melonjak hingga 90 Persen di Indonesia Timur, Bagaimana Mengatasinya? Begini Kata Ahli
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria Case Trend Rises by as Much as 90 Percent in Eastern Indonesia; How Can It Be Addressed? Here's What Experts Say.
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a major infectious disease challenge in Indonesia, with Eastern Indonesia bearing the brunt. The Plasmodium parasite, transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes, causes fever, headaches, chills, muscle pains, nausea, and weakness; severe cases may lead to respiratory distress, anemia, organ damage, or altered consciousness. Nationally, malaria cases recently totaled 706,297, with over 90% of infections in Papua, which remains endemic. Prevention must go beyond treatment to include vector control and environmental improvements. APJIPMI president Boyke Arie Pahlevi calls for a science-based approach and community involvement, including cultivation of insect-repellent plants and the use of larvivorous fish in certain waters. He also urges engagement of UMKM, Ekraf, and digital innovation to spearhead field vector control in high-endemic areas like Papua.

triage.headline_ja: インドネシア東部のマラリア感染者が90％まで増加する傾向、どのように対処するか？専門家の意見
triage.triage_reason: インドネシア東部でマラリア症例が90％増加し、国内全体で706,297件の症例報告がある。感染症の異常な増加傾向、中等～重度の臨床症状（呼吸窮迫、貧血、臓器損傷）、長期的な曝露リスクが認められ、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性・重症度・長期曝露・流行性・管理可能性）を複数満たす。
triage.notes: インドネシア東部（特にパプア州）でのマラリア蔓延を主題としており、パプアニューギニアは記事サマリーに明示されていないため verified_locations から除外。症例数706,297件、特にパプアでの90%以上の感染率の報告が重大。ベクター制御と環境改善を含む包括的対策が必要とされており、地域管理の困難性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola outbreak grows to 782 cases, 181 deaths
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo reaches 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths (as of 2026-06-15), with 56 recoveries and a 23% fatality rate. Official confirmation was on May 15; actual caseload likely higher as contact tracing has declined to 56%. Over 90% of infections occur in Ituri Province, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border spread into Uganda. The Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or treatment. Ongoing conflict in Ituri, causing mass displacement (~1 million), difficult terrain, and poor road access, hampers surveillance and tracing. Challenges include monitoring artisanal miners moving between sites, attacks on healthcare workers, and community mistrust, all impeding containment. The report notes international concerns around cross-border transmission and related public health responses, alongside the broader security context hindering outbreak control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラアウトブレイク、782症例181人の死亡に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo strain Ebolaは公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、国際的な国境越え拡大（ウガンダへの患者発生確認）、渡航・貿易制限リスク、異常・予想外の状況が明確である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo strain）の確定診断アウトブレイク。782確定症例、181死亡、23%致命率。ウガンダへの国境越え拡大が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。紛争による大規模な人口移動（約100万人）、医療施設へのアクセス困難、接触者追跡の大幅な低下（56%）により、実際の患者数はさらに多い可能性が高い。ワクチンや承認された治療法がないBundibugyo strainであるため、管理可能性が極めて低い。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội ghi nhận ca viêm não Nhật Bản đầu tiên trong năm: Cha mẹ cần nhớ ngay điều này để bảo vệ con
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi records its first case of Japanese encephalitis this year: Parents should remember this right away to protect their child.
article.articleSummary: Hanoi records its first Japanese encephalitis (JE) case this year: a 13-year-old in Hung Dao commune, Quoc Oai District, is under active treatment. Cumulative JE cases in Hanoi for 2026 total 1, with no deaths; this marks an increase from 2025’s same-period tally. The patient developed symptoms about a week ago. Despite completing three primary vaccine doses, the child did not receive the recommended booster. JE is a mosquito-borne viral infection that can progress from flu-like symptoms (fever, headache, nausea, vomiting, fatigue) to severe CNS disease—encephalitis, brain edema, seizures, altered consciousness, coma, and multi-organ failure. Vaccination is the best prevention: three-base-dose schedule plus a booster every 3–4 years until age 15. Immunity gaps from skipping boosters leave children vulnerable even if they completed the primary series. Vietnam’s Expanded Immunization Program reduced cases but they continue among under-vaccinated groups.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイが今年初の日本脳炎患者を記録：保護者が子どもを守るために今すぐ覚えるべきこと
triage.triage_reason: 日本脳炎は重篤な中枢神経感染症で、予防接種ギャップが問題となっており、WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、長期曝露リスク、流行易感受性）を複数満たし、公衆衛生上の関心も高い。
triage.notes: 日本脳炎は蚊媒介ウイルス感染症で、脳炎、脳浮腫、発作、意識障害、昏睡、多臓器不全へと進行する可能性がある重篤な疾患。2026年のハノイでの初患者は13歳で、予防接種シリーズを完了していたが推奨ブースター接種を受けていなかった。記事では予防接種ギャップの脆弱性を強調しており、保護者向けの教育メッセージが含まれている。ベトナムの定期予防接種プログラムは患者数を減らしたが、予防接種不十分な集団での継続発生が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Hà Nội ghi nhận ca viêm não Nhật Bản, cần chủ động phòng bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hanoi records a case of Japanese encephalitis; proactive prevention measures are needed.
article.articleSummary: Hanoi reports its first Japanese encephalitis (JE) case in 2026: a 13-year-old resident of Hung Dao commune, Hanoi (in the former Quoc Oai district) is receiving intensive care. The child had completed the 3-dose primary JE vaccine but had not received recommended boosters, leaving waning protection. JE is transmitted via mosquitoes, mainly Culex; pigs and some birds act as natural hosts. Transmission is seasonal, peaking May–September. Early symptoms resemble other viral illnesses; progression can include seizures, altered consciousness, neck stiffness, respiratory issues, and coma. Case fatality is high without timely treatment, and survivors may suffer long-term cognitive or motor sequelae. Prevention hinges on full vaccination with boosters every 3–4 years until age 15, plus mosquito control measures: bed nets, long sleeves, repellents, and removal of standing water. From January 2026 to June 15, Hanoi has 1 JE case and no deaths, higher than 2025 when none were recorded.

triage.headline_ja: ハノイが日本脳炎の患者を確認、積極的な予防対策が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で重症度と国際拡大リスクが該当（2/4）。WPROスクリーニング基準で異常性、重症度、流行リスクが該当（3/5）。ベトナムは対象国かつJEは公衆衛生上重要な再興感染症である。
triage.notes: 2026年のハノイにおけるJE患者報告は異常（2025年はゼロ）。患者は予防接種済みであるが追加接種が不足していた。JEは蚊媒介で季節性あり（5月～9月がピーク）、致死率が高く長期後遺症のリスク有。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: South Africa's Afrigen eyes Ebola vaccine role after landmark GMP certification
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Bundibugyo Ebola strain outbreak crossing into Uganda spurs vaccine development proposals, with South Africa’s Afrigen among rivals to create an effective vaccine. No vaccine exists for Bundibugyo; CEPI issued a call for proposals. Afrigen’s Cape Town facility became Africa’s first end-to-end mRNA production site after GMP certification in late May 2026, enabling rapid GMP material production and small-volume outbreak stockpiles. The effort highlights vaccine inequity seen during Covid-19, where Africa’s vaccination coverage lags behind the US and EU and costs vary. The Medicines Patent Pool, WHO, and the mRNA Technology Transfer Programme—launched in 2021 with Afrigen, Biovac, and SA Medical Research Council—seek to boost regional manufacturing; 15 Global South firms have since been trained. Afrigen has seven vaccine candidates, including Rift Valley fever (no vaccine) and TB; collaborations target multidrug-resistant gonorrhoea. Local ownership and AU procurement aim at sustainability.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカのAfrigen研究所、GMP認証達成後エボラワクチン開発に力を入れる
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のBundibugyo Ebola株がウガンダに越境し、複数の重篤感染症（Ebola、Rift Valley Fever、TB、耐性淋病）の集約的な開発提案が述べられており、国際的ワクチン供給体制の整備が進行中。WPRO異常性および管理可能性基準を満たし、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: DRCのBundibugyo Ebola株がウガンダに拡大している中での南アフリカのワクチン開発提案という文脈。ただしサマリーの主題はワクチン開発・製造能力の構築であり、現在進行中の感染症の急速な拡大リスクよりも、将来的な対応体制整備に焦点がある。複数の重篤感染症（Ebola、RVF、TB、耐性淋病）が同時に論じられており、公衆衛生上の複合リスクが存在する。CEPI提案募集、AU調達、地域製造能力の強化は国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Phụ huynh tìm hiểu về viêm não Nhật Bản qua hoạt động tương tác
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Parents learn about Japanese encephalitis through interactive activities
article.articleSummary: Japanese encephalitis (JE) awareness event on June 6 at Aeon Mall Tan Phu, Ho Chi Minh City, Vietnam, attracted more than 1,000 parents and children to interactive learning stations. The event, organized by the Vietnam Preventive Medicine Association with Zuellig Pharma and Sang Pharma, aimed to raise awareness of JE and the importance of complete vaccination schedules, including booster doses. Interactive stations—Trace the Risks, Build a Protective Dome, and Safety Shield—together with on-site reminders about vaccination timing, encouraged families to review their children's immunization records, as many parents were unsure whether booster doses had been given. The program also emphasized mosquito-bite prevention during the summer. Content was educational and not promotional of any products, and families were advised to consult health facilities for tailored vaccination plans. As of 2026-06-15.

triage.headline_ja: 両親が対話的活動を通じて日本脳炎について学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは日本脳炎の予防啓発活動であり、新規の感染症集団発生やアウトブレイクではない。公衆衛生上の脅威を示す疾病統計や症例数の増加は報告されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事はホーチミンシティで開催された日本脳炎の予防啓発イベント（ワクチン接種啓発キャンペーン）についての報道である。感染症の集団発生、患者報告、または疾病サーベイランスデータの異常を示す情報は含まれていない。ルーチンな公衆衛生教育活動として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Los estropajos y las esponjas son un entorno perfecto para que crezcan microbios
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Scouring pads and sponges are a perfect environment for microbes to grow.
article.articleSummary: Bathroom sponges, dishcloths, and kitchen scourers provide a damp, nutrient-rich niche that sustains bacteria, including Salmonella, Staphylococcus aureus, Campylobacter, Listeria monocytogenes, and Escherichia coli, contaminating kitchens and bathrooms. The global market for sponges and scourers reached $5.7B in 2025 and is projected to $7.2B by 2034. Hot cleaning water (below 45°C) fails to eradicate microbes, and sponges can harbor up to 54 billion bacteria per cubic centimeter. A 1997 US kitchen survey found 33% of sponges positive for E. coli and 67% for fecal coliforms; E. coli, Salmonella, and S. aureus can persist up to 16 days on sponges and 13 days on microfiber cloths. A 2020 university study reported antibiotic-resistant pathogens; a 2025 Hyderabad study showed high cloth contamination with coliforms (98%), S. aureus (84%), Vibrio cholerae (82%), Shigella (74%), Salmonella/E. coli (54%), and Pseudomonas aeruginosa (26%). Six European countries found 16% engage in risky practices; hanging cloths to dry reduces load. Some studies suggest chlorine bleach as a simple mitigation; hot-water machine washes help.

triage.headline_ja: 台所用スポンジや雑巾は微生物の増殖に最適な環境である
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は台所用スポンジ・雑巾の微生物汚染に関する一般的な衛生情報であり、具体的な感染症のアウトブレイク・集団発生を報告していない。スポンジ市場の動向と微生物の一般的な生態に関する教育的コンテンツである。
triage.notes: 記事は過去の研究結果（1997年の米国調査、2020年の大学研究、2025年のハイデラバード研究）を引用しているが、現在進行中のアウトブレイク・集団発生イベントを報告していない。Hyderabad（テランガナ州）が言及されているが、これは過去の研究データの参照であり、現在の感染症イベント発生を示していない。したがって verified_locations は空配列とする。

article.articleHeadline: Personalul medical se luptă să țină sub control epidemia de Ebola în taberele din Congo. Locuitorii sunt furioși, nu cred în virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Medical staff are struggling to keep the Ebola outbreak under control in the camps in Congo. Locals are furious, they do not believe in the virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo across Ituri, South Kivu and North Kivu, with the Nizi area highlighted as a densely populated mining zone. Described as one of the largest Ebola outbreaks in history, it has left more than 5 million people displaced across the three affected provinces. Medical camps and aid workers, including WHO personnel, have faced violent backlash from locals who deny the virus’s role in deaths. Two women are reported to have died from Ebola, according to Reuters. Ongoing containment is threatened by fear and hostility, as crowded camps share limited sanitation (hundreds per toilet; open defecation) which accelerates transmission within camps and to other refugee sites. Attacks on medical teams and facilities further hinder response, contact tracing, and case management.

triage.headline_ja: 医療スタッフがコンゴのキャンプでエボラ感染症のアウトブレイクを抑制しようと奮闘。地元住民は激怒し、ウイルスを信じていない
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5つ全てに該当。500万人以上の国内避難民を含む大規模なエボラアウトブレイク、医療チームへの暴力的バックラッシュ、および限定的なサニテーション設備による急速な感染拡大の脅威が特定されている。
triage.notes: 記事は複数州（Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu）にまたがる大規模エボラアウトブレイクを報告。医療対応に対する住民の不信と暴力的抵抗は、感染症管理能力と公衆衛生上の懸念を大幅に低下させている。キャンプ内のサニテーション不全（数百人が1トイレを共用、屋外排泄）は感染拡大を加速させている。IHR通知および即座なフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: السلطات الكونغولية: وفاة 181 شخصا وإصابة 782 بفيروس إيبولا - بوابة الشروق
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congolese authorities: 181 dead and 782 infected with Ebola virus - Shorouk Portal
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths reported, with 56 recoveries and a 23% case-fatality rate. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare species with no licensed vaccine or therapy, unlike Zaire ebolavirus which has been associated with most prior DRC epidemics. The vast majority of cases (over 90%) are in Ituri province in eastern DRC, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border spread to Uganda. About one million people have been displaced in Ituri due to conflict, complicating contact tracing amid forested terrain, poor roads, and remote villages, as well as movement by thousands of artisanal miners. The outbreak was confirmed on May 15. In a related note, the United States discussed relocating Americans exposed to Ebola to a new 50-bed quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base in Kenya, a plan that provoked protests and was halted by courts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国当局：エボラウイルスで181人死亡、782人感染 - シェルーク・ポータル
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラウイルスの急速な拡大、高い致死率（23%）、国境越えの感染、ワクチン未開発の稀有な株による発生は重大な国際公衆衛生上の脅威であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にLaikipia（ケニア）とUganda、USAが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主体はDRCでのエボラ発生。ウガンダへの国境越え感染が報告されているが、主要な流行地はDRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu。Laikipia Air Base（ケニア）はアメリカ人の隔離施設候補であり、実際の発生地ではない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀有株）でワクチン未開発の点、約100万人の難民・鉱夫による移動による拡大リスク、接触者追跡の困難性（森林地形、悪路、辺境村落）が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: What we should know about Ebola - WhyAfrica
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak active in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri (Bunia, Mongbwalu, Rwampara) with cases also in North and South Kivu and Uganda; World Health Organization declared a global health emergency on 17 May 2026. Incubation 2–21 days (typically 5–9); early symptoms are flu-like (fever, malaise) progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, rash, and sometimes bleeding. Historically about 50% case fatality, but early aggressive fluids and supportive care improve survival. Not airborne; transmission occurs by direct contact with infected bodily fluids; natural reservoir includes fruit bats and primates (bushmeat). No licensed vaccine or antiviral for Bundibugyo strain; existing Ebola vaccines/drugs for other strains are not expected to work. Early recognition and rapid transfer to specialist care save lives. Travelers should check outbreak maps (NICD, CDC, WHO), monitor 21 days post-return, and report travel details to clinicians; suspected cases require isolation and public health notification; NICD 24-hour Bundibugyo/VHF hotline: 0800 212 552. A fictional travel case illustrates diagnostic challenges in early Ebola.

triage.headline_ja: エボラについて知るべきこと - WhyAfrica
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo株エボラの活発な流行がコンゴ民主共和国東部で進行中であり、WHO が 2026年5月17日にグローバルヘルスエマージェンシーを宣言。IHR基準4つ全て該当、WPRO基準も5つ全て該当し、国際的な重症感染症イベントとして認識される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC（Ituri、Bunia、Mongbwalu、North/South Kivu）が主たる流行地域として記述されており、ウガンダも言及されているがサマリー上での記述は限定的。対象国リストでは DRC のみ該当するため verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo 株エボラは既存ワクチン・抗ウイルス薬が効かない新興脅威として位置づけられ、2026年5月17日のWHO グローバルヘルスエマージェンシー宣言により高いレベルの国際的対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah and Shigella Cases Under Control, Monitoring Continues - The PrimeTime News
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15 in Kerala, Nipah virus and Shigella infections are reported under control after recent concerns. Health officials have intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and preventive measures to contain any possible spread. Hospitals and local health departments remain on high alert, ensuring suspected cases are identified early and treated promptly to prevent escalation. Monitoring continues, with renewed hygiene campaigns and public awareness measures encouraging symptom reporting and adherence to safety guidelines. The state government notes stronger coordination and swift response mechanisms are needed, and Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan has called for a review of outbreak management to bolster health system readiness. Authorities continue to work with medical experts to stay prepared for potential case increases, particularly in affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: ニパールウイルスとシゲラ菌の感染者は管理下にある、監視は継続中
triage.triage_reason: ニパールウイルスの発生であり異常・予想外性があり、WPROスクリーニング基準を満たす可能性があるが、現在「管理下にある」と報告されており、深刻度や国際的拡大リスクの詳細情報が不足しているため。
triage.notes: ニパールウイルス（人畜共通感染症）はWHO懸念病原体であり、ケーラー州での発生は異常性が高い。現在「管理下」との報告だが、詳細な患者数、重症度、死亡率、ヒト-ヒト感染の程度が不明。州首相による対応強化要求から政府の関心は高い。続報を注視し、患者数増加や州境を越えての拡大がないか監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Contracted polio at age 2; Savan set to stand on his feet after studying at IIT
article.articleSummary: Polio contracted at age two left Savan Kumar with roughly 70% locomotor disability in both legs, from Vibhutipur village, Samastipur, Bihar. He moved to Kota's Education City, where Allen Career Institute supported him; he earned AIR 17,532 in JEE Advanced, AIR 22 in the PwD category, and AIR 9 in the OBC-NCL PwD subcategory, with a 99.15 percentile in JEE Main. Allen granted him an 80% scholarship; he previously studied at Simultala Awasiya Vidyalaya (Jamui, Bihar) under a free program from Class 6 to 10 after topping the Bihar Board merit list. From a farming family; father Prabhu Rai works as a sharecropper. Savan aims to study Computer Science at IIT Bombay, IIT Delhi, or IIT Madras and to join the Civil Services to serve the poor. Naveen Maheshwari of Allen highlighted support for talented, needy students. As of 15 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 2歳でポリオに感染したサヴァン、IIT入学後に自立へ向かう
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はポリオの過去感染者の個人的成功事例を扱ったもので、新規の感染症アウトブレイクや公衆衛生上の危機を報告していない。歴史的な個人の障害克服の物語であり、シグナルの要件に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は2026年6月15日の日付を持つが、実際には2020年前後のポリオ感染事例を回顧した人物紹介記事と考えられる。新規の感染症イベント報告ではなく、過去の患者の教育的成功を扱う人間関心記事である。疾患名『Poliomyelitis』は記事サマリーに登場するが、これは個人の病歴であり、進行中の疫学的脅威ではない。

article.articleHeadline: RDC eleva a 181 los fallecidos confirmados a causa del brote de...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC raises the confirmed death toll to 181 due to the outbreak of...
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 782 confirmed cases, 181 deaths, and 40 recoveries as of June 13, 2026. The outbreak, declared in mid-May in the northeast, continues to spread with 72 new cases. Ituri province accounts for the majority (56) with notable cases in Mongbwalu (25), Bunia (13), Rwampara (6), Nyankunde (5), Komanda (3), Nizi (2), Damas (1) and Nia-Nia (1). Health zones Nia-Nia (Ituri) and Mabalako (North Kivu) are newly affected, expanding areas from 29 to 31. The World Health Organization has warned of geographic expansion. triage.headline_ja: DRC、エボラ出血熱の流行で確認死亡者数を181人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認患者数782人、死亡181人という深刻な公衆衛生影響、高い致死率（約50%）、地理的拡大（29～31保健地域に拡大）が認められ、IHR基準の複数該当およびWPRO基準の複数該当により、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで確認される発生地はDRC国内（イトゥリ州、北キブ州など）のみ。Bluedot APIがコスタリカ（San José州など）の地名を誤出力しているが、記事本文にはコスタリカの記載なく除外。ルワンダについても記事中に検査確認の記載がなく、DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: RDCongo.- RDC eleva a 181 los fallecidos confirmados a causa del...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC increases the number of confirmed fatalities to 181 due to ...
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) reach 782 confirmed cases, 181 deaths, and 40 recoveries as of June 13, 2026, with 72 new cases reported. Most new cases are in Ituri Province (56 total), including Mongbwalu (25), Bunia (13), Rwampara (6), Nyankunde (5), Komanda (3), Nizi (2), Damas (1), and Nia-Nia (1). Two new health zones are affected: Nia-Nia village in Ituri and Mabalako rural area in North Kivu, expanding affected areas from 29 to 31. triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）、エボラウイルスによる確認死亡者数を181人に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の大規模アウトブレイク（782確認症例、181死亡）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、地理的拡大中であり、国際的拡散リスクと渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
