article.articleHeadline: La RDC informa que el número de fallecidos confirmados a causa del brote de ébola ha aumentado a 181, con más de 780 casos registrados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The DRC reports that the number of confirmed deaths due to the Ebola outbreak has risen to 181, with more than 780 cases recorded.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is expanding. As of June 13, 2026, the Ministry of Health reports 782 confirmed cases, 181 deaths, and 40 recoveries. Seventy-two new cases were recorded: 56 in Ituri Province and additional cases in Mongbwalu (25), Bunia (13), Rwampara (6), Nyankunde (5), Komanda (3), Nizi (2), Damas (1), and Nia-Nia (1). Affected health zones rise from 29 to 31, with Nia-Nia in Ituri and Mabalako in North Kivu newly impacted. WHO warns the outbreak is expanding across more territories. The case fatality rate is around 50%, with initial fever, fatigue and headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and kidney/liver deterioration. DRC has extensive Ebola experience since 1976 near Yambuku and the Kasai outbreak ended in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: DRCがエボラ出血熱による確認死亡者数が181人に増加したと報告、780件以上の症例が登録された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な拡大（782症例、181死亡、CFR 50%）、複数地域への拡大、および国際的に極めて重大な公衆衛生上の影響を有する。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最も重大な一類感染症で、記事で複数の影響地域（Ituri、North Kivu、Kasai地区など31の保健地域）、高い症例ファチリティレート（約50%）、および継続的な地域的拡大が報告されている。Costa RicaおよびRwandaはBluedot APIの位置情報に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは発生地域として言及されておらず、verified_locationsから除外した。フルRRAに即座に進むべき。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo nguy cơ đại dịch toàn cầu mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: The risk of a new global pandemic.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, health experts warn that the risk of a new global pandemic remains very high. Diphtheria cases are rising again in Australia, signaling a notable resurgence. In the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, hundreds of Ebola cases have been confirmed, with many fatalities, challenging regional health systems and security. Avian influenza H5N1 continues to circulate in animal populations worldwide, with several reported human infections but no sustained human-to-human transmission yet. Epidemiological models estimate the annual probability of a pandemic comparable to COVID-19 at about 2%, increasing over time. While countries, including Australia, have strengthened outbreak response via surveillance upgrades, isolation facilities, stockpiles, and vaccine manufacturing capacity, experts warn that vigilance can wane due to reduced vaccination uptake and misinformation. Strong health system readiness, continued vaccination, and public awareness are deemed essential to mitigate impact if a new pandemic arises.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：新たな世界的パンデミックのリスク
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重大感染症（ジフテリア、エボラ、鳥インフルエンザH5N1）が同時に複数地域で報告されており、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高く、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の重大感染症を扱っており、DRCのエボラ確認例が最も具体的かつ検証可能。オーストラリアのジフテリアおよびウガンダはDRC対象国リストに含まれず。H5N1は世界的な循環を示唆するが、対象国での具体的な人間感染は記載されていない。記事配信日時が2026年6月で未来日付（システム時刻との相違の可能性あり）であるため、情報の最新性確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Girl bitten by dog outside hospital in UP's Muzaffarnagar
article.articleSummary: Muzaffarnagar, UP, Jun 15: A three-year-old girl, Mehrab, was bitten by a dog outside Muzaffarnagar district hospital on Sunday. The child had come from Sherpur village to the hospital after fever. Chief Medical Superintendent Dr. Sanjay Kumar Verma said she was administered a rabies injection following the bite, and he added that a drive to catch roaming dogs will be started soon. The incident, reported by PTI, notes immediate preventive measures after animal exposure, with no further details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or outcomes provided.

triage.headline_ja: アッター・プラデーシュ州ムザッファルナガルの病院外で犬に噛まれた女児
triage.triage_reason: 狂犬病の単一の動物咬傷事例であり、予防措置は実施されているが、症例確認やアウトブレイク指標に関する情報が不足。社会的関心や国際的リスクの判断材料が限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は散発的な動物咬傷事例を報告している。狂犬病ウイルス感染確認なし、症状や検査結果の記載なし。地方当局が野犬捕獲キャンペーン開始を計画しており、ある程度の公衆衛生対応は実施されている。ただし個別事例の報告であり、アウトブレイク指標を示していない。続報で症例確認または複数事例の関連性が判明した場合はPICKUP判定に変更可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo rise to 710 as authorities deny lockdown rumors
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) climbs to 710 confirmed cases and 149 deaths, a case fatality rate of 21.0%. A total of 324 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, and 35 have recovered. Health authorities, with provincial partners and response teams, continue interventions to interrupt transmission, including epidemiological surveillance, patient care, contact tracing, targeted vaccination, risk communication, and community engagement. Rumors of a nationwide lockdown are denied; no lockdown has been ordered and none is under consideration. The World Health Organization notes the outbreak is evolving rapidly with rising case numbers and geographic spread, and cautions that the reported CFR may underestimate mortality because some deaths prior to the outbreak declaration remain under investigation.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数が710人に増加、当局はロックダウン説を否定
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認患者710人、死亡149人という深刻な公衆衛生影響、地理的拡大、国際的懸念があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率（報告CFR 21.0%）を持つ指定感染症。患者数の急速な増加と地理的拡大が報告されており、WHO が危惧を表明。ロックダウン説の否定はエスカレーションコミュニケーション戦略の可能性がある。対象国リスト内の DRC のみを verified_locations に含める。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo khả năng xuất hiện đại dịch toàn cầu mới
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Potential emergence of a new global pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Diphtheria cases are rising in Australia, marking one of the most notable recent outbreaks. In the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, hundreds of Ebola infections have been reported, with several fatalities amid ongoing health and security challenges. Globally, H5N1 avian influenza is spreading in animals and has caused some human infections, but there is no evidence of sustained human-to-human transmission yet. Epidemiologists estimate the annual probability of a pandemic comparable to COVID-19 at about 2%, with cumulative risk increasing over a lifetime. Australia, reflecting on COVID-19, emphasizes strengthened preparedness: a bolstered CDC-equivalent, expanded dedicated quarantine facilities, domestic vaccine production capacity, and stockpiles of medicines and essential medical equipment. Key themes: potential global pandemic, surveillance, and rapid public health response to emerging pathogens.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなグローバルパンデミックの出現可能性に対する警告
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤な感染症（ジフテリア、エボラ、H5N1）が同時に報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「国際的拡大リスク」に該当。パンデミック出現の警告というグローバルな懸念事項であり、社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでオーストラリアのジフテリア、DRCとウガンダのエボラ、グローバルなH5N1が言及されているが、対象国リストに該当するのはDRC（203312）のみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。オーストラリアも対象国外。複数疾患の同時報告とパンデミック警告という性質から、フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Zambia : Chief Mumena Urges Corporate World To Join Malaria Fight
article.articleSummary: Malaria remains a central public health challenge in Zambia's North-Western Province, with provincial data showing malaria incidence around 500 per 1,000 population (about 5 in 10 people diagnosed). Chief Mumena of Kalumbila District urged the corporate sector to partner with government toward elimination by 2030, calling for investment in mosquito nets distribution, mass malaria drug administration, environmental cleanup, and expanded information campaigns. End Malaria Council Chair Godwin Beene said the End Malaria Golf Tournament at Kansanshi Golf Estate in Solwezi District aims to raise funds for malaria awareness and mobilize resources in North-Western Province, with funds accounted for. Chief Environmental Health Officer Francis Nsofwa emphasized ongoing collaboration and that malaria remains a province-wide burden. Spectra Oil sponsor urged CSR investments to eradicate malaria. More than 70 participants attended.

triage.headline_ja: ザンビア：ムメナ酋長がマラリア対策への民間企業参加を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: マラリアはザンビア北西部での既知の風土病であり、記事は啓発キャンペーンと資金調達イベントに焦点を当てており、新たな異常な発生状況や急速な拡大を示す要素がない。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリアの風土性および既知の公衆衛生課題を扱うものであり、新規シグナルではない。北西部での感染率の高さ（1,000人当たり500人）は既知の状況であり、予防・対応戦略に関する報道である。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: un mois après le début de l'épidémie d'Ebola, à Bunia les décès s'enchaînent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: One month after the Ebola outbreak began, deaths mount in Bunia.
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ituri-focused Ebola outbreak, declared May 15 as the seventeenth Ebola epidemic in the country's history, has progressed rapidly. By 15 June 2026, authorities report 782 confirmed Ebola cases, with most in Ituri (95%) per MSF. In Bunia, the regional capital, precise case counts remain unclear; fatalities mount as patients die after short stays at the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE). A 50-year-old gold prospector died the day after admission; his relatives question precise infection links. At Nyamurongo cemetery, routine burials intensify the sense of crisis; six to ten corpses arrive daily, up from three to four. Hospital staff have not yet received confirmatory test results for some patients, complicating diagnosis. MSF warns that the full scale of transmission and the specific zones where the virus circulates remain unknown.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: エボラ流行開始から1ヶ月後、ブニアで死亡者が相次ぐ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確定患者782例、急速な進行、死亡率の上昇、国際的な懸念の高さから、フルのRapid Risk Assessmentに進む必要がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は高い病原性と高い致死率を特徴とし、国境を越えた拡大リスクが高い。イトゥリ地域に集中しているが、ブニアなどの都市部での感染確認により、さらなる地理的拡大の可能性がある。診断検査の遅延と完全な感染経路の把握困難性が管理上の課題となっている。MSFおよび国際社会による支援が継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Tuberkulosis Bisa Menular Sebelum Penderita Menyadarinya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tuberculosis Can Be Transmitted Before the Patient Realizes It
article.articleSummary: Tuberculosis (TB) can be transmitted before coughing or overt symptoms. A Nature Communications study in eastern China’s Jiangsu Province followed over 1,000 household contacts and 560 neighbours of TB patients across four health centers. Contacts were tested with QuantiFERON blood tests and tuberculin skin tests. Results showed about 25% of household contacts tested positive regardless of whether the index patient had symptoms; this rate was more than twice that of unexposed neighbours. Laboratory data indicate that tidal breathing, not only coughing, can release infectious bacilli into the air. The findings imply that symptom-based TB screening—especially cough—misses asymptomatic cases, underscoring the need for non-symptom-based diagnostics such as chest X-ray or broader blood testing. The study also supports offering preventive therapy to all household members living with TB patients, regardless of symptom status.

triage.headline_ja: 結核は患者が気付く前に感染する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: 結核の感染メカニズムに関する科学的知見の報告であり、新規アウトブレイク・緊急事態ではなく、スクリーニング基準1つ（異常/予想外）に該当するが、公衆衛生への直接的な深刻な影響や即時的な国際拡大リスクは明確でない。情報不足による保留判定。
triage.notes: 本記事は中国江蘇省での研究成果報告であり、現在進行中のアウトブレイク警報ではなく、結核の非症候性感染メカニズムに関する科学知見の公開。Bluedot発生地域は正確（China）。スクリーニング基準では「異常/予想外」に該当するが、IHR基準は該当なし。社会的・政治的関心の情報が不足しているため、WATCH判定として続報を注視する。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo says number of confirmed Ebola cases rises to 782
article.articleSummary: DR Congo Ebola outbreak rises to 782 confirmed cases, with 181 deaths, as 72 new cases were documented in the last 24 hours—one of the biggest single-day jumps. The outbreak, Congo’s 17th, remains confined to three eastern provinces: Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. First-time confirmations were reported in Nia-Nia health zone (Ituri) and Mabalako health zone (North Kivu). As of the latest government report, confirmed cases are in 20 of Ituri’s 36 health zones, 10 of North Kivu’s 34 health zones, and one health zone in South Kivu. No infection-source details or imported/exported-case data are provided. Date reference: 2026-06-15.

triage.headline_ja: DRC、確認されたエボラウイルス病の症例数が782件に増加したと発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で死亡182件、24時間で72件の新規症例が報告され、複数州で急速に拡大。国際的な懸念と支援必要性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（高致死性病原体）の大規模流行。782確認症例、181死亡、24時間で72件の新規症例という増加率は緊迫した状況を示唆。3州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）に拡大。感染源・輸出入症例情報は報告されていないため、国外への拡大リスク評価には追加情報が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στο Κονγκό - Φόβοι για μία από τις φονικότερες επιδημίες των τελευταίων ετών
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the Congo - Fears over one of the deadliest epidemics in recent years.
article.articleSummary: Mid-June 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province in eastern DRC, is spreading rapidly. The UN reports 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths, most in Ituri, with WHO noting cases nearly doubling weekly. Severe shortages of equipment and transport, plus ongoing armed conflict, hinder response. Contact tracing is weak: about 600 cases in one region but fewer than 5,000 contacts identified and just over half monitored, raising risk of community transmission; several confirmed patients remain outside hospitals. Health workers are among casualties; at Bunia's treatment center, 5 of 22 inpatients were health workers (including two doctors and one anesthesiologist). Misinformation, distrust, and violence against responders further complicate control; WHO records over 520 safety incidents. Vaccines targeting Bundibugyo strain are under development; some antivirals show potential. An estimated $518 million is needed over six months per WHO-Africa CDC plan; models warn it could approach 2014-2016 West Africa scale if unchecked.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ - 近年の最も致命的な流行の一つに対する懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準すべて該当。アフリカで進行中の大規模エボラ流行であり、緊急のフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（イトゥリ州ブニア）でのエボラ流行に焦点を当てている。アンゴラは発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではアンゴラ関連の言及がないため除外。2026年6月時点で676確認症例、136死亡、週間ベースで症例数が倍増、武装紛争・医療体制不備・接触者追跡の脆弱性など複数の管理上課題を示唆。2014-2016年西アフリカエボラ流行規模への懸念あり。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: 剛果伊波拉疫情升溫破百死　國際最新醫療動態一覽 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo escalates, death toll surpasses 100 — latest international medical updates at a glance.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to intensify. The official tally reports 710 confirmed cases and 149 deaths as of June 15, 2026. WHO and local health authorities are tracing contacts in refugee camps to interrupt transmission, but distrust among residents—who refuse to believe deaths are due to Ebola, as noted by local official Jean-Claude Lonzama—complicates containment. In other news, Sigma Healthcare of Australia abandons its planned purchase of Boots in the United Kingdom. In patent news, China and Platinum Medicine prevail against Amgen in a suit; a U.S. federal jury orders Amgen's Teneobio to pay 20 million USD, with both sides planning to focus on another larger patent infringement case. No details on imported/exported cases are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ疫情が深刻化、死亡者数が100人を超える　国際医療動向の最新情報
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス病の大規模流行（確認患者710例、死亡149例）は、IHR基準4項目全て該当し、深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威である。国際的な対応が既に開始されており、シグナルとして認識する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主要テーマはDRCでのエボラ流行である。中国とプラチナムメディシンのAmgenに対する特許訴訟、オーストラリアのSigma HealthcareのBoots買収中止は付随的なニュースであり、感染症イベント自体には無関係。対象国リストに基づき、DRCとChina（特許関連言及）を検証済みロケーションに含める。ただし、本トリアージの主要な懸念はDRCでの大規模エボラ流行である。

article.articleHeadline: ¿Sin control? El brote de ébola en el Congo suma 782 casos y golpea a nuevas zonas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Out of control? The Ebola outbreak in Congo totals 782 cases and hits new areas.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (variant Bundibugyo) totals 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, with 56 recoveries, as of June 15, 2026. The epidemic is expanding geographically, recording 72 new confirmed cases in 24 hours and new foci in Nia-Nia (Ituri) and Mabalako (North Kivu). Officials warn the official count likely underestimates total infections due to weeks of circulation before official confirmation on May 15 and reduced contact tracing to about 56%. The case fatality rate is around 23%. Over 90% of cases are in Ituri, but cross-border transmission is evident, with Uganda reporting linked cases and deaths. No vaccines or targeted treatments exist for Bundibugyo; containment relies on patient isolation, contact tracing, and community surveillance amid ongoing conflict, displacement, forests, and artisanal mining that hinder response.

triage.headline_ja: 制御不能か？コンゴのエボラ流行が782件の感染者を記録し、新たな地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の確認患者782人、死亡181人という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、国境を超えた感染拡大（ウガンダでの関連症例・死亡報告）、対応困難な環境（紛争、強制移動、森林、採掘活動）により国際支援が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダでの国境を超えた伝播が報告されているのみで、主要な流行地はDRC（Nord-Kivu州とIturi州）。Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルスの中でも致死率が相対的に低いとされるが、本件では23%の致命率、接触追跡の低減（56%）、ワクチン・治療薬の欠如により対応が極度に困難。72件/24時間の新規確認症例と地理的拡大、紛争地域での流行継続という点で極めて懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Malawi, WHO step up Ebola preparedness
article.articleSummary: Malawi, with WHO, stepped up Ebola screening and border preparedness as of 15 June 2026. Health ministry and WHO inspectors evaluated screening at Kamuzu International Airport in Lilongwe, with WHO country representative Charles Kuria Njuguna and Health Minister Madalitso Baloyi. WHO will hand over protective equipment and laboratory reagents to enable sample collection and testing if a case arises. Malawi currently reports no Ebola cases; however, Ebola is in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and Uganda. Border surveillance and entry protocols at all ports of entry have been intensified to counter rising risk in affected countries. Malawi has direct flights with Uganda; Uganda and DRC are affected by Bundibugyo virus strain, for which there is no vaccine. WHO notes early symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, sore throat, and transmission via direct contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: マラウイ、WHOと共にエボラ熱対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラ熱の地域的リスクは確認されるが、マラウイでは現在症例がなく、予防的措置の段階。DRCとウガンダでの流行が存在し、国際的拡大リスクと予防体制強化の背景が示唆される一方で、具体的な新規発症や被害情報がないため、継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはマラウイの予防体制強化に焦点を当てているが、実際のエボラ流行はDRCとウガンダで確認されている。マラウイは隣接国での流行リスクに対する予防措置段階。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない（マラウイとDRCのみ）。IHR基準は2つ以上該当しているが、WATCH判定とするのは、マラウイでの現在の症例がなく、予防段階の記事であるため、フルRRA前の情報追跡が適切と判断されるためである。

article.articleHeadline: Czy Trójmiasto jest gotowe na Ebolę?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Is the Tri-City ready for Ebola?
article.articleSummary: By June 15, 2026, Ebola concerns persist globally. In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, 676 confirmed Ebola cases and 136 deaths were reported, with Uganda registering 19 cases as the outbreak spreads. In Poland’s Tri-City region and the Pomeranian Voivodeship, readiness for a patient with suspected hemorrhagic fever remains questioned, as a dedicated isolation facility has not yet materialized. Although Gdynia was repeatedly mentioned as a potential site (public discussions in December 2024 and February 2026), no isolation center exists there. Poland relies on three facilities declared ready to admit high-consequence infectious disease patients, none located in Pomeranian Voivodeship. Ambulances in Słupsk and Gdańsk are equipped with BIO-BAG isolation chambers for transport. A laboratory for dangerous virus research has opened, with authorities continuing to assess imported or exported case implications and regional preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: トリシティはエボラに対して準備ができていますか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際的に拡大中（DRC 676例、ウガンダ19例）で、ポーランドにおける準備態勢評価の問題として報道されている。IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・国際的拡大リスク）、かつ複数国における実際の感染例の存在により、シグナルとして識別されるべき。
triage.notes: ポーランドの記事であるが、実際の感染症イベントはDRCおよびウガンダで発生しており、対象国はDRCのみ。ポーランドは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCの記事主題感染症イベントが実際に進行中であるため PICKUP 判定。

article.articleHeadline: ಕಾಂಗೋದಲ್ಲಿ ಎಬೋಲಾ ಮರಣಮೃದಂಗ : 181 ಮಂದಿ ಬಲಿ, ಪ್ರಕರಣಗಳ ಸಂಖ್ಯೆ 782ಕ್ಕೆ ಏರಿಕೆ - Eesanje
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Congo: 181 dead, cases rise to 782 - Eesanje.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo has surged to 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of June 15, 2026, with 85 recoveries and a case fatality rate of 23%. The Bundibugyo virus strain is responsible, with no licensed vaccine or treatment available. The outbreak is centered in Ituri province (eastern Congo) and accounts for over 90% of cases; additional cases have been reported in North Kivu and South Kivu near the Uganda border. Contact tracing coverage is about 56%, down from the prior week. Ongoing conflict has displaced ~1 million people in Ituri, complicating surveillance due to rough terrain, long travel times, and population movement across districts. Attacks on health workers and community distrust in hotspots further hinder response efforts. Separately, US officials said Americans exposed to Ebola would be moved to a new 50-bed quarantine facility at Kenya’s Laikipia Airbase, prompting protests and court challenges.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死者数: 181人死亡、症例数782件に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事は主にコンゴでのエボラ流行（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州での782症例、181死亡、23%致死率）を報道。Bundibugyo株、ワクチン・治療なし、接触者追跡率56%という深刻な状況。紛争による人口移動（~100万人）が対応を阻害。米国がケニアのLaikipia Airbaseに隔離施設を設置する計画は記載されているが、その施設での患者発症の記載はなく、ケニアは流行地ではなく予防的措置の対象地。対象国リストではDRCのみが流行の主舞台。

article.articleHeadline: Congo says 782 Ebola cases confirmed, two new health zones affected
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) involving the Bundibugyo strain continues, with 782 laboratory-confirmed cases and 181 deaths reported as of 2026-06-15. In the latest 24 hours, 72 new cases were documented, one of the largest single-day increases in this outbreak. The outbreak remains confined to three eastern provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. For the first time, cases were confirmed in the Nia-Nia health zone of Ituri and in the Mabalako health zone of North Kivu. Across Ituri and North Kivu, case distribution has expanded to 20 of Ituri's 36 health zones and 10 of North Kivu's 34, with one health zone in South Kivu now affected. The government's situation report confirms ongoing transmission within this 17th Congo Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが782件のエボラ確定症例を報告、新たに2つの保健地区が被害を受ける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常なイベント、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航制限のリスク）。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率と感染性を持つ疾患であり、継続的な地理的拡大を示している。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の第17次発生。Bundibugyo株による782確定症例と181死亡（致死率23.1%）。24時間で72新規症例という大規模な単日増加を記録。地理的拡大傾向（Ituri州20/36保健地区、North Kivu州10/34保健地区に拡大）と新規保健地区への侵入が報告されており、継続的な伝播リスクが高い。DRC東部3州に限定されているが、国際的な対応と監視が急務。

article.articleHeadline: 민주콩고 에볼라 확진자 782명...환자 추적에도 난항 - 신아일보
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 782 Ebola-confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with difficulties in contact tracing.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo reports an Ebola outbreak with 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of June 14 local time, 56 recoveries, and an approximate 23% case fatality rate. The outbreak is due to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain, with no approved vaccine or therapy available. Officials warn the officially reported figures may underestimate true infections. United Nations agencies say about one million people have been displaced in Ituri Province by ongoing conflict, complicating contact tracing and surveillance. The region’s dense forests and poor road infrastructure force long travel times to reach remote villages. Compounding issues include ongoing intercommunal trade, distrust of health workers, and armed groups, all hindering outbreak containment and vaccination campaigns.

triage.headline_ja: 民主コンゴでエボラ確診者782名...患者追跡にも難航
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全てに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模集団発生で、死亡例が多数、稀な株の使用、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な株）で、23%の致命率を示す782確認例と181死亡が報告。100万人以上の国内避難民がいるイトゥリ州で、武力紛争、医療不信、インフラ不足により対策が極めて困難。公式数値は実態を過小評価の可能性ありと警告。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémia eboly v Konžskej demokratickej republike si vyžiadala 181 životov, počet prípadov rastie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has claimed 181 lives; the number of cases is rising.
article.articleSummary: An ongoing Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of 15 June 2026. The outbreak, which began on 15 May, remains concentrated in Ituri and the North and South Kivu provinces in eastern DRC. It is driven by a rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or therapy; by contrast, vaccines exist for other Ebola strains. The ministry of health reports 56 recoveries. More than 90% of cases are in Ituri, where conflict has displaced nearly one million people, complicating contact tracing amid dense forests and difficult terrain. Attacks on health workers, public mistrust, and ongoing armed conflict hinder response efforts. The virus has crossed into Uganda, with 19 cases and 2 deaths reported by 11 June, mostly Congolese nationals crossing the border.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行は181人の死亡者を記録、感染者数は増加中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。稀有なBundibugyo株による進行中の大規模流行で、国境越えと死亡率の高さから国際的リスク有り。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダへの流行越境（19例、2死亡）が明記されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。稀有な Bundibugyo 株でワクチン・治療法がない点、武力紛争による対応阻害、接触者追跡の困難性が追加的な懸念。

article.articleHeadline: Конгода Эбола вирусымен ауырғандар саны 780-нен асты
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of people infected with the Ebola virus in Congo has surpassed 780.
article.articleSummary: Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo have surpassed 780, with 181 deaths among confirmed cases. The outbreak is centered in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with detections in Ituri’s Nia-Nia and North Kivu’s Mabakalo health zones. Ituri has 20 of 36 health zones reporting cases; North Kivu 10 of 34; South Kivu one health zone. In the Kpangba refugee camp, health workers say transmission chains cannot be traced as locals resist quarantine, hindering response. Two deaths occurred at Kpangba on May 31 and June 1, first reported by UNHCR. The first confirmed patient was a 60-year-old woman diagnosed May 30 but not quarantined. Refugees exceed 5 million in these provinces, where attacks on health facilities have risen since the outbreak was declared a month ago. Humanitarian groups warn refugee camps with poor sanitation risk rapid spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルス感染者数が780人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルスは極めて重篤で、DRCでの大規模流行（780人超）は深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクをすべて満たす。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは高い致死率を伴い、記事は780人を超える感染者と181人の死亡を報告。難民キャンプでの感染連鎖追跡不能、衛生施設への攻撃増加などにより管理困難性が高い。IturiとNorth Kivu省を中心とする東部での大規模流行であり、国際的な支援と対応が急務。発生地域にはSierra Leoneも列挙されているが、記事サマリーではDRCのみが主題であり、Sierra Leoneは検証対象国外のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Regierungsdaten - Über 780 Ebola-Fälle in der Demokratischen Republik Kongo bestätigt - Epidemiologe warnt vor Dunkelziffer
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Government data - More than 780 Ebola cases confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo - Epidemiologist warns of the undercount.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has been confirmed in more than 780 cases, with 181 deaths reported per government data cited by Reuters. In the last 24 hours, 72 new cases were documented. Three eastern provinces are affected. The Bundibugyo-type strain currently circulating has no vaccine and no approved therapy. Ebola virus disease is a contagious and life-threatening illness transmitted through direct contact with bodily fluids. The DRC lies in Central Africa and has experienced multiple Ebola outbreaks. An epidemiologist warns that official counts may underestimate the true burden.

triage.headline_ja: 政府データ - コンゴ民主共和国で780例以上のエボラ確定例 - 疫学者が隠れた患者数を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを示しており、フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の重大な発生。確定例780例以上、死亡181例、過去24時間で新規72例の急速な増加を示している。流行株はワクチン・承認治療法がないBundibugyo型であり、公式統計値が実際の患者数を過小評価している可能性が指摘されている。即座のフルRRAが必須。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya Rolls Out 23 Ebola Isolation Centres as Government Tightens Disease Preparedness
article.articleSummary: Kenya expands Ebola readiness with 23 isolation and treatment centres nationwide, while officials confirm no locally confirmed Ebola case; the country remains Ebola-free but on high alert. Garissa County Referral Hospital houses an Ebola isolation unit with a 20-bed ward for confirmed infections and a separate 10-bed section for suspected cases, a model replicated across the 23 centres. The rollout aims to isolate, test, and manage suspected cases quickly to prevent overwhelming the main health system. Cross-border risk from Uganda and DRC is noted. Training exceeds 34,000 healthcare workers in infection prevention, surveillance, and emergency response; over 100,000 travellers have been screened at entry points; four laboratories are equipped to test for Ebola and related viral haemorrhagic diseases; rapid response teams are deployed across counties. A refurbished 28-bed ward was opened at Garissa Hospital. Controversy arose in Nanyuki over a proposed quarantine facility at Laikipia Air Base, sparking protests.

triage.headline_ja: ケニア、エボラ対策強化で23の隔離センターを展開 疾病準備態勢を厳格化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスは高い公衆衛生上の脅威だが、記事サマリーでケニアは「エボラ陰性を維持」「局所確認症例なし」と明記されており、現在の活動は予防的準備段階。国境を越えたリスク（ウガンダ、DRC）が指摘されるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ケニア本体ではEbola陰性と確認されているため、verified_locationsには含めない。国境を越えたリスク（DRC、ウガンダ）がサマリーで明記されているため、両国を記載。ナニュキ（Nanyuki）の隔離施設計画をめぐる抗議は社会的関心を示す。情報不足により WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: Số ca sốt xuất huyết ở Cần Thơ ghi nhận vẫn ở mức cao, ngành y tế khuyến cáo người dân chủ động diệt lăng quăng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of dengue fever cases in Cần Thơ remains high; the health sector urges residents to actively eliminate mosquito larvae.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Can Tho, Vietnam, remains high with 3,038 cases and 1,285 outbreak clusters reported in 2026 up to June 15, including 252 severe cases and zero deaths. Local health authorities urge residents to regularly eliminate mosquito larvae, inspect water containers, and maintain a clean environment ahead of the rainy season. On June 15, 2026, the Can Tho Department of Health and the city CDC organized an ASEAN Dengue Day rally to raise awareness and mobilize community prevention. Despite ongoing control efforts, the outbreak level is substantial and may rise with changing monsoon conditions. The article emphasizes dengue as a dangerous infectious disease with high regional outbreak risk in Southeast Asia and stresses shared public health responsibility across government and communities.

triage.headline_ja: カンホー市におけるデング熱患者数が依然として高水準であり、保健当局が住民に対して積極的に蚊の幼虫駆除を行うよう呼びかけている
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムにおけるデング熱の活動的な流行が継続中であり、3,038症例と1,285のアウトブレイククラスターが報告されている。WPRO基準の複数項目（異常性、重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）に該当し、地域的な公衆衛生上の関心も高い。
triage.notes: 2026年6月15日時点で3,038症例、1,285クラスター、252重症例が報告されており、死亡例は0件。カンホー市が主な影響地域。ASEAN Dengue Day集会が実施され、地域的な関心が高い。雨季の気象条件により流行がさらに拡大する可能性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от Эболы в Демократической Республике Конго превысило 180 -- НИАТ "Ховар"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has surpassed 180 — NIAT "Khovar"
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues, with laboratory-confirmed cases reaching 782 and 181 deaths as of 15 June 2026. Over the past 24 hours, 72 new infections and 32 deaths were reported. Cases have now been identified in two additional districts in Ituri and North Kivu provinces, signaling expanding transmission in eastern DRC. The current outbreak began on 15 May, with the epicenter in Ituri. There are also reported Ebola cases and deaths in neighboring Uganda, indicating cross-border spread. The report provides no infection source details or vaccination data; all counts are laboratory-confirmed, highlighting sustained transmission and regional public health concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死亡者数が180人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大（782確定症例、181死亡）、異常な流行、国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、DRCでの主要な流行を確認。ウガンダへの越境感染も記述されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。24時間以内に72新規症例、32死亡という急速な増加、多地区での拡大、越境感染の報告により、PICKUP判定が適切。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Počet prípadov eboly v Kongu stúpol na 782, zahynulo vyše 180 ľudí
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in Congo rose to 782; more than 180 people died.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains concentrated in Ituri, South Kivu, and North Kivu, with 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of June 15, 2026. In the last 24 hours, 72 new cases were reported. The outbreak, which began on May 15, is driven by the Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment; previous DRC outbreaks involved Zaire ebolavirus, which has a vaccine. So far, 56 patients have recovered. Over 90% of cases are in Ituri, where nearly a million people have been displaced by conflict, complicating contact tracing amid insecurity and attacks on health workers. The virus has also reached neighboring Uganda, with 19 cases and 2 deaths reported by June 11, 2026, mostly among Congolese nationals entering Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者数が782人に増加、180人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常なBundibugyo株、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での確認、高い死亡率、ワクチン・治療法不在の株による急速拡大。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCとウガンダでの事例を述べているが、ウガンダ（GeoNames ID 226074）は対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株の出現（過去のZaire株と異なり、ワクチン・治療法なし）、高い日次新規発症数（72件/24時間）、紛争地域での感染管理の困難さ（医療従事者への攻撃、90%以上の患者がIturi州に集中、近百万人の避難民）により、シグナルレベルは極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Illegal dumpsite washed into Weija Lake after floods, raising public health fears - Adomonline.com
article.articleSummary: Illegal unauthorised landfill at American Farm, Ngleshie Amanfro, Ga South, Accra, washed into Weija Lake after floods, threatening drinking water for 80% of Accra residents served by GWCL. The dump mixes municipal, industrial and e-waste, releasing metals - lead, cadmium, mercury, arsenic, chromium - and pollutants such as PAHs, PCBs, phthalates, BPA, plus faecal coliforms, E. coli, ammonia and hydrogen sulphide. Immediate microbiological risks include gastroenteritis, typhoid, cholera and dysentery; long-term exposures risk lead-related neurodevelopmental harm in children, cadmium kidney disease, arsenic cancers; PAHs/PCBs may bioaccumulate in fish with cancer and endocrine disruption risks. Dr. Bruce-Vanderpuije urges GWCL and EPA to prioritize tests for total coliform, E. coli, turbidity, pH, DO, conductivity, ammonia; within 1 week, a heavy metal panel; 2-4 weeks for PAHs, PCBs, phthalates, with sediment cores. Treat debris as hazardous waste; PPE; avoid burning; relocate to a permitted landfill with leachate containment; deploy silt curtain. Policy gaps: enforcement and catchment boundaries.

triage.headline_ja: 洪水でWeija湖に流入した不法投棄地、公衆衛生への懸念が高まる - Adomonline.com
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）。複数の水因性感染症（コレラ、チフス、大腸菌）の即時リスクと、80%の市民の飲料水供給を脅かす大規模な環境汚染。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはAccra（Greater Accra Region, Ghana）における不法投棄地がWeija湖に流入し、飲料水供給への直接的な脅威を記述。複数の微生物学的リスク（ファエカルコリフォーム、E. coli、チフス、コレラ）と化学汚染（重金属、PAHs、PCBs等）の両方が特定されている。公衆衛生専門家による緊急対応の提言あり。情報は十分であり、即座のリスク評価と検査対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Reports 72 New Ebola Infections as Outbreak Expands to New Health Zones
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows 72 new lab-confirmed cases in the last 24 hours, bringing total infections to 782 and deaths to 181 since the outbreak began. The outbreak remains concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with confirmed cases detected for the first time in Niania health zone (Ituri) and Mabalako health zone (North Kivu), signaling geographic spread. Public health authorities continue surveillance, contact tracing and treatment in affected communities as transmission remains active despite containment efforts. Ebola spreads via direct contact with infected bodily fluids or contaminated materials; symptoms include fever, fatigue, vomiting, diarrhea and, in severe cases, internal bleeding. Long-running insecurity and armed conflict in eastern Congo hinder response and complicate containment, with international observers warning outbreaks in conflict zones are harder to control.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ感染72件の新規報告、新保健地区への拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルのリスク疾患であり、確認感染782件・死亡181件、地域的拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性があり、シグナルとして即座にフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際保健上の最高リスク疾患。24時間で72件の新規確認感染は急速な増加を示唆。新保健地区への地理的拡大（Niania、Mabalako）が報告されている。武装紛争による対応困難という構造的問題も存在。直ちにフルRRA実施および関連省庁への報告が必須。

article.articleHeadline: الكونجو الدّيمقراطية تسجّل 181 حالة وفاة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 181 Ebola deaths.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, June 15, 2026 — The Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ministry of Health reports Ebola virus disease has reached 782 confirmed infections and 181 deaths, with 72 new cases recorded in the past 24 hours. The outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda remains ongoing. The World Health Organization, on May 17, declared the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting the danger to other states. WHO assesses the regional spread risk as high. The announcement highlights ongoing cross-border transmission and sustained international monitoring as health authorities contend with rising case and fatality counts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルスで181人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WHO既にPHEIC宣言済み。フルRRA必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスの大規模アウトブレーク。2026年5月17日にWHOがPHEIC宣言済み。確認感染者782人、死亡181人で過去24時間に72人の新規感染を記録。DRCおよびウガンダでの継続的な交差感染を報告。記事サマリーではウガンダも言及されているが、主要な発生地域はDRCであり、検証済みロケーションにはDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala Shigella Virus | Cruel Bacteria That Will Shake Kerala - Another Boy Dies
article.articleSummary: Seven-year-old boy from Pookkottur area, Malappuram district, Kerala, died in Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital after contracting Shigella infection (shigellosis). This year, Kerala has recorded four Shigella-related deaths. The report provides no details on symptoms, laboratory confirmation, or infection source, and does not describe an ongoing outbreak beyond these fatalities. No information is given on imported/exported cases or public health measures. The article notes a pediatric fatality in Kerala during 2026, and while it uses the term Shigella virus, the disease is bacterial (Shigella infection). Location scope includes Kerala state with emphasis on Malappuram and Kozhikode, highlighting the ongoing burden of shigellosis in 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州シゲラ菌感染症 | ケーララ州を揺るがす凶悪な細菌 - 別の少年が死亡

article.articleHeadline: Opinion: Manitoba's role in a distant Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola has re-emerged in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda, underscoring that geography no longer shields communities from outbreaks. Manitobans face very low direct infection risk, but global spread matters through research and supply chains. Winnipeg's National Microbiology Laboratory studies Ebola and other dangerous pathogens, contributing to understanding and response. Manitoba's universities recruit international students and healthcare professionals, while continental supply chains connect the province to global health networks. The One Health approach links human, animal, and environmental health as a single system. The piece argues investments in disease surveillance, laboratory infrastructure, and outbreak response in vulnerable regions are cost-effective for domestic health. Preparedness must be built through sustained funding, scientific collaboration, and international cooperation rather than reactive measures.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Ebola" continues to spread... 782 cases and 181 deaths in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to intensify. As of 15 June 2026, the Ministry of Health reports 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths. The last 24 hours alone added 72 cases, underscoring a rapid escalation of transmission within local communities. The World Health Organization has formally classified the outbreak in the DRC and neighboring Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, signaling a global alarm. The WHO has also raised the regional risk level to high, highlighting serious concerns about cross-border spread to other states. The situation reflects a widening outbreak across shared borders, with international support deemed essential to reinforce health systems, surveillance, and response efforts in the region.

article.articleHeadline: Doctors issue warning as Hanoi records first Japanese encephalitis case this year
article.articleSummary: Hanoi reports its first Japanese encephalitis (JE) case in 2026, a 13-year-old from Hung Dao Commune diagnosed about a week ago and under intensive treatment. This is Hanoi’s first case this year; none in the same period in 2025. The patient had completed the three-dose primary JE vaccination but did not receive the booster dose. JE is an acute viral infection transmitted by mosquitoes; peak transmission is in summer (May–September), with children most at risk. Early symptoms resemble influenza—high fever, headache, nausea, vomiting, fatigue—and can rapidly progress to central nervous system involvement, encephalitis, seizures, coma, and multi-organ failure. WHO notes most infections are asymptomatic; about 1 in 250 become severe, with up to 30% fatality and many survivors with long-term neurological issues. Authorities advocate three primary doses plus boosters every 3–4 years until 15, and mosquito-bite prevention during peak season.

article.articleHeadlineTranslated: G7 Summit in France: A Test of Western Unity Amid Iran, Ukraine, and Ebola Crises.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, the G7 summit in Evian, France unfolds amid crises: Iran, Ukraine, Ebola, and trade tensions. US officials say no major breakthroughs are expected; aims to reaffirm shared interests and keep channels open on contentious issues, with security and trade as core axes. Iran's nuclear program and broader regional tensions top the agenda; a recently discussed agreement to end the war and a 60-day window to resolve issues could pave the way for reopening the Strait of Hormuz and resuming Gulf energy exports; European allies are watching. In Ukraine, President Zelensky attends a dedicated session seeking further military aid, notably air defenses and Patriot systems, though ammo shortages persist and Patriot availability is global. Ebola's resurgence features on the agenda; US travel bans remain controversial with WHO. China is discussed as a key though non-member interlocutor; other topics include AI, energy security, minerals, migration, and health.

article.articleHeadline: Fourth Shigella death reported in Kerala; seven-year-old Malappuram boy dies in Kozhikode
article.articleSummary: Fourth shigellosis death in Kerala this year: seven-year-old Arjav from Pookkottur, Malappuram, died at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital after admission last Friday for fever and severe diarrhoea; he passed away Monday morning. Other shigellosis deaths this year include Sarojini (59) of Keezhattur in Perinthalmanna (died June 9); Nila (4) of Vallilkadavu, Kozhikode (died June 6); and a three-year-old girl from Anakuzhikkara in Kozhikode (died in March). Malappuram authorities have intensified surveillance and preventive measures. Public health guidance urges strict hygiene, safe drinking water, and prompt medical care for fever, diarrhoea, vomiting, or blood-stained stools.

article.articleHeadline: Flooding raises risk of disease outbreaks -- GAPHTO
article.articleSummary: Flooding in Ghana raises the risk of disease outbreaks, with GAPHTO warning that floods are often followed by waterborne and vector-borne diseases in urban communities facing sanitation challenges. Diseases of concern include cholera, typhoid, acute diarrhoeal infections, dysentery and malaria. Floodwaters mixing with sewage and refuse, overcrowding, and stagnant water create exposure to hazards, prompting past increases in cholera and diarrhoeal illnesses and rising malaria cases. While Ghana has strengthened surveillance and response, prevention remains key: prioritize personal hygiene, safe drinking water, prompt medical attention for symptoms, proper cooking and food protection, and regular handwashing. Sanitation measures—clearing choked drains, removing refuse, draining standing water—are urged at household and community levels. GAPHTO members are on alert to support disease surveillance, health education, and emergency response in collaboration with the Ministry of Health, Ghana Health Service, NADMO and local authorities, as of 2026-06-15.

article.articleHeadline: IREDA Joins 100-Day TB Mukt Bharat Drive with TB Screening Camp at New Delhi Office
article.articleSummary: New Delhi, 15 June 2026: Indian Renewable Energy Development Agency Limited (IREDA) joined the nationwide 100-Day Intensified TB Mukt Bharat Campaign by holding a two-day Ni-Kshay Shivir TB screening camp at its New Delhi corporate office. Conducted in collaboration with the Central TB Division, Ministry of Health and Family Welfare, the initiative aims at early detection and prevention of tuberculosis among IREDA employees. A dedicated Central TB Division team carried out health screenings as part of the government’s intensified drive to eliminate TB in India, seeking to raise awareness and ensure timely diagnosis to curb transmission. The two-day screening underscores national TB elimination goals and strengthens workplace health programs.

article.articleHeadline: World Dengue Day 2026: डेंगू में जब हो जाती है मौत, क्या है शॉक सिंड्रोम, एक्सपर्ट ने बताया
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Dengue Day 2026: When Dengue Becomes Fatal, What Is Dengue Shock Syndrome? An Expert Explained
article.articleSummary: World Dengue Day on June 15 highlights Dengue and Dengue Shock Syndrome (DSS) in India, per Delhi Municipal Corporation doctor Ajay Kumar. About 90% of dengue infections show symptoms, and with appropriate treatment most patients recover; however, DSS rapidly lowers blood pressure and damages blood vessels, reducing organ blood supply and risking multi‑organ failure and death. DSS does not start abruptly: fever begins mildly and is often ignored, then worsens over 3–4 days with restlessness, chills, abdominal pain, vomiting, and fatigue. In shock, blood pressure drops and nasal or gum bleeding may occur, necessitating immediate hospital care. Platelets fall quickly, and mental health effects are noted, so patients and families should remain calm. Prevention methods are discussed in the article, though details are not provided here.

triage.notes: 本記事は世界デング熱デー（World Dengue Day）の記念日に関連した、デング熱およびデング出血熱（DSS）に関する医学的な啓発・教育記事である。新規アウトブレイク、異常な疾患発生状況、または急速な感染拡大を報告するものではなく、医療専門家による一般向けの情報提供である。シグナルとしての価値はない。

article.articleHeadline: Apakah Hantavirus Akan Jadi Pandemi Seperti Covid-19? Ini Kata Pakar UIN Jakarta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Will hantavirus become a pandemic like COVID-19? Here's what an expert from UIN Jakarta says.
article.articleSummary: On 15 June 2026, Indonesian epidemiology expert Minsarnawati of UIN Syarif Hidayatullah Jakarta cautions hantavirus could generate global concern but is unlikely to become a pandemic like COVID-19 due to transmission patterns. Hantavirus spreads mainly via rodents; infection occurs when people contact urine, saliva, feces, or dust contaminated by infected rodents. It is a zoonosis, not primarily human-to-human. Globally, cases have appeared across the United States, Asia, Europe, and Africa. In Indonesia, hantavirus has been reported before, but not the highly lethal strain seen in parts of the Americas. Clinically, there are two main syndromes: HFRS (hemorrhagic fever with renal syndrome) affecting kidneys, common in Asia/Europe and previously confirmed in Indonesia; and HPS (hantavirus pulmonary syndrome) affecting the lungs, more deadly and concentrated in the Americas. At-risk groups include sanitation workers, waste handlers, farmers, and laboratory animal workers; prevention remains key.

triage.headline_ja: ハンタウイルスがCOVID-19のようなパンデミックになるのか？UINジャカルタの専門家の見解
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの専門家がハンタウイルスのパンデミック化の可能性は低いと述べており、ヒト-ヒト感染は限定的である。ただしインドネシアでの過去報告歴と複数国での発生報告があるため、動物由来感染症の継続的監視対象として経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な焦点はインドネシアの専門家の見解であり、ハンタウイルスがパンデミックになる可能性は低いと明示されている。現在のインドネシアでの活動的な感染拡大は報告されていない。動物由来感染症（ネズミ由来）であり、基本的にヒト-ヒト感染ではないため、流行性は限定的。過去にインドネシアでHFRS（出血熱腎症候群）の報告があることから、継続的な監視の対象。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ebola din Republica Democrată Congo continuă să se extindă în zone noi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread to new areas.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread to new areas, with health authorities reporting almost 800 cases in the northeastern provinces of Ituri and North Kivu. Nearly 200 deaths have been recorded. Despite intensified surveillance and treatment measures, transmission persists as local media report crowded conditions in many venues due to lax vigilance and weak enforcement of public-health rules. Authorities have imposed restrictions on public gatherings, but adherence remains uneven, enabling continued movement and potential expansion of the outbreak. The report highlights the ongoing challenge of controlling Ebola in conflict-affected, densely populated border regions. The article does not detail laboratory confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. BBC World Service published the story on 15 June 2026.

Data reflect ongoing surveillance updates; no information on imported or exported cases is provided beyond the cross-border relevance noted by WHO.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルス感染症による181人の死亡を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において、エボラウイルス感染症は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを満たし4基準全て該当。WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEICを宣言しており、確定症例782件、死亡181件の重大な事態。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダとの国境での関連性が言及されているが、サマリー内でウガンダでの確定症例や死亡者数が具体的に報告されていないため、verified_locationsではDRCのみを含める。WHO PHEICの宣言により国際的な懸念レベルは最高度。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases hit 782, including 178 deaths
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak escalates to 782 confirmed cases and 178 deaths across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, as of 15 June 2026. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus triggered the outbreak, declared on 15 May, now affecting 31 health zones with Nia-Nia and Mabalako newly affected. On 14 June, Ituri and North Kivu logged 72 new infections and 29 deaths. As of that period, 359 patients are hospitalized or in isolation, and 40 have recovered. Suspected cases total 136, including 49 deaths. A total of 6,275 contacts have been identified, but only 3,548 (56.5%) have been followed up, far below the 95% target. Major challenges include limited treatment-center capacity, weak contact tracing and alert reporting, and shortages of infection-prevention materials in North Kivu. By 9 June, 635 cases had been lab-confirmed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者782人に達する、死亡178人を含む
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の大規模流行で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な脅威。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus（BDBV）による大規模流行。2026年5月15日に公式宣言。3州31保健区域に拡大。接触者追跡が目標95%に対し56.5%と大幅に遅れており、感染予防物資不足など対応能力の課題が深刻。国際支援が急務。

article.articleHeadline: Dịch Ebola: CHDC Congo khẩn trương mở rộng khu vực cách ly và điều trị
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: DRC urgently expands isolation and treatment zones.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo expands with new isolation and treatment zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. WHO warns the outbreak is larger than initial estimates, with cases concentrated in densely populated areas and refugee camps in Ituri. As of early June, WHO reports more than 600 confirmed Ebola cases and over 130 deaths; the DRC Ministry of Health, as of June 13, tallies 782 confirmed cases and 178 deaths. The epidemic spans at least 24 health zones, with new cases detected nearly daily in new localities. Improved diagnostic capacity is driving the apparent rise by clearing backlogs. In Ituri, MSF is building a 65-bed Ebola Treatment Center for suspected and confirmed cases and helping Bunia-based hospitals establish safe isolation. WHO cites three treatment centers in Bunia (~80 beds) plus units in Mongbwalu, Rwampara, Beni, Goma, and Bukavu.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行：コンゴ民主共和国が隔離・治療ゾーンを緊急拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：600例以上・死亡178例、異常・予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。加えてスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラが確認された大規模流行。確認例782例、死亡178例（DRC厚生省報告）。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州で複数の治療センターが稼働中。難民キャンプを含む人口密集地での発生が報告されており、地域的な対応能力に懸念あり。WHOが警告を発出しており国際的な懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reports record one-day surge in Ebola cases as more health zones affected
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) records a record one-day surge: 72 new confirmed cases, bringing total to 782 since declaration on May 15, caused by the Bundibugyo strain. Deaths rise by 29 to 181 (case fatality 23.1%). Ituri province remains the epicenter with 56 new cases; two new health zones affected are Nia-Nia (Ituri) and Mabalako (North Kivu), lifting affected zones to 31 across three provinces. About 40 recoveries have occurred since the start. An immediate response is deployed in the newly affected zones. Challenges include a $21.5 million funding gap, limited Ebola treatment center capacity, weak contact tracing, and shortages of infection prevention and control materials. Africa CDC is deploying technical expertise, laboratory support, active case finding, and community engagement, urging partners and donors to mobilize resources to stop transmission. As of 2026-06-15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ出血熱の1日の過去最大の新規感染者数を報告、さらに多くの保健地区が影響を受ける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で、1日72例の過去最大記録的な新規確認患者発生、死亡率23.1%と高い重症度、複数州への拡大、国際的な対応・資金支援の必要性が明確である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の既知高リスク地域での大規模流行。1日72例という過去最大の新規患者数報告は流行の急速な拡大を示唆。Bundibugyo株は比較的致死率が低いとされるが、現在の23.1%の致死率は憂慮すべき水準。2つの新規発症地区（Nia-Nia、Mabalako）への拡大により、影響地区は31に増加。資金ギャップ（21.5百万ドル）と対応能力の制限が深刻な課題。AfricaCDCの技術支援と国際的リソース動員が急務であり、フルRRA実施の対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄爆發登革熱群聚事件！累計6例、確診第2型，疾管署：防蚊大作戰不鬆懈 - 民視新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung dengue fever cluster outbreak erupts! Cumulative 6 cases, dengue serotype 2 confirmed; Taiwan CDC: mosquito-control campaign must not let its guard down - Minshi News Network
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung Minsheng Hospital dengue fever cluster in Taiwan reaches 6 confirmed DENV-2 cases, the first in-hospital cluster in eight years; as of June 14, all cases are hospital inpatients. Taiwan CDC mobilized a rapid-response team to assist the hospital and surrounding communities with breeding-source surveillance and vector control, with monitoring through July 12. The index case is a woman in her 70s with chronic illness hospitalized May 29–June 10, then readmitted June 11 with fever and dizziness, diagnosed as dengue fever type 2. Investigations suggest nosocomial transmission within the hospital; sequencing is expected by June 16 to confirm a single transmission chain. Domestically, seven indigenous dengue cases are all in Kaohsiung; 68 imported cases, mainly from Indonesia (21), the Maldives (14), and Vietnam (9). Ongoing rainy-season risk; authorities urge environmental cleanup, elimination of breeding sites, protective clothing, and timely medical care if dengue-like symptoms appear and travel history is reported.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄で登革熱群集発生！累計6例、デング2型確認。台湾CDC：蚊対策キャンペーンを緩めない
triage.triage_reason: 台湾の高雄市で院内感染を含む登革熱群集（6例、デング2型）が発生。8年ぶりの院内集団発生であり、国内他地域への拡大リスク（国内7例、輸入例68例の背景）と媒介蚊媒介感染症の特性から、IHR基準2つ以上（異常性・重症度）とWPRO基準複数該当（流行可能性・管理の重要性）で判定。
triage.notes: 記事はタイワン（台湾）の高雄市での登革熱群集を主題としているが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。ただしサマリーに記載されている輸入ケースの出発地（インドネシア21例、モルディブ14例、ベトナム9例）のうち、対象国であるベトナムとインドネシアのみを列挙。モルディブは対象国外のため除外。院内感染の特性、雨季到来による蚊の増加リスク、地域的流行可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: FROM COVID-19 TO Foot and Mouth (FMD): Is Botswana Learning the Right Lessons?
article.articleSummary: Al Jazeera questions global preparedness for the next pandemic, surveying Ebola flare-ups in Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo, hantavirus fears, rising anti-vaccine rhetoric, and World Health Organization funding problems. The piece centers on readiness and robustness, arguing the key question is whether lessons from COVID-19 have been absorbed into policy and practice. Framed in a Botswana context with Foot and Mouth Disease (FMD) referenced in the title, it suggests applying pandemic-era lessons to both human and animal health threats. Published 2026-06-15, the article underscores gaps between knowledge and action and calls for sustained investment in surveillance, preparedness, and global health governance.

triage.headline_ja: COVID-19から口蹄疫(FMD)へ：ボツワナは正しい教訓を学んでいるか？
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（エボラ、ハンタウイルス、COVID-19、口蹄疫）が言及されており、スクリーニング基準複数項目で懸念あり。ただし記事の主題は「パンデミック対策準備の評価」であり、進行中の具体的なアウトブレイクの詳細情報が不足しているため。
triage.notes: 記事は複数の実在する感染症（ウガンダとDRCのエボラ再発、ハンタウイルス、ボツワナの口蹄疫）を言及しているが、記事本文が未提供のため具体的な発生規模・死亡者数・感染者数等の詳細情報が不明。発生地域にはDRC・ウガンダ・ボツワナが含まれるが、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダ・ボツワナは対象国に含まれないため除外。記事主体の「パンデミック準備態勢」という解説記事性のため、実時間的なシグナルとしての確実性が低い。続報による具体的なアウトブレイク情報を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ghana selected for €11 million global dengue vaccine project to fight rising threat in Sub-Saharan Africa
article.articleSummary: Ghana selected for a €11 million, four-year dengue vaccine project to curb rising risk in Sub-Saharan Africa. Kwame Nkrumah University of Science and Technology (KNUST) will host Phase III trials of DengiAll, a single-dose vaccine covering all four dengue serotypes. The DENSTAR Project—a multinational collaboration across Africa, Europe, Asia and North America—began on 1 June 2026 with funding from the EU-backed Global Health European & Developing Countries Clinical Trials Partnership. Dengue, transmitted chiefly by Aedes mosquitoes, is increasingly impacting Africa due to climate change and rapid urbanisation. DengiAll’s key advantage is no prior blood testing required, aiding deployment in Ghana and similar contexts. If successful, the vaccine could enable large-scale vaccination across Sub-Saharan Africa, strengthening outbreak prevention and protective measures for vulnerable populations in Ghana and the region.

triage.headline_ja: ガーナ、サハラ以南アフリカの脅威に対抗するため1,100万ユーロのグローバルデングス熱ワクチンプロジェクトに選定
triage.triage_reason: デングス熱の上昇傾向は確認されるが、記事の主眼はワクチン開発プロジェクトの進行状況であり、現在の流行や患者数に関する具体的情報が欠落している。シグナルの深掘り評価には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はワクチン開発プロジェクトの開始を報道しており、現在の流行状況の深刻度に関する具体的データ（患者数、死亡例、感染率など）が記載されていない。デングス熱がサハラ以南アフリカで上昇傾向にあることは記述されているが、PICKUP判定には公衆衛生への具体的影響の証拠が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Health experts will use wastewater, social media to hunt for outbreaks during World Cup
article.articleSummary: Wastewater sequencing and social-media surveillance will underpin a Washington, D.C.–based public health operation during the World Cup across the United States, Canada, and Mexico. The 39‑day tournament began in Mexico on June 11, with 6.5 million fans from more than 100 countries attending 104 games. A Georgetown University–led team, housed in an epidemiological command post and supported by MedStar Health, will issue daily risk briefs to hospital leaders and authorities at local, state, federal, and international levels, including FIFA. Advanced wastewater analysis detects DNA/RNA from pathogens without culture, enabling early outbreak signals; data are supplemented by anonymized electronic health records and open-source social surveillance. Diseases of concern include measles (nearing 2,000 US cases this year), Ebola (DRC outbreak; low North American risk; DRC team quarantined in Belgium before US travel), dengue, and chikungunya. The setup serves as a test run for future events, including the 2028 Los Angeles Olympics.

triage.headline_ja: Health experts will use wastewater, social media to hunt for outbreaks during World Cup
triage.triage_reason: Multiple diseases of concern (measles, Ebola, dengue, chikungunya) are mentioned with specific outbreak contexts (measles ~2,000 US cases, Ebola in DRC). However, the article primarily focuses on a surveillance operation setup rather than an active outbreak event. Verified locations include DRC (Ebola outbreak), but the primary narrative is about monitoring preparedness across US, Canada, and Mexico during World Cup. Information on current case counts and outbreak severity in target regions is limited.
triage.notes: The article describes a surveillance infrastructure being set up during the World Cup to monitor multiple pathogens across US, Canada, and Mexico. DRC is mentioned as the source of the current Ebola outbreak. While measles cases are noted (~2,000 in US), the article focuses on preparedness/surveillance rather than describing an active outbreak requiring immediate intervention. The multiple pathogens of concern (measles, Ebola, dengue, chikungunya) warrant continued monitoring, particularly given the large gathering context (6.5M attendees from 100+ countries). Recommend continued observation for any escalation in case reports during the tournament period.

article.articleHeadline: تأكيد 782 إصابة بفيروس إيبولا وظهور الفيروس في منطقتين جديدتين بالكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmation of 782 Ebola virus infections and the virus's appearance in two new regions in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of Congo reaches 782 confirmed infections with 181 deaths, after 72 new cases were reported in the last 24 hours—the largest daily increase of the current outbreak, the 17th in the country. The outbreak remains concentrated in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, but new confirmed cases have been recorded in Nia-Nia Health Zone (Ituri) and Mabalako Health Zone (North Kivu). Current data show confirmed cases in 20 of 36 health zones in Ituri, 10 of 34 in North Kivu, and one health zone in South Kivu. Urgent public health measures are needed to curb transmission as the situation evolves.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染782件を確認、コンゴの2つの新しい地域でウイルスが出現
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重症度・異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。エボラの新規感染数急増（24時間で72件）と地理的拡大が確認され、公衆衛生上の重大な懸念がある。
triage.notes: DRCで17番目のエボラ流行。782確認患者数と181死亡数、24時間での72件の新規患者（過去最大の日次増加）。東部州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）で継続し、新規患者がNia-Nia Health Zone（Ituri）およびMabalako Health Zone（North Kivu）で記録される。Ituri：36健康圏中20圏、North Kivu：34健康圏中10圏、South Kivu：1健康圏での確認症例。緊急の公衆衛生対策が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Chủ động phòng dịch, đẩy lùi sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Proactive epidemic prevention, curb dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: On ASEAN Dengue Prevention Day (June 15, 2026), Gia Lai reports rising dengue fever in the western region during the rainy season. Since the start of 2026, the province has recorded 1,656 dengue cases, nearly double the same period in 2025, with no fatalities reported yet. While awareness campaigns run, many households still neglect preventive measures, raising outbreak risk. Sustainable control hinges on removing mosquito breeding sites; chemical spraying targets adult mosquitoes as a stopgap. In De Gi commune, 29 cases have been detected across 8 of 21 hamlets; Ia Nan commune has 13 cases in 6 of 9 villages, and field surveillance on 12-6 found larval densities above the danger threshold in Tung village despite repeated messaging. Local authorities are urged to strengthen multi-sector coordination, surge vector surveillance, and empower households to routinely inspect water containers, clean debris, and eliminate breeding sites, shifting to proactive prevention.

triage.headline_ja: 積極的な感染症対策、デング熱を抑制
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでデング熱の症例が前年同期比でほぼ2倍に増加しており、異常な上昇傾向を示している。地域的流行の兆候が明らかで、ヒト-ヒト感染ではなく蚊媒介だが、多くの世帯が予防措置を怠っており流行リスクが高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはベトナムのGia Lai省における2026年のデング熱流行に焦点を当てている。2026年1月以降1,656症例が記録され、前年同期比で約2倍の増加を示している。Bluedot APIはIran (Kerman)も検出しているが、記事サマリー上はIranに関する実質的な内容がないため、verified_locationsから除外した。蚊媒介感染症であり、雨季に関連した季節的な流行だが、予防意識の低さと幼虫密度が危険閾値を超えていることから、管理可能性にも課題がある。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو تسجل 181 حالة وفاة بفيروس إيبولا.. والصحة العالمية تحذر من خطر إقليمي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo records 181 deaths from Ebola virus, and WHO warns of regional risk.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo reports 782 confirmed Ebola cases and 181 deaths, with 72 new infections in the past 24 hours. The outbreak also involves Uganda, per the DRC Ministry of Health. On 17 May, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola situation in the DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting it poses a risk to other countries and assessing regional spread as high. The report underscores ongoing transmission and international concern, highlighting the need for sustained surveillance, containment measures, and cross-border public health coordination in the affected region.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが181人のエボラウイルス死亡者を報告、WHO地域リスク警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、多数の死亡者、国際的拡大リスク高と評価されている。フルRRA推奨。
triage.notes: WHOにより2026年5月17日にPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）宣言済み。DRCとウガンダが影響国として報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。72時間以内に新規感染72件と活発な病原体伝播が確認されており、緊急性極めて高。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果埃博拉疫情升温 确诊破700死亡超180 | 伊波拉 | 埃博拉病毒 | Ebola | 大纪元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo intensifies; confirmed cases surpass 700, deaths exceed 180 | Ebola | Ebola virus | The Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensifies, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of June 14, the DRC health ministry reported 782 confirmed cases, 56 recoveries, and 181 deaths (case fatality rate 23%). Ituri Province in eastern DRC houses more than 90% of cases, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu; the outbreak has spread to Uganda, which has 19 cases and 2 deaths. This Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific antivirals, unlike prior Zaire ebolavirus-focused therapies. The CDC says no U.S. cases and low overall risk to the public. Transmission occurs via animal reservoirs (notably fruit bats) and human-to-human contact with infected bodily fluids; incubation 2–21 days. Challenges include limited contact tracing (56%), rugged Ituri terrain, conflict-driven displacement, and distrust of authorities; Kenya’s plan to isolate exposed Americans was halted by a court injunction amid protests.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染症が激化 確認患者数が700を突破、死亡者数180超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。致命率23%のBundibugyo ebolavirus株による大規模アウトブレイクで、DRC、ウガンダに広がり、米国への輸入例懸念もあり。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus株によるアウトブレイク（782確認患者、181死亡、CFR 23%）。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kuvuの複数州で発生。ウガンダへの国境越えの拡大確認（19患者、2死亡）。ワクチンおよび特異的抗ウイルス療法なし。接触追跡率56%、紛争による住民流出、当局不信など対応課題多数。米国では症例なしとされるが、輸入リスク認識あり。対象国リストに含まれるDRCのみを verified_locations に記載。

article.articleHeadline: الكونغو الدّيمقراطية تسجّل 181 حالة وفاة بفيروس إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 181 Ebola virus deaths.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 782 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 181 deaths, according to a Ministry of Health statement dated 2026-06-15. The update notes 72 new infections identified in the previous 24 hours. The rising case and death toll reflect a continuing outbreak within the country, though the report provides no information on the geographic distribution, provinces affected, laboratory methods used for confirmation, patient age or sex, or suspected transmission sources. There is no detail on whether any cases are imported or exported. The article does not describe any response measures or interventions. The reported data underline the need for ongoing surveillance, testing, and outbreak response efforts to curb transmission of Ebola virus disease in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルス死亡181例を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患は極めて高い致命率（23.1%）を持つVHF であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、予想外の流行、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限の懸念があるため、直ちにフルRRAを実施すべきシグナルである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC内でのアウトブレイク継続が明記されており、782例確認例・181例死亡（致命率23.1%）という高い死亡数。72時間内に新規72例という新規患者増加が報告されている。地理的分布・地域情報・実験室確認方法・患者属性・感染源などの詳細情報が不足しているが、それでもVHF（特にエボラ）の性質上、極めて高い優先度でピックアップすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Jawa Barat Catat Kasus DBD Tertinggi, 36 Orang Meninggal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Java records the highest number of dengue fever cases; 36 people died.
article.articleSummary: West Java has the highest dengue fever burden in Indonesia, with 9,526 cases and 36 deaths as of May 19, 2026, according to the Health Ministry. East Java follows with about 5,300 cases and 12 deaths, and Central Java reports 3,792 cases and 9 deaths. National totals through May 2026 reach 39,672 dengue cases and 105 deaths, yielding a case-fatality rate around 0.3%. Health Ministry official Prima Yosephine stated these figures at a June 15, 2026 press conference in Jakarta. The ministry urges stronger vector surveillance and control measures and notes Indonesia’s target of zero dengue deaths by 2030, contingent on cross-sector collaboration among government, communities, and private sector.

triage.headline_ja: 西ジャワ州がデング熱の最高件数を記録、36人死亡
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのデング熱流行は国内的には重大だが、国際的な拡大リスクや渡航制限リスクの明確な言及がなく、情報が限定的。社会的関心の程度が不明のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: デング熱は周期的に流行する既知疾患であり、本事例は国内統計報告。死亡数（36名）と総症例数（西ジャワ州9,526件）は国内的に顕著だが、国際的な拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性、異常性の言及がない。保健省による公式発表であり政府関心は確認できるが、フルRRA前の情報収集継続が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果埃博拉疫情升溫 確診破700死亡超180 | 伊波拉 | 埃博拉病毒 | Ebola | 大紀元
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola outbreak intensifies; confirmed cases surpass 700, deaths surpass 180 | Ebola | Ebola virus | Ebola | The Epoch Times
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak intensifies: Bundibugyo virus causing 782 confirmed cases, 56 recoveries, 181 deaths (case fatality rate 23%) as of June 14, 2026. Most cases (over 90%) are in Ituri Province, with cases also reported in North Kivu and South Kivu; the outbreak has spread to Uganda, with 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. This strain lacks licensed vaccines or specific antivirals; existing vaccines/therapies target Zaire Ebola. U.S. CDC says there are no US cases and overall risk remains low. Transmission occurs via contact with infected bodily fluids; initial symptoms resemble fever, headache, and fatigue, progressing to vomiting, diarrhea, and potential organ failure; incubation 2–21 days. Challenges include difficult surveillance in Ituri’s vast, forested terrain amid conflict-driven displacement (nearly a million people), widespread cross-border mining activity, and distrust, leading to limited contact tracing (about 56%).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国エボラ出血熱の流行が加速 確認患者700人超、死亡180人超
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）の多国間での急速拡大、高い死亡率、既存ワクチンの無効性が確認され、対応困難な状況にある。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスの発生であり、既承認ワクチンはZaire型に対応するため医療対応上の課題あり。ウガンダへの越境感染を確認。記事サマリーはアメリカでの感染を否定しているため、DRC及び関連地域のみを verified_locations に含める。紛争地帯での広大な森林地形、人口移動、採掘活動による拡散リスク高く、監視体制が脆弱（接触追跡率56%）である点が重要。

article.articleHeadline: تأكيد 782 حالة إصابة بفيروس إيبولا وظهور الفيروس بمنطقتين جديدتين بالكونغو - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 782 confirmed cases of Ebola virus infection and the emergence of the virus in two new regions of Congo - The Seventh Day
article.articleSummary: 782 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, with 181 deaths, and 72 new cases reported in the last 24 hours, marking one of the largest daily increases in the ongoing outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The outbreak—DRC’s 17th—remains confined to three eastern provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. For the first time, confirmed cases have been documented in Nyania Health Zone in Ituri and Mabalaqo Health Zone in North Kivu. Overall, confirmed cases now span 20 of Ituri’s 36 health zones, 10 of North Kivu’s 34 health zones, and one health zone in South Kivu. The figures come from a government status report; no specific infection source details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染782例を確認、コンゴの2つの新たな地域でウイルスが出現
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラは高い死亡率を伴う重篤な感染症で、新たな地域への拡大と国際的な懸念を引き起こす可能性が高い。
triage.notes: DRCの17番目のエボラ流行。新規地域への拡大（ニャニア保健地区、マバラロ保健地区）が確認されており、過去24時間で72例の新規症例が報告。181名の死亡が確認されている。国際的な保健危機対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Día Mundial del Dengue: por qué el virus se expande y cuáles son las medidas clave para reducir el riesgo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Dengue Day: Why the virus is spreading and what the key measures are to reduce the risk.
article.articleSummary: World Dengue Day highlights dengue, a viral flavivirus transmitted by Aedes aegypti, threatening about 5.6 billion people and causing 100–400 million infections annually; 2024 saw a historic 14.6 million cases and over 12,000 deaths across more than 100 countries. Dengue, increasingly outdoor-focused and urban, spreads beyond tropical climates due to climate change, urbanization, migration, and travel; four serotypes mean sequential infections risk severe dengue. In Argentina, the 2025-2026 season has 65 confirmed cases; most in the Centro region (56), including Buenos Aires City (30); NEA 4, NOA 3, and Cuyo 2. No new cases were reported in epidemiological week 21. Argentina previously faced the largest dengue outbreak in 2023-2024 (>580,000 cases, 419 deaths) and emphasizes vaccination as part of integrated control. The tetravalent vaccine, approved by ANMAT in 2023 for ages 4+, has distributed over 24 million doses in 40+ countries, with 84.1% efficacy against hospitalizations (4.5-year follow-up) and 90.6% after a booster (2.5 years).

triage.headline_ja: 世界デング熱の日：ウイルスがなぜ拡大しているのか、そしてリスクを減らすための重要な措置は何か
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の世界的流行は重大だが、本記事は啓発・政策解説型であり、アルゼンチンでの新規症例報告がなく（週21）、対象国検証では該当する感染症イベントが限定的である。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はBluedot APIによってアルゼンチン、イタリア、フィリピンの地域が付与されているが、サマリーの主要な感染症イベント発生地はアルゼンチン（2025-2026シーズン65例、2023-2024で58万例以上）である。ただしアルゼンチンは対象国リストに含まれていない。フィリピンはMimaropaおよび他地域で言及されているが、詳細な症例数や流行状況の言及がない。イタリアはBluedot APIの誤付与と考えられ、サマリーに具体的な記載がない。記事は「世界デング熱の日」という啓発イベントの解説で、現在のホットスポット情報というより背景と対策の説明が中心。新規症例報告はアルゼンチンで週21に報告なし。対象国での具体的な流行状況が限定的なため、WATCHとしたが、グローバルな流行規模（2024年1460万例）は重大。

article.articleHeadline: Eliminasi Schistosomiasis, Saatnya Sulteng Beralih dari Pengendalian Menuju Pemutusan Transmisi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Elimination of Schistosomiasis: It's Time for Central Sulawesi to Move from Control to Transmission Interruption.
article.articleSummary: Schistosomiasis remains a challenge in Indonesia, where endemic transmission persists only in Central Sulawesi—in the highlands of Lindu, Sigi Regency, and in Napu and Bada in Poso Regency. World Health Organization estimates over 250 million people globally need prevention and treatment for schistosomiasis (also known as snail fever). In Central Sulawesi, sustained public health efforts—including Mass Drug Administration (MDA), regular surveillance, community education, and environmental interventions—have reduced prevalence to below 1%. This marks significant progress toward elimination, but residual asymptomatic infections and local pockets of transmission persist. Hotspots with prevalence above 1% despite routine MDA indicate pockets of local transmission. The article argues for shifting from mere control to interruption of transmission, with Central Sulawesi pivotal to national elimination.

triage.headline_ja: シストソーマ症の排除：中央スラウェシが対策から感染遮断への転換の時
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアの中央スラウェシにおけるシストソーマ症の流行状況を報道した記事だが、新規の急性事例発生やアウトブレイク宣言ではなく、既知の風土病の対策進捗に関する論説的内容。IHR基準の該当は限定的であるが、東南アジア地域における重要な感染症管理の課題として経過観察に値する。
triage.notes: 記事は既知の風土病（中央スラウェシに限定）の対策転換に関する論説記事であり、新興のシグナルではない。Bluedot APIが返した「Bada」および「Zabaykal'skiy Kray」は誤った位置情報と考えられる。サマリーから実際の発生地はインドネシア中央スラウェシ州の限定された地域（リンド、シギ郡、ナプ、ポソ郡バダ）のみ。流行病学的には長期的な曝露と感染可能性が存在するが、有病率が1%未満に低下しており、急性の懸念事象ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolautbrottet växer: Fler döda och smittade
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak is growing: More dead and infected
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has 782 confirmed and registered cases, according to the country’s health ministry on X. The true number is believed higher, indicating underreporting and suggesting the outbreak has persisted past mid-May, when Africa CDC first flagged it. The outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. The World Health Organization warned that the outbreak is expanding to additional areas in the region. A WHO-led operation, funded at nearly five billion Swedish kronor, has been launched to combat the hemorrhagic fever. Ongoing surveillance, rapid case finding, isolation, and community measures are critical as transmission extends to new districts.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ感染症の流行が拡大：死者と感染者が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目全てに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認症例782件、死亡者あり、新規地域への拡大報告、ワクチンなし、WHO大規模対応展開中。国際的関心極めて高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC北東部でのエボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant）の流行を主題としている。確認症例782件、実数はさらに高いと推定。ワクチンなし、治療法なし。WHO主導の大規模対応実施中（約50億スウェーデンクローナの予算）。新規地域への拡大が警告されており、極めて高いリスク評価。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : un mois après la déclaration d'épidémie, MSF s'inquiète de dangereuses lacunes dans la réponse
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: One Month After the Outbreak Was Declared, MSF Warns of Dangerous Gaps in the Response
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, one month after declaration, with Ituri accounting for about 95% of cases and spread into North Kivu and South Kivu; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases. Congolese authorities list over 650 confirmed cases and more than 130 deaths, though MSF cautions figures likely underestimate the true burden. Diagnostics and surveillance gaps persist: hundreds of mobile tests for Bundibugyo virus have arrived, but many areas remain without rapid testing and North Kivu has only one lab, causing multi-day to week-long result delays. Weaknesses in case detection, contact tracing, and community engagement amid insecurity and displacement hinder response. MSF urges rapid strengthening of diagnosis, surveillance, and access to care, alongside maintaining routine health services (maternal care, vaccination, malaria, cholera) to support Ebola control. MSF operates Ebola treatment centers in Bunia, Mongbwalu, Komanda, Goma, Bukavu, and Lwiro.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：流行宣言から1ヶ月後、MSFが対応のギャップに警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ、コレラ、マラリアの複合発生で、IHR基準4項目全てに該当。DRC国内での複数州への拡大、ウガンダへの国際的な拡大が確認され、診断・監視の重大なギャップが存在する。
triage.notes: ウガンダも19例の確定症例が報告されているが、記事主題はDRCのエボラ流行であり、DRCが主要な発生地。Ituri州で約95%の症例が集中し、北キブ州・南キブ州へと拡大。診断・監視システムの重大な欠陥が対応を阻害している。

article.articleHeadline: Pemkot Bengkulu gencarkan program skrining antisipasi penyebaran HIV
