article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bengkulu City Government steps up HIV screening program to curb the spread of HIV
article.articleSummary: 32 Bengkulu City residents tested HIV-positive by early 2026 as the city tightens HIV screening to curb spread. The Bengkulu City Health Office (Dinkes) reports the cases as an iceberg, with many unaware of their status or avoiding testing due to stigma. The intensified screening targets high-risk groups and uses health facility testing plus field outreach to expand detection. Early detection enables prompt treatment initiation, reducing onward transmission and improving outcomes. The city provides free antiretroviral therapy for those diagnosed, supporting continuous treatment and health stability. Officials urge at-risk individuals to undergo confidential screening, ensuring anonymity. The effort aims to broaden testing, interrupt transmission, and strengthen public health response in Bengkulu City, Bengkulu Province, Indonesia, as of 15 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ベンクル市、HIV感染拡大を防ぐためスクリーニングプログラムを強化
triage.triage_reason: HIV症例検出に対する公衆衛生対応（スクリーニング強化）の記事であり、突発的な感染症危機ではなく、既知の慢性疾患への通常の予防・検査プログラム。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はHIV検査プログラムの強化について報じており、新規の感染症危機やアウトブレイク事象ではない。32症例の検出は既知のHIV問題への通常対応であり、シグナル認識の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Ausbruch: Weiterhin schnelle Ausbreitung von Ebola im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak: Continued rapid spread of Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues to spread rapidly in the northeast, centered in Ituri province. As of 13 June, there are 782 confirmed Ebola cases and 181 deaths (case fatality rate 23.1%), with 359 patients currently hospitalized or in isolation. Contact tracing is weak at 56.5% identified/monitored, well below the 90% target needed to curb transmission according to WHO. MSF warns persistent surveillance gaps: unknown true extent and locations, overwhelmed treatment centers, and many patients arriving late, often without prior contact identification. Testing access is limited and lab result turnaround is slow, hindering early detection. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific therapy. Transmission occurs via direct contact with infected individuals or bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ集団発生：コンゴでのエボラの急速な拡大が続く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による782確定症例、181死亡という重大な outbreak で、接触追跡が目標（90%）に達せず、治療体制が圧倒されている状況は、支援の必要性と国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus はワクチンも特異的治療法も存在しないため重大。接触追跡率56.5%は目標90%を大きく下回り、transmission control に深刻な課題あり。MSFの警告により、実際の症例数が報告以上の可能性も示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de ébola supera los 780 casos y se extiende a 31 zonas sanitarias
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak has surpassed 780 cases and has spread to 31 health zones.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) continues, with 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of 13 June, for a case fatality rate of 23.1%. The epidemic spans 31 health zones across three provinces: Ituri (20 zones), North Kivu (10), and South Kivu (1). In the last 24 hours, 72 new infections and 32 deaths were reported, underscoring sustained intense transmission in the eastern region. Current totals show 359 patients hospitalized or in isolation, and 56 recovered, with 21 new discharges. Surveillance gaps persist, as only 56.5% of identified contacts are being monitored, well below targets. Challenges include logistics, access to communities, population movement, and security issues that complicate public health response and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの流行が780症例を超え、31の保健ゾーンに拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべて該当。対象国DRCで進行中の大規模エボラ流行であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Ebola Bundibugyo型として782確定症例、181死亡（CFR 23.1%）。3州31保健ゾーンに拡大（Ituri 20、North Kivu 10、South Kivu 1）。過去24時間で72新規感染、32死亡と激しい伝播が継続。接触者監視カバー率56.5%で目標値以下。ロジスティクス、アクセス、人口移動、セキュリティ課題による対応困難。

article.articleHeadline: Young children paying the highest price one month since DRC declared new Ebola crisis - Save the Children
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) declared May 15, 2026, centered in Bunia. By June 15, 2026, the Ministry of Health reports 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths overall, with at least 52 children contracting Ebola in the past month, including 16 toddlers/infants, and 19 pediatric deaths. Children 0–14 have a markedly higher case fatality rate than older groups (about 38.6% vs 18.1% for 15–44), underscoring rapid deterioration and the need for early identification, referral, and intensive supportive care. Humanitarian conditions—malnutrition, malaria, poverty, displacement, interrupted vaccination and health services—compound risks. Beyond the illness, families face separation, psychosocial distress, school disruption, and risks of child labor and exploitation. Response measures include active case finding and contact tracing, training community health workers and teachers to identify and refer cases, and distributing hygiene kits and thermometers; ongoing humanitarian crisis affects roughly 15 million people in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: DRCが新しいエボラ危機を宣言してから1ヶ月、最も高い代償を払っているのは幼い子どもたち - セーブ・ザ・チルドレン
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な小児死亡、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全て該当。現在進行形の大規模エボラアウトブレイクで、児童の高い致命率と複合的人道危機が確認された。
triage.notes: DRCでの2026年5月15日宣言のエボラアウトブレイク。782確定例、181死亡。特に幼児・小児の高い致命率（38.6%）が懸念される。マラリア、栄養不良、住民15百万人規模の人道危機との複合的状況。セーブ・ザ・チルドレンによる報告で社会的関心も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo khẩn: Thu hồi toàn bộ sữa công thức Nara Organics sau 3 ca ngộ độc ở trẻ sơ sinh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgent warning: Recall of all Nara Organics infant formula after 3 cases of poisoning in newborns.
article.articleSummary: Three US newborns diagnosed with infant botulism linked to Nara Organics Whole Milk Organic Powdered Infant Formula. Cases occurred in California, Pennsylvania, and Washington. On June 13, 2026, the US FDA voluntarily recalled all Nara Organics infant formula, distributed from July 2025 through June 2026 via Target, Target.com, and Nara.com. Botulinum toxin from Clostridium botulinum can cause severe neurological illness, including paralysis and respiratory failure, particularly in infants. The product was limited to the United States with no official international distribution. To ensure safety, Vietnam's National Food Safety Authority (Cục An toàn thực phẩm) instructed agencies to halt sales, remove advertising, and coordinate recalls if any lot is found in Vietnam; to review product registration/publications, and require import quantities, sales, stock, and proposed disposal plans, with reports due by 25 June 2026. Consumers should heed official alerts and avoid recalled lots.

triage.headline_ja: 緊急警告：3件の新生児中毒事例後、Nara Organics粉ミルク全製品の回収
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「深刻な公衆衛生影響」が該当（乳児ボツリヌス症、複数州での事例、FDA回収）。また対象国ベトナムが積極的な規制対応を実施しており、国際的なサプライチェーンリスクと食品安全の重要性から、シグナルとして認識すべき。
triage.notes: 主要事例は米国（対象国外）で発生したが、ベトナムの国家食品安全庁が積極的な規制措置を発令。記事がベトナムメディア発信であり、ベトナムでの在庫確認・回収措置の必要性が強調されている。汚染食品の国際流通リスクが存在。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolautbrottet växer: Fler döda och smittade
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak grows: More dead and infected.
article.articleSummary: Confirmed and registered Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo’s Kongo-Kinshasa region have risen to 782, according to the country’s health ministry on X. The true burden is believed higher, with the outbreak thought to have been under way longer than mid-May, when Africa CDC publicly announced it. The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo variant of the Ebola virus, for which there is currently no licensed vaccine and no specific treatment. The report underscores the gravity of the situation as cases continue to accumulate in the DRC, with limited countermeasures available for this lineage. No death toll is provided in the summary, and no additional affected locations are specified beyond the Kongo-Kinshasa region mentioned. Ongoing surveillance and public health response remain critical.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大：死亡者と感染者が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は高い重症度と致死率を持ち、ワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株による流行であり、早期の詳細RRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは対象国リスト内のDRCでのエボラ流行を主題としており、Kongo-Kinshasa地域での確認症例782件と報告。Bundibugyo変異体はワクチン・特異的治療がないため、公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。実際の負担はより高いと推定されている。アフリカ大陸全般での言及はあるが、具体的な他国への拡大報告はなく、DRCが唯一の検証対象国。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: One month on, MSF warns dangerous gaps persist in Ebola disease response
article.articleSummary: By 15 June 2026, the DRC reports over 650 confirmed Ebola cases and more than 130 deaths, figures MSF warns are likely undercount. One month after outbreak declaration, Ituri accounts for about 95% of cases, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases across the border. Major gaps persist in surveillance, diagnosis, contact tracing, and community engagement, and testing remains a bottleneck despite new mobile kits and a North Kivu lab processing results in days. MSF warns the outbreak is outpacing the response and calls for scale-up proportional to the crisis. MSF has established Ebola treatment centres in Bunia, Mongbwalu, Komanda, Goma, Bukavu, and Lwiro, reinforced IPC, community engagement, and training, and shipped hundreds of tonnes of equipment and medicines, with nearly 600 staff involved.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: 1ヶ月経過後、MSFはエボラ病対策の危険な格差の継続を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。確認症例650以上、死亡130以上、国境を越えてウガンダへの拡大あり、大規模流行対応が進行中であり、国際的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Uganda）は発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases across the border」と国境を越えた二次的確認にとどまり、主要な発生地はDRCである。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い重症度（130死亡）と国際的拡大リスクを持つため、フルRRA実施が強く推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Der Tag: Ebola breitet sich im Kongo stark aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Day: Ebola is spreading rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola is spreading rapidly in the northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The Congolese Ministry of Health reports 72 new confirmed Ebola cases in the last 24 hours, bringing the total to 782, with deaths rising by 32 to 181. The figures cited refer to June 13, suggesting the current toll is higher. The case fatality rate is 23.1%. About 359 patients are currently in hospitals or isolation units. Contact tracing remains a major challenge, with tracing effectiveness at 56.5%, well short of the 90% target. The World Health Organization states that stopping the outbreak requires identifying and monitoring 90% of all contacts of Ebola patients. The report underscores ongoing transmission and the need for improved surveillance to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラが急速に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大、高い死亡率（23.1%）、接触者追跡の不十分性が確認され、国際的な懸念と支援ニーズが存在する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高レベルのバイオセキュリティリスク。記事は北東部DRCでの急速な拡大を報告し、782確定症例、181死亡、死亡率23.1%を示している。接触者追跡効率56.5%は目標90%に大きく及ばず、持続的な感染の危険を示唆。WHOの国際支援の必要性が明示されている。

article.articleHeadline: Weiterhin schnelle Ausbreitung von Ebola im Kongo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Continued rapid spread of Ebola in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak迅速 spreading in Congo's Ituri Province, with 782 total cases and 181 deaths, up 72 cases and 32 deaths in the last 24 hours; figures refer to June 13, implying higher numbers currently. Case fatality rate ≈23.1%. About 359 patients are hospitalized or in isolation. Contact tracing stands at 56.5%, far below the WHO 90% target for identifying and monitoring contacts, hindering containment. MSF warns that a month into the outbreak, surveillance gaps undercut response: treatment centers are overwhelmed, many patients arrive late, and numerous contacts have not been identified or monitored. Testing access is limited and lab results are slow, risking delayed case detection. Transmission is via direct contact with infected body fluids. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no vaccine or specific therapy, complicating efforts to control the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラの継続的な急速な拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてにも該当。エボラウイルス疾患は重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、急速な広がり、高い致死率、国際的拡大リスク、および管理体制の不十分さが明確である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）はコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥリ州で発生。782例、死亡181例、過去24時間で72例増加。致死率23.1%。接触者追跡率56.5%でWHO目標90%に大きく及ばず、治療センターの過負荷、遅発性患者到着、検査アクセスの制限など、対応上の深刻な課題が複数報告されている。ワクチン・特異的治療法がない現状で国際的支援が不可欠。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de Ébola no Congo sobem para 689 com 139 mortes confirmadas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in Congo rise to 689 with 139 deaths confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 689 confirmed cases and 139 deaths as of 2026-06-15, a case fatality rate of 20.2%. The outbreak began in the eastern region on 15 May, with 29 of 104 health zones in Ituri (the epicenter), North Kivu and South Kivu currently affected. Treatment centers are isolating 315 patients, with a bed occupancy of 69.7%, and authorities are mobilizing additional capacity to ensure rapid and safe care for new patients. Recoveries stand at 32, while 419 alerts have been reported, with about 90% investigated to identify possible cases. The data indicate a sustained eastern outbreak, underscoring ongoing surveillance, case management, and resource expansion.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ症例が689件に上昇、139件の死亡が確認される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大、高い死亡率（20.2%）、東部地域での持続的な流行、国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健上の最高リスク疾患。689確定症例、139死亡、20.2%の症例致命率は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。東部（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）での持続的流行、104の衛生地区中29地区の関連は、国内での感染拡大リスクが高い。処置能力の逼迫（病床稼働率69.7%）と資源拡張の要請は、DRC政府の対応能力の限界を示唆。国際的な支援とWHO関与が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Miền Tây Nam Bộ: Sốt xuất huyết diễn biến phức tạp, nhiều nơi ca bệnh tăng cao
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Southwestern Mekong Delta: Dengue fever is developing in a complex manner, with case numbers rising in many places.
article.articleSummary: On 15 June, ASEAN Dengue Day, dengue fever is rising in a complex pattern across the Southwestern Mekong Delta. Nationwide since January 2026: over 50,000 dengue cases and 5 deaths. In Can Tho, Can Tho Children's Hospital reports nearly 1,300 dengue admissions with 97 severe cases; outpatient visits exceed 1,200. The city’s health center notes over 3,000 cases in 2026 to date, more than 250 severe, and about 1,285 outbreaks sprayed with insecticides while larval-control campaigns continue. In Ca Mau, over 1,100 cases across all communes, 3.5 times higher than the previous year, with 1 death. Vinh Long records over 2,540 cases with no fatalities. An Giang reports over 3,480 cases (+3.9x) and more than 170 severe. Monsoon rains, urbanization, and mobility drive transmission; Ho Chi Minh City plans preventive measures from mid-June.

triage.headline_ja: 南西メコンデルタ地域：デング熱が複雑な様相で進展、多くの地域で患者数が急増
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、異常な発症パターン）。WPROスクリーニング基準で5つ全て該当。ベトナム全域で5万症例超、複数省で3～4倍の増加率、死亡例あり。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: デング熱の季節的上昇期（雨季・モンスーン）と都市化が相まって、複数省で例年比3～4倍の患者増加。ホーチミン市、カントー、カマウ、ビンロン、アンザン各地で重症例・死亡報告あり。ASEAN デング День（6月15日）の注視期にあり、地域的な対策強化（蚊帳の配布、幼虫駆除キャンペーン）も進行中。東南アジア域内での拡大監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-Alarm: "Niemand kennt das wahre Ausmaß"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola alert: "No one knows the true extent."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province shows 782 total cases and 181 deaths (as of June 13), a 23.1% case-fatality rate, with 359 patients currently hospitalized or in isolation. In the last 24 hours, cases rose by 72 and deaths by 32. Reported figures may undercount the true extent. Contact tracing is at 56.5%, far below the WHO target of 90% identification and monitoring of those exposed. MSF warns that surveillance and tracing gaps undermine containment a month after the outbreak began, with overwhelmed treatment centers, late patient presentation, and many not identified as contacts prior to care. Testing access is limited and lab results are slow. Ebola spreads via body contact and body fluids. No vaccine or specific therapy exists for the Bundibugyo strain involved in this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ警報：「誰も真の規模を知らない」
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱の集団発生。782例、死亡181例（CFR 23.1%）という重篤な事例数、接触者追跡の不十分さ（56.5%、目標90%未満）、治療体制の限界が報告されており、IHR基準3項目以上該当、WPRO基準全項目で懸念が確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは明確にコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州でのエボラ出血熱発生を主題としている。Bundibugyo株による集団発生、高い死亡率（23.1%）、接触者追跡の大幅な不足（56.5% vs 90%目標）、治療施設の飽和、診断遅延、ワクチンおよび特異的治療法の欠如が記載されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と国際的対応の必要性が明確。MSFの警告は管理可能性の問題を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: केरल में शिगेला संक्रमण के कारण सात वर्षीय बच्चे की मौत, इस साल यह चौथी मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A seven-year-old child dies of shigellosis in Kerala; fourth death this year.
article.articleSummary: Seven-year-old Arjav from Pookkottur, Malappuram district, Kerala, died from shigellosis on June 15, 2026, after treatment at Kozhikode Government Medical College and Hospital; he was admitted June 12 with fever and diarrhea and Shigella infection was confirmed. This marks Kerala’s fourth death from shigellosis this year and the third in June. As of June 14, Kerala reported 138 confirmed shigellosis cases across the state, with Kozhikode district recording the highest number; 77 suspected cases were also reported statewide. In June alone, 62 cases were lab-confirmed and 17 suspected, with three new cases reported on June 14. Shigella infection is described as a virus-originated infection in the article, causing diarrhea, fever, and abdominal cramps, and mainly spreads through contaminated food or water, and via contact with an infected person.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でシゲラ感染により7歳児が死亡、今年4人目の死亡事例
triage.triage_reason: シゲラ症による死亡事例の増加（今年4件、6月だけで3件）、6月の確認患者62例と急増傾向、水系感染リスク、対象国インドのケーラ州での発生。IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な影響・異常性・国際拡大リスク）、WPRO基準4項目該当（重症度・長期曝露・流行性・管理性）。
triage.notes: ケーラ州（Kerala）での局所的な集団発生。6月の患者急増（62確認例）と3件の死亡事例は短期間での深刻な増加。水系感染経路が指摘されており、公衆衛生対応が急務。記事では細菌をウイルス起源と誤記しているが、シゲラは細菌性赤痢菌である。国内感染症対応体制の強化が必要と判断。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola breitet sich in DR Kongo weiter aus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread in the DR Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak persists in the Democratic Republic of Congo, concentrated in the northeast, notably Ituri province. As of June 13, total cases reached 782 (up 72 in 24 hours) with 181 deaths (case fatality rate 23.1%). Approximately 359 patients are hospitalized or in isolation. Contact tracing stands at 56.5%, far below target, complicating containment. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) warns that surveillance gaps a month after the Ituri outbreak began are undermining efforts: treatment centers are overwhelmed, patients often arrive late, and many have not been identified or monitored as contacts. Figures reference June 13; the article was published on June 15, 2026, indicating ongoing transmission in the region."}{}{

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国で引き続き拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響、高い致命率、接触者追跡の不十分さなど複数の懸念要因があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 782症例、181死亡（致命率23.1%）、接触者追跡56.5%と目標値以下。MSFが報告した監視ギャップと医療施設の過負荷状態は重大な懸念。エボラ出血熱のヒト-ヒト感染の高い伝播性と高い致命率により、複数の国際的リスク基準に該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is back. So are the double standards
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus drives the Ebola outbreak centered in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) with spillover into Uganda. As of 9 June, 617 confirmed cases and 117 deaths are reported. No approved vaccine or specific treatment exists; care is supportive (hydration, fever management, secondary infection treatment, transfusions). Containment hinges on contact tracing and infection control, though burial practices and distrust of health workers complicate efforts. Genetic analysis indicates a single recent spillover event. The outbreak heightens regional risk amid ongoing travel between the DRC, Uganda, and Johannesburg, South Africa. While South Africa is not considered at immediate risk, Western countries have banned travel from the region, and the United States has proposed a quarantine facility in Kenya for Americans in outbreak zones, prompting a Kenyan High Court order to temporarily close the Laikipia Air Base quarantine site. No vaccine exists for Bundibugyo ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが戻ってきた。二重基準も一緒に。
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）のDRC中心の爆発的発生、617例の確認患者と117人の死亡、ウガンダへの流行、南アフリカを含む地域への拡大リスク、複数国への国際的拡散の証拠があり、WHO通知基準を明らかに超えている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは複数国言及（DRC、ウガンダ、南アフリカ、ケニア、米国）だが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。ウガンダは「spillover」として言及されているが、主要な発生地域はDRC。発生地域フィールドにはケニア、南アフリカ、米国も含まれるが、これらは対象国外またはイベント発生地ではなく、対応地として記載されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus は西アフリカのエボラよりも致死率は低いが、617確認患者と117死亡は深刻な公衆衛生危機。ワクチンなし、治療法なし、国際的移動と地域間の信頼問題が複雑さを増す。

article.articleHeadline: 高雄爆發登革熱群聚！累計6例、確診第2型，疾管署：防蚊大作戰不鬆懈
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kaohsiung dengue fever outbreak cluster! A total of 6 cases, serotype 2 confirmed; Taiwan CDC: Mosquito-control campaign must not slack off.
article.articleSummary: Kaohsiung, Taiwan – Dengue fever cluster at Kaohsiung Minsheng Hospital grows to 6 locally acquired cases, all dengue virus serotype 2, the first hospital-linked cluster in eight years. The index case is a woman in her 70s with chronic illness who was hospitalized May 29–June 10, re-admitted June 11 with fever and dizziness. Taiwan CDC says intra-hospital transmission is likely due to same-serotype virus; genome sequencing expected by June 16 to confirm a single transmission chain. Nationally, seven locally acquired dengue cases this year, all in Kaohsiung; 68 imported cases from Southeast Asia and South Asia, Indonesia 21, Maldives 14, Vietnam 9. A mobile anti-epidemic team supports hospital and surrounding community vector-control; monitoring continues through July 12. With monsoon season, standing water after rain fosters Aedes breeding; residents advised to clean environments, wear light-colored long sleeves/pants, and use government-approved repellents; seek medical care promptly with travel history if fever.

triage.headline_ja: 高雄でデング熱クラスター発生！累計6例、2型確認；台湾疾管署：蚊対策キャンペーン継続
triage.triage_reason: 台湾（対象国外）での院内クラスター発生だが、越境リスク低く、対象国内での実発生地が確認できないため。ただしベトナム・インドネシアなど対象国への輸入例があり経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要事象は台湾高雄での院内クラスター（対象国外）。ただし輸入症例がベトナム・インドネシアから確認されており、これらの対象国を verified_locations に含める。モンスーン季節による蚊媒介リスク増加、院内感染チェーン追跡が進行中。死亡や重症度については記事に記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: 基礎研究から臨床へ、日本発ニパウイルスワクチンの第1相試験を開始｜共同通信PRワイヤー｜茨城新聞クロスアイ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: From basic research to clinical, Japan-origin Nipah virus vaccine begins Phase I trial | Kyodo News PR Wire | Ibaraki Shimbun Cross I
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus vaccine MV-NiV, a measles-virus vector, begins Phase I human trial in Belgium (Ghent University Vaccine Center) on 2026-06-15 to assess safety and immunogenicity. The study is led by Teikyo University researchers Misako Yoneda, Chieko Kai, and Tomoko Fujiyuki, advancing toward practical Nipah vaccination. Nipah virus causes fatal encephalitis with case fatality up to 90%, outbreaks recurring in South Asia (Bangladesh, India) since 1999, with fruit bats as natural reservoirs and human-to-human transmission reported; no approved therapies or vaccines exist. The MV-NiV program has demonstrated strong protection and safety in preclinical studies using a measles vaccine backbone, and EU BSL-4 facilities supported efficacy data. CEPI funded, AMED SCARDA supports, and a broad international collaboration (15+ institutions including EVI, Stanford, icddr,b, ERINHA) underpins the project. If safety and immunogenicity are confirmed, progression to Phase II in Bangladesh is anticipated, aiming for durable protection with a two-dose regimen."

triage.headline_ja: 基礎研究から臨床へ、日本発ニパウイルスワクチンの第1相試験を開始
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高い致死率（最大90%）と南アジアでの継続的な流行という深刻な脅威であるが、本記事は臨床試験開始の進捗報告であり、現在の感染症アウトブレイク事象ではなく、ワクチン開発のマイルストーンである。基礎情報は充実しているが、実際の流行発生を示す情報がないため、継続的な動向監視が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはベルギー（Gent/Flanders）も含まれているが、これは臨床試験実施地であり、ニパウイルスの自然発生地ではない。バングラデシュとインドは歴史的なニパウイルス流行地として記事本文に言及されており、verified_locationsに含める。本件はワクチン開発の進捗報告であり、アウトブレイク通知ではないため、引き続き南アジアにおける実際の流行状況の監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا يتسع في الكونغو.. 72 إصابة جديدة خلال يوم واحد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads in Congo: 72 new cases in one day.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: As of 15 June 2026, Ebola virus disease has reached 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, after 72 new infections in 24 hours, one of the largest daily increases in this seventh outbreak. The outbreak remains centered in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, but is expanding within health zones. For the first time, confirmed cases have been reported in Nia-Nia Health Zone in Ituri and in Mabalako Health Zone in North Kivu, indicating widening transmission within current foci. Confirmed cases now occur in 20 of 36 health zones in Ituri, 10 of 34 in North Kivu, and one health zone in South Kivu. Health authorities are maintaining close surveillance and response to prevent spread to additional areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴで拡大：1日で72人の新規患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、DRCにおける大規模エボラ流行（782確定患者、181死亡）の急速な拡大。1日72人という大きな日次増加、複数州への地理的拡大、国際的蔓延リスク、貿易・渡航制限可能性が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最も高いリスク疾患の一つ。第7次流行で782確定患者、181死亡、1日72人の新規患者は極めて高い増加率。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kuvuの東部3州に集中しつつ複数ヘルスゾーンに拡大中。新しいフォーカス（Nia-Nia、Mabalako）での初確認患者により地理的拡大が実証されている。WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当する極めて高リスクのシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola deja 149 muertos en la República Democrática del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola leaves 149 dead in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo features 710 confirmed cases and 149 deaths as of 14 June 2026. In Kinshasa, health authorities warn containment remains difficult. Residents of the Kpangba displacement camp blocked epidemiological tracing after disputing reports that two women died from Ebola, forcing the Ministry of Health, WHO, and partners to abandon the area and suspend contact tracing. The Nizi health zone, hosting 22 displacement sites, lacks preventive measures. The World Health Organization acknowledged some progress in contact tracing but cautioned that efforts are not yet sufficient to stop transmission. The situation highlights challenges of operating in displacement settings and the need for community cooperation and strengthened surveillance to control the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で149人の死者を出す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な疾患、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを有する。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生を主題としており、710確認症例、149死亡（2026年6月14日現在）を報告。キンシャサ、Kpangba難民キャンプ、Nizi保健地区での感染継続を指摘。社会的混乱（接触者追跡の困難さ、コミュニティ協力の不足）が強調されている。Sierra Leone は記事内で主題とされていないため verified_locations から除外した（Bluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーではDRCが一貫して焦点）。

article.articleHeadline: Inside Ebola country: NPR reports from eastern DR Congo's outbreak zone
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bunia as the epicenter. The government declared the outbreak on May 15; as of June 13, 782 confirmed cases and 181 confirmed deaths in eastern Congo, with Bunia reporting 212 cases. Counts are believed to be underestimates due to testing delays and uncounted village deaths. The outbreak likely began with clusters in Mongbwalu before detection. Health workers face major challenges: Clinique Universelle hospital shut after a patient tested positive; decontamination teams scrub facilities; PPE shortages persist despite aid deliveries of medicines and PPE. A sick man vomited blood in the city before dying, underscoring ongoing transmission, and only 56% of contacts have been traced across three provinces with active Ebola transmission. Community outreach and Ebola Awareness Day aim to promote prevention amid conflict, limited infrastructure, and dense populations.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ国内から：NPRが東部コンゴ民主共和国の流行地帯から報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当する極めて重大な出来事。確認症例782件・死亡181件の進行中のエボラ流行で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC東部イトゥリ州ブニアを震源とするエボラ流行を明確に描写。2026年5月15日に政府が宣言、6月13日時点で確認症例782件・死亡181件。保健医療施設の閉鎖、PPE不足、接触者追跡率56%など管理可能性の課題が深刻。進行中の市中感染と多数の死亡例が確認され、控えめな推定でも実際の影響はより大きい可能性。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo: een maand na de uitbraak blijft ebolarespons ernstig tekortschieten
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: One month after the outbreak, the Ebola response remains severely underperforming.
article.articleSummary: One month after the Ebola outbreak declaration in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns that surveillance, diagnosis, contact tracing, and community engagement remain severely under-resourced, hampering control efforts. In the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, Ituri accounts for about 95% of cases. Official figures exceed 650 confirmed cases and over 130 deaths, though MSF cautions the true burden is likely higher. Testing remains a major weakness despite expanded lab capacity and hundreds of mobile test kits for Bundibugyo virus, with many communities—especially in insecure areas—having limited access and lab results arriving after delays. In North Kivu, only one lab analyzes blood samples, and there is no automatic system to relay results to health centers. MSF has established treatment centers in Bunia, Mongbwalu, Komanda, Goma, Bukavu, and Lwiro, and supports surveillance; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases. An urgent scale-up is needed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ発生から1か月、対応が深刻に不十分なままである
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス疾患は深刻な公衆衛生影響を持ち、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダで既に19確認例）と渡航・貿易制限リスクがある。西アフリカでの過去の流行経験から、対応不足は極めて危険。フルRRAに進むべき。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患（Bundibugyo virus）は極めて高リスク疾患。記事サマリーから、DRC内の東部地域（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）が主要な発生地域であり、Ituri州が約95%の症例を占める。確認例650以上、死亡130以上で、実際の負荷はさらに高い可能性がある。隣国ウガンダでも既に19確認例が報告されており、国際的拡大の兆候が見られる。検査、接触者追跡、コミュニティエンゲージメントの重篤なリソース不足が報告されており、管理可能性に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Lâm Đồng ghi nhận 2.265 ca mắc tay chân miệng, một ca tử vong do chủng EV71
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Lam Dong Province records 2,265 cases of hand, foot and mouth disease, and one death caused by the EV71 strain.
article.articleSummary: Lam Dong Province reports 2,265 hand, foot and mouth disease (HFMD) cases from the start of 2026 through 15 June, up 1,510 (176.6%) vs 2025. One death is attributed to Enterovirus 71 (EV71). An outbreak has emerged in Toa Cat village, Ta Nang commune. EV71 is described as capable of severe disease with rapid progression, risking further community transmission without decisive control measures. The Lam Dong Department of Health urges the provincial Center for Disease Control to monitor epidemiology, assist with outbreak investigations, sample collection and laboratory confirmation to detect EV71 and other risks. It calls for coordination with public and private healthcare facilities, preschools, and other entities to detect cases early, contain spread from the first case, and implement patient triage, isolation, and infection control. Prepare adequate staffing, medications, supplies, and sanitation; local authorities should prioritize HFMD prevention and daily health surveillance in children.

triage.headline_ja: ラムドン省が手足口病2,265症例を記録、EV71株による1名の死亡
triage.triage_reason: Enterovirus 71による死亡例を伴う手足口病の顕著な増加（前年比176.6%）を報告。重症度、異常性、コミュニティ伝播リスクが明確であり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 2026年の現在年におけるデータであることに留意。EV71による死亡例と急速な感染拡大のリスク、発生地のToa Cat村での局地的アウトブレイクが確認されている。予防接種体制やウイルス監視体制の強化が地域レベルで要求されている。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N8
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2

article.articleHeadline: 兩歲男童染甲型禽流感H9N2　徐樂堅指屬低致病性 　料本地大流行風險低 (17:00) - 20260615
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two-year-old boy contracted avian influenza A(H9N2); Xu Lejian says it is of low pathogenicity; local pandemic risk is low (17:00) - 20260615
article.articleSummary: Two-year-old boy in Hong Kong contracted avian influenza A(H9N2); authorities classify it as low pathogenic and local pandemic risk as low. The child visited a local street market selling live poultry and a fresh-food shop with live birds, exposing him to contaminated surfaces. Whole-genome sequencing showed no mutations in the virus. Environmental sampling from the home, market, and a park yielded 17 samples (15 negative, 2 pending). Household contacts (13 people) remained asymptomatic with negative tests and received prophylactic antivirals. H9N2 typically causes mild illness via direct poultry contact or contaminated environments; there is no sustained human-to-human transmission. Parents are advised to keep young children away from live-poultry markets. Separately, influenza and COVID-19 activity has risen since May; influenza positivity and hospitalizations are near baseline, while COVID-19 has produced several severe pediatric cases and rare care-home outbreaks, including one death; summer peaks for both are possible.

triage.headline_ja: 2歳の男児が鳥インフルエンザA(H9N2)に感染；徐楽堅は低病原性に属するとし、地域のパンデミックリスクは低いと指摘
triage.triage_reason: H9N2鳥インフルエンザの小児確認例であり、予想外性と持続曝露リスクの基準を満たすが、当局が低病原性・低流行リスクと評価し、濃厚接触者が全員陰性で人-人感染がない点から、直ちにフルRRA対象とはしない。ただし香港での新規感染例であり、今後の動向を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 香港での初回H9N2ヒト感染例として医学的には注目に値するが、当局による低リスク評価、濃厚接触者の全員陰性、人-人感染歴がない点から、現時点では即座のピックアップより経過観察が適切。今後の追加症例や環境検体の結果（2検体保留中）に注視を要する。

article.articleHeadline: 181 döda och smittade i Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 181 dead and infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kongo-Kinshasa) with 181 deaths and 782 confirmed cases as of 2026-06-15. The Bundibugyo variant is involved; no vaccine or specific treatment exists. Health authorities warn the true toll is likely higher and that transmission appears to have continued since mid-May. WHO warns the outbreak is expanding to more areas; a WHO-led response worth nearly five billion Swedish kronor has been launched to combat the hemorrhagic fever. The article notes Ebola virus disease but provides limited symptom details.

triage.headline_ja: エボラで181人の死亡・感染者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当。コンゴ民主共和国北東部でのエボラウイルス病アウトブレイク、181死亡・782確認症例、Bundibugyo変異株、国際的拡大警告、WHOによる大規模対応開始。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo変異株によるエボラアウトブレイク。ワクチンや特異的治療法がない。WHOが大規模対応を開始。実際の感染者数がより多い可能性が指摘されている。5月中旬以降も伝播が継続している。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe grave por VSR tem aumento de casos no CE; veja sintomas e prevenção
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe flu caused by RSV on the rise in CE; see symptoms and prevention.
article.articleSummary: RSV-driven SRAG (Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome) is rising in Ceará, Brazil. In weeks 14–17 (April–early May) there were 1,006 SRAG notifications; weeks 18–21 (late May) 945. Despite an overall SRAG decline, Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) led detections, comprising 40.9% of SRAG cases in the last four weeks, with lab positivity increasing from 11.9% to 26.0%. The 1–4 year age group remains the most affected. In Fortaleza, 275 SRAG cases were recorded in weeks 16–21; since January the capital has 945 SRAG cases, with 1–4 years (247) and under-1 year (226) most impacted. Influenza A declined (2.2% to 1.1%), while Influenza B rose (6.8% to 12.1%). Co-circulation includes rhinovirus, COVID-19, metapneumovirus. Oseltamivir and vaccination contributed to fewer severe outcomes; weekend health posts are part of seasonal planning. Regional spread extends to Sobral and Cariri (Juazeiro do Norte, Crato, Barbalha).

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州でRSVによる重症インフルエンザが増加中；症状と予防方法を確認
triage.triage_reason: RSVを主とした複数の呼吸器感染症の同時流行がブラジル（セアラ州）で報告されており、小児層に集中。ただし死亡報告や国際拡大の明示的証拠に欠け、地域内の流行対応が進行中のため、追加情報の経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、ブラジルのセアラ州でRSV主導のSRAG（重症急性呼吸器症候群）流行が進行中。複数の呼吸器病原体（RSV 40.9%、Influenza B 12.1%、COVID-19、メタニューモウイルス）の同時流行。1～4歳が最も影響を受ける。一部で実験室陽性率の上昇（11.9%→26.0%）と患者数増加が報告されているが、全体SRAG数は減少傾向にある。死亡数、重症化率の詳細は記事に記載されていない。オセルタミビルとワクチン接種により重症化が減少した模様。IHR基準で「serious_impact」と「unusual_unexpected」に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも4項目に該当するが、社会的・政治的関心の詳細が不足しており、追加情報を待つ段階と判断した。

article.articleHeadline: Halálos ebola-járvány árnyékában, kongói árvák éneklik magyarul a Republic legendás slágerét - hallgasd meg te is
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the shadow of a deadly Ebola outbreak, Congolese orphans sing the Republic's legendary hit in Hungarian — listen to it as well.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports an Ebola outbreak with multiple deaths. The article contrasts this with a heartwarming moment: orphans at La Providence Orphanage in the DRC sing Hungary’s Republic hit “67-es út” in Hungarian, a video on the Afrikáért Alapítvány YouTube channel. La Providence, supported by Hungarian aid since 2008, houses children who lost parents or lack family care. The piece highlights widespread poverty and fragile social and health systems: many live on under two dollars a day; official free basic education exists, but state-run orphanages are largely nonfunctional, and healthcare is often inaccessible. Ebola has drawn global attention and continues to claim lives, underscoring how preventable diseases persist where screening and treatment options are limited.

triage.headline_ja: 致命的なエボラ出血熱の流行の影 — コンゴの孤児たちがハンガリーの共和国の伝説的ヒット曲をハンガリー語で歌う
triage.triage_reason: DRCにおけるエボラ出血熱の発生報告があり、IHR基準3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、死亡報告あり。
triage.notes: 発生地域にHungaryが含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCでのエボラ発生が主題であり、Hungaryはハンガリーの援助団体による人道支援の文脈でのみ登場するため verified_locations から除外した。記事は2026年6月15日時点でDRCにおける複数の死亡事例を伴うエボラ発生を報告している。

article.articleHeadline: La cifra de fallecidos en el brote de ébola del Congo sigue subiendo y supera los 180
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll in the Congo Ebola outbreak continues to rise and has surpassed 180.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to rise, with 181 confirmed deaths, more than 780 infections, and 40 recoveries reported as of June 15, 2026. The health ministry notes 72 new infections and two additional health zones affected, bringing the total to 31. The estimated case fatality rate is about 50%. Early symptoms include sudden fever, fatigue, malaise, muscle pains, sore throat, and headache, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and deterioration of kidney and liver function. The Democratic Republic of the Congo remains the country with the most Ebola experience, having faced more than a dozen outbreaks since 1976, and had declared the previous outbreak over in December 2025.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ出血熱の死者数が増加し続け、180人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い重症度・死亡率を示し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響は明白。国際的な懸念事項であり、複数の保健ゾーン拡大傾向により感染拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の新規事例。感染者781人、死者181人（致命率約50%）。31の保健ゾーンに拡大。DRCはエボラ最多発生国であり、2025年12月に前回の流行終息を宣言していただけに再発火は懸念材料。国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威度は最高レベル。

article.articleHeadline: Agência Minas Gerais | Governo de Minas amplia combate às arboviroses com Método Wolbachia em Mário Campos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Minas Gerais Agency | Minas Gerais Government Expands Fight Against Arboviruses With Wolbachia Method in Mário Campos
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, Minas Gerais began deploying Wolbachia-infected Aedes aegypti (Wolbitos) in Mário Campos, part of the Belo Horizonte metropolitan region, to curb arboviruses under the Paraopeba Project. The releases—produced in Belo Horizonte's biofactory with more than R$ 77 million in government funding—are coordinated by SES-MG with World Mosquito Program Brasil, Fiocruz, and the municipal government. Wolbachia bacteria block dengue, Zika, and chikungunya virus development in mosquitoes, reducing transmission without genetic modification. Releases will occur over about 20 weeks; expected results may be seen about two years after the final release. The Paraopeba rollout began in Brumadinho in March and will encompass 22 municipalities in the Paraopeba basin, as part of reparations from the 2019 Vale dam disaster that killed 272 people, funded by the Brumadinho Judicial Agreement.

triage.headline_ja: ミナスジェライス州政府、マリオカンポスでウォルバキア法を用いたアルボウイルス対策を拡大
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで実施されている予防的なベクターコントロール活動（ウォルバキア菌感染蚊の放出）であり、新規の感染症患者発生報告ではない。スクリーニング基準は満たさないが、複数のアルボウイルス対策という背景から経過観察が妥当。
triage.notes: 本記事はDengue、Zika、Chikungunyaの患者発生報告ではなく、2019年ダム災害の補償に関連した政府主導のベクターコントロール事業報告である。ウォルバキア菌を感染させたAedes aegyptiの放出は確立された予防手法であり、新規感染症シグナルには該当しない。政府の制度的な関心は高いが、CEPR-EBSのシグナル識別基準は満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: Số ca sốt xuất huyết ở Cần Thơ ghi nhận vẫn ở mức cao, ngành y tế khuyến cáo người dân chủ động diệt lăng quăng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever cases in Can Tho remain high; health authorities urge residents to actively eliminate mosquito larvae.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Can Tho City, Vietnam remains high in 2026, with 3,038 cases and 1,285 outbreak clusters reported to date, including 252 severe cases and no deaths. On June 15, Can Tho’s Department of Health and the City CDC marked ASEAN Dengue Day’s 16th edition to raise awareness and mobilize prevention. Health authorities urge active environmental sanitation, elimination of mosquito breeding sites, and intensified mosquito control, complemented by public education to change behaviors. Residents are advised to regularly inspect water containers and remove larval habitats (mosquito larvae) to keep environments clean and safe. Dengue is described as a dangerous infectious disease with a high outbreak risk in Southeast Asia, especially during challenging weather conditions, underscoring the need for community-wide action during the rainy season.

triage.headline_ja: カントー市のデング熱患者数は依然として高水準、保健当局が住民に積極的な蚊幼虫駆除を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の既知の流行地域での継続的な患者報告であり、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）に該当するが、新規の異常な事態や国際的拡大の明確なシグナルはない。情報が限定的なため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: カントー市は2026年にデング熱患者3,038件、1,285の感染クラスターを報告。重症例252件、死亡者0件。当局が積極的な啓発・蚊対策を実施中。デング熱はベトナムの風土病であり、季節性流行のため「異常」とは判定されない。ただし重症例数と患者数が多く、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 精准守护，快速响应 -- -- 妙智检猫瘟抗原检测试纸条重磅上市，筑牢爱宠健康第一道防线
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Precision protection, rapid response — MiaoZhiJian feline panleukopenia antigen test strips make a grand debut, fortifying the first line of defense for your pet's health.
article.articleSummary: Feline panleukopenia (FPV) antigen test strips debut from MiaoZhiJian to enable rapid home or clinic screening, addressing high risk in young kittens (3–5 months). The test employs aptamer-CRISPR-paper-based microfluidics, achieving >99% accuracy with a limit of detection of 10 copies/μL and no cross-reactivity with common feline pathogens such as feline coronavirus or feline herpesvirus. Samples can be feces or rectal swabs; after 5 minutes of processing, the sample is applied to the card and incubated at 39°C for 30 minutes, with results read by color change or portable fluorescence. Each box contains 20 tests with pre-dried reagents; storage is 2–30°C for 12 months, no cold chain required. In 412 clinical samples, total qPCR concordance reached 99%, with cost about one-third of PCR. Applications span homes, clinics, shelters, breeding facilities, and customs ports for imported/exported cases, enabling fast, affordable FPV screening and early intervention.

triage.headline_ja: 精准守護，快速響應 — 妙智檢貓瘟抗原檢測試紙條重磅上市，築牢愛寵健康第一道防線
triage.triage_reason: 本イベントは猫汎白血球減少症(FPV)の診断検査キット上市であり、感染症パンデミックのシグナルではない。公衆衛生危機に該当しない動物用医療製品情報である。
triage.notes: 本記事は猫汎白血球減少症(FPV)は動物疾病であり、COVID-19とは無関係。Bluedot APIの疾患分類エラーの可能性。診断検査キットの商品上市に関する報道であり、感染症アウトブレイクのシグナルではない。スクリーニング対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola continúa propagándose en provincias afectadas de RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread in affected provinces of the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola persists in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 782 laboratory-confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of 15 June 2026, one month after the epidemic was declared on 15 May. The outbreak remains confined to three provinces: Ituri (Nia-Nia health zone) and North Kivu (Mabalako), plus South Kivu. Two new health zones — Nia-Nia in Ituri and Mabalako in North Kivu — were added to the list, bringing the total to 31 health zones with confirmed cases out of 104. The epidemic is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a strain for which there are no vaccines or approved treatments. Authorities report 40 recoveries and a case-fatality rate of 23.1%, lower than past Zaire ebolavirus outbreaks but still substantial.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱がコンゴ民主共和国の被災州で引き続き拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な影響：782確認症例、死亡181人；異常性：Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模流行；国際拡大リスク：国境地域での発生；渡航制限リスク：エボラ出血熱は高リスク病原体）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全5項目に該当。フルリスク評価（RRA）に進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus はワクチンおよび承認済み治療法がない株であり、公衆衛生上の脅威として重大。発症1ヶ月後の時点で複数州にわたる拡大が継続中。症例致命率23.1%は過去のザイールエボラウイルスアウトブレイクより低いが、依然として実質的な懸念。DRC内での地理的拡大（South Kivu、Ituri、North Kivu）が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DR Congo rise to 710, death toll reaches 149
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) has reached 710 confirmed cases and 149 deaths. Over the past 24 hours, 21 new infections were recorded. WHO data show 137 samples tested in the last day, with 35 positives. The current outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment (unlike the Zaire strain, for which vaccines/treatments exist). Authorities attribute the apparent surge to expanded diagnostic capacity that enabled processing of a backlog of previously collected samples. The outbreak was detected in eastern Congo less than a month after authorities declared it, underscoring the severity and the urgency of containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数が710人に増加、死亡者は149人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。確認患者710人、死亡149人の大規模アウトブレイク、ワクチン/治療法が利用できないBundibugyo株による深刻な影響。国際的拡大リスクおよび渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はZaire株と異なり承認済みワクチン/治療法が存在しないため、制御難度が高い。過去24時間で21件の新規感染が報告されており、流行の拡大傾向が示唆される。DRCはIHR報告義務国であり、国際的な懸念の対象となる可能性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế yêu cầu rà soát, ngừng lưu hành sữa Nara Organics liên quan 3 ca ngộ độc ở Mỹ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ministry of Health requests a review and to suspend the distribution of Nara Organics milk linked to three poisoning cases in the United States.
article.articleSummary: Three infant botulism cases in the United States (California, Pennsylvania, and Washington) are linked to Nara Organics Whole Milk Organic Powdered Infant Formula, triggering a voluntary recall by Nara Organics. FDA disclosed distribution in the U.S. via Target stores, Target.com, and Nara.com from July 2025 to June 2026; the product was not officially distributed outside the U.S. In Vietnam, the Ministry of Health’s Food Safety Department urged a rapid review of any registration or labeling for this formula and, if present, immediate recall. Authorities should halt use, notify distributors and consumers, and report imported, sold, and stock quantities to enable appropriate action. They also asked e-commerce platforms to suspend sales and remove ads for recalled lots and to cooperate with the producer on the recall. Local governments must report results by 25 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がナラオーガニクス粉ミルクの流通停止を要請 - 米国の3件の乳幼児ボツリヌス中毒に関連
triage.triage_reason: 本事例は米国での限定的な製品リコール対応であり、対象国内での発症報告がない。ベトナムは予防的な流通停止要請のみで、IHR基準およびWPRO基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが Vietnam を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーではベトナム国内での発症事例は報告されていない。米国での3件の乳幼児ボツリヌス中毒が発生し、その製品がベトナムの保健省により流通停止対象として審査された背景だが、ベトナムは対象国リストに含まれるものの、実際の感染症イベント発生地ではなく監視国となっている。したがって verified_locations は空配列とする。本件は製品安全性の行政対応であり、感染症シグナルとしては位置づけられない。

article.articleHeadline: Friss adat jött az Ebola járványról, Magyarország is érintett
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New data on the Ebola outbreak; Hungary is also affected.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda draws international attention. Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has led to hundreds of confirmed cases and a significant number of deaths in the DRC by mid-June 2026, with Uganda reporting confirmed cases as well. On May 17, 2026, the WHO declared the event a public health emergency of international concern, though not a pandemic. Transmission requires direct contact with infected body fluids, secretions, contaminated objects, or deceased patients, with health workers and close contacts at highest risk without proper protection. Symptoms include fever, weakness, muscle pains, vomiting, diarrhea, and sometimes hemorrhage; early symptoms are nonspecific, making travel history crucial. In Hungary, EU/EEA risk is very low per the ECDC, while national labs maintain high biosafety capacity. Travelers with recent exposure should seek medical advice by phone and disclose travel history if symptoms develop.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行に関する新データが発表、ハンガリーも関連
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。DRC・ウガンダでの数百確認症例と死亡者、WHOによるPHEIC宣言、国際的拡大リスク、複数国への渡航関連。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC・ウガンダでのBundibugyo型エボラ流行が主題。ハンガリーについては記述が「EU/EEAリスクが非常に低い」という評価のみで、実際の発生地ではなく対象リストにも非該当のため除外。ウガンダはNot SEARO対象国のため除外。WHOのPHEIC宣言（パンデミック宣言ではない）により国際的関心が高く、RRA進行対象。

article.articleHeadline: 默沙东呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）预防单抗获批，为中国婴儿RSV预防带来新选择
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Merck's Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) Prophylactic Monoclonal Antibody Approved, Bringing a New Option for RSV Prevention in Chinese Infants.
article.articleSummary: Merck's long-acting RSV monoclonal antibody (克莱罗韦单抗; brand Anfu Chang) has been approved by China's National Medical Products Administration to prevent RSV-associated lower respiratory tract infections in newborns and infants entering or born during the upcoming RSV season. RSV remains one of the most common causes of respiratory infections in children under five worldwide. The antibody is indicated for healthy term infants, preterm infants, and those at high risk for severe RSV disease, and uses a fixed dose given by injection regardless of weight. Chinese virologist Qian Yuan of the Capital Institute of Pediatrics notes that passive immunity early in life can reduce severe outcomes, and that a single-dose regimen simplifies protection. Merck leaders Tang Kaiyu and Li Zhengqing emphasize the approval provides a new preventive option for Chinese newborns and underscores Merck's commitment to RSV prevention and awareness in China.

triage.headline_ja: メルクの呼吸道合胞病毒（RSV）予防単クローン抗体が承認、中国の乳幼児RSV予防に新たな選択肢をもたらす
triage.triage_reason: 医薬品承認のニュースであり、感染症の突発的な流行や異常な多発ではない。感染症危機管理上のシグナルとしては該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はRSV予防医薬品の中国での承認案内であり、感染症イベント（outbreak、clusters、異常な疾患多発）の報告ではない。医療用医薬品の規制承認は通常、疾患監視シグナルトリアージの対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев заболевания Эболой в ДР Конго выросло до 782
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 782.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease has surged in the Democratic Republic of Congo to 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, as of June 15, 2026. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain outbreak, declared May 15, is spreading in the war-torn Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, with additional cases detected in two districts in Ituri and North Kivu. In the last 24 hours, 32 deaths and 72 new infections were reported. Confirmed Ebola cases have also appeared in neighboring Uganda, indicating cross-border transmission. The outbreak persists amid armed conflict, complicating surveillance and response. Public health measures, case finding, laboratory confirmation, and cross-border coordination are essential to curb transmission and prevent further export.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ患者数が782人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患は深刻で異常、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境感染）があり、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの越境感染事例は記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めず。DRC は対象国であり、サマリーの主題。2026年6月時点で782確定症例、181死亡、過去24時間で72新規感染。武装紛争下での蔓延により対応が複雑化。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株であることは注目。

article.articleHeadline: Inside Ebola country: NPR reports from eastern DR Congo's outbreak zone
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with Bunia as the epicenter. The government declared the outbreak on May 15 after cases clustered in Mongbwalu; the virus had likely circulated weeks earlier. As of June 13, 782 confirmed Ebola cases and 181 confirmed deaths have been reported in eastern Congo, though officials say counts underestimate the reality due to testing delays and unrecorded village deaths. Bunia alone accounts for 212 confirmed cases, the largest share in the city of over 1 million. Tracing contacts remains challenging: only 56% of contacts have been traced across three provinces, amid armed groups, poor roads, and dense populations. Hospitals like Clinique Universelle have been decontaminated after positive cases; staff work without adequate PPE, driven by fear but continuing to help. Community volunteers, such as Eliezer Kasongo, conduct door-to-door outreach to raise awareness.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ国内部：NPRが東部コンゴ民主共和国の流行地帯からレポート
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。重症度が高く（782確定症例、181死亡）、地理的に限定されているものの公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、接触追跡の困難性から国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Ebola）は極めて致死率が高く、東部DRC（Ituri州）での大規模流行（782確定症例、181死亡）は国際的公衆衛生上の懸念事項。接触追跡率が56%と低く、武装勢力の存在と脆弱な保健システムが対応を複雑にしている。NPRからの報道により国際的な関心と社会的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Новая вспышка Эболы в Конго вырвалась за границы страны и затронула Уганду
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new Ebola outbreak in Congo has crossed the border and reached Uganda.
article.articleSummary: An outbreak of Ebola virus disease caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus has spread from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) into Uganda. In the DRC, 72 new laboratory-confirmed cases were reported in 24 hours, bringing the total to 782 with 181 deaths. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, with transmission currently confined to Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu across 31 health zones, though the geographic footprint is expanding. European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control data (as of June 10) show 676 cases, a rise of over 100 in a short span. In Uganda, by June 11 there were 19 cases (2 deaths), with 14 imported; most detections in Kampala and Wakiso District. EU risk of spread is assessed as very low. Report date: 2026-06-15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの新しいエボラアウトブレイク、国境を越えてウガンダに到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模多国間アウトブレイク。DRCで782例（死亡181例）、ウガンダへの越境確認、国際的な拡大リスクと公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラアウトブレイク（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）とウガンダへの越境を報告。対象国はDRCのみ（ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれない）。DRC内での複数州（Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu）での広がり、短期間での急速な増加（100例以上/短期間）、死亡率の高さ（23%）、越境事例の確認により、全IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当。EUのリスク評価は「very low」とされているが、DRC内での地理的拡大が継続中であることに注意。

article.articleHeadline: คองโก เผย ยอดผู้ป่วยอีโบลา พุ่งทะลุ 782 ราย แพร่เข้าเขตใหม่อีก 2 แห่ง
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo reports Ebola cases have surpassed 782, spreading to two more regions.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Ebola outbreak has surged to 782 laboratory-confirmed cases, with 181 deaths, according to government figures reported by Reuters. The update shows 72 new infections in the past 24 hours—the largest one-day increase in this wave. The outbreak, the country’s 17th, remains concentrated in three eastern provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. New health zones affected include Nia-Nia in Ituri and Mabalako in North Kivu, signaling geographic expansion within the eastern Congo. The figures are based on laboratory-confirmed cases; the statement was issued from Kinshasa and covered as of Sunday, June 14 local time. The data indicate continued community transmission in eastern DRC despite ongoing public health responses.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ患者数が782人を超えたと報告、さらに2つの地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は極めて高い重症度と致死率を持ち、公衆衛生への深刻な影響がある。72時間で782例への急速な増加は異常で、新規地域への地理的拡大が確認されている。国際的な拡大リスクと渡航制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最も高いリスク評価疾患の一つ。782例確認、181死亡（死亡率約23%）。過去24時間で72例の新規感染は重大な加速を示唆。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州の3州に集中しつつも、Nia-NiaおよびMabalako地域への新規拡大が確認されている。コミュニティ伝播の継続を示唆。WHOおよび国際保健機関による即座の対応が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Đi trước một bước trong kiểm soát sốt xuất huyết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One Step Ahead in Dengue Fever Control
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever in Can Tho, Vietnam, is rising ahead of the rainy season. By June 15, 2026, Can Tho reports 3,038 dengue cases, about four times higher than the same period in 2025, with 1,285 outbreak sites detected and 252 severe cases. Authorities are expanding surveillance, outbreak response, sanitation, and risk communication to curb fatalities. Ninh Kieu Ward has run two campaigns (late Jan/early Feb and Apr 2026) in 38 zones; environmental cleaning on the 10th, 20th and 30th; surveillance and insecticide spraying target high-risk areas. The ward promotes a School Without Larvae model and a Sunday 10 minutes to destroy larvae drive to involve residents. Dr. Nguyen Huynh Nhat Truong of Can Tho Children’s Hospital warns that late presentations worsen outcomes; complacency, flu-like misdiagnosis, self-treatment, and improper IV fluids contribute to shock, multi-organ failure, bleeding, and severe thrombocytopenia, underscoring the need for early recognition and prompt care.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱対策で一歩先へ
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでデング熱が雨季前に急増（前年同期比4倍）、重症例252件を含む3,038件報告。異常性、重症度、長期曝露リスク、流行性の複数基準に該当し、社会的・政治的関心も高い公衆衛生上の重要なシグナルである。
triage.notes: Can Tho市で報告された3,038件のデング熱例は前年同期比約4倍の急増を示す。重症例252件、1,285の流行地点が確認されており、雨季前の増加傾向が続く可能性がある。ベトナムは対象国に含まれており、地域検証において記事の主題とも一致している。

article.articleHeadline: PS Sing'Oei Protests Israel Travel Restrictions on Kenya Linked to Ebola Concerns
article.articleSummary: Kenya has conducted over 80,000 Ebola tests with no confirmed cases, maintaining active regional surveillance and response amid renewed global caution over outbreaks in Africa. Kenya's Principal Secretary for Foreign Affairs, Abraham Korir Sing'Oei, protested Israel's June 10 directive to restrict travellers from Kenya and other listed countries (Uganda, Rwanda, South Sudan, the Democratic Republic of the Congo) due to Ebola concerns, calling the move unjustified. The directive bans boarding for foreign nationals who have visited any restricted state within the prior 21 days and requires airlines to screen passengers for travel history before boarding to Israel; it excludes Israeli citizens and residents and takes immediate effect. Kenya reiterates its surveillance, testing, and cross-border coordination with regional partners to prevent and manage potential outbreaks. The measures reflect broader tightened travel controls tied to Ebola outbreaks in parts of Africa.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアの歌手Sing'Oeiがイスラエルのエボラ関連渡航制限に抗議
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的な渡航制限が発生しているが、ケニアでは確認症例がなく、現在の記事は主にイスラエルの政策対応に焦点を当てているため、実質的なアウトブレイク情報が不足している。
triage.notes: IHR基準4つすべてに該当するが、ケニアでの確認症例がゼロであり、記事の主要な内容はアフリカの他地域（DRC、ウガンダ、ルワンダ）でのエボラ発生に対するイスラエルの政策対応である。対象国リストの中では、実際のエボラ発症が示唆されているのはDRCのみ。継続的な監視が必要であるが、現時点では具体的な急性アウトブレイク情報の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: AzG: meer noodhulp nodig om ebola-uitbraak te bedwingen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AzG: More emergency aid needed to contain the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri Province) demands more emergency aid, says Doctors Without Borders (MSF/Aid group). One month into the outbreak, the virus is spreading faster than the response. Official tallies show over 650 Ebola infections and more than 130 deaths, though MSF suspects the true numbers are higher. The vast majority of cases are in eastern DR Congo’s Ituri, with some cases reported in Uganda. MSF calls for a larger, better-coordinated response, including expanded testing capacity, improved outbreak surveillance and contact tracing, closer collaboration with local communities, and sustained access to regular healthcare in affected areas. Without intensified support, transmission is likely to continue and overwhelm treatment centers.

triage.headline_ja: AzG：エボラ流行を封じ込めるためにより多くの緊急援助が必要
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は国際公衆衛生上の最重要脅威であり、DRCでの流行拡大と隣国ウガンダへの波及、死亡例の報告は即座のフルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダ（Republic of Uganda）が列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは『eastern DR Congo's Ituri, with some cases reported in Uganda』と述べられており、主要な流行地はDRC（イトゥリ州）であり、ウガンダは限定的な症例報告にとどまっている。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ただし、ウガンダでの症例確認は国際的拡大の重要な指標として、フルRRA時に詳細検証が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reports record one-day increase in Ebola cases, a month after outbreak's declaration
article.articleSummary: On 15 June 2026, Congo reports 72 new Ebola cases in 24 hours, raising total confirmed to 782 and deaths to 181 (32 new fatalities). Recoveries are 56; fatality rate 23%. The outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo virus, with no approved vaccine or treatment, confirmed May 15 with suspected earlier onset. Contact tracing coverage is only 56%, down from last week, weakening the response amid insecurity and funding gaps. Ituri province accounts for over 90% of cases; cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu, with cross-border transmission to Uganda. Nearly 1 million displaced by conflict in Ituri hampers tracing as people move in forests and mining sites. WHO is intensifying testing, contact tracing, and treatment, deploying lab support, active case finding, and community engagement. Africa CDC chief Jean Kaseya urges partners to mobilize resources to stop transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが1日当たりの記録的なエボラ患者数増加を報告、アウトブレーク宣言から1ヶ月後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。致死率23%、一日72例の記録的増加、ワクチン・治療法なしのBundibugyo型、接触者追跡カバー率56%低下、ウガンダへの国境越境感染、100万人の避難民によるコントロール困難化により、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的な蔓延リスクが極めて高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスは稀な型で承認済みワクチン・治療法なし。接触者追跡率56%（先週から低下）、紛争による避難民約100万人がコントロール困難化させている。ウガンダへの国境越境感染確認済みで、WHOと Africa CDC が資源動員を緊急に要請している。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo thu hồi sữa nghi ngộ độc Botulinum
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Milk recall due to suspected botulism.
article.articleSummary: Three infant botulism cases in the United States have been linked to Nara Organics Whole Milk Organic Powdered Infant Formula, prompting a voluntary recall announced by the U.S. FDA. The illnesses occurred in California, Pennsylvania, and Washington, with affected infants having used the formula prior to illness onset. Recalled products were distributed from July 2025 through June 2026 via Target stores, Target.com, and Nara.com, and were not distributed outside the United States. Botulinum toxin produced by Clostridium botulinum is an extremely potent neurotoxin; as little as 0.03 micrograms intravenous could be fatal for a 70 kg person, and contamination is commonly linked to improperly preserved canned foods. Vietnamese authorities have urged relevant agencies to review product declarations, halt sales, and coordinate with distributors to stop use and issue recalls. They also called for notification of imported quantities and shipments and to remove listings on Vietnamese e-commerce platforms by June 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ボツリヌス中毒の疑いで牛乳回収警告
triage.triage_reason: 乳児ボツリヌス中毒の複数州での発生、製品リコール、高い毒性リスク、ベトナムを含む複数国での対応が報告されており、IHR基準2項目以上、WPROスクリーニング基準複数項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはボツリヌス中毒との関連が疑われる乳児粉ミルク製品のリコール事案。米国での3件の乳児ボツリヌス中毒とナラ・オーガニクス製品の関連、FDA回収、及びベトナム当局による規制対応（e-commerce削除要請、販売停止など）が記載されている。発生地域にはアメリカの複数州が含まれるが、対象国リスト外のため検証地域にはベトナムのみを記載。ボツリヌス毒素の極めて高い毒性、複数州での患者発生、国際的な製品流通と各国政府による対応がシグナル性を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Exame descarta caso suspeito de ebola no Rio Grande do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test rules out a suspected Ebola case in Rio Grande do Sul.
article.articleSummary: An Ebola case in Brazil was ruled out after tests on a 64-year-old man who had traveled from Uganda, Africa, to Novo Hamburgo and was transferred to Porto Alegre, Rio Grande do Sul. During investigation, a rapid malaria test detected Plasmodium falciparum, and treatment began. Blood samples for Ebola detection were sent to Fiocruz for confirmation, which came back negative. The article notes an Ebola outbreak in parts of Africa, including the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with about 700 confirmed cases and 139 deaths. On Friday, São Paulo state officials also discarded a second suspected Ebola case linked to Congo travel; the two patients who had been in Congo in recent weeks are no longer considered cases. The report underscores ongoing surveillance for imported infections amid regional Ebola transmission.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドスルでエボラ疑い症例が検査で除外
triage.triage_reason: ウガンダからの渡航歴を持つ患者のエボラ検査が陰性となった報告であり、実際の確定患者ではない。ただしブラジルでのエボラ輸入感染リスク認識とアフリカでの流行状況の背景情報から経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は確認済みエボラ患者ではなく、疑い症例が除外された事例である。患者はウガンダからの渡航歴があり、代わりにPlasmodium falciparumマラリアが検出された。DRCでの流行の背景情報がある（約700確定患者、139死亡）が、本イベント自体はブラジルでの実際の患者ではない。WATCHに分類したのは、輸入感染症リスク認識と地域的な流行状況への監視の継続が妥当なため。

article.articleHeadline: کانگو میں ایبولا کی تباہ کاری جاری، 181 افراد ہلاک، متاثرین کی تعداد 782 تک پہنچ گئی
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola devastation continues in Congo; 181 dead, the number of those affected has reached 782.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues, with 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths. The health ministry reports transmission across multiple provinces, notably Ituri in the east and the North Kivu and South Kivu regions. In the last 24 hours, 72 new confirmed cases were recorded, all from Ituri, now the outbreak’s major hotspot. Ebola is highly contagious and deadly, transmitted via bodily fluids. The response includes vaccination campaigns, surveillance, contact tracing, and isolation, but security concerns and difficult terrain hinder operations. The World Health Organization warns that rapid diagnosis and prompt isolation are essential to curb spread. Field investigations and vaccination campaigns are ongoing, with further details expected in the coming days.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が継続、181人が死亡、患者数は782人に達した
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病はIHR(2005)に基づく届出対象疾患であり、782確定患者・181死亡という深刻な公衆衛生影響、複数州への地理的拡大、国際的な感染拡大リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染性の高さが確認される。IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準もすべて満たすため、即座にフルRRA対象として進める。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はIHR(2005) Annex2に明示的に記載された届出義務疾患。782確定患者と181死亡は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）への地理的拡大確認。ヒト-ヒト感染性が高く、体液を介した伝播。72時間内に72新規確定患者が発生し、急速な増加傾向。WHO警告による国際的関心も高い。セキュリティ上の懸念と地形的課題により対応が困難との記載。即座のフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế cảnh báo thu hồi, ngừng sử dụng sữa hữu cơ Nara Organics sau khi 3 trẻ ngộ độc Botulinum ở Mỹ
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health warns of recall and discontinuation of use of Nara Organics organic milk after three children contracted botulism in the United States.
article.articleSummary: Three infants in the United States hospitalized with botulism prompted recalls of Nara Organics Whole Milk Organic Powdered Infant Formula. The U.S. FDA on June 13, 2026 announced a voluntary recall of all Nara Organics Whole Milk Organic Powdered Infant Formula produced from July 2025 through June 2026, sold at Target stores, Target.com, and Nara.com; 16 lots are affected, with distribution limited to the United States. Cases were reported in California, Pennsylvania, and Washington; all involved infants had consumed the recalled formula. In Vietnam, the Ministry of Health’s Food Safety Department issued a directive on June 15, 2026 urging provincial authorities to review product declarations, halt use, and conduct a recall per manufacturer guidance; request data on imports, sales, and stock, and to inform consumers. The department also asked e-commerce regulators to halt sales in Vietnam and remove listings if present, with a report due by June 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省がナラオーガニクス有機粉乳の回収中止を警告 — 米国で3人の乳幼児がボツリヌス菌中毒に
triage.triage_reason: 米国でボツリヌス中毒の集団事例が発生し、粉乳製品の自主回収が実施されている。ベトナムは当該製品の販売停止と回収指示を発令。ただしベトナムでの実症例報告がなく、国際的な流行リスク情報も不足しているため、追加情報の継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主要なイベント発生地は米国（対象国外）だが、ベトナムが公衆衛生命令を発令し能動的に対応している。ベトナムでの実症例報告はなく、予防的措置段階。米国での事例数は限定的（3例）で、製品回収に対応している。ボツリヌス中毒は重度だが、本事例は既に管理下の製品回収で対応中。追加症例や他国への波及など続報を要監視。

diseases.name: Low Pathogenic Avian Influenza A H9N2
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2

article.articleHeadline: Major H9 bird flu outbreak not likely: CHP
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong SAR reports a local H9N2 avian influenza infection in a two-year-old boy who fell ill earlier this month, with genetic analysis confirming the virus as H9N2, a low-pathogenic strain. Officially, transmissibility between humans remains low and a major outbreak is unlikely. The infection is linked to exposure at a fresh provision shop at Wo Che Market in Sha Tin that sells live chickens earlier this month; the CHP suggests environmental contamination as the likely source. Environmental sampling produced 15 negative results out of 17 across the boy's home, the shop, and a park, with the remaining two results pending; daily disinfection at the shop may have eliminated the virus. All 13 contacts were asymptomatic and tested negative for H9N2. The article is dated 2026-06-15.

triage.headline_ja: H9鳥インフルエンザの大規模流行は起こりにくい：CHP
triage.triage_reason: 香港での小児H9N2人感染ケースで異常・予想外性がありIHR基準に該当する可能性があるが、当局は大規模流行は起こりにくいと評価し、ヒト-ヒト感染は限定的。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 香港での単一症例報告で、濃厚接触者13名は全員無症状・陰性。環境汚染が感染源と推定され、ヒト-ヒト感染リスクは低評価。大規模流行の可能性は低いとされているが、H9N2の人感染報告は異常事象として注視価値あり。香港はChina（GeoNames ID 1814991）に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : le Kenya prépare des services d'isolement
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Kenya prepares isolation facilities.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, Kenya is strengthening Ebola preparedness with no confirmed cases in the country, while outbreaks continue in neighboring Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. At Nairobi's Kenyatta National Hospital, the largest referral center, staff have been trained to identify and manage potential Ebola cases, with procedures to ensure the safety of staff and other patients. The hospital states that isolation units are ready, with dedicated personnel and protocols to prevent nosocomial transmission; Kenyatta is the only facility with a full, independent infectious disease isolation unit, though other public hospitals can repurpose spaces to isolate patients as needed. Kenya is also preparing to quarantine Americans arriving from DRC at one of its air bases, a measure that sparked protests in which one person was killed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：ケニアが隔離施設を準備
triage.triage_reason: ケニアはエボラ確定症例なしで準備段階にあり、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当が限定的。ただし隣接するDRC・ウガンダでの流行継続と地域的なリスク上昇により経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではケニアは確定症例なしで準備態勢のみ、DRCとウガンダで流行継続が記載されている。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしIHR基準3つ、WPRO基準3つが該当し国際的な懸念が高いため、DRCでの流行動向の継続監視が重要。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya protests after Israel bans its travellers over Ebola fears
article.articleSummary: Kenya protests Israel’s travel ban on travellers from Kenya amid Ebola fears. Israel’s border authorities ordered airlines to deny boarding to passengers travelling from Kenya, Democratic Republic of the Congo, South Sudan, Rwanda, and Uganda, and to bar foreign nationals who have visited those countries in the previous 21 days. Kenya reports zero confirmed Ebola cases after extensive surveillance and testing, including more than 80,000 Ebola tests with no positives. Kenyan Principal Secretary for Foreign Affairs Korir Sing’Oei condemned the move as unjustified and inconsistent with available public health data. Israel notes no Ebola cases in the country, with low public risk but high fatality and complex treatment necessitating readiness. Kenya says border screening, lab capacity, and emergency preparedness have strengthened regional surveillance and response to Ebola, contributing to no transmission on Kenyan soil. The announcement is dated June 15, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルがエボラ懸念からケニア人旅行者を禁止、ケニアが抗議
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱という重篤な疾患に関連し、複数国での旅行制限というIHR関連事象が発生しているが、実際の感染拡大・患者発生の報告がなく、むしろ予防的措置としての旅行禁止であるため。情報の確認と背景状況の詳細把握が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから実際に患者が報告されているのはDRC（エボラ発生地として一般的に認識される地域）のみであり、ケニア、ウガンダ、ルワンダ、スーダン、イスラエルは旅行禁止措置の対象国または実施国であって、実際の感染事例報告がない。Bluedot APIの発生地域情報は予防的措置の対象国を含めて列挙されているが、verified_locationsは実際の患者発生が示唆される地域のみに限定した。背景となるDRC内の具体的なエボラ患者数、発生地域、検査状況などの詳細情報が不明であり、より詳細な情報確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ébola: Casos Confirmados Aumentam Para 782 e Atingem Novas Zonas na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Confirmed Cases Rise to 782 and Reach New Areas in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: As of 14 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo has 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, with 72 new confirmed cases reported in the last 24 hours—the largest daily increase so far. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, still focused in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. For the first time, confirmed cases are reported in the Nia-Nia health zone (Ituri) and in Mabalako health zone (North Kivu). Active transmission now spans 20 of 36 health zones in Ituri, 10 of 34 in North Kivu, and one zone in South Kivu. The WHO cautions three DRC laboratories have exhausted Ebola testing materials amid the ongoing spread of the Bundibugyo strain. The United States has added $20 million in funding for outbreak response, bringing total U.S. direct support to over $220 million.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：確認症例が782件に増加し、コンゴ民主共和国の新たな地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な拡大パターン、国際的リスク、渡航制限リスク）。アウトブレイクの規模拡大、新地域への拡大、検査能力の不足が確認されており、フルRRA実施の要件を満たす。
triage.notes: 本アウトブレイクはDRCの第17次エボラアウトブレイク。過去24時間で72件の新規確認症例（過去最大の日次増）、複数健康地帯への新たな拡大、検査材料の枯渇という深刻な課題がある。米国からの追加資金投入（$20百万）は国際的な関心の高さを示唆。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, Msf: "A un mese dall'inizio dell'epidemia, la diffusione del virus sta superando gli sforzi di risposta"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, MSF: "One month since the start of the outbreak, the spread of the virus is outpacing the response efforts."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri and North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is outpacing response after a month, MSF warns. In areas affected, millions live under protracted conflict, repeated displacement, chronic health-service gaps, and a limited humanitarian response, conditions that hinder containment and fuel transmission. Fear and distrust toward response teams persist in Ituri communities; MSF urges listening to concerns and involving communities to build trust. Maintaining access to routine care is essential alongside outbreak control, with pregnant women needing maternity services, children requiring vaccinations, and patients needing malaria and cholera care, which also strengthens Ebola monitoring. In North Kivu, only one laboratory can analyze blood samples, with multi-day processing and no automated result transmission to facilities, delaying action. MSF teams are being sent to remote, insecure areas to strengthen case finding and local response. The window to contain this outbreak is closing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱、国境なき医師団：「流行開始から1ヶ月、ウイルスの拡散が対応努力を上回っている」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当する重大な進行中エボラ出血熱アウトブレイク。複数地域での並行流行、対応能力の限界、地域への信頼欠如が報告されており、封じ込め機会の喪失が警告されている。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi地域及びNorth Kivu地域で進行中の重大エボラアウトブレイク。MSF（国境なき医師団）が現地支援を強化中。紛争下の人口移動、医療サービスの著しい不足、検査室の限定性（North Kivu州で1ヶ所のみ）、地域住民の不信感など複合的課題が報告されており、封じ込め窓口の喪失が懸念されている。マラリア、コレラの並行流行も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kenya remains at high Ebola risk, Health PS says
article.articleSummary: Kenya remains at high risk of importing the Budibugyo Ebola virus, currently ravaging parts of the DRC and Uganda with 141 deaths to date. There is no case in Kenya, but the Ministry of Health reports systems to contain entry and management. Public Health and Professional Standards Principal Secretary Mary Muthoni said vigilance at borders is extreme, with a standby surge team of over 300 healthcare officers in 25 counties identified as very high or high risk. Rapid Response Teams are mobilized and border screening is a key vigilance driver, with about 3,000 people screened per day at points of entry. As of 13 June, 91 Kenyan samples tested were negative. Of Ebola cases in DRC/Uganda, 22 involve healthcare workers. Separately, MPOX has affected 38 counties with 1,000 confirmed cases and 19 deaths; Dengue fever surge is also noted. Authorities urge enhanced rapid response.

triage.headline_ja: ケニアはエボラ出血熱の高リスク状態にあると保健局が発表
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当（重症度、流行性、管理可能性）。複数の重篤感染症（エボラ、mpox、デング熱）の同時流行と地域的拡大が進行中。
triage.notes: ケニアは現在症例なしだが高リスク国として言及されている。記事サマリーに基づき、実際に流行が発生しているのはDRC（141死亡）とウガンダ（患者および医療従事者22人の感染）。ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。Mpoxはケニアで38県に拡大（確認例1,000、死亡19）しているが、DRC/ウガンダでのエボラ流行が主要な懸念。ヒト-ヒト感染リスク高く、医療従事者への感染も報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: MSF s'inquiète de " dangereuses lacunes " dans la réponse à Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF is concerned about "dangerous gaps" in the Ebola response in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: June 15, 2026 – Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than the ground response can keep up, Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) warned Monday, flagging dangerous gaps in the health response. The statement conveys MSF’s concern that current measures are not matching the epidemic’s pace in affected areas of the DRC. The excerpt provides no case or death counts, and it does not detail laboratory confirmation or transmission routes. Nonetheless, MSF characterizes substantial vulnerabilities in the ongoing Ebola response and urges accelerated support and better coordination to address the widening gap between transmission and the capacity to respond on the ground.

triage.headline_ja: MSF は DRC でのエボラ対応における「危険な隙間」について懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において公衆衛生への深刻な影響（拡大速度）と異常性が確認され、エボラウイルス病という国際的なリスクの高い疾患である。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・管理可能性が該当し、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健規則（IHR 2005）に基づく報告対象疾患であり、DRCでの拡大報告は重大なシグナルである。MSFによる公式声明が記事の根拠であり信頼性が高い。具体的な症例数・死亡数がサマリーに記載されていないが、「拡大速度が対応能力を上回っている」という直接的な懸念表明が報告されており、実質的な公衆衛生上の脅威を示唆している。フルRRA実施を推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Rekordmånga smittade med ebola senaste dygnet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Record number of people infected with Ebola in the last 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Congo-Kinshasa) is growing. Local authorities report 72 cases confirmed in 24 hours. Since the outbreak began about a month ago, nearly 800 people have been infected, with at least 181 deaths. Officials caution the true toll may be higher, as the outbreak could have started before May 15, when the first cases were confirmed. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo Ebola virus, an unusual variant for which there are no approved treatments or vaccines. The report provides no details on symptoms, laboratory methods beyond confirmation, infection sources, or imported/exported cases. AP is cited as the source.

triage.headline_ja: 過去24時間でエボラに感染した記録的な多数の患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準を3つ満たす（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。また、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。活動中の大規模エボラアウトブレイクであり、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virusは稀な株であり、承認されたワクチン・治療法がない点で特に懸念。過去1ヶ月で約800例、181死亡が報告されており、実際の死亡数はさらに高い可能性あり。24時間あたり72例という急速な増加傾向が確認されている。国際的な支援と監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 獨家／外帶地瓜葉驚見「粉紅福壽螺卵」！她吃下肚嚇壞就醫 吞驅蟲藥│TVBS新聞網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Exclusive: Takeout Sweet Potato Leaves Spotted with Pink Apple Snail Eggs! She Ate Them, Was Terrified and Sought Medical Care, Took Deworming Medication | TVBS News Network
