article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-15 in Taichung, a consumer in Xitun District’s Yong’an store tookout sweet potato leaves and found 4–5 pink pink apple snail eggs on the stems, some already swallowed. She sought infectious disease care and received antiparasitic (deworming) treatment as a precaution. Pink apple snails are the intermediate host of Angiostrongylus cantonensis; ingestion of raw or undercooked snails or contaminated produce can allow the parasite to invade brain or spinal cord, causing meningitis and other severe neurological symptoms. The patient cited possible inadequate cleaning by staff; the company said CCTV checks showed no anomalies and may terminate the franchise if faults are confirmed. A separate Taichung branch had previously faced a complaint about cockroaches in broccoli, prompting health inspections. The parasite’s incubation is long, so future health effects remain uncertain as of now.

triage.headline_ja: 独占報道：テイクアウト中の野菜に『ピンク色のリンゴガイの卵』を発見！食べてしまった女性が医療機関に駆け込みデワーミング薬を服用｜TVBS ニュースネットワーク
triage.triage_reason: 単発の食品汚染事例であり、IHR/WPROの基準を満たす多数の該当はないが、アニサキスの神経症状リスク、食品衛生管理の問題、及び公開報道による関心が存在するため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主な舞台は台湾（台中市）であるが、台湾は対象国リストに含まれていない。ただし、Bluedot APIが中国（中華人民共和国）も発生地域として付与しており、アニサキス症は東アジア全域で認識されるリスク。単一の食品汚染事例であるため、大規模なアウトブレイクの兆候は見られない。今後の追加事例報告があれば要ピックアップの可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Inside Ebola country: NPR reports from eastern DR Congo's outbreak zone
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, centered on Bunia. As of June 13, 2026, 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths; Bunia has 212 cases—the highest in any location. Outbreak officially declared May 15 after likely circulating weeks earlier, with initial clustering in Mongbwalu. Contact tracing reaches 56% across three provinces, hampered by armed groups, poor roads, and dense settlements. Clinique Universelle in Bunia treated an Ebola-positive patient; decontamination ongoing and hospital temporarily shut; staff lack PPE and some have died. Aid groups have airlifted hundreds of metric tons of medicines and PPE, but shortages persist. Community volunteers like Eliezer Kasongo work door-to-door to raise awareness amid fear and ongoing fatalities (e.g., a man vomiting blood before dying). Symptoms include hemorrhagic signs; ongoing response features handwashing stations and public announcements.

triage.headline_ja: エボラの国から：NPRが東部コンゴ民主共和国の感染拡大地域からレポート
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、複数のWPRO基準該当、高い社会的・政治的関心がある。フルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイク、782確認症例、181死亡（CFR約23%）。イトゥリ州ブニアを中心に東部DRCで拡大中。接触追跡カバー率56%と低く、武装勢力や貧弱なインフラが対応を阻害。医療施設の脆弱性（PPE不足、スタッフ死亡）と地域不安が深刻。国際援助が進行中だが継続支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: تصاعد وتيرة تفشي فيروس إيبولا في الكونغو الديمقراطية مع تسجيل حصيلة قياسية جديدة | أهل مصر
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak accelerates in the Democratic Republic of the Congo as a new record-high toll is registered.
article.articleSummary: 72 new confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo push the outbreak total to 782 cases and 178 deaths, marking a record-high toll. The spike follows intensified surveillance in remote, densely populated regions and reflects ongoing challenges in early diagnosis and rapid treatment. Health authorities warn that logistical bottlenecks and strained healthcare capacity contribute to the surge. International and local containment efforts contend with obstacles including armed conflict limiting movement of emergency teams, weak health infrastructure, and community mistrust in certain areas, complicating transmission control and response coordination. The situation underscores the need for bolstered surveillance, rapid diagnostic and treatment resources, and stronger public health messaging to slow spread and prevent further escalation of this Ebola outbreak in the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラウイルスの流行が加速、新たな最高記録を達成
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラは高い致死率を持つ重篤な感染症であり、記録的な症例数・死亡数の増加、国際的な拡大リスク、および貿易・渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスは高い致死率（約23%）を示し、782症例・178死亡という記録的規模の流行が報告されている。武力紛争、医療インフラの脆弱性、コミュニティの不信感といった複合的な課題が対応を複雑にしている。国際的な支援と迅速な対応が不可欠な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Hơn 50.000 người mắc sốt xuất huyết, 5 ca tử vong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Over 50,000 people contracted dengue fever; 5 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Vietnam records over 50,000 dengue fever cases this year with 5 deaths, as of year-to-date. Dengue is breaking old patterns with shorter outbreak cycles and affects people of all ages across all regions. Globally, dengue fever, transmitted by Aedes aegypti, threatens about 5.6 billion people with an estimated 100–400 million infections annually. The disease is most common in tropical and subtropical urban areas, but is spreading toward temperate zones. There is no specific treatment; early detection and timely care reduce the risk of severe dengue and death. In Vietnam, the south and highly urbanized provinces report higher transmission, and the DENV-2 serotype is currently dominant, increasing the risk of severe cases. WHO notes AI-based early warning tools and dengue vaccines as prevention options. Public health measures include eliminating standing water, cleaning surroundings, covering water containers, using bed nets, and seeking care promptly. ASEAN Dengue Prevention Day is observed on June 15.

triage.headline_ja: 50,000人以上がデング熱に感染、5人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムで年初から50,000人以上のデング熱患者が記録され、死亡例も報告されている。IHR基準3項目（重篤性、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性で懸念があるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: サマリーで「短い流行サイクル」「全年齢層・全地域への影響」「DENV-2優位」との記載あり。WHO が AI ベースの早期警報ツールとデング熱ワクチンを予防選択肢として言及している。南部および都市化地域での伝播が高いことが指摘されており、地域的な管理能力の評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola risk for World Cup is 'extremely low', but US is ready, experts
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk for the 2026 World Cup across the United States, Mexico and Canada is extremely low but not zero; as of 2026-06-15 US hospitals are prepared to respond if a traveler with Ebola arrives during the 39-day tournament featuring 104 matches and drawing about 6.5 million fans. The Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak has infected more than 675 people and killed more than 135, remaining a concern. Lessons from the 2014 West Africa outbreak led to $260 million in US funding for preparedness, 13 specialized treatment centers, and training thousands of healthcare workers in 11 host cities. Measures include airport screening and travel bans for non-citizens with recent travel to affected areas; the DRC team trained in Belgium in May. Host-city medical committees monitor risks with surveillance tools (wastewater, air quality, electronic records). Ebola spreads via body fluids of the ill, not casual contact or airborne.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップのエボラリスク「極めて低い」が米国は警戒態勢—専門家
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準で潜在的に重大だが、本記事は主にアメリカ等のホスト国の準備態勢とリスク低減に焦点を当てており、進行中の大規模な流行事象ではなく、情報が限定的である。DRC発生状況は言及されているが、記事の主要な関心事はホスト国のリスク管理である。
triage.notes: Bluedot API発生地域にはUSA、Canada、Mexico、Angola、Belgiumが含まれているが、記事サマリー上、実際の感染症イベント（outbreak）はDRCに限定される。2026 World Cupの開催国（USA、Mexico、Canada）はホスト国として言及されているが、エボラ患者の発生地ではない。DRCでの発生（675人以上感染、135人以上死亡）は進行中だが、本記事の主要テーマはホスト国の準備態勢であり、新興感染症危機というより予防的対応の事例である。情報不足のため継続監視が妥当。

article.articleHeadline: DRC: Ebola fear grips Bunia as life slows and businesses lose income in Ituri
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak centers Bunia in Ituri, DRC. As of 2026-06-15, the Congolese Ministry of Health reports 782 confirmed Ebola cases and 181 deaths; the outbreak was confirmed on May 15, with contact tracing at 56%, suggesting the true burden is higher. In Bunia, a city under a million, fear suppresses social life and business, though bars/clubs stay open and staff set up hand-washing stations. Trésor Lumaya, manager of the Champagne Club, cites significant income losses. Awareness campaigns are underway, but disbelief persists, with Abdul Kasenda noting families that have lost two, three, or four members. Public health measures focus on hygiene and information dissemination at venues. The report emphasizes laboratory-confirmed cases, ongoing transmission, and the need for strengthened surveillance and community engagement in Ituri to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: DRC: Ebola fear grips Bunia as life slows and businesses lose income in Ituri（コンゴ民主共和国：イツリ州ブニアではエボラへの恐怖が広がり、生活が遅滞し、ビジネスが収入を失う）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響：782確認患者181死亡、国際拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイクの進行中の状況を示す報告。確認患者782名、死亡181名、接触者追跡率56%は実際の負担がさらに高いことを示唆。Ituri州ブニアを中心に社会的・経済的影響が深刻。国際的な懸念と支援の必要性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв Эболы в Конго превысило 180 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola deaths in the Congo has surpassed 180.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports an Ebola outbreak with 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of June 15, 2026, per the Ministry of Health. The case fatality rate is about 23%, with 56 recovered. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; unlike the Zaire strain, there is no approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo. The eastern Ituri province accounts for more than 90% of cases, with additional infections in North Kivu and South Kivu; the virus has spread to neighboring Uganda. Only 56% of contacts are traced, suggesting the true burden may be higher since official confirmation was on May 15. The humanitarian situation complicates response: nearly one million displaced in Ituri, widespread movement between forests and villages, and attacks on health workers amid distrust and ongoing fighting. Separately, the U.S. plans 50-bed quarantine facilities in Kenya for deported Ebola migrants, provoking protests and three deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死亡者数が180人を超えた
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。ブンディブギョエボラウイルスによる大規模流行で782件の確認症例、181人の死亡、隣国ウガンダへの拡大、ワクチン・治療法なし、接触者追跡率56%と低い。国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の危機。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラウイルスはザイール系統と異なり承認されたワクチン・治療薬がない点が重要。東部イトゥリ州が症例の90%以上を占め、人口移動が多く衛生対応が限定的。隣国ウガンダへの波及も確認。米国のケニアでの強制送還者隔離施設計画は周辺国の不安を反映している。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de dengue caem 75% no Acre em comparação com 2025
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue cases drop 75% in Acre compared with 2025.
article.articleSummary: 1,774 probable dengue cases were reported in Acre, Brazil, through epidemiological week 22 of 2026 (Dec 29, 2025–May 30, 2026), with one confirmed death and another under investigation. Incidence reached 200.6 per 100,000; case fatality among probable cases 0.06%, rising to 6.67% among severe cases. Compared with 2025 (7,254 probable cases, 3 deaths, 820.2 per 100k) and 2024 (3,755 cases, no deaths, 426.4 per 100k), the reductions are ~75.5% and ~52.8%, respectively. Demographics: 52% of cases in men; most affected age 20–29, followed by 30–39 and 40–49; >89% of cases in pardo individuals. Of 1,774 probable cases, 796 have been laboratory-confirmed. Public health efforts emphasize ongoing surveillance and vector control—eliminating water-holding containers to reduce Aedes aegypti, the dengue, Zika, and chikungunya vector.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱患者数が2025年比で75%減少（ブラジル・アクレ州）
triage.triage_reason: 記事は2026年上半期のアクレ州におけるデング熱患者の減少傾向を報告しており、IHR基準2つ以上該当せず、スクリーニング基準でも社会的関心が低い。既存感染症の通常な疫学報告であり、新興リスクを示唆していない。
triage.notes: 記事は実際には感染症の**減少**を報告しており、患者数の低下（75%減）、死亡率の低さ（0.06%）、既存の対策の継続実施が述べられている。デング熱はブラジルにおいて地域的に風土病化した感染症であり、今回の報告は通常の疫学的監視の一環である。新規または異常な公衆衛生上の脅威を示唆していない。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : l'organisation de la riposte expliquée au nouveau gouverneur militaire - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: the organization of the response explained to the new military governor - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 15 June 2026 in Bunia, Ituri province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, public health authorities explained the organization of the Ebola virus disease (EVD) response to the new military governor, General-Major Gaby Kasongo Mulumba. The Director-General of the National Institute of Public Health outlined how the response is coordinated, patient care, social support measures, and the collaboration among the Incident Management System (SGI) components, addressing social media-claimed mismanagement concerns. The governor commended the field teams and reaffirmed support for ongoing interventions while calling for strengthened containment measures to accelerate the end of the province’s 17th Ebola outbreak. The workshop reviewed the epidemiological situation and actions to interrupt transmission within Ituri’s health zones and communities.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州のエボラ: 新しい軍事知事に対応体制が説明される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された発生で、IHR基準の複数項目に該当。深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが存在し、対応体制の強化が求められている。
triage.notes: イトゥリ州での17番目のエボラアウトブレイクであり、軍事知事による対応強化の指示と社会メディア上での不適切な対応の疑いに対する説明が行われている。感染伝播の遮断と封じ込め措置の強化が重点課題として示されており、進行中の公衆衛生危機を示唆している。DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）は対象国リストに含まれる。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : les États-Unis annoncent 1 milliard $ pour la riposte et l'aide humanitaire
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The United States announces $1 billion for the response and humanitarian aid.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province, receives a US$1 billion aid package. The United States commits US$300 million to support the outbreak response and US$700 million for humanitarian actions related to the crisis. The announcement was made by the U.S. Embassy in the DRC on June 12, 2026, in Kinshasa. The funding supplements the government's national response strategy led by the Ministry of Health, and aims to strengthen surveillance, prevention, and control of the virus in affected areas. It also targets cross-border management, including screening at border posts and airports, to reduce transmission within the DRC and to neighboring countries. The funds will also assist affected populations and bolster health-response mechanisms in the region, with particular emphasis on Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：米国が対応と人道支援に10億ドルを発表
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、予想外性の基準を満たす。米国による大規模資金援助により国際的関心も高く、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: DRCのイツリ州を中心としたエボラ出血熱の発生。米国による1億ドルの支援表明、境界管理・監視強化の実施、隣国への感染拡大リスク対策を含む国際的対応。記事は米国の支援発表が主題だが、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Waspadai Demam Tinggi Mendadak, Bisa Jadi DBD
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Watch out for a sudden high fever; it could be dengue fever.
article.articleSummary: Dengue fever (DBD) in Indonesia: Jakarta hosts ASEAN Dengue Day on 15 June 2026. Health officials describe abrupt, high fever as a hallmark, with temperatures hitting 38–40°C. Fever does not gradually warm but rises quickly, accompanied by body aches. Patients may also suffer from muscle and joint pains, severe headache, weakness, and loss of appetite. Some experience gastrointestinal symptoms such as nausea, vomiting, diarrhea, or abdominal discomfort. Red spots under the skin (petechiae) can occur in some cases, though this symptom is now rare. Early medical evaluation is emphasized to reduce dengue-related mortality. If a high fever emerges suddenly with headache, muscle or bone pains, and remains high on day two, seek care promptly at a healthcare facility or from a health professional. Statements by Prima Yosephine, Director of Communicable Diseases, Indonesian Ministry of Health, during ASEAN Dengue Day in Jakarta.

triage.headline_ja: 突然の高熱に注意、デング熱の可能性
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアのデング熱に関する啓発記事だが、具体的な症例数、死亡数、流行規模の情報が不足しており、現在発生している新規流行イベントとしての証拠が限定的。ASEAN Dengue Day（予定されたイベント）の文脈であり、既知の季節的疾患の啓発キャンペーン的性格が強い。
triage.notes: 記事はASEAN Dengue Dayの文脈での啓発・教育的内容。インドネシア保健省の公式声明を含むが、現在進行中の具体的な流行の規模、症例数、死亡数などの定量的データが記載されていない。デング熱はインドネシアにおいて風土病であり、季節的なピークがある既知の疾患。新規な流行シグナルとしてのエビデンスが限定的。

article.articleHeadline: Bộ Y tế đề nghị ngừng lưu hành sữa bột trẻ em Nara Organics sau vụ ngộ độc
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health requests halting the distribution of Nara Organics infant formula after a poisoning incident.
article.articleSummary: On June 15, 2026, Vietnam's Ministry of Health urged local authorities to halt distribution of Nara Organics Whole Milk Organic Powdered Infant Formula after a U.S. voluntary recall linked to three infant botulinum poisonings in California, Pennsylvania, and Washington. The U.S. recall covers products produced July 2025–June 2026 and sold through Target stores, Target.com, and Nara.com, with no distributions outside the United States. MOH instructed provincial health agencies and Ho Chi Minh City to review registration declarations, coordinate with the producer, and notify distributors and consumers to stop use, while reporting imported, sold, and remaining quantities and proposing action for affected lots. It also directed e-commerce and digital economy authorities to halt sales of any affected lots in Vietnam and remove related listings. Botulinum toxin causes severe neuroparalysis; if treated with botulinum antitoxin within 48–72 hours, outcomes improve, with 5–7 days recovery for ventilated patients.

triage.headline_ja: ボツリヌス中毒事件後、ナラ・オーガニクス乳幼児粉ミルクの流通停止をベトナム保健省が要請
triage.triage_reason: ボツリヌス毒素による乳幼児中毒事件（米国での3例）に対応したベトナムの管理措置だが、ベトナム国内での実際の発症報告がなく、情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 米国での3例のボツリヌス中毒事例が主要な懸念。ベトナムは供給鎖管理と流通停止措置を実施しているが、ベトナム国内での実発症はサマリーに記載されていない。IHR基準を2つ満たすが、国内での実際の感染症イベント発生の確認がないため、WATCHで経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: MSF warns of 'dangerous gaps' in Ebola response in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo has killed more than 180 people. Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warns dangerous gaps remain in the response. One month into the crisis, MSF emergency medical coordinator Kate White says the outbreak is outpacing the response, and no one knows the true scale or exactly where the disease is spreading across the vast central African country. The report provides no updated counts beyond deaths and gives little detail on where the disease is spreading. The warning, issued on 2026-06-15, highlights ongoing uncertainties about transmission and spread within DR Congo.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱対応における「危険な欠陥」について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。高い致死率、国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生影響、および対応の重大な欠陥が認識されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際公衆衛生上の最高危機度病原体。180人超の死亡、地理的拡散の不確実性、対応体制の重大な欠陥が報告されている。MSFを含む国際機関が関与し、国境を越えた拡大リスクが懸念される。フルRRA実施は必須。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reports 72 new Ebola cases in a day as contact tracing weakens - CNBC TV18
article.articleSummary: 72 new Ebola cases in 24 hours in Congo bring total to 782 cases and 181 deaths (32 more fatalities). Contact tracing coverage has fallen to 56% as insecurity, displacement, and funding gaps hamper response. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus (no approved vaccine or treatment), was confirmed on May 15, with a 23% fatality rate and 56 recoveries. The surge is concentrated in Ituri province (over 90% of cases), with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border transmission into Uganda. Nearly one million people displaced in Ituri complicate tracing amid forested terrain, poor roads, and mobile artisanal miners. WHO is intensifying testing, contact tracing, and treatment; Africa CDC provides technical support, laboratory capacity, active case finding, and community engagement, urging urgent resources to stop transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1日に72人の新規エボラ患者が報告、接触者追跡が弱体化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。高い死亡率（23%）、急速な症例増加、ウガンダへの越境伝播、および接触者追跡能力の低下が確認されており、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域リストに含まれているが、サマリーは越境伝播（cross-border transmission into Uganda）として記述されており、主発生地はDRCである。Bundibugyo virus（ワクチン・承認治療なし）によるアウトブレイク、1日72例の急速な増加、接触者追跡カバレッジ56%への低下、約100万人の避難民、および資金不足による対応の制約が深刻なリスク要因。WHOおよびAfrica CDCが技術支援を実施中。

article.articleHeadline: RDC - Bunia : quand l'épidémie d'Ebola compromet l'activité économique
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC – Bunia: when the Ebola outbreak jeopardizes economic activity.
article.articleSummary: Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is the epicenter of an Ebola outbreak that has strained daily life and local commerce. Bars and clubs remain open but attract few patrons as fear limits movement; handwashing stations and health information are being offered to curb transmission. The Congolese Health Ministry reported 782 confirmed Ebola cases and 181 deaths; however, case counts may be higher since the outbreak was confirmed on May 15 and contact-tracing coverage stands at 56%, a notable decline from the previous week. In Bunia, a city of under one million, Ebola has caused dozens of fatalities. Public awareness campaigns have begun, but skepticism remains: some residents say their families have lost two, three, or even four members, underscoring the outbreak's severe social and economic toll.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国 - ブニア：エボラ流行が経済活動を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全てに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された流行であり、既に782確定例、181死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクが明らかである。フルRRAへ進むべき。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病はWHO懸念事項感染症（PHEIC）候補。接触者追跡カバレッジが56%と低く、実際の症例数はより多い可能性が高い。確認日5月15日から約1ヶ月経過しており、社会経済的影響も深刻。緊急の国際支援が必要な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reports record one-day increase in Ebola cases, month after outbreak's declaration
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a record one-day jump in Ebola cases: 72 new cases in 24 hours, bringing the total to 782, with 181 deaths after 32 new deaths. The outbreak was confirmed on May 15, weeks after suspected onset, and authorities mark the situation a month after declaration. Ongoing transmission persists amid weak contact tracing (56% coverage, down from last week), insecurity, and funding gaps hindering response efforts. The sizable daily increase underscores challenges in containment and surveillance. No specific infection source or imported/exported case details are provided. As of June 15, 2026, the figures reflect confirmed cases and deaths in this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ出血熱の1日記録更新を報告、発生宣言から1ヶ月後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への重大な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有する。現在進行中の流行で急速な増加が報告されている。
triage.notes: 現在進行中のエボラ出血熱流行で1日72例の記録的増加が報告されている。コンタクトトレーシング能力の低下（56%）、セキュリティ問題、資金不足により対応に支障が出ている。6月15日時点で確認症例782例、死亡181例。フルRRAが必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola risk at World Cup sparks fears despite US readiness claims
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk at the 2026 World Cup remains low but not zero; US readiness emphasizes identification, isolation, and safe care for suspected cases, supported by $260 million since the 2014 West Africa outbreak and 13 specialized treatment centers, with thousands trained to respond. About 6.5 million fans are expected in the US, Mexico, and Canada for 104 matches. Despite low risk acknowledged by CDC, PAHO, and WHO, the Democratic Republic of Congo Ebola outbreak—over 675 infections and more than 135 deaths—drives vigilance; Ebola is not airborne and spreads via direct contact with the fluids of the ill. Preparations include national trainings, MERS simulations, guidance on malaria/dengue/chikungunya, airport screening, and travel bans for some travelers; the DRC team trained in Belgium. FIFA medical committees and surveillance tools support early detection. Georgetown University hosts an independent Health Security Operations Center with 30+ partners to coordinate daily monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱がワールドカップ2026で懸念、米国の対応準備が強調される
triage.triage_reason: 複数の高危険病原体（エボラ、MERS、マラリア、デング、チクングニア）が関連する国際的大規模イベント（ワールドカップ2026）での集団感染リスク。DRCでの現在のエボラ流行（675例以上、135死亡以上）と米国での準備体制が示唆する重大な公衆衛生的関心。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでの現在のエボラ流行と2026年ワールドカップ開催地（米国・メキシコ・カナダ）での準備状況を主題としている。発生地域にはDRCのみが対象国に含まれる。ただし、ワールドカップは米国・メキシコで開催される国際的なイベントであり、多くの国から来訪者が予想されるため、複数国への拡大リスクが存在。記事は主にDRCの流行と米国の対応を扱っているため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。

diseases.name: Low Pathogenic Avian Influenza A H9N2
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2

article.articleHeadline: 料男童觸摸雞檔周圍環境染H9N2　當局籲市民避免帶幼童到街市
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boy suspected of contracting H9N2 avian influenza after touching the area around a chicken stall; authorities urge the public to avoid bringing young children to the market.
article.articleSummary: Two-year-old boy in Hong Kong previously infected with H9N2 avian influenza is suspected to have contracted the virus again after touching the area around a chicken stall at Sha Tin Wo Che Market. Health authorities say he visited the stall during the incubation window (1–10 days before onset) and may have become infected by touching the glass divider and nearby contaminated surfaces. An on-site inspection found environmental hygiene acceptable, but officials cautioned that live-poultry excreta can contaminate flooring and children are more likely to touch contaminated areas. Authorities urge avoiding bringing young children to markets and to practice good personal hygiene. Two environmental samples from the market’s fresh foods shop are pending results. Local farms are not considered to pose elevated risk; H9N2 is a common poultry endemic disease. AFCD will monitor for abnormal poultry deaths; current monitoring results are normal.

triage.headline_ja: 男児が鶏檔の周囲環境接触後にH9N2感染の疑い　当局は幼児の市場訪問回避を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 香港での小児H9N2再感染疑い事例であり、スクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、流行性）に部分的に該当するが、情報が限定的（環境サンプル検査待機中、単一事例）で確定性が低いため。
triage.notes: 香港での2歳男児の再感染疑い事例。環境サンプル検査結果待機中であり、現時点では推定感染にとどまる。H9N2は地域流行疾患であり一般的だが、小児の再感染および市場での環境汚染リスク示唆により要経過観察。確定診断と環境検査結果により判定が変わる可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ada 39.672 kasus DBD, Kemenkes serukan deteksi lebih kuat di daerah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: There are 39,672 dengue fever cases; the Ministry of Health calls for stronger detection in the regions.
article.articleSummary: By May 2026, Indonesia reported 39,672 dengue fever cases and 105 deaths, led by West Java with over 9,000 cases and 36 deaths. Indonesia is the world’s second-largest dengue burden, contributing about 3% of global cases and 17% of deaths, in Southeast Asia’s largest share. The National Dengue Control Action Plan 2026–2029 outlines four core strategies: strengthen early detection and diagnosis; optimize case management; expand prevention; and bolster surveillance and rapid response, supported by governance, financing, partnerships, data, research, and innovation. The plan targets zero dengue deaths by 2030 and a 25% reduction in cases from 2021 levels. Interventions include environmental controls to reduce breeding, vector strategies such as Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes, and human measures including dengue vaccination. Wolbachia deployments are in Jakarta, Kupang, Semarang, Bandung, and Bontang, with outcomes expected in 2027; prior Yogyakarta trials showed ~70% incidence reduction. Vaccination remains voluntary; 11 of 514 cities/districts offer school-based services.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱39,672例、保健省は地域での検出強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアでのデング熱大規模流行（39,672例、105死亡）は、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な規模、国際的拡大リスクを示しており、IHR基準3つ以上該当する。国家的対応計画の策定と政府関心の高さから、フルRRA実施の価値あり。
triage.notes: インドネシアは世界第2位のデング熱負担国（全球症例の約3%、死亡の17%）。Wolbachia蚊戦略やワクチン接種を含む包括的対策が進行中。2026年1月から5月の期間データで、西ジャワが最多（9,000例以上、36死亡）。国家計画2026-2029は2030年までのゼロ死亡目標を設定している。

article.articleHeadline: Congo enfrenta un alarmante aumento diario de casos de ébola un mes después del brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo faces an alarming daily rise in Ebola cases one month after the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri province in the east, with spillover into North Kivu, South Kivu, and Uganda. One month after the outbreak was declared on May 15, 2026, authorities report 72 new laboratory-confirmed cases in 24 hours, bringing total to 782, with 181 deaths (32 new fatalities). Real case numbers may be higher due to under-detection amid widespread displacement, and contact tracing coverage has fallen to 56%. Recoveries reach 56, yielding a case-fatality rate of about 23%. The Bundibugyo virus is less common and has no vaccines or approved treatments. WHO is intensifying testing, tracing, and treatment; Africa CDC provides technical support, strengthens laboratories, and boosts community engagement. Ituri accounts for over 90% of cases; North and South Kivu report cases, and Uganda has imported cases. Nearly one million displaced hinder response, including mining movements across sites.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、ブレイク発生から1ヶ月後にエボラウイルスの症例が日々増加し警戒状態に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルスBundibugyo株の多国間アウトブレイク（DRC・ウガンダ）で、782症例・181死亡の深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの流出）、渡航・貿易制限の可能性がある。社会政治的関心も高く、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの流出は報告されているが、本シグナルの主たるイベント発生地はDRCであり、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。アウトブレイク宣言は2026年5月15日で、100万人近くの国内避難民が対応を阻害している。Bundibugyo株は稀な株型でワクチンが未承認。接触者追跡率が56%と低下している点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: El brote de Ébola en en el Congo sigue expandiéndose: casi 200 muertos y más de 780 casos en los últimos dos meses
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread: nearly 200 deaths and more than 780 cases in the last two months.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths (and 40 recoveries) as of 13 June 2026, per the Ministry of Health. Over the past two months, about 200 deaths and more than 780 cases were recorded. Thirty-two? No—72 new cases were reported, including 56 in Ituri province: 25 in Mongbwalu, 13 in Bunia, 6 in Rwampara, 5 in Nyankunde, 3 in Komanda, 2 in Nizi, 1 in Damas, and 1 in Nia-Nia. Two new health zones are affected: Nia-Nia (Ituri) and Mabalako (North Kivu), bringing the total affected zones to 31. The WHO warns the outbreak is expanding geographically. Common Ebola symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle and joint pain, headache, sore throat, vomiting, diarrhea, abdominal pain, rash, and renal/hepatic impairment. The DRC, which ended a Kasai outbreak in December 2025, remains highly experienced in Ebola response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行が拡大を続ける：過去2ヶ月間で約200人の死亡と780例以上の患者数
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の地理的拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5/5項目に該当。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体であり、ただちにフルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは2026年6月15日時点で782確定例・181死亡を報告。過去2ヶ月間の新規患者数720例以上・死亡約200例は異常な増加率を示唆。地理的拡大（新たに31ヘルスゾーン、うち2ゾーン新規）、高い致死率（約23.1%）、ヒト-ヒト感染能。DRCは過去のエボラ対応経験があるが、流行の勢いが強い。Bluedot APIはコスタリカを誤って含めているが、サマリー上でコスタリカの流行に言及なし。

article.articleHeadline: Struggling to Prevent Ebola at DR Congo's Displacement Camps
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak response is focused on displacement camps in the Democratic Republic of Congo, where authorities struggle to prevent transmission. The article, dated 2026-06-15, centers on prevention challenges in DR Congo’s displacement camps, highlighting ongoing efforts to curb Ebola spread among populations affected by conflict and displacement. While the full text shared here consists of a publisher disclaimer from AllAfrica, the title signals that Ebola remains a concern in the region, with no specific case counts, deaths, or dates of events provided in the excerpt. The document notes that AllAfrica aggregates reports from multiple sources and that publishers are responsible for content. No laboratory confirmation or infection sources are detailed in this excerpt, and there is no information on imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の避難民キャンプでのエボラ予防の課題
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病は極めて致命率が高く、避難民キャンプという高リスク環境での感染予防の困難性が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに具体的な症例数、死亡者数、実験室確認情報が記載されていないが、エボラウイルス病は固有の高い病原性と国際的懸念から、最小限の情報でもシグナル価値が高い。避難民キャンプという高リスク集団への曝露環境が明記されており、制御困難性が示唆されている。フルRRAでの詳細情報収集が必須。

article.articleHeadline: DA rolls out ₱140-million vaccine plan to fight ASF crisis
article.articleSummary: Philippines, June 15, 2026 — The Department of Agriculture launched the Animal Vaccine Development Program (AVDP), budgeting ₱140.9 million over three years to build local vaccine capacity for animal diseases including African swine fever (ASF) and foot-and-mouth disease (FMD). The inter-agency effort, under the national livestock program and involving the Bureau of Animal Industry, the Philippine Carabao Center, and Central Luzon State University, targets safer, domestically produced vaccines. A Biosafety Level 3 facility will be established to enable safe handling of high-risk pathogens and accelerate vaccine candidates for ASF and FMD. DA notes the domestic swine industry remains in recovery, with imports filling shortfalls, and argues locally developed vaccines can be tailored to Philippine pathogen strains, improving effectiveness and resilience. It marks a move toward greater self-reliance in protecting livestock livelihoods. However, ASF continues to threaten local hog production, underscoring the need for vaccine self-sufficiency.

triage.headline_ja: DA、ASF危機に対抗するための1億4,000万ペソワクチン計画を展開
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ASF・FMD）に関する政策・ワクチン開発プログラムの発表であり、直接的な流行・アウトブレイク報告ではない。ただしASFの継続的な脅威が記事内で言及されており、今後の発生状況の進展を注視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 本記事は政策発表・ワクチン開発計画に関するニュースであり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。ASFの継続的な脅威が地域の畜産業に存在することが背景として述べられているが、具体的な新規患者数や発生件数は報告されていない。動物疾病に関する感染症シグナルとしての優先度は低いが、フィリピンにおけるASF・FMD対策の強化を示す指標として今後の動向監視の対象とすることが適切。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reports record one-day increase in Ebola cases, a month after outbreak's declaration
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-15, Congo reports a record 72 new Ebola cases in 24 hours, bringing confirmed infections to 782 and deaths to 181 (32 new). Fifty-six recovered, CFR 23%. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, which has no approved vaccine or treatment. Weak contact tracing, insecurity, and funding gaps hinder the response a month after the outbreak was declared on May 15. Ituri province accounts for more than 90% of cases, with spillovers into North Kivu and South Kivu and across the border to Uganda. Contact tracing coverage stands at 56%, down from last week, complicating detection amid the displacement of nearly a million people and frequent movement by artisanal miners. WHO is intensifying testing and tracing; Africa CDC appeals for rapid resources to stop transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、アウトブレーク宣言から1ヶ月後にエボラ患者が1日で過去最多を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大な感染症アウトブレーク。確定患者782名、死亡181名、CFR 23%、複数県への拡大、ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されている。対象国DRCで発生中。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（発生地域に含まれるが対象国外）への越境感染が報告されているため、地域監視強化が必要。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による1日72症例の記録的増加、接触者追跡カバー率56%と低下、百万人規模の国内避難民と採掘業者の移動により制御困難な状況。WHO及びAfrica CDCの支援要請あり。

article.articleHeadline: Doctors Without Borders warns of 'dangerous gaps' in Ebola response in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC)—Bundibugyo strain—with 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths in the DRC, plus 19 cases and 2 deaths in neighboring Uganda as of 15 June 2026. The outbreak centers in Ituri province, extending to North Kivu and South Kivu. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo. MSF warns “dangerous gaps” in the response one month after the May 15 declaration, noting overwhelmed treatment centers, late-stage patient presentations, and many cases not identified as contacts before care. Testing remains a major weakness despite ramped-up capacity and mobile Bundibugyo-specific kits; North Kivu has only one lab for blood testing, and results are delayed. Insecurity hinders access to communities. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids, fueling fear of a potential scale comparable to the 2014 West Africa epidemic if action is not accelerated.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応の『危険な隙間』を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱の多国家的アウトブレイク（DRC 782確定例、181死亡、ウガンダ19例2死亡）で、治療法なし、対応の重大な不備あり、国際的拡大リスク高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダはBluedt APIで発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーの主眼はDRCでの対応不備にあり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo株は2012年以来の再出現で、利用可能な承認ワクチン・治療法がない点が特に懸念される。MSFの警告は対応ギャップの実質的な課題を指摘し、2014年西アフリカエボラ流行との比較が関心の高さを示唆。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Οι MSF ανησυχούν για τα "σοβαρά κενά" στην υγειονομική αντίδραση
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola epidemic in the DRC: MSF concerned about the "serious gaps" in the public health response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus is spreading faster than the local response, according to MSF. One month after the May 15 outbreak declaration—the 17th Ebola outbreak in the country—WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. For Bundibugyo, there is neither a vaccine nor an approved therapy. Despite recent response improvements, MSF warns of serious gaps in diagnosis, surveillance, contact tracing, and community engagement. In North Kivu Province, there is only one laboratory for blood analysis, causing multi-day delays in results. The WHO, citing Congolese authorities, reports 782 cases and 181 deaths so far, though MSF says official figures likely underestimate the true scale. Hundreds of portable rapid tests have arrived in eastern DRC, but access remains limited in insecure areas, hindering rapid case detection and containment.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：MSFが公衆衛生対応の「深刻な不備」を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行で死亡者・重症例多数、国際保健緊急事態宣言済み、深刻な公衆衛生対応不備が報告されており、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による流行で、ワクチンと承認済み治療法が利用できない。WHO が2026年5月17日に国際保健緊急事態を宣言済み。MSF は公式統計が実数を過小評価していると指摘。北キブ県における検査室の不足と診断遅延、セキュリティ上の課題により対応が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: MSF προειδοποιούν για ελλείψεις στην υγειονομική αντίδραση
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: MSF warn of shortages in the public health response.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns that Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than the response, with dangerous gaps in health response and an unknown true extent of the outbreak. A month after the May 15 declaration, MSF’s Kate White says the disease outpaces response in North Kivu, where only one laboratory analyzes blood samples, causing days-long delays. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved treatment, hampering containment. WHO figures cite 782 cases and 181 deaths, but MSF cautions official data likely undercount the real scale. Testing capacity has improved with portable rapid tests, yet access remains limited in insecure areas and results remain delayed. The situation is contrasted with the West Africa outbreak (2013-2016), where MSF criticized WHO for delays during a larger crisis, which killed over 11,000 people and affected about 29,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：MSFが公衆衛生対応における不足を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は既知の重篤感染症で、対応が発生速度に追いつかないという重大な懸念が報告されている。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC（特にNorth Kivu）が主要な発生地点として記述されており、アンゴラについての具体的な感染例や発生状況の記載がないため、verified_locationsには含めない。DRCはWPRO対象国リストに含まれる。エボラは極めて高い致死率と国際的に重要な感染症であり、フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : les Émirats arabes unis livrent 20 tonnes de matériel médical pour renforcer la riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the United Arab Emirates delivers 20 tonnes of medical equipment to strengthen the response.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, the United Arab Emirates dispatched 20 tonnes of essential medical supplies to eastern Democratic Republic of Congo to bolster the Ebola response against the Bundibugyo strain. The airlift, drawn from WHO stockpiles, was flown via Uganda from Al Maktoum International Airport. Dubai Humanitarian led the operation on instruction of Sheikh Mohammed bin Rashid Al Maktoum. The shipment aims to support 280 health facilities and enable care for hundreds of patients over four weeks, including tents, disinfectants, personal protective equipment, thermometers, and other medical items to protect frontline staff. The UAE reaffirmed its pledge to international Ebola containment efforts, assisting WHO to strengthen measures to curb spread through collaboration with its Emirates International Aid Agency, international partners, and local authorities. Sheikh Shakhbout bin Nahyan Al Nahyan warned that WHO data show the cross-border Bundibugyo outbreak is severe, underscoring the need for renewed coordination, vaccines, and essential medicines.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：アラブ首長国連邦が対応強化のため20トンの医療機器を配送
triage.triage_reason: Ebola Bundibugyoの国際的な多国間対応事例であり、IHR基準の複数該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、国境を越えた感染の警告）およびWPRO基準の該当（重症度、管理可能性の確認）から、フルリスク評価進行が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCでのEbola（Bundibugyo株）の発生および国際的な対応である。Dubai・UAEは支援国として言及されているが、実際の発生地点ではない。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。サマリーにおいて『重篤』『国境を越えた』『ワクチン・医薬品の必要性』と明記され、WHOデータによる深刻性の警告もあり、継続的な監視と国際協調の重要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: MSF įspėja apie pavojingas spragas kovojant su Ebolos viruso protrūkiu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF warns of dangerous gaps in the fight against the Ebola virus outbreak.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns of significant gaps in the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where Bundibugyo-strain Ebola virus is driving an outbreak concentrated in Ituri Province, with spillovers to North Kivu and South Kivu. As of May 15, 2026, DRC had 782 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases and 181 deaths; neighboring Uganda reported 19 cases and 2 deaths. No vaccine or approved treatment exists for Bundibugyo. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever; the outbreak likely circulated unnoticed for weeks before declaration. MSF cites insecurity and unsafe access hampering case finding, contact tracing, and surveillance; testing remains a major weakness. Although laboratory capacity has increased and mobile Bundibugyo-specific tests arrived, many communities still lack access, and North Kivu has only one capable lab. Without faster, broader testing, this outbreak could reach magnitudes comparable to the 2014 West Africa epidemic (28k+ cases, 11k+ deaths).

triage.headline_ja: MSF、エボラウイルスの流行対策における危険な不備を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。Bundibugyo株エボラ出血熱はコンゴ民主共和国で782確認例・181死亡、ウガンダにも19例の波及を見せており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確。フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラは2014年西アフリカ流行並みに拡大する可能性があり、ワクチン・承認治療法が存在しないため極めて高リスク。検査体制整備不足、治安悪化による接触追跡困難が記載。記事ではウガンダでの波及も述べられているが、詳細は限定的で、DRCが主要な発生国。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ébola na RDCongo "está a superar esforços de resposta"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo "is outpacing response efforts"
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is outpacing response efforts one month after declaration, according to MSF. The virus is spreading across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Ituri accounting for about 95% of cases. The response, led by the Ministry of Health and international partners, is hampered by insecurity that limits access and by gaps in surveillance, diagnosis, contact tracing, and community engagement. Official counts exceed 650 confirmed cases and 130 deaths, but MSF warns these figures underestimate the outbreak; a day with 72 new cases raised totals to 782 cases and 181 deaths. Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment. 56 recovered; mortality around 23%. MSF calls for rapid diagnostics and scaled response as the window closes.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行「対応の努力を上回っている」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当。対象国DRCで650以上の確認症例と130以上の死亡が報告され、隣国ウガンダへの拡大も確認。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州における活発なエボラ流行を報告。ウガンダへの確認症例拡大（19例）も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。Bundibugyo Ebola virus（ワクチン・治療法未承認）による高い死亡率（23%）と急速な拡大が懸念される。MSFによる警告あり。

article.articleHeadline: Εμπολα: Ενας μήνας απο την κήρυξη της επιδημίας στο Κονγκό -Οι MSF ανησυχούν για σοβαρά κενά
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: One month since the outbreak was declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo — MSF are concerned about serious gaps.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) is spreading faster than on-the-ground response in North Kivu. MSF warns of dangerous gaps in diagnosis, surveillance, contact tracing, and community engagement one month after the outbreak was declared on May 15. WHO data indicate 782 cases and 181 deaths, though MSF cautions official figures likely undercount. Only one laboratory in North Kivu analyzes blood samples, causing multi-day delays in results; insecurity limits access to rapid tests in many areas. The Bundibugyo strain currently has no vaccine or approved therapy. WHO declared an international health emergency on May 17. Despite improved capacity with portable tests in eastern DRC, rapid, widespread testing remains essential to identify cases and curb transmission. The piece notes the West Africa 2013–2016 outbreak (over 11,300 deaths, ~29,000 cases) as a grim reference.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：コンゴ民主共和国での流行宣言から1ヶ月——国境なき医師団が深刻な対応の空白を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際健康上の緊急事態宣言、国際的拡大リスク）。WHOが国際衛生上の緊急事態を宣言し、高い死亡率と対応の遅延が確認されている。
triage.notes: アンゴラは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは主にコンゴ民主共和国（北キブ州）での流行に焦点が当たっており、アンゴラでの確認された症例や流行については明記されていないため、verified_locationsから除外。WHOが2026年5月17日に国際衛生上の緊急事態を宣言済み。Bundibugyo ebolavirus株は予防ワクチンや承認された治療法が現在存在しない。

article.articleHeadline: MSF warns of 'dangerous gaps' in Ebola response in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, declared 15 May 2026, has killed more than 180 people and continues to spread. As of 15 June 2026, the World Health Organization confirms 782 Ebola cases with 181 deaths in DRC; 19 cases with two deaths in neighbouring Uganda. MSF warns dangerous gaps persist in the response and that the outbreak is outpacing efforts; the true scale remains unclear. Kate White, MSF's emergency medical coordinator in the DRC, says most treatment centres in Ituri province are overwhelmed, many patients arrive at a late stage, and the majority were never identified or monitored as contacts before seeking care.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ対応の『危険な欠落』について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示し、複数国への拡大が確認されており、国際的関心が極めて高い。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてで該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（EVD）の大規模感染症イベント。DRコンゴでの感染確認782例、死亡181例、さらに隣国ウガンダへの拡大も確認（19例、2死亡）。対応体制の崩壊的な状況（治療センターの過負荷、接触者監視の失敗など）が報道されており、制御不能のリスクが高い。ウガンダも記事中に言及されているが、感染者数・死亡数から判断してイベントの主体はDRコンゴ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak: DRC pastor's funeral emerges as possible early transmission point, investigation finds
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) may trace to funeral of Pastor Paluku Makundi Dennis after his Feb 3 death in Bunya; a Reuters investigation traced a transmission chain to Mongbwalu, where the body was buried. The funeral involved a damaged coffin that was replaced and burned, after which fever, vomiting and bleeding preceded a surge in illness; 48 deaths occurred within two weeks of burial, and several relatives also died. Investigators interviewed more than 20 people, reviewed hospital and burial documents, and concluded authorities began examining whether Paluku could be among the earliest victims. Health workers alerted WHO on May 5; the outbreak was officially confirmed on May 15. Since then over 600 cases and at least 115 deaths have been reported across eastern Congo, including Mongbwalu. DRC has endured 17 Ebola outbreaks since 1976, including 2018–2020 with 2,299 deaths; fear and misinformation hinder contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行：DRC牧師の葬儀が初期伝播ポイントとして浮かび上がる、調査が判明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、既に600例以上の患者と115名以上の死亡者を伴う進行中の大規模エボラ出血熱流行である。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的な関心と支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 進行中の確定エボラ出血熱流行。2026年6月時点で既に600例以上、115名以上の死亡者を報告。初期伝播源として牧師の葬儀が特定されている。DRCの過去のエボラ流行歴（17回、2018-2020では2,299死）と恐怖・誤情報による接触者追跡の困難性が懸念材料。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: Οι Γιατροί χωρίς Σύνορα ανησυχούν για "σοβαρά κενά" στην υγειονομική αντίδραση στο Κονγκό
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Doctors Without Borders are concerned about "serious gaps" in the public health response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns of dangerous gaps in the Ebola response in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, where Bundibugyo ebolavirus is spreading faster than local capacity to contain it. As of June 15, 2026, the outbreak began May 15, and the World Health Organization declared a public health emergency of international concern on May 17. The DRC reports 782 cases and 181 deaths, though MSF cautions that official tallies likely undercount. Only one laboratory in North Kivu analyzes blood samples, causing multi‑day delays for results. Despite reinforced response and hundreds of portable Bundibugyo-specific tests, access remains limited in insecure areas, hindering rapid detection. Surveillance and contact tracing have improved to about 70% of contacts identified (up from 45% earlier this month), yet major gaps persist. There is no vaccine or approved therapy for Bundibugyo. The 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak killed over 11,300 people and ~29,000 cases, underscoring the risk.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：国境なき医師団がコンゴ民主共和国の公衆衛生対応における「深刻な欠陥」を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による進行中の大規模流行で、WHO が5月17日に国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言。公衆衛生対応に重大な欠陥があり、国際的支援が急務である。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus 株による流行で、過去の West Africa outbreak（2013-2016、11,300人以上の死亡）を参考に危機管理が必要。記事サマリーは DRC での発生を主題としており、Angola は記事本文の内容に明示されていないため verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Gripe grave por VSR cresce no Ceará e acende alerta para crianças; veja sintomas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Severe RSV infection on the rise in Ceará, raising alarm for children; see symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV) now leads severe acute respiratory syndrome (SRAG) in Ceará, Brazil, accounting for 40.9% of detections among hospitalized SRAG patients over the latest four weeks, surpassing rhinovirus. In Ceará, SRAG totaled 1,006 cases in weeks 14–17 and 945 in weeks 18–21, with RSV RT-PCR positivity rising from 11.9% (week 16) to 26% (week 21). Children aged 1–4 years represented about 26.7% of state SRAG records. Fortaleza reported 275 SRAG cases in weeks 16–21 of 2026, RSV identified as the main virus in severe cases; since January, Fortaleza has 945 SRAG notifications. Among under-5s, 1–4 years accounted for 247 cases and under-1 year for 226. Other municipalities with notable activity include Juazeiro do Norte, Maracanaú, Crato and Barbalha. Co-circulation with rhinovirus, influenza B, COVID-19 and metapneumovirus persists; authorities urge vigilance and care-seeking for worsening symptoms, especially in children under five.

triage.headline_ja: セアラ州でRSVによる重症感染症が増加、子どもに警告を発令；症状を確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル・セアラ州でRSVが重症急性呼吸器症候群（SRAG）の主要病原体となっており、複数の呼吸器病原体の同時流行を伴う中規模流行が認められる。特に1～4歳の小児が高い割合で罹患しており、公衆衛生上の影響が深刻である。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・セアラ州での多病原体同時流行（RSV 40.9%、ライノウイルス、インフルエンザB、COVID-19、メタニューモウイルス）を報告。RSV陽性率が週16の11.9%から週21の26%へ急速に上昇しており、特に1～4歳の小児（全SRAG症例の26.7%）が重症化している。Bluedot APIは複数の地域（Maracanaú、Ceará、Fortaleza等）を検出しているが、すべてセアラ州内の同一流行を示しているため、verified_locationsはBrazilのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Why existing vaccines won't help this Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Vaccine strategies against the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola face tradeoffs between protection, safety, and speed. Live-virus vaccines tailored for Bundibugyo could offer strong protection but carry higher risks of fever, aches, and fatigue and potential dangers for pregnant or immunocompromised people; scaling manufacturing would take seven to nine months to reach human testing. An alternative, ChAdOx1, uses a non-replicating chimpanzee adenovirus platform developed by Oxford and AstraZeneca, reducing side effects but in early trials required two doses; human testing could begin in two to three months, with manufacture by the Serum Institute of India. A Moderna mRNA candidate encodes a Bundibugyo protein via lipid nanoparticles; design is rapid, but the product requires strict cold storage and has no prior human Ebola vaccine trial data, meaning months are likely before testing.

triage.headline_ja: 既存のワクチンがこのエボラ出血熱の発生に役立たない理由
triage.triage_reason: 記事はBundibugyo株のエボラワクチン候補の技術的特性を論じた解説記事であり、実際の感染症イベント（患者発生、流行）の報告ではない。IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事はBundibugyo株エボラワクチン候補の比較検討（live-virus、ChAdOx1、Moderna mRNA）に関する科学的解説であり、現在進行中の実際のエボラウイルス感染症イベント（患者、流行）の報告ではない。Bluedot APIが付与したIndiaとUKはワクチン開発・製造の拠点（Serum Institute of India、Oxford/AstraZeneca）を示しているが、これらの国でのエボラ感染症発生を示すものではない。対象国リストに基づく verified_locations は該当なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ambulatório de dengue e doenças respiratórias de Divinópolis muda de endereço nesta segunda (15) - Portal MPA
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue and Respiratory Diseases Outpatient Clinic in Divinópolis moves to a new address this Monday (15) - Portal MPA
article.articleSummary: Endemic Diseases Support Clinic in Divinópolis relocates to a new address on Monday, June 15, 2026. The outpatient unit, created in 2024 to treat suspected dengue fever and respiratory diseases, moves to Itambé Street, No. 5, in the Ipiranga neighborhood, near the railway and Planalto Sports Complex, from its former address on Nova Serrana Street in Afonso Pena. The clinic operates Monday–Friday, 7:00–17:00; weekends and holidays are closed. It features a multidisciplinary team that performs triage, specimen collection, and consultations for mild cases classified as A, B, or C; more severe cases are referred to the Emergency Care Unit (UPA). It supports primary care units to speed care during periods of high disease incidence. For questions, call (37) 3229-6004.

triage.headline_ja: ジビノポリスのデング熱および呼吸器疾患外来クリニックが月曜日（15日）に新住所へ移転
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱流行そのものではなく、既存の外来クリニックの施設移転に関する行政情報である。新たな疾患事象、流行拡大、または公衆衛生上の危機を示す情報は含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・ミナスジェライス州に関連しているが、評価対象は対象国リストに含まれていない（ブラジルは対象国ではなく、対象国はZambia、Philippines、Thailand、Ghana、DRC、Indonesia、China、Myanmar、Vietnam、Indiaである）。加えて、記事の主内容はデング熱の新規発生や流行情報ではなく、既存医療施設の移転手続きに過ぎず、シグナルトリアージの対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola - MSF s'inquiète de "dangereuses lacunes" dans la réponse à Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola - MSF is concerned about 'dangerous gaps' in the Ebola response in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than the on-the-ground response, according to Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF). One month after the May 15, 2026 declaration, MSF warns the true scale of the epidemic and the exact zones where the virus is circulating remain unknown, complicating containment. Kate White, MSF's emergency medical coordinator in DRC, called for a response worthy of the crisis and urged urgent action. The outbreak is the 17th Ebola event in the DRC, a country of over 100 million people. Two days after the declaration, the WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus triggered a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. No case or death counts are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ - MSFはコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応における「危険な欠陥」に懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、WHO公衆衛生緊急事態（PHEIC）が既に宣言されている。WHOによる国際的通知相当の高リスク状況
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHRで最高リスク疾患。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。MSFが対応の重大な欠陥を指摘し、実際の流行規模が不明という点が管理可能性を脅かしている。1ヶ月で感染拡大が対応を上回っているとの警告は、継続的曝露と急速な拡大のリスクを示唆。即座のフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Thu hồi sữa bột trẻ sơ sinh Nara Organics liên quan đến ngộ độc Botulinum
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Recall of Nara Organics infant formula linked to botulism.
article.articleSummary: US FDA on June 13, 2026 voluntarily recalled Nara Organics Whole Milk Organic Powdered Infant Formula after three infant botulism cases in California, Pennsylvania, and Washington were linked to the product used before illness. The recalled formula had been distributed in the United States via Target.com and Nara.com from July 2025 to June 2026 and was not officially distributed outside the U.S. In Vietnam, the Food Safety Department (Cục An toàn thực phẩm) issued a directive on June 15, 2026 to Ho Chi Minh City and other provinces to publicize the recall, stop use of all recalled lots, and coordinate with the producer and distributors to report imported, consumed, and stock quantities and disposal plans. The agency also instructs collaboration with e-commerce regulators to suspend sales, remove advertisements, and enforce recalls, with reports due by June 25, 2026.

triage.headline_ja: ボツリヌス中毒に関連するNara Organics乳幼児粉ミルクの回収
triage.triage_reason: 乳幼児向け粉ミルク製品の国際的なボツリヌス中毒関連リコール事案。米国での3件の患者発生と、ベトナムでの行政対応（流通停止・調査指示）が確認され、複数国での公衆衛生対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、実際の発生・対応が確認される対象国はベトナムのみ（ホーチミン市及び他省での行政対応）。米国はBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ただしIHR基準では米国での患者発生と製品回収が確認されており、国際的な関連イベント。ボツリヌス中毒は重篤疾患で乳幼児が影響を受けるため、公衆衛生上の重要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo Ebola cases climb as two more health zones report infections
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, Ebola infections in the Democratic Republic of Congo have risen to 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, after 72 new cases were recorded in the previous 24 hours—a surge described as one of the largest daily increases of the current outbreak. Two additional health zones were reported with infections, bringing the total to 31 health zones across the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. The outbreak, Congo's 17th, remains confined to these eastern provinces despite the uptick in cases, according to government data released on Sunday 14 June. The figures reflect confirmed infections and deaths in this ongoing eastern-focused outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: DRコンゴのエボラ患者数が増加、2つの追加保健地域で感染を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響：782確定症例・181死亡、異常：72症例/24時間は最大級の日増加率、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。スクリーニング基準も複数該当。対象国DRC内での継続的な流行形態。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（EVD）の継続的な流行。782確定症例・181死亡という深刻な状況。過去24時間で72新規症例という記録的な日増加率が報告されている。31の保健地域に拡大。DRコンゴ第17次アウトブレイク。東部州（イツリ、北キブ、南キブ）に限定されているが、保健システムの脆弱性と人口密集地への拡大リスクが懸念される。フルのRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Afreximbank cancels annual meeting on Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: On 15 June 2026, Afreximbank canceled its upcoming annual meeting in El Alamein, Egypt, citing public health concerns and measures by Egypt and the African Union amid rising Ebola activity in central Africa. The Democratic Republic of Congo has reported 782 Ebola cases after an outbreak was declared about a month ago, with Uganda also reporting infections. As a result, Afreximbank will conduct shareholder business by correspondence, and the Egyptian government has postponed other international events this month. Afreximbank, a Cairo-based institution owned by African governments, regional financial institutions and private shareholders, notes these decisions reflect evolving health conditions. The African Development Bank recently held its annual meeting in Brazzaville last month, following the DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: アフリエクシムバンク、エボラ懸念により年次総会をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの発生（DRC 782例、ウガンダでも報告）であり、国際的な行事キャンセルによる国際的影響、複数国での報告、公開された社会的関心があり、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: DRC で 782 例のエボラ報告、ウガンダでも報告あり。対象国はDRCのみ。エジプトでの国際会議キャンセル、アフリカ連合による対応等、国際的な影響が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Shigella toll rises in Kerala: Seven-year-old fourth victim this year
article.articleSummary: Shigella infection in Kerala, India, drives four deaths this year as a seven-year-old boy from Malappuram district, Arjav, died while undergoing treatment at Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital after being admitted June 12 with fever and diarrhoea. Kerala has 138 confirmed Shigella cases reported across the state through June 14, with Kozhikode district recording the highest counts. An additional 77 suspected cases are reported statewide; in June alone there are 62 confirmed and 17 suspected cases. Three fresh confirmed cases were reported on June 14. Shigellosis, a bacterial diarrheal illness, spreads via contaminated food or water and contact with infected people. The Indian Journal of Medical Research notes Shigella as a major diarrhoeal cause in India and endemic with limited morbidity/mortality estimates; authorities say surveillance and containment are ongoing in affected districts.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でシゲラ菌感染症が増加：今年4番目の死亡者は7歳
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）、またWPRO基準でも複数該当し、重症度が確認できることからシグナルとして認定。
triage.notes: ケーラ州のシゲラ菌感染症アウトブレイク。2026年中の死亡4件、確認症例138件（6月14日時点）、疑い症例77件が報告されている。感染の拡大傾向が明らかで、特にコーチ地区での症例集積が顕著。飲食水汚染と人から人への接触感染が引き起こし要因。インド医学研究ジャーナルがシゲラ菌を主要な下痢症起因菌として記述しており、インドでの常在性が指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: 300 Patienten am Tag, ein Arzt, sechs Pflegekräfte- Ebola-Epidemie im Kongo spitzt sich weiter zu
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 300 patients a day, one doctor, six nurses — Ebola epidemic in the Congo is intensifying.
article.articleSummary: Since the Ebola outbreak began in mid-May 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo has recorded 710 laboratory-confirmed cases and 149 deaths. The epidemic is intensifying as health facilities are overwhelmed: in some treatment centers, one doctor and six nurses care for up to 300 patients daily. The NGO Help – Hilfe zur Selbsthilfe and local partner UGEAFI are conducting health trainings and supplying disinfection materials and equipment, reaching about 20,000 people. Ongoing conflict and poverty have collapsed the health system, with many aid groups pausing operations due to funding cuts; international funding is urgently needed to expand aid and prevent a larger outbreak like 2018. Misinformation and distrust hinder response. The article does not detail a specific infection source or imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: 1日300人の患者、医師1人、看護職6人——コンゴのエボラ流行が一層悪化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4/4該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も全項目該当。確認された710症例、149死亡、医療システムの崩壊、国際支援の緊急ニーズがある。
triage.notes: 2026年5月中旬からの進行中のエボラ流行。710確認症例、149死亡。医療施設の深刻な過負荷（1医師6看護職が1日300患者対応）。紛争と貧困による保健システム崩壊。国際資金の緊急要請。2018年の大規模流行再現の懸念。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is back, so are the double standards
article.articleSummary: Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) began 15 May; by 9 June it had 617 confirmed cases and 117 deaths. Bundibugyo is a rarer ebolavirus with two prior outbreaks (Uganda, 2007; DRC, 2012); the current outbreak is larger but has a lower fatality rate than Zaire. There is no approved vaccine or targeted treatment; patients receive supportive care—fever management, hydration, treatment of secondary infections, and, for severe bleeding, transfusions. Transmission occurs via contact with infected bodily fluids, not airborne. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda, and ongoing regional linkages include near-daily flights between the DRC and Johannesburg. The first confirmed case was a healthcare worker who became ill on 25 April in Bunia. The US seeks a quarantine facility for Americans in Kenya’s Laikipia Air Base; Kenya’s president supports the plan, while several Western countries have imposed travel bans, despite WHO cautions.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが戻ってきた、二重基準も
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo株の大規模アウトブレイク（617確定例、117死亡）が東部DRCで発生し、ウガンダへの越境拡大、国際的な移動制限とWHO警告のギャップなど、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大リスク。
triage.notes: DRC東部で5月15日開始したエボラBundibugyo株アウトブレイク。2007年ウガンダ、2012年DRC以来の3度目の流行で過去最大規模。Bundibugyo株はZaire株より致死率が低いが（117/617=19%）、特異的ワクチン・治療法なし。既にウガンダへ越境し、DRC-ヨハネスブルグ間の頻繁な航空連絡による地域的リスク。ケニアのLaikipia基地への米国隔離施設設置計画など国際的な対応も行われている。

article.articleHeadline: Deadly 'fox tapeworm' linked to lethal disease detected in West Coast wildlife
article.articleSummary: Echinococcus multilocularis, the fox tapeworm, detected for the first time in West Coast wildlife after University of Washington researchers found the parasite in 37 of 100 coyotes near Puget Sound; the study was published in PLOS Neglected Tropical Diseases earlier this year. The tapeworm causes echinococcosis, producing cystic lesions most often in the liver; alveolar echinococcosis is rarer and more lethal, potentially causing liver failure. Humans become infected by ingesting eggs, via contaminated hands or handling an infected pet. In coyotes, a newer European variant now predominates in the U.S. and Canada, with westward spread from the Midwest over the past decade. Most human infections occur abroad, but the overall risk to the public remains low. Prevention includes thorough handwashing, avoiding contact with wild canids, and ensuring routine veterinary care for dogs; the CDC advises these measures. Western China is cited as having the highest global prevalence.

triage.headline_ja: 西海岸の野生動物で検出された致命的な「キツネ条虫」は致死的な疾患と関連
triage.triage_reason: 米国西海岸での初検出で異常性あり、ヒト感染リスク低く公衆衛生への深刻な影響は限定的。対象国内での本格的な流行兆候なく、情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な流行地は米国西海岸（対象国外）。中国言及は「西部中国が世界最高流行地」という背景情報であり、現在の発生地ではない。動物での検出が主で、ヒト感染リスクは「overall risk to the public remains low」と明記。対象国での直接的な発生報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला प्रकोप घोषित किए जाने के महीने भर बाद एक दिन में सर्वाधिक 72 मामले सामने आए
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A month after the Ebola outbreak was declared in the Congo, 72 cases were reported in a single day—the highest.
article.articleSummary: In Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola outbreak intensifies one month after declaration, with 72 new cases in the last 24 hours, raising total to 782 cases and 181 deaths (including 32 new in the past day). Undercounting is likely since confirmation occurred on May 15 and transmission may have started weeks earlier. Contact tracing coverage has fallen to 56%, hindering containment. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which no licensed vaccine or treatment exists. So far, 56 people have recovered, yielding a case fatality rate of about 23%. The World Health Organization says it is accelerating testing, identification of contacts, and treatment efforts to curb transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染症の発生宣言から1か月後、1日で過去最高の72例が報告される
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ワクチン・治療法なし）による急速な感染拡大、高い致死率（23%）、接触者追跡の低下（56%）により、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とコントロール不可能性が認識される。国際的な支援が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo種）の急速拡大。1日当たり最高新規患者数の記録更新、累積782例、181例の死亡が報告されている。接触者追跡カバー率の低下（56%）は流行制御能力の喪失を示唆。WHOが対応加速を表明。記事サマリーに基づき、発生地はDRC（キンシャサ）に限定される。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में बेकाबू हुआ इबोला, 24 घंटे में 72 नए केस, अब तक 181 लोगों की मौत
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola out of control in Congo; 72 new cases in 24 hours; death toll stands at 181.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC), caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. As of 15 June 2026, 782 lab-confirmed cases and 181 deaths; 72 new cases in the last 24 hours—the highest daily toll yet. Official confirmation occurred on 15 May, with true caseload likely higher due to limited contact tracing (56% coverage) and earlier transmission. Ituri province is the epicenter, accounting for over 90% of cases, with spread also in North Kivu and South Kivu; the outbreak has reached neighboring Uganda. 56 people have recovered; case fatality rate ~23%. Unlike the earlier Zaire ebolavirus outbreaks in the region, Bundibugyo has no approved vaccine or effective treatment. WHO and Africa CDC are accelerating testing, contact tracing, and patient care, strengthening labs, active case finding, and community engagement; displacement in Ituri (~1 million) further challenges containment and tracing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで制御不能となったエボラ、24時間で72新規症例、累計死亡者181人
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。高い社会的関心と国際支援の必要性が認められ、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模流行。15日時間で72症例という過去最高の1日当たり感染数。ワクチン未承認のため、公衆衛生上の脅威が極めて高い。ウガンダへの越境拡大リスクあり。100万人の国内避難民による感染制御の困難が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: "Gydytojai be sienų": yra pavojingų spragų kovojant su Ebolos viruso protrūkiu KDR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: "Doctors Without Borders": There are dangerous gaps in fighting the Ebola virus outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns of dangerous gaps in fighting the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths have been reported, with Uganda adding 19 cases and 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus strain is centered in Ituri Province in northeastern DRC, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu. No licensed vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo. MSF cites insecurity and hard-to-reach communities, late patient presentation, and insufficient contact tracing as major challenges, and warns testing remains a critical weakness. Although mobile Bundibugyo-specific testing kits have begun arriving in eastern DRC, many communities still lack access; North Kivu has only one lab capable of testing blood samples. Without faster, broader testing and response, the outbreak could escalate toward levels seen in the 2014 West Africa epidemic.

triage.headline_ja: 「国境なき医師団」：コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラウイルス発生に対応する際に危険な隔たりが存在する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響782確認例・181死亡、予想外の株（Bundibugyo）、隣国ウガンダへの国際拡大19例、国際的な対応能力の限界）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全て該当。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのBundibugyo Ebolaの発生が主題。ウガンダでの症例報告（19例・2死亡）も言及されているが、サマリーの主要フォーカスはDRCでの発生状況と対応の課題である。DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。ワクチン・治療薬がないBundibugyo株、検査能力の深刻な制限、治安情勢による対応困難が特に懸念される。2014年西アフリカ流行との比較言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: Perspėja dėl Ebolos protrūkio: mato "pavojingų spragų
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warns of an Ebola Outbreak: Sees Dangerous Gaps
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in Ituri Province (northeast) with spillover into North Kivu and South Kivu. As of June 15, 2026, WHO-confirmed totals show 782 cases and 181 deaths in the DRC, while neighboring Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. MSF warns of dangerous gaps despite a stronger response since May 15: treatment centers in Ituri are overloaded, patients arrive late, and many are not identified or monitored as contacts. Testing remains a major weakness; mobilized Bundibugyo-specific kits have arrived, but access is limited, and North Kivu has only one laboratory able to test blood samples, causing delays. There are no licensed vaccines or treatments for Bundibugyo; transmission occurs via close contact and body fluids and can cause fatal hemorrhagic fever. Experts fear the outbreak could approach the scale of West Africa’s 2014 epidemic without urgent action.

triage.headline_ja: エボラアウトブレイクに警告：危険な隙間を認識
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の国際的な多地域流行で、DRC 782例・181死亡、ウガンダ19例・2死亡の確認数あり。高い重症度と国際拡大のリスクが明確。
triage.notes: ウガンダは記事に言及されているが、発生地域リストにあっても対象国リスト外のため verified_locations に含めない。DRC内の South Kivu、Ituri、North Kivu は全て DRC に統合。Bundibugyo株特有のワクチン・治療薬がない点、検査能力の制限（North Kivu で検査可能施設1箇所）、2014年西アフリカエボラ流行同規模への懸念が表明されており、フルRRA進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 致死率高达50%！这个病毒早期症状和感冒相似，紧急提示 -- -- _京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fatality rate up to 50%! The early symptoms of this virus resemble those of a common cold; urgent alert.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) outbreak in Africa features the Democratic Republic of Congo with 710 confirmed cases and 149 deaths; 324 patients are in isolation or hospitalized and 35 have recovered. Uganda is affected as well. WHO has designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern; China’s CDC warns travelers returning from risk areas to seek medical care if fever, fatigue, or hemorrhagic symptoms appear. WHO cites about a 20% case-fatality rate, though the true rate may be higher. Ebola is a zoonotic infection caused by six species (Zaire, Sudan, Bundibugyo, Taï Forest, Reston, Bombali); Zaire, Sudan and Bundibugyo have caused major outbreaks. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms mimic flu or malaria, followed by vomiting/diarrhea; some patients develop bleeding. Transmission is by direct contact with infected fluids; not airborne. Prevention: avoid unnecessary travel to Ituri Province and parts of Uganda; 21-day self-monitoring after return; avoid wildlife; hygiene; vaccines exist only for Zaire ebolavirus.

triage.headline_ja: 致死率高達50%！このウイルスの初期症状は風邪に似ている。緊急警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病のアフリカでの流行が、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHO PHEIC指定済みの国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威である。DRCで710例の確認患者と149例の死亡が報告されており、ウガンダにも拡大。中国のCDCによる渡航警告も発出されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが報告した発生地域にはUganda（226074）とChina（1814991）が含まれているが、サマリーを詳読するとUgandaは「also affected」と言及されているのみで主要発生地ではなく、対象国リストに含まれていない。Chinaについては、CDC警告と渡航警告者への医療受診推奨が述べられているが、これは報告国であり発生地ではないため、verified_locationsから除外した。実際の流行はDRCで発生中。WHOによるPHEIC指定（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）確認済み。致死率は20〜50%と高リスク。2-21日の潜伏期間で初期症状が風邪やマラリアに類似するため、診断遅延リスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: உலக டெங்கு தினம் 2026: வீட்டு தோட்டத்திற்கு டெங்கு கொசுக்களை வரவழைக்கும் 5 முக்கிய தவறுகள்!
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Dengue Day 2026: 5 major mistakes that attract dengue-carrying mosquitoes to your home garden.
article.articleSummary: World Dengue Day 2026: Five major mistakes that attract dengue-carrying mosquitoes to your home garden highlights simple, actionable tips to curb Aedes breeding in domestic spaces. The piece is authored by R.S. Anoj, a Tamil digital content producer with over six years in Tamil media, who joined Samayam Tamil in 2023 to cover health, lifestyle, and related topics. Anoj has written web stories across body-health, fashion, relationships, beauty, travel, food, cinema, and sports, with more than 8,000 articles. He emphasizes consulting domain experts to ensure accuracy and translates research from organizations like WHO and CDC into accessible Tamil. He holds an MSc in Electronic Media from Anna University, Chennai. His prior roles include content writing for ETV Bharat (2019–2020), Indian Express Tamil (2021), and Public Vibe Short News (2022). In his spare time he travels and watches films.

triage.headline_ja: 世界デング熱の日 2026年：自宅の庭にデング熱媒介蚊を引き寄せる5つの主な誤り
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱の予防啓発コンテンツであり、新たな感染症アウトブレイクやイベントの報告ではない。IHR基準・WPRIスクリーニング基準に該当せず、社会的関心も低い。
triage.notes: 本記事は世界デング熱の日（6月15日）に関する啓発記事であり、タミル語のデジタルメディアコンテンツプロデューサーによる予防情報である。具体的な感染症イベント、アウトブレイク情報、新規患者情報、死亡報告は含まれていない。したがってシグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Hari Dengue ASEAN: Waspada DBD, Kenali Tanda Bahaya dan Utamakan Pencegahan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ASEAN Dengue Day: Be Alert to Dengue Fever, Recognize the Warning Signs, and Prioritize Prevention.
article.articleSummary: ASEAN Dengue Day emphasizes that dengue fever remains a public health issue in Indonesia, transmitted by Aedes aegypti and not just a mild fever. Typical onset is a sudden high fever (39–40°C) with headache, retro-orbital pain, myalgia/arthralgia, nausea or vomiting, reduced appetite, and a red skin rash. Bleeding is not universal early. Warning signs arise when fever subsides (days 3–7), signaling risk of severe dengue: severe abdominal pain or tenderness, persistent vomiting, epistaxis or gum bleeding, vomiting blood, black stools, lethargy or restlessness, cold extremities, poor intake, or reduced urination. Early recognition and prompt medical care are essential to prevent dengue shock. Fogging is not the main solution; prevention and early treatment are prioritized in Indonesia.

triage.headline_ja: ASEAN デング熱の日：デング熱に警戒し、危険な兆候を認識し、予防を優先する
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は ASEAN デング熱啓発キャンペーン（毎年 6月15日）の一部であり、インドネシアにおけるデング熱の既知の公衆衛生課題についての教育・啓発活動です。新規の疾病クラスターや異常なイベント、急速な国際拡大、管理上の危機を示す具体的なシグナルは示されていません。
triage.notes: 本記事は ASEAN デング熱の日（毎年 6月15日）の啓発活動で、インドネシアの既知の流行疾患についての予防・治療方法の周知です。新規のアウトブレイク情報や異常な感染増加を示すシグナルではなく、定期的な公衆衛生コミュニケーションと判断されます。

article.articleHeadline: Commissaria Ue, 'a Gaza rischio concreto di epidemia, persa la bussola morale' - Altre news
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: EU Commissioner, 'In Gaza, a real risk of an epidemic, the moral compass is lost' - Other news
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, EU Crisis Management Commissioner Hadja Lahbib warned of a real epidemic risk in the Gaza Strip due to overcrowding and a collapse in sanitation, with 1.7 million people in tent shelters. The risk is concrete and must be addressed, she said, ahead of summer. She urged full, unobstructed humanitarian access to Gaza and the West Bank, noting international humanitarian law obliges Israel to allow aid. In Congo, she highlighted an Ebola outbreak that is worsening, with more than 700 confirmed cases. She rejected a US-backed travel ban, arguing it would slow aid distribution and delay supplies. Instead, Lahbib called for strong political will and a coordinated, science-based approach to the outbreak and to humanitarian relief.

triage.headline_ja: EU委員、『ガザでの流行の具体的リスク、道徳的羅針盤が失われた』—その他のニュース
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱（DRC）とガザの衛生崩壊による流行リスク警告。IHR基準で重篤な公衆衛生影響（serious_impact）と国際的拡大リスク（international_spread）が該当し、国際支援と政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な感染症イベントはDRCのエボラ出血熱（700例以上の確定症例）であり、DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ガザ・西岸はEU委員による一般的な人道的懸念として言及されているが、エボラ発生地ではなく、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外した。米国が発行した渡航禁止令への異議や国際的調整の必要性が強調されており、社会的・政治的関心が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: 衞生防護中心：新冠病毒活躍程度有上升趨勢　流感嚴重個案增加
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Centre for Health Protection: COVID-19 activity on the rise; severe influenza cases increasing.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection reports rising COVID-19 activity, evidenced by higher positivity rates, public hospital admissions, and wastewater signals. Based on historical 6–9 month cycles and waning population immunity, the pandemic may intensify in the near term. Seasonal influenza activity is also increasing: influenza-positive tests and hospitalisations are approaching baseline levels, though severe cases have risen in recent weeks. Since May, there have been three pediatric severe influenza cases; among adults, weekly severe cases rose from an average of 7 in April to 15 in the first week of June. With local flu activity increasing, severe cases are expected to rise further. The Centre urges unvaccinated residents to receive the COVID-19 vaccine and this season's influenza vaccine.

triage.headline_ja: 香港衞生防護中心：新型コロナウイルスの活動が上昇傾向、季節性インフルエンザの重症例が増加
triage.triage_reason: COVID-19とインフルエンザの同時上昇が報告されており、IHR基準の「異常性」「国際的懸念」に該当。香港（中国）での公衆衛生上の重要な動向であり、フルRRA実施の対象となる。
triage.notes: 香港（中国の特別行政区）での報告であるため、China（GeoNames ID: 1814991）として記録。COVID-19とインフルエンザの同時流行傾向、特に小児の重症インフルエンザ例（5月以降3例）と成人重症例の増加（4月平均7例→6月第1週15例）が注目される。歴史的な6～9ヶ月サイクルとワクチン接種率低下による流行intensification予測がされている。

article.articleHeadline: Alertă în Congo: Numărul cazurilor de Ebola atinge un nivel record
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Alert in Congo: The number of Ebola cases has reached a record high.
article.articleSummary: Record Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo: 72 new confirmed cases in 24 hours, total 782. Among confirmed cases, 171 deaths (32 new) and 56 recoveries, for about 23% fatality. The World Health Organization will continue testing, contact tracing, and treatment. True caseload is likely higher, as the outbreak was confirmed on May 15 and contact-tracing coverage is 56%, down from last week. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo, a rare Ebola strain with no vaccine or approved treatment, unlike Zaire. The epicenter is Ituri province in eastern Congo (over 90% of cases), with additional cases in North and South Kivu and spillover into Uganda. Nearly a million people displaced by conflict in Ituri complicating tracing. The DRC Ministry of Health mobilizes technical and lab support, active case finding, and community engagement; Africa CDC head Jean Kaseya calls for urgent resources from partners and donors.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでの警報：エボラ患者数が過去最高水準に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の大規模流行で、記録的症例数、高い死亡率、ウガンダへの越境症例、ワクチン未開発の稀な株による発生であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明らかである。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境症例が報告されているが、ウガンダは評価対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのみを記載。エボラウイルス感染症は国際保健上の重大事象として最高レベルのトリアージが必須。
