article.articleHeadline: Сотни зараженных и десятки смертей: в Африке вспышка Эболы вызвала тревогу на Западе. Ее уже назвали "началом конца"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hundreds infected and dozens dead: an Ebola outbreak in Africa has sparked concern in the West. It has already been dubbed "the beginning of the end".
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, Ebola virus disease outbreaks are reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo and neighboring areas, including Uganda. Western media describe hundreds of cases and dozens of deaths, with the outbreak spanning several provinces. Local health facilities face resource shortages for isolating and treating patients. Early diagnosis is hampered because initial Ebola symptoms resemble other common regional illnesses. Debates are underway about international readiness to respond to such outbreaks and the impact of funding reductions for global health programs. The World Health Organization has urged stronger measures to control epidemic threats and to coordinate international responses to dangerous infections. The article notes that these discussions do not predict an inevitable outcome, but stress the need for coordinated, scaled-up public health action to contain transmission and prevent escalation.

triage.headline_ja: 数百人が感染、数十人が死亡：アフリカのエボラ出血熱流行が西側に懸念を引き起こす。すでに「終わりの始まり」と呼ばれている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模流行、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。複数国での流行報告、高い重症度と死亡率、国際的な関心が極めて高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames ID 226074であり、提供された対象国リスト（895949=Zambia, 1694008=Philippines, 1605651=Thailand, 2300660=Ghana, 203312=DRC, 3469034=Brazil, 1643084=Indonesia, 1814991=China, 1327865=Myanmar, 1562822=Vietnam, 1269750=India）に含まれていないため、verified_locationsからは除外した。DRCのみを記載。複数省にわたる流行、健康施設のリソース不足、WHO声明の存在など、多くのシグナル要件を満たしている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Brazzaville: Santé publique - Plus d'un milliard FCFA pour contrer la propagation d'Ebola dans la zone Cémac
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Republic of the Congo: Public health - More than one billion CFA francs to counter the spread of Ebola in the CEMAC region.
article.articleSummary: Following the 13 June meeting in Kintélé, Brazzaville, the Republic of the Congo, the UEAC Council of Ministers approved a 1,166,910,000 FCFA plan to counter the resurgence of Ebola in the Central African Economic and Monetary Community (CEMAC). Half of funds will come from the Community Development Fund, with the rest borne by member states, to bolster rapid diagnostics and outbreak response amid fears of cross-border spread due to population mobility and geographic proximity. The Council urged mobilization of additional funding from partners and acknowledged Equatorial Guinea President Teodoro Obiang Nguema Mbasogo for a $1 million donation to the Africa CDC to aid Ebola victims. Cameroon will host a high-level tripartite Copil CER-AC meeting as CER-AC rationalization advances toward merging CEEAC and CEMAC, with a summit anticipated in Yaoundé, while urging timely Copil/CER-AC contributions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ共和国：公衆衛生 - CEMAC地域のエボラ感染拡大に対抗するため10億FCFA以上を充当
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の国際的地域的再燃イベント。複数国間での越境感染リスク、政府間での協調対応、追加的国際支援の必要性が明示されており、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月15日配信で、コンゴ共和国（Brazzaville中心）でのエボラ再燃とCEMAC地域全体への拡大懸念を示唆。発生地域にはカメルーン、赤道ギニア、DRCが列挙されているが、記事サマリーの主題はコンゴ共和国での資金確保と地域的対応枠組みであり、確実な感染者報告はDRCのみが対象国に含まれる。カメルーンと赤道ギニアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Regional cooperation and vigilance will control the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports 19 confirmed Ebola cases and one probable case as of 15 June 2026, largely from cross-border transmission with the Democratic Republic of the Congo. The outbreak, due to Bundibugyo virus, has no approved vaccines or specific treatments; early optimized care is lifesaving. Cases are treated at Mulago Hospital’s Ebola Treatment Unit, commissioned within six hours of outbreak declaration, with a 146-member Emergency Medical Team deployed within two hours. Uganda’s surveillance, testing and case management have enabled rapid identification and management. WHO Director-General Tedros visited 8–9 June 2026, praising preparedness and urging sustained regional cooperation, community engagement, and support for frontline workers. Travel bans are discouraged; emphasis remains on entry/exit screening, surveillance and contact tracing. A joint continental response plan by WHO and Africa CDC aims to support DRC, Uganda and neighboring countries to control transmission at the source and regionally. This is Uganda’s ninth Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 地域協力と警戒がエボラ集団発生を抑制する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限検討）。Bundibugyo型エボラの確定・推定患者20名が確認され、コンゴ民主共和国からの越境感染で拡大リスクが高く、高度な警戒と国際支援体制が整備されている。
triage.notes: 記事はウガンダでのエボラ確定・推定患者20名（19確定+1推定）とコンゴ民主共和国との越境感染を具体的に報告。Bundibugyo型であり既承認ワクチン/治療法がない。Mulago病院ETUの迅速な立ち上げ（6時間以内）と緊急医療チーム展開（2時間以内）が報告されており、管理体制は整備されている。WHO事務局長の訪問（6月8-9日）と大陸規模対応計画の立案が示唆される。これはウガンダの9番目のエボラ集団発生。高度な国際関心と対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Britt urges USDA action against virus that could devastate Alabama catfish producers
article.articleSummary: Yellow Catfish Virus threatens Alabama's catfish sector, the second-largest in the United States. U.S. Senator Katie Britt and colleagues urged USDA APHIS to conduct a formal risk assessment of the virus, identified in Chinese aquaculture outbreaks in 2020. The pathogen can cause mortality rates up to 90% in infected catfish and can survive freezing and thawing, creating a potential entry route via imported fish products. Alabama accounts for roughly 33% of U.S. farm-raised catfish, with about 66 farms in the Black Belt and more than 2,400 jobs, contributing around $92 million in economic value. The letter asks APHIS to require exporting countries to prove their products are virus-free before US entry. Support from Catfish Farmers of America and Alabama farm groups is noted; additional signatories include Senators Wicker, Cotton, Hyde-Smith, and Tuberville.

triage.headline_ja: ブリット上院議員、アラバマナマズ生産者に壊滅的な影響を与える可能性のあるウイルスに対するUSDA措置を促進
triage.triage_reason: 本件は動物疾病（養殖ナマズウイルス）に関する農業経済上の懸念であり、公衆衛生上の直接的な影響ではない。対象国での発生報告なし。
triage.notes: 本イベントは動物衛生（aquaculture virus in catfish）に関する米国の農業政策・規制対応であり、人の感染症ではない。China での過去の水産養殖での検出は記載されているが、本記事の主題は米国のナマズ産業保護である。EBS/IHR監視対象外。

article.articleHeadline: একদিনে সর্বোচ্চ সংক্রমণ! কঙ্গোয় আতঙ্কের অপর নাম ইবোলা
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Record daily infections! Ebola: the name of fear in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo worsens, driven by Bundibugyo strain. On Sunday, 72 new infections were reported, bringing total cases to 782 and deaths to 181, including 32 new fatalities. The first detection occurred on 15 May, and the past month has seen rapid escalation. The World Health Organization has intensified testing, contact tracing, and treatment; Africa CDC is reviewing the situation and coordinating response. Jean Kaseya, Africa CDC director, pledged support for affected countries until transmission stops and called for urgent resources. Although transmission remains focused near the Congo- Uganda border, officials warn against complacency. Ituri province reports multiple confirmed and suspected cases and deaths; Kampala, Uganda, also reports separate infections with no clear link established to Congolese cases at this time. The broader risk to neighboring regions and beyond remains a global concern.

triage.headline_ja: 記録的な1日の感染！コンゴでの恐怖の象徴であるエボラ
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の急速な拡大（1日72例の新規感染、死亡者181名）で深刻な公衆衛生影響があり、ウガンダへの国際的拡大リスク、WHO・Africa CDCの強化対応が確認され、IHR基準3項目以上該当。スクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Kampala）での感染も記載されているが、記事サマリーでは「明確なリンクが確立されていない」と述べられており、主な発生地はコンゴとされている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsには含めていない。Bundibugyo株によるエボラ、1日72例の新規感染、死亡181名、Africa CDCが緊急対応中。国境地域での持続的曝露リスクあり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola risk for World Cup is 'extremely low', but US is ready, experts
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk for the 2026 World Cup in the US, Mexico and Canada is low but not zero. US hospitals are prepared to identify, isolate, and treat suspected cases, supported by $260 million in preparedness funding and 13 centers. The tournament runs 39 days with 6.5 million fans and 104 matches, aided by medical committees and surveillance. Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak has infected more than 675 people and killed over 135; officials say Ebola is not airborne and spreads via direct contact with body fluids. Airport screening and entry bans for travelers from affected areas are in place; the DRC team left for Belgium in May to train ahead of travel to the US. Preparedness traces to 2015 collaborations among Emory, UNMC, and NYC Health + Hospitals/Bellevue. Georgetown’s Health Security Operations Center coordinates with 700+ state/local authorities and 60 federal partners; FIFA and the CDC; staffing concerns persist.

triage.headline_ja: 2026ワールドカップのエボラリスク「極めて低い」が、米国は準備万端と専門家が言明
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、DRCでの継続的な流行が存在するが、当該記事は2026年ワールドカップ開催地におけるリスク低減と準備状況に焦点を当てており、現在進行中の急速な国際拡大を示唆していない。情報整理と続報監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、実際のエボラ流行はDRCで継続中（675名以上感染、135名以上死亡）。米国、メキシコ、カナダはワールドカップ開催予定地だが、記事の主題は「リスク低減」と「準備完備」である。DRC以外の対象国リストに該当する国での現在の確定的な感染報告はサマリーに示唆されていない。ベルギーのDRCチーム滞在は準備トレーニング目的であり、発症例の報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Save The Children afirma que 19 niños han muerto por ébola en el este del Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Save the Children says that 19 children have died of Ebola in eastern Congo.
article.articleSummary: June 15, 2026 – Save the Children reports 19 children have died from Ebola and 52 pediatric cases in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo since the outbreak was declared on May 15; 16 of the infected were infants or young children. Africa CDC and the African Union’s public health agency provide the data. Children 14 and under have more than double the mortality risk compared with ages 15–44, reflecting rapid disease progression and the need for early identification, referral, and intensive care. Contributing factors include malnutrition, malaria, anemia, poverty, displacement, and disrupted health, vaccination, and nutrition services. Authorities report 181 Ebola deaths and 782 cases across Ituri, and the eastern provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu, near Uganda and South Sudan. The response must center children and maintain essential health, nutrition, and water services, with accurate child-focused information.

triage.headline_ja: セーブ・ザ・チルドレン：コンゴ東部でエボラにより19人の子どもが死亡したと報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する重大な感染症アウトブレイク（エボラ出血熱）。782確認例、181死亡、小児の高い死亡率を示し、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダ、南スーダン隣接）と社会的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の確認されたアウトブレイク（2026年5月15日宣言）。782例、181死亡（CFR23.1%）、小児症例52例含む。Ituri州、North Kivu州、South Kivu州で発生。ウガンダおよび南スーダンと隣接する地域でのリスク。マラリア、栄養不良などの併発症がある。Bluedot APIではUgandaおよびSudanも列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは「Ituri and the eastern provinces of North Kivu and South Kivu, near Uganda and South Sudan」と述べられており、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。

article.articleHeadline: Photos show how the Ebola outbreak is changing nightlife in Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Bunia, eastern Congo, is reshaping nightlife as of 15 June 2026. A photo gallery by AP editors shows bars enforcing public health measures: face masks around venues, temperature checks at every entry, and social distancing on dance floors, with DJ booths and beer bottles highlighted as part of precautions. Authorities have imposed strict measures to slow transmission in a city known for vibrant youth culture and nightlife. The piece focuses on social life and venue-level responses rather than epidemiological details; it does not provide case counts, laboratory confirmation, or infection-source information, and there is no discussion of imported or exported cases. Published on 2026-06-15, the coverage illustrates how the Ebola outbreak is reshaping daily routines in Bunia by documenting protective behaviors in entertainment venues.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴの夜間経済を変えている様子を写真で紹介
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生は重大な公衆衛生脅威であり異常/予想外であるが、提供されたサマリーには疫学的詳細（患者数、重症度、死亡者数）が全く記載されていないため、フルRRA前に続報による情報充実が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はフォトジャーナリズム形式で、感染症対策の社会的影響に焦点を当てており、疫学的データ（患者数、死亡者数、確認方法、感染経路、ヒト-ヒト感染の詳細）が全く提供されていない。シグナルはコンゴ東部ブニアでのエボラ発生自体による WPRO 基準の該当により WATCH 判定としたが、正式な疫学調査報告書や保健省発表の続報を必要とする。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Les Émirats arabes unis intensifient leur soutien à la RDC dans la lutte contre Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | The United Arab Emirates intensify their support for the Democratic Republic of the Congo in the fight against Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-15, the United Arab Emirates intensifies humanitarian support to the Democratic Republic of Congo to counter Ebola, coordinating with the World Health Organization and other international partners. The cross-border Bundibugyo strain remains a concern for transmission, prompting calls to strengthen international cooperation to limit spread and protect at-risk populations. UAE authorities emphasize rapid, coordinated aid to improve medical management and access to licensed vaccines and essential treatments. Dubai Humanitarian, under Dubai authorities, arranged a major airlift of 20 tonnes of essential medical supplies drawn from WHO prepositioned stocks, transported to the DRC via Al Maktoum International Airport. The cargo includes personal protective equipment, versatile tents, disinfectants, and medical equipment to bolster frontline staff and patient care. Officials estimate the aid could treat hundreds of patients over about four weeks and support around 280 health facilities in affected areas, reflecting enhanced global outbreak logistics.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | アラブ首長国連邦、エボラ対策でコンゴ民主共和国への支援を強化 | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: DRCでエボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）の継続的な伝播が報告されており、国際的な支援と協力が強化されている。IHR基準では3つ以上該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はDRCにおけるエボラ感染症の継続的な流行と、UAE含む国際的な支援の強化である。Bundibugyo株は国境を越えた伝播リスクがあることが強調されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれる。UAEはあくまで支援国であり、エボラの発生地ではないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Six Regional Organisations Sign MoU to Strengthen Asia's Dengue Response as Cases Rise | Taiwan News | Jun. 15, 2026 19:30
article.articleSummary: Six regional organizations signed a Memorandum of Understanding to strengthen dengue prevention and control across Asia amid rising dengue risk driven by climate change and urbanisation. The MoU, signed on June 15, 2026 at the 9th Asia Dengue Summit in Singapore during ASEAN Dengue Day and the first WHO-recognised World Dengue Day, creates a regional framework for knowledge exchange, advocacy, and coordinated action among public health actors, advocacy groups, and community organisations. Signatories are ADVA; the Philippines END Dengue Coalition; Dengue Prevention Advocacy Malaysia (DPAM); Indonesia's Kobar Lawan Dengue; Singapore Dengue Alliance; and the International Society for Neglected Tropical Diseases (ISNTD). ADVA will convene discussions on outbreak insights, education, and policy, including joint publications and digital knowledge-sharing platforms, aiming to move toward Zero Dengue Deaths by 2030. Leaders noted advances in surveillance, vector control, and vaccination, while emphasising sustained, multi-sectoral implementation.

triage.headline_ja: 6つの地域機関がMoUに署名、アジアのデング対策強化へ。ケース数増加に対応
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の地域的な協力枠組み構築に関するニュースであり、予防・制御の強化が主題。ただし、具体的な感染症の重症度、死亡数、国際的拡大のリスク等の詳細情報が記事サマリーに含まれていないため、完全なリスク評価には追加情報が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱の地域的協力体制構築に焦点を当てている。Singapore、Malaysiaは発生地域に含まれるが、対象国リストに存在しないため除外。Philippines、Indonesiaは対象国であり、記事内で言及されているため included。現在の実際の流行状況や患者数に関する詳細情報は記事サマリーに記載されていない。継続的な監視と追加情報の収集が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito da dengue pode adoecer cães e gatos; identifique sinais de alerta
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue-carrying mosquito can make dogs and cats sick; identify warning signs.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-15, the article warns that the dengue-carrying mosquito Aedes aegypti, along with other common mosquitoes, can transmit dirofilariosis cardiopulmonar (heartworm disease) to dogs and cats. Early infection often shows no clear symptoms, making initial diagnosis difficult. As parasites reach the heart and pulmonary vessels, the disease can cause severe heart failure and respiratory distress, drastically reducing quality of life and necessitating complex, costly treatments. The piece emphasizes warning signs for pet owners and highlights vector control and vigilant veterinary care to prevent cases. While noting human dengue risk, the focus remains on pet health, transmission via mosquito bite, and the need for prevention and timely care as vector activity persists.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱蚊は犬猫を病気にする可能性があります。警告サインを特定してください
triage.triage_reason: 記事はペット（犬猫）への媒介生物感染症（フィラリア症）に焦点を当てており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な人間の感染症クラスター、国際的拡大のリスク、または渡航制限が示唆されていません。教育・啓発記事です。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルで発表された教育記事で、ペットの健康リスクに関する啓発が主体です。人間のデング熱については言及されていますが、記事の主眼はペットへのフィラリア症感染リスクです。公開日が2026年6月15日（未来）であることに注意してください。

article.articleHeadline: Six Regional Organisations Sign MoU to Strengthen Asia's Dengue Response as Cases Rise
article.articleSummary: Six regional organisations across Asia, led by the Asia Dengue Voice and Action Group (ADVA), signed a regional Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) at the 9th Asia Dengue Summit in Singapore on June 15, 2026 (ASEAN Dengue Day and the first WHO-recognised World Dengue Day). The MoU establishes a framework for knowledge exchange, advocacy and coordinated dengue action among ADVA, the Philippines END Dengue coalition, Dengue Prevention Advocacy Malaysia (DPAM), Indonesia’s Kobar Lawan Dengue, the Singapore Dengue Alliance, and the International Society for Neglected Tropical Diseases (ISNTD), with ADVA facilitating collaboration. The partnership responds to rising dengue risk and increasing case numbers driven by climate change and urbanisation, enabling shared public education, outbreak insights, regional campaigns, joint publications, policy recommendations and digital knowledge platforms. The summit’s June 15–17 agenda covers surveillance, vector control, vaccine implementation and multi-sectoral approaches toward the goal of zero dengue deaths by 2030.

triage.headline_ja: アジアの6つの地域組織がデング熱対応の強化に向けてMoUに署名、症例数増加に対応
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の症例増加を背景とした地域組織間の協力枠組み構築を報道するもので、公衆衛生上の重要性は認識されるが、具体的な流行規模、死亡数、医療体制への負荷等の詳細情報が不足しているため、現段階では継続的な経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はデング熱対策の国際協力枠組み署名に焦点を当てており、現在の流行状況の詳細（症例数、死亡者数、地域別の重症度等）が記載されていない。WPRO基準の『prolonged_exposure』と『epidemic_prone』は該当するが、具体的なリスク指標が不足。シンガポール・マレーシアは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Un mois après le début de l'épidémie d'Ebola, à Bunia les décès s'enchaînent
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: One month after the Ebola outbreak began, deaths are mounting in Bunia.
article.articleSummary: One month after the May 15 declaration of the seventeenth Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, the epidemic is accelerating in Ituri, which accounts for about 95% of cases per MSF. In Bunia, authorities report a rising death toll and delayed test results, with several deaths occurring before confirmation. The country shows 782 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases, with 29 health zones affected across three provinces. Transmission is widening along borders and transport routes, fueled by cross-border mourning movements from Uganda around Lake Albert. Uganda has closed official border posts, but movements shift to irregular routes; the Lac Albert axis remains a key transmission corridor. By June 10, Congo had activated 17 of 35 planned border checkpoints; Masereka and Vuhovi in North Kivu, near the Rwanda-Burundi frontier, have been affected. WHO classifies certain areas as Priority 1b for preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ流行開始から1ヶ月、ブニアでの死亡者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生への深刻な影響（782確認患者、多数死亡）、異常性（国内での急速な拡大）、国際拡大リスク（ウガンダとの国境越えの感染、ルワンダ・ブルンジ国境への影響）、渡航・貿易制限リスク（国境閉鎖）を示しており、直ちにフルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが検出した発生地域にはオーストラリア（Lake Albert、New South Wales）が誤って含まれているが、記事サマリーはDRC（北キブ州イトゥリ地域、ブニア）での発生を明確に述べており、オーストラリアは実際の感染症イベント発生地ではない。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。記事は2026年6月15日配信だが、イベント発生は2026年5月15日の流行宣言から継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Ngày Sốt xuất huyết thế giới 15/6: Chủ động diệt muỗi, loại bỏ lăng quăng để ngăn dịch bệnh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Dengue Day on June 15: Proactively kill mosquitoes and eliminate mosquito larvae to prevent outbreaks.
article.articleSummary: World Dengue Day (June 15) spotlights proactive mosquito control to prevent outbreaks. Dengue fever, caused by Dengue virus and transmitted by Aedes aegypti (the striped mosquito), infects hundreds of millions annually in tropical and subtropical regions, with estimates of 100–400 million infections worldwide and about 5.6 billion people living in risk areas. The disease has spread beyond tropics into some temperate zones due to climate change and urbanization. Most infections are mild, but severe dengue can cause shock, hemorrhage, organ failure, and death without timely care. There is no specific antiviral treatment; early detection and proper medical care are essential. WHO supports surveillance, diagnostics, treatment, vector control, and global policies. In Vietnam, over 50,000 dengue cases and 5 deaths have been reported this year; the peak season coincides with hot, humid, rainy conditions and abundant stagnant water. Prevention focuses on eliminating mosquito breeding sites, personal protection, and community action.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年6月15日世界デング熱デー：蚊の主動的な駆除と幼虫除去による疾病流行の予防
triage.triage_reason: デング熱の世界的な疾病負荷と公衆衛生への影響は認識されているが、本記事は啓発・予防キャンペーン中心であり、具体的な新規流行事例や異常な発生パターンの報告ではない。ベトナムの2026年の報告事例（50,000件以上、死亡5件）は重要だが、国内対応状況が明確でないため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事は世界デング熱デー（6月15日）の啓発キャンペーン色が強く、ベトナムの2026年の報告（50,000+例、5死亡）は述べられているが、流行の異常性や急速な拡大の兆候は明記されていない。現地の対応能力・外部支援の必要性が不明な点から、WATCH判定とした。続報で流行の急速化や対応困難の報告があれば、PICKUP検討が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola risk low in Ireland, watchdog says, as WHO monitors emergency in DRC and Uganda
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk in Ireland remains low; watchdog notes Ireland is well prepared for an imported case, with heightened readiness after Hantavirus events. The WHO has declared the Congo Basin outbreak a public health emergency of international concern, driven by Bundibugyo virus affecting the DRC and Uganda. As of June 10, 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths reported in DRC; Uganda has 19 confirmed cases, 2 deaths, and 1 probable death with 32 recoveries. Bundibugyo virus disease is severe and often fatal; natural reservoir bats are suspected, with human infection via contact with blood or secretions of infected wildlife, followed by person-to-person transmission through fluids or contaminated surfaces. Incubation 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, and sore throat, progressing to gastrointestinal symptoms, organ dysfunction, and potential haemorrhage. Ireland’s HCID pathways, isolation, infection prevention/control, and transfer protocols remain in place; the National Virus Reference Laboratory can test and has EU/UK partners for expanded capacity. Neighboring countries remain at higher risk, with ongoing international coordination.

triage.headline_ja: アイルランドではエボラのリスク低いと当局、WHOはDRCとウガンダの緊急事態を監視中
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOが国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言したBundibugyo virus outbreak（DRC・ウガンダ）であり、高い重症度と致命率を示すシグナル。フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで明示的にDRCとウガンダでの発生が述べられているが、対象国リストにはDRC（203312）のみ含まれる。ウガンダ（226074）はGeoNames IDが対象リストにないため除外。アイルランドはリスク評価の主題だが発生地ではないため除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの Bundibugyo virus outbreak（エボラ関連）で、676例、136死亡（DRC）、重症度・人-人感染リスク高。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: 181 décès cumulés parmi les cas confirmés - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: 181 cumulative deaths among confirmed cases - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo involve Ituri (epicenter), plus North Kivu and South Kivu in the northeast and east. As of June 13, 2026, 782 confirmed cases and 181 cumulative deaths were reported, yielding a 23.1% case fatality rate; 359 patients are in isolation or hospitalized, with 56 recoveries. The outbreak spans 31 health zones. Key symptoms include fever, vomiting, and diarrhea; suspected cases should promptly seek hospital care. Preventive measures stress regular handwashing with soap, temperature screenings, avoiding contact with patients or corpses. The government, along with financial, social, and health partners, remains engaged in the response. Data are based on epidemiological indicators released by the Ministry of Public Health on June 13, 2026, with the published date of June 15, 2026 serving as the current reference. Keywords: Ebola, outbreak, public health measures, DRC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ：確認症例の累計181死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は重大な公衆衛生上の影響を伴う異常かつ予想外のイベントであり、国際的拡大と渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の大規模流行。782確認症例、181死亡（致命率23.1%）、31保健区域に拡大。Ituri州が震源地で、South KivuおよびNorth Kivu州にも影響。政府と国際パートナーによる対応継続中。フルRRA実施推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : MSF alerte sur une réponse dépassée par la progression de l'épidémie
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF warns that the response is outpaced by the progression of the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) sees MSF warning the outbreak is outpacing the response. More than 650 cases have been officially recorded with over 130 deaths; Ituri province accounts for about 95% of infections. The outbreak, of the Bundibugyo type, spans Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu in the eastern DRC. MSF cites ongoing gaps in screening, epidemiological surveillance, contact tracing, and community engagement, compounded by security challenges that hinder operations. Access to testing remains limited in several areas, with results taking days despite recent laboratory capacity improvements. Delays impede early detection and containment. The WHO reports 695 confirmed cases and 138 deaths across DRC and Uganda (DRC: 676/136; Uganda: 19/2), with risk levels judged very high in the DRC and high in Uganda. Surveillance, contact tracing and patient care continue with international support.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：MSFが流行の進展に対応が追いつかないことに警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な感染拡大、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の確認例および死亡報告、国境を越えた拡大（DRCとウガンダ）、実装ギャップにより高いリスク。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでの症例報告（19確認例、2死亡）に言及しているが、対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）の確認例は695例（DRC 676、ウガンダ19）、死亡は138例（DRC 136、ウガンダ2）。セキュリティ上の課題と検査能力の制限が対応を阻害している。MSFを含む国際支援が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Le bas et le haut : deux leviers pour renforcer l'engagement communautaire dans la riposte contre la 17ème épidémie de la Maladie à virus Ebola (MVE)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bottom-up and top-down: two levers to strengthen community engagement in the response to the 17th Ebola virus disease outbreak (EVD).
article.articleSummary: Two-lever strategy to strengthen community engagement in the 17th Ebola outbreak in Ituri, including Bunia and Rwampara, links bottom-up and top-down actions. Engagement must be dialogue-based, with listening, accountability, and co-creation, not mere leader attendance or messaging. Barriers include cultural, linguistic, and social distance between response teams and communities, which fuels distrust when outsiders speak. A local Risk Communication and Community Engagement (RCCE) team should be established in each zone, comprising an opinion leader, civil society member, religious leader, neighborhood chief, traditional authority representative, plus focal points from the health zone and the Provincial Health Directorate. In conflict and mining contexts, adaptive inclusion of mining-area leaders and armed groups is desirable. Resources must support local actors transparently; Ebola survivors should be deployed as peer educators. Safe and dignified burials (SDB) require respectful, culturally informed handling, with community involvement and, where possible, transparent mortuary bags to help families identify loved ones.

triage.headline_ja: ボトムアップとトップダウン：第17次エボラ出血熱流行対応におけるコミュニティ・エンゲージメント強化の2つの手段
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて重篤な感染症であり、第17次流行という活発な状況下での対応戦略論述。IHR基準では重症度・異常性が明確（Yes/Yes）、DRC及びルワンダでの発生で国際的拡大リスクも該当。WPRO基準でも重症度・流行性・管理課題が複合的に示唆される。
triage.notes: 記事は第17次エボラ出血熱流行（Ituri州Bunia含む）におけるコミュニティ・エンゲージメント戦略を扱っており、DRCが主な発生地域。Kigali Province（ルワンダ）は発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーではイツリ州（DRC）に焦点が当てられている。ただし、ルワンダ隣接地域での発生報告であり、国際的な懸念が示唆される。

article.articleHeadline: Kemenkes: 39.672 kasus DBD terjadi di 2026, 105 angka kematian
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ministry of Health: 39,672 dengue fever cases occurred in 2026, 105 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Indonesia reports 39,672 dengue fever cases and 105 deaths by May 2026, West Java leading with over 9,000 cases and 36 deaths. The country ranks second in dengue burden, accounting for 3% of world cases but 17% of deaths, and is largest dengue burden in Southeast Asia. The Ministry of Health outlined four core strategies in the National Dengue Control Action Plan 2026–2029: strengthen early detection and diagnosis, optimize case management, reinforce prevention, and bolster surveillance and rapid response, supported by governance, resources, financing, partnerships, and data, research, and innovation. Targets include zero dengue deaths by 2030 and a 25% reduction in cases by 2030 versus 2021. Interventions focus on environmental management to curb mosquito breeding, vector control via Wolbachia-infected mosquitoes (Jakarta, Kupang, Semarang, Bandung, Bontang) with impact expected by 2027; prior Yogyakarta trials showed ~70% incidence reduction. Dengue vaccination remains voluntary; 11 of 514 cities/regencies offer it for schoolchildren.

triage.headline_ja: 保健省：2026年にデング熱39,672例が発生、死亡者105人
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおいてデング熱の大規模発生が報告されており、死亡例を含む重症度がある。IHR基準で異常性・深刻性が確認でき、WPROスクリーニング基準では複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: インドネシアはWPRO地域の東南アジアにおけるデング熱の最大流行国であり、世界的なデング熱負荷の17%を占める死亡例を記録している。複数州（ジャカルタ、西ジャワ、ヨグヤカルタ、東ヌサテンガラ）での同時多発流行が確認されており、ウォルバキア蚊によるベクトル制御など新しい対策が導入段階にある。

article.articleHeadline: Lacunas na vigilância e diagnóstico dificultam resposta a epidemia de Ébola na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Gaps in surveillance and diagnosis hinder the response to the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Gaps in surveillance and diagnostic capacity hinder the response to the Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 2026-06-15, health authorities face challenges in timely detection and confirmation of Ebola cases due to limited surveillance systems and diagnostic capabilities across affected regions. The deficiencies impede rapid case identification, reporting, and laboratory confirmation, delaying outbreak response measures and potentially allowing continued transmission. The article underscores the critical need to strengthen surveillance networks, expand access to reliable diagnostics, and improve data flow to support timely public health actions in the DRC. No outbreak metrics, such as case counts or deaths, are provided in the available excerpt; the focus remains on systemic gaps in surveillance and diagnosis that compromise containment efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱流行への対応を妨げる監視診断の問題
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は国際保健規則(IHR)上の通知対象疾患であり、DRCでの流行は深刻な公衆衛生影響を有する。監視・診断体制の不備が報告されており、拡散リスクと国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて重大度が高く、DRCでの流行は国際的に高い関心を集めている。監視・診断体制の脆弱性の指摘は、アウトブレーク対応の大きな課題を示唆している。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo arrives in Houston for 2026 World Cup after 21-day Ebola isolation
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's Leopards arrive in Houston for the 2026 World Cup after a 21-day Ebola isolation in Belgium, avoiding Kinshasa-based pre-tournament plans. The Ebola outbreak forced cancellation of a Kinshasa camp; the team completed a 21-day quarantine and trained in Belgium before traveling. They qualified from CAF Group B as runners-up and beat Jamaica in the intercontinental playoff. Coach Sebastien Desabre's squad is drawn into Group K with Portugal, Colombia, and Uzbekistan; opening match vs Portugal is June 17 at Houston Stadium. Houston will host group-stage training at SaberCats Stadium. The journey highlights Africa's expanding World Cup representation under the 48-team format. Arrival drew Congolese diaspora to the airport, marking a homecoming for a team returning to the World Cup after 52 years.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラウイルス病の21日間隔離後、2026年ワールドカップのためヒューストンに到着
triage.triage_reason: コンゴ民主共和国のワールドカップ出場に関する記事であり、エボラウイルス病の新規発生・流行の報告ではなく、既往の隔離措置と移動に関する情報のみ。疾患に関する公衆衛生的脅威は記事に含まれていない。
triage.notes: 記事はスポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）に関する報道であり、エボラウイルス病の現在の流行や新規感染症イベントを報告していない。過去の隔離措置の完了とチーム移動に関する情報のみで、感染症リスク評価の対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reports a record daily increase in Ebola cases a month after outbreak was declared
article.articleSummary: Congo reports record daily Ebola increase amid Ituri outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus; 72 new confirmed cases raise total to 782; 181 deaths (29 new). 40 recovered; CFR 23%. The outbreak was confirmed May 15; numbers reflect heightened surveillance with community reporting. Ituri province accounts for >90% of cases; North Kivu and South Kivu also affected; cross-border spread to Uganda. Contact tracing coverage 56% (down from prior week). WHO intensifying testing, contact tracing, treatment; supplies arriving; Africa CDC deploying expertise to accelerate response. Nearly 1 million people displaced in Ituri; tracing difficult due to mobility, forested terrain, and miners moving among sites.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラアウトブレイク宣言から1ヶ月後に記録的な1日新規患者増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認されたアウトブレイクで、IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、国際的な広がり（ウガンダへの越境感染）、高い致死率（CFR 23%）、急速な患者増加（1日72例）など重大なシグナル特性を示している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーによると、エボラアウトブレイクはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイトゥリ州で発生しており、ウガンダへの越境感染も報告されている。しかしウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。確認患者782例、死者181例（致死率23%）、接触者追跡カバー率56%と低い。大規模な人口移動（約100万人が避難）と地形上の困難により管理が困難。

article.articleHeadline: MSF s'inquiète de "dangereuses lacunes" dans la réponse à Ebola en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF expresses concern over "dangerous gaps" in the Ebola response in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to outpace the response, with Ituri province accounting for about 95% of cases and North Kivu reporting testing delays due to a single laboratory. As of 2026-06-15, about one month after the May 15 outbreak declaration and two days after the WHO triggered an international alert, the tally stands at 782 cases and 181 deaths (case fatality rate ~23%). The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment. MSF warns of dangerous gaps in diagnosis, surveillance, contact tracing, and community engagement that hinder control efforts. Contact tracing has improved to just over 70% of contacts traced, up from 45% in early June. In Ituri, fear and mistrust toward response teams are noted; MSF is deploying teams to remote, unstable areas to strengthen detection and response, including within the Rwampara Ebola Treatment Center in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: MSFがコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ対応における「危険な脆弱性」を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。エボラウイルス病アウトブレイク（782例、死亡181例、致死率23%）で重篤な公衆衛生影響、Bundibugyo株で治療法がない異常事象、国際的拡大リスク（ルワンダとの国境での活動、WHO国際アラート発令済み）、渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）、2026-06-15時点で782例181死亡（CFR 23%）。アウトブレイク宣言は2026-05-15、WHO国際アラート発令済み。Ituri州が全体の95%を占める。ワクチン・承認治療なし。ルワンダも発生地域に含まれるが、記事の主題はDRCのみであり、ルワンダは対象国リストに未含のため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Exame descarta Ebola em caso investigado no Rio Grande do Sul
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Test rules out Ebola in a case under investigation in Rio Grande do Sul.
article.articleSummary: Ebola test negative for a 64-year-old man under investigation in Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil. The Fiocruz result was communicated to the State Center for Health Surveillance (CEVS) on the night of Saturday, June 13. The investigation began Thursday, June 11, after the patient, with a recent stay in Uganda, was treated in Novo Hamburgo and later transferred to Porto Alegre. A rapid malaria test was positive for Plasmodium falciparum, and malaria treatment was started. On Friday, June 12, the patient was transferred to Grupo Hospital Conceição in Porto Alegre. On Saturday, June 13, samples for Ebola detection were collected and sent to Fiocruz, with the operation involving CEVS and the Ministry of Health; the samples were transported by the Brazilian Air Force (FAB) to Galeão airport in Rio de Janeiro. Surveillance remains ongoing.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデドスルで調査されていた事例のエボラが検査で除外
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染は検査で陰性が確定し、実患者は単なる熱帯熱マラリア（Plasmodium falciparum）であると判明。公衆衛生上の緊急リスクは解消され、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: ウガンダ滞在歴のある患者がエボラ疑似症状で報告されたが、Fiocruzの検査でエボラは陰性と確認された。患者は熱帯熱マラリアで治療中。これはシグナルではなく、既に除外されたルールアウト事例である。

article.articleHeadline: Every American Flight from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan Is Now Rerouted to Four Specific Airports for Ebola Screening -- Here Is What That Means for Travelers
article.articleSummary: Owing to the Bundibugyo virus disease outbreak spreading from the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, Nord-Kivu, Sud-Kivu) to Uganda (Kampala) and proximity to South Sudan, the United States reroutes all international arrivals from DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan to four airports for enhanced Ebola screening: Washington Dulles (IAD), Atlanta (ATL), Houston (IAH), and New York JFK. Confirmed June 14–15, 2026, this public health action, coordinated by CBP, DHS, and CDC, uses a multi-step screening: travel/exposure/symptom questionnaire and fever check; negative-screen travelers proceed with 21 days of self-monitoring (twice-daily temperatures) and instructions to report symptoms. Positive or high-risk exposures trigger medical evaluation and isolation pending lab testing. Canada implements parallel measures May 30–Aug 29, 2026. The 2–21 day incubation means airport screening misses some cases, hence the self-monitoring layer; outbreak projections warned >20,000 cases in 3 months (65% probability).

triage.headline_ja: DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダンからのすべてのアメリカ便が4つの特定空港にルート変更され、エボラ出血熱スクリーニングが実施 — 旅行者にとって何を意味するか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の国際的流行（DRC→ウガンダ→南スーダン）で重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、米国・カナダによる国境検疫と旅行制限が実施されている。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年の仮想シナリオと見られるが、エボラ出血熱の国際的流行と複数国間の公式な検疫措置、渡航制限が記述されている。DRCが主要発生地。ウガンダとスーダンも言及されているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。Bundibugyo病（ウイルス種）はエボラ属に分類される高リスク病原体。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths rise in DR Congo -- RT Africa
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DR Congo) has 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths (as of 15 June 2026), with 72 new cases and 29 additional deaths in the latest update, CFR 23.1%; 40 recoveries since May 15 when the outbreak was declared. Confirmed cases span 31 health zones across Ituri (20), North Kivu (10), and South Kivu (1), with two zones newly affected as of June 13. WHO notes no approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo Ebola, though candidates are under testing. Response faces insecurity, humanitarian crisis, and high population/trade movements. The government received 16.5 tons of WHO-supplied medical and logistical aid. Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu have long been destabilized by armed conflict; nearly 1 million displaced in Ituri. This is DR Congo’s 17th Ebola outbreak. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, headache, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, kidney/liver problems, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ出血熱の死亡者数が増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つすべてに該当。確認症例782件、死亡181件（CFR 23.1%）の進行中のエボラアウトブレイクであり、複数の州に拡大、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響とワクチン・治療法の不在が確認されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreakは確認症例782件、死亡181件、CFR 23.1%。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kuvuの3州31の保健地域に拡大。武装紛争による不安定性、人道的危機、高い人口・貿易移動がリスク要因。WHO医療・物流支援提供（16.5トン）。承認済みワクチン・特異的治療なし。DRCの17番目のエボラアウトブレイク。

article.articleHeadline: Brazil suspends new dengue vaccine after two suspicious deaths
article.articleSummary: Brazil suspended on June 8, 2026, the world’s first single-dose dengue vaccine after two suspicious deaths. The vaccine, developed publicly in Brazil and approved in November 2025, had vaccinated more than 501,000 people in 2026. Of 501,044 recipients January–May, 3,703 (0.7%) showed dengue-like symptoms (fever, headaches, muscle pain, nausea, rashes); 42 had severe reactions, including two deaths (58-year-old man and 48-year-old woman) and a 38-year-old woman in intensive care who was discharged. Health Minister Padilha said there is not yet enough data to prove a cause, but the signal warranted a temporary halt. Trials across 14 states with over 16,000 volunteers yielded 91.6% efficacy against the most severe dengue. TAK-003 remains a two-dose alternative. Background: Brazil had over 6,000 dengue deaths in 2024 (about half worldwide), with improvements in 2025.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル、2件の疑わしい死亡後に新しいデング熱ワクチンを中止
triage.triage_reason: デング熱ワクチンの安全性シグナル（死亡2件を含む有害事象）により大規模な公衆衛生介入が実施されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な事象）に該当。50万人以上が接種済みで国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: デング熱ワクチンの安全性懸念事象。501,044人の接種者のうち3,703人（0.7%）がデング様症状を呈し、重篤反応42件（死亡2件）が報告された。ブラジル保健相は因果関係を証明するデータが不足していると述べているが、安全性シグナルを理由に一時的な中止を実施。世界初のシングルドーズワクチンであり国際的な注目度も高い。

article.articleHeadline: Rare Tsetse Fly-Borne Disease Found in Safari Travelers Returning from Zambia and Zimbabwe, Highlighting a Diagnostic Blind Spot in the U.S.
article.articleSummary: East African Human African Trypanosomiasis (HAT), caused by Trypanosoma brucei rhodesiense and transmitted by tsetse flies, has re-emerged in the Zambezi Valley of northern Zimbabwe and southern Zambia, with a 2024 cluster signaling renewed transmission and the first U.S. case from that area since 2019. Safari travelers returning from Zambia or Zimbabwe have developed fever, fatigue, headache, and skin rash; early symptoms mimic malaria and other tropical illnesses, delaying diagnosis. Diagnosis hinges on peripheral blood smear to detect trypanosomes during the early bloodstream phase, often requiring experienced microscopy and repeat sampling at peak parasitemia. In the United States, clinicians should exclude sleeping sickness in febrile travelers from East Africa and can contact the CDC Emergency Operations Center at (770) 488-7100 for testing and guidance. Treatment is suramin for early-stage disease and nifurtimox-eflornithine combination therapy (NECT) for neurologically involved late-stage disease, both accessible through the CDC, underscoring the need for rapid recognition and treatment.

triage.headline_ja: ツェツェバエ媒介の稀少疾患、ザンビア・ジンバブエからのサファリ旅行者で発見 - 米国での診断の盲点を浮き彫りに
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ睡眠病（ザンビア・ジンバブエで再出現）が米国旅行者で確認され、国際的拡大リスク（既に米国で症例あり）と診断困難性による公衆衛生影響が認められるため、IHR基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: 記事はザンビア・ジンバブエでのアフリカ睡眠病再出現を主題としており、米国での症例確認も含む。国際的移動による感染拡大リスクが高く、診断困難性が公衆衛生上の課題。ただしジンバブエは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations はザンビアのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Special TB-HIV Detection Camp Organised at Mauli Jagran Dispensary
article.articleSummary: Special TB-HIV Collaborative Detection Camp held at Mauli Jagran Dispensary, UT Chandigarh, on 2026-06-15. Organized by the State TB Unit and Health Department, the camp was inaugurated by MP Manish Tewari. The event underscored early detection and timely treatment for tuberculosis (TB) and HIV, with free TB and HIV screening, counselling, and information on prevention, diagnosis, and treatment under the National AIDS & STI Control Programme and the National TB Elimination Programme. Project activities highlighted the Break Free App, an HIV self-assessment tool from NACO, to enable confidential risk assessment and facilitate linkage to care. Health officials stated early diagnosis improves outcomes, and the camp aimed to raise awareness, promote voluntary testing, and ensure timely referral. A large turnout from Mauli Jagran and nearby areas availed screening and counselling.

triage.headline_ja: マウリ・ジャグラン・ディスペンサリーで特別TB-HIV検査キャンプを開催
triage.triage_reason: TB-HIVの検査・啓発キャンプは公衆衛生上の定期的な予防活動であり、異常な疾病発生や緊急事態を示す情報ではない。IHR基準、WPROスクリーニング基準ともに該当なし。
triage.notes: 本イベントは、インドのチャンディガル地域で政府によって組織された、TB/HIV検査と啓発のためのキャンプである。これは感染症の発生・まん延を示すシグナルではなく、公衆衛生スクリーニング活動の報道であるため、トリアージ対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC: un mois après l'annonce d'une 17e épidémie, la gestion toujours complexe des cas contacts
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: a month after the announcement of a 17th outbreak, the management of contact tracing remains complex.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is now one month into the 17th outbreak, with the epicenter in Ituri province in the east, between Bunia and Mongwalu. The response began on May 15, but on the ground the disease continues to spread. Officials say there is no epidemiological map yet, hindering projections of spread, and the curve of laboratory-confirmed cases continues to rise without a plateau. MSF notes that despite added personnel, funding, and the deployment of standalone Ebola treatment centers, challenges persist: community mistrust, and difficulties in detecting, tracing, and isolating contacts. Contact-tracking follow-up stands at about 51%, well below the >90% target and down from around 60% the previous week. Two new health zones were declared affected in the last 24 hours; transmission is by close contact and body fluids. Ebola has killed over 15,000 people in Africa in the last five decades.

triage.headline_ja: RDCのエボラ：第17次流行宣言から1ヶ月、接触者管理は依然として複雑
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行であり、IHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、接触者追跡率が目標を大きく下回るなどWPRO基準複数項目（重症度、管理可能性）に該当するため。
triage.notes: 第17次エボラ流行で、Ituri州（Bunia、Mongwalu地域）が震源地。発症から1ヶ月で接触者追跡率が51%に留まり、目標90%を大きく下回る。検査確認例の曲線が増加傾向を続けており、地域不信や検出・隔離困難などにより対応が複雑化。MSFを含む国際支援が展開されている。

article.articleHeadline: Israel sparks diplomatic row with broad ebola travel ban on 5 African nations
article.articleSummary: Israel imposed a travel restriction on foreign nationals and residents from five African nations—DRC, South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, and Uganda—effective June 10, 2026, barring boarding for anyone who has stayed in any of these countries within the prior 21 days (three weeks). Israeli citizens and permanent residents are exempt. Airlines must interrogate passengers and verify recent travel histories before departure. The move comes amid renewed concern over Ebola outbreaks in East and Central Africa. Kenya protests its inclusion, noting no Ebola cases despite extensive testing (over 80,000 tests) and its role in regional surveillance. The measure highlights tensions between public health safeguards and international mobility, with potential implications for Israel-Kenya relations and broader travel and trade if maintained.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルがアフリカ5カ国に対する広範なエボラ渡航禁止令で外交問題を引き起こす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限）。エボラウイルス病は重篤な感染症であり、複数国における発生と国際的な渡航制限措置が講じられている。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の発生地はDRC（対象国）を含む。記事ではスーダン、モザンビーク、ルワンダ、ケニア、ウガンダが言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。イスラエルの渡航禁止措置は公式な感染症発生対応であり、外交関係への影響も言及されている。情報源の信頼性は高い（Business Insider Africa）。

article.articleHeadline: Afreximbank cancels annual meeting on Ebola concerns
article.articleSummary: June 15, 2026: Ebola outbreaks in Central Africa prompt travel and event caution. The Democratic Republic of Congo reports 782 Ebola cases after the outbreak was declared a month ago, with Uganda also reporting cases. Afreximbank cancels its annual meeting planned for next week in El Alamein, Egypt, and will conduct shareholder business via correspondence; Egypt has postponed other international events this month for public health reasons in coordination with the African Union. Afreximbank is Cairo-based and owned by African governments, regional financial institutions and private shareholders. As context, the African Development Bank held its annual meeting in Brazzaville, Republic of Congo, last month, soon after the outbreak was declared by its neighbour, the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: Afreximbank、エボラ懸念で年次総会を中止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の多国にわたる流行で、国際的な経済・外交活動への影響が顕著。
triage.notes: 記事は中央アフリカ地域でのエボラ流行を報じており、DRCで782症例が報告されている。エジプト・ウガンダ等が言及されているが、確認されたイベント発生地は対象国リストではDRCのみ。国際的な経済活動への影響（銀行年次総会中止）が社会政治的関心を示唆。

article.articleHeadline: إلغاء الاجتماع السنوي للبنك الأفريقي للتصدير بسبب مخاوف "إيبولا"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Cancellation of the African Export-Import Bank's annual meeting due to Ebola concerns.
article.articleSummary: Cancellation of the African Export-Import Bank's annual meeting in El Alamein, Egypt, next week due to joint health-safety actions by Cairo and the African Union amid rising Ebola cases in Central Africa. The Democratic Republic of Congo reports 782 Ebola infections since the outbreak was declared about a month ago, triggering travel concerns for meetings and events; Uganda has also reported cases. AFREXIMBANK, headquartered in Cairo, will conduct shareholder business by correspondence for now, while the Egyptian government postponed other international events this month. For context, the African Development Bank held its annual meeting in Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo last month shortly after the DRC outbreak was announced. The situation underscores ongoing Ebola activity in Central Africa and related travel and event restrictions as of 2026-06-15.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱への懸念によるアフリカ輸出入銀行年次総会の中止
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の国際的流行、渡航制限）。DRC・ウガンダでエボラウイルス確認、782感染例報告、国際的イベント中止へ至る影響があり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはCairo（エジプト）、Brazzaville（コンゴ共和国）などが含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題は中央アフリカ（DRC・ウガンダ）でのエボラ感染事案である。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。エジプト・コンゴ共和国でのイベント中止は二次的影響。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola Alarmı Büyüyor: Vaka Sayısı 782'ye Yükseldi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Alarm Grows in the Congo: Case Count Rises to 782
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has confirmed 782 cases and 181 deaths as of 15 June 2026, with 72 new cases reported in the last 24 hours. The virus has spread to Ituri and North Kivu provinces, indicating expansion beyond existing centers. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, for which there is no approved vaccine or targeted therapy, complicating response efforts. Authorities emphasize rapid case finding, isolation, and contact tracing, but only about 56% of contacts are being reached, limiting containment. Ongoing security conflicts and mass displacement hinder health teams and surveillance. The World Health Organization and other aid partners are coordinating with the government to prevent regional escalation, with close monitoring of neighboring countries for cross-border transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ警報が拡大：感染者数が782人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。また、WPRO基準も複数該当し、社会的関心も高い。フルRRA進行を推奨。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（認可されたワクチンなし）による大規模アウトブレイク。連絡可能な接触者が56%に限定され、封じ込めが困難。治安問題と人口流出により対応が阻害されている。WHO及び国際パートナーによる支援が進行中。国境を越えた感染リスク監視中。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго 782 случая Эболы: вспышка затронула новые зоны здравоохранения
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, 782 Ebola cases: the outbreak has reached new health zones.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ebola outbreak has reached 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, with 72 new cases reported in the last 24 hours—the steepest daily rise yet. The rare Bundibugyo strain, for which there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment, has been confirmed in two new health zones: Nia-Nia in Ituri and Mabalako in North Kivu, expanding the geographic spread. The outbreak began on 15 May in Ituri, with subsequent cases in North and South Kivu. Current reach includes 20 of 36 zones in Ituri, 10 of 34 zones in North Kivu, and one zone in South Kivu affected. International commentary frames the outbreak as a potential rehearsal for a future pandemic amid shrinking global health funding and eroding trust in science, with WHO declaring a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで782件のエボラ患者：発生は新たな保健地域に拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常で予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済み。ワクチンがない希少株の急速な地理的拡大。
triage.notes: WHO PHEIC宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。希少なBundibugyo株で、ライセンス取得済みワクチンなし。72時間で782確定症例・181死亡。24時間での新規症例数が過去最高。地理的拡大は3州20+地域に及ぶ。国際的な懸念が高い。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Viúva processa fabricante de queijo após morte do marido por listeriose e pede indenização milionária
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Widow sues cheese manufacturer after her husband's death from listeriosis and seeks multimillion-dollar damages.
article.articleSummary: In the United Kingdom, a 59-year-old artist died after consuming an artisanal cheese contaminated with Listeria monocytogenes; his widow has filed a multimillion-pound civil lawsuit against the cheese manufacturer, seeking about 1.3 million reais. The case highlights listeriosis, a relatively rare but potentially fatal infection, especially for older adults, pregnant individuals, newborns, and immunocompromised people. Early symptoms include fever, muscle pains, nausea, and gastrointestinal issues; severe disease can cause meningitis and septicemia. Listeria monocytogenes can survive and multiply even at refrigeration temperatures, complicating containment along the food chain. International context includes France recalling multiple cheeses after an outbreak that killed two and sickened dozens; Switzerland investigating a cheese producer amid dozens of infections and multiple deaths; Brazil suspending artisanal cheese lots in 2025 due to Listeria detection. The outcome could influence future accountability for contaminated foods.

triage.headline_ja: チーズメーカーを提訴した未亡人 - リステリア症で夫が死亡し、数百万ドルの損害賠償を請求
triage.triage_reason: リステリア菌による複数国での食品汚染事案で、死亡者を含む重症例が報告されており、IHR基準（異常性・国際的拡大リスク・重症度）を満たす。食品安全性に関する重大な公衆衛生影響が確認できる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは英国、フランス、スイスのリステリア事案について言及していますが、対象国リストに含まれるのはブラジルのみ。ブラジルは2025年にリステリア検出により職人チーズ製品を一時停止した事例が報告されています。本事案は国際的な食品汚染問題であり、複数国での死亡例と食品流通の中断が確認されており、WPROスクリーニング基準を全て満たす重要なシグナルです。

article.articleHeadline: MSF își exprimă îngrijorarea față de 'lacunele periculoase' din reacția împotriva epidemiei de Ebola în RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF expresses its concern about the 'dangerous gaps' in the response to the Ebola outbreak in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than the on-the-ground response. As of now, the WHO reports 782 Ebola cases and 181 deaths. The outbreak began with Bundibugyo strain; there is no vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. Ituri province accounts for about 95% of cases; Nord-Kivu has only one laboratory capable of analyzing blood samples, with turnaround times of several days, undermining containment. Diagnostic and contact-tracing gaps persist, though testing capacity has increased with mobile labs. Community engagement and trust remain weak in affected areas. The MSF says the real scope may be underreported. Vaccination campaigns have not yet been deployed for this strain. The outbreak was declared May 15; WHO IHR alert on May 17. MSF plans to deploy teams to the most isolated and unstable zones to boost detection and response.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行対応における『危険な隙間』に懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は既知の高致死性病原体で、国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響が明確である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo strain）の流行。2026年5月15日に宣言、5月17日にWHO IHRアラート発出済み。782例の患者、181例の死亡を報告。Norte-Kivu州とIturi州で発生。診断・接触追跡の隙間が存在し、ワクチン展開がまだ実施されていない。MSFは実数がさらに多い可能性を指摘。既にRRA段階が進行中と考えられるが、現在の状況の更新として重要。

diseases.name: Low Pathogenic Avian Influenza A H9N2
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2

article.articleHeadline: 香港兩歲男童染H9N2禽流感　當局已通報世衞組織 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two-year-old boy in Hong Kong contracted H9N2 avian influenza; authorities have notified the WHO | Telecom
article.articleSummary: A two-year-old boy in Hong Kong is infected with low-pathogenic avian influenza A(H9N2); whole-genome sequencing confirmed H9N2 and the case has been reported to the World Health Organization. The patient had no travel during the incubation period, indicating local infection likely linked to exposure at Sha Tin’s Wo Che Market, where he visited twice and may have encountered poultry-contaminated environments. The Centre for Health Protection reported no symptomatic illness among 13 tracked close contacts and hospital patients; all nasal/oropharyngeal samples were negative. Environmental sampling at the boy’s home, the market, and a fresh-food shop yielded 17 samples, with 15 negative and 2 awaiting results. Two market workers are asymptomatic and under medical surveillance; their tests are negative. CHP notes that negative environmental results do not rule out market exposure. Globally, over 160 human H9 infections have been reported in the past decade, with most cases mild and no sustained human-to-human transmission; no mutations detected.

triage.headline_ja: 香港の2歳男児がH9N2鳥インフルエンザに感染、当局がWHOに通報
triage.triage_reason: 人獣共通感染症（H9N2鳥インフルエンザ）の人への感染が確認され、IHR基準（異常性、国際的関心）を満たす。ヒト感染例の報告は国際的スクリーニング対象であり、WHOへの報告も既になされている。
triage.notes: 香港（中国特別行政区）における人での H9N2 鳥インフルエンザ感染事例。地域検証では、発生地域に香港と中国が列挙されており、サマリーでも香港での感染が主題である。香港は中国に含めるため verified_locations に China のみを記載。症例は軽症で、現在までにヒト-ヒト感染は認められていないが、市場での曝露リスクが継続している可能性がある点に注意。過去10年間の全球的 H9 感染報告数は160例以上で、ウイルスの持続的な人への脅威が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in Congo jump by 72 in a day as tracing falters
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Congo driven by Bundibugyo virus shows 72 new confirmed cases in 24 hours, raising the total to 782 infections and 181 deaths (32 new deaths). The fatality rate stands at 23%. The outbreak, declared May 15, remains concentrated in Ituri province (over 90% of cases) with spillovers into North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border transmission into Uganda. Authorities warn the true caseload may be higher because confirmation lags suspected onset. Contact tracing coverage has fallen to 56% amid insecurity, displacement (nearly a million people affected in Ituri), and difficult terrain. Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or treatment. WHO is intensifying testing, tracing, and treatment; Africa CDC and partners are deploying technical expertise, strengthening labs, active case finding, and community engagement. The response faces funding gaps and ongoing challenges in ground conditions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者が1日で72人増加、接触者追跡が機能不全に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。ブンディブギョウイロウイルス型エボラの急速な感染拡大、高い致死率、国際的越境感染、管理能力の限界が明確であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは『ウガンダへの越境感染』として言及されており、主要な発生地はDRCのIturi州である。したがってDRCのみをverified_locationsに含める。1日72人の新規確認症例、23%の致死率、接触者追跡カバー率56%への低下、ワクチン・治療法の不在、100万人近くの国内避難民が存在する極めて深刻な状況。

article.articleHeadline: NGO warns Ebola epidemic is 'outpacing' response efforts in DRC
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo strain Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri with spread to North and South Kivu and neighboring Uganda. As of 2026-06-15, 782 cases and 181 deaths confirmed in DRC; 19 cases and two deaths detected in Uganda. First reported about a month ago; outbreak described as outpacing the response, with Bunia cemetery overwhelmed. MSF notes treatment centers are overwhelmed, patients arriving late, and contact tracing often incomplete. Testing remains a critical weakness: only one lab in North Kivu able to test; slow lab results delay detection. No approved vaccines or treatments exist for Bundibugyo strain. Transmission via close contact and bodily fluids causes hemorrhagic fever; insecurity and funding gaps hinder efforts, and cross-border import/export in Uganda underscores risk.

triage.headline_ja: NGOが警告：DRCでエボラ感染症対応の取り組みを『上回ピース』でアウトペースしているエボラ流行
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全てに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全てに該当。エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の確定症例782件、死亡181件（DRC）および国際的クラスター（ウガンダ）、医療対応システムの過負荷、および国境を越えた拡大リスクが明示されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラはまれな株であり、治療法やワクチンが存在しない。DRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州で確認され、ウガンダへの越境伝播も記録されている。検査能力の制約（North Kivuに1施設のみ）、医療インフラの過負荷、不完全な接触追跡、セキュリティ・資金難が対応を阻害している。記事はウガンダでの症例・死亡も報告しているが、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした理由は、主要な流行地がDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため。

article.articleHeadline: Hari Dengue Sedunia, saat Ini Masih Ada 5,6 Miliar Penduduk yang Berisiko terhadap Dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Dengue Day: There are still 5.6 billion people at risk of dengue.
article.articleSummary: Dengue remains a global threat on World Dengue Day: about 5.6 billion people are at risk worldwide, across 130 countries; an estimated 100–400 million infections occur yearly. In Indonesia, as of 14 April 2026, 30,465 dengue cases were reported, including 10,138 dengue fever (DF), 19,877 dengue hemorrhagic fever (DHF), and 450 dengue shock syndrome (DSS), with 79 deaths (case fatality rate 0.3%) and an incidence rate of 10.6 per 100,000. The outbreak spans 401 districts/cities in 29 provinces, with fatalities reported from 58 districts across 20 provinces. Prevention centers on vector control, aligning with WHO’s Global Vector Control Response (2017–2030) and the Global Arbovirus Initiative. Clinical management stresses early detection and timely access to medical care to reduce severe disease and mortality. This summary references World Dengue Day remarks by Prof. Tjandra Yoga Aditama of YARSI University.

triage.headline_ja: 世界デング熱の日：現在、56億人がデング熱のリスクにさらされている
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアで30,465例のデング熱症例（DHF/DSSを含む）と79例の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性）を2つ以上満たす。WPRO基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行性）も複数該当。
triage.notes: インドネシアで複数省29州401地区にまたがる広範囲のデング熱流行が確認されている。DHF（デング出血熱）とDSS（デングショック症候群）を含む重症例が報告されており、死亡率0.3%（79/30,465例）、10万人当たり10.6の罹患率を示している。World Dengue Dayの公式発表に基づく公式統計であり、政府・公衆衛生当局の関心が高い。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Ľudská miešačka: Aké infekčné choroby sa môžu šíriť medzi divákmi MS vo futbale?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Human blender: What infectious diseases can spread among spectators at the FIFA World Cup?
article.articleSummary: FIFA World Cup 2026 across 16 U.S. cities plus Canada and Mexico creates dense crowds and travel hubs, elevating infectious-disease risk. Ebola (Bundibugyo lineage) outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompt WHO actions; transmission requires direct contact with bodily fluids, with no vaccines or rapid tests available. US, Mexican, and Canadian travel restrictions and European screening calls are in place. Respiratory infections pose greater short-term danger: measles, influenza, and COVID-19. By June 4, 2026, US CDC records 2,030 measles cases in 2026, with a 30-year high influenza season and COVID-19 hospitalizations of roughly 290,000–450,000 annually. Avian influenza H5N1 has caused about 70 human infections in the US since 2024, with no sustained human-to-human spread. Mosquito-borne threats include dengue (≈3,800 US cases in 2024; LA local cases), yellow fever risk for travelers, and Oropouche (Zika-like) with >8,000 Brazilian cases in 2024; no vaccines or antivirals.

triage.headline_ja: 人間混合器：FIFAワールドカップの観客の間で感染する可能性のある感染症とは？
triage.triage_reason: 複数の懸念される感染症（麻疹、インフルエンザ、COVID-19、鳥インフルエンザH5N1、エボラ）が複合的に存在し、国際的な大規模イベント開催による拡散リスク、国際渡航・入国制限の実施、複数国（米国、カナダ、メキシコ、DRC、ウガンダ）での感染報告があり、IHR基準2つ以上該当またはWPRO基準複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年FIFAワールドカップ開催時点での感染症リスク評価。複数の懸念感染症が並列して記述されており、エボラ（DRC・ウガンダ）、麻疹（米国で2,030例）、インフルエンザ、COVID-19、鳥インフルエンザH5N1（米国で約70例）、蚊媒介疾患（デング、オロポーシ）が該当。国際イベントによる密集・国際旅行のリスク、複数国での実際の感染報告、入国制限措置の実施がある。対象国リストにはDRCとBrazilが該当。米国・カナダ・メキシコでのイベント開催だが、これらは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Pune: PMC, State Health Department Intensify Monsoon Disease Prevention and Mosquito Control Measures
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, Maharashtra Health Department and Pune Municipal Corporation (PMC) intensify monsoon disease prevention across Pune and the state to curb dengue, malaria, chikungunya, gastroenteritis and typhoid. Measures include enhanced disease surveillance, sanitation drives, and chlorination of drinking water sources; targeted mosquito-control with removal of stagnant water, larviciding, insecticide spraying, and biological control using guppy fish. Inspections will cover old-age homes, hostels, and schools; entomological surveys aim to identify breeding sites before outbreaks. Hospitals stock essential medicines; rapid-response teams ready. PMC leads a citywide campaign with ASHA workers conducting door-to-door fever monitoring, early-symptom identification, and referrals. Interdepartmental coordination (health, waste, drainage, building control, anti-encroachment) supports integrated prevention, along with public-awareness programs on nets, repellents, screens, and hygiene to reduce transmission during monsoon rains.

triage.headline_ja: プネー：PMC・州保健部門、モンスーン時期の疾病予防と蚊対策の強化
triage.triage_reason: インドのプネー地域において複数の蚊媒介疾患（デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア、腸チフス）の予防対策が強化されていることは異常/予想外と言える。ただし記事は積極的な予防措置の発表であり、現在の流行状況や重症度、患者数が明記されていない。情報不足のため、継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はプネー市およびマハーラシュトラ州における複数の蚊媒介疾患に対する予防・対策の強化に関する当局の発表である。実際の患者数、死亡数、重症度については明記されていない。モンスーン時期における感染症予防は地域として予想可能な季節的対応であるが、複数疾患の同時対策強化は注視に値する。

article.articleHeadline: Beni: la jeunesse en première ligne pour sensibiliser contre la maladie d'Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beni: Youth on the front line to raise awareness about Ebola virus disease - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease is present in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo. On Sunday, members of Bungulu commune's youth council launched a door-to-door awareness campaign on Ebola prevention, aiming to curb transmission already in Beni. Shukrani Munganga, president of Bungulu's youth council, said the effort engages youths from all segments to educate the community and map strategies to block spread, noting Bungulu was among the epicenters of the 2018 Ebola outbreak that caused numerous deaths due to ignorance. The campaign coincides with World Blood Donor Day, with volunteers giving blood to assist civilians and military personnel in an area affected by a resurgence of ADF-MTM militants. The report does not provide current case counts, symptoms, or laboratory confirmation details.

triage.headline_ja: ベニ：エボラウイルス病に対する認識向上の最前線の青年たち - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラは異常・予想外の重篤感染症であり、DRCでの継続的な発生は国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを有する。スクリーニング基準複数該当、かつ社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月15日配信で、ベニ（ノルド・キヴ州、DRC）でのエボラ発生を報じている。サマリーでは現在のケース数、症状、検査確認の詳細は提供されていないが、既存の流行（「既に存在」、2018年アウトブレイク歴参照）と青年による認識啓発活動が記載されている。DRCにおけるエボラ再興流行は継続中の懸念であり、IHR基準とWPRO基準のいずれも複数該当する。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reports record daily increase in Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: 72 new Ebola cases in 24 hours push Congo’s total confirmed infections to 782 and deaths to 181 (29 new) in the month-old Bundibugyo-virus outbreak, concentrated in Ituri (more than 90% of cases) with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border transmission to Uganda. Since outbreak confirmation on May 15, 40 people have recovered while the fatality rate stands at 23%. The true case count may be higher due to delayed confirmations and ongoing surveillance improvements. Contact tracing coverage is 56%, down from last week, as authorities race to identify exposed individuals amid conflict-driven displacement (nearly a million people in Ituri) and mobility among thousands of miners. The World Health Organization is intensifying testing, tracing, and treatment; supplies have arrived, with Africa CDC providing technical expertise and support to accelerate response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ出血熱の記録的な1日あたりの感染者増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱による死亡者181名、感染者782名、23%の致命率、隣国ウガンダへの越境感染、および継続的な増加傾向が確認され、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが顕著。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。紛争による避難民（イトゥリで約100万人）と採掘労働者の移動がさらなる拡大のリスク要因。接触者追跡カバー率が56%に低下しており、管理能力に懸念。WHO、アフリカCDCが技術支援を提供中。

article.articleHeadline: ANSVSA încearcă să convingă CE să regionalizeze exporturile de ovine, după focarele de variolă din Mureş. Pieţele non-UE, valoare record la livrările de animale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ANSVSA tries to convince the European Commission to regionalize sheep exports following sheep pox outbreaks in Mureș. Non-EU markets, record value for animal shipments.
article.articleSummary: Romania's ANSVSA urges the European Commission to regionalize sheep exports following localized outbreaks of sheep pox and goat pox in Mureș County, rather than a blanket embargo. A Technical Agreement signed by exporters/livestock centers supports the institutional strategy, emphasizing continued trade from disease-free zones and rapid implementation of regionalization. The agency is also examining strategic vaccination against sheep and goat pox to bolster the EU dossier as an added immunity barrier. The plan aims to secure non-EU markets and maintain transparent dialogue with Brussels; leadership stability within ANSVSA is cited as essential to negotiations. Economically, live sheep exports to non-EU markets reached over €210 million in the first 10 months of 2025, with around 1 million head shipped and a projected minimum 40% growth in 2026. Markets include Algeria (1 million head contract), Saudi Arabia, Jordan, Morocco, China, Azerbaijan, Albania. Romania tallies over 10 million sheep (2nd in EU for flock size, 1st for live exports) per INS. In Mureș, outbreaks: Toldal (398 head), Dumbrava (248), Malea (830), Lueriu (392) and PMR in Viișoara (882).

triage.headline_ja: ムレシュ県の羊痘感染拡大後、ルーマニア当局がEUに羊の輸出地域化を要請。非EU市場への記録的な動物出荷
triage.triage_reason: 羊痘・ヤギ痘の局所的発生は異常かつ予想外であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に合致するが、情報不足と地理的限定性により、フルRRA前の経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが複数国（Albania、Azerbaijan、Algeria、Jordan、Saudi Arabia、Morocco）を発生地域として付与しているが、記事サマリーの主題はルーマニア（Mureș県）の局所的な羊痘・ヤギ痘アウトブレイクであり、これらの国は輸出先市場としてのみ言及されている。したがってverified_locationsはChinaのみ（対象国リストに含まれているため）とした。他の非対象国への輸出への言及は除外。ルーマニアは評価対象の対象国ではないため含めない。局所的なアウトブレイク規模（計1,750頭）は中等度の重症度と判断される。WATCHは、IHR基準2つ以上合致、WPROスクリーニング基準2つ以上合致し、社会的・政治的関心も存在するが、対象国での発生確認がなく情報が限定的であるため。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola risk for World Cup is 'extremely low', but US is ready, experts say
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk for the 2026 World Cup is extremely low but not zero; US hospitals are prepared. The 2014 West Africa outbreak prompted $260 million in funding and 13 specialized treatment centers after a Liberian patient arrived in Dallas and two nurses were infected. With 6.5 million fans attending 104 matches over 39 days across the United States, Mexico and Canada, the CDC, PAHO and WHO deem Ebola risk low, though measles, COVID-19 and influenza remain a concern at mass gatherings. The Democratic Republic of Congo's outbreak has infected more than 675 people and killed over 135; Ebola is not airborne and requires direct contact with body fluids of an ill person. Preparedness includes thousands of trained healthcare workers, airport screening, travel bans for some visitors, and surveillance tools (wastewater, air quality, EHRs). DRC outbreak control and imported/exported-case risks are under ongoing monitoring by FIFA and health authorities.

triage.headline_ja: 「2026年ワールドカップのエボラリスク は『極めて低い』だが、米国は準備完了」と専門家は語る
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤疾患（エボラ、麻疹、COVID-19、インフルエンザ）が言及されており、国際的な大規模集会イベント（650万人以上の参加者）における流行リスクが指摘されている。ただし、現在のリスク評価は「極めて低い」とされており、DRC発生事例は監視下にあるが、対象国での直接的な流行拡大の兆候は記事に示されていない。継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが付与した発生地域にはダラス（テキサス州、米国）、アンゴラ、カナダ、リベリア、メキシコが含まれているが、記事サマリーの内容から判断すると、実際に流行イベントが発生している国はDRCのみ。米国、カナダ、メキシコはワールドカップ開催国として言及されているが、現在の流行地ではない。エボラは657人以上の感染者と135人以上の死亡者を有するDRCでの発生事例に基づいており、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。大規模国際イベントでの流行懸念があるため、準備状況の監視継続が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: As the Ebola Epidemic Spreads, NV-387 Oral Gummies Can Enter a Phase II Clinical Trial for Treatment of Ebola - NanoViricides Proposal is Approved by the Pillar Committee in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda continues to expand, with 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths in DR Congo as of June 14, 2026. The spread covers Ituru province (20 of 36 zones), North Kivu (10 of 34 zones), and a South Kivu zone; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. CDC models project 10,000–20,000 cases and 2,000–4,000 deaths in the next three months. NanoViricides seeks Phase II testing of NV-387 Oral Gummies as a treatment for the current Bundibugyo Ebolavirus strain, approved by the DR Congo Pillar Committee; ethics approvals in DRC and ACOREP clearance for a Mpox Phase II trial are planned. NV-387 is described as a broad-spectrum, orally delivered antiviral potentially overcoming IV therapy delivery challenges in resource-limited settings, with prior animal data suggesting superiority to remdesivir.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行が拡大する中、NV-387経口グミがエボラ治療のフェーズIIクリニカルトライアルに進出可能に - ナノウイルサイズ社の提案がDRコンゴのピラー委員会で承認
triage.triage_reason: Bundibugyo Ebolavirus（エボラ）のDRコンゴ・ウガンダでの大規模流行（782確認症例、181死亡）で、WHOがPHEICを宣言しており、IHR基準4つすべてに該当。国際的に重大な感染症危機。
triage.notes: 記事はBundibugyo Ebolavirus（エボラ）の流行を主題としており、DRコンゴが中心。ウガンダも記事に言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。ケニアはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているがサマリーでの言及がないため除外。WHOのPHEIC宣言（2026年5月17日）、CDC予測（今後3ヶ月で10,000～20,000症例、2,000～4,000死亡）、複数州での急速な拡大により国際的脅威は明白。

article.articleHeadline: Επιδημία Έμπολα στη ΛΔ Κονγκό: Οι MSF ανησυχούν για τα "σοβαρά κενά" στην υγειονομική αντίδραση
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: MSF are concerned about the "serious gaps" in the public health response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is spreading faster than the on-site response, with MSF warning of dangerous gaps in diagnosis, surveillance, contact tracing, and community engagement. The Bundibugyo strain has no vaccine or approved therapy. On May 15, the DRC declared the outbreak; WHO followed with an international health emergency on May 17. In North Kivu, only one laboratory analyzes blood samples, causing multi-day delays for results. WHO data report 782 cases and 181 deaths, though MSF cautions official counts may understate reality. Despite the arrival of hundreds of portable rapid tests in the eastern DRC, access remains limited in insecure areas, and health facilities face long result delays, hindering rapid case detection. WHO notes improved contact tracing (just over 70% of contacts identified vs ~45% earlier). Context: the 2013–2016 West Africa outbreak caused more than 11,300 deaths and ~29,000 cases.

triage.headline_ja: DRC（コンゴ民主共和国）でのエボラ流行：MSFが公衆衛生対応の「深刻な欠陥」を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo strain）による確認済み流行で、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、隣国アンゴラへの国際的拡大リスク、および渡航・貿易制限の可能性が認められる。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言済み（2026年5月17日）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCでのエボラ流行を主として報告。隣国アンゴラは発生地域フィールドに含まれるが、サマリー本文ではDRCのみが具体的に論じられており、アンゴラへの実際の拡大確認の記載がないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを列挙。Bundibugyo strainはワクチン・承認治療法がなく、重症度が高い。MSFらによる診断・監視・接触追跡の「深刻な欠陥」警告は管理可能性の懸念を示す。WHO国際保健緊急事態宣言（PHEIC）により、国際的なシグナル確認済み。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola deaths rise in DR Congo
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in eastern DR Congo now totals 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths (case fatality rate 23.1%), with 72 new cases and 29 new deaths reported on Sunday. Since declaration on May 15, 40 people have recovered. The outbreak, the 17th in DR Congo since 1976, involves the Bundibugyo species; no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists, per WHO. Confirmed cases span 31 health zones across three eastern provinces: Ituri (20 zones), North Kivu (10), and South Kivu (1), with two zones newly affected as of June 13. Response faces insecurity, humanitarian crisis, and high population/trade movements; contact tracing hindered by displacement. Government has received 16.5 tons of WHO medical/logistical supplies. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhea, rash, kidney/liver problems, and bleeding.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の死亡例がコンゴ民主共和国で増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo種エボラの確認症例782例、死亡181例（致死率23.1%）、複数州にまたがる流行で重篤な公衆衛生影響、予防接種なし、国際的拡大リスク高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo種エボラは16th公式エボロウイルス種。2023年以降の新規流行。高い致死率（23.1%）、複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）への拡大、ワクチン/特異的治療なし、安全保障上の課題および大量の人口移動がリスク要因。WHO対応支援あり。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Misinformation fuels Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: An Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is nearing 1,000 official cases, with health workers citing misinformation as a key barrier to containment. False claims, such as the epidemic being a hoax, have spread across the country, worsening transmission in overcrowded displacement camps where hundreds share a toilet. The World Health Organization warned of many blind spots in high-risk areas, suggesting official counts may understate the true scale of transmission. Despite these challenges, officials expressed cautious optimism that an Ebola vaccine could be ready for clinical trials within a couple of months.

triage.headline_ja: 誤情報がエボラ出血熱の拡大を助長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模アウトブレイク（公式1,000例近く）で、重症度・国際拡大リスク・管理困難性が極めて高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高リスク病原体。公式統計の過小報告、変位キャンプでの高密度曝露、誤情報による対策阻害など複合的リスク要因あり。WHOも警告。ワクチン開発進展情報あるが、直近の感染制御困難性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Nord-Kivu : démarrage des travaux de construction du centre de traitement d'Ebola à Beni - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: North Kivu: Start of construction work on the Ebola treatment center in Beni - ACP
article.articleSummary: Construction of the Ebola Treatment Center (CTE) in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, has begun. Site preparation is underway as care continues in the old building, with triage and other suspected Ebola cases admitted within the facility for treatment and follow-up. The new center will not be built as a permanent concrete structure; it will use locally sourced materials and is expected to be completed quickly. Community relay teams and other health staff are on the ground to raise awareness and help contain transmission in North Kivu. Five patient housing rooms for potential Ebola patients were available at the Beni CTE before the relaunch began.

triage.headline_ja: 北キブ州：ベニでのエボラ治療センター建設工事開始 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行対応中における治療センター整備という異常/予想外の公衆衛生活動。IHR基準2項目以上（深刻な影響・異常性）及びWPRO基準複数項目該当により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は進行中のエボラ流行に対応するための治療センター建設工事を報じており、既に複数の疑似患者が施設内で治療を受けている状況。地域コミュニティチームと保健スタッフが感染制御対策に従事中。DRCは対象国リストに含まれ、サマリーで明示的にDRCが主題。

article.articleHeadline: RIVM zag al vroeg dat corona-uitbraak veel groter was dan gedacht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RIVM had already realized early on that the coronavirus outbreak was much larger than previously thought.
article.articleSummary: January 2020 analyses by the Dutch National Institute for Public Health and the Environment (RIVM) showed the Wuhan coronavirus outbreak was much larger than official Chinese figures. Lead modeller Jacco Wallinga and colleagues used data from local Chinese health services and from Thailand, Singapore, and other Asian countries to gauge quarantine durations and contagious periods. They concluded that, while China reported high mortality, the true scale appeared larger than official counts, an assessment reinforced when cases emerged in Japan and Thailand.
