The Dutch team benefited from a Mandarin-speaking intern who translated information, underscoring that local health authorities provided more actionable data than national statistics. From January–February 2020, analyses were updated as more data accrued, considering implications for the Netherlands if the virus arrived. At that time it was not yet clear it would become a pandemic, though deaths in China were concerning for Dutch healthcare planning.

triage.headline_ja: オランダの公衆衛生機関（RIVM）は、コロナウイルス感染拡大が予想より大きいことを早期に認識していた
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2020年1月の過去のCOVID-19初期段階に関する回顧的な分析記事であり、現在のアクティブなシグナルではない。記事公開日は2026年6月15日だが、内容は2020年初期の歴史的イベントの記録であり、新規感染症イベントの検知ではない。
triage.notes: 記事は2020年初期のCOVID-19拡大に関するオランダの公衆衛生機関による過去の分析についての回顧的報道である。現在のアクティブなシグナルではなく、歴史的なドキュメント記事として分類される。記事配信日が2026年と未来であることも注記される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo Ebola Outbreak Spreads as Case Count Reaches 782
article.articleSummary: DRC's Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus (laboratory-confirmed), has reached 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, spreading to Ituri and North Kivu. By June 10, Ituri reported 629 confirmed cases across 19 health zones; on June 14, 72 new infections were recorded in 24 hours, among the largest increases since May 15. The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine or specific treatment; isolation, contact tracing, testing and supportive care remain the main tools. This is the DRC's 17th Ebola outbreak, five months after the previous one ended. The disease crossed into Uganda, with an imported Congolese case in Kampala who died after traveling from DRC. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026; Africa CDC followed with a continental security emergency the next day. MSF and WHO are scaling up the response amid security challenges and surveillance gaps, with calls for more funding.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染症アウトブレイク拡大、感染者数が782人に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WHO/Africa CDCが既に公衆衛生上の国際的懸念事項（PHEIC）を宣言。DRCでの確認された282人の死亡者を含む大規模なエボラアウトブレイクであり、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（Kampala）に輸入症例が確認されているが、記事の主題はDRCのアウトブレイクであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRCはアフリカで最大級のエボラアウトブレイクの一つとして深刻。Bundibugyo株はワクチンや特異的治療法がなく、セキュリティ上の課題と監視ギャップがある中での対応継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Рекордный однодневный прирост случаев заболевания Эболой произошел в Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A record one-day increase in Ebola cases occurred in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo reports a record daily increase in Ebola cases. In the last 24 hours, 72 new infections were confirmed, raising the total to 782; deaths reached 182, with 32 fatalities in the day, and 56 recoveries. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a rare Ebola species; unlike the more common Zaire ebolavirus, there are no approved vaccines or specific treatments available for Bundibugyo. The virus was first identified in Uganda in 2007, and large outbreaks have been infrequent since. The report notes ongoing transmission within the DRC and does not provide details on the infection source or any imported/exported cases. The case fatality rate stands at about 23%. Public health authorities continue surveillance and response under local ministries of health and international partners.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1日の新規エボラ感染者数が過去最高を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の大規模流行で深刻な公衆衛生上の影響、稀なBundibugyo種での異常な流行増加、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダでの初発生報告あり）、渡航制限の可能性がある。WPROスクリーニング基準もすべて該当（致死率23%、ヒト-ヒト感染、継続的曝露、管理支援ニーズ）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダでのウイルス初発見(2007年)に言及しているが、現在の流行はDRCが主体。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の稀な性質とワクチン/治療法の欠如により、リスク評価は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémia eboly sa rozrastá. Lekári bez hraníc varujú, že vírus sa šíri rýchlejšie než reakcia naň
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola epidemic is spreading. Doctors Without Borders warn that the virus is spreading faster than the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading faster than the response, according to Doctors Without Borders (MSF). One month after the outbreak declaration on May 15, MSF notes the true scale remains unclear, with transmission outpacing the response. WHO data report 782 confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC with 181 deaths; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. The outbreak epicenter is Ituri province in the northeast, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu. Access remains hampered by security and health-system gaps; testing is a major weakness affecting case finding, contact tracing, and monitoring. The Bundibugyo Ebola virus variant has no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever; Africa has seen more than 15,000 Ebola deaths in 50 years.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行が拡大。国境なき医師団は、ウイルスの感染速度が対応より速いと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な急速な拡大、複数国への越境、国際的対応必要）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべて該当。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルのリスク疾患であり、即座にフルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は指定感染症中の最高リスク疾患。記事サマリーではDRCでの発生が主題であり、ウガンダの症例報告も含まれているが、ウガンダは対象国リストにないため verified_locations には含めない。782確定症例・181死亡、ワクチン・治療なしのBundibugyo型、接近不可による対応困難という多重リスク要因が存在。

article.articleHeadline: Record daily jump in DRC Ebola outbreak takes death toll to 178
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak, Bundibugyo strain, records 782 confirmed cases and 178 deaths as of 2026-06-15, with 72 new cases and 29 deaths reported in the previous 24 hours, marking one of the largest daily increases. The Bundibugyo strain has a 22.8% case-fatality rate; 40 patients recovered. Ituri province remains epicenter, housing about 95% of cases; virus has breached into North Kivu and South Kivu, and crossed into Uganda. No approved vaccine or treatment for Bundibugyo; unlike Zaire strain. Contact tracing coverage plummeted to 56.5% from the 95% target. WHO ramping up diagnostics and contact surveillance; MSF warns true scale unknown due to surveillance/testing gaps. Nearly one million residents displaced amid armed conflict in Ituri’s mining region; Mongbwalu Health Zone believed origin. Funding gap of $21.5 million.

triage.headline_ja: DRC エボラ感染症の大流行、死亡者数が178人に到達 — 1日の記録的な増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱のBundibugyo株による大規模流行で、782確定患者、178死亡、1日あたり72新規患者の記録的増加が報告されており、ウガンダへの越境が確認された。直ちにフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの越境が明記されているが、発生地域リストに含まれるウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations に含めない。DRCのみが対象国。高い致死率(22.8%)、接触者追跡カバレッジの急激な低下(95%→56.5%)、Bundibugyo株に対する承認済みワクチン・治療法の不在、および武装紛争による約100万人の避難民発生など、複合的リスク要因が存在。資金ギャップ$21.5百万。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : arrivé à Bunia, le Général-Major Gaby Kasongo appelle à la mobilisation pour la paix et contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: Arrived in Bunia, Major General Gaby Kasongo calls for mobilization for peace and against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ituri, Bunia, Democratic Republic of the Congo — Major General Gaby Kasongo Mulumba arrived in Bunia to assume the military governorship amid a state of siege, after being appointed by presidential decree on June 5. Landing around 18:00, he was welcomed by provincial security officials, authorities, and residents. In his first remarks, he called for close collaboration with the population to restore lasting peace in Ituri, which faces persistent armed-group activity and a progressing Ebola outbreak. Ituri remains the national epicentre of the Ebola crisis, and Kasongo urged media and citizens to support ongoing risk communication and outreach, stressing that the disease exists and that awareness campaigns must counter rumors, denial, and resistance. Civil society groups, including FOSSHID, attended to offer support for peace, social cohesion, and provincial development. A formal handover with Lt-Gen Johnny Luboya N'Kashama was expected in the coming hours.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ：ブニアに到着したガビ・カソンゴ少将は平和とエボラ対策への動員を呼びかける
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された流行がDRC（イトゥリ州）で進行中であり、IHR基準3つ（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外の状況、国際拡大リスク）に該当。WPRO基準も複数該当し、政府の高い関心が明確。
triage.notes: DRCのイトゥリ州におけるエボラウイルス病の「進行中」な流行（ongoing Ebola outbreak）が明記されている。国防軍幹部の緊急配置と住民への積極的なリスク・コミュニケーション実施がシグナルの重要度を高める。2026年という記事日付は将来日付であるが、シミュレーション環境での運用と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Afreximbank Cancela Reunião Anual Por Receios Ligados ao Surto de Ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Afreximbank Cancels Annual Meeting Over Ebola Outbreak-Related Concerns
article.articleSummary: Afreximbank cancels its annual meeting scheduled for next week at El Alamein, Egypt, due to Ebola outbreak-related health and safety concerns in Central Africa. The Democratic Republic of the Congo has logged 782 Ebola cases since the outbreak was declared about a month ago, with Uganda also reporting cases, raising travel concerns for meetings and events in the region. The Cairo-based bank said shareholder matters will be handled by correspondence, and the Egyptian government has postponed other international events this month. Afreximbank is owned by African governments, regional financial institutions, and private shareholders. Last month, the African Development Bank held its annual meeting in Brazzaville, Republic of the Congo, shortly after the Congo declared the current Ebola outbreak, highlighting heightened caution amid ongoing regional transmission.

triage.headline_ja: アフリックスバンク、エボラ流行懸念でアフリカ開発銀行年次総会をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（コンゴ民主共和国で782例）の国際的拡大リスク、地域的影響、及び国際イベント中止を伴う国際的関心があり、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: エボラは高病原性で、コンゴ民主共和国およびウガンダでの活動的な流行が報告されている。国際銀行機関が年次総会をキャンセルするなど、政治的・経済的影響が明確。ただし、発生地域リストに含まれるエジプト、コンゴ共和国、ウガンダは、記事の主な関心事（DRCでの流行）の周辺国であり、サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地点として言及されているため verified_locations に DRC のみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Misinformation fuels Ebola spread
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is being hampered by misinformation that the outbreak is a hoax, hindering containment as official cases approach 1,000. False claims circulating nationwide have accelerated spread in overcrowded displacement camps where hundreds share a single toilet. The World Health Organization cautions there are many blind spots in high‑risk areas, meaning official statistics could substantially undercount true case numbers. Despite these challenges, officials say a vaccine may be ready for clinical trials within a couple of months, signaling cautious optimism amid the outbreak response. The report highlights how misinformation, sanitation crowding, and surveillance gaps combine to facilitate transmission while authorities work to verify cases and advance vaccine development.

triage.headline_ja: 誤情報がエボラ出血熱の拡大を助長
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当し、WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱による深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、誤情報による管理困難性が確認されている。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最高レベルのバイオセキュリティリスク。誤情報による市民の不信が封じ込めを大きく阻害し、公式統計以上の隠れた感染者が存在する可能性が指摘されている。避難キャンプの過密環境での急速な伝播が懸念される。ワクチン開発進行中だが、誤情報がワクチン接種意欲も損なう可能性あり。フルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: 5 ca tử vong do sốt xuất huyết, Bộ Y tế cảnh báo nguy cơ dịch gia tăng
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 5 deaths from dengue fever; Ministry of Health warns of rising outbreak risk.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, Vietnam records more than 50,000 dengue fever cases nationwide, with 5 deaths. Dengue remains endemic in many localities, especially in the Southern region and densely populated, rapidly urbanizing provinces with high mobility. The current weather pattern—alternating rains and sun and rising humidity—favors Aedes mosquito breeding, with household water containers and waste creating larval habitats (larvae and pupae). Without early and sustained prevention, outbreak risk is high. The Ministry of Health urges public action: No larval habitats, no dengue; at least 10 minutes weekly to inspect and eliminate water-holding items; cover water containers; refresh vases and plant pots; collect waste; tip over unused items; sleep under nets; avoid bites; collaborate with health authorities in vector-control campaigns. Local authorities should strengthen surveillance, enable rapid case management, and mobilize primary care networks and communications in high-risk areas.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱で5人が死亡、保健省は流行拡大のリスクに警告
triage.triage_reason: デング熱による50,000件以上の症例と5人の死亡が報告され、IHR基準の「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」と「異常性」に該当。また、WPRO基準でも重症度（死亡例あり）、長期曝露（エンデミック、気象条件が蚊の繁殖を助長）、流行しやすさ（高密度地域、人口流動性高い）が明らかであり、保健省による公式警告で政府関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはベトナム全国での50,000件以上のデング熱症例と5人の死亡を明記。南部地域と急速に都市化している高人口密度地域での流行。保健省による公式警告であり、公共衛生上の懸念は高い。記事本文が未入力だが、サマリーで十分な情報あり。

article.articleHeadline: Measles under control, few cases reported: health official
article.articleSummary: Measles remains under control in Iran despite a global surge, with only eight confirmed cases since March 21, the start of the new year. In the first month of spring, 266 suspected cases yielded eight confirmations, down from 266 of 828 suspected last year. High vaccination coverage and robust surveillance have reduced transmission; the World Health Organization has verified that Iran sustained measles elimination since 2019, with Iran, Oman, and Bahrain as the region’s verified countries. Iran’s vaccination program began in 1984 and achieved high coverage, including a 2003 campaign vaccinating about 33 million people. Officials noted Europe’s loss of measles-free status, while measles remains prevalent in West Asia, notably Turkey. By April 2025, about 98% of the target population had been vaccinated; 10,000–20,000 under-one children remain unvaccinated, and about 5% of vaccinated individuals reportedly develop measles. Disrupted vaccination programs in Afghanistan and Pakistan are cited as main risk factors.

triage.headline_ja: 麻しんはコントロール下にあり、報告例は少数：保健当局者
triage.triage_reason: イランにおける麻しん患者数は限定的（3月以降8例）で、高いワクチン接種率と強固なサーベイランスにより状況はコントロール下にある。WHOが2019年以来の排除状態を確認しており、深刻な公衆衛生上の影響や国際的拡大のリスクは低い。
triage.notes: 記事はイランの麻しん状況の管理状態を報告する肯定的なニュースであり、アウトブレイクやシグナルの性質ではない。Bluedot APIが複数国を発生地域として列挙しているが、サマリーの主題はイランの状況報告であり、イランは対象国リストに含まれていない。Shanghai Shiはサマリー内に言及されていないため、Chinaは含めるが、これも直接的な発生報告ではなくコンテキスト参照と推測される。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo confirms 782 Ebola cases, 2 new health zones affected
article.articleSummary: DR Congo's 17th Ebola outbreak continues, with 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of 2026-06-15. The outbreak remains confined to North Kivu, Ituri, and South Kivu provinces. A one-day surge of 72 new infections was reported, the largest single-day increase in the current outbreak. Two health zones reported cases for the first time: Nia-Nia in Ituri and Mabalako in North Kivu. Latest tallies show Ebola across 20 of 36 health zones in Ituri, 10 of 34 in North Kivu, and 1 in South Kivu. Authorities are expanding response measures with international health partners, including contact tracing and establishing treatment centers, while urging communities to report symptoms promptly. Ebola transmission occurs through direct contact with blood or body fluids of an infected person or contaminated objects.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の症例782件を確認、新たに2つのヘルスゾーンが影響を受ける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の継続的な流行拡大、死亡者181名、地理的拡大（新規ヘルスゾーン侵入）、国際的支援体制の構築により、フルRRA実施の対象。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国第17次エボラアウトブレーク。1日最大の感染数増加（72件）、地理的拡大継続、死亡率高（181/782≈23%）。国際保健パートナーとの連携体制構築済み。記事日付2026年は明らかに架空だが、イベント情報の構造として評価対象。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola risk for World Cup is 'extremely low', but US is ready: Experts
article.articleSummary: Ebola risk for the 2026 World Cup in the United States is extremely low but not zero, and US hospitals are prepared to respond if a traveler arrives infected. The context cites a 2014 West Africa outbreak in which Liberian immigrant Thomas Eric Duncan triggered a Dallas hospital outbreak and led to two infected nurses; that event prompted about $260 million in preparedness funding and 13 specialized treatment centers to improve detection, isolation, and care. With 6.5 million fans across 39 days and 104 matches in the United States, Mexico, and Canada, and 11 US host cities, public health officials emphasize vigilance. The CDC, PAHO, and WHO describe Ebola risk to host countries as low, while noting measles, COVID-19 and influenza as more probable crowd threats. The Democratic Republic of Congo outbreak has infected more than 675 and killed more than 135.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス病が2026年ワールドカップで「極めて低い」リスク、しかし米国は備え：専門家
triage.triage_reason: 記事は2026年ワールドカップに関するエボラリスク評価であり、複数国での議論を扱っているが、現在の具体的な流行発生イベントではなく予防的な評価内容。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の判定が不確実で情報が限定的。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は2026年ワールドカップに向けた予防的なリスク評価であり、現在進行中の感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。DRCで675以上の感染者と135以上の死亡が記載されているため検証対象地域に含めるが、この記事自体はイベント予測に関するもの。米国・メキシコ・カナダは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Konge toliau sparčiai plinta Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread rapidly in Congo.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, Ebola virus disease is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with Ituri province bearing the brunt. Case fatality is 23.1%, and 359 patients are being treated in hospitals and isolation facilities. Contact tracing performance is weak at 56.5%, far below the 90% target needed to halt transmission, per WHO data. MSF warns that surveillance and tracing gaps, a month after the outbreak began in Ituri, undermine control efforts for this highly dangerous disease. Treatment centers in Ituri are overcrowded; many patients arrive with advanced disease, and most were neither identified as contacts nor monitored before treatment. Community testing capacity is limited and laboratory result turnaround is slow. Without faster, broader testing to promptly identify cases, outbreak control will be difficult. Ebola transmits via physical contact and body fluids; there is no vaccine or specific treatment for the Bandibadžio Ebola variant.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスが急速に拡大し続けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。エボラウイルスは極めて高いリスク、死亡率23.1%、接触追跡の失敗（56.5%）により国際的拡大リスクが高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（死亡率23.1%）がコンゴ民主共和国のイトゥーリ州で急速に拡大中。接触追跡成功率56.5%は目標90%を大きく下回り、制御困難な状況。医療施設の過密化、遅い検査結果報告、限定的なコミュニティ検査能力などの管理上の課題がある。ワクチンと特異的治療法が存在しないバンディバジオ株。対象国DRCのみに該当。

article.articleHeadline: RIVM zag al vroeg dat corona-uitbraak groot was * 'Het virus was een soort biologische natuurramp'
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RIVM had already realized early on that the coronavirus outbreak was large * 'The virus was a kind of biological natural disaster'.
article.articleSummary: RIVM modeler Jacco Wallinga described the coronavirus outbreak as a 'biological natural disaster' in a risk diagram, labeling the virus 'severely catastrophic' and implying inaction was not an option. His risk analyses highlighted Dutch healthcare bottlenecks, noting the Netherlands had fewer hospital and ICU beds than neighboring countries. In January, while China faced rising cases, Wallinga and colleagues mined Chinese sources (assisted by an intern who read Chinese) to inform models, concluding the virus was highly contagious and could cause severe illness; he documented these findings in notes and papers. Although not a policymaker, his scenario runs—aiming to minimize the R-number—formed a key basis for ministers and officials deciding on school closures, curfews, and lockdowns. Former OMT member Diederik Gommers lamented the toll of strict measures on dying patients and recounted policy disputes over admission policies and age considerations. Wallinga testified to the coronacommission on 15 June 2026 at 14:00.

triage.headline_ja: RIVM は早期からコロナウイルス流行が大規模であることを認識していた * 「ウイルスは一種の生物学的な自然災害だった」
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2026年6月15日のオランダ当局による過去の COVID-19 対応に関する公開証言・評価であり、現在進行中の新規感染症イベントではない。歴史的・政策的な回顧記事であり、新たな公衆衛生上の脅威を示唆していない。
triage.notes: 記事は 2026 年 6 月 15 日にオランダ（対象国リストに含まれない）で行われた過去の COVID-19 対応に関する公開証言であり、現在進行中の感染症イベントではない。中国が言及されているが、記事の主題は歴史的な政策評価であり、新規の感染症危機ではない。対象国に該当する実際の発生イベントがないため verified_locations は空配列。

article.articleHeadline: Spike in Ebola cases: Congo reports 72 new infections in 24 hours; toll rises to 181
article.articleSummary: In eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province, 72 new Ebola infections were reported in the last 24 hours, pushing total confirmed cases to 782 and deaths to 181 (29 new fatalities). The outbreak, officially confirmed May 15 and caused by the Bundibugyo strain, has no approved vaccine or treatment; the case fatality rate is about 23%. Authorities note that intensified surveillance, expanded testing, and contact tracing are driving higher reported numbers, with 40 recoveries since the outbreak began. Ituri accounts for over 90% of cases, with additional infections in North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border spread into Uganda. WHO and Africa CDC have expanded response capacity, while humanitarian challenges—nearly one million displaced in Ituri and attacks on health workers—complicate containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の急増：コンゴが24時間で72例の新規感染を報告、死者181人に
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外な急増、国際的な国境越え拡大の実績、渡航制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。エボラ出血熱の確定患者急増は最高優先度のシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）の大規模アウトブレイク。782例の確定患者、181人の死亡（致死率23%）、ウガンダへの国境越え拡大報告。100万人近くが国内避難民化、医療従事者への攻撃など人道危機と並行。WHOおよびアフリカCDCが対応能力を拡大している状況。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations からは除外。

article.articleHeadline: Epidémie d'Ebola en RDC : Médecins sans frontières alerte sur les lacunes dans la lutte contre le virus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in the DRC: Doctors Without Borders warns of gaps in the response to the virus.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is spreading faster than the on-the-ground response, with Doctors Without Borders (MSF) warning of dangerous gaps in diagnostic, surveillance, contact tracing, and community engagement. Declared May 15, 2026, the outbreak—the 17th in DRC—prompted WHO to declare an international Public Health Emergency on May 17. There is no vaccine or approved treatment for the Bundibugyo strain driving this outbreak. WHO figures based on Congolese authorities report 782 cases and 181 deaths to date, though MSF says official counts likely undercount reality. In North Kivu, only one laboratory analyzes blood samples, with delays of several days; hundreds of mobile tests exist for Bundibugyo, yet many insecure areas lack access and treatment centers wait long for results. WHO notes improved contact tracing to just over 70% of contacts, up from 45% in early June, but containment remains precarious.

triage.headline_ja: RDCにおけるエボラ流行：国境なき医師団がウイルス対策の不備について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。WHOが国際保健緊急事態を宣言した確認済みのエボラアウトブレイク。
triage.notes: WHOが2026年5月17日に国際保健緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言。RDC17番目のエボラアウトブレイク。Bundibugyo株が主流。確認症例782件、死亡181件（WHO発表値）。MSFはこの数値が過小評価されている可能性を指摘。診断、サーベイランス、接触追跡、コミュニティエンゲージメントにおける重大なギャップが存在。

article.articleHeadline: Број оболелих од еболе у Конгу повeћао се на 782
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in Congo has risen to 782.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has climbed to 782 confirmed cases and 181 confirmed deaths, according to the Ministry of Health. In the past 24 hours, 72 new cases were reported—a record for that period. The outbreak affects Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, regions long affected by armed conflict. The initial appearance was reported on 15 May, though officials say the virus had been spreading for weeks, complicating control efforts. An additional 29 deaths were recorded in the latest update, bringing fatalities to 181. Described as one of the world's largest Ebola outbreaks, the response faces significant challenges in conflict zones and surveillance.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ患者数が782人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（782確定患者、181死亡）であり、IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスクが明らかである。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーから、イベントはコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイツリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州で発生していることが確認される。配信日時が2026年6月15日と将来日付だが、これはシミュレーション系統の日付と考えられ、評価は記事内容の疫学的特性に基づいて実施。武装紛争地域での流行制御の困難さが言及されており、国際的支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: MSF preocupada com "perigosas lacunas" na resposta ao surto de ébola na RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF concerned about "dangerous gaps" in the Ebola outbreak response in the DRC
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is accelerating faster than the response on the ground, with MSF warning of dangerous gaps in diagnosis, surveillance, contact tracing, and community engagement. The WHO reports 782 cases and 181 deaths to date, though MSF says official numbers likely reflect only part of the reality. Despite intensified efforts, testing bottlenecks persist: in North Kivu a single laboratory analyzes blood samples with multi-day turnaround, and insecure areas have limited test access. Ituri accounts for about 95% of cases, with distrust toward response teams. Case tracing has improved to over 70% (up from 45% in early June). The outbreak was declared May 15; no licensed vaccine or treatment exists for the Bundibugyo strain, which has a fatality rate around 23%. This is the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC in five decades.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、DRCのエボラ出血熱流行対応における「危険なギャップ」に懸念を表明
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：782例、181死亡；予想外かつ異常；国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準5つ全て該当。Bundibugyo株での発生、ワクチン・治療薬がなく、対応に大きなギャップがあり、早期段階での集中的RRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 発生地域はDRC Ituri州が95%のケースを占める。Bundibugyo株は致命率23%。公式数字は実態の一部のみと指摘。5月15日に流行宣言。DRC過去50年間の17番目のエボラ流行。MSFの対応ギャップ警告は国際的な支援・関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Mitch McConnell Hospitalized; Outbreak Deaths Reach 181; iPhones and Birth Rates
article.articleSummary: 782 Ebola cases and 181 deaths in Congo, per the ministry of health, as of 2026-06-15, with WHO director-general Tedros Ghebreyesus warning amid war and displaced populations and strained health workers. Measles outbreak in a Virginia county approaches 90 confirmed cases. Leptospirosis death in California linked to a resident who trapped and bred wild rats. Florida records eight Vibrio vulnificus cases this year. Three infants hospitalized with botulism linked to recalled Nara Organics infant formula. Globally, blood donations rose 19% from 2013 to 2023, though access remains uneven. HIV care: only 3% of people with HIV on Medicare received long-acting injectable antiretroviral therapy in 2023. Ongoing Ebola response in conflict-affected settings and broader public health concerns accompany these developments.

triage.headline_ja: ミッチ・マコーネル入院; 集団発生の死亡数が181に達する; iPhoneと出生率
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。コンゴでのエボラウイルス病782例・181死亡、複数地域での同時多発アウトブレイク（麻疹、レプトスピラ症、ビブリオ・バルニフィカス感染症、ボツリズム）。WPROスクリーニング基準全て該当。国際的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 複数の高リスク疾患（エボラ、麻疹、レプトスピラ症など）が同時に報告されている。コンゴでのエボラウイルス病は紛争地域での対応困難、保健労働者不足が指摘されている。米国内の複数州でのアウトブレイクは対象国外のため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: MSF alerta de que la respuesta al brote de ébola en RDC sigue sin...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF warns that the response to the Ebola outbreak in the DRC is still without....
article.articleSummary: MSF warns that one month after the Ebola outbreak declaration in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, the response lags the crisis, with cases advancing faster than containment efforts. The outbreak affects Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu; declared May 15, and the WHO declared a PHEIC on May 17. MSF notes most treatment centers in Ituri are overwhelmed; many patients arrive late, and most are not identified as contacts before seeking care. Gaps in surveillance, diagnosis, and contact tracing persist, worsened by insecurity that hampers access and data reliability—official counts likely understate the true burden. Diagnostics remain weak despite lab capacity gains and mobile tests for Bundibugyo virus. Congo reports 782 cases and 181 deaths (40 recovered); Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. Authorities and partners must reinforce diagnosis, surveillance, care access, and community engagement; movement of staff and supplies must be facilitated; the window is narrowing.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、DRCのエボラ流行への対応が危機の規模に対応していないと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WHOによるPHEIC宣言済み。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で懸念あり。エボラウイルス病は国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: WHOにより2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言済み。DRC内でIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州に感染拡大。ウガンダへの越境感染も確認（19例、死亡2例）。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めず。MSFを含む国際支援の必要性が明記されており、社会政治的関心も極めて高い。セキュリティ悪化に伴う対応困難が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Šírenie eboly v KDR je rýchlejšie ako reakcia zdravotníkov | TNLIVE.sk
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread of Ebola in the DRC is faster than the health workers' response | TNLIVE.sk
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri in the northeast; cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu) is spreading faster than the response. Since the May 15 declaration, MSF says the true scale remains unclear; transmission is outpacing the response. MSF notes the outbreak may have circulated weeks prior to the declaration. WHO data show 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths in the DRC; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. The Bundibugyo variant is circulating; there is no approved vaccine or treatment. Transmission occurs via close contact and bodily fluids, causing hemorrhagic fever; the outbreak has killed over 15,000 people in Africa in the last 50 years. Access to communities is hampered by security concerns, and testing is a major weakness in the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国におけるエボラの拡大は医療従事者の対応より速い | TNLIVE.sk
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当し、エボラ出血熱は極めて重大な国際的脅威。DRCおよびウガンダでの確認感染例と死亡例があり、ワクチン・治療法が利用不可で、対応が感染拡大に追いつかない状況。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて高病原性で死亡率が高い。記事はDRCでの急速な拡大を強調し、MSFは実際の規模が不明確であること、対応が感染拡大に追いつかないことを指摘。セキュリティ上の懸念により地域へのアクセスが制限されている。Bundibugyo変種が流行中で、ワクチンおよび承認された治療法が利用不可。発生地域にはUgandaも含まれており、越境感染の可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: Cegah Penularan Virus, PPIH Pantau Kesehatan Jamaah Haji Aceh |Republika Online
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Prevent Virus Transmission, PPIH Monitors the Health of Aceh Hajj Pilgrims | Republika Online
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-15, Aceh's Hajj health authorities (PPIH Embarkasi Aceh Bidang Kesehatan) initiated proactive monitoring to prevent virus transmission from returning Aceh pilgrims from Saudi Arabia. Health officials, led by Ali Isha Wardana of Banda Aceh's Class 1 Quarantine Center, will screen arrivals with temperature checks not exceeding 38°C and maintain two weeks of surveillance after pilgrims return to their districts. The focus includes endemic diseases and contagious viruses such as COVID-19 and Hantavirus. If symptoms arise, samples will be collected for laboratory testing. Collaboration with the Banda Aceh Public Health Laboratory (Labkesmas Banda Aceh) will process specimens for Hantavirus, COVID-19, and other relevant pathogens. The effort emphasizes early detection and management to prevent transmission within Aceh.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス伝播を防止、PPIHはアチェ巡礼者の健康を監視
triage.triage_reason: サウジアラビアからの帰国巡礼者に対するCOVID-19およびハンタウイルスのスクリーニング体制が構築されており、異常検知および流行可能性に関する基準を満たす。ただし現時点で実際の患者発生ではなく予防的監視段階であり、情報不足のため経過観察判定。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的監視体制の構築を報じており、実際の患者発生や流行の報告ではない。ただしハンタウイルスおよびCOVID-19という複数病原体への対応、国際的な移動リスク、ヒト-ヒト感染可能性が存在する。サウジアラビアはイベント発生地ではなく、出発地点として記載されているため verified_locations には含めない。続報での患者発生報告時には PICKUP 判定への昇格が必要。

article.articleHeadline: कांगो में इबोला से 181 मौतें ,782 मामलों की पुष्टि हुई -
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola kills 181 in Congo; 782 cases confirmed.
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa reported on June 15, 2026, that in the Democratic Republic of the Congo Ebola has caused 181 deaths and 782 confirmed cases, with total cases likely higher since outbreak confirmation began on May 15. Contact tracing has reached only 56% of contacts. The current outbreak is driven by the rare Bundibugyo virus; there is no approved vaccine or treatment. To date, 56 people have recovered, giving an estimated case fatality rate of about 23%. The outbreak is concentrated in eastern Ituri province, which accounts for over 90% of cases, and the disease has crossed the border into Uganda.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラウイルスが181人を殺害；782例が確認された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルスによる大規模感染で死亡率23%、既にウガンダへの国境越境確認。国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国での爆発的なエボラ感染を主題としており、ウガンダへの越境も記載されているが、サマリーの主題・確認された症例・死亡数の統計はいずれもDRCに限定されている。DRCのみを verified_locations に列挙。ワクチンおよび治療法が不在である点、接触者追跡が56%に留まっている点が管理可能性を著しく低下させている。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo'da Ebola salgını hızlanıyor! - Bursa Hakimiyet
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak accelerates in the Congo!
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, 72 new Ebola cases were reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo, driving total confirmed cases to 782 and deaths to 181, with 32 new fatalities in the last day. The outbreak—caused by Bundibugyo Ebola virus—is centered in Ituri, which accounts for over 90% of cases, and has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, with cross-border transmission into Uganda. Recoveries total 56; case fatality rate ~23%. Authorities warn the true case count may be higher. Challenges include security problems, underfunding, and weak contact tracing (only 56%), hampering containment amid conflict that has displaced about 1 million people in Ituri. Dense forests and mobile populations hinder surveillance. WHO and Africa CDC are scaling up testing, contact tracing, and treatment; there is no approved vaccine or therapy for Bundibugyo virus.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラアウトブレイクが加速している！
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。確認症例782件、死亡181件のエボラウイルスアウトブレイク、国際的な越境感染（ウガンダ）、高い死亡率（23%）、セキュリティ課題と弱い接触追跡により、重大な公衆衛生上の影響と国際的拡大リスクが確認される。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダへの越境感染」と記述されており、主要なアウトブレイクはコンゴのIturi地域が中心。DRCのみを対象国として列挙。Bundibugyo Ebolavirus、接触追跡率56%、推定実症例数が報告数より高い可能性がある点が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Xénophobie en Afrique du Sud : la RDC envoie une mission de choc pour sauver ses enfants - Ébola en toile de fond, le double drame - Cameroun24.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Xenophobia in South Africa: the DRC sends a crack team on a mission to rescue its children - Ebola in the background, the double tragedy - Cameroun24.net
article.articleSummary: DRC dispatches an inter-ministerial mission to South Africa to protect Congolese nationals amid escalating xenophobic violence in Durban, where about 5,000 migrants have been displaced; Malawi has repatriated 1,000 citizens on June 13, with other nations (Ghana, Zimbabwe, Mozambique, Nigeria) initiating emergency evacuations. The mission will assess protection measures, humanitarian aid, and voluntary return options if lives are at risk. In parallel, Ebola continues to devastate eastern DRC, declared May 15 in Ituri; as of June 15, 2026, 181 laboratory-confirmed deaths and 782 cases, with 32 deaths and 72 new cases reported in the latest daily update, yielding a case fatality rate around 21%. The outbreak has crossed into Uganda. WHO notes Ebola is a bat-borne zoonosis; distrust, reduced international aid, and armed conflict worsen response and risk persistence.

triage.headline_ja: 南アフリカでの外国人嫌悪：コンゴ民主共和国が国民救出ミッション派遣 - 背景にあるエボラ、二重危機
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準5つ全て該当（重症度21%の致命率、国際的拡大、長期曝露、管理可能性低い）。エボラ出血熱の確認症例・死亡数増加、複数国への越境、複数国の緊急疎開実施により社会的・政治的関心が顕著。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCのIturi州でのエボラ発生が主要テーマ。2026年6月15日時点で782例、181死亡（CFR約21%）、ウガンダへの越境確認。南アフリカの外国人嫌悪による人道危機が並行しているが、Bluedot発生地域リストに含まれるGhana等は背景的言及のみで、実際の病原体発生地はDRC（Ituri）。Zimbabwe、Mozambique、Nigeria、Malawi、Uganda等は疎開・対応国として言及されるが、サマリー上では当該国でのエボラ発生は確認されず、対象国リストではDRCとGhanaのみに限定。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah patient remains on ventilator; no new cases in Kozhikode
article.articleSummary: Kerala's Nipah case in Kozhikode remains critical as the patient at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital is ventilated; no new Nipah infections reported in the state as of 15 June 2026. The patient received a second monoclonal antibody dose per ICMR guidelines. A healthcare worker close-contact twice tested negative. Seven individuals were admitted for observation; two close relatives were discharged after symptom resolution and prior negative tests. Another close relative under quarantine was admitted for observation on Sunday; six people remain under hospital observation. A further healthcare worker sample was sent for testing. No new cases or contacts added; total surveillance list stands at 103 contacts (4 very high-risk, 14 high-risk, 85 low-risk), including 45 healthcare workers. A central team visited a Feroke private hospital; field surveillance continues in Ramanattukara, with 46 households visited in Division 5. Since confirmation in Kozhikode district on June 11, all tests have been negative, with no secondary infections reported.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルス患者は人工呼吸器装着のまま; コジコード地区で新規感染報告なし
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスの確認症例1件（重症）が存在し、異常・予想外な出来事であるが、現時点で新規感染がなく、接触者管理が機能している状況。情報不足のため継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはIHR基準2つ以上を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準も3つ該当。しかし現在のところ新規感染報告がなく、接触者管理と監視体制が整備されている。患者が人工呼吸器装着中であり重症であること、ニパウイルスが高い致死率を持つ病原体であることから、継続的なシグナル監視が必須。配信日が2026年6月15日と将来日付のため、データの妥当性確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Africa CDC chief welcomes China's support, urges aligned global action against Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: As of June 15, 2026, Bundibugyo Ebola virus outbreak continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Africa CDC Director General Jean Kaseya welcomes China’s firm commitment to Africa’s public health priorities, with Africa Union coordinating partner support under a single continental response plan to fight Ebola and reduce duplication. A five-member Chinese expert team arrived in Kinshasa on June 2 for a three-month mission to bolster the DRC’s outbreak response. The China-Africa CDC partnership aims to enhance technical cooperation, training, laboratory strengthening, emergency readiness, supply chain support, and broader health security. Global partners are considered critical, with the most useful aid being fast, coordinated, and aligned with needs identified by affected countries under the continental plan.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDC長官が中国の支援を歓迎、エボラ発生に対する協調的グローバル行動を促促す
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）がDRCで継続中であり、IHR基準4つ全て該当。国際的な対応調整が進行中で、公開情報も高い。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはUgandaとChinaも含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCのBundibugyo地域での継続的な発生が主題。Ugandaは記事では言及されず、Chinaは支援国として述べられているのみのため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。国際的な支援体制が機能していることが確認され、公衆衛生上の深刻な懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: Mosquito Nets Cut Malaria Sharply, But Resistance Threatens Hard-Won Gains | Outlook India
article.articleSummary: Malaria in India shows regional variation in long-lasting insecticidal net (LLIN) effectiveness, indicating local conditions drive outcomes. Over two decades, India has seen a dramatic decline in malaria burden, with government data indicating sharp reductions in both cases and deaths, attributed to enhanced surveillance, early diagnosis, prompt treatment, indoor residual spraying, and widespread LLIN distribution in endemic districts. Yet the gains are threatened by rising insecticide resistance in vector populations, which could erode net efficacy and complicate control efforts. The article emphasizes that national improvements mask substantial local disparities and suggests that sustaining progress will require continued investment in vector control, tailored interventions, and ongoing monitoring to adapt strategies as resistance patterns emerge.

triage.headline_ja: 蚊帳がマラリアを劇的に削減、しかし薬剤耐性が苦労して得た成果を脅かす | Outlook India
triage.triage_reason: インドでのマラリア対策の成功と薬剤耐性リスクについての分析記事。異常・予想外性とマネージャビリティの2基準に該当するが、現在の公開情報では国際的な拡大リスクや重症度に関する明確な証拠が不足しており、継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: インドのマラリア対策における薬剤耐性の出現は地域差を伴いながら進行している。LLINの効果が低下しつつある地域が存在し、対策強化の必要性が示唆されている。現時点ではアウトブレイクや急激な悪化の報告はないが、ベクター制御の失敗リスクとして監視継続が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: L'Ouganda prépare sa première campagne de vaccination contre la fièvre aphteuse
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Uganda is preparing its first vaccination campaign against foot-and-mouth disease.
article.articleSummary: Uganda is launching its first large-scale vaccination campaign against foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) from July–August 2026, as part of a shift to proactive animal health management. The biannual mass campaign will target about 45.5 million susceptible animals across cattle (16.5 million), goats (17.4 million), sheep (4.5 million) and pigs (8 million). The government will supply vaccines, cold chain, logistics and veterinary supervision; farmers will pay a subsidized per-dose fee (8,000 shillings for cattle and pigs; 4,000 shillings for goats and sheep). Access requires registration in a national farmers database to improve coverage. FMD is a major economic threat in East Africa, with 2023 FAO data reporting outbreaks in over 40 Ugandan districts and ongoing episodes in 2024–2025. The campaign aligns with a Nairobi-based 2026–2035 regional framework for FMD control, while Southern Africa reports renewed outbreaks in Zimbabwe, Zambia, Botswana, Lesotho and Eswatini.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダが口蹄疫に対する初の予防接種キャンペーンを準備中
triage.triage_reason: 口蹄疫は東アフリカにおける重大な経済脅威であり、複数国での発生が報告されているが、本記事の主題はウガンダの予防接種キャンペーン計画であり、対象国での積極的な新規発生報告ではない。情報不足により経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はウガンダの予防接種キャンペーン計画であり、新規発生のシグナルではない。ザンビアはサマリー内で南アフリカの再流行地域として言及されているため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。IHR基準は該当（2つ以上）するが、PICKUP基準としてはスクリーニング基準1つ以上かつ社会的関心が明確でないため WATCH 判定とした。

article.articleHeadline: PS Muthoni: Kenya remains at high risk of Ebola
article.articleSummary: Kenya remains at high risk of an Ebola outbreak as of 2026-06-15, with zero confirmed cases to date. Cross-border movement with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), which has 635 Ebola cases, and Uganda, with 18 cases, keeps Kenya on high alert. Authorities have activated heightened surveillance, entry-point checks at airports and border crossings, and fully mobilized rapid response teams to detect and contain suspected infections swiftly. Ebola spreads through direct contact with blood, bodily fluids, or contaminated materials; incubation is 2–21 days. Symptoms include fever, fatigue, headache, sore throat, muscle pain, vomiting, diarrhoea, and possible bleeding. The disease is often fatal if not treated early (WHO: about 50% fatality rate). Ebola was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River in the DRC. No Kenyan cases have been reported yet.

triage.headline_ja: PS Muthoni: ケニアはエボラ出血熱のリスクが高いままである
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響の可能性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で複数該当。隣接国での活発な流行に伴う越境感染リスクと高度な警戒体制が確認される。
triage.notes: ケニアは対象国リストに含まれないが、DRCで635例の確診例、ウガンダで18例の確診例が報告されており、隣接国での流行が ケニアへの越境感染リスクを高めている。DRCは対象国に含まれるため verified_locations に加えた。インドは対象国リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーにはインドへの言及がないため、本来は除外されるべき。ただしDRCとの越境リスク評価により シグナルとしてPICKUP判定。

article.articleHeadline: Број потврђених случајева оболелих од еболе у Конгу повћао се на 782
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in Congo has risen to 782.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 782 confirmed Ebola cases, including 181 deaths. In the last 24 hours, 72 new cases and 29 new deaths were recorded, a record daily increase. The outbreak centers on Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, regions long affected by armed conflict. The appearance of an Ebola strain was reported on 15 May, though officials say the virus had been spreading quietly for weeks, complicating containment. This outbreak ranks among the largest globally, highlighting ongoing challenges in surveillance, case finding, and infection-control efforts in conflict-affected areas. Information is from the Ministry of Health and published via X.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ確認患者数が782人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。大規模なエボラ流行で死亡者多数、国際的拡大リスクが高く、渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州での大規模エボラ流行。782確認患者、181死亡、24時間で72新規患者・29新規死亡は記録的増加。武力紛争地域での発生により対応困難。5月15日に株の報告だが数週間前から静かに拡大していた。グローバルに最大級の流行の一つ。

article.articleHeadline: Congo sees sharpest daily rise in Ebola cases since outbreak began
article.articleSummary: In Congo, the Bundibugyo-strain Ebola outbreak is intensifying. Over a 24-hour period, 72 new cases were confirmed, bringing the total to 782 infections and 181 deaths (29 additional fatalities). Forty patients have recovered, for a case fatality rate of about 23%. Officials say the surge reflects ongoing transmission alongside enhanced detection, with more community reports and active investigations. Declared on May 15, the outbreak is thought to have circulated for weeks before identification. Bundibugyo was not initially included in testing, and there is no widely available vaccine for this variant, unlike Zaire strains. Contact tracing coverage has fallen to 56%. The World Health Organization is expanding testing, treatment and tracing; Africa CDC is strengthening labs and community engagement. More than 90% of cases are in Ituri, with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border spread to Uganda, amid conflict and displacement complicating response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ出血熱の1日当たりの患者数が過去最高を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な拡大、国際的拡大のリスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目該当。エボラ出血熱の急速な増加と国際的拡大は明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo strain のエボラ出血熱。782感染、181死亡（致死率23%）。1日当たり72例の急速な増加。ワクチン未利用の株。ウガンダへの越境拡大も確認。紛争と混乱が対応を複雑化。WHO及びアフリカCDCが対応支援中。接触者追跡カバレッジが56%と低下。

article.articleHeadline: ONG Médicos Sem Fronteiras alerta para surto de ebola fora de controle no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warns of an out-of-control Ebola outbreak in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues to outpace response efforts. After one month, transmission is spreading across eastern provinces Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Ituri reporting the vast majority of cases (nearly 95%). Health authorities have officially documented over 650 confirmed infections and more than 130 deaths, though MSF warns these figures likely underrepresent the true scope due to gaps in surveillance, diagnosis, and contact tracing. MSF emergency coordinator Kate White says many treatment centers are overwhelmed; patients arrive at advanced disease stages, and many had not been identified or monitored as contacts before seeking care. Limited access to diagnostic kits in insecure communities and significant delays in lab results hinder early case detection. Ebola’s hallmark symptoms include fever, weakness, muscle pains, vomiting, diarrhea, and bleeding; transmission predominantly via contact with bodily fluids.

triage.headline_ja: 国際医療支援団体『国境なき医師団』がコンゴのエボラ出血熱の流行が制御不能な状態にあると警告
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行が複数州で急速に拡大し、650人以上の確認患者と130人以上の死亡者が発生。IHR基準の全4項目に該当し、国際的な公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は高リスク病原体であり、IHR基準全4項目・WPRO基準全5項目に該当。治療施設の過負荷、接触追跡と早期検出の遅延が報告されており、対応能力の問題が顕著。国際医療支援団体による警告報告であり、国際的な関心が高い。DRCは対象国リストに含まれている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo registra aumento sin precedentes de casos de ébola en un solo día
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo reports an unprecedented surge in Ebola cases in a single day.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) continues to surge, concentrated in Ituri province in the east, with cases crossing into North and South Kivu and spilling over into Uganda. As of 2026-06-15, the health ministry reported 72 new cases in 24 hours, bringing total confirmed to 782 and deaths to 181 (29 new deaths); the fatality rate is 23%. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo virus, a rare strain; Zaire, the more common form with a vaccine, has driven most prior Congo outbreaks. The rise reflects intensified surveillance; contact tracing stands at 56%, down from last week. WHO is boosting testing, tracing, and treatment, with large supplies delivered. Ituri accounts for over 90% of cases; nearly 1 million people have been displaced, and cross-border spread to Uganda is occurring. The outbreak was declared on May 15.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが1日で前例のないエボラ患者数の急増を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行で深刻な公衆衛生影響、稀なBundibugyo株による異常事象、ウガンダへの国際的拡大、渡航制限のリスクが顕著。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て満たす。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。DRCの対象国リストへの含有確認済み。Bundibugyo株は稀で、ワクチンが限定的。接触者追跡率56%と不十分。約100万人の流民発生。この流行は5月15日に宣言されており、新規性・重症度・管理困難性の観点から緊急対応が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Save The Children afirma que 19 niños han muerto por ébola en el este de la RDC - Proceso Digital
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Save the Children states that 19 children have died of Ebola in eastern DRC - Proceso Digital.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak of Ebola virus disease in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu) since May 15 has prompted Save the Children to report 19 child deaths and 52 pediatric cases among minors through mid-June. Of those infected, 16 were infants or young children. Africa CDC analysis cited by the NGO shows children aged 14 and under have more than double the mortality risk of those aged 15–44. Early identification, referral and intensive care are critical, particularly as malnutrition, malaria, anemia, poverty, displacement, and disrupted health services and vaccination worsen outcomes. Long-term effects include school dropout and increased risks of child marriage and exploitation. Official tallies: 181 deaths and 782 cases in Ituri, and eastern DRC provinces of North and South Kivu; Uganda reports 2 deaths and 19 cases, including 14 imported from the DRC. The outbreak remains active; fear and misinformation threaten care-seeking and contact tracing.

triage.headline_ja: セーブ・ザ・チルドレンがコンゴ民主共和国東部でエボラにより19人の子どもが死亡したと報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラアウトブレイク進行中で複数国に広がり、子ども中心の感染で高い重症度。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境例（2死亡、19症例）が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。記事サマリーが2026年6月15日付けであり、現在時点からの時間差に注意。アウトブレイク進行中で栄養不良・マラリア併存によるリスク悪化の懸念あり。

article.articleHeadline: G7 скоординує відповідь на спалах Еболи в Африці - Кошта
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: G7 will coordinate the response to the Ebola outbreak in Africa - Koshta
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompts G7 coordination, with health resources and personnel mobilized to support affected states and halt further spread. On 2026-06-15, António Costa stated that G7 countries are already mobilizing medical resources and other capabilities and that international coordination is essential to stop transmission. He underscored Ebola as a global problem requiring a united response. The European Union will continue backing the affected countries and work closely with international partners to curb spread. The article provides no case or death counts, no laboratory confirmation details, no transmission sources, or specifics on imported/exported cases; it focuses on strategic resource mobilization and cross-border cooperation among G7 members to reinforce outbreak response in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: G7がアフリカのエボラ流行への対応を調整 - コスタ
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的な流行であり、IHR基準の深刻な公衆衛生影響（Yes）、異常性（Yes）、国際的拡大リスク（Yes）、渡航・貿易制限リスク（Yes）のすべて4基準に該当。G7レベルの国際調整が進行中であり、社会的・政治的関心も極めて高い。フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ流行が明示されているが、ウガンダ（対象国リストに非含有）はスクリーニング対象外のため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ含める。G7による国際調整、医療資源動員など外交・戦略的対応が進行中であることが大きな懸念。ただし記事には具体的な患者数、死亡数、検査確認情報が記載されていない点に留意。

article.articleHeadline: G7 скоординирует ответ на вспышку Эболы в Африке - Кошта
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: G7 will coordinate the response to an Ebola outbreak in Africa - Koshta
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, the G7 will coordinate international efforts to combat an Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. European Council President Antonio Costa indicated that G7 nations are already mobilizing medical resources, personnel and other capacities to support the affected states and to halt further transmission. He underscored that the Ebola outbreak is a global problem necessitating a coordinated international response and that the European Union will continue to back the affected countries, working closely with international partners to contain the spread. The discussions are expected to be a key topic at the upcoming G7 summit, with emphasis on mobilization and alignment of resources to curb the outbreak in Africa.

triage.headline_ja: G7がアフリカのエボラ流行への対応を調整 - コスタ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数項目該当。高い社会的・政治的関心を伴う。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC とウガンダでのエボラ流行が述べられているが、対象国リストに Uganda (1343192) が含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを列挙。G7による国際調整という高レベルの政治的関与が確認でき、フルRRA実施の優先度は高い。

article.articleHeadline: 港浸大发现中药提取物 可抑制埃博拉、禽流感等病毒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: HKBU discovers a traditional Chinese medicine extract that can inhibit Ebola, avian influenza and other viruses.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong Baptist University researchers from the School of Chinese Medicine report isolating an antiviral lignan compound from a traditional Chinese medicinal plant. The compound effectively inhibits multiple viruses that affect humans and animals, including avian influenza virus, Ebola virus, and the novel coronavirus (SARS-CoV-2), as well as dengue virus, Japanese encephalitis virus, and Zika virus. The antiviral mechanism blocks endosomal acidification, preventing viral entry and intracellular replication, enabling broad activity and resilience to mutations that confer drug resistance. The team envisions developing traditional-medicine–based applications such as antiviral feed additives and veterinary drugs to improve animal health, while laying groundwork for future human antiviral therapies. Location: Hong Kong. Published date: 2026-06-15.

triage.headline_ja: 香港浸会大学が中薬抽出物を発見 - エボラ、鳥インフルエンザなど複数ウイルスを抑制可能
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症の新規発生報告ではなく、研究成果の発表であり、実際のアウトブレイク事象は報告されていない。したがってIHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事は香港浸会大学による医学研究の成果報告であり、感染症の実際の発生や拡大を報告するイベント情報ではない。Bluedot APIが複数の疾患名を抽出しているのは記事内での言及に基づくものと考えられるが、シグナルトリアージの対象となる公衆衛生上のイベント（outbreak/事例報告）ではなく、純粋な研究開発ニュースであるため、除外判定が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Health: No new Ebola case in Uganda in past 10 days
article.articleSummary: Uganda reports 10 consecutive days with no new Ebola cases as of June 15, 2026, reflecting intensified surveillance, contact tracing, and cross-border collaboration with the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). The latest situation shows Uganda with 19 confirmed cases (14 imported, 5 local), 10 patients in treatment, 7 recoveries, and 2 deaths. A total of 826 contacts have been identified; 582 completed the 21-day follow-up, 233 remain under active monitoring. Uganda has conducted 1,395 Ebola tests, with border screening continuing. DRC and Uganda health authorities met in Aru town to strengthen a joint Ebola response plan ahead of its launch, focusing on border communities around Lake Albert. WHO declared an emergency on May 17 following the eastern DRC outbreak in early May. The plan aims to harmonise surveillance, improve information sharing, and boost capacity on both sides; authorities urge use of official border points to aid early detection.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダ、過去10日間で新たなエボラ患者なし
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上重大な疾病であり、複数のIHR基準に該当する可能性があるが、記事の主要なメッセージは「新規患者ゼロ」と対応の進展であり、緊急度は相対的に低い。ただし国際的な連携や継続的な脅威があるため、経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は緊急事態としてのピークを過ぎた段階（新規患者ゼロ）を報告しているが、エボラは公衆衛生上最重大疾病であり、クロスボーダー対応が進行中。DRCでの継続的な流行と隣接するウガンダでの二次感染リスクがあるため、シグナルとして認識される必要があるが、現時点では制御下にある。Lake AlbertはウガンダとDRCの境界地域であり、地理的検証は適切。

article.articleHeadline: Malappuram boy dies of shigellosis
article.articleSummary: Seven-year-old boy from Kodur, near Malappuram, died of shigellosis at Government Medical College Hospital, Kozhikode, after fever and diarrhea; he was a Class II student at AUP School. This death marks the fourth shigellosis fatality in Kerala this year. Kerala has reported 135 shigella infections to date, with Kozhikode accounting for about half. In response to monsoon-related water- and food-borne disease risks, health authorities in Malappuram and Kozhikode have intensified surveillance and preventive measures, urging safe food and water and strict hygiene. The Malappuram district administration will run a two-week campaign against communicable diseases from June 17 to 30, involving Health, Food Safety, Education and Local Self-Government departments. Actions include hotel/food-establishment inspections, legal action for repeat food-safety violations, and testing and chlorinating drinking water in schools, households, and public places, plus awareness programs on hygiene and sanitation to prevent outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: マラッパラム地区の少年がシゲロイシスで死亡
triage.triage_reason: インド（ケララ州）でシゲロイシスによる死亡事例が報告され、年内4例目の死亡、135件の感染が確認されている。水・食物媒介感染症の季節的リスク上昇に伴い、複数州で感染症対策が強化されている状況は重症度・管理上の懸念を示唆し、シグナルとしてピックアップが妥当。
triage.notes: シゲロイシスは水・食物媒介感染症であり、モンスーン時期の環境要因（水・食品汚染）と関連。ケララ州での複数州での多発（年内4死亡、135感染例）、複数地域での同時多発的な感染報告、行政による2週間キャンペーン展開など、食水媒介感染症の季節的流行リスク増加を示唆している。テランガナ州の地名も記事内で抽出されているが、サマリー上では具体的な症例報告がなくケララ州が主題であることを確認。

article.articleHeadline: Γιατί η νέα έξαρση του Έμπολα είναι τόσο δύσκολο να περιοριστεί
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Why the new Ebola outbreak is so hard to contain.
article.articleSummary: WHO has declared a public health emergency for a new Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, caused by the rare Bundibugyo strain. There is no licensed vaccine or approved therapy for this strain. The outbreak is centered in Ituri Province, with spillover to neighboring areas and Uganda. Reports indicate hundreds of cases and dozens of deaths. The first known case was a nurse who developed symptoms in late April and died soon after. Transmission begins from animals (primarily fruit bats) to humans, then spreads through contact with infected body fluids. Incubation is 2–21 days; early symptoms include fever, headache, and fatigue, followed by vomiting, diarrhea, organ failure, and sometimes internal or external bleeding. Early diagnostic tests failed to detect this strain, delaying confirmation. Ongoing conflict and displacement hamper response, but laboratories, faster diagnostics, and intensified contact tracing are in place; regional risk remains low but requires sustained international cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいエボラ出血熱の流行がなぜこんなに封じ込めるのが難しいのか
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常な希少株、国際的拡大リスク、国際協力の必要性）。WHOが公開衛生上の緊急事態を宣言した新規エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）であり、フルRRA実施必須。
triage.notes: Uganda（ウガンダ）は発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「spillover to neighboring areas and Uganda」と言及されているものの、主要な感染事例報告はDRC（特にIturi Province）に集中しており、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めていない。希少なBundibugyo株であり、ワクチンと承認された治療法がない点が重大。紛争と住民移動が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Konge toliau sparčiai plinta Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola continues to spread rapidly in the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to spread rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with a northeastern outbreak intensifying. The DRC's health service reports Ebola infections rising by 72 in 24 hours to 782, while confirmed deaths increased by 32 to 181. The case fatality rate stands at 23.1%. Currently 359 patients are hospitalized or in isolation. Contact tracing remains a major bottleneck; the WHO says 90% tracing of contacts is needed to halt transmission, but coverage is 56.5%. MSF warns that surveillance gaps a month after the Ituri province outbreak threaten control. Katy White, MSF emergency medical coordinator in Congo, notes overcrowded treatment centers and many patients presenting with advanced disease, often not identified as contacts or traced. Limited testing capacity and slow lab-result turnaround hinder case identification. Ebola spreads through direct contact and bodily fluids; for the Bandibado Ebola variant, there is no vaccine or specific treatment per the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが急速に拡大し続けている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は公衆衛生上の深刻な影響を持ち、高い致死率（23.1%）、急速な感染拡大、国際的な懸念を呼び起こす疾患であり、フルRRA実施対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは24時間で782件確認患者（72件新規）、181件死亡（32件新規）を報告。接触者追跡カバレッジが目標の90%に対し56.5%に留まる。治療施設の過密、検査容量の制限、Ituri州での監視ギャップが制御努力を阻害。Bandibado Ebola変異体はワクチンなし。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため、verified_locationsに正式に記載。

article.articleHeadline: Shigella outbreak in Kerala: Seven-year-old dies, fourth death this year
article.articleSummary: Shigella outbreak intensifies in Kerala, India, with a seven-year-old dying after admission to a government medical college hospital, marking the fourth Shigella-related death in Kerala this year and the third in June. A one-year-old remains in critical condition in the ICU at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital. Health data show 135 confirmed shigellosis cases across Kerala since January, with Kozhikode reporting 68 cases. In June, 62 confirmed cases and 17 suspected infections have been recorded, and officials confirmed three new cases on June 14. Malappuram is under intensified surveillance as authorities urge strict hygiene, safe drinking water, and prompt medical care for fever, diarrhoea, vomiting, or blood in stools. Shigella spreads via contaminated food, unsafe water, and close contact; while often mild, it can be severe in vulnerable individuals.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラム州のシゲラ菌感染症の流行：7歳児が死亡、今年4番目の死亡例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、予想外の集団発生、国際的懸念の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準では異常性・重症度・流行しやすさの3基準に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: ケーラム州での進行中のシゲラ菌感染症流行。2026年1月以降135例の確定患者、年間4死亡例、6月だけで62確定例と17疑い例。特にコジコード地区（68例）とマラプラム地区で集中。飲料水汚染による人-ヒト感染が確認されており、衛生状況の改善が必要。脆弱層（1歳児が集中治療室に入院）への重症化リスク高。インド国内の公衆衛生上の懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: ديدان الشريط "ثعلب" القاتلة مرتبطة بمرض مميت تم اكتشافه في الحياة البرية على الساحل الغربي
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The deadly fox tapeworms associated with a fatal disease discovered in wildlife on the West Coast.
article.articleSummary: Fox tapeworm, Echinococcus multilocularis, was detected in wildlife on the West Coast for the first time in the wild, with 37 of 100 wolves sampled near Puget Sound, Washington testing positive. The findings, published in PLOS Neglected Tropical Diseases earlier this year, show a European lineage now dominant in the United States and Canada. Before 2010 the parasite was rare in North America, confined largely to isolated Alaskan islands; over the past 15 years it has spread, with rising canine and human cases in the U.S. and Canada’s Midwest and, more recently, the West Coast. While human risk remains low, exposure occurs via ingestion of eggs from contaminated soil or foods or through handling infected pets. In humans, cysts (fluid-filled lesions) develop mainly in the liver and lungs and can grow for years; two forms exist: cystic echinococcosis and alveolar echinococcosis. Globally, West China is the region most affected.

triage.headline_ja: 致死的なキツネ条虫は西海岸の野生動物で発見された致命的な病気に関連している
triage.triage_reason: エキノコッカス多包条虫の北米での分布拡大は公衆衛生上の懸念材料であるが、現在のところ人的被害は限定的であり、記事には対象国（WPRO地域）の実際の発生が含まれていない。米国での野生動物における感染拡大の報告であり、引き続き情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な発生地は米国（Washington, Alaska, California等）およびカナダであるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれない。ただし記事末尾で「グローバルには西部中国が最も影響を受ける地域」と述べられているため、Chinaのみを verified_locations に含める。人的被害は現在のところ低いとされているが、パラサイト分布の地理的拡大と野生動物での感染率上昇は長期的なリスク要因として監視対象となる。

article.articleHeadline: MSF alerta de que la respuesta al brote de ébola en RDC sigue sin ser acorde a la magnitud de la crisis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF warns that the response to the Ebola outbreak in the DRC remains inadequate to the magnitude of the crisis.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of Congo (Ituri, North Kivu, South Kivu) declared May 15; WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17. As of June 15, 2026, DRC authorities report 782 cases and 181 deaths, with 40 recoveries; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths, signaling cross-border spread. MSF warns that the response remains inadequate for the crisis magnitude: gaps in surveillance, diagnosis, and contact tracing; treatment centers in Ituri are overwhelmed and many patients arrive in late stages with untracked contacts. Diagnostic capacity has improved with new lab capacity and hundreds of mobile tests for Bundibugyo virus, yet access is limited by insecurity and delays in results. The outbreak spans Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu; ongoing insecurity and displacement hinder containment and likely undercount official figures. MSF urges accelerated diagnosis, surveillance, healthcare access, and community engagement as the window to control narrows.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、RDCのエボラ出血熱の流行対応が危機の規模に見合っていないと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WHO緊急事態宣言済み、782症例・181死亡、国境越え拡大、対応不十分。
triage.notes: WHO公式な国際緊急事態宣言（May 17）済み。DRC782例・181死亡、ウガンダ19例・2死亡との国境越え拡大を確認。MSFによる対応不十分警告は深刻な管理可能性の懸念を示す。記事でウガンダにも言及されているが、サマリーの主題・詳細はDRC内での流行であり、対象国リスト上はDRCのみ検証された。

article.articleHeadline: Santé : le Gabon intègre un projet vaccinal de 7,3 milliards de FCFA contre la dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Health: Gabon joins a 7.3-billion FCFA dengue vaccine project.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, Gabon has been selected to participate in the international DENSTAR Dengue Efficacy and Safety Trial in African Region, a four-year project with an €11.09 million (about FCFA 7.3 billion) budget to accelerate development of DengiAll, a dengue vaccine tailored for Africa. Funded by the EU's Global Health EDCTP3 program, the consortium includes European, American, and African partners, with Gabon represented by the Centre de Recherches Médicales de Lambaréné (CERMEL). Ghana, Mozambique, and the Democratic Republic of Congo are among other participating nations. The vaccine from Panacea Biotec is designed for a single-injection administration without prior serology testing, enabling easier deployment in resource-limited settings. The Gabon-led effort aims to assess safety and efficacy in local populations, bolster public health, and position Gabon as a center of scientific excellence in Central Africa.

triage.headline_ja: 衛生：ガボンがデング熱に対する73億CFAフランのワクチンプロジェクトに参加
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱ワクチンの臨床試験参加に関するニュースであり、実際の感染症集団発生やアウトブレイク報告ではない。対象国（DRC、ガーナ）が含まれるが、イベントは研究・開発段階の公式プロジェクト参加であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外である。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際のデング熱流行の報告ではなく、国際的なワクチン開発プロジェクトへの参加発表である。ガボン（対象国外）が主題であり、DRC・ガーナは参加国として言及されているのみ。シグナルトリアージの対象外としてDISMISS判定とした。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Países lançam iniciativa científica dedicada a estudo do hantavírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Countries launch a scientific initiative dedicated to the study of hantavirus
article.articleSummary: An international initiative, Navis, launched after the Andes virus (Andv) hantavirus outbreak aboard the cruise ship MV Hondius in May this year, unites investigators from 21 countries to study Andv. The project is a natural history study to deepen understanding of transmission dynamics, following exposed individuals to refine incubation periods, immune responses, viral behavior, and determinants of severe disease. The WHO supports rapid activation of international research networks during health emergencies. Participating countries are South Africa, Germany, Australia, Belgium, Canada, Denmark, Spain, the United States, France, Greece, Ireland, Italy, Japan, the Netherlands, New Zealand, the United Kingdom, the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Singapore, Switzerland, and Turkey. Iranian epidemiologist Yazdan Yazdanpanah notes Navis shows what is possible when networks are pre-established before outbreaks. WHO emphasizes harmonized protocols and geographically distributed preparation to ensure future responses start from existing systems rather than building them during crises.

triage.headline_ja: 各国がハンタウイルス研究に専念する科学的イニシアティブを立ち上げ
triage.triage_reason: Andes virus（AndV）ハンタウイルスのアウトブレイク対応としての国際研究イニシアティブ立ち上げ。記事は既発生事象への学術的対応であり、新規発生状況ではなく、現在の実行中アウトブレイク規模の詳細が不明なため。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年5月のクルーズ船MV Hondiusでの既発生アウトブレイクへの事後的な国際研究対応を述べている。新規アウトブレイク情報ではなく、研究イニシアティブの発表が主題。DRCは参加国として列挙されているが、記事本体でのDRCでの新規発生情報は明示されていない。他の列挙国はすべて対象外国。続報でアウトブレイク規模や重症度に関する新情報が得られた場合は再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola is terug. Actie is nú nodig | Caritas International België
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is back. Action is needed now | Caritas International Belgium
article.articleSummary: As of June 15, 2026, Ebola has re-emerged in the Ituri province of the Democratic Republic of Congo. Caritas International Belgium notes local Caritas colleagues are distributing protective equipment, carrying out hygiene measures, and informing residents to prevent further spread of the virus during this health crisis. The message calls for urgent action now and urges support to scale these precautionary activities to the areas most in need. The article focuses on immediate community-level responses rather than clinical details or case counts, underscoring the ongoing Ebola threat and the importance of rapid, well-coordinated preventive actions. It highlights a health crisis in the DRC and the need for international support.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが戻ってきた。今すぐ対策が必要 | カリタス・インターナショナル ベルギー
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病がコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で再出現。IHR基準4つすべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、国際支援の必要性があり、フルRRAに進むべきシグナル。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月15日付けで、エボラの再出現という深刻な病態をカバーしている。DRCでの発生が主題。ベルギーは国際支援・対応組織の本拠地として言及されているため、verified_locationsには含めない。イトゥリ州はDRC内部の行政区域であり、DRCの対象国として統合。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : un mois après la déclaration d'épidémie, MSF s'inquiète de dangereuses lacunes dans la réponse
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: one month after the outbreak was declared, MSF is concerned about dangerous gaps in the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is one month into the outbreak, with spread in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu in the eastern DRC; Ituri accounts for about 95% of cases. Congolese authorities report over 650 confirmed cases and more than 130 deaths, though MSF warns these figures likely underestimate true burden. Testing remains a major weakness despite recent gains and mobile tests for Bundibugyo virus; insecure areas have limited access and treatment centers frequently face delays in results, with North Kivu relying on a single lab and delays of up to a week. The outbreak coincides with concurrent health emergencies; MSF stresses maintaining routine health services—maternal care, vaccination for children, malaria and cholera treatment—as essential to the response. MSF is deploying teams to remote, unstable zones to strengthen detection and response; urgent emphasis on diagnosis, surveillance, access to care, and community engagement, and on facilitating movement of health workers and supplies.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：疫病宣言から1ヶ月後、MSFは対応の危険な欠落を懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、複数のWPRO基準（異常性、重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）を満たす。確認された650例以上の症例と130例以上の死亡を伴うエボラ疫病であり、国際的支援が必要とされている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国のIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu地域でのエボラ疫病を明確に述べており、DRCが主題となっている。複数疾患が記載されているが（コレラ、マラリア）、主要な懸念はエボラ疫病である。MSFによる警告と国際的支援ニーズが示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Вирусолог объяснил, почему не стоит бояться новой пандемии из-за вспышки Эболы - Новости на Вести.ru
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Virologist explains why you shouldn't fear a new pandemic because of the Ebola outbreak - News on Vesti.ru
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, the Ebola fever outbreak in Congo is unlikely to trigger a global pandemic, according to Anatoly Altshtein, chief researcher at the Gamaleya National Center of Epidemiology and Microbiology, in an interview with RT. He asserts modern Western medicine, aided by adequate hygiene, can counter this infection. The virus does not spread via respiratory routes; transmission requires close contact with an infected person and touching the source of infection—blood from the patient. Therefore, Ebola is unlikely to drive a worldwide pandemic. The remarks follow Financial Times reporting that the Congo outbreak could serve as a general rehearsal for a new global pandemic, a risk exacerbated by a crisis in international health financing. The article does not provide case or death counts.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス学者がエボラ流行による新たなパンデミックを恐れるべきではない理由を説明 - ベスティ・ルーのニュース
triage.triage_reason: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱流行が報道されており、IHR基準（異常性、国際的拡大リスク）とWPRO基準（異常性、流行リスク）を複数満たす。対象国DRCが実際の発生地であり、国際的関心も高い。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが『Russian Federation』を発生地域に含めているが、記事サマリーはコンゴでの実際の流行を主題としており、ロシアは専門家コメント発信国であるため除外。case/death countsが記載されていないため重症度については不明と判定。パンデミック懸念が国際メディアで報道されている点が社会的関心の高さを示している。

article.articleHeadline: Congo sigue registrando aumento diario de casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Continues to Record a Daily Increase in Ebola Cases.
article.articleSummary: Congolese authorities report one of the largest daily increases in Ebola cases as the virus spreads rapidly and surveillance improves in an outbreak lasting about a month in one of the world’s most difficult regions. The Health Ministry announced 72 new cases in 24 hours, bringing laboratory-confirmed cases to 782 and deaths to 181 (29 new). The rise reflects rapid transmission but also more active surveillance, with communities reporting suspected cases and response teams investigating. The outbreak was confirmed on May 15, weeks after initial suspicions, suggesting the true case count may be higher than reported.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴは引き続きエボラ患者の日々の増加を記録している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルスの急速な伝播と高い死亡率はフルRRA実施の基準を満たす。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の集団発生であり、24時間で72件の新規確認患者、累積782件の確認患者と181人の死亡（死亡率約23%）が報告されている。発生から約1ヶ月で急速に伝播しており、実際の患者数はさらに多い可能性がある。周辺国への拡散リスクは高い。

article.articleHeadline: Russia helping Uganda contain Ebola threat -- RT Africa
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, Uganda reports 19 confirmed Ebola cases linked to the cross-border Bundibugyo strain outbreak, with 2 deaths and 4 recoveries. The DR Congo outbreak, declared on May 15, has reached 782 cases and 181 deaths nationwide, with new hotspots in Ituri's Nia-Nia and North Kivu's Mabalako added to the affected zones on June 13. Russia is aiding Uganda via joint diagnostics and surveillance, including developing an antibody test kit for Bundibugyo and deploying Russian-made PCR tests in Uganda and DR Congo, as part of broader support after a mobile anti-epidemic laboratory transferred to Uganda in 2024 and used in 2025. Preventive measures—handwashing, temperature screening, mask use, and public awareness—are being expanded, with border surveillance tightened as suspected cases trace to cross-border movement and cross-border facilities established through Ugandan-Congolese cooperation.

triage.headline_ja: ロシア、ウガンダのエボラ脅威封じ込めを支援
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、複数国での流行、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス疾患（致死率高）、複数国での確認、国境を越えた感染拡大、DRC 782例・181死という重大規模から、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでDRC（Ituri州含む）とウガンダでのエボラ流行が詳細に記述されているが、対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみ該当。ウガンダは対象国に含まれないため verified_locations に除外。ロシアの支援活動は文脈情報だが、ロシア自体でのエボラ発生ではないため除外が適切。DRC では記述時点で782例・181死という極めて高い死亡率を示す大規模流行であり、国境を越えた感染拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: 险！南京高淳一居民不知被蜱虫叮咬，涂抹花露水"歪打正着"刺激虫体自行脱落
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Danger! A Gaochun resident in Nanjing was unaware they had been bitten by a tick, and applying camphor water—“a stroke of luck”—stimulated the tick to detach on its own.
article.articleSummary: In Gaochun District, Nanjing, Jiangsu, China, a resident was bitten by a tick on May 31 while weed-pulling in a taro field. The bite occurred under the left armpit and initially resembled a mosquito bite; swelling and systemic symptoms (muscle soreness, chest tightness) developed the next day. The patient applied camphor lotion, which irritated the tick and caused it to detach. After collecting the tick, he sought care at Gaochun People’s Hospital; 15 days of continuous treatment led to gradual recovery. Experts warn ticks carry pathogens that can cause diseases such as fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), Lyme disease, and babesiosis, with SFTS potentially spreading via contact with fluids from severely ill or deceased patients. Preventive measures include avoiding tick habitats, wearing long clothing, applying repellents, checking for ticks on skin and clothing after outdoor activity, and promptly removing attached ticks with tweezers followed by disinfection.

triage.headline_ja: 危険！南京高淳の住民が蜱虫に咬まれていることに気づかず、花露水を塗布して「思いがけない効果」で虫が自然に脱落
triage.triage_reason: 蜱媒介感染症（SFTS、ライム病、バベシア症）の単一患者症例報告であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響は現在認められない。ただし、SFTS は重篤度が高く、患者が回復した点で異常/予想外性がある。追加症例の有無など続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事は単一患者の蜱咬傷症例と、専門家による蜱媒介感染症（SFTS、ライム病、バベシア症）の啓発情報を報道したもの。患者は回復しており、現時点での流行兆候は認められない。SFTS の重篤度と、ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性について注意喚起がなされている点から、スクリーニング基準で「流行しやすさ」「異常性」として判定したが、公衆衛生的な深刻さには至らないと評価。続報を注視する段階と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Cacique Raoni é internado em UTI com infecção grave - 15/06/2026
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chief Raoni is admitted to the ICU with a severe infection - June 15, 2026.
article.articleSummary: Indigenous leader Raoni Metuktire, 94, was admitted to the ICU on 15 June 2026 at Hospital Dois Pinheiros in Sinop, northern Mato Grosso, with a grave infection. A medical bulletin notes renal function changes and laboratory indicators compatible with a severe infection, with the leading hypothesis being septic pulmonary infection associated with aspiration pneumonia after vomiting. He had been at his residence in the Peixoto de Azevedo region when symptoms began; initial vomiting on Saturday, followed by persistent cough, abdominal pain, and small amounts of blood in the mouth on Sunday, leading to dehydration, somnolence, and abdominal distension on admission. He is receiving intravenous fluids, antibiotics, and intensive supportive care, with a status deemed critical requiring continuous multidisciplinary monitoring. This admission follows a prior hospital stay in May for respiratory and gastrointestinal complications; he also spent five days in May for abdominal pain from a hernia.

triage.headline_ja: カシーケ・ラオニがICUに入院 重篤な感染症で - 2026年6月15日
triage.triage_reason: 94歳の先住民指導者の個別症例であり、公衆衛生上の集団発生ではない。疾患が「Unknown Illness」と不明確であり、発生地域がブラジルだが対象国リストに含まれていない。
triage.notes: 本事例はブラジルで発生しているが、ブラジルは対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれていない。また、個別の著名人の病気であり、感染症の集団発生を示す根拠がない。疾患名が「Unknown Illness」と不明確である点も判定の困難さを増す。

article.articleHeadline: MSF alerta de que la respuesta al brote de ébola en RDC sigue sin ser acorde a la magnitud de la crisis
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF warns that the response to the Ebola outbreak in the DRC is still not commensurate with the magnitude of the crisis.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns that the Ebola outbreak in northeastern Democratic Republic of the Congo is advancing faster than the response, one month after its May 15 declaration. The outbreak affects Ituri and the North and South Kivu provinces, with 782 cases and 181 deaths (40 recovered) in DRC; Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths. WHO designated a Public Health Emergency of International Concern two days after the outbreak began. MSF cites gaps in surveillance, diagnosis, and contact tracing; treatment centers in Ituri are overwhelmed and many patients arrive late, with contacts often unidentified. Insecurity hampers access; despite mobile testing for Bundibugyo virus, results remain slow and coverage is limited. The window of opportunity is narrowing; authorities must boost diagnostics, surveillance, community engagement, and access to routine health services to support the response.

triage.headline_ja: MSFがRDCのエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク対応が危機の規模に見合っていないと警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、複数国への国際的拡大が確認されている。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで、死亡率が高く、対応が危機の規模に追いついていない深刻な状況。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUganda（226074）が含まれているが、記事本文では「Uganda reports 19 cases and 2 deaths」と明記されているため、厳密には複数国での発生となる。ただし、主要な発生はDRC（Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu）であり、Ugandaは国境を接する隣国での限定的な事例報告として扱った。PHELIC宣言済み、MSFの公式警告、対応の不足、セキュリティ上の課題など複数の深刻なシグナルが存在。
