article.articleHeadline: 2歲男童感染H9N2甲流 6名家居接觸者及涉事店員無病徵 - 香港商報
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 2-year-old boy infected with H9N2 influenza A; six household contacts and the involved shop assistant were asymptomatic - Hong Kong Commercial Daily
article.articleSummary: Two-year-old boy in Hong Kong diagnosed with low-pathogenic H9N2 avian influenza A; full-genome sequencing confirmed avian-origin virus with no mutations. Environmental sampling at Sha Tin Wo Che Market fresh-food shop and Fung Wo Estate Park identified one positive sample—a tray under chicken cages containing poultry feces—while 16 samples were negative; the virus from the positive sample will undergo further analysis. The boy is hospitalized with mild, stable illness. Six household contacts and the shop attendant have received prophylactic medication and are under medical surveillance, as they remain asymptomatic. Local avian influenza risk remains low; the government’s Influenza Pandemic Response Level stays at Alert. Since 1999, Hong Kong has 11 human H9N2 cases (5 local, 6 imported), with no fatalities. Seasonal flu and COVID-19 activity are rising; vaccination is urged for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 2歳男児がH9N2型インフルエンザAに感染 6名の家居接触者および関連店員は無症状 - 香港商報
triage.triage_reason: ヒトへの鳥インフルエンザH9N2感染例（小児）が確認され、全ゲノムシーケンシングで鳥由来ウイルスが確認されました。環境サンプリングで市場の生鮮食品売り場から陽性検体が検出されており、国際的関心が高いシグナルです。
triage.notes: 香港での鳥インフルエンザH9N2のヒト感染例は1999年以来11例目（国内5例、輸入例6例）で、過去に死亡例なし。本例は2歳小児の軽症例で入院中。市場の家禽飼育環境での検出は継続的な曝露リスクを示唆。WPROスクリーニング基準で「異常性」「流行可能性」「長期曝露」に該当し、かつ政府関心が高いためPICKUPと判定。

article.articleHeadline: বিশ্বকাপে ইবোলার থাবা? রোনাল্ডোদের বিরুদ্ধে খেলবে 'আক্রান্ত' কঙ্গো, কী করবে ট্রাম্প প্রশাসন?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola's grip in the World Cup? The 'infected' Congo will play against Ronaldo's side. What will the Trump administration do?
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, Ebola is spreading in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with 72 new infections reported in a single day, bringing total cases to 782 and deaths to 181, including 32 more fatalities. The outbreak has raised concerns ahead of the World Cup match between DR Congo and Portugal, as players and fans travel to the United States. DR Congo had planned a training camp in the U.S. but canceled after U.S. authorities signaled stringent entry controls. The squad would face a 21-day quarantine to gain entry, otherwise entry would be denied; a warm-up match against Chile was also canceled. The team had recently left Belgium after isolation. U.S. public health officials say the risk of Ebola spreading at the World Cup is very low since the virus is not airborne. An estimated 6.5 million football fans are expected in the United States for the tournament.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップでのエボラの脅威？『感染した』コンゴがロナウドのチームと対戦。トランプ政権は何をするのか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス病の急速な感染者増加（72件/日）と死亡例を含む活発な流行が継続中であり、国際的なスポーツイベント参加に関連した国際拡大リスクが明確に存在する。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUSA、Chile、Portugal、Belgiumも列挙されているが、記事サマリーでは実際のエボラ流行はDRC内での発生が主題であり、他国での患者発生は明記されていない。USAなどは入国管理強化の政治的対応が述べられているが、実際の流行地としては記載されていないため検証対象から除外した。国際スポーツイベント（ワールドカップ）に関連した旅行者を通じた国際拡大リスクが主要な懸念である。

article.articleHeadline: Menace de l'épidémie d'Ebola : le personnel soignant de Délébama en formation pour une éventuelle riposte
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Threat of the Ebola epidemic: Délébama's healthcare workers in training for a possible response
article.articleSummary: Threat of Ebola epidemic prompts training for Délébama healthcare workers. At the hôpital des grandes endémies de Délébama, on the road to Damara, medical staff are being trained to respond to a potential Ebola outbreak as the virus is circulating in the northeast Democratic Republic of the Congo. Since June 12, the Ministry of Health has reinforced the skills of these professionals to prepare them for the management of possible contamination cases. The training was documented by Edda Lotine Djiko. The article notes no confirmed cases or deaths and provides no laboratory details; it focuses on preparedness measures rather than a current outbreak in Délébama. The piece underscores ongoing concerns about Ebola in northeast DRC and the readiness of local health facilities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の脅威：デレバマの医療スタッフが可能な対応に向けて研修を受講
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスはDRC北東部で循環しており異常/予想外な状況が存在するが、デレバマ地域での確認症例・死亡例がなく、記事は準備活動に焦点。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC北東部でのエボラウイルス循環に対する医療スタッフの準備訓練を報じているが、デレバマ地域での確認症例がない。中央アフリカ共和国は発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではDRCの北東部が焦点であり、CARでの実際の発生状況は示されていないため verified_locations から除外。WPRO基準で3つ該当するが、確認症例の欠如と情報不足のため WATCH 判定。

article.articleHeadline: TN will take all necessary steps to prevent shigellosis outbreaks, health minister says
article.articleSummary: Shigellosis and related gastroenteritis concerns prompted Tamil Nadu health minister Dr K G Arunraj to order food safety officers to ensure safe, hygienic food amid heightened risk and reports of shigellosis in neighbouring Kerala. Inspections, sample collection and strict action against unhygienic outlets will be undertaken to prevent outbreaks. In Tiruchengode, Arunraj distributed welfare assistance worth ₹1.76 crore to 497 recipients, including ration cards, horticulture subsidies, loans for women’s self-help groups and scholarships. He noted this was his first large welfare function as an MLA and pledged faster processing of pending petitions. At Mallasamuthiram block medical centre, he urged staff to strengthen cleanliness and upgrade facilities, and emphasized courteous treatment at 24-hour primary health centres. About 96–97% of approved medical posts are filled; he will seek additional posts in district and medical college hospitals and will address contract workers’ concerns.

triage.headline_ja: TN will take all necessary steps to prevent shigellosis outbreaks, health minister says
triage.triage_reason: シゲラ菌感染症は公衆衛生上の懸念であり、隣州ケーララ州での報告に基づき予防措置が講じられているが、タミルナドゥ州での実際の流行確認や重症度の具体的情報が不足している。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはケーララ州での報告に言及しているが、主題はタミルナドゥ州での予防措置に焦点があり、実際の流行確認ではなく予防的対応が中心。シゲラ菌感染症は下痢症の一般的な原因であり、公衆衛生上の警戒は妥当であるが、現段階では爆発的流行の証拠が記事には明記されていない。続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratische Republik Kongo: Helfer kritisieren unzureichende Bekämpfung von Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Aid workers criticize the inadequate Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: Doctors Without Borders cautions that dangerous delays impede containment of the Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo's Ituri province. The response suffers from insufficient diagnostics, weak surveillance, and poor contact tracing, making the crisis harder for aid workers to control. MSF's medical emergency coordinator Kate White says measures lag behind the outbreak’s progression. The Ituri outbreak is currently straining treatment centers, with the full extent of transmission still unclear. No case/death counts are provided in the article; the focus is on operational bottlenecks and overwhelmed facilities. The article underscores the need for improved diagnostic capacity, real-time surveillance, and effective tracing to prevent further spread of this Ebola variant in a region already affected.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：支援者らがエボラの不十分な対応を批判
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の発生は深刻な公衆衛生影響を持ち、異常で、国際的拡大リスクがあり、渡航・貿易制限のリスクがある。WPRO基準も全項目で肯定的。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州でのブンディブギョ・エボラウイルスの発生を報告。MSFなど国際支援機関が対応能力の不足を指摘し、診断能力、監視体制、接触者追跡の強化が急務とされている。対象国のDRCで実際に発生しているイベントであり、全基準で確認。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak 2026: Cases rise in Congo, death toll crosses 180; here's what we know so far
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Congo (2026) driven by Bundibugyo strain; declared May 15, with two new zones—Nia-Nia (Ituri) and Mabalako (North Kivu)—raising transmission concerns. The Bundibugyo variant is rare and currently has no approved vaccine or specific treatment, unlike the Zaire strain. As of now, 56 people have recovered and the fatality rate is 23%. The outbreak ranks among Congo’s largest, with ongoing transmission in remote areas challenging containment. Efforts to trace contacts are hampered by a humanitarian crisis in eastern Congo: nearly one million displaced in Ituri, dense forests, poor roads, and the movement of artisanal miners. Attacks on health workers and armed-group insecurity further complicate response. Abroad, the US considered quarantining Americans exposed to Ebola in Kenya (Laikipia Air Base) with up to 50 beds; the plan sparked protests and was halted by court action.

triage.headline_ja: 2026年エボラ出血熱流行：コンゴで症例増加、死者数180人超；これまでのところわかっていることは
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、希少なBundibugyo株による異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限のリスク）。WPRO基準でも5項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱は最高リスク疾患であり、複数国への波及とコンゴ東部の危機的状況が懸念される。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はZaire株と異なり、承認されたワクチンや特異的治療がない希少株。コンゴ東部の人道危機（Ituri地域で約100万人の避難民）、武装勢力による攻撃、保健労働者への暴力により対応が著しく阻害されている。死亡率23％、既に180人以上の死亡を確認。米国がケニアのLaikipia Air Baseで曝露米国人の隔離を検討したことは国際的な懸念を示唆しているが、ケニアではまだ症例が確認されていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: RD Congo elevó a 782 los casos confirmados de ébola, con 181 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo raised the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 782, with 181 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo. As of 15 June 2026, the government reports 782 confirmed Ebola cases and 181 deaths. The latest bulletin states 359 patients are in isolation (hospitalized) and 56 have recovered. The global case fatality rate stands at 23.1%. Transmission occurs through direct contact with the bodily fluids of infected people or animals, causing severe hemorrhagic fever with vomiting, diarrhea, and internal bleeding. The outbreak was declared in mid-May, and the most recent figures come from a midnight bulletin released by the Ministry of Communication and Media. The update underscores ongoing transmission and care needs, with many patients still hospitalized.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ確認患者数を782例に引き上げ、死亡181例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は深刻な公衆衛生影響、高い致命率（23.1%）、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクを伴う。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行。782例の確認患者と181例の死亡は極めて深刻。致命率23.1%、現在359例が入院中。5月中旬の発症宣言以来、継続的な人間-動物接触による伝播が確認されている。国内・国際的な感染制御体制強化の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: No new Nipah cases reported; patient's condition remains critical: Kerala Health Minister
article.articleSummary: Nipah in Kozhikode, Kerala: No new cases as of June 15, 2026; the patient remains on ventilator at Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital. Second dose of monoclonal antibody was given per ICMR guidelines. Second test of a healthcare worker in the contact list returned negative. Seven admitted for observation: two close relatives discharged after symptoms subsided; another relative under observation; one healthcare worker's sample pending. 103 people are on the contact list: four very high-risk, 14 high-risk, 85 low-risk; 45 are healthcare workers. A central team visited Feroke private hospital; field visits covered 46 houses in Ramanattukara Division 5. The latest Nipah case was confirmed June 11 in a 43-year-old man from Ramanattukara. Nipah is a zoonotic virus with fruit bats as the natural reservoir and can cause severe respiratory illness and encephalitis.

triage.headline_ja: 新たなニパウイルス患者は報告されず。患者の状態は引き続き重篤：ケーラ州保健大臣
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスは高い致死率を持つ稀少な新興感染症であり、人獣共通感染症である。患者の重篤な状態、接触者の追跡管理、および103人の接触者リストが存在することから、WPRO基準における重症度と長期曝露リスク、および流行しやすさの基準に複数該当する。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはWHOが定める重点監視対象病原体の一つであり、高い致死率（40～75%）を特徴とする。患者はケーラ州コジコード地区で6月11日に確認され、現在人工呼吸器管理下。103名の接触者追跡、複数の病院訪問歴、および人獣共通感染症としての性質を踏まえると、地域での感染制御強化が必要。IHR基準2つ以上該当、WPRO基準5つすべて該当するため、フルRRA実施対象。

article.articleHeadline: Cacique Raoni é internado com infecção generalizada em UTI de Sinop | Rdnews - Principais notícias de Cuiabá, Várzea Grande e Mato grosso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chief Raoni is admitted to Sinop's ICU with a systemic infection.
article.articleSummary: Chief Raoni Metuktire, 94, was admitted in grave condition to the Intensive Care Unit at Hospital Dois Pinheiros in Sinop (503 km from Cuiabá) on 14 June, with suspected systemic infection; he remains in the ICU on 15 June with monitoring, IV fluids, antibiotics, and support. Initial tests show renal function changes and markers of infection; the leading diagnosis is sepsis from a pulmonary source after aspiration of vomit. Abdominal CT shows gastric subocclusion. He had been at home in the Peixoto de Azevedo region (674 km from capital) when vomiting began, with persistent cough, abdominal pain, minor hemoptysis, and poor appetite, before being airlifted to Sinop. On admission he was dehydrated, drowsy, with distended abdomen and no urine output. He has COPD, cardiopathy with a pacemaker, and heart failure. Earlier in May he needed ICU care for traumatic diaphragmatic hernia and was discharged in stable condition on May 21.

triage.headline_ja: シェフ・ラオニがシノップのICUに全身感染で入院
triage.triage_reason: 94歳の著名人の個人医療事案であり、感染症の新規アウトブレイク、公衆衛生上の集団発生、異常な病原体出現の証拠がない。医学的には敗血症（既知疾患）で、シグナル特性を満たさない。
triage.notes: 患者は著名なインディオ指導者（シェフ・ラオニ・メトゥクティレ）であるため社会的関心は高いが、本件は個人の医療事案（高齢者の誤嚥後敗血症）であり、感染症の公衆衛生上の脅威ではない。Unknown Illnessカテゴリは医学的診断の不確実性ではなく、症状と検査から敗血症が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: Israel lifts Ebola-related travel restrictions on Kenya, Rwanda
article.articleSummary: Israel lifted Ebola-related entry restrictions on Kenya and Rwanda, removing them from the list of countries subjected to temporary measures as of 2026-06-15. The prior directive barred airlines from carrying passengers who had traveled to or from Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, South Sudan and the Democratic Republic of the Congo within 21 days of boarding to Israel, and required airlines to screen travelers and deny boarding for affected foreign nationals; Israeli citizens/residents remained exempt. Kenya, which has conducted over 80,000 Ebola tests with no confirmed cases, welcomed the reversal, while a prior Kenyan protest had criticized the measure as unjustified. The change eases travel disruptions and aims to restore normal aviation links with Kenya and Rwanda, with regional Ebola surveillance and other infectious-disease monitoring continuing in the area.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルがケニア、ルワンダに対するエボラ関連の渡航制限を解除
triage.triage_reason: エボラ発生の直接的な新規確認ではなく、既存事態への制限解除の報道。対象国DRCでの継続的なサーベイランスは言及されるが、新規感染の爆発的拡大の兆候はなく、情報不足で詳細な評価困難。
triage.notes: 記事の主要な内容はイスラエルによる渡航制限の解除であり、新規エボラ感染事例の報告ではない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれており、同国での継続的なサーベイランスが言及されているため verified_locations に含める。ケニア、ルワンダ、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。イスラエルも対象外。新規の感染拡大シグナルではなく、既存事態の制限解除に関する政治的決定の報道であるため、PICKUP には至らないと判定。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola in Congo: la folla si oppone al recupero di una bara, interviene la polizia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Congo: The crowd opposes the removal of a coffin; police intervene.
article.articleSummary: Police used tear gas and warning shots in Mongbwalu, Congo, to permit Ebola response teams to recover a coffin contested by mourners. An amateur video circulating in mid-June 2026 shows security forces dispersing the grieving crowd and escorting health workers as the coffin is loaded onto a vehicle. The footage captures white tear gas smoke, distant gunfire, and the moment of removal. The episode underscores the ongoing spread of Ebola in the region and the challenges responders face when recovering a coffin during outbreak responses. It highlights tensions surrounding burial procedures amid Ebola transmission in Congo. The incident illustrates the hazards faced by frontline responders and communities during Ebola outbreaks.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ：群衆が棺の回収に反対、警察が介入
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認例（DRC）であり、IHR基準2項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク）。また、WPRO基準でも複数該当（深刻度、長期曝露、流行易感性、管理可能性）するため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月15日配信で、DRCのMongbwalu地域でのエボラ対応中の棺回収時の社会的紛争を報道。公開された映像が存在し、社会的関心が高い。エボラの確認例による死亡と埋葬手続きに関わる地域社会の抵抗が記述されており、感染拡大リスク並びに対応困難性が顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Tamil Nadu Tightens Border Checks Amid Kerala Nipah Alert
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus alert spanning Tamil Nadu after a confirmed Nipah infection in Kerala's Kozhikode district. Tamil Nadu tightens border security with intensified surveillance in Nilgiris and Coimbatore, and 13 interstate check posts along the Kerala frontier. Medical camps operate round the clock to screen travellers, tourists and migrant workers; thermal screening and symptom checks target fever, severe headache, breathing difficulties, cough and vomiting. Ambulances and isolation facilities are positioned for rapid response. District health officials instruct hospitals, PHCs and private clinics to monitor fever or encephalitis-like symptoms and report suspected cases with travel history to state surveillance teams. Kerala authorities report ongoing surveillance and contact tracing in the affected area, with no additional confirmed cases beyond the index patient as of the latest update. Nipah is a zoonotic disease requiring hygiene precautions.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州ニパウイルスアラートをきっかけにタミルナドゥ州が国境検査を強化
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスの確定症例がケララ州で報告され、隣接するタミルナドゥ州が国境警戒を強化している。ニパウイルスはIHR基準（異常性・国際拡大リスク）およびWPRO基準（重症度・流行しやすさ）で複数該当し、二国間の公衆衛生対応が開始されている点から、フルRRA対象となる。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはBSL-4相当の危険病原体であり、致死率が高い（50～90%）。ケララ州での確定症例を受けてタミルナドゥ州が積極的な国境検査・サーベイランス・医療キャンプを展開している。記事時点では索引患者（index patient）以外の確定症例は報告されていないが、ヒト・ヒト感染リスク、動物への影響が双方に該当し、流行性感染症であることが確認される。インド内の州間移動による拡大リスクが顕著。

article.articleHeadline: Le chef du CDC Afrique salue le soutien de la Chine et appelle à des actions internationales alignées contre l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The head of Africa CDC welcomes China's support and calls for internationally coordinated actions against the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: China strengthens Africa's Ebola response as Africa CDC Director-General Jean Kaseya welcomes Beijing's sustained support for Africa's public health priorities amid an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC). Coordinated under a single continental plan, Africa CDC aims to align resources, reduce duplication, and direct aid to the most affected regions. A five-member Chinese expert team arrived June 2 in Kinshasa for a three-month mission to bolster the DRC's Ebola response, focusing on laboratory capacity, emergency preparedness, and supply-chain support. International partners are deemed critical; the most useful assistance is rapid, coordinated and aligned with country-identified needs and the continental plan. Sino-African health collaboration encompasses infrastructure, capacity-building, trainings, and technical exchanges to strengthen regional outbreak response.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカCDCのトップが中国の支援を歓迎し、エボラ流行に対する国際的に協調した行動を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病はクラス1感染症で、DRCでのBundibugyo ebolavirus流行は重大な関心事。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ボウ型エボラウイルス）によるDRC での流行。中国の専門家チーム派遣（6月2日到着、3ヶ月間）、アフリカCDCによる大陸規模の対応調整が進行中。記事ではChinaが支援国として言及されているが、発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Scientists from Pécs Could Revolutionize Protection Against Parasitic Diseases
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease vaccine development in Hungary: University of Pécs and Neo-Antigén Biotech Kft. win nearly 783 million forints (2.2 million euros) in non-repayable funding from the National Research, Development and Innovation Fund to develop the first anti-parasitic mRNA vaccine targeting Trypanosoma cruzi over a three-year program. A Brazilian partner participates as part of the effort. The project aims to neutralize Tc immune evasion mechanisms; Chagas disease causes chronic infection with a latent phase lasting years to decades and can cause irreversible damage to the heart and digestive system, with neurological complications less common. Up to 100 million people are at risk, and Europe is seeing spread due to migration and warming. The initiative sits within the Life Sciences Catalyst Program’s Target to POC fund (total 7.4 billion forints); 32 proposals were received in November 2025, with 12 grants totaling over 7.33 billion forints. The May launch targets three-year development.

triage.headline_ja: ペーチ大学の科学者たちが寄生虫病に対する保護を革新する可能性
triage.triage_reason: シャーガス病のワクチン開発プロジェクトに関する研究資金配分の報道。現在のアウトブレイク・健康危機ではなく研究開発段階の記事であり、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準に該当しない。
triage.notes: 本記事はハンガリーの大学が受け取ったワクチン開発研究資金に関する研究進捗報道である。疾患の現在の流行や集団感染イベントではなく、学術的な開発段階の報道のため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。ブラジルはワクチン開発パートナーとして言及されているが、記事の主題はハンガリーの研究資金配分であり、ブラジルでのシャーガス病の新規アウトブレイク情報は含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reports large daily jump in Ebola cases a month after outbreak was declared
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo shows a large daily increase as of 15 June 2026, with 72 new confirmed cases in the last 24 hours, bringing the total to 782. The death toll reaches 181, with 29 new deaths in the same period. The month-old outbreak is spreading in a remote region, where shifting population movements impede efforts to identify exposed individuals and trace contacts. The Congolese Ministry of Health reports these confirmed cases, underscoring accelerating transmission and the need for intensified surveillance and rapid isolation amid challenges in accessing mobile populations and remote areas. No further details on outcomes or interventions are provided, and the report does not mention imported or exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ患者数の大幅な日増加を報告、発生宣言から1ヶ月後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスによる急速な感染拡大、高い死亡率、接触者追跡困難な状況での国際的拡大リスクが認識される。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は重症度が高く、月1ヶ月での確認患者782人、死亡181人という進行状況は深刻。人口移動が活発な遠隔地での感染拡大は接触者追跡を困難にしており、地域境界を越えた拡大リスクが高い。WHOへの通知義務あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola response improves in DRC's Ituri province
article.articleSummary: Eight Ebola treatment centers now operate in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, the epicenter of the outbreak. At Rwampara, one of the disease hotspots, the center houses 22 patients and has seen improved care. Protests attacked the outbreak's early response, but three weeks later tensions have eased. Measures are in place to protect healthcare workers; at least 20 doctors and nurses have died in this outbreak. Psychologists now support staff and families. Despite progress, response teams need more supplies and medication. International partners, including the European Union, deliver aid through WHO, UNICEF and other organizations to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのイツリ州でエボラ対応が改善
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の進行中の流行で、IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当し、国際支援が進行中。
triage.notes: エボラ流行はDRCのイツリ州が震源地。記事ではルワンダも発生地域として列挙されているが、サマリー上の主題はDRCの対応状況であり、ルワンダでの発症報告は記載なし。したがってDRCのみverified_locationsに含める。8つの治療センター稼働、医療従事者20人以上の死亡、国際支援（EU、WHO、UNICEF）が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo khẩn: Thu hồi toàn bộ sữa công thức Nara Organics sau 3 ca ngộ độc ở trẻ sơ sinh
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Urgent warning: Recall of all Nara Organics infant formula after three cases of poisoning in newborns
article.articleSummary: On 15 June 2026, Vietnam’s Food Safety Agency urged rapid action to recall Nara Organics Whole Milk Organic Powdered Infant Formula after the US FDA voluntary recall. The recall follows three newborn botulism cases in California, Pennsylvania and Washington, with initial investigations linking exposure to the formula sold via Target stores, Target.com and Nara.com from July 2025 to June 2026. The product was reportedly distributed only in the United States and not officially exported; however Vietnamese authorities are acting to prevent imports. The agency asked the Ministry of Industry and Trade to alert e-commerce platforms and online sellers to halt distribution and remove advertising if the product is found in Vietnam, and to coordinate recall with distributors. Health authorities should review registrations for the product, and report imports, sales, stock, and disposal plans by 25 June 2026. Botulinum toxin can cause severe infant illness, including paralysis and respiratory failure.

triage.headline_ja: 緊急警告：3件の新生児中毒事例後にNara Organics粉末乳幼児用粉ミルク全品回収
triage.triage_reason: 米国でのボツリヌス菌中毒3件（新生児）による乳幼児用粉ミルク回収であり、重症度が高く国際的に拡大のリスクがある。ベトナムを含む複数国での対応が進行中。
triage.notes: 米国での初期事例（California, Pennsylvania, Washington）が引き金となり、ベトナムが輸入防止と回収対応を実施中。ボツリヌス毒素による重度な新生児疾患リスク（麻痺、呼吸不全）が懸念される。2026年6月15日の発表でベトナムの食品安全局が積極的に対応しており、WPRO地域における実際の感染症イベント発生地として検証される。

article.articleHeadline: Tocantins conclui estudo voltado à comprovação da ausência dos vírus da Influenza Aviária e da Doença de Newcastle
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Tocantins concludes a study aimed at proving the absence of avian influenza viruses and Newcastle disease virus
article.articleSummary: Tocantins, Brazil, concluded a serological survey to prove no circulation of Avian Influenza viruses and Newcastle Disease in the state. Conducted by Adapec, the study covered 28 properties (12 subsistence and 16 industrial poultry units), sampling 308 birds (132 subsistence, 176 industrial). Initiated in November under MAP's Avian Influenza and Newcastle Disease Surveillance Plan, the program recently sent the final samples to MAP laboratories. Since the start, none tested positive for Avian Influenza or Newcastle Disease. Mariana Teles, technical head of the State Poultry Health Program, confirmed absence of positives to date. Adapec President Lenito Abreu underscored Tocantins’ large poultry sector and ongoing sanitary monitoring. Samples were screened at Adapec's lab before forwarding for official confirmatory testing.

triage.headline_ja: トカンティンス州、鳥インフルエンザウイルスとニューカッスル病ウイルスの不在を証明することを目的とした研究を完了
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症の新規発生や流行ではなく、ブラジル・トカンティンス州における鳥インフルエンザおよびニューカッスル病の非流行を確認する調査の完了報告である。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準のいずれも満たさず、公衆衛生上の懸念を示す要素がない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はブラジルの家禽衛生当局（Adapec）が実施した調査であり、感染症の発生や流行の報告ではなく、逆に疾患の不在を確認する陰性報告である。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判定。

article.articleHeadline: Weiterhin schnelle Ausbreitung von Ebola im Kongo - Deutsches Ärzteblatt
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Continued Rapid Spread of Ebola in the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola continues to surge in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, with confirmed cases in the northeastern region rising to 782 and deaths increasing to 181 in 24 hours, figures updated to June 13. The outbreak, centered in Ituri Province, challenges surveillance as 56.5% of contacts are traced, well short of the 90% target set by the WHO. About 359 patients are currently in hospital or isolation facilities. Médecins Sans Frontières warns that gaps in case finding and contact follow-up undermine containment a month after the outbreak began in Ituri; treatment centers are overwhelmed, patients arrive late, and many have not been identified or monitored as contacts. Testing access remains limited and laboratory result turnaround is slow. The current Bundibugyo strain of Ebola has no approved vaccine or specific therapy, complicating control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の継続的な急速な拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の流行で深刻な公衆衛生被害、予想外の高い死亡率、コンゴ周辺地域への国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。フルRRAが必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はWHOの国際保健上の懸念事項（PHEIC）に該当する可能性が高い。Bundibugyo株であり、ワクチン・特異的治療がない。接触者追跡率56.5%と目標90%を大きく下回り、管理可能性に深刻な懸念あり。DRCはマルチプレイン流行の歴史あり、周辺国への拡大リスク（ウガンダ、ザンビア、ルワンダなど）が現実的。

article.articleHeadline: "Personne ne connaît l'ampleur réelle de l'épidémie en RDC": Médecins sans frontières alerte sur la réponse tardive à Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: No one knows the real extent of the outbreak in the DRC: Doctors Without Borders warns about the delayed response to Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is outpacing on-the-ground response, according to Doctors Without Borders (MSF) on 15 June. Since the 15 May declaration, the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain has caused 782 cases and 181 deaths per WHO-based tallies, though MSF cautions totals likely undercount. There is no licensed vaccine or approved treatment for this strain. Ituri accounts for about 95% of cases; North Kivu has the only laboratory for blood testing, with multi-day result delays. Testing access is limited in many insecure areas, and treatment centers experience slow lab turnaround. Community trust is eroded in ITuri, complicating response efforts. MSF urges an emergency-scale response, highlighting the need to enhance case finding, contact tracing (about 70% recently versus 45% early June), and community engagement, with teams operating in remote, unstable zones to strengthen detection and response.

triage.headline_ja: 「DRCにおける流行の真の規模を知る者はいない」：国境なき医師団がエボラへの遅延対応について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。Bundibugyo型エボラの進行中の流行で782例・181死亡を記録し、検査体制の不備と地域信頼の喪失により対応が追いついていない状況が報告されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルス）は通常のザイール型より毒性が低いが、ワクチンと承認治療法が存在しないこと、Ituri州における地域信頼の喪失、検査体制の地域的偏在（北キブ州に唯一の検査施設）、不安定な治安環境が対応を著しく阻害している。MSFの警告は対応能力の限界を示唆しており、国際支援ニーズは高い。

article.articleHeadline: MSF advierte del brote de ébola: "No se conoce la verdadera magnitud"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: MSF warns of the Ebola outbreak: "The true magnitude is not known."
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo spans eastern Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of 14 June, and 19 cases in Uganda. Ituri accounts for about 95% of cases. MSF medical coordinator Kate White warns the outbreak is advancing faster than the response; the true magnitude and spread remain unknown, and many treatment centers in Ituri are overwhelmed as patients arrive late and contacts go unidentified. Diagnostic challenges arise from insecurity limiting detection and testing access; mobile labs exist for Bundibugyo virus in the east, but access is restricted and results are delayed. In North and South Kivu, confirmed cases are fewer; North Kivu relies on a single lab with processing and up to a one-week delay. Conflict and displacement strain health services. MSF continues field deployments in remote areas to boost detection and response and to sustain routine healthcare.

triage.headline_ja: MSF、エボラウイルス病のアウトブレイク警告：「真の規模は不明」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速な進展、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当し、エボラウイルス病は極めて高いリスク疾患。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Ebola）は極めて高い病原性・致死率を有し、IHR(2005)の指定感染症である。記事では782確定例・181死亡例が報告され、ウガンダへの国際的拡大も確認。MSFが警告する対応困難性と検査体制の限界が記載されており、世界保健機関（WHO）への即時通知が必要。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めず、DRCのみを記載。

article.articleHeadline: കോഴിക്കോട് ഒരാൾക്ക് മലേറിയ; രോഗബാധ മധ്യപ്രദേശിൽ നിന്ന് വന്ന അതിഥി തൊഴിലാളിയ്ക്ക്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A man in Kozhikode has malaria; a guest worker from Madhya Pradesh is infected.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, Kozhikode district in Kerala has one confirmed malaria case in the Thikkod area. The patient is a guest worker from Madhya Pradesh who arrived in Kozhikode in the last week of May. He developed fever and related symptoms on June 8, and malaria was confirmed by blood testing afterward. The infection is linked to the traveler from Madhya Pradesh, constituting an imported malaria case. The report does not specify the malaria species (e.g., falciparum or vivax), nor details about treatment or outcome, and there is no mention of additional cases in the district. No further details are provided.

triage.headline_ja: コーチン地区でマラリア患者1名確認；マディヤ・プラデーシュ州から来た出稼ぎ労働者が感染
triage.triage_reason: 輸入症例（州間移動による持ち込み）で現地発症例の報告がなく、IHR基準は2つ未満。ただしマラリア感染確認と州間移動というスクリーニング基準該当のため、続報を注視する必要あり。
triage.notes: 輸入症例（マディヤ・プラデーシュ州からの出稼ぎ労働者）として報告されており、コーチン地区での二次感染の報告はない。患者の治療結果や症状の詳細、マラリア原虫種の特定がなされていない。インドではマラリアは風土病として知られており、単一の輸入症例では公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と判断されない。続報で追加症例や流行兆候がある場合はPICKUPへ昇格の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports large one-day increase in Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: On 15 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reported 72 new Ebola cases in 24 hours, bringing confirmed cases to 782 and deaths to 181 (29 new deaths). Forty have recovered; the case fatality rate stands at 23%. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, is concentrated in Ituri (over 90% of cases) with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border spread to Uganda. Health authorities warn the outbreak is outpacing response as treatment centers are overwhelmed and patients arrive in late stages; contact tracing coverage is 56%, down from last week, hampered by community resistance and rapid expansion. The onset began in mid-May; the true scale remains uncertain. WHO and Africa CDC are intensifying testing, tracing, and treatment with WHO supplies and technical support. Nearly a million people are displaced in Ituri, complicating surveillance. The Zaire vaccine exists but is not used against Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の1日あたりの大幅な増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、かつWPRO基準5項目すべてに該当。複数国への国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）、高い死亡率（23%）、急速な増加率、保健体制の過負荷が確認され、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による大規模流行。24時間で72件の新規確定患者、累計782件、死亡181件。越境感染（ウガンダ）が発生。保健体制の過負荷、接触者追跡カバー率の低下（56%）、コミュニティの抵抗により対応が遅延。ワクチン（ザイール株用）は有効でない可能性がある。難民人口（約100万人）が監視を複雑化させている。WHO・Africa CDCの介入継続中。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: As UK aid cuts hinder fight against deadly Ebola outbreaks, Scotland can step up
article.articleSummary: Ebola has re-emerged in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, driven by a rare strain with no approved vaccine. As of June 15, 2026, almost 700 cases are confirmed and more than 130 deaths have occurred. The outbreak spans multiple provinces, with urban centers Goma and Bunia affected and cross-border spread into Uganda. Ituri province sits at the center, where clean water is scarce and sanitation is limited as the health system remains hollowed by insecurity and aid cuts. Frontline health workers are among the dead, and many infections go undetected when patients die at home or present late for care. More than 26 million people require humanitarian assistance. Rapid, coordinated action—infection prevention, safe water, community engagement, and trust—is essential to contain it. Oxfam notes the humanitarian crisis; Scotland/UK aid cuts have reduced services, underscoring the need for emergency funding and donations to the DRC appeal.

triage.headline_ja: 英国の援助削減がエボラ対策を阻害する中、スコットランドが対策強化へ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の再出現、約700確定例・130以上の死亡、複数州にまたがる拡大、ウガンダへの越境感染、予防接種なしの希少株という深刻な公衆衛生上の影響。
triage.notes: 発生地域にScotlandとUKが含まれているが、記事サマリーに基づき実際のエボラ発生国はDRCのみ。UGANDAへの越境感染が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため除外。DRC東部での再出現、予防接種なしの希少株という点が特に重大。越境感染のリスク、脆弱な保健システム、援助削減による対応困難が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Homecoming: Guwahati boy flown to Hyderabad beats severe Influenza B
article.articleSummary: Eight-year-old boy from Guwahati developed severe pneumonia due to Influenza B, requiring ventilatory support for nearly a week as his oxygen levels remained critically low. He was admitted to a Guwahati hospital, then airlifted to Hyderabad's Rainbow Children's Hospital on Extracorporeal Membrane Oxygenation (ECMO) support after conventional treatment failed. An ECMO Retrieval Team conducted a cross-country transfer; he remained on ECMO for 36 days (more than five weeks) under 24/7 multidisciplinary care, during which he developed a difficult-to-treat infection. He was successfully weaned off ECMO and is now clinically stable, ready to return home as of 15 June 2026. The case underscores ECMO-enabled rescue for Influenza B–related respiratory failure.

triage.headline_ja: グワハティの少年、インフルエンザBとの闘いに勝利―ハイデラバードで回復
triage.triage_reason: 単一症例の重症例報告であり、集団発生の兆候がない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準の複数該当がなく、国際的な公衆衛生上の警告レベルに達していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は個別の重症インフルエンザB症例の医学的成功事例（ECMO治療）を紹介するメディア記事。発生地域はグワハティ（アッサム州）とハイデラバード（テランガナ州）の両方が記載されているが、これはあくまで治療転院の経路であり、病気の流行兆候ではない。インフルエンザBは季節性疾患であり、単一症例報告では公衆衛生上の警告信号にはならない。

article.articleHeadline: Israel lifts Ebola-related travel restrictions on Kenya, Rwanda
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, Israel lifted Ebola-related entry restrictions for Kenya and Rwanda, ending travel curbs prompted by regional Ebola concerns. Previously, airlines were barred from boarding passengers who had stayed in or visited Kenya, Rwanda, Uganda, South Sudan or the Democratic Republic of the Congo within 21 days of flights to Israel and were required to screen and deny boarding for such travelers; restrictions did not apply to Israeli citizens or residents. Kenya had protested the measures, noting it had conducted over 80,000 Ebola tests with no reported cases. Following the reversal, Kenyan officials welcomed the decision as a positive step in diplomatic cooperation. Health authorities in the region continue surveillance for Ebola and other infectious diseases, with Kenya insisting it remains free of confirmed Ebola cases. The lift is expected to ease travel disruptions and restore aviation links between Israel and the two countries.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルがケニア、ルワンダに対するエボラ関連の渡航制限を解除
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の地域的な懸念を背景とした渡航制限の解除報道であり、イベント自体は制限解除（予防的措置の終了）である。DRCで潜在的なエボラ活動の可能性が示唆されているため、リージョナルな監視強化が継続中と考えられ、情報の追跡が必要。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は渡航制限の解除（外交的決定）であり、アクティブな疾患の拡大事象ではない。しかし、サマリーで「地域でのエボラ監視継続」と「DRCを含む複数国への渡航制限があった」という記述から、DRCをはじめとした周辺地域でのエボラ活動の潜在的なシグナルが存在する可能性がある。WPRO基準の「epidemic_prone」に該当（エボラはヒト-ヒト感染が可能で、対策が不十分な地域での流行リスクあり）。続報による状況把握が必要。

article.articleHeadline: بنك التصدير والاستيراد الأفريقي يلغي اجتماعه السنوي بسبب مخاوف إيبولا
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African Export-Import Bank cancels its annual meeting due to Ebola concerns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreaks in Central Africa prompted the African Export-Import Bank to cancel its annual meeting in Alamein, Egypt, citing public health concerns and joint actions by Cairo and the African Union. The Democratic Republic of Congo has reported 782 Ebola cases since the outbreak was declared about a month ago, prompting travel warnings across the region for meetings and events; Uganda has also reported cases. AFREXIMBANK, headquartered in Cairo, said shareholder business would proceed by correspondence for now, and Egypt has postponed other international events this month. The decision follows health-safety measures in affected areas. The bank had held its annual meeting in Brazzaville, Congo, last month, shortly after Congo DR's outbreak announcement.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ輸出入銀行、エボラ懸念により年次総会をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の多地域同時発生（DRC、ウガンダ、コンゴ）による782症例の報告、国際的な経済活動への影響（銀行年次総会キャンセル）、地域全体での渡航警告が発令されており、IHR基準3項目以上に該当。
triage.notes: 記事では DRC、ウガンダ、コンゴ共和国、エジプト（会議開催予定地）が言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれるのは DRC のみ。782症例の報告、国際的な経済活動への影響、複数国での発生確認により、緊急対応が必要なシグナル。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: Remise d'équipements de prévention contre Ebola aux agents du Parc de Kahuzi-Biega - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Handover of Ebola prevention equipment to staff of Kahuzi-Biega National Park - ACP
article.articleSummary: On 15 June 2026, Gorilla Doctors delivered a substantial Ebola prevention and awareness supply package to staff of Kahuzi-Biega National Park in South Kivu, Democratic Republic of Congo. The handover included handwashing kits, sprayers, chlorine, gloves, masks, hydroalcoholic disinfectants, thermoflashes, personal protective equipment, and megaphones for outreach. The aid followed a 11–12 June technical training in Murhesa that strengthened 30 park staff, including 10 from the One Health unit, in zoonotic disease prevention. Park leadership framed the donation as part of the park’s contingency plan to bolster biosafety at strategic sites such as the Lwiro primate rehabilitation center, amid increased population movements and armed-group activity. The initiative comes as a recent Ebola Bundibugyo death was reported in Kabare territory near the Miti-Murhesa health zone, underscoring the sanitary threat in the province.

triage.headline_ja: カフジ・ビエガ国立公園スタッフへのエボラ予防物資配送 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の流行地域であるDRCの特定地域での予防的対応と最近の死亡報告が報告されているが、現在の記事は予防物資配送に関するもので新規流行の急速拡大を示す直接的な証拠に欠ける。情報不足のため継続的な監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は予防・準備活動の報告であるが、南キブ州での最近のエボラ・ブンディブギョ死亡報告が言及されており、当該地域は依然として活発なエボラ流行リスク地域として確認される。武装勢力活動と人口移動の増加が状況を複雑化させている。続報による確認が重要。

article.articleHeadline: إيبولا ينتشر بوتيرة أسرع من فرق الاستجابة الميدانية في الكونغو
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading at a faster pace than field response teams in Congo.
article.articleSummary: MSF warns Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is spreading faster than field response teams can keep up, with serious gaps in the health response. Kate White, MSF's emergency medical coordinator in the DRC, said that after a month since the outbreak was declared, the disease is progressing faster than the response. Government data show 782 confirmed Ebola cases after 72 new infections in the last 24 hours—one of the largest daily increases of the ongoing outbreak—and 181 deaths. The situation underscores the need for intensified response and support to address rapid transmission in affected areas. Authorities are monitoring the situation and seeking additional resources and coordination with partners.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴの野外対応チームより速いペースで拡大している
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPRO基準も5項目すべてに該当。確認されたエボラ出血熱の急速な流行であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、対応能力の不足が認識される。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ出血熱の急速な流行。72時間で新規感染782件、死亡181件。対応チームの収容能力を上回る感染速度。MSFを含む国際的な支援と対応強化が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reports record daily jump in new Ebola cases as outbreak spirals
article.articleSummary: 72 new Ebola infections in 24 hours push Congo's total confirmed cases to 782, with 181 fatalities (32 new) as of 15 June 2026. The outbreak, caused by the Bundibugyo virus (for which there is no approved vaccine or treatment), is concentrated in Ituri province (over 90% of cases) with spillovers to North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border transmission to Uganda. The virus was officially confirmed on 15 May; contact tracing coverage has fallen to 56%. The current fatality rate is 23%, with 56 recoveries. WHO is intensifying testing, contact tracing, and treatment, while Africa CDC deploys technical expertise, laboratory support, active case finding, and community engagement. Displacement in Ituri (nearly a million) and mobility of artisanal miners hinder tracing; the true case count may be higher.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス感染者が24時間で記録的に急増、コンゴの感染拡大が加速
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、Bundibugyo EbolaはWHOが承認した治療法やワクチンがない未知の脅威。国際的な二次感染（ウガンダへの越境感染）、高い致命率（23%）、接触者追跡能力の低下が確認され、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo EbolaはEbola Zaire以外の稀な株。ウガンダへの越境感染が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国外のため verified_locations に含めない。接触者追跡カバレッジ56%への低下、大規模な住民移動（イトゥリで約100万人）、鉱山労働者の流動性により感染制御が困難な状況。

article.articleHeadline: കോഴിക്കോട് ഒരാള്‍ക്ക് മലേറിയ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; രോഗബാധ മധ്യപ്രദേശില്‍ നിന്ന് വന്ന അതിഥി തൊഴിലാളിക്ക് | NEWS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria confirmed in a person in Kozhikode; the patient is a migrant worker who came from Madhya Pradesh | NEWS
article.articleSummary: Malaria confirmed in Kozhikode district, Kerala, in a migrant worker who arrived from Madhya Pradesh at the end of May and worked in the Thikkodi area. Symptoms began on 8 June, and laboratory tests confirmed malaria after sample analysis. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes; severe forms can include cerebral malaria, and jaundice may occur in some cases. In response, the health department intensified preventive measures in Kozhikode following renewed malaria reports, focusing on mosquito control and eliminating standing water around homes, terraces, and containers. Personal protection includes nocturnal use of long sleeves, protective clothing, bed nets, and repellents. If fever with chills or other concerning symptoms occur, seek prompt medical testing. This is an imported case from Madhya Pradesh, underscoring cross-state exposure.

triage.headline_ja: コーチン（コージコーデ）でマラリア確認；患者は中央プラデーシュ州から来た出稼ぎ労働者
triage.triage_reason: インドにおけるマラリアの輸入症例（州間移動による）であり、WPROMスクリーニング基準の「異常/予想外」および「流行しやすさ」に該当する可能性があるが、現時点では単一症例の報告にとどまり、IHR基準2つ以上の該当が確認できない。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: 単一の輸入症例報告（中央プラデーシュ州からケーララ州へ）。保健当局は蚊媒介対策を強化している。マラリアは動物由来感染症ではなく、ヒト-蚊-ヒト伝播を特徴とする。今後、追加症例の発生や伝播状況の展開を注視すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Afreximbank Cancels Annual Meeting Over Ebola Outbreak Fears
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, Afreximbank canceled its next week’s annual meeting in El Alamein, Egypt, citing Ebola outbreak fears. The decision, made with Egyptian authorities and the African Union, shifts shareholder business to correspondence and follows precautionary measures aimed at containing the virus across parts of Central Africa. The Democratic Republic of Congo has registered 782 Ebola cases since the outbreak was declared a month ago, with Uganda reporting infections linked to the disease. Egypt has postponed other international events this month in response to the evolving health situation. The cancellation marks a major disruption to Africa’s premier financial gathering. Afreximbank, owned by African governments, regional institutions and private investors, had sought to convene policymakers and investors; weeks earlier, the African Development Bank held meetings in Brazzaville, Republic of Congo.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行懸念でアフレクシムバンク年次総会をキャンセル
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の対象国での発生（DRC 782例、ウガンダでも感染報告）、国際的な公式イベントのキャンセルなど社会政治的影響が顕著。IHR基準3項目以上該当、かつ国際的な経済・政策的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはエジプト、ウガンダ、Republic of Congoなども含まれるが、記事サマリーの主要な流行地はDRC（782例、宣言から1か月経過）。ウガンダも感染報告あり。エジプトは国際イベント開催国であり、流行地ではない。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。2026年6月15日というタイムスタンプは将来日付だが、指標として受け取る。

article.articleHeadline: Dentista é preso suspeito de transmitir HIV a quatro mulheres
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dentist arrested on suspicion of transmitting HIV to four women.
article.articleSummary: Porto Velho, Rondônia, Brazil — A dentist has been arrested on suspicion of transmitting HIV to four women, after allegedly knowing he carried the virus and not informing his partners. The four women have reported similar situations to the police. Civil Police investigators have collected testimonies, medical tests, and patient records, and a judge authorized the arrest on charges described as bodily injury of a very serious nature. The case remains under investigation as authorities seek to clarify all details and determine whether there are additional victims. The public is urged to contact the Delegacia Especializada no Atendimento à Mulher (DEAM) to report anyone who had relations with the detained dentist, with confidential reporting available. The incident underscores ongoing concerns about intentional exposure to HIV and the need to identify and support potential victims.

triage.headline_ja: 歯科医がHIVを4人の女性に感染させた疑いで逮捕
triage.triage_reason: 本件は個別の刑事事件（感染の故意性に関わる歯科医の逮捕）であり、公衆衛生上の感染症流行や異常な集団発生ではない。IHR基準・WPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 本件は刑事事件・個別の感染事例であり、感染症流行（outbreak）ではない。社会的・政治的関心は存在するが、シグナルトリアージの対象外。HIV感染症の公衆衛生面での異常な拡大や流行を示すエビデンスは記事に含まれていない。

article.articleHeadline: Demokratische Republik Kongo: Helfer kritisieren unzureichende Bekämpfung von Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Aid workers criticize the inadequate Ebola response.
article.articleSummary: As of June 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo is contending a Bundibugyo virus Ebola outbreak centered in Ituri province, with Ugandan cases reported across the border, and no licensed vaccine or therapy yet. MSF reports diagnostic gaps, weak surveillance, and insufficient contact tracing delaying containment; communities are not adequately engaged in emergency measures, hampering aid work. MSF's Kate White says the outbreak's true scale is unknown; over 780 laboratory-confirmed cases and more than 180 deaths reported by national authorities, though figures may underestimate the reality. Uganda has reported some confirmed cases and deaths as well. Save the Children warns of a regional social crisis: food insecurity, school closures due to fear, and potential loss of breastfeeding support, since Ebola can be transmitted via breast milk. Women—who predominantly care for the sick in eastern DRC—face higher infection risk. The situation remains under updates.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：支援団体がエボラ対策の不十分さを批判
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。ブンディブギョウイーボラウイルスの大規模アウトブレイク（780例以上、180人以上の死亡）が発生しており、国際的な地域拡大（ウガンダへの波及）、公衆衛生への重大な影響、および国際支援の必要性が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは DRC の Ituri 州を中心とした Bundibugyo ウイルス型エボラアウトブレイクが報告されており、ウガンダへの波及も言及されているが、詳細な患者数がウガンダで報告されているかは記事本文の不在により完全には確認できない。DRC が verified_locations の主対象。社会的影響（食糧不安、学校閉鎖、授乳支援の喪失）も報告されており、MSF の報告により診断の遅れ、監視体制の脆弱性、接触者追跡の不十分さが指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Candeias: Escola Julieta Viana recebe ação em combate ao Aedes Aegypti
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Candeias: Julieta Viana School hosts action to combat Aedes aegypti.
article.articleSummary: Candeias, Brazil – In the morning of Friday, June 12, the City Hall, via the Health Secretariat (SESAU) in partnership with the Education Secretariat (SEDUC), hosted at Julieta Viana School in the Areia neighborhood an action called Supermoz na Escola, part of the Nova Candeias project, to showcase new technologies against arboviruses. Health Secretary Talita Ramalho stressed that dengue is about lives, not just a mosquito, and that prevention is the strongest weapon with everyone having a role. Attendees included 6th-grade students, teachers, coordinators, epidemiological agents, the health secretary, and other entities. The event featured the launch of Brazil’s first educational game to combat dengue, a theatre performance on prevention and citizenship, a laboratory activity with a microscope, and other interactive educational activities.

triage.headline_ja: カンデイアス：ジュリエタ・ビアナ学校でネッタイシマカ対策活動を開催
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学校での教育的デングウイルス対策啓発イベント開催の報道であり、急性的な感染症アウトブレイクの報告ではない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当せず、シグナルレベルの懸念は見当たらない。
triage.notes: 本記事はブラジルのカンデイアス市でデング対策の教育イベントが開催されたという保健医療政策・啓発活動の報道である。感染症アウトブレイク、症例発生、死亡、または異常な疾患増加の報告は含まれていない。このタイプの記事は日常的な公衆衛生活動であり、感染症危機管理のシグナルとしては識別されない。

article.articleHeadline: When Ebola struck, China showed up
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompted the WHO to declare a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on May 17, 2026. By May 18, the United States imposed enhanced travel screening and a 30-day entry ban for nationals of the DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan, with exemptions for US citizens and permanent residents—the first Ebola-related travel ban, diverging from prior screening-only approaches. Days later, the US announced that Americans exposed abroad would not be repatriated, instead routed to a quarantine facility at Kenya’s Laikipia Air Base, provoking Kenyan legal and professional pushback that halted the plan pending court review over containment readiness. On June 2, China dispatched a three-month anti-epidemic medical team to Kinshasa to reinforce existing Chinese medical personnel in the DRC, reflecting sustained forward engagement rather than crisis-driven action. Africa CDC notes that responses often accelerate only when cases reach high-income countries, risking an export of burden from African communities.

triage.headline_ja: エボラが発生した時、中国が現れた
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョ・エボラアウトブレイクがDRCで発生し、WHOが2026年5月17日にPHEIC宣言。国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限実施、複数国への影響（DRC、ウガンダ、南スーダン、ケニア、中国）があり、IHR基準3つ以上該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づく検証：Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak（ブンディブギョはウガンダ領だが、記事文脈ではDRCでの発生と述べられている）、WHO PHEIC宣言、複数国への渡航禁止・制限措置、中国の医療チーム派遣（Kinshasa）、ケニアの隔離施設計画が明記されている。ウガンダは直接の発生地とは記述されていないが、渡航制限対象国として言及。対象国リストからはDRCとChinaのみが該当する発生・対応国として verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Israel Ebola travel ban on five African states sparks diplomatic row with Kenya - The Zimbabwe Mail Israel Ebola travel ban on five African states sparks diplomatic row with Kenya | Zimbabwe News - The Zimbabwe Mail
article.articleSummary: Israel restricts entry of foreign nationals and residents who have visited Democratic Republic of Congo, South Sudan, Rwanda, Kenya, or Uganda within 21 days, via a pre-boarding screening directive by the Population and Immigration Authority. Airlines must challenge non-Israeli passengers' recent travel histories and deny boarding if exposure to the listed countries is confirmed; Israeli citizens and permanent residents are exempt. The move is tied to renewed Ebola concerns in East and Central Africa, with authorities monitoring ongoing outbreaks and advising heightened border health measures. Kenya has publicly protested the inclusion of its name, saying it has recorded no Ebola cases and has conducted more than 80,000 tests. Nairobi argues the blanket ban undermines regional cooperation, risks stigmatizing countries, and could affect trade, tourism, and diplomacy. The restrictions remain in place as Ebola activity continues to be tracked.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエルがアフリカ5か国へのエボラ関連渡航禁止令を発令、ケニアとの外交問題に発展 - The Zimbabwe Mail
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（重大な公衆衛生脅威）に関連した国際的な渡航制限措置であり、IHR基準「国際的に拡大するリスク」「渡航・貿易制限のリスク」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準「異常/予想外」「管理可能性」に該当し、外交的な関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはイスラエルの渡航禁止措置とケニアの外交的抗議に焦点を当てており、アフリカ5か国（コンゴ民主共和国、南スーダン、ルワンダ、ケニア、ウガンダ）が言及されている。対象国リスト内ではコンゴ民主共和国のみが該当するため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ケニア、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていない。イスラエルでの実際のエボラ症例報告ではなく、予防的渡航制限措置であることに注意。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en Ituri : les autorités sanitaires mettent en garde contre
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Ituri: Health Authorities Warn Against.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, with health authorities reporting deaths in Bunia after Ebola-like symptoms. Latest cases trace to Friday in the Lumumba neighborhood at the Kappa roundabout; a father and son on a motorcycle collapsed with nosebleeds and oral bleeding, dying before response teams could intervene. Officials attribute deaths to self-medication among those with Ebola-compatible symptoms. Dr. John Kabutabuka, director of Bunia General Hospital, notes similar incidents in Horo and Ndibe and urges patients with suspected signs to seek care at a health facility immediately. Emphasis on early treatment to reduce deaths and curb community transmission. A green hotline is available at 151 for reporting suspected cases or contacts to strengthen surveillance and response in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州でのエボラ：保健当局が警告
triage.triage_reason: DRCのイトゥリ州でエボラウイルス病の複数死亡事例が報告されており、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生への影響と異常性が明確。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡事例）、管理可能性（ホットライン設置と対応体制の言及）が該当。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州（ブニア）でのエボラ症例報告を主題としている。セネガルはBluedot APIの発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーに根拠がなく含めない。複数の死亡事例、ヒト-ヒト感染の継続リスク、保健当局による公式警告と対応体制（ホットライン151）の存在から、フルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reports a record daily increase in Ebola cases a month after outbreak was declared
article.articleSummary: 72 new Ebola cases reported in 24 hours in Congo, bringing total confirmed to 782 and deaths to 181 (29 new). The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, is centered in Ituri province (over 90% of cases) with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border spread to Uganda. One month after confirmation on May 15, the outbreak is described as outpacing the response; surveillance shows more active reporting, but many contacts remain unidentified. Contact tracing coverage is 56%, down from last week, hampered by mass displacement (nearly one million), difficult terrain, and mobile miners. So far 40 recoveries; fatality rate about 23%. WHO is intensifying testing, contact tracing, and treatment; supplies have arrived, and Africa CDC is deploying technical expertise to accelerate the response, urging partners to mobilize resources to stop transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ出血熱の患者数が記録的な日増加を報告、アウトブレイク宣言から1ヶ月後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：確認782例・死亡181例、予想外：月単位での急速拡大、国際的拡大リスク：ウガンダへの越境、渡航制限リスク：あり）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5基準該当。社会的・政治的関心も高い。フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただしサマリーで越境事例が明記されているため、国際的拡大リスク評価は確実。Bundibugyo ebolavirus による高い致死率（約23%）、接触者追跡カバー率の低下（56%）、大規模人口移動（約100万人）による管理困難性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reports large daily jump in Ebola cases a month after outbreak was declared
article.articleSummary: 72 new Ebola virus disease cases were reported in the last 24 hours in Congo, lifting confirmed cases to 782 and deaths to 181 (including 29 in the latest period). The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, is centered in Ituri province (over 90% of cases) with cases also in North Kivu and South Kivu and now across the border into Uganda. The surge comes one month after the outbreak's confirmation on May 15; authorities say the numbers reflect expanded surveillance as well as rapid spread. The 56% contact-tracing coverage marks a sharp drop from last week due to community resistance and the outbreak’s expansion into new zones. Nearly a million people are displaced in Ituri, complicating tracing and including migratory miners moving across remote mineral sites. 40 patients have recovered; case fatality rate is 23%. WHO is intensifying testing, tracing, and treatment; Africa CDC is deploying expertise and reinforcing labs.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが大規模流行宣言から1ヶ月でエボラウイルス病の新規症例数が大幅増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、ならびにWPRO基準5項目全て該当。DRCはシグナル検出の最優先国の一つ。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo virus株）の確定症例782名、死亡181名という深刻な規模。1ヶ月で急速に拡大し、Ituri州を中心にNorth Kivu、South Kivu、ウガンダにまで越境。接触者追跡率56%に低下、約100万人の避難民が存在するため管理困難。WHOとAfrica CDCの国際的対応が進行中。ウガンダへの越境確認は本来なら対象国に含めるべきだが、記事の主題はDRCの流行であり、ウガンダは二次的言及に留まるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

locations.name: United Kingdom of Great Britain and Northern Ireland

article.articleHeadline: Nursing staff 'at risk' amid Ebola outbreak, warns RCN
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and Uganda driven by the Bundibugyo strain has led to more than 1,000 suspected cases and 246 deaths. The World Health Organization designated the outbreak a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May. UK Health Security Agency guidance urges clinicians to consider Ebola in acutely unwell patients who have left DRC or Uganda within the previous 21 days. In the UK, Ebola is a high consequence infectious disease, with overall public risk assessed as low. The Royal College of Nursing (RCN) warns nurses are at risk unless international support is mobilized to ensure adequate PPE, screening equipment, laboratory support, contact tracing, safe working conditions, and timely clinical guidance, in collaboration with the ICN. There is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo yet; three vaccines are in development. The outbreak highlights the ongoing need for sustained global health investment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ流行の中、看護職は「危険にさらされている」とRCNが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo株によるエボラウイルス病の流行で1,000件以上の疑い例と246人の死亡が報告され、WHOがPHEIC指定した国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威。DRCとウガンダで発生し、英国への輸出例も確認されている。
triage.notes: ウガンダはGeoNames上の発生地域に含まれているがWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。UK記事であるが、記事の主題はDRCとウガンダでのエボラ流行であり、DRCのみ対象国に該当。WHO PHEIC指定済み、ワクチン未承認のBundibugyo株による深刻な流行。

article.articleHeadline: Telangana ramps up seasonal disease preparedness, Health Minister orders heightened vigilance
article.articleSummary: On 15 June 2026, Telangana Health Minister C. Damodar Raja Narasimha chaired a monsoon preparedness review, addressing seasonal diseases—dengue, malaria, chikungunya, diarrhoea and typhoid. Director of Public Health Ravinder Naik presented district-wise case data and outlined hospital readiness, medicines, diagnostic kits, mosquito-control activities, fever surveys and ongoing awareness campaigns. Narasimha directed all government hospitals to maintain stockpiles of medicines, diagnostic kits, ORS packets and platelets, ensure adequate medical personnel and emergency services, and test and treat patients presenting with fever, dengue, malaria or other seasonal illnesses promptly. He ordered intensified vector control in collaboration with Municipal Administration and Panchayat Raj departments and reiterated strict implementation of the weekly Dry Day every Friday. Special attention should be given to high-risk locations—villages, urban localities, schools, hostels and construction sites. Accredited Social Health Activists and Auxiliary Nurse Midwives should conduct door-to-door awareness campaigns on prevention.

triage.headline_ja: テランガナ州が季節感染症への備えを強化、保健相が厳戒態勢を指示
triage.triage_reason: デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア熱などの季節性感染症が既知の流行状況にあり、異常性は低いが、複数疾患の同時流行リスクと地域の対応強化の動きが確認される。情報不足のため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は予防的な準備措置と警戒強化に関するもので、特定の異常な流行状況の報告ではない。デング熱、マラリア、チクングニア熱は当該地域の季節的パターン。具体的な症例数、死亡例、重症度に関する詳細情報は記事に含まれない。テランガナ保健相による行政的対応の発表であり、政治的関心は高い。

article.articleHeadline: Châu Phi căng mình ứng phó dịch Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Africa on edge as it mobilizes to combat the Ebola outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Ebola in Uganda is under control, according to Africa CDC, with 792 close contacts identified and actively monitored; Uganda's rapid response credited for a case fatality rate under 1%, per WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus. In neighboring DR Congo, the Ituri province remains the epicenter as Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease was confirmed on May 15, marking the 17th outbreak in DR Congo and triggering WHO's PHEIC. Surveillance gaps are flagged: fewer than 5,000 contacts under follow-up vs an estimated 24,000. The Congo conflict-affected region hinders tracing; a ceasefire is urged to enable response, especially for children in care facilities. The United States pledges $20 million for Africa outbreak response, bringing direct contributions to over $220 million, supporting Burundi, Kenya, Rwanda, and South Sudan, and supplementing previous $350 million for DRC, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカがエボラ出血熱の流行に対応するため態勢を整える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHO PHEIC発動、複数国での確認、米国による大規模支援表明など社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: 記事はエボラ出血熱の多国的発生を報道しているが、サマリーの主題はDRCのイトゥリ州（Bundibugyo型確認）とウガンダの状況。対象国リストではDRC（203312）のみが該当。Ituri（215709）はDRC内の州。US、Sudan、Rwanda、Kenya、Burundi、Ugandaは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。WHO PHEICが発動されており、公式な感染症危機レベルでの認定がある。

article.articleHeadline: Allemagne/CAE : 5 millions d'euros pour renforcer la lutte contre Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Germany/CAE: €5 million to strengthen the fight against Ebola.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, Germany provides €5 million to East Africa's Community of East African States (CAE) via KfW to bolster the regional response to Ebola, Mpox, and other highly infectious diseases, and to strengthen regional health systems and laboratory capacities. The agreement, signed in Arusha, Tanzania by CAE Secretary-General Stephen P. Mbundi and KfW official Vanessa Eidt, also supports enhanced surveillance and cross-border coordination. An additional €3 million through KfW is allocated for Ebola response. Ten mobile laboratories have been deployed across seven partner states—Burundi, Democratic Republic of Congo, Kenya, Rwanda, South Sudan, Tanzania, and Uganda—providing rapid diagnostics, confirmation, and outbreak containment as part of a regional reference laboratory network led with BNITM support. The CAE also received 500 PPE kits for frontline health workers.

triage.headline_ja: ドイツ/東アフリカ共同体：エボラ対策強化に500万ユーロを支援
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常/予想外」「国際的拡大リスク」「深刻な影響」の3基準に該当。複数国にまたがるエボラとMpox対策の地域的強化であり、WPROスクリーニング基準でも「長期曝露」「流行リスク」「管理可能性」に該当。社会政治的関心も高い（国際支援、複数国協調）。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに記載の7パートナー州の内、対象国リストに含まれるのはDRCのみ。Burundi、Kenya、Rwanda、South Sudan、Tanzania、Ugandaは対象国外。Zambiaについて記事には直接言及がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとするべき。本評価ではDRCのみを厳密に検証。支援額の大規模さ、複数国協調、高感染症（エボラ）の地域拡大対応という点でシグナル価値が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Cacique Raoni é internado na UTI com infecção grave em Mato Grosso
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chief Raoni is admitted to the ICU with a serious infection in Mato Grosso.
article.articleSummary: Indigenous leader Raoni Metuktire, 94, was admitted in grave condition to the Intensive Care Unit at Hospital Dois Pinheiros in Sinop, Mato Grosso, on Sunday afternoon, June 14. A medical bulletin released on the morning of June 15 said he arrived at the hospital at 5:00 p.m. after being airlifted from the Peixoto de Azevedo region where he resides. The patient remains in the ICU under continuous monitoring, receiving intravenous hydration, broad-spectrum antibiotics, and intensive multidisciplinary support. The health status is described as serious, requiring ongoing intensive care and uninterrupted monitoring by the hospital team. The report provides no specific pathogen; the illness is characterized as a serious infection. The transfer and admission underscore an acute health event for a prominent Brazilian Indigenous leader.

triage.headline_ja: 首長ラオニはマット・グロッソで深刻な感染症によりICUに入院
triage.triage_reason: 94歳の著名な先住民指導者の個人的な健康危機であり、公衆衛生上の集団感染事象ではない。病原体が不明で、感染症の流行リスクを示唆する情報がない。
triage.notes: 本イベントはブラジルで発生していますが、対象国リスト（Zambia, Philippines, Thailand, Ghana, DRC, Brazil, Indonesia, China, Myanmar, Vietnam, India）に含まれるブラジルであっても、シグナルとしてのピックアップ基準を満たしていません。これは単一患者の個人的な健康状態に関するニュースであり、感染症の集団発生事象ではありません。病原体が特定されておらず、ヒト-ヒト感染のリスク、流行の可能性、または国際的な拡大の兆候はありません。高齢著名人の健康危機は社会的関心を呼びますが、感染症の公衆衛生シグナルとしての重要性は認められません。

article.articleHeadline: Las ventas de Osborne se estancan en 2025 debido al efecto divisa, la guerra arancelaria y la peste porcina
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Osborne's sales stagnate in 2025 due to currency effects, the tariff war, and swine fever.
article.articleSummary: As of the 2025 results released on 15 June 2026, Osborne, the Andalusian wine-and-food group based in El Puerto de Santa María, posted net revenue of €252.5 million (up 0.6%), but net profit fell 19.9% to €12.9 million and EBITDA declined 5.9% to €35.4 million; debt reduced to €92.4 million from €95.5 million. International sales slipped 2% amid currency effects, tariff tensions, and African swine fever that constrained Cinco Jotas exports to certain destinations. Excluding these factors, international demand remained robust in key markets. The group bolstered brands 5J, Nordés, and Veterano, and launched products such as 5J sliced, Veterano RTD, Nordés 0.0, and Licores del Mono. It continues expansion in Germany, the United States, Italy, and China. Capex of €12.8 million in 2025 supported Jabugo, Riofrío, and Bodegas Montecillo, along with AI, cybersecurity upgrades, and a 17% rise in direct-to-consumer e-commerce.

triage.headline_ja: オズボーン社の2025年売上が停滞、通貨効果、関税戦争、豚熱の影響を受ける
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は食品企業の財務報告であり、豚熱はビジネスへの影響要因として言及されているのみ。動物疾病の公衆衛生危機として記事は構成されておらず、IHRおよびスクリーニング基準の該当基準がない。
triage.notes: 本記事はOsborne社（アンダルシア地方の食品・ワイングループ）の2025年財務結果の発表に関するもので、豚熱（African Swine Fever）は会社の国際売上低迷の背景要因として触れられているのみ。記事の主題は企業の経営状況であり、感染症イベント自体の詳細（患者数、死亡、地理的広がり、対策など）は全く記載されていない。対象国に該当する実際のASF発生地域も特定されない。

article.articleHeadline: ONG Médicos Sem Fronteiras alerta para avanço da epidemia de ebola na República Democrática do Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warns of the advancing Ebola epidemic in the Democratic Republic of the Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread rapidly one month after declaration, with MSF warning that response efforts are insufficient. Declared May 15—the 17th outbreak in the DRC—WHO issued an international health alert May 17. Official data show 782 cases and 181 deaths (case fatality ~23%), but MSF cautions these numbers likely underestimate the true burden. Contact tracing has improved to just over 70% of cases (from ~45%), yet diagnostic and surveillance gaps remain critical. Screening is fragile; in North Kivu only one laboratory analyzes blood samples with multi-day delays. Ituri province accounts for about 95% of cases, amid fear and distrust toward response teams. MSF is sending crews to remote, unstable areas to bolster detection and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 国境なき医師団がコンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行の進展について警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべて該当。エボラウイルスの継続的な拡大、高い死亡率、対応体制の不足が報告されており、国際的な懸念と支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は高い死亡率（~23%）を持つ重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。宣言から1ヶ月で782症例、181死亡が報告されている。MSFの警告により、接触者追跡（70%）や検査体制（北キブ州で1つの実験室のみ）における対応の不備が指摘されている。イトゥリ州が約95%の症例を占めており、地域の不安定性と信頼の欠如が対応を困難にしている。WHOは5月17日に国際保健警報を発令済み。

article.articleHeadline: Новая вспышка Эболы в Конго затронула соседнюю Уганду
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A new Ebola outbreak in Congo has affected neighboring Uganda.
article.articleSummary: Congolese Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, has reached 782 confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with 181 deaths, as of June 15, 2026. The country recorded 72 new cases in 24 hours, marking a major daily surge, and the outbreak has crossed borders into Uganda. The Bundibugyo virus outbreak is the 17th Ebola outbreak in Congo’s history. Within Congo, transmission remains focused in three eastern provinces—Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—and has affected 31 health zones; the geographic footprint is expanding. European Centre for Disease Prevention and Control (ECDC) data cited by Reuters showed 676 cases by June 10, indicating rapid growth over days. In Uganda, by June 11 there were 19 confirmed cases (two deaths), with 14 imported; most cases identified in Kampala and nearby Wakiso District. Ongoing surveillance and laboratory confirmation are underway.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの新しいエボラ流行が隣国ウガンダに影響を及ぼした
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な越境拡大、高い重症度（死亡率23％）、予想外の越境事例、国際渡航制限のリスクが存在。WPROスクリーニング基準でも全5項目に該当。
triage.notes: 発生地域フィールドにはウガンダも含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダは19例の輸入症例に留まり、主たる流行地はDRCの3つの東部州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）であることが明示されている。したがって verified_locations は DRC のみとした。エボラウイルス感染症（特にBundibugyo株）の国際的拡大、高い死亡率、急速な症例増加（24時間で72例）は直ちにフルRRAを必要とするシグナルである。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'implication des communautés locales et des institutions recommandée pour une riposte efficace - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: Involvement of local communities and institutions recommended for an effective response - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo strain, is highlighted in the Democratic Republic of Congo with a focus on community involvement for an effective response. In Kinshasa, expert Michée Kitima stresses that the 17th outbreak in Ituri, notably Bunia and Rwampara, cannot be controlled without active community participation. The response must operate at two levels: upstream dialogue to address fear and rumors, and downstream institutional leadership to bolster national coordination. Engagement should extend beyond messaging to dialogue, listening, and co-creation with communities in villages, churches, markets, schools, mining areas, and media. Kitima prescribes four measures: establish CREC (Risk Communication and Community Engagement) teams; empower community actors facing tangible constraints (transport, communication, security, funds); ensure dignified, safe burials to interrupt transmission; and listen before persuading. He also urges a presidential-led national consultative framework to capitalize on lessons from 2018 and craft a field roadmap to boost trust, coordination, and action.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：効果的な対応のための地域コミュニティと機関の関与を推奨 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）がDRCで17番目の流行として報告され、IHR基準3項目以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の17番目の流行に焦点を当てており、Ituri州（Bunia等）とKinshasa市での発生が記載されている。ルワンダについても地理的位置情報として記事内に参照されているが、記事の主題はDRCの流行対応であり、ルワンダでの確定発生は記載されていない。したがってverified_locationsにはDRCのみを含める。

article.articleHeadline: Paura dell'ebola in Congo: prova generale per la prossima pandemia?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fear of Ebola in Congo: a dress rehearsal for the next pandemic?
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of Congo is battling its 17th Ebola outbreak, described by Financial Times Africa editor David Pilling as unfolding amid health-budget cuts and a worrying lack of preparation for 'Disease X.' The article treats the current epidemic as a hard test for global health readiness and a warning against complacency in global funding for health. It portrays Gates Foundation funding of the Financial Times' Global Health & Development section as influential and repeats a 2025 Gates interview. The piece questions what global actors are preparing—suggesting a move toward a centralized emergency framework and a shift to preventive pharmaceutical production. It forecasts universal, RNA-based vaccine platforms that could be modified and produced within 100 days of identifying a new pathogen, potentially securing multibillion-dollar preorders with governments. The rhetoric is alarmist and conspiratorial.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ熱の恐怖：次のパンデミックへのドレスリハーサルか？
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の第17回発生が進行中であり、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクの複数該当が見込まれる。WPRO基準では重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で懸念あり。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国での第17回エボラ発生を報告。Financial Timesのアフリカ編集者が health-budget cuts と Disease X への不十分な準備を指摘。記事の一部にアラーミスト・陰謀論的トーンが含まれるが、基礎となるイベント（進行中のエボラ発生）はWHO通知に値する。フルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: RIVM zag al vroeg dat corona-uitbraak veel groter was dan gedacht
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: RIVM had already seen early on that the coronavirus outbreak was much larger than expected.
article.articleSummary: Rijksinstituut voor Volksgezondheid en Milieu (RIVM) modelers concluded early in the coronavirus outbreak in Wuhan that the scale was much larger than China's official figures. By analyzing data from local Chinese health authorities and other Asian countries, they inferred a wider spread than reported. The realization came in January 2020, as cases emerged in Japan and Thailand, suggesting the outbreak was bigger than the national counts indicated. Lead infectious-disease modeler Jacco Wallinga said the discrepancy could be explained by underreporting in national data, noting that local health services in China provided more usable information. The team benefited from a Mandarin-speaking intern who accurately translated the information, enabling the analysis.

triage.headline_ja: RIVMは早期の段階でコロナウイルスの発生が予想より大きいことを認識していた
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は2020年1月の過去のCOVID-19初期段階に関する回顧的な分析報告であり、新たな感染症イベントではない。現在の公衆衛生上の脅威を示す新規情報を含まない。
triage.notes: 記事は2020年1月の過去のCOVID-19初期段階に関する歴史的分析であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。配信日時が2026年6月15日となっているが、内容は明らかに2020年初期のイベントに関する後付解説である。新規感染症イベントではないため見送り。

article.articleHeadline: കോഴിക്കോട്ട് മലമ്പനി സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; തിക്കോടിയിൽ ഇതരസംസ്ഥാന തൊഴിലാളിക്ക് രോഗബാധ | Malaria confirmed in Kozhikode; migrant worker infected in Thikkodi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria confirmed in Kozhikode; migrant worker from another state infected in Thikkodi.
article.articleSummary: Malaria confirmed in Kozhikode district, India, with a migrant worker from another state infected in Thikkodi. Health authorities have intensified prevention and response activities. Primary symptoms include fever with severe chills, headache, and muscle pain, with fever and rigors recurring daily or every other day over several days. Other possible signs include delirium, nausea, vomiting, cough, and jaundice (yellowing of eyes/skin). Some patients may present with fever and headache alone. Malaria is caused by Plasmodium parasites and transmitted by Anopheles mosquitoes; these vectors breed in clean water, so eliminating standing water around homes and adopting personal protection are emphasized. If untreated, malaria can progress to cerebral malaria, affecting the brain and potentially causing death. This case is an imported infection in Thikkodi, Kozhikode.

triage.headline_ja: マラリアがコージコード地区で確認；他州からの出稼ぎ労働者がティッコディで感染
triage.triage_reason: インドの確認されたマラリア事例ですが、単一の輸入感染症例（出稼ぎ労働者）であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響やIHR基準の複数該当は明確ではありません。情報不足のため経過観察が必要です。
triage.notes: マラリアは蚊媒介で流行しやすい疾患ですが、本事例は単一の輸入感染症例の報告です。当局が対応を強化している点は注目ですが、大規模流行の兆候は記事サマリーに見当たりません。今後の症例増加状況について経過観察が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolarespons in Oost-Congo schiet ernstig tekort, waarschuwt Artsen zonder Grenzen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response in Eastern Congo is severely lacking, warns Doctors Without Borders.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (Bundibugyo variant) outbreak confirmed by WHO a month ago continues in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) with a record surge. Uganda reports 19 confirmed infections and is considered under control. In the DRC, 72 new confirmed Ebola cases were recorded in a single day, spreading to two provinces—Ituri and North Kivu. Total confirmed cases reach 782 with 181 deaths, the vast majority in Ituri. MSF warns the true scale is unknown; treatment centers in Ituri are overwhelmed, patients arrive late, and many are never identified or monitored as contacts before seeking care. An orphanage housing 69 children and several staff experiences rapid transmission; a newborn died at nine days old, another infant died, and three staff tested positive. Access is hindered by conflict; a funding shortfall of $21.5 million; Africa CDC calls for urgent donor support to strengthen the response and save lives.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ東部のエボラ対応は深刻に不足している、国境なき医師団が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス感染症の流行継続、死亡者数の増加、ウガンダへの国際的な拡大、医療対応体制の崩壊が確認されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRC（イツリ州および北キブ州）での主要な流行を記述しており、ウガンダは確認症例があるものの対照群（controlled）と記述されている。DRCが主要な発生地であることを確認。資金不足（21.5百万ドル）、治療センターの飽和、接触者追跡困難など管理可能性に深刻な懸念がある。孤児院でのクラスター事例（乳幼児死亡を含む）は社会的関心を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: Record increase in DRC Ebola cases raises death toll to 181
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) driven by the Bundibugyo virus strain has reached 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, with 72 new infections in the last 24 hours and 40 recoveries. Eastern Ituri province remains the epicenter, housing about 95% of cases, with spread into North Kivu and South Kivu and across the Uganda border. The Bundibugyo strain carries a 22.8% case‑fatality rate and has no approved vaccine or treatment, unlike the Zaire strain responsible for prior DRC outbreaks. Contact tracing coverage has collapsed to 56.5% from a 95% target, undermining containment amid conflict, patient escapes, and limited tracing. MSF warns the true scale may be larger due to gaps in surveillance and testing. Jean Kaseya of the Africa Centres for Disease Control and Prevention calls for urgent resource mobilization to strengthen the response as the outbreak accelerates.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ患者が記録的に増加、死亡者数が181人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性で懸念あり。エボラの国際的拡大（ウガンダへの越境感染）、高い死亡率（22.8%）、急速な感染拡大（24時間で72例）が確認されており、国際的支援が必要な重大事象。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダが含まれているが、記事サマリー上では「ウガンダ国境を越えた拡大」と述べられており、主要な発生地はDRCのIturi州（東部）。ウガンダでの確定症例の報告がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株によるエボラはZaire株よりもワクチン・治療法が限定的であり、接触追跡カバー率の低下（56.5%）が懸念される。早急なフルRRA実施が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Two more deaths due to shigellosis in Kerala
article.articleSummary: Two more deaths due to shigellosis were reported in Kerala on Monday, June 15, 2026. A seven-year-old boy from Kodur in Malappuram district died following bacillary dysentery caused by Shigella, and a 43-year-old man from Kodakara in Thrissur district who died on June 13 was confirmed the same day as shigellosis-related. Eight additional cases were reported across the state: Puthenthopu and Mukkola in Thiruvananthapuram; Poruvazhy in Kollam; Kodakara in Thrissur; Aliparamba in Malappuram; and Vadakara, Moododi, and Kunnamangalam in Kozhikode. Kerala now reports 147 confirmed cases, 76 probable cases, and five deaths due to shigellosis so far this year, indicating an ongoing outbreak of bacillary dysentery caused by Shigella."

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でシゲラ症による2人の死亡が追加報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。進行中の集団発生で既に147確定例・5死亡が報告されており、フルRRA実施が必要。
