triage.notes: ケーラ州内の複数地域（Malappuram、Thrissur、Thiruvananthapuram、Kollam、Kozhikode）での多点発生。年間で既に147確定例・76疑い例・5死亡が報告されており、進行中の集団発生と判断。シゲラ症は水系感染が多く、衛生状況悪化の可能性が示唆される。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。

article.articleHeadline: Com avanço do Ebola, missão oferece apoio espiritual a doentes no Congo
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: As the Ebola outbreak advances, the mission offers spiritual support to patients in Congo.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo prompts Samaritan's Purse to open two treatment centers in Bunia and Nyankunde, Ituri Province, where most confirmed cases are located. With cases surpassing 1,000, each center offers 40 beds and medical teams plus spiritual support for families. About 65 professionals are mobilized to train on hygiene, prevention, and community education, and dozens of hand-washing stations have been installed to reduce transmission. The program has reached more than 14,000 Congolese through awareness activities, while 12 humanitarian flights delivered PPE and medical supplies. The effort emphasizes patient isolation and care alongside faith-based outreach, and Franklin Graham has urged prayer for frontline workers and affected communities as the outbreak continues.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の拡大に伴い、ミッションがコンゴの患者に精神的支援を提供
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目中3項目に該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、異常性）。確認症例1000件超、複数治療センター開設、国際的人道支援を必要とする大規模発生。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模発生事例。確認症例1000件超、死亡情報は記事に明記されていないが治療センター開設と国際的な人道支援の動員から深刻な状況が示唆される。Ituri州Bunia地域を中心に発生。複数国からの国際支援（12便の人道支援輸送等）により国際的関与の高さが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: No new Nipah virus cases: Kerala after man who tested positive remains critical
article.articleSummary: No new Nipah virus cases have been reported in Kozhikode district, Kerala, as of 15 June 2026. The patient at Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital remains on ventilator support. A second dose of a monoclonal antibody drug was administered per ICMR guidelines. The second test of a healthcare worker from the patient’s primary contact list returned negative. Of seven admitted for observation, two close relatives were discharged after symptoms subsided and tested negative; another close relative under quarantine was admitted for observation. Six people are currently under observation in hospital, with one additional healthcare worker’s sample sent for testing. A total of 103 contacts are listed, including 45 healthcare workers: 4 very-high, 14 high, 85 low-risk. A central team visited Feroke; field visits covered 46 houses in Ramanattukara Division 5. The latest confirmed Nipah case, on 11 June, involves a 43-year-old man from Ramanattukara.

triage.headline_ja: ニパールウイルスの新規感染なし：ケーラ州内で陽性反応を示した男性患者が重篤な状態のまま
triage.triage_reason: ニパールウイルスの確認症例が報告され、患者が重篤（人工呼吸器装着）。ニパールウイルスはIHR通知対象疾患であり、異常/予想外の感染症イベント、重症度、ヒト-ヒト感染リスク、管理の必要性が全て該当する。
triage.notes: ニパールウイルスはNiV-Bおよび動物接触による自然発生的な発生が知られており、アウトブレーク対応を要する。患者が重篤で継続支援が必要。103名の接触者リストアップと積極的な監視体制が構築されており、ICMR指針下での治療実施。

article.articleHeadline: True scale of Congo Ebola outbreak still unknown one month in, responders say
article.articleSummary: Eastern DRC reports 782 confirmed Ebola cases and 181 deaths after one month, making it the third deadliest outbreak on record. The true scale remains unknown due to major data gaps and testing weaknesses; MSF says undercounting is likely, with data from laboratories, hospitals, and epidemiological surveillance hard to harmonize. Cases may be double-counted across health zones, while many deaths occur in communities not reached by authorities; officials say the virus may have circulated since February. In Nizi, Ituri, 19 positive cases and 17 deaths have been reported, while a national report lists 11 cases and one death for the area. Only 14 treatment facilities exist across nine zones, with the outbreak affecting 31 of at least 90 zones. Security incidents at burials (including a funeral in Mongbwalu) and an attack on burial teams in South Kivu, plus patient absconding, hinder response. MSF urges stronger diagnostics, surveillance, care access, and movement of health workers; containment window narrows.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染症流行の真の規模は依然不明、発生から1ヶ月経過後も対応者が指摘
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。782確認症例、181死亡、3番目に致命的なアウトブレイク、データギャップによる規模不明確性、安全保障上の課題が対応を阻害し、国際的支援が急務。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東部DRCにおけるエボラアウトブレイクの深刻性を明確に述べており、確認症例782、死亡181、イトゥリ州ニジでのセキュリティインシデント、埋葬時の攻撃などの対応阻害要因が記載されている。データギャップと検査の弱さにより真の流行規模が不明確という点が特に重要で、潜在的には更に大規模である可能性を示唆している。MSFによる診断強化、監視、ケアアクセス改善の要請は国際的支援の必要性を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Face à Ebola, un combat sur tous les fronts en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Facing Ebola, a battle on all fronts in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province has been ongoing since May, with 782 cases and 181 deaths reported by WHO and Congolese authorities. The Bundibugyo strain, an animal-origin Ebola lineage identified in 2007 in Uganda, currently has no licensed vaccine or treatment. Ituri, already destabilized by conflict, sees rapid spread driven by population displacement, mining-area crowding, and close family contacts; funeral practices risk amplification. Health responders emphasize early management: intensive hydration, pain control, nutrition support, and vital-sign monitoring, along with strict PPE, case isolation, and thorough contact tracing. Community engagement is central to prevention. An EU airlift on June 8 delivered 100 tonnes of emergency supplies to Bunia. Security challenges and distrust complicate response; the Catholic Church in Bunia coordinates hygiene promotion and support for displaced families amid perceived state inaction.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリでのエボラとの戦い：全面的な対応
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（致命率23%）の大規模アウトブレイク、782例・181死亡、ワクチン/治療法なし、国際的支援の既配備（EU支援）。シグナルとして確実。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (BDBV) は2007年ウガンダで初回分離されたエボラ種。現在のアウトブレイクは5月開始で782例・181死亡（致命率23.1%）と大規模。ワクチン・治療法なし。紛争によるIturi地域の不安定さ、人口移動、鉱業地域の過密、葬儀慣行が急速な感染拡大を促進。EU支援（6月8日）など国際的対応が既に始動。記事はUganda地域も言及されているが、サマリーの主題はDRCのIturi州でのアウトブレイクであるため、DRCのみをverified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: 九江市举办结核病防治职业技能竞赛
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Jiujiang City Hosts a Tuberculosis Prevention and Control Vocational Skills Competition
article.articleSummary: TB prevention and control knowledge contest held in Jiujiang City on June 12, organized by the Municipal Health Commission and hosted by the Municipal CDC with the Third People’s Hospital as co-organizer. Over 50 participants from across districts/counties, CDCs, and medical institutions took part, answering a common theoretical exam. The contest covered TB fundamentals, prevention and control, laboratory testing, clinical diagnosis and treatment, and provisions of the Infectious Disease Prevention and Control Law. Contestants maintained composure and demonstrated solid professional knowledge and ethics. City CDC leadership oversaw the event to ensure fairness, with plans to select a provincial competition team and award certificates. The event aims to promote TB prevention knowledge citywide, translate learning into practice, and strengthen public health defenses, contributing to healthier Jiujiang and citizens’ respiratory health.

triage.headline_ja: 九江市が結核病防治職業技能競技会を開催
triage.triage_reason: 結核の教育・啓発イベント（知識競技会）の報告であり、新規の感染症危機や異常な発生を示す情報ではない。公衆衛生上の深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクのいずれも認められない。
triage.notes: 本記事は結核病の防止と対策に関する職業技能競技会（教育イベント）の開催報告であり、感染症の流行や危機的状況を示すシグナルではない。ルーチンな公衆衛生啓発活動として分類される。

article.articleHeadline: Segundo periodo de vacunación contra fiebre aftosa ya alcanza 78,87% del hato bovino
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Second vaccination period against foot-and-mouth disease already reaches 78.87% of the cattle herd.
article.articleSummary: Paraguay's second vaccination period against foot-and-mouth disease has reached 78.87% of the national cattle herd, with data cut-off at June 12. Highest vaccination coverage is in Guairá (86.11%), Boquerón (85.68%), and Amambay (84.36%), followed by Canindeyú (81.54%) and Presidente Hayes (80.01%). Lower coverage persists in Ñeembucú (67.35%), Guazú (70.58%), Cordillera (71.62%), and Alto Paraná (74.07%), though all remain on track. The campaign also reports progress in owner registration, now 72.80% nationally (73,351 producers), led by Misiones (90.05%), Boquerón (85.33%), Guairá (83.66%), and Ñeembucú (82.16%); San Pedro (58.06%), Cordillera (61.94%), and Caaguazú (61.79%) trail behind. In the western region, Boquerón combines high vaccination (85.68%) with registration (85.33%), while Presidente Hayes reaches 80.01% vaccination and 74.27% registration; Alto Paraguay records 73.65% and 75.36%. These results support Paraguay’s sanitary status and market access; Senacsa urges completion of vaccination and registration within deadlines.

triage.headline_ja: 口蹄疫ワクチン接種の第2期キャンペーン、全国の牛群の78.87%に到達
triage.triage_reason: パラグアイの口蹄疫ワクチン接種キャンペーンの進捗報告であり、新たな感染事例の報告ではない。疾病管理下での定期的な予防接種活動であるため、公衆衛生危機シグナルとしての性質を持たない。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIが返した発生地域にはパラグアイ、ボリビア、フィリピンが含まれているが、記事サマリーはパラグアイのワクチン接種キャンペーンの進捗のみを記述。パラグアイは対象国（GeoNames ID: 3437598）に含まれていない。新規感染事例の報告ではなく、既知の疾病に対する予防接種活動の進捗報告であるため、シグナル検出対象外。

article.articleHeadline: UAE pojačavaju borbu protiv ebole: Podrška WHO-u u Africi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The UAE step up the fight against Ebola: Support for the WHO in Africa
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-15, the United Arab Emirates pledged expanded support to the WHO Ebola response in Africa, channeling aid through the UAE Aid Agency (WAM). State Minister Sheik Shakhbout bin Nahyan Al Nahyan confirmed UAE’s commitment to humanitarian relief, vaccine supply, medicines, and coordination with governments and UN bodies to bolster treatment centers. The article notes the cross-border spread of the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, prompting calls to double international efforts to curb transmission across age groups in Africa. UAE’s multi-faceted assistance includes medical aid and vaccine provision, in partnership with international and local organizations. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warned that the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains uncontrolled, citing isolation and contact-tracing challenges, and stressed achieving 90% isolation to halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: UAEがエボラ対策を強化：アフリカでのWHO支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（既知の高危険病原体）の民主共和国での流行継続、国際的支援拡大、及びWHO事務局長による「制御不可能」との評価により、IHR基準2つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準でも複数該当（異常性、国境越境拡大、管理能力の課題）。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: UAE等の国際支援拡大が報道されているが、エボラの実発生地はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のみが記事主題。WHOのテドロス事務局長による「制御不可能」警告と国境越境拡大（Bundibugyo strain）への言及により、重症度・流行性・管理性での課題が明確。

article.articleHeadline: Actualité | Avec un financement direct de 200 millions USD, les Etats- Unis sont en première ligne dans la lutte contre Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: News | With $200 million in direct funding, the United States is at the forefront of the fight against Ebola | mediacongo.net
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo declared its 17th Ebola outbreak, announced by the Ministry of Health on 16 May 2026, with Mongbwalu health zone in Ituri province identified as the epicenter. On 17 May, the World Health Organization classified the outbreak as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern. The United States has provided substantial support: about $200 million in direct funding for the response under bilateral cooperation, over $350 million regionally, and roughly $1.8 billion for humanitarian activities. Aid flows through the Office for the Coordination of Humanitarian Affairs (OCHA), the World Food Programme (WFP), UNICEF, and the International Organization for Migration for border screening and surveillance to curb cross-border spread. The U.S. aims to deepen collaboration with the Congolese government, including strengthening capacities via a Health Emergency Operations Center to coordinate the response, with all activities aligned to the DRC’s national Ebola response plan for this outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: ニュース | 2億ドルの直接資金提供により、米国がエボラウイルスとの戦いの最前線に | mediacongo.net
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みで国際的な対応が進行中の新規エボラウイルス発症。
triage.notes: 2026年6月15日時点でDRCが17番目のエボラウイルス発症を宣言。5月16日にIturi州Mongbwalu保健地区を中心に発症が確認され、5月17日にWHOがPHEIC(国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態)として宣言。米国が2億ドルの直接資金提供を含む大規模な支援を実施中。国際的な対応体制が整備されている重大な感染症イベント。

article.articleHeadline: 23 new ASF cases confirmed in Nueva Vizcaya
article.articleSummary: 23 new African swine fever (ASF) cases confirmed in Nueva Vizcaya as of 2026-06-16, affecting the municipalities of Kasibu, Bayombong, and Villaverde. PVSO reports these sporadic outbreaks, fewer than last year’s 25 cases, with no spread to other towns. ASF continues to threaten the province’s swine industry, prompting ongoing surveillance and biosecurity measures. With Department of Agriculture support, two municipalities received 10 million pesos each under the Swine Repopulation Project to rebuild herds via gilts, feeds, and veterinary supplies. Additional provincial funding includes 300,000 pesos for animal health services, 1,000 rabies vaccine vials for dogs and cats (10,000 doses total), and 60,000 pesos for spaying/neutering kits. Separately, 40 cattle were dispersed to tobacco farmers under a 2 million-peso provincial program. Nueva Vizcaya remains free of avian influenza, shielding poultry sector stability.

triage.headline_ja: ヌエバ・ビスカヤで23件の新規アフリカ豚熱症例が確認
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚熱（ASF）は動物感染症であり、ヒトへの感染リスクはない。記事は家畜産業への経済的影響を述べているが、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響や国際的な感染拡大リスクはIHR基準の該当なし。
triage.notes: IHR通知対象外。アフリカ豚熱は動物疾病であり、公衆衛生上の直接的な脅威ではない。フィリピンは対象国リストに含まれるが、ヒト感染症ではないため、EBS活動のシグナルトリアージ対象外。

article.articleHeadline: കോഴിക്കോട്ട് ഒരാൾക്ക് മലേറിയ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു | Deepika | The Largest Read Malayalam Internet Daily | Online News
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria confirmed in one person in Kozhikode.
article.articleSummary: Malaria confirmed in one person in Kozhikode, Kerala. The patient is a migrant worker who traveled from Madhya Pradesh and arrived in Kozhikode by the end of May. He developed fever and related symptoms on June 8, and subsequent laboratory testing confirmed malaria. The case is described as imported, with no report of deaths or additional locally transmitted cases at this time. The report underscores the risk of travel-related malaria and the need for prompt testing of febrile travelers from other states. No further clinical details are provided in the article, including the Plasmodium species or treatment specifics. This single imported case highlights the importance of surveillance for infections among interstate migrant workers and rapid diagnostic confirmation to prevent secondary transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コージコット（コーチン）でマラリアが一人に確認される
triage.triage_reason: インドで確認された輸入マラリア症例（単発）。重症度や公衆衛生への重大な影響は明確ではなく、現時点では国内二次感染報告なし。継続的な監視が必要だが、フルRRA実施までの情報としては不足。
triage.notes: 記事は州間労働者の移動に関連するマラリアの輸入症例を報告。感染リスク自体は存在（マラリアは流行の可能性がある感染症）だが、単発の確認症例で死亡報告なく、二次感染報告もない。サーベイランスの重要性が述べられているが、公衆衛生危機の兆候は限定的。今後の追加症例報告を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola au pays - MSF s'inquiète des lacunes dans la riposte médicale
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: Ebola in the country — MSF is concerned about gaps in the medical response
article.articleSummary: One month after the Ebola outbreak declaration in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, MSF says the virus is spreading faster than the humanitarian response. Authorities report more than 650 confirmed cases and over 130 deaths; Uganda has 19 confirmed cases. The outbreak centers on Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, with Ituri ~95% of cases. MSF cautions that treatment centers are overwhelmed, many patients present late, and most contacts are not identified or tracked. Three barriers hinder control: limited access to testing and long lab turnarounds; despite mobile tests for Bundibugyo, insecurity and a single North Kivu lab slow results up to a week; mistrust of external responders; and neglect of routine health services, risking maternal care, child vaccinations, malaria and cholera treatment. MSF has mobilized 600 health workers and shipped hundreds of tonnes of supplies, urging rapid strengthening of diagnostics, surveillance, care access, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：国内でのエボラ出血熱 — MSFは医療対応の欠陥について懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）かつWPRO基準5項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の多国家での報告、高い死亡率、医療体制の崩壊が確認されており、緊急対応が必要。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの19件の確定症例も報告されているが、記事の主題はコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ発生であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。コレラとマラリアが記事サマリーで言及されているが、これらは主流行ではなく二次的懸念として記述されている。医療体制の深刻な崩壊、接触者追跡の失敗、検査能力の限界が制御困難性を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: 疱疹性咽峡炎进入高发期，专家：多见于6岁以下儿童
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Herpangina enters a peak-incidence period; experts say it is most common in children under six.
article.articleSummary: Herpangina is entering a peak-incidence period in China, mainly affecting children under six. In Zhuhai, Guangdong, families report fever, poor appetite, and throat white blisters; some kindergartens have suspended classes. Pediatric departments in Wuhan, Guangzhou, and Xiamen report a near 50% rise in cases compared with earlier periods. Jiangsu CDC warned in May that herpangina is in high season; Guangdong CDC cautioned on June 9 that higher temperatures, rainfall, and holiday gatherings heighten risk, alongside dengue, chikungunya, hand-foot-mouth disease, and measles. The illness is caused by enteroviruses (coxsackie, echovirus, EV71) and is highly contagious. Lesions are in the oropharynx (soft palate, uvula sides, tonsils) with gray-white vesicles 1–2 mm; fever 38–40 C, throat pain, irritability. It lasts about 4–7 days; no antiviral exists, treatment is supportive. EV71 vaccine can reduce severe disease. Prevention: hygiene, nutrition, oral care, avoidance of crowds, ventilation, boiling utensils, and chlorinated disinfection.

triage.headline_ja: 疱疹性咽峡炎進入高発期、専家：6歳以下児童に多見
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（Enterovirus 71、麻疹、チクングニア、デング熱）が中国で同時に高い活動を示しており、IHR基準（異常性・国際的リスク）2つ以上に該当。小児施設の休園、複数都市での症例増加、当局の警告があり、スクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は疱疹性咽峡炎（Herpangina）を主題としており、Enterovirus 71を含む複数のエンテロウイルスによる感染症と記載。同時にデング熱、チクングニア、手足口病、麻疹の増加も言及されており、夏季の呼吸器・ウイルス感染症クラスターの可能性。複数の地方疾病予防管理センターからの公式警告がある。国際的拡大リスクおよび渡航制限リスクについては現記事では明記されていないため不明とした。

article.articleHeadline: El Niño coincidió con algunos de los peores brotes de dengue de la última década
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: El Niño coincided with some of the worst dengue outbreaks of the last decade.
article.articleSummary: El Niño coincided with some of the worst dengue outbreaks in the last decade in Costa Rica, with three ENSO phases (2014–2016, 2018–2019, 2023–2024) driving 142,660 vector-borne cases, of which dengue accounted for 125,035 (87.65%). The 2014–2016 period, including the 2016 Super Niño, recorded 51,853 dengue cases; chikungunya reached 4,912 (2015) and 3,613 (2016); zika totaled 7,820 (2014–2016). The 2018–2019 phase had dengue 10,914; chikungunya 291; zika 639. The 2023–2024 interval saw dengue at 61,908—the highest toll. PAHO/WHO reported incidence rates of 600.37 and 609.46 per 100,000 in 2023 and 2024. Serotype circulation intensified: 2016—1,2,3; 2018–2019—1,2; 2023–2024—1–4; current circulation remains 1 and 3. Severe dengue: 43 cases and 7 deaths (all in 2024); 195 dengue with warning signs in 2024. Atenas Canton repeatedly among top five; other recurring cantons include Abangares, Nicoya, La Cruz, Sarapiquí, Guácimo, Osa, Corredores, Santa Cruz, Buenos Aires.

triage.headline_ja: エルニーニョは過去10年間で最悪のデング熱流行と一致
triage.triage_reason: コスタリカで複数のENSO段階にわたり142,660件のベクター媒介性疾患（デング125,035件含む）が記録されており、2023-2024年には過去最高の61,908件のデング症例と7件の死亡が報告されている。IHR基準2つ以上該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響と異常な流行が認められるため、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはコスタリカ（対象国リストに含まれない）とフィリピン（GeoNames ID 1694008）が記載されているが、記事サマリーの主題はコスタリカでのデング熱流行である。フィリピンは記事サマリー内で言及されていないため除外。対象国リストに該当する発生地がないため verified_locations は空配列。ただしコスタリカにおける深刻な流行は PAHO/WHO報告に基づく確実な情報であり、シグナルとしてのピックアップは妥当。

article.articleHeadline: Kinshasa : les élèves d'une école sensibilisés à la prévention contre Ebola - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kinshasa: Students at a school sensitized to Ebola prevention - ACP
article.articleSummary: Kinshasa, Democratic Republic of the Congo – At Sacré-Cœur school in Masina, east of Kinshasa, students were sensitized on prevention of cholera and Ebola virus disease during a ceremony on June 15, 2026. The event, part of the Étoile du Sud project, was led by Zozo Mpemudjiri, president of the Masina 1 health zone community relays, who said awareness activities will extend to households and other schools and will also address mpox. The campaign aims to break transmission by teaching essential measures: frequent handwashing with soap, drinking purified or boiled water, and maintaining healthy eating. The article notes that cholera and Ebola prevention is a community-wide concern, not limited to any age group.

triage.headline_ja: キンシャサ：学校の生徒がエボラ予防に関する啓発活動を実施 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ、コレラ、mpoxの3疾患が言及されており、DRCの首都キンシャサで啓発活動が実施されているが、記事は主に教育・予防キャンペーン活動であり、実際の疾患の流行や増加を報告していない。感染症イベントの検証が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は学校での予防啓発キャンペーン活動の報告であり、実際の感染症の流行拡大を示す情報ではない。Bluedotが複数疾患（Ebola、Cholera、Mpox）を検出しているが、記事サマリーからは実際の症例報告や疾患発生の確認は読み取れない。情報が啓発活動に限定されているため、経過観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola virus screening underway at Coimbatore International Airport
article.articleSummary: At Coimbatore International Airport, India, Ebola virus screening is underway as a preventive measure. Health advisories from the Ministry of Health and Family Welfare guide the response, with Civil Aviation SOPs followed by the airport. In-flight announcements and self-declaration forms classify passengers as asymptomatic or symptomatic; forms are reviewed by airport health officers and the Immigration Department on landing. Symptomatic travelers are moved to an isolation room and, if needed, to a designated hospital via a state ambulance after doctors’ advice. As of 2026-06-15 (Monday), no symptomatic case has been reported at Coimbatore airport. Declarations collect 21-day travel history and contacts with people who travelled to Ebola-affected countries such as Congo, Uganda, and South Sudan.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルススクリーニングがコインバトール国際空港で進行中
triage.triage_reason: インドの主要空港でエボラウイルス対応体制が既に稼働しており、複数のアフリカ国（DRC、ウガンダ、スーダン）からの感染リスクに基づいた国際的スクリーニングが実施されている。異常/予想外かつ国際的拡大リスクが認識され、公式な対応体制が構築されている。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドにはDRC、ウガンダ、スーダンが含まれているが、記事サマリー上の主題はインドのコインバトール空港でのスクリーニング実施であり、実際の患者発生地はアフリカである。しかし検疫・スクリーニング体制が確立された対象国（インド）でのイベントであるため、verified_locationsはインドのみとした。アフリカでのエボラ発生が背景にあり、国際的な関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Gram-Negative Pathogens Dominate Neonatal Infections in Manila
article.articleSummary: Manila, Philippines, NICUs show Gram-negative bacteria dominate both early-onset (within 72 hours of birth) and late-onset neonatal infections, according to a Nature Communications study. Klebsiella pneumoniae and Escherichia coli emerged as primary culprits, with extended-spectrum beta-lactamase (ESBL)–producing strains complicating therapy. Researchers used culture plus molecular diagnostics to reveal frequent polymicrobial sepsis and subtle shifts in pathogens not captured by culture alone. Environmental and procedural factors—overcrowded facilities, limited infection control resources, insufficient sterilization, frequent invasive procedures, and long hospital stays—facilitate transmission of multidrug-resistant Gram-negatives in Manila's NICUs. The findings challenge traditional timing-based distinctions between early- and late-onset infections and call for empirical regimens with broader Gram-negative coverage in neonatal sepsis, alongside strengthened antimicrobial stewardship and surveillance. The study signals a Southeast Asian shift toward Gram-negative dominance in neonatal infections, underscoring urgent investment in diagnostics and infection-control capacity.

triage.headline_ja: グラム陰性菌がマニラの新生児感染症を支配
triage.triage_reason: 新生児感染症の病原体パターン変化（グラム陰性菌優位、多剤耐性菌増加）を報告する研究発表で、地域的な感染制御上の課題と微生物学的な関心がある。ただし、流行発生ではなく疫学的観察研究であり、即座の公衆衛生的脅威としての緊急性が限定的。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症の流行発生ではなく、研究発表に基づく病原体パターンの変化に関する報告。マニラのNICU施設における環境的・運用上の感染制御不備（過密、資源不足、滅菌不十分、侵襲的処置頻繁、長期入院）が多剤耐性グラム陰性菌の伝播を促進している点で地域公衆衛生上の懸念材料。東南アジア地域における新生児感染症の病原体シフトを示唆し、診断能力と感染制御能力への投資の必要性を強調している。

article.articleHeadline: Hospital recebe R$ 2,4 milhões para ampliar busca ativa de hanseníase em MS
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hospital receives R$ 2.4 million to expand active case finding for leprosy in Mato Grosso do Sul
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Mato Grosso do Sul government allocated R$2.4 million to the Associação de Auxílio e Recuperação dos Hansenianos (AARH), operator of Hospital São Julião in Campo Grande, to fund active case finding and identification of new Hansen's disease (leprosy) cases across the state. The agreement with the State Health Secretariat (SES), via the Special Health Fund, provides 12 monthly payments of R$200,000, with an initial 12-month term and potential extension up to 60 months if both parties agree. Signed on 11 June, the program aims to systematize proactive case finding as a public health priority in multiple regions. In addition, a separate agreement (Convênio 007/2025, signed 30 June 2025) was extended for five more months (30 June–30 November) to fund hospital energy costs at São Julião, maintaining other terms.

triage.headline_ja: ハンセン病（らい病）の積極的な症例発見拡大のためにマットグロッソドスル州の病院が240万レアルを受け取る
triage.triage_reason: ハンセン病は既知の疾患で、本記事は資金配分と行政プログラムの拡充についての報道。新規発生、異常な集団発生、または国際的リスクの証拠がない。
triage.notes: ブラジルは対象国リストに含まれていない（GeoNames ID: 3469034）。記事は既知疾患であるハンセン病の診断・治療能力強化の行政プログラムに関するもので、新規シグナルの要件を満たさない。

article.articleHeadline: നിപയ്ക്ക് പുറമെ മലേറിയയും, കോഴിക്കോട് ഇതര സംസ്ഥാന തൊഴിലാളിക്ക് രോഗം സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു നിലവിൽ തിക്കോടിയിൽ ഇയാൾ താമസിച്ചിരുന്നു സ്ഥലത്ത് തന്നെ നീരീക്ഷണത്തിൽ തുടരുകയാണ്.
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles as well as Nipah confirmed in a migrant worker from another state in Kozhikode; he had been living in Thikkodi and is currently under observation at the same place.
article.articleSummary: Measles and Nipah virus infections are confirmed in a migrant worker from Madhya Pradesh now in Kozhikode, Kerala. The individual, who arrived in late May to seek work and resided in a rented building in Thikkodi, is under observation at the same site. He developed high fever and was admitted on June 8; laboratory testing confirmed measles, with Nipah infection also confirmed. Health officials report no cause for alarm and describe his condition as stable. The health department identifies Madhya Pradesh as the source of the measles infection, indicating an imported case. Contact tracing and local surveillance are ongoing to monitor potential spread within the Thikkodi locality and surrounding areas.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルスおよび麻疹が、コーチン在住の別州出身出稼ぎ労働者で確認され、ティッコディで経過観察中
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルス感染（高致死率の新興感染症）と麻疹の同時確認という異常事象、複数の対象国との関連性（インド国内の州間移動），および国境を越えた労働人口流動のリスク。IHR基準2項目以上該当，WPRO基準3項目以上該当。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスは高致死率（40～75%）の重篤感染症。麻疹との同時感染は異常。マディヤ・プラデーシュからケーラ州への州間移動による感染事例は，インド国内での疾病伝播リスクを示唆。接触者追跡および地域サーベイランスが進行中。記事は2026年6月15日配信であるが，感染確認は2026年6月8日。

article.articleHeadline: Florentino Neto passa por exames e segue tratamento contra dengue em casa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Florentino Neto undergoes tests and continues treatment for dengue at home.
article.articleSummary: Brazilian federal deputy Florentino Neto (PT) was hospitalized in Parnaíba, Piauí, on Sunday, June 14, for dengue-related tests after his diagnosis on Friday, June 12. He remained in observation at Hospital Marques Bastos and was discharged the same day to continue dengue treatment at home. On social media, his team stated that he would undergo additional laboratory and imaging studies on Monday, June 15, to monitor his clinical condition. He remains at rest per medical advice and is expected to resume official duties only after completing the treatment. The report provides no details on symptoms beyond the dengue diagnosis and does not reference any outbreak or case counts beyond the single patient.

triage.headline_ja: フロレンティーノ・ネト連邦下院議員がデング熱の検査を受け、自宅での治療を継続
triage.triage_reason: 単一の個人患者（政治家）の入院・退院事例であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、および流行可能性は認められない。発症者が限定的で、地域的なデング流行の兆候もない。
triage.notes: 記事は個人患者の医療対応に関する人事報道的な内容。デング熱が流行性疾患であるため WPROスクリーニング基準では epidemic_prone の可能性があるが、本記事ではアウトブレイクや複数患者の言及がなく、単一患者の経過報告に限定されている。社会的関心は高いが、公衆衛生危機の証拠がないため DISMISS と判定。

article.articleHeadline: What Congo's New Referendum Bill Means for Democracy and the Ebola Response
article.articleSummary: DRC's National Assembly passed a referendum bill on 09 June 2026, creating a legal framework for national referendums and introducing a pathway to constitutional changes via a constituent assembly when state institutions face 'major dysfunction.' The measure leaves Article 220 intact but critics argue it could bypass term limits and enable prolonged presidential rule. President Félix Tshisekedi’s current term ends in 2028; in May 2026 he said he had not asked for a third term but would accept one if the people wanted it. The vote comes amid a worsening Ebola outbreak with more than 100 deaths and 550 confirmed cases, attacks on frontline health workers, and restricted humanitarian access in conflict-affected areas. International dynamics include US strategic mineral deals cited to justify reforms. The African Charter guarantees rights to participate and health, which are pressed by the crisis. Calls for Constitutional Court clarity on compatibility and for AU and ACHPR examination of the process are urged.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの新国民投票法が民主主義とエボラ対応に与える意味
triage.triage_reason: エボラ発生（100+ 死亡、550+ 確定例）が進行中であり、国家機能不全と政治的不安定性がエボラ対応を阻害している状況が報告されている。IHR基準3項目（重篤な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）該当、WPRO基準4項目該当。
triage.notes: 記事は政治的な国民投票法可決の報道だが、進行中のエボラ感染症危機（100+ 死亡、550+ 確定例）と紛争地域での医療従事者への攻撃、人道支援アクセス制限が明記されている。国家機能不全がエボラ対応を複雑化させており、感染症危機管理上の重要なシグナル。発生地域に米国が含まれているが、記事本文では米国でのエボラ発生言及なし。DRC のみを verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: تحذيرات من اتساع تفشي إيبولا في الكونغو وسط غموض حول الأعداد الحقيقية
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warnings of a widening Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo amid uncertainty about the true numbers.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of May 2026, marking it as the third-largest Ebola surge on record. The Bundibugyo strain is circulating, with the epicenter in eastern provinces Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, and new health zones reporting cases. Health responders warn the true burden may be higher due to surveillance gaps, reporting delays, testing shortages, and underreporting of community deaths, compounded by population movement and access challenges. Violence against safe-burial teams and treatment centers, along with distrust and continued displacement, impede containment and sustain transmission. The outbreak was declared in May 2026 and has extended into additional health zones in Ituri and North/South Kivu. UN and WHO characterize it as among the gravest crises in the Lake Victoria basin, with potential blind spots suggesting broader spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ流行拡大の警告 真の患者数を巡る不透明さの中で
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤な感染症であり、782確認症例・181死亡は深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスクを示唆している。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのエボラ流行（Bundibugyo株）を主題としており、South Kivu、Ituri、North Kivu州が主な発生地。オーストラリアは発生地域フィールドに含まれているが、記事サマリーに根拠がないため除外。2026年5月宣言、第3位規模のエボラ流行。監視ギャップ、報告遅延、治療施設への暴力などが対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebolarespons in Oost-Congo schiet ernstig tekort, waarschuwt Artsen zonder Grenzen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola response in eastern Congo is severely lacking, warns Doctors Without Borders.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak response in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo is severely lacking, according to Doctors Without Borders. MSF warns there are too few tests, hospital beds, and protective equipment, and contact tracing has not taken off, allowing transmission to spread to new locations. A month ago the World Health Organization confirmed the outbreak of the rare Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant, but the outbreak’s scale remains unclear. In neighboring Uganda, there are 19 confirmed infections and authorities say the outbreak is under control. In the Democratic Republic of Congo, the response has not yet caught up with the virus, risking wider spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ対応が東コンゴで深刻な不足、国境なき医師団が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の確認された多国間流行であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的拡大リスクが明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでウガンダの19例確認と記載されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。DRCでのエボラ流行が主題であり、対応体制の不備が強調されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus の稀な亜型が確認されており、疫学的に重要。

article.articleHeadline: Hyderabad: Health Minister Asks Officials To Conduct Prompt Testing For Seasonal Diseases
article.articleSummary: Hyderabad Health Minister Damodar Rajanarsimha urged prompt testing and immediate treatment for fever, dengue, malaria, and other seasonal illnesses as the monsoon begins, ensuring no shortages of medicines, diagnostic kits, ORS, platelets, staff, or emergency services in government hospitals. Director of Public Health Dr Ravinder Nayak briefed on the current situation and district-wise case data at the review meeting. The government aims to prevent disease spread, not just treat outbreaks, and called for intensified mosquito-control in coordination with municipal and panchayat raj departments. A weekly dry-day program, rapid elimination of stagnant water, larval control, fogging, and fever surveys were mandated, with focus on villages, towns, schools, hostels, and construction sites. ASHA workers and ANMs were asked to undertake door-to-door awareness. Stronger inter-department collaboration—municipal, panchayat raj, education, women and child welfare, revenue—should accelerate sanitation, safe drinking water, and field-level monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: ハイデラバード：保健大臣が季節性疾病の迅速な検査を実施するよう当局者に要請
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とマラリアの季節的発生であり、当局による対応体制の強化が確認される。ただし、具体的な症例数、死亡者数、国際的な拡大リスク等の詳細情報が不足しており、現段階では経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: インドのテランガーナ州ハイデラバードでのデング熱・マラリアに関する行政的対応記事。季節的な疾患発生への予防的措置が述べられているが、具体的な発症者数、重症例、死亡例等の疫学データが記事に記載されていない。モンスーン期に向けた当局による対応体制の強化が確認されるため、継続して情報収集を行う必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Uganda, DRC Strengthen Cross-Border Coordination Ahead of Joint Ebola Response Plan
article.articleSummary: Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) concluded a two-day cross-border meeting in Aru town to strengthen preparedness against Ebola and other threats along their shared border. They finalized arrangements for a Joint Ebola Response Plan to improve disease surveillance, information sharing, screening, and emergency response in border communities. Uganda's delegation was led by Dr. Charles Olaro, Director General of Health Services. The plan aims to roll out early detection of suspected cases, strengthen referral systems, harmonize response protocols, and enhance cross-border communication. Mechanisms for real-time information sharing, entry-point screening (official and unofficial), and community engagement were discussed. Uganda has invested in Ebola preparedness, including isolation facilities, trained staff, and laboratory capacity, and notes the 2022 Sudan Ebola outbreak affected Mubende and Kassanda, underscoring cross-border collaboration. The joint plan seeks to boost readiness and protect border communities through coordinated surveillance and response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：ウガンダ、DRC、共同エボラ対応計画を前に国境調整を強化
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症は深刻な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、国際的な広がりのリスクがあるが、本記事は予防的な準備計画の発表であり、実際の新規発生事例ではない。情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際のエボラ発生事例報告ではなく、DRCとウガンダが国境地域でのエボラ対策強化のための協調計画を発表したもの。2022年のスーダンエボラ株によるウガンダ内での過去発生が言及されている。ウガンダの座標情報は対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めない。

article.articleHeadline: Israel Lifts Ebola-Related Travel Restrictions on Kenya and Rwanda
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-15, Israel lifted Ebola-related entry restrictions for Kenya and Rwanda, removing them from the list of affected countries. The prior June 10 directive barred airlines from carrying passengers from Ebola-affected states and travelers who had visited listed countries within 21 days. Uganda, South Sudan, and the Democratic Republic of Congo remain on Israel’s Ebola monitoring list. Kenya, which reports no Ebola cases, continues enhanced screening and surveillance, with over 100,000 travelers screened at airports and border posts and about 3,000 checked daily. Kenya is collaborating with international partners, including the United States, to strengthen preparedness, including plans for Ebola isolation and treatment facilities. Nairobi criticized the initial inclusion as unjustified but welcomed the decision as a positive step in bilateral relations. Rwanda is similarly removed from the restrictions.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエル、ケニアとルワンダに対するエボラ関連の渡航制限を解除
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスという重大な感染症に関連した報道であり、国際的な渡航制限や監視体制に関わる内容。ただし記事の主眼は制限の解除であり、新規の感染例報告ではなく、情報が限定的であるため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーからケニアとルワンダでのエボラ確認例は報告されていない。DRCが「エボラ監視リスト」に残存している唯一の対象国として該当。現在の内容は渡航制限の行政的決定報告であり、アウトブレイク確認ではない。ただしエボラウイルスという重大病原体に関連し、国際的な対応・監視が進行中であるため、継続的な情報収集が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Congo-Kinshasa: Ebola en Ituri - Les autorités sanitaires mettent en garde contre l'automédication
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo: Ebola in Ituri – Health authorities warn against self-medication.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in Bunia, Ituri Province, DR Congo triggers warnings against self-medication and urges immediate hospital care for suspected cases. Latest suspected cases trace to Friday in Lumumba neighborhood near the Kappa roundabout; a father and his son on a motorcycle collapsed after bleeding from the nose and mouth and died before response teams could intervene. Authorities say self-medication is not isolated; similar incidents have occurred in Horo and Ndibe. Dr. John Kabutabuka, Medical Director of Bunia General Hospital, emphasizes rapid hospital attendance to reduce fatalities and curb transmission. To bolster surveillance, health services have launched the green helpline 151 for reporting suspected cases or anyone with compatible symptoms, reinforcing vigilance in the highly contagious Ituri outbreak as of 15 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国: イトゥリ州のエボラ - 保健当局が自己投薬に警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病は最高危険度感染症であり、フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は国際保健上最高危険度の病原体。DRC イトゥリ州ブニアでの確認感染症であり、複数地区での発生報告、死亡事例あり。保健当局による警告レベルの高さと公開ホットライン設置から、管理可能性に課題あり。国際支援必須と判断。

article.articleHeadline: PS Muthoni: We remain at high risk of Ebola
article.articleSummary: as of 2026-06-15, Kenya remains at high risk and on heightened alert for Ebola spilling into the country from neighbouring Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC), where outbreaks are active. Kenya has not recorded any Ebola infections, but surveillance is intensified with rapid response teams deployed and authorities monitoring airports, border posts and other entry points to detect potential cases. DRC has reported 635 Ebola cases; Uganda 18 cases, underscoring the cross-border threat. Health officials urge vigilance among healthcare workers to report suspected cases for testing and isolation, and for the public to seek care if symptoms appear after travel or contact with suspected cases. Ebola's fatality rate averages about 50%; transmission occurs through direct contact with blood, bodily fluids, or contaminated materials. Ebola was first identified in 1976 near the Ebola River, in what is now the DRC.

triage.headline_ja: PS Muthoni: We remain at high risk of Ebola（我々はエボラのリスク高い状態を保っている）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。複数国での活動的なエボラ流行があり、隣接国ケニアで高リスク警戒中。
triage.notes: 記事はケニア（対象国リスト外）の警戒を中心としているが、DRCが対象国であり、635例のエボラ発症が確認されている活動的流行を報告。ウガンダも隣接国で18例が報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リスト外のため verified_locations には含めない。DRCでの流行は確認されており、国際的脅威として高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: Dengue, stop al nuovo vaccino in Brasile: indagini su due morti e reazioni gravi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue: Brazil halts the new vaccine amid investigations into two deaths and serious reactions.
article.articleSummary: Brazil has temporarily halted, as a precaution, the world’s first single-dose dengue vaccine, Butantan-DV, after two healthcare workers died and 42 adverse events were reported. Health authorities are investigating possible links; 21-day post-vaccination monitoring is advised. Reported cases included severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, and hemorrhages; three events were serious, two fatal. The vaccination campaign, started January 2026, targeted health workers and people aged 15–49 in Botucatu, Maranguape, Nova Lima and Araguaína, Tocantins. Over 500,000 doses had been given by May 30, 2026; adverse events accounted for 0.008%. No causal relation is established yet; pharmacovigilance continues. Vaccine efficacy is 65% overall and 80.5% against severe dengue. Dengue control measures persist, with a 94% drop in cases through May 2026 (365,000 probable vs 5.8 million in 2024) and 178 deaths in 2026 vs over 6,300 in 2024.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルでデング熱の新ワクチンが一時停止：2人の死亡と重篤な副反応の調査
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルで承認されたデング熱ワクチン（Butantan-DV）の安全性シグナルとして、2人の死亡と42件の有害事象報告がある。ワクチン関連の重篤事象であり、公衆衛生上の深刻な影響と国際的な関心が高い。
triage.notes: デング熱ワクチンの安全性シグナルであり、ワクチンキャンペーンの一時停止という重大な公衆衛生措置が講じられている。死亡と重篤な有害事象の因果関係は確立されていないが、薬物有害性監視が継続中。ブラジルの全国的なデング熱制御では著しい成功が報告されており、本ワクチン有害事象は予想外の展開である。

article.articleHeadline: La RDC rapporte une hausse significative des cas d'Ebola, un mois depuis l'épidémie | L'actualité
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DR Congo reports a significant increase in Ebola cases, one month since the outbreak | L'actualité
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports a surge in Ebola cases one month into the outbreak, with 72 new cases in 24 hours (total 782) and 181 deaths (29 new). The 15 May-confirmed outbreak is caused by the rare Bundibugyo Ebola virus, unlike the Zaïre strain that has caused most past Congolese outbreaks and for which a vaccine exists. The epicenter is Ituri province in eastern DRC, accounting for over 90% of cases, with additional cases in Nord-Kivu and Sud-Kivu and spillover across the Uganda border. Contact tracing coverage has fallen to 56%, complicating containment amid widespread displacement—nearly a million people displaced in Ituri and many miners moving between remote sites. About 40 recoveries are reported; the case fatality rate is 23%. The WHO is intensifying testing, contact tracing, and treatment, with large shipments of equipment arriving to boost response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ出血熱の有意な増加を報告、流行発生から1ヶ月
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当。Bundibugyo株による稀な流行で国際的波及リスク（ウガンダへの越境事例あり）があり、ワクチン非対応株による制御困難性が懸念される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリー上、Ituri、Nord-Kivu、Sud-Kivu各州での発生と、ウガンダへの越境事例が明記されているが、Ugandaはスピルオーバー（確認症例）の記述に留まり流行の主舞台ではないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。Bundibugyo株はZaïre株よりも稀で、既存ワクチンが効果不十分であることが対応困難性を高める。接触追跡カバー率の低下（56%）と大規模な人口移動が制御を著しく困難にしている。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reporta gran aumento diario de casos de ébola a un mes de declararse el brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a sharp daily increase in Ebola cases one month after the outbreak was declared.
article.articleSummary: DRC reports 72 new Ebola cases in 24 hours, lifting confirmed cases to 782 and deaths to 181 (29 new fatalities) as of June 15, 2026. The eastern Ituri province accounts for more than 90% of cases; smaller numbers detected in North Kivu and South Kivu, with transmissions crossing the border into Uganda. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rarer strain not prioritized in early testing; Zaire ebolavirus, more common in DRC’s history and vaccine-enabled, accounts for most past outbreaks. MSF warns treatment centers are overwhelmed, with late presentations and many untraced contacts. Contact tracing coverage is about 56%, hindered by community resistance and rapid geographic spread. About 1 million people displaced in Ituri, complicating surveillance. WHO is expanding testing, tracing, and treatment; Africa CDC is supporting labs and community engagement, urging rapid resources.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国、エボラ出血熱の発生宣言から1か月で1日あたりの症例数が大幅増加と報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生上の重大な脅威であり、国境を越えてウガンダへの感染拡大が報告されており、国際的対応が必要である。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへの感染拡大が言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。エボラ出血熱の希少株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）による大規模発生であり、治療施設の過密化、接触者追跡の不十分性（56%）、100万人の避難民など複合的リスク要因が存在する。

article.articleHeadline: Over 350 join PALTIMAR3 dengue drive in Jamshedpur
article.articleSummary: On World Dengue Day, June 15, 2026, over 350 stakeholders gathered in Jamshedpur for a Dengue Prevention & Control Workshop under #PALTIMAR3 at Kudy Mohanty Auditorium, Kadma. Tata Steel UISL organized it with Health Department, engaging school principals, teachers, residential societies, officials, health workers, and conservancy supervisors. Attendees included Krishan Kumar (Deputy Municipal Commissioner), Atul Kumar Bhatnagar (MD, Tata Steel UISL), R.K. Singh (GM Town O&M), and Raghunath Pandey (Tata Steel UISL Union). Speakers urged community participation to curb dengue—eliminating breeding sites, spreading awareness, and involving children as ambassadors; penalties may apply if breeding is detected. Dr Asad (IDSP) reviewed dengue trends over three years, discussed transmission, symptoms, vector surveillance, and source reduction, and encouraged a Weekly Dry Day and daily 10 minutes of prevention, plus twice-weekly checks of water-holding containers. A live exhibit of dengue larvae and Aedes mosquitoes reinforced learning, ending in a pledge to intensify dengue awareness.

triage.headline_ja: ジャムシェドプルでPALTIMAR3デング熱対策キャンペーンに350人以上が参加
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱の予防・啓発イベント（ワークショップ）の開催を報告したもので、新たな感染症の流行や異常な発生を報告するものではない。シグナルトリアージの対象となる疾病イベントではなく、公衆衛生教育活動である。
triage.notes: 本記事はデング熱の啓発キャンペーン・ワークショップ開催報告であり、新規感染症流行、異常発生、重症例クラスター、あるいは予想外の疫学パターンを報告したものではない。よってシグナルとして識別不可。

article.articleHeadline: RS emite terceiro alerta sanitário para raiva herbívora; veja municípios afetados
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rio Grande do Sul issues third public health alert for rabies in herbivores; see affected municipalities.
article.articleSummary: Rio Grande do Sul issued its third public health alert for herbivorous rabies in 2026, targeting São Francisco de Paula (Serra) and Caraá (Litoral Norte) last week. Authorities warn of potential spread to Canela and Três Coroas, and to Rolante, Riozinho and Maquiné. Wilson Hoffmeister, coordinator of the Rabies Control Program for herbivores, says foci have persisted since last year. Rabies affects cattle, buffalo, horses, sheep and pigs; there is no cure after clinical signs. Symptoms include staggering, loss of coordination, progressive paralysis, behavioral changes, difficulty swallowing, and death; incubation can reach up to 60 days. Prevention centers on herd vaccination (two doses in primovaccination, revaccination per veterinary guidance) and immediate reporting to the Inspectorate upon suspicion. Monitoring also targets hematophagous bat refuges. The disease is a public health issue; earlier alerts were Tiradentes do Sul/São Nicolau and Piratini.

triage.headline_ja: リオグランデ・ド・スル州が3度目の家畜狂犬病公衆衛生警報を発令、影響を受けた市町村を確認
triage.triage_reason: 家畜狂犬病の反復的な警報であり、人間への直接的な重症例報告がなく、地域的な防疫措置が進行中である。情報の完全性に欠けるため、継続的な経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 家畜狂犬病であり、人間への発症報告がない。しかし狂犬病は理論的に人獣共通感染症であり、長期的な暴露リスク（家畜での流行継続、ワクチン対応）と流行可能性が確認される。3度目の警報という繰り返しの発令が政府の関心を示唆。ただし現時点で人間の死亡例や重症感染症例の報告なし。対象国検証：Rio Grande do Sulはブラジル内の州であり、記事主題はBrazilで発生。

article.articleHeadline: DRC reports record number of single-day Ebola cases outbreak hits 1-month mark
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak reaches 782 total cases, with 72 new confirmed on June 13, and 29 deaths reported that day. A month into the outbreak, 181 fatalities have occurred in the last month. Most cases remain concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with two new health zones—Nia-Nia (Ituri) and Mabalako (North Kivu)—reporting first cases, bringing affected zones to 31. Ongoing contact tracing remains insufficient (56.5% of identified contacts followed up), well below the 90–95% target for containment. Health officials cite community hesitancy and shortages of medicines and infection-control supplies. Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases (linked to cross-border transmission from DRC) and two deaths. UNICEF warns increasing pediatric involvement as surveillance remains challenged. The United States plans $50 million to CEPI to develop vaccines and treatments for the Bundibugyo Ebola strain, joining more than $270 million in Ebola response; Ituri has seen screening of 6,300 people, support to 100 facilities, and 200 safe burials.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国が1日の単一エボラ症例の記録的数を報告、アウトブレイクは1ヶ月目に突入
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。782症例、181死亡、複数省への拡大、国境越え伝播、および国際的支援（$50M+）が進行中である。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）におけるエボラアウトブレイクを主要な焦点としており、ウガンダへの国境越え伝播（19症例、2死亡）も報告されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には DRC のみを記載。接触者追跡カバレッジの不足（56.5% vs. 90-95%目標）、医療資源不足、小児を含む疾患進展は管理可能性の懸念を示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Dr. Leandro Baptista alerta para aumento dos casos graves de gripe; veja como agir
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dr. Leandro Baptista warns of an increase in severe influenza cases; see how to act.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, Brazil reports rising hospitalizations from respiratory infections driven by respiratory syncytial virus (RSV) and influenza A and B, per Fiocruz InfoGripe for Week 22 (May 31–June 6). Colder weather and indoor crowding facilitated transmission. Eleven states—Espírito Santo, Rio de Janeiro, Minas Gerais, Bahia, Goiás, Ceará, Distrito Federal, Amazonas, Maranhão, Mato Grosso, Mato Grosso do Sul, and Paraíba—show SARI (Severe Acute Respiratory Infection) at alert, at-risk, or high-risk levels, with upward trends in some areas. Through 2026, 3,591 SARI deaths have been recorded. Preventive measures remain essential: hand hygiene, masking in health facilities, avoiding closed spaces, staying home when symptomatic, and using PFF2/N95 respirators when isolation isn’t feasible. Vaccination remains the most effective protection, especially for priority groups; RSV drives hospitalizations in children up to 4, while influenza A causes severe disease in younger, adult, and older populations, with influenza B rising in ages 5–49.

triage.headline_ja: Dr. レアンドロ・バプティスタが重症インフルエンザ患者の増加に警告。対応方法を確認してください
triage.triage_reason: ブラジル全土で複数の呼吸器感染症（RSV、インフルエンザA/B）による入院患者が急増し、11州でSARI警告レベルに達している。2026年年初から3,591人の死亡が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、異常な上昇傾向）と WPRO基準（重症度、流行しやすさ、長期曝露、管理可能性）に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーで複数州での SARI 警告レベル、3,591人の死亡報告、季節的な呼吸器感染症の増加が確認されている。Fiocruz InfoGripe（ブラジルの公式監視システム）のデータに基づいている。国際的な拡大リスクは現在のところ報告されていない。

article.articleHeadline: La Russie vient en aide à l'Ouganda pour endiguer la menace de l'épidémie d'Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Russia Comes to Uganda's Aid to Curb the Threat of the Ebola Outbreak.
article.articleSummary: Russia provides a mobile Ebola-diagnostic laboratory to Uganda to curb the outbreak at the Uganda–DRC border, with Russian medical specialists aiding Ugandan staff to bolster surveillance, treatment capacity, and response. The Bundibugyo strain raises cross-border transmission concerns from the DRC. Uganda reports 19 lab-confirmed Ebola cases linked to the outbreak, with 2 deaths and 4 recoveries (as of June 10, Africa CDC). Border measures—handwashing, temperature checks, masks, and public-awareness campaigns—are in place, with suspected cases identified and isolated. Rospotrebnadzor announced on June 11 the development of an antibody test kit for Bundibugyo; Russian PCR tests are deployed in Uganda and the DRC. In 2024, Russia provided the mobile lab, used in 2025 to help contain a prior Ebola surge. In the DRC, two more health zones—Nia-Nia (Ituri) and Mabalako (North Kivu)—were added on June 13, bringing totals to 782 cases and 181 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: ウガンダのエボラ流行の脅威を抑制するためにロシアが支援
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国境を越えた感染拡大リスク、死亡例の報告、複数国での発生確認により、IHR基準3項目以上該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも異常・重症度・流行しやすさ・管理可能性が該当し、国際支援実施中で社会的・政治的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーの主題はウガンダへのロシア支援に関するものであるが、実際のエボラ発生地はDRC(北キブ州・イトゥリ州)とウガンダの国境地帯。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。DRC内で782例、181死亡と報告されており、Bundibugyo株による国境を越えた伝播リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: Infectologista explica como ocorre a transmissão do ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infectious disease specialist explains how Ebola is transmitted.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, Ebola has drawn renewed attention after African outbreaks. Transmission occurs mainly by direct contact with blood, secretions, and other bodily fluids of infected humans or animals, not via respiratory spread. In Brazil, Hospital Universitário João de Barros Barreto (HUJBB) in Pará is a leading infectious diseases center; Infectologist Rita Medeiros notes the virus requires close contact with contaminated materials, limiting spread where transmission is not active. Symptoms appear 2–21 days after exposure and include high fever, extreme fatigue, muscle and head pains, sore throat; severe cases may involve vomiting, diarrhea, bleeding, and organ failure. Diagnosis relies on lab tests and epidemiological investigation, since early symptoms resemble dengue and malaria. Prevention emphasizes isolation, hand hygiene, PPE for health workers, and avoiding wildlife contact. The Ministry of Health ruled out two suspected Brazilian cases from Africa (Rio de Janeiro, São Paulo). WHO cites around 50% fatality; no travel bans; vaccines exist for some Ebola species, but no approved therapy for Bundibugyo.

triage.headline_ja: 感染症専門医がエボラの伝播方法について説明
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでの疑い患者2例は除外されており、アフリカでのアウトブレイク情報は教育的・解説的記事。対象国ブラジルに確定患者なく、情報不足のため経過観察。
triage.notes: 記事の主要内容はアフリカでのエボラアウトブレイクに関する教育的解説。ブラジルでは2例の疑い患者が報告されているが、厚生労働省により除外済み。実際のブラジル国内の確定患者は報告されていない。社会的関心は高いが、ブラジル国内での実際の発病は記事に記載されていないため、シグナルとしてはWATCHに留める。

article.articleHeadline: Congo informa que número de casos confirmados de Ebola sobe para 808
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo reports that the number of confirmed Ebola cases has risen to 808.
article.articleSummary: As of June 15, 2026, Ebola cases confirmed in the Democratic Republic of the Congo have risen to 808, with 192 deaths, according to government data released on Monday. The tally reflects cases confirmed through Sunday, based on a situation report that recorded 26 new cases and 11 new deaths in the previous 24 hours. The briefing provides the latest publicly disclosed totals for the outbreak in the DRC, with no further details in this excerpt on affected provinces, laboratory confirmation timing, or response measures. These are the most recent publicly released figures for the Ebola outbreak in the DRC as of mid-June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラの確認症例数が808に上昇したと報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準でも全5基準該当。エボラ出血熱の進行中の大規模アウトブレイク。
triage.notes: コンゴ民主共和国でのエボラ出血熱の現在進行形アウトブレイク。確認症例808例、死亡192例という重大な状況。世界的な保健上の脅威として国際的な関心と支援が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от лихорадки Эбола в ДР Конго возросло до 192
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola fever in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has risen to 192.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 808 confirmed cases and 192 deaths, a case fatality rate of 23.8%. The figures come from the DRC Ministry of Health, published on X, and indicate ongoing transmission within the DRC and cross-border concerns with Uganda. The World Health Organization has declared the Ebola outbreak in the DRC and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting a high regional risk of further spread. The report centers on laboratory-confirmed cases and fatalities and underscores international attention and the need for coordinated public health responses to prevent wider transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ熱による死者数が192人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、国際的懸念）し、WPRO基準でも5つ全て該当。WHOがPHEIC宣言済みであり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準において最優先感染症の一つ。WHOがPHEIC（Public Health Emergency of International Concern）を公式宣言済み。記事ではウガンダとの越境リスクについても言及されているが、記事サマリー主題はDRC内での発生状況であるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Tabipler Birliği'nden Ebola salgınına karşı ulusal eylem planı çağrısı - BRTK
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Turkish Medical Association calls for a national action plan against the Ebola outbreak - BRTK.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-15, the Turkish Medical Association of Northern Cyprus (KTTB) urged the Health Ministry to prepare a national action plan against Ebola, publish procedures to relevant agencies, and inform health workers. With Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda and WHO's May declaration of an International Public Health Emergency, authorities highlight Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a highly lethal virus transmitted via direct contact with infected blood and body fluids; there is no approved specific vaccine or treatment for this strain. The KTTB criticized the Infectious Diseases High Council for lacking concrete preparedness measures, calling for clear case definitions, entry-point screening, notification, isolation, and management pathways, and for training and PPE provisions. Proposals include multilingual public information and a ministry helpline; interagency coordination with universities, immigration, and airlines; border risk assessments; 21-day fever surveillance for returning students from risk regions; strengthened airport surveillance; predefined isolation rooms and trained response teams.

triage.headline_ja: トルコ医師会がエボラ流行に対する国家行動計画を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準4つ該当（異常性、重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性）。複数の対象国で確認される高リスク病原体。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国とウガンダでのエボラ流行、およびWHOの国際保健緊急事態宣言を明記。サマリーには対象国リストのミャンマーへの言及がないため、verified_locationsはDRC のみとすべきです。ただし、ウガンダも対象国リストに含まれていないため、確認可能な対象国はDRCのみ。タイ、インドネシア、ベトナム等への言及もサマリーに見当たらない。北キプロスのトルコ医師会による警告は準備状況に関するもので、北キプロスは対象国でないため除外。WHO緊急事態宣言とBundibugyo ebolavirus（高致死率、体液接触感染、ワクチン/特異的治療なし）の記載により、重症度および管理可能性が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Brote de ébola en Congo suma fuerte aumento de contagios...
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo records a strong increase in infections.
article.articleSummary: 72 new Ebola virus infections in 24 hours in Democratic Republic of the Congo, total 782 cases and 181 deaths (29 new). The outbreak is driven by the Bundibugyo strain, a rare variant with no approved vaccine. Ituri province contains over 90% of cases, with spillovers into North Kivu, South Kivu, and border areas with Uganda. Health authorities note increased surveillance and case reporting, but experts warn the true scale may be higher since the outbreak was confirmed on May 15. Contact tracing coverage has fallen to 56%, hampered by population displacement, community resistance, and difficult terrain; nearly one million people displaced in Ituri. 40 recoveries; fatality rate 23%. WHO is shipping medical supplies and strengthening detection, care, and epidemiological surveillance; Africa CDC provides technical support, lab strengthening, and community engagement.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴにおけるエボラ出血熱の流行が感染者数と死亡者数の急増を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。Bundibugyo株による稀な亜型、高死亡率（23%）、ウガンダへの越境リスク、および国際的な支援（WHO、Africa CDC）が既に展開されている。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株はエボラウイルス種の中で承認されたワクチンがない稀な亜型。接触者追跡の低下（56%）、約100万人の国内避難民、地形の困難さなどにより管理が困難。ウガンダとの国境での感染者報告もあり、越境拡大リスクが高い。

article.articleHeadline: True scale of Congo Ebola outbreak still unknown one month in, responders say
article.articleSummary: DRC’s Ebola outbreak in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu remains poorly quantified about a month after onset. MSF and aid groups say the true toll is understated due to testing weaknesses, delays in lab results, and incompatible data from labs, hospitals, and epidemiological teams. A senior Congolese official says the virus may have circulated since February, with deaths and cases undercounted as many occur in communities not reached by authorities. In Nizi, local physicians report 19 positive cases and 17 deaths, while national figures show 11 cases and 1 death for the same area. Only 14 treatment facilities exist across nine zones, yet the outbreak has spread to 31 of at least 90 zones. Absconding patients and attacks on burial teams persist; safe burial practices may involve family members to build trust. WHO notes insufficient hospital capacity; MSF cautions the containment window is narrowing compared with the 2014-16 West Africa outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ共和国のエボラ熱アウトブレイク、発症から1ヶ月経過も実規模は不明と対応者が指摘
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を持つ第一類感染症であり、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生への影響、国際的拡大リスク）と全WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、重症度、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさ、管理可能性の困難さ）を満たす。DRC国内の複数州への拡大、死亡例の増加、検査・対応システムの弱さが確認されており、フルのRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、アウトブレイクはDRC国内（Ituri州、North Kivu州、South Kivu州）で発生していることが明確。Angolaは発生地域に含まれているが、サマリー上での言及がなく、対象国リストにも含まれていないため除外。エボラ出血熱の特性（高致死率、ヒト-ヒト感染、国境を超えるリスク）と現地報告（検査能力不足、死亡数の過少計上、複数州への拡大、医療施設不足）を踏まえ、緊急のフルRRA実施が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Direct Relief Expands Congo Ebola Response As Routine Care Becomes Strained
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo are pressuring fragile health systems, limiting access for patients with chronic conditions such as diabetes and hypertension. Humanitarian aid groups aim to prevent disruption of routine care. Direct Relief expands support to frontline clinics with essential medicines and protective equipment to help maintain basic services. The ongoing response forces some facilities to divert staff and resources from routine care. Relief organizations are working to stabilize supply chains and assist clinics managing both Ebola patients and ongoing needs from long-term conditions. Efforts focus on stabilizing supply chains and preserving routine care while the Ebola response continues.

triage.headline_ja: 直接支援がコンゴのエボラ対応を拡大、日常医療が逼迫
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数該当し、進行中のアウトブレイクとしてシグナル特性を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年6月15日時点でコンゴ民主共和国でのエボラアウトブレイクが進行中であることを示している。複数の人道支援団体が対応を拡大しており、国内の保健システムへの深刻な負荷が報告されている。進行中のイベントとしてフルRRAへの進展が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Novo guia reforça vigilância da febre amarela com identificação de primatas sentinelas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Guide Reinforces Yellow Fever Surveillance with Identification of Sentinel Primates.
article.articleSummary: Yellow fever surveillance in São Paulo State is strengthened by a new carcass identification guide for field workers. Yellow fever, endemic in the Amazon, spreads to Southeast Brazil in epizootic waves about every five years, via mosquitoes that infect neotropical primates (sentinels). The Guia de Identificação de Carcaças para Vigilância da Febre Amarela no Estado de São Paulo, by USP’s FMVZ (led by Professor Adriano Pinter, with Ana Luiza Peraro Mattos), is a practical tool to improve epidemiological surveillance and early viral detection in São Paulo. It details skeletal anatomy for local primates (Alouatta, Sapajus, Callithrix), offers differential diagnosis against other mammals, provides distribution maps, and explains Cronotanatognose (decomposition stages and estimated time since death) to guide sample collection. The guide is freely downloadable via USP Open Books, with supplementary YouTube explanations. Outbreaks occurred in 2024–2025; rapid primate identification enables swift human vaccination responses.

triage.headline_ja: 新しいガイドが黄熱病の監視を強化 - 番人役プリマーテの識別を通じて
triage.triage_reason: 黄熱病は公衆衛生上の懸念疾患だが、本記事は監視体制の強化（ガイド発行）についての報告であり、新規発症の急増や緊急事態の報告ではない。ただし背景として2024-2025年の集団発生があり、ブラジル（対象国）での継続的な流行状況を監視する価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事の主要テーマはサンパウロ州での黄熱病監視体制の強化（新ガイド発行）であり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではない。ただしサマリーで2024-2025年のアウトブレイク言及があり、Amazon由来で5年周期での Southeast Brazil への流行拡大が示唆されている。黄熱病は WHO 指定疾患だが、本記事は予防的対応（ガイド整備）であるため WATCH 判定。継続的な発症数や重症化の報告あれば PICKUP へ昇格すべき。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reporta gran aumento diario de casos de ébola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo reports a large daily increase in Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: As of June 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a surge in Ebola cases in a remote region, with 72 new cases in 24 hours, bringing confirmed cases to 782 and deaths to 181 (including 29 newly reported deaths). The outbreak was confirmed May 15, about a month after initial suspicion, and authorities warn the true scale may be larger due to ongoing transmission in a population that is highly mobile. Healthcare centers are overwhelmed; many patients arrive at advanced stages, and most have not been identified as contacts before seeking care. MSF Emergency Medical Coordinator Kate White notes the outbreak is outpacing response efforts. While community reporting and active investigation are improving surveillance, the rapid spread underscores challenges in exposure tracing and containment in this remote area.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、エボラ患者数の大幅な日次増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は極めて高い死亡率を持つ指定感染症であり、急速な症例増加（72例/24時間）、高い死亡率（181死亡）、医療施設の機能不全、接触追跡の困難性、および広域人口移動による国際拡大リスクが存在する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は致死率50-90%の極めて危険な病原体。記事サマリーは2026年6月15日時点で782確定患者、181死亡（新規29死亡）、24時間で72新規患者という急速な増加を報告している。遠隔地での大規模人口移動、医療施設のキャパシティ超過、接触追跡の困難性が述べられており、国際的拡大リスクが高い。MSFが緊急対応に当たっていることから国際支援の必要性も確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola : l'OMS exclut toute éradication définitive et appelle à une vigilance permanente en RDC
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: WHO rules out any definitive eradication and calls for permanent vigilance in the DRC.
article.articleSummary: WHO Representative in the Democratic Republic of Congo, Anne Ancia, warns Ebola will remain a durable threat in Africa even after the current outbreak is contained. As of June 14, 2025, Congolese health authorities reported 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths. Ebola is a zoonosis rooted in forest ecosystems, with bats as natural reservoirs; expanding human activity in forested areas increases spillover risk. Response constraints include local distrust of the disease, armed conflict in the east limiting access and logistics, and reduced international funding. WHO aims beyond outbreak control to strengthen national health systems and epidemiological surveillance to anticipate future flare-ups. The rVSV-ZEBOV vaccine (Ervebo), approved since 2019 and used in prior RDC outbreaks, is among tools deployed. Ancia emphasizes permanent vigilance and improved surveillance to detect and respond to new transmission promptly.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：WHOは完全根絶を除外し、コンゴ民主共和国での継続的な警戒を呼びかける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当し、エボラウイルス病という高リスク病原体の継続的な脅威に関する公式声明であり、シグナルとして確実にピックアップすべき。
triage.notes: 現在の発生は782確認症例・181死亡。エボラは動物由来感染症（自然宿主はコウモリ）であり、森林エリアの人間活動拡大がヒト感染リスク増加。対応上の制約：地域住民の不信感、東部の武力紛争による対応困難、国際的資金削減。WHO は流行制御だけでなく国家保健システム強化と疫学的監視体制の強化を重視。rVSV-ZEBOV ワクチン（Ervebo）2019年承認以来活用。継続的な警戒と監視体制の強化が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo reports record one-day increase in Ebola cases
article.articleSummary: 72 new Ebola cases in 24 hours in the Democratic Republic of Congo, bringing total confirmed infections to 782 with 181 deaths and 56 recovered (case fatality rate 23%). The outbreak began last month and is concentrated in Ituri province, which accounts for more than 90% of cases. Cases have also been detected in North and South Kivu and across the border in Uganda. The Bundibugyo virus has no approved vaccine or treatment, unlike the Zaire Ebola strain responsible for most previous DRC outbreaks. Nearly one million people are displaced in Ituri due to armed conflict, complicating contact tracing in forests, poor roads, and remote villages. Africa CDC head Jean Kaseya urged partners and donors to mobilize resources to strengthen the response and halt transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ患者数の1日当たりの記録的増加を報告
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス疾患の急速な拡大（24時間で72例）、複数州での確認、国境越しウガンダへの拡大、高い致死率、ワクチン・治療法がないBundibugyo株、紛争による移動難民の存在により、IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、国際的脅威が顕在化している。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（226074）は発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダで確認された」と述べられており、発生の主要地はDRC（Ituri省）である。したがってDRCのみを verified_locations に含める。Bundibugyo株の出現は特異的で、治療手段の欠如と移動難民層（約100万人）の存在が対応を困難にしている。アフリカCDC長による国際支援要請は政治的エスカレーションを示唆している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola se širi Kongom, rekordnih 72 nova slučaja u 24 sata
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola is spreading in Congo, a record 72 new cases in 24 hours.
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo faces a rapidly expanding Ebola outbreak, now with 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths. In the past 24 hours, 72 new cases were reported, a record daily rise. The outbreak, fueled by three provinces long affected by conflict—Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu—began appearing around May 15, with officials noting the virus had been spreading covertly for weeks. In a displaced persons camp at Kpangba, two Ebola-related deaths were recorded among about 30,000 refugees, and UNHCR warns there are surveillance blind spots that likely undercount true transmission. The Bundibugyo strain, for which no approved therapy or vaccine exists, remains poorly understood, and the WHO has not completed a full assessment of its scope. The U.S. CDC cautions the outbreak could reach the scale of West Africa’s 2014–2016 crisis, with more than 11,000 deaths.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラが拡大、24時間で過去最多72例の新規症例
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、スクリーニング基準も全5項目該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行であり、国際的支援が急務。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはDRCのIturi、South Kivu、North Kivu州における流行を主題としている。Bluedot APIがAngola、Sierra Leoneも発生地域として列挙しているが、サマリーではDRCが唯一の発生国として記述されており、これらは除外。対象国リストにAngola、Sierra Leoneは含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRC（203312）のみ。Bundibugyo株による流行、372人の死亡、24時間記録更新の72例増加、紛争地域での流行拡大、難民キャンプでの事例確認、WHO未評価、西アフリカ2014-2016年危機（11,000死）への懸念等により、極めて高いリスク評価。

article.articleHeadline: ViroClube realiza palestra sobre flavivírus e alfavírus
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: ViroClub Holds a Lecture on Flaviviruses and Alphaviruses
article.articleSummary: Online lecture by the Center for Virology Research at USP’s Ribeirão Preto Medical School as part of ViroClub. On Tuesday, June 16, 2026, from 14:00 to 15:00, the free session will be conducted via Google Meet to discuss initial events in infection by alphaviruses and flaviviruses. Guest speaker Jolanda Smit from University Medical Center Groningen, Netherlands, will cover virology topics including yellow fever, dengue, and Zika viruses, alongside alphaviruses and flaviviruses. The event, hosted by ViroClub, aims to advance understanding of early infection processes and related virology themes. Based in Ribeirão Preto, Brazil, the lecture is open to attendees via online access.

triage.headline_ja: ViroClubが<フラビウイルスとアルファウイルスについての講演会を開催
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は学術講演会の告知であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク・イベントの報告ではなく、疾病の発生や患者報告を含まない。情報発信・教育活動が主題である。
triage.notes: 記事内容は学術講演会の開催案内であり、Yellow Fever、Dengue、Zikaが言及されているが、実際の感染症事例や集団発生の報告ではない。したがって、対象国での実際の疾病発生を示すエビデンスがなく、verified_locationsは空配列とした。シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: Shigella outbreak: Fight goes on even after hospital discharge
article.articleSummary: Shigella infection can trigger reactive arthritis weeks after the initial illness. In Kochi, 28-year-old schoolteacher Meera Nair developed knee stiffness three weeks after recovering from shigellosis, rapidly progressing to swollen ankles and an inability to walk. This case illustrates reactive arthritis, an autoimmune complication that can emerge up to a month after an acute gastrointestinal infection. Clinicians warn that Shigella can also cause severe colitis and bloodstream infection; in children, high fever can precipitate seizures. Prolonged bowel symptoms and reactive arthritis may appear even after the acute illness has resolved. At Aster Medcity, Kochi, physicians emphasize vigilance for these delayed complications and the need for ongoing evaluation following discharge from hospital.

triage.headline_ja: 赤痢菌感染症：病院退院後も続く対抗戦
triage.triage_reason: 赤痢菌の後遺症（反応性関節炎）に関する症例報告であり、個別事例の臨床学的側面が中心。集団発生規模や国際的拡大リスク、公衆衛生上の広域影響を示す具体的データが不明である。
triage.notes: 記事はコーチン（ケーララ州）での赤痢菌感染症とその後遺症（反応性関節炎）の症例報告である。集団発生の規模、患者数、感染者数の推移など疫学的情報が記載されていないため、シグナル判定は保留。反応性関節炎は赤痢菌感染後の既知の合併症であり、異常性は低い。続報で集団発生規模や公衆衛生への影響が明らかになれば再評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Sthefany Brito expõe relação dos filhos com irmão recém-nascido e medidas para evitar doenças virais em casa
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Sthefany Brito reveals her children's relationship with their newborn brother and measures to prevent viral diseases at home.
article.articleSummary: On Monday, June 15, Brazilian actress Sthefany Brito reported that her older sons Enrico and Vincenzo have bonded with their newborn brother Felippo. She praised the boys' affection but voiced concern about the transmission of viral diseases that children can bring home from spaces outside the home, such as school. Brito discussed implementing measures at home to reduce viral spread as part of caring for a newborn, stressing the ongoing balance between close sibling interactions and infection prevention. The piece does not detail any specific pathogens, illnesses, case counts, or outbreaks. Overall, it centers on parental awareness and home-based precautions to limit viral exposure during the newborn period.

triage.headline_ja: ステファニー・ブリトが新生児の兄弟との子どもたちの関係を明かし、家庭でウイルス性疾患を防ぐための対策を提案
triage.triage_reason: 記事は有名人の育児エッセイであり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク、疾患集積、公衆衛生上の問題を報告していない。疾患名が『Unknown Illness』であり、特定の病原体や症例情報も記載されていない。
triage.notes: 本記事は感染症イベントではなく、有名人による育児関連のコラムである。医学的根拠のある疾患情報、流行データ、公衆衛生上の懸念事項が一切含まれていない。Bluedot APIによる誤分類と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: मध्यप्रदेश: स्वास्थ्य विभाग पहली बार एआई से जुटाएगा डेंगू-मलेरिया प्रभावित क्षेत्रों की जानकारी, मिलेगी एक महीने पहले सूचना | MP News, MP State News, MP, State News, Bhopal
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Madhya Pradesh: The Health Department, for the first time, will use AI to gather information on dengue- and malaria-affected areas; information will be available one month in advance | MP News, MP State News, MP, State News, Bhopal.
article.articleSummary: Madhya Pradesh health department will deploy for the first time an AI-based predictive system to forecast dengue, malaria, and other seasonal illnesses, with a one-month advance notice to authorities. The system, already tested in Delhi and Gujarat, uses last year’s dengue data, population, and area characteristics (including humidity and prior affectation) to identify potential hotspots and guide preemptive actions such as anti-larval measures, fogging, and public awareness. Hospitals in alerted areas will be prepped, with drug stocks and testing prioritized. District and selected civil hospitals offer free dengue and malaria testing; 64 labs can process samples. By 2026, over 3.9 million houses were larva-surveyed, with 20,238 harboring larvae and treated. Dengue cases declined from 14,147 in 2019 to 3,252 in 2024 and 2,083 in 2025; current status is normal, though monsoon may raise cases. The approach includes an annual system evaluation after one year.

triage.headline_ja: 中央プラデーシュ州：保健部門が初めてAIを使用してデング熱・マラリア影響地域の情報を収集、1ヶ月前に情報を取得
triage.triage_reason: デング熱とマラリアは既知の風土病であり、記事は予防的なAI予測システムの導入という公衆衛生上の管理改善を述べている。既存の流行を報告するものではなく、新興の重大な危機的状況は示唆されていない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドの風土病（デング熱・マラリア）に対する予防技術導入の報道であり、新規感染症イベント・アウトブレイク・危機的状況ではない。症例数は2019年から減少傾向にあり、現在の状態は「正常」と記載されている。シグナルトリアージの対象外と判断。

article.articleHeadline: رئيس مفوضية الاتحاد الأفريقي يبحث مع رئيس بوروندي تطورات تفشي إيبولا والسلم في القارة
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chairperson of the African Union Commission discusses with the President of Burundi the developments in the Ebola outbreak and peace on the continent.
article.articleSummary: June 15, 2026 – Mahmoud Ali Yusuf, Chairperson of the African Union Commission, met Burundi President Évariste Ndayishimiye at the presidential palace in Bujumbura to discuss developments in the Ebola outbreak across Africa, based on Africa CDC assessments and the response by affected member states. Yusuf noted ongoing efforts to contain the outbreak and the solidarity from AU partners supporting the health response, ahead of the African Union Ebola Summit scheduled for tomorrow under Burundi’s presidency. The talks highlighted strategic priorities, including ongoing institutional reform to strengthen the AU’s effectiveness, efficiency, and outbreak response capacity, with Kenyan President William Ruto cited for leadership on reform. Yusuf also briefed on AU peace and security/mediation work addressing Sudan, South Sudan, and eastern DRC, and supporting constitutional restoration in the Sahel. Ndayishimiye reaffirmed Burundi’s commitment to reforms and to health preparedness.

triage.headline_ja: アフリカ連合委員会議長がブルンジ大統領とエボラ出血熱流行の進展とアフリカ大陸の平和について協議
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の大陸規模での流行が報告されており、IHR基準で深刻な公衆衛生影響（Yes）と国際的拡大リスク（Yes）の2基準以上に該当。アフリカ連合による公式な流行対応会合の開催が予定されており、政府関心および国際支援の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは「アフリカ全体でのエボラ流行」について述べられており、複数国での拡大が示唆されている。しかし具体的な流行地域として明確に記述されているのはアフリカ大陸全体の対応であり、対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ブルンジ（Burundi）での開催地であるが、記事の主題は「流行の進展協議」であり実際の発生地域の詳細な確認が必要。東DRC（eastern DRC）への言及もあり、DRCでの流行が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: У Конгу један од највећих дневних скокова броја заражених од еболе
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, one of the largest daily increases in the number of Ebola infections.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (Kinshasa) with 782 total cases and 181 confirmed deaths, plus 29 new deaths and 72 new cases reported in the last 24 hours as of 15 June 2026. The epicenter is eastern Ituri province, where over 90% of cases have been documented; cases also appear in North and South Kivu and across the border in Uganda. Authorities warn the outbreak is expanding faster than response efforts, hindering case finding in a remote region with mobile populations. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus variant is driving this outbreak, differing from earlier epidemics caused by the Zaire variant, with initial days lacking testing. MSF reports overwhelmed treatment centers, late patient arrivals, and many infections not linked to known contacts, signaling possible wider transmission within Congo.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで、エボラ感染者数の最大級の日増加の一つを記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱の広域流行であり、対象国DRCで確認。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の大規模流行。782件の総症例、181件の確認死亡、24時間以内に29件の新規死亡と72件の新規症例。イトゥリ州が震源地で症例の90%以上が報告。ウガンダへの国境越え症例も存在。Bundibugyo型エボラウイルス。治療センターが過負荷状態で、多くの症例が既知接触者との関連性がなく、より広い感染伝播の可能性を示唆。フルRRA必須。

article.articleHeadline: Numărul cazurilor confirmate de Ebola în RD Congo a ajuns la 808
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the DRC has reached 808.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of Congo has 808 confirmed Ebola virus disease cases. The outbreak remains active, with cross-border transmission prompting regional vigilance. Uganda—lauded for its international response to the cross-border Ebola outbreak from DR Congo—has recorded 19 cases and two deaths. Uganda has denounced recently imposed air travel restrictions as unfair, highlighting tensions around border measures amid the epidemic.
