The report emphasizes the spillover risk from the DR Congo outbreak and ongoing public health measures, including travel controls, intended to curb import and export of cases. No vaccination or treatment details are provided in the excerpt.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定患者数は808人に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の確定患者808人、死亡例、国際的な越境感染、国境閉鎖を含む渡航制限等により、フルRRA実施の対象となるシグナル。
triage.notes: ウガンダは発生地域に含まれているが、記事サマリーではウガンダの患者数（19人）は越境感染事例として記載され、主たる流行地はDRC。対象国リストにはウガンダが含まれていないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。DRCは対象国に含まれており、確定患者808人、死亡例あり、複数国への越境感染、国際的な渡航制限の実施といった深刻な状況が確認されている。

article.articleHeadline: Why existing vaccines won't help this Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola-driven outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) challenges existing vaccines, as Ervebo (the Zaire-specific VSV-based vaccine) does not reliably prevent Bundibugyo transmission; cross-protection is limited and WHO deems evidence inconclusive. The Zaire vaccine showed 75% survival in 2011 monkey studies against Bundibugyo, but that protection is unlikely to be sufficient in an outbreak setting with distrust in health authorities. The 2014 West Africa Zaire outbreak killed more than 11,000 people and informed current vaccine development. To address Bundibugyo, CEPI funds multiple vaccine candidates, including two Ervebo-like prototypes targeting Bundibugyo’s distinct glycoproteins (about 35% difference from Zaire). IAVI and Public Health Vaccines are developing similar VSV-based vaccines, with WHO labeling VSV platforms as the most promising. Rapid, targeted vaccine development aims to stop the current DRC outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: 既存のワクチンがこのエボラアウトブレイクに役立たない理由
triage.triage_reason: ブンディブギョエボラの発生はIHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、既存ワクチンの有効性不足により国際的対応と新規ワクチン開発の急務が生じている。DRCでの流行は公衆衛生上の深刻な脅威である。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラウイルスはザイール型と異なり、既存のErveboワクチン（VSV-ZEBOV）の有効性が限定的。記事サマリーはDRCでの発生を主題としており、アンゴラは発生地域に含まれているが、サマリー内では明示されていないため除外。CEPIによる新規ワクチン開発の進行中が言及されており、国際的な公衆衛生対応が進んでいる状況を示している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola, altri 52 bambini hanno il virus e di questi 19 sono morti: "Ma la crisi non è solo sanitaria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola, another 52 children have contracted the virus and of these 19 have died: "But the crisis is not only health-related."
article.articleSummary: Democratic Republic of the Congo reports at least 52 children contracted Ebola in the month after the May 15, 2026 outbreak declaration, including 16 newborns, with 19 deaths. The outbreak is the third largest in DRC, tallying about 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, per the Health Ministry. Under-14s have higher fatality, with a 38.6% case-fatality in 0–14 years versus 18.1% in 15–44 years, though data are still under investigation. Rapid deterioration in young children is common, compounded by malnutrition, malaria, anemia, poverty, displacement, interrupted vaccination, and limited access to essential treatments. Basic supplies like PPE, disinfectants, safe isolation spaces, and medications are short in many areas, while fear and misinformation hinder care-seeking and contact tracing. Save the Children frames this as a broader social crisis affecting families and communities, with health workers acting heroically; the RDC has endured 17 outbreaks since 1976. Save the Children has operated in DRC since 1994, with 13 local partners.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ、さらに52人の子どもが感染し、そのうち19人が死亡：「しかし危機は保健のみではない」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、予想外の大規模感染、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当（異常性、高い重症度・死亡率、長期曝露リスク、流行しやすさ、管理能力不足）。フルRRA進行の必要性が高い。
triage.notes: DRC第3位の規模のエボラ発生（確定症例782例、死亡181例）。0～14歳の致死率38.6%と高く、特に16人の新生児を含む52人の小児感染が報告。基礎疾患（栄養不良、マラリア、貧血）や医療アクセスの問題が重症化を加速。PPE不足や医療機器の不足が管理を困難にしている。社会的危機として国際的な支援と関心を惹起している。

article.articleHeadline: Curso gratuito vai capacitar estudantes para diagnóstico de arboviroses em parceria entre Brasil e Nigéria
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Free course will train students to diagnose arboviral diseases in partnership between Brazil and Nigeria
article.articleSummary: A free online course on arboviral diagnostics is organized by researchers from the University of São Paulo (USP) in Ribeirão Preto, Brazil, in partnership with the University of Maiduguri, Nigeria. The program, promoted by ViroClube (Virology Lectures Club) at USP’s Center for Virology Research, offers 20 slots and runs remotely from July 20–24, 9:00–12:00 local time (three hours daily). Completion yields a certificate for 15 hours. Targeted at undergraduate and graduate students, the course covers biotechnology techniques for diagnostic tools for arboviruses such as dengue, Zika, and chikungunya, including recombinant protein production, purification, and their use in tests to identify viral infections. Applications due June 20 via esposito@usp.br, with selection based on CV and letter of interest. Coordinated by Danillo Espósito, in collaboration with the University of Maiduguri, aiming to strengthen diagnostic capacity in Brazil and African regions with limited health infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルとナイジェリアの連携によるアルボウイルス診断の学生研修プログラム（無料オンラインコース）
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は教育プログラムの告知であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイク報告ではない。デング熱、ジカウイルス、チキングニアウイルスは言及されているが、症例増加や疾病発生の報告はなく、IHR基準およびWPRO基準の該当はない。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジルとナイジェリア間の学術的な診断技術研修プログラムの案内であり、感染症の発生や流行を報告するものではない。発生地域にナイジェリアが含まれるが、記事の主題はニジェリアでの感染症イベントではなく、ブラジルの大学による教育提供であるため、ナイジェリアは verified_locations から除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Police, mourners clash over coffin of suspected Ebola victim in DRC
article.articleSummary: Clashes erupted in the Democratic Republic of the Congo during a funeral for a suspected Ebola victim on 15 June 2026. Police fired tear gas to prevent mourners from seizing the coffin as healthcare workers rushed to remove the body, underscoring concerns about possible transmission. The report centers on a suspected Ebola case with no laboratory confirmation or case counts provided. The incident highlights tensions around suspected Ebola deaths and the challenges of safe burial practices in the DRC. No details on the infection source, travel history, or whether other individuals were exposed were disclosed, and the article does not indicate an ongoing or verified outbreak beyond this funeral incident.

triage.headline_ja: 警察と遺族が衝突、DRC のエボラ疑い患者の棺をめぐる
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は重大な感染症であり IHR 基準で最大3項目が該当する可能性があるが、本報告は単一の疑い患者の葬儀での社会的事象であり、ラボ確認、症例数、または検証済み発症データの記載がない。続報で検査確認や集団発生の証拠が必要。
triage.notes: 本イベントは単一の疑い患者（ラボ確認なし）の葬儀での警察と遺族の衝突を中心としており、進行中の集団発生の証拠がない。エボラ病の自然宿主からの曝露は確認されていない。DRC での葬儀儀式とエボラ制御の社会的課題を浮き彫りにするが、流行の転機を示すのに十分な疫学的データが欠けている。WATCH 状態で続報監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: WHO commends Uganda's Ebola response, urges vigilance and regional cooperation
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola outbreaks confirmed in May in DRC and Uganda; no approved vaccine. Uganda reports 19 confirmed and 1 probable case; linked to DRC transmission. WHO praises Uganda's response amid humanitarian pressures, insecurity, and cross-border movement. Key measures include surveillance, testing, and rapid case management; Mulago Hospital's Ebola Treatment Unit was commissioned within six hours of declaration and is staffed by Uganda's 146-member Emergency Medical Team, deployed within two hours, with WHO/EU support. WHO official Dr. Chikwe Ihekweazu cites strong community cooperation and new laboratories as encouraging signs; WHO Director-General Tedros visited Uganda and commended preparedness and quality of care. Risk of further transmission remains; sustained Uganda-DRC cooperation and border-area community engagement are essential. WHO opposes travel bans. Uganda's ninth Ebola experience; lessons strengthen surveillance, lab networks, and emergency teams; UN system coordinating response.

triage.headline_ja: WHOがウガンダのエボラ対応を称賛、警戒と地域協力を促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。エボラウイルス病の確認、複数国での発生、死亡例、継続的な感染リスク、そして国際的な関心と対応の実施が認められ、シグナルとしてフルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはBundibugyo（ウガンダ域内）でのエボラ確認とDRCからの越境伝播を報告している。発生地域フィールドにはUgandaも含まれているが、Ugandaは対象国リスト外のため、verified_locationsに含めない。DRCは対象国（203312）として確認されている。エボラは極めて重篤な感染症であり、複数国での同時発生、死亡例、継続的な感染リスク、そして国際的な対応が実施されていることから、全てのWPRO基準を満たしている。

article.articleHeadline: Chimbote: en sesión del consejo provincial de salud del Santa exhortamos a priorizar acciones articuladas en la lucha contra la tuberculosis y el dengue
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chimbote: In a session of the Santa Provincial Health Council, we urge that coordinated actions be prioritized in the fight against tuberculosis and dengue.
article.articleSummary: Chimbote, Santa Province, in a session of the Provincial Health Council, urged coordinated, timely, and sustained actions against tuberculosis (TB) and dengue, noting they require different transmission-based approaches. The Defensoría del Pueblo called for involvement of the Environmental Management Directorate, municipal oversight, health networks, and schools through preventive campaigns, screening, and targeted communication. Health networks reported 2025 TB: 274 drug-susceptible and 19 drug-resistant cases in Pacífico Norte; 2026 YTD: 92 susceptible, 6 resistant. Pacífico Sur recorded 2025: 142 susceptible and 69 resistant; 2026 YTD: 22 susceptible, 8 resistant. Agreements include a TB working table tentatively for July 7 and ongoing joint efforts against dengue and TB prevention. Defensoría del Pueblo pledged ongoing oversight to safeguard health rights, especially for vulnerable populations.

triage.headline_ja: チンボーテ：サンタ州保健評議会の会議でUPIEMI感染症（結核とデング熱）対策の調整された行動の優先化を強調
triage.triage_reason: 疾患（結核・デング熱）は既知で、記事の主題はペルーでの公衆衛生会議における対策強化の呼びかけである。IHR基準では深刻な影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクのいずれも不明または低く、WPRO対象国にペルーが含まれていないため、本スクリーニング枠での優先ピックアップ対象外と判断される。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にはペルーとフィリピンが含まれているが、記事サマリーの主題はペルーのチンボーテ（サンタ州）での結核・デング熱対策に関する地域保健会議である。ペルーはWPRO対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsは空配列とした。フィリピンは座標情報（Santa, Ilocos）が含まれているが、記事本文・サマリー上でフィリピンのイベントについての記述はないため除外した。

article.articleHeadline: Numărul cazurilor confirmate de Ebola în RD Congo a ajuns la 808
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 808.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-15, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 808 confirmed cases and 192 deaths. The daily tally released Monday records 26 new confirmed cases and 11 additional deaths in the preceding 24 hours, according to Reuters and Agerpres. The update reflects the latest figures for the outbreak and indicates continued transmission within the country. No further detail is provided on affected provinces, transmission sources, or public health responses in this brief notice. The rising totals underscore the ongoing burden of Ebola in the DRC and the need for sustained surveillance and containment efforts to prevent further fatalities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認症例数が808に達した
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は最高レベルの公衆衛生脅威であり、継続的な人-人感染が記録されており、国際的なフルRRA評価が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱の継続的な発生。24時間で26新規確認症例、11追加死亡という継続的な伝播を示す。公開日2026-06-15（未来日付だが、記事内容に基づき評価を実施）。詳細な地域別情報や対応策は記事に記載されていない。

article.articleHeadline: El Congo eleva a 808 los casos de ébola confirmados, incluidas 192 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo raises the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 808, including 192 deaths.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of Congo reports 808 confirmed Ebola cases and 192 deaths from the outbreak first declared May 15 in Ituri, with three provinces affected: Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. Some 363 people are in isolation, with a case fatality rate of 23.8%. The outbreak has extended from Ituri into North and South Kivu; 31 of 104 health zones have been impacted. The epidemic has also reached Uganda, recording 19 cases (14 imported from the DRC) and two deaths. The circulating strain is Bundibugyo Ebola, associated with a 30–50% fatality rate, and there is no licensed vaccine or specific treatment. WHO classifies the regional risk as high in sub-Saharan Africa and low globally. The virus likely circulated in Ituri about two months before declaration; transmission occurs via direct contact with bodily fluids, causing fever, vomiting, diarrhea, and hemorrhagic symptoms. Authorities urge symptomatic individuals to seek urgent care.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ出血熱の確認症例を808例に引き上げ、192人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当（重篤な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。高い致死率、複数州での拡大、ウガンダへの越境拡大、ワクチンなしという極めて深刻なエボラ出血熱パンデミック初期段階。
triage.notes: 発生地域にUgandaが含まれているが、記事サマリーでは「ウガンダで19例が報告（14例はDRCからの輸入）」と述べられており、主要な流行地はDRCである。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとする。Bundibugyo Ebola株による感染で致死率23.8%、ワクチン・特異的治療なし。地域リスク：サブサハラ・アフリカで高、世界的には低い評価だが、初期段階での迅速な対応が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Circulação silenciosa da doença de Chagas é identificada em bairros de Salvador
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Silent Transmission of Chagas Disease Identified in Salvador Neighborhoods
article.articleSummary: Chagas disease (Trypanosoma cruzi) circulation detected in urban Salvador neighborhoods. Fiocruz Bahia study (Acta Tropica) tested 290 dogs across Alto do Cabrito, Marechal Rondon, and Pau da Lima. Among 177 dogs in Alto do Cabrito and Marechal Rondon, seroprevalence was 5.1% with nine positives; Pau da Lima had 113 dogs and all were negative. ELISA used recombinant chimeric antigens. Infected dogs were aged 5–15 years (median 8.5), with no clinical signs, suggesting silent transmission and strong local geographic heterogeneity. Findings support dogs as sentinel indicators of T. cruzi circulation in vulnerable urban settings with poor sanitation and vector-friendly environments; results are preliminary and do not confirm active human transmission. Earlier Bahia data from Feira de Santana reported 13/112 positives (11.6%) among 1,115 residents screened for cardiac involvement, with indoor triatomine exposure and mobility from endemic regions as notable factors.

triage.headline_ja: サルバドルの地区で高血圧感染症（シャーガス病）の静かな伝播が確認
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでシャーガス病の都市部での循環が確認された。犬の血清陽性率5.1%で人間への感染は確認されていないが、環境・衛生条件と関連する基礎データとして重要。情報不足（人への実際の感染拡大、公的な管理対応など）のためWATCH判定。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは犬での血清学的検出を報告しており、人間への実際の感染リスク・拡大の直接的証拠は記述されていない。Fiocruzの研究結果は予備的段階とされている。El Salvadorは発生地域に含まれているが、サマリー本文ではブラジル（サルバドル、フェイラ・デ・サンタナ）のみが主題であり、El Salvadorは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Число умерших от Эболы в ДР Конго увеличилось до 192
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The death toll from Ebola in the DR Congo has risen to 192.
article.articleSummary: June 15, 2026 — The Democratic Republic of Congo reports Ebola deaths rising to 192, with 808 laboratory-confirmed cases. There are 363 patients in hospitals or medical isolation, and the case fatality rate stands at 23.8%. The World Health Organization has declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern for Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda. The Financial Times described the current outbreak as a 'dress rehearsal' for a potential future global pandemic, citing declines in international health funding and eroding public trust in science. Ongoing African Ebola activity is noted, with emphasis on laboratory confirmation and international monitoring.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が192人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。WHOによるPHEIC宣言、高い死亡率（23.8%）、複数国への拡大（DRC＋ウガンダ）、国際的な関心の高さが確認される。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダ（Uganda）も言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみを対象国として列挙。WHOのPHEIC宣言によって国際的重要性が確認され、フルRRAへの進行が必須。

article.articleHeadline: Dimensão do surto de Ebola no Congo segue desconhecida | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The extent of the Ebola outbreak in the Congo remains unknown | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Democratic Republic of Congo, across Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu, is of uncertain magnitude: 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths reported, making it the third-deadliest Ebola outbreak on record. Official counts likely underestimate toll, MSF and Congolese authorities warn, as data from laboratories, hospitals and treatment centers and surveillance teams are hard to harmonize. Testing bottlenecks and security issues, plus testing duplicates, may distort figures; many deaths occur in communities never reached by health workers. In Nizi health zone, some reports showed 19 positive cases and 17 deaths since outbreak began, while dashboards listed 11 cases and 1 death in the same area. Health facilities are overwhelmed: 14 treatment centers across 9 zones, with the outbreak reaching at least 31 of 90 health zones. WHO notes security incidents threaten the response; MSF urges intensified diagnosis, surveillance, care access and safe burials, and unhindered movement of teams.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ出血熱の発生規模は引き続き不明 | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべて該当。確認された重篤な感染症の流行であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は最も高いリスク分類の感染症。782確認症例、181死亡（致死率23%）で史上3番目の規模。Ituri、South Kivu、North Kivu州での発生が報告されている。検査ボトルネック、セキュリティ上の懸念、データハーモナイゼーション困難により実際の規模は統計値を上回る可能性が高い。WHOおよびMSFが支援を強化している。

article.articleHeadline: Votorantim intensifica combate à dengue após identificação de larvas em bairros da cidade | TVS+
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Votorantim intensifies the fight against dengue after larvae were identified in the city's neighborhoods | TVS+
article.articleSummary: Votorantim, Brazil, intensifies dengue control as a June 2026 larval survey found Aedes aegypti in 45 of 600 inspected residences. Although winter approaches and conditions are less favorable for dengue, the city’s Zoonoses teams continue house visits to eliminate breeding sites, prioritizing community awareness. The neighborhoods with the highest larval counts include Dominguinho, Santo Antônio, Jardim Paulista, Vila Garcia, Jardim Araújo, Protestantes, Monte Alegre, Maria José, Paraíso, Morumbi, Bela Vista, Rio Acima, Vila Nova, and Jataí. While current larval density has not yet led to a rise in dengue cases, authorities remain concerned. In the prior year, Votorantim registered more than 550 dengue cases and adopted emergency measures; the 2026 prevention efforts seek to prevent outbreaks and reduce risk.

triage.headline_ja: ヴォトランティムがデング熱の幼虫確認後、対策を強化｜TVS+
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルのヴォトランティムでAedes aegyptiの幼虫が確認されたローカルレベルの予防活動であり、死亡や入院が報告されておらず、国際的拡大リスクも言及されていない。IHR基準・WPROスクリーニング基準に十分に該当しない。
triage.notes: WPROスクリーニング基準で「prolonged_exposure」と「epidemic_prone」に該当するが、重症度や管理可能性に懸念がなく、社会的関心も限定的。前年の550件超のデング症例から予防転換しており、現在の幼虫確認は予防段階の報告であり、フルRRA対象とはしない。

article.articleHeadline: DRC reports record number of single-day Ebola cases outbreak hits 1-month mark - World Byte News
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-15, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo recorded a record single-day increase, about one month after the outbreak was first detected. The article provides no exact case counts, subnational locations within the DRC, or details on laboratory confirmation. It confirms an ongoing outbreak with rising daily cases but offers no information on symptoms, transmission dynamics, patient outcomes, or public-health responses. No data are given on infection sources or imported/exported cases, and there is no mention of vaccination status. The piece emphasizes the rapid progression of the outbreak in the DRC and notes that health authorities are monitoring the surge in daily cases as the outbreak continues. Overall, the report lacks granular epidemiological details beyond the noted record increase.

triage.headline_ja: DRCが単日当たりのエボラウイルス病患者数の記録を報告、発生1ヶ月経過
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病は高い致死率と国際的な感染拡大リスク、公衆衛生への深刻な影響により、IHR基準を複数満たす。DRCでの記録的な単日増加は異常な進展を示し、WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当する。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは具体的な症例数、亜国地域の詳細、検査確認情報が不足しているが、DRCでのエボラ発生後1ヶ月での記録的な単日増加が確認されている。フルリスク評価では追加の疫学的詳細情報の収集が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Risco de ebola para a Copa do Mundo é 'extremamente baixo', dizem especialistas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Risk of Ebola at the World Cup is 'extremely low', experts say.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) remains a concern, with more than 675 cases and over 135 deaths, and the virus is not airborne, requiring direct contact with bodily fluids for transmission. As World Cup 2026 begins, the risk of an infected traveler reaching the United States is extremely low but not zero; US hospitals are prepared. The 2014 West Africa Ebola outbreak prompted about $260 million in U.S. investments for training and 13 treatment centers after a Liberian man, Thomas Eric Duncan, arrived in Dallas with Ebola-like symptoms and was initially refused admission; two nurses were infected but survived. Host cities across the US, Mexico, and Canada expect 6.5 million visitors over 39 days and 104 matches. CDC, PAHO, and WHO classify Ebola risk for host countries as low, while diseases such as measles, COVID-19, and influenza pose greater threats.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップ2026でのエボラのリスクは「極めて低い」と専門家が指摘
triage.triage_reason: 複数の対象国（DRC）に発生が確認されているものの、記事の主要論点はワールドカップ開催国（米国・メキシコ・カナダ）でのエボラ伝播リスクが「極めて低い」という専門家の評価であり、公開情報としては新規の感染拡大を示唆するシグナルとは言えない。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の判定では重篤な警告性が認められない。
triage.notes: 記事はワールドカップ2026に関連する大型スポーツイベント開催を背景に、エボラリスク評価についての専門家見解を報道している。DRCでの流行は既知であり、ホスト国での流行リスク低減が主題である。対象国中で実際のイベント発生地はDRCのみに限定される。

article.articleHeadline: Число жертв Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 190 человек - Minval Politika
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Death toll from Ebola in DR Congo exceeds 190.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has killed 192 people and registered 808 laboratory-confirmed Ebola virus disease cases, as of June 15, 2026. About 363 patients are currently in hospitals or medical isolation, and the case-fatality rate is 23.8%. The flare-up began on May 15, with the epicenter in Ituri Province; cases and deaths have also been reported in neighboring Uganda. One day earlier, the figures were 181 laboratory-confirmed cases and 782 deaths, according to a daily bulletin from the Congolese Ministry of Communications and Media. Authorities continue to monitor transmission and coordinate cross-border responses.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ死者数が190人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。高い死亡率と国際的な人間への深刻な公衆衛生影響、国境を越えた拡大、国際的な貿易・渡航制限のリスクがある。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの症例報告も記載されているが、対象国リストにウガンダは含まれないため verified_locations に追加していない。DRC内のイトゥリ州が震源地。2026年6月15日時点で192人の死亡、808例の確定例、23.8%の致命率。5月15日から流行開始。国境を越えた対応が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Bundibugyo : l'OMS renforce la riposte en RDC avec 16,5 tonnes de matériel médical d'urgence - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Bundibugyo Ebola: WHO steps up the response in the DRC with 16.5 tonnes of emergency medical equipment
article.articleSummary: The World Health Organization intensified its response to Bundibugyo Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo by delivering 16.5 tonnes of emergency medical supplies and equipment. The items, shipped from the WHO Global Logistics Hub in Dubai and routed via Uganda to the DRC, support infection prevention and control and clinical management in affected areas. This follows a prior shipment two weeks earlier of 4.6 tonnes of emergency supplies and more than 2,000 RadiOne diagnostic tests. Since the Bundibugyo Ebola flare began, the DRC has recorded 782 cases, including 72 new confirmed cases, and 181 deaths, a case fatality rate of 23.1%. The intervention aims to strengthen operational capacity of deployed teams and enhance interventions in households.

triage.headline_ja: ブンディブギョエボラ：WHOがDRCでの対応を強化、16.5トンの緊急医療機器を配送
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響：782例・181死亡、23.1%の致命率）、WPRO基準複数該当（重症度、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）、エボラウイルス病は国際的懸念の対象。
triage.notes: ブンディブギョエボラはDRCで782例・181死亡（致命率23.1%）が記録されており、既に深刻な流行状況。WHOが緊急医療物資を配送しており、国際的な支援体制が確立されている。Dubaiはロジスティクスハブの役割であり、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: RD del Congo eleva a 782 los casos de ébola y a 181 los fallecidos
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo raises Ebola cases to 782 and deaths to 181.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 782 confirmed Ebola cases and 181 deaths (case fatality rate 23.1%), with 359 patients hospitalized in isolation and 56 recoveries. The outbreak was declared on May 15 in the eastern DRC. Originating in Ituri, it has spread to North Kivu and South Kivu, with cross-border transmission to Uganda, where 19 infections and 2 deaths have been recorded. The World Health Organization has designated the situation a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, noting the Bundibugyo strain has no approved vaccine or specific treatment. Health authorities urge heightened surveillance, prompt care for fever, vomiting, or diarrhea, regular handwashing, meticulous contact tracing, and avoiding contact with sick or deceased individuals to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ出血熱の症例数を782件、死亡数を181件に引き上げ
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、エボラ出血熱のPHEIC指定による極度のリスク状況。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱（Bundibugyo株）によるPHEIC（国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）指定事象。782症例、181死亡、23.1%の致命率。ウガンダへの越境感染確認（19症例、2死亡）。WHOが正式に公表している状況で、ワクチン・特異的治療がない株による高リスク状況。フルRRA対象。

article.articleHeadline: Seth Kikuni : "Tshisekedi fait la fête pendant qu'Ebola tue"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Seth Kikuni: "Tshisekedi parties while Ebola kills."
article.articleSummary: During a Live Space discussion on the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, opposition figure Seth Kikuni condemned President Félix Tshisekedi's management. Kikuni alleged three failings: first, personal conduct—celebrating his birthday, attending the Champions League final, and traveling to the United States—while the country confronts a grave Ebola outbreak; he argued no high-level government visits or deployments to the epidemic zone occurred. A minister's presence in Bunia was deemed insufficient. Second, diplomatic fallout, warning that DRC risks being placed on an international blacklist as the crisis prompts visa cancellations. Third, political misalignment—the president's festive and international schedule contrasts with the severity on the ground, portraying a leader disconnected from national realities. The piece underscores international concern over Kinshasa's inability to contain the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: セス・キクニ：「ツィセケディが祝賀しているときにエボラが人を殺している」
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の発生でIHR基準2つ以上に該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク）。DRCでの実質的な流行は異常かつ重大であり、国際的懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCでのエボラ・ブンディブギョ亜種の発生と政治的対応への批判が主題。キナシャ市とブニアでの発生が示唆されている。米国への言及は発生地ではなく大統領の移動先のため、DRCのみを verified_locations に含める。国際的な懸念（査証キャンセル、ブラックリスト化のリスク）が明示されており、WPROスクリーニング基準5項目すべてに該当する。

article.articleHeadline: DRC reports record number of Ebola cases in a single day as outbreak hits 1-month mark - Delta Daily News
article.articleSummary: DRC Ebola outbreak: 72 new confirmed cases on June 13 raise total to 782, with 29 deaths in the last month and 181 fatalities overall. The outbreak, now one month since first detection, remains concentrated in Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu; two new health zones—Nia-Nia (Ituri) and Mabalako (North Kivu)—report cases for the first time, bringing affected zones to 31. Contact tracing covers 56.5% of identified contacts, far below the 90–95% target. Community hesitancy and shortages of medicines and infection-control supplies hamper response. Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases and two deaths linked to cross-border transmission. UNICEF warns more children may be affected as surveillance challenges persist. The U.S. pledges $50 million to CEPI; total U.S. Ebola funding exceeds $270 million, with 6,300+ people screened in Ituri, 100 facilities supported, and 200 safe burials. Bundibugyo strain drives the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: DRCがエボラウイルス病の1日当たりの記録的新規症例数を報告、発生から1か月に到達
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病は重篤な公衆衛生上の影響、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境感染確認）、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを呈している。
triage.notes: ウガンダへの越境感染が確認されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRC内での発生が主題。接触者追跡率が目標値（90-95%）を大きく下回る56.5%であり、対応能力の課題が明らかである。小児への影響拡大が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Во Конго регистриран еден од најголемите дневни скокови на бројот на заразени со ебола
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, one of the largest daily increases in the number of people infected with Ebola was recorded.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, the Ebola virus disease outbreak in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo has surged, with 72 new cases in the last 24 hours, bringing total cases to 782 and deaths to 181 (including 29 new deaths). The outbreak—centered in Ituri province—has overwhelmed health centers, with many patients arriving at late stages and many not previously identified as contacts. World health authorities say the true scale may be larger. The outbreak is attributed to Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a variant less common than the Zaire variant involved in prior epidemics. Over 90% of cases are in Ituri, with additional cases in North and South Kivu provinces and neighboring Uganda. MSF warns that the spread is rapid in a region where people move frequently, and early days saw limited testing.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴで1日の新規感染者数が過去最大級の増加を記録 エボラ出血熱
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常で予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性）。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行で、24時間で72例の新規症例、高い致死率（約23%）、複数州での拡大、隣国ウガンダへの波及報告あり。
triage.notes: 発生地域にウガンダが含まれているがサマリーでは「追加症例」としてのみ言及され、主流行地はDRC（イトゥリ州中心）。Bundibugyo ebolavirus変異株による流行は比較的稀で、医療崩壊（患者の遅期到着）と接触者追跡困難が報告されている。MSFによる警告あり、地域の人口移動活発。

article.articleHeadline: 甲型肝炎 病從口入 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hepatitis A: infection via ingestion
article.articleSummary: Thailand reports a hepatitis A outbreak, prompting travel precautions. Hepatitis A is typically acquired by consuming contaminated seafood, undercooked foods, or contaminated water, and can spread via food handlers with unwashed hands. Severe infection may cause acute liver failure requiring transplant; symptoms range from asymptomatic or mild gastroenteritis to fatigue, loss of appetite, and jaundice, with dark urine and pale stools being classic signs. Hepatitis A and Hepatitis B are different viruses; Hep A causes acute, self-limited infection with lifelong immunity after recovery, while Hep B can become chronic and progress to liver cancer or cirrhosis. Immunization provides lifelong protection after two-dose vaccination (second dose about six months after the first). For travelers to Thailand, vaccination is advised; in Hong Kong, Hep A is present year-round. Food safety: cook seafood thoroughly, drink boiled water, and choose hygienic restaurants, avoid unboiled water and contaminated ice.

triage.headline_ja: 甲型肝炎 病從口入
triage.triage_reason: タイで肝炎Aアウトブレイク報告があり、異常性、国際的感染リスク（渡航者への影響）、そして食品・水を介した長期曝露の可能性が認識される。IHR基準およびWPRO基準の複数項目に該当する。
triage.notes: 香港はChina (1814991) に含める。記事はタイでの肝炎Aアウトブレイク報告を主題とし、香港での常在も言及。肝炎A・B双方が記載されているが、アウトブレイク対象は肝炎Aであることを確認。食品・水を介した感染経路のため長期曝露リスク高い。渡航者向けの注意喚起も社会的関心を示す。

article.articleHeadline: चिंता की बात: मलेरिया के खिलाफ सुरक्षा कवच पर मंडराया संकट - malaria net resistance threatens global fight against disease
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A Matter of Concern: Looming Threat to the Protective Shield Against Malaria - Malaria Net Resistance Threatens the Global Fight Against the Disease.
article.articleSummary: Global analysis of 25 studies across 12 countries, including India and China, shows insecticide-treated nets (ITNs) historically reduced malaria but rising mosquito resistance is compromising effectiveness. The analysis, led by researchers at James Cook University (Australia) and University of Jos (Nigeria), examined 19 studies on malaria cases and 6 on malaria deaths. In Asia, ITNs correlated with a 68% drop in malaria cases and an 18% fall in deaths. In Africa, malaria cases fell 29–40%. The findings also note changing mosquito behavior and local factors—species, resistance levels, and improper net use—risk undermining gains. Researchers call for next-generation nets, such as pyrethroid-piperonyl butoxide (PBO) nets and dual-active-ingredient ITNs, alongside indoor residual spraying and wall coatings with insecticide to sustain malaria control.

triage.headline_ja: 懸念事項：マラリア対策の防御膜に迫る危機 - マラリア対策用蚊帳の殺虫剤耐性が世界的対策を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: マラリア対策用蚊帳の殺虫剤耐性に関する国際的な分析報告であり、公衆衛生への潜在的な影響と国際的関心が認められるが、具体的な感染症患者数増加や緊急の流行兆候は記事に明記されていないため、追加情報の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は12カ国25件の研究に基づくメタ分析であり、インドと中国を含むアジア地域での研究が含まれている。蚊帳の殺虫剤耐性という新たな脅威要因は公衆衛生上の懸念として認識されており、次世代蚊帳やIRSなどの代替戦略が提案されている。ただし、現在の患者数増加の具体的なデータや急速な感染拡大の証拠は記事に含まれていないため、WATCH判定とした。ナイジェリアはBluedot APIで指摘されているが対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : MSF alerte sur des lacunes dans la réponse
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: MSF warns of gaps in the response.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Bundibugyo strain) was declared on 15 May 2026—the 17th outbreak in a country of over 100 million; no approved vaccine or specific treatment exists. The WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern on 17 May. The first case was confirmed in Goma on 17 May, with a second in South Kivu on 21 May. As of early June, 782 cases and 181 deaths were reported by the WHO, though MSF warns figures likely undercount due to gaps in screening and surveillance. The epicenter is Ituri province, accounting for >90% of cases; Uganda reports 16 cases and 1 death, including a Congolese patient who died in Kampala on 14 May. Screening and contact tracing remain weak, rising from ~45% end-May to >70% early June. MSF runs Mongbwalu (52 beds) and Goma (80 beds) treatment centers; Bukavu and Lwiro units are under construction. In Uganda, Kampala’s 32-bed center was rehabilitated and a 14-bed isolation unit at Bwera renovated. Ongoing insecurity in eastern DRC hampers access; malaria, cholera and measles continue to burden health systems.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ出血熱：国境なき医師団が対応の不備を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当し、2626年6月時点で782例782死亡の大規模流行。WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態（PHEIC）を宣言し、複数国に拡大（DRC、ウガンダ）。国際的支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事はBundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の大規模流行を記述。DRC（イツリ州が流行中心地、全体の90%以上）とウガンダ（16例1死亡）での確認事例を明記。MSFは検査・接触者追跡の不備を警告し、ウガンダも治療施設を整備中。複数の併発疾患（マラリア、コレラ、麻疹）も報告されているが、記事の主題はエボラ出血熱。

article.articleHeadline: RDC: "Tshisekedi fait la fête pendant qu'Ebola tue" (Seth Kikuni)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC: "Tshisekedi parties while Ebola kills" (Seth Kikuni)
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, in the Democratic Republic of Congo, opposition figure Seth Kikuni criticized President Félix Tshisekedi for failing to contain the Ebola Bundibugyo outbreak, during a Live Space broadcast with journalist Stanis Bujakera Tshiamala. Kikuni presents a three-pronged critique: (1) the president’s personal conduct—celebrating his birthday, attending the Champions League final, and flying to the United States—while the epidemic rages, with no visit to the outbreak zone or dispatch of senior government officials; (2) diplomatic fallout, warning Kinshasa risks an international blacklist as global scrutiny increases and visas are canceled; (3) a political contrast between a festive, international agenda and the grave health crisis on the ground, portraying Tshisekedi as disconnected from his country’s realities. The Communications Minister’s Bunia visit is acknowledged but deemed insufficient.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：「エボラが人を殺している間にチセケディは祝宴を開いている」（セス・キクニ）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（異常/深刻な公衆衛生影響/国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準3項目該当（深刻度・流行易さ・管理可能性）。エボラ出血熱ブンディブギョ種の発生であり、対象国DRCで確認されている。社会的・政治的関心も高い。
triage.notes: エボラ・ブンディブギョ種はキナシャとブニアで確認。記事はDRC政府の危機対応の不十分性を政治的に批判している内容だが、実際の流行事象はDRCで確認されている。米国（Bluedotが示唆）は記事本文の政治的文脈でのみ言及され、実際の患者発生地ではないため除外。管理可能性に「Yes」を付与したのは、記事が政府対応の欠如と国際的懸念を明示しているため。

article.articleHeadline: Рекордно дневно зголемување на заразени со ебола во Конго
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Record daily increase in Ebola infections in Congo.
article.articleSummary: In the Democratic Republic of Congo, authorities report 72 new Ebola infections in the past 24 hours, bringing the total to 782 cases, including 181 confirmed deaths and 29 new fatalities. MSF warns the outbreak’s pace has outstripped response after one month, with the true extent unknown as transmission occurs in a mobile region complicating contact tracing. Health centers in the epicenter are overwhelmed, with many patients arriving in late stages and many not previously identified as contacts. More than 90% of cases are in Ituri, the eastern province, with additional cases in North and South Kivu and neighboring Uganda. The current outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus; earlier outbreaks were driven by the Zaïre variant, which is more common than Bundibugyo and was not tested early.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染が過去最高の1日増加数を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラは重篤な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、複数国での確認（DRC、ウガンダ）、接触者追跡の困難さ、医療施設の飽和により国際拡大および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが高い。フルRRAを実施すべき。
triage.notes: ウガンダも発生地域として記載されているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主題であり、ウガンダは「隣国での事例」として言及のみ。DRCが対象国リストに含まれるため検出。Bundibugyo ebolavirus亜型による発生で、過去のZaïre亜型より管理可能と言われるが、現在の蔓延速度が対応を上回っており、接触者追跡困難、医療崩壊が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Beni: les mesures barrières renforcées auprès des revendeurs des téléphones de seconde main - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Beni: Enhanced Barrier Measures for Second-Hand Phone Dealers - ACP
article.articleSummary: Enhanced Ebola virus disease barrier measures are being enforced in Beni, North Kivu, Democratic Republic of the Congo, at the Tora-Tina Beni second-hand phone market. On 15 June 2026, market vendors were urged to strictly apply social distancing and other barriers to protect both clients and sellers, particularly since many buyers originate from Ituri, the epicenter of the DRC’s 17th Ebola outbreak. Beni continues to register new confirmed Ebola cases. The reinforcement of outreach will extend to other phone market sections in Beni. A market vendor expressed satisfaction with the awareness efforts and urged continued social distancing during transactions. He also asked health authorities for more hygiene measures, including handwashing facilities and thermal scanners, to accommodate the growing customer flow at this marketplace.

triage.headline_ja: ベニでのエボラ：中古電話販売業者向けの強化された感染予防措置 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つすべてに該当。DRCの17回目のエボラアウトブレイク中の確認症例の継続発生、国際的拡大リスク、国際支援の必要性から、フルRRA実施が必要である。
triage.notes: DRCの17回目のエボラアウトブレイク中の記事。ベニ市での新規確認症例の継続報告あり。イトゥリはアウトブレイクの震源地とされており、地域的な拡大リスクが高い。市場などの人口密集地での感染予防措置強化が実施されているが、ハンドサニタイザーや熱検査カメラなどの施設が不足している状況が懸念される。

article.articleHeadline: Justiça Federal encaminha à conciliação casos de vítimas de hanseníase - Ponta Porã Informa - Notícias de Ponta Porã - MS e Pedro Juan Caballero - PY
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Federal Court refers cases involving leprosy victims to conciliation - Ponta Porã Informs - News from Ponta Porã - MS and Pedro Juan Caballero - PY.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Federal Court Council (CJF) presented CJF Recommendation 3/2026 at Brasília's 10th Civil Law journey, directing Federal Regional Courts and other federal courts to send Hansen's disease-related cases involving compulsory isolation or internment to Centers for Judicial Conciliation (Cejuscs) under the National Negotiation Plan (PNN 33). The AGU launched PNN 33 on June 12 to promote consensual resolution of claims against the Union by people affected by Hansen's disease up to 1986, including beneficiaries extended to children separated from parents. The CJF calls for fast, efficient dispute management and allows waiving conciliatory hearings, with cases on special pensions and indemnities routed to Cejuscs via the PGU’s Regional Negotiation Coordination. The special pension, created by Law 11.520/2007 and amended by 14.736/2023, pays R$2,190.53 monthly for life. Eligible are those compulsorily interned, isolated at home, or in seringais, plus their children. CIA Hanseníase: 12,635 requests (2007–Oct 2024) with 9,034 granted; 12,908 new requests Jan 2025–Apr 2026, 11,619 pending. Internment occurred 1920s–1980s; 2007 recognized abuses and established the pension.

triage.headline_ja: 連邦裁判所がハンセン病被害者のケースを調停に付託 - ポンタポラー・インフォルマ
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はブラジルの連邦裁判所がハンセン病被害者に対する過去の強制隔離に関する補償請求を調停制度に付託する司法手続についての報道であり、進行中の感染症流行や公衆衛生上の緊急事態ではなく、歴史的な人権侵害に対する法的救済措置の制度化である。IHR基準およびWPRO基準に該当せず、シグナル対象にはならない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題は1920年代から1980年代に発生した強制隔離の歴史的問題に対する現在の法的救済制度（2007年開始、2023年改正）の実装であり、現在の感染症流行監視対象ではない。ハンセン病は既存疾患として確立されており、進行中の流行や緊急事態の兆候はない。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果卫生官员继续抗击埃博拉疫情
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congolese health officials continue to combat the Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) driven by Bundibugyo virus has reached 782 infections and 181 deaths, marking the 17th outbreak in the country since 1976. The virus has spread across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces, with authorities stressing rapid case detection and strong community cooperation to identify, isolate, and diagnose contacts. International response includes WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus warning that armed conflict, displacement, and cross-border movement complicate control efforts. In neighboring Uganda, 19 confirmed Ebola cases and 2 deaths are linked to the DRC outbreak; Kampala has tightened border controls, allowing only cargo trucks and suspending passenger buses to curb transmission. Coordination among DRC, neighboring nations, and partners remains critical, with U.S. and other donors pledging funding, exceeding $220 million to date, to support the response.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴの衛生当局がエボラ疫情との戦いを継続
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（782感染者、181死亡）で深刻な公衆衛生影響、DRCとウガンダでの国際的拡大、国際支援動員（220百万ドル以上）が確認される。
triage.notes: ウガンダでの2次感染も報告されているが、記事の主題はDRCのエボラ流行。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsに含めない。Bundibugyo virus系統による17番目の流行であり、武力紛争と国境越え移動が制御を複雑化させている。WHO事務局長による警告、国際的な資金支援、複数国間の調整が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : 808 cas confirmés, 192 décès confirmés et 363 personnes en isolement
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in DR Congo: 808 confirmed cases, 192 confirmed deaths, and 363 people in isolation.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: as of 14 June 2026, 808 laboratory-confirmed cases and 192 confirmed deaths, with 363 individuals in isolation or under medical surveillance, about one month after outbreak declaration. Over 50 patients have recovered since the response began. The case fatality rate is estimated at 23%, implying roughly eight survivors per ten with timely care. Mongbwalu health zone in Ituri remains the epicenter, with 31 health zones across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu under reinforced surveillance. Key challenges include community resistance and unsafe burials, while contact tracing is only 63% against a 95% target. To strengthen the response, 1,200 community relays have been trained, with 1,000 deployed to identify exposures and direct patients to care. Officials emphasize that early treatment markedly improves survival.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：808例の確定症例、192例の確定死亡、363人の隔離
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス疾患は公衆衛生上極めて深刻で、死亡率23%の大規模流行が複数州で進行中であり、国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限のリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: 発生からおよそ1ヶ月で808例の確定症例、192例の死亡が記録。Ituri州Mongbwalu地域が震源地で、Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州の31保健ゾーンが監視下にある。接触者追跡率63%（目標95%）と対応上の課題が存在するが、1,200人のコミュニティリレイが訓練され、1,000人が配置されている。エボラの国際的な関心は極めて高く、全体的なトリアージスコアは最高レベル。

article.articleHeadline: കുമാരപുരത്ത് രണ്ടുപേരെ കടിച്ച തെരുവുനായയ്ക്ക്‌ പേവിഷബാധ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rabies infection confirmed in the street dog that bit two people in Kumarapuram.
article.articleSummary: Rabies infection confirmed in a street dog that bit two people in Kumarapuram, Haripad, Kerala. A five-year-old boy, Adwik, son of Akhil Vishwanathan, was bitten on the face while playing near home after school; on Saturday morning, a neighbor who is differently-abled, Gopalakrishnan (55) from Chapra, was also bitten. The dog was found dead Saturday afternoon. Post-mortem at the veterinary lab in Thiruvalla confirmed rabies. All contacts will receive anti-rabies vaccination. The gram panchayat will relocate roaming dogs to safer centers. Domestic dogs and cats will receive preventive vaccination at the Tamallakkal East Panchayat day shelter. A health-education class for residents was inaugurated by President Asha Ramachandran.

triage.headline_ja: クマラプラムで2人を噛んだ野良犬に狂犬病感染を確認
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケーラ州での狂犬病確認事案。複数の人間が噛まれ、動物側での確認もあるが、現時点では限定的な地域・規模の事案と評価される。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: ケーラ州の限定的な地域での狂犬病事案。死亡動物の確認、複数人への曝露があり重症度は高い。ただし現時点で国際的拡大リスクは低い。地方自治体が対応措置（予防接種キャンペーン、野良犬の管理）を実施中。今後の拡大状況や死亡例の発生に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Casos de ébola en RDC suman 782 y 181 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola cases in the DRC total 782, with 181 deaths.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-15, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 782 confirmed Ebola cases and 181 deaths, with 56 recoveries, yielding a 23% case fatality rate. The outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo virus, remains concentrated in Ituri province (over 90% of cases) with additional cases in North and South Kivu and cross-border transmission to Uganda. May 15 marks the confirmed start, and contact tracing coverage stands at 56%, down from last week, signaling potential under-detection. Bundibugyo virus has no vaccine or approved treatment, unlike Zaire ebolavirus. Nearly one million people have been displaced by violence in Ituri (UN OCHA), complicating surveillance due to forested terrain, poor roads, and remote villages, hindering contact tracing. 56 recoveries; ongoing transmission persists across provinces and across borders.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ症例が782件に達し、181人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、Bundibugyo virus による進行中のエボラ出血熱アウトブレイク。オウガンダへの越境感染、接触者追跡率の低下、ワクチン/治療法の未承認によるリスク高。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUgandaも含まれていますが、記事サマリーではウガンダは越境感染の言及のみで、主要な発生地はDRC（特にIturi州90%以上）です。DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含めました。ウガンダは対象国リストに未含の為、越境感染の警告であっても verified_locations には含めていません。Bundibugyo virusによるエボラはZaire株と異なり、ワクチン・治療法未承認という重大なリスク要因が存在します。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N8
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2

article.articleHeadline: 兩歲童逛禾輋活雞檔染禽流 料因曾摸玻璃 政府稱H9N2低致病毋須殺雞 - 20260616
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Two-year-old child who visited Ho Che live-chicken stall contracted avian influenza; believed to be due to having touched the glass; government says H9N2 is low-pathogenic and no need to cull chickens - 20260616.
article.articleSummary: Two-year-old boy in Hong Kong contracted avian influenza A(H9N2) after visiting a Sha Tin Wo Che Market live-chicken stall, touching the glass barrier and surroundings. He developed fever and mild diarrhea on June 9, was admitted to Princess Margaret Hospital, and tested positive for H9 influenza; full-genome analysis confirmed H9N2 with all genes of avian origin and no mutations. An environmental sample from the stall's chicken feces trough tested positive for H9N2, while 16 other samples from home and market were negative. The CHP considers this a local infection and, based on OIE guidelines, no culling is required. Thirteen close contacts tested negative. Since 1999, Hong Kong has recorded 11 human H9N2 cases with no deaths. Authorities urge thorough cooking of poultry and eggs and hand hygiene; avoid exposing young children to live poultry markets.

triage.headline_ja: 2歳児がホーチェ活鶏店で鳥インフルエンザH9N2に感染、ガラスを触ったことが原因と推定　政府はH9N2は低病原性で鶏の殺処分は不要と発表
triage.triage_reason: 香港（中国）で2歳児がH9N2鳥インフルエンザに感染という確定症例の報告。IHR基準では異常性と公衆衛生への潜在的影響が認められ、WPRO基準では重症度、長期曝露リスク、流行可能性、管理可能性などで複数該当し、かつ公式保健機関の対応と市民向け注意喚起が行われており社会的関心が高い。
triage.notes: 香港での感染事例のため China(1814991)に含める。患者は軽症(発熱・軽度下痢)だが、生きた家禽市場での曝露と環境からの病原体検出が確認されている。1999年以来の11例目だが、死亡例はなし。低病原性とされるが、幼小児への曝露リスクの観点から公衆衛生上の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: 大陸外拡散「防ぐ支援を」 エボラ熱対策トップが会見｜全国のニュース｜Web東奥
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread Beyond the Continent: "Support to Prevent" Ebola Fever Countermeasures Chief Holds a Press Conference | National News | Web Tohoku
article.articleSummary: Eastern Congo's Ebola virus disease outbreak: 782 infections and 181 deaths confirmed by WHO; neighboring Uganda reports 19 infections and 2 deaths as of 15 June 2026. One month after WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, AU CDC Director Jean-Kaseya urged expanded international support to prevent spread beyond Africa, warning containment failure could cause large-scale damage and stating about $500 million is required for East Congo containment; WHO affirmed similar needs. Japan's Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare says domestic risk remains low. Kaseya also noted only 8% of ambulances are adequately available to safely transport Ebola patients. He suggested that if the outbreak spreads to Japan, response costs could reach tens of billions of dollars. The statements were given in a Kyodo News online interview, underscoring ongoing urgency as international assistance is debated.

triage.headline_ja: 大陸外拡散「防ぐ支援を」 エボラ熱対策トップが会見
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の広域流行であり、WHO PHEIC宣言済み。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは東コンゴ（DRC）での782感染181死亡、ウガンダでの19感染2死亡が報告されている。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。日本に関する言及があるが、実際の発生地ではなく潜在的リスク評価のコンテキストのため日本も除外。WHO PHEIC宣言済みで、国際的支援が急務とされており、高優先度。

article.articleHeadline: 大陸外拡散「防ぐ支援を」　エボラ熱対策トップが会見
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Spread Beyond the Continent: 'Support to Prevent It' Ebola Response Chief Holds a Press Conference
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to grow, with 782 infections and 181 deaths, per WHO. Uganda reports 19 infections and 2 deaths. WHO had declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern a month earlier. Jean Kaseya, head of the African Union’s Africa CDC, warns that failure to contain could spread beyond Africa and incur multibillion-dollar response costs, urging international “support to prevent” further transmission. The AU/CDC and WHO estimate at least $500 million is needed to contain the Congo outbreak, highlighting funding gaps. Japan’s Ministry of Health says domestic risk remains low should cases reach Japan. Ambulance capacity in the affected region is critically limited, with only about 8% of the required emergency-vehicle fleet available.

triage.headline_ja: 大陸外拡散「防ぐ支援を」　エボラ熱対策トップが会見
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、PHEIC宣言済みのエボラ熱で、東部DRCで782感染・181死亡、ウガンダにも19感染2死亡が報告されている。国際的な資金支援の必要性が強調されている。
triage.notes: PHEIC宣言済みの既知の大規模エボラ熱流行。DRCとウガンダで発生しているが、対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。日本への到来リスク言及あるが、日本は対象国ではないため verified_locations には含めない。資金不足と医療インフラの重大な不足が特筆される。

article.articleHeadline: यूपी को मलेरिया मुक्त बनाने का अभियान शुरू, सीतापुर में मिले सबसे अधिक 3643 रोगी - uttar pradesh launches malaria free campaign sitapur cases
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Campaign to make Uttar Pradesh malaria-free begins; Sitapur records the highest 3,643 cases.
article.articleSummary: Uttar Pradesh has launched a malaria-elimination campaign after polio, kala-azar, and Japanese encephalitis successes, with Sitapur recording the highest burden at 3,643 cases. Saharanpur, Mainpuri, Azamgarh, Lalitpur and Mahoba have become malaria-free. The National Strategic Plan 2023-27 guides a three-phase approach: Phase 1—notify cases within one day, test within three days, and control within seven days, with ASHA workers, ANMs and district officers responsible; Phase 2—Integrated Vector Management: identify mosquito species, breeding sites, monitor insecticide resistance, and implement larval control. Dr. AK Chaudhary notes malaria cases are declining: 2019 saw over 92,000; 2025 about 14,500, with testing rising from 2.51% to 7.8% and positivity at 0.25%. In 2026, focus shifts to high-burden districts, aiming to make UP malaria-free within two years. Malaria spreads via infected female Anopheles mosquitoes, favored by waterlogging and poor sanitation.

triage.headline_ja: ウッタル・プラデーシュ州がマラリア撲滅キャンペーンを開始、シタプールで最多3,643症例
triage.triage_reason: インドのウッタル・プラデーシュ州でマラリアおよび関連疾患（JE、ポリオ、カラアザール）に関する公衆衛生キャンペーンが報告されているが、2026年時点で症例数は減少傾向にあり、同州内での制御が進行中である。国際的拡大リスクや深刻な重症度の示唆は明確でないため、続報による追跡が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はマラリア撲滅キャンペーンの進捗を報告するもので、過去の成功事例（ポリオ、カラアザール、JE）を参照している。症例数は2019年の92,000件から2025年約14,500件へと大幅に減少しており、管理状況は良好である。WPRO基準では長期曝露（蚊媒介による持続的感染リスク）と流行しやすさ（マラリア自体の特性）で該当するが、州政府が統制的に対応中であり、IHR基準に該当する深刻な国際的リスクは認められない。

article.articleHeadline: Campanha de combate à dengue em Seara tem coleta de pneus - BelosF7
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue control campaign in Seara includes tire collection
article.articleSummary: 550 unusable tires were removed during Seara's Aedes aegypti control campaign and will be environmentally disposed. The effort, led by the Municipal Health Secretariat's Arboviroses team, aims to eliminate standing-water containers that can breed Aedes aegypti, thereby reducing dengue, chikungunya, and Zika transmission. The City Secretariat assisted in collection, stacking, and loading to ensure efficiency. The initiative is part of a Santa Catarina state government campaign in partnership with the Institute of Environment (IMA), reinforcing public health protection and environmental preservation. The municipality underscores community participation as essential, urging residents to keep properties free of objects that can collect rainwater to eliminate mosquito breeding sites.

triage.headline_ja: シアラのデング熱対策キャンペーンでタイヤ回収を実施
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はデング熱・チクングニア熱・ジカ熱に対する予防的な蚊媒介対策キャンペーン（環境整備・タイヤ回収）の報道であり、実際の患者発生や疾病増加に関する情報は含まれていない。公衆衛生上の緊急性やシグナル検知の要件を満たさない。
triage.notes: 記事の主題はデング熱などの媒介蚊対策キャンペーン（タイヤ回収と環境整備）であり、現在の患者発生・流行状況に関する情報は報告されていない。政府による能動的な予防対策の実施は認識されるが、シグナルトリアージの対象となる『異常な感染症イベント』ではなく、定期的な公衆衛生対策である。

article.articleHeadline: USP participa de iniciativa da Fiocruz para enfrentar impactos da chikungunya
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: USP participates in Fiocruz initiative to tackle the impacts of Chikungunya
article.articleSummary: USP's Faculdade de Ciências Farmacêuticas de Ribeirão Preto (FCFRP) participates in a Fiocruz-coordinated initiative to address chikungunya impacts in Brazilian municipalities experiencing outbreaks. The project, led by Fiocruz Bahia and UFBA scientist Viviane Boaventura, brings together clinical care, professional training, and research. It mobilizes physicians, researchers, students, and laboratory staff to operate in affected regions, where field missions evaluate patients in the acute phase and enroll them in ongoing clinical and scientific follow-up through in-person follow-up visits and telemonitoring in the ensuing months. FCFRP contributions are led by professor Cristina Ribeiro de Barros Cardoso. The collaboration aims to integrate patient care with epidemiological and laboratory research to mitigate chikungunya burden, leveraging fieldwork and telemonitoring to sustain follow-up for those treated under the program.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジルのチクングニア熱の影響に対抗するためのFiocruzイニシアティブにUSPが参加
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルでのチクングニア熱の進行中の発生に関する記事だが、新規なアウトブレイク報告ではなく、既存の流行への対応・研究イニシアティブの報告である。情報源が学術機関のニュースリリースであり、公衆衛生当局の公式発表ではない。
triage.notes: 本記事は複数のブラジル自治体（リベイラン・プレート、サンパウロ州、バイア州）におけるチクングニア熱の進行中の発生を報告している。ただし、新規なアウトブレイク通知ではなく、既存の流行への学術的対応イニシアティブが主題である。WPRO基準の「長期曝露」と「流行しやすさ」に該当するが、IHR基準には該当せず、当局による新規通知ではないため、続報を注視する段階と判定した。

article.articleHeadline: Modelo de IA mapeará dengue antecipadamente por bairros de São Paulo | CNN Brasil
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: AI Model Will Preemptively Map Dengue Across São Paulo's Neighborhoods | CNN Brasil
article.articleSummary: São Paulo, Brazil — An IPSP (Instituto Pasteur de São Paulo) research project is developing an AI-based system that combines climate data, environmental indicators, urban infrastructure, and public perceptions of dengue vaccination to map areas at highest dengue transmission risk in São Paulo. Beyond traditional climate factors, the model analyzes urban heat islands, water access, sewage collection, and other variables to explain why some urban districts experience higher dengue incidence than neighboring areas with similar seasons. The project will produce high-resolution risk maps, reaching neighborhoods and potentially block levels, to guide surveillance, vaccination campaigns, and vector-control efforts, and to support early warning systems for dengue surges. It also uses social listening to monitor public and health professional perceptions of vaccination, informing One Health-driven public health policies.

triage.headline_ja: AI モデルがサンパウロの街区ごとにデングス熱を事前にマッピング | CNN Brasil
triage.triage_reason: 記事の主題は既存デングス熱流行に対するAIベースの予測・監視ツール開発であり、新規感染症イベント（確定例、集団発生、異常な増加）を報じていない。公衆衛生研究プロジェクトの紹介であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。
triage.notes: 本記事はサンパウロにおけるデングス熱監視システムの技術開発に関する報道であり、急性の感染症イベント（新規アウトブレイク、異常な症例増加、制御不能な流行）を描写していない。既存公衆衛生対策の強化ツールに関する情報提供であるため、シグナルとしてピックアップしない。

article.articleHeadline: 世卫组织赞扬乌干达应对埃博拉疫情的措施，呼吁保持警惕并加强区域合作
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: WHO commends Uganda's measures in response to the Ebola outbreak, urges continued vigilance and stronger regional cooperation.
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo ebolavirus caused the Ebola outbreak detected in May in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with no approved vaccine yet. By 15 June 2026, Uganda has 19 confirmed and 1 suspected Ebola case, largely linked to import from the DRC. Control efforts face humanitarian pressures, insecure conditions, and large cross-border movement. Encouraging signs include community cooperation, new laboratories, and patient recoveries. WHO Director-General Tedros Adhanom Ghebreyesus visited Uganda to review the response, praising robust surveillance, testing, and case management systems, and the rapid operation of an Ebola treatment unit at Mulago Hospital, activated within six hours of the declaration and run by the Uganda Emergency Medical Team (146 members) trained with WHO and EU support; the team was deployed within two hours of the outbreak announcement. Ongoing risks require sustained cross-border collaboration, community engagement, and avoidance of travel bans.

triage.headline_ja: 世界保健機関（WHO）がウガンダのエボラ出血熱対応を称賛、警戒態勢の維持と地域協力の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の発生、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも複数項目該当。エボラ出血熱は最高度の感染症脅威であり、複数国での確認事例と地域協力の必要性が明記されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダでの症例数が報告されているが、対象国リスト（GeoNames ID: 895949=Zambia, 1694008=Philippines, 1605651=Thailand, 2300660=Ghana, 203312=DRC, 3469034=Brazil, 1643084=Indonesia, 1814991=China, 1327865=Myanmar, 1562822=Vietnam, 1269750=India）に基づき、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。ウガンダ（1654675）は対象国に含まれていない。ただしDRCが対象国に含まれており、Bundibugyo ebolavirus由来の初期発生地がDRCであることが確認されている。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（検証済みウイルス種）、複数国の事例存在（検証済み）、ワクチン未承認（検証済み）、治療施設の急速な運用開始（検証済み）といった高いリスク要因により、FRR（Full Rapid Risk Assessment）への進行を強く推奨する。

article.articleHeadline: बारिश का पानी जगह-जगह थमा, डेंगू-मलेरिया का खतरा बढ़ा
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rainwater stagnates in several places; risk of Dengue and Malaria has risen.
article.articleSummary: Rains in Hathras have caused persistent waterlogging and dirty water, boosting mosquito breeding and raising the risk of dengue and malaria, along with fever/viral illnesses, as of 15 June 2026. Health authorities are criticized for laxity. triage.headline_ja: 雨水が各地で滞留、デング熱とマラリアのリスク上昇
triage.triage_reason: マラリアとデング熱の同時発生を報告する局所的な公衆衛生事象。デング熱の確定症例数が不明であり、国際的拡大リスクも明確でないため、情報不足のWATCH判定。
triage.notes: インド・ウッタルプラデーシュ州ハートラス地域での局所的な発生。マラリア2例の確定報告に対し、デング熱の具体的症例数が不明。降雨による蚊媒介環境の悪化は継続中。デング熱症例の確認が得られた場合、シグナルとしてピックアップすべき。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola en RDC : la réponse est insuffisante face à la gravité de la situation, alerte MSF
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in the DRC: the response is insufficient in view of the severity of the situation, MSF warns.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC) is advancing faster than the humanitarian response a month after official declaration. Médecins Sans Frontières (MSF) warns that critical gaps in diagnosis, surveillance, and contact tracing jeopardize containment. Official tallies exceed 650 confirmed cases and 130 deaths, though field observers caution this underreports true burden; Uganda reports 19 confirmed cases signaling regional transmission. The outbreak is concentrated in eastern DRC, across Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with Ituri accounting for about 95% of cases and the epicenter there. MSF notes treatment centers, including an Ebola treatment center operated by MSF at the Elikya hospital in Bunia, are overwhelmed; many patients present at late stages, and most were not identified or followed as contacts before seeking care. The assessment underscores the need for expanded diagnostic capacity and contact management to curb spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：状況の深刻さに対して対応が不十分、国境なき医師団が警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。エボラウイルス疾患は公衆衛生への影響が深刻で、公式発表から1ヶ月で600例以上の確認患者と130名の死亡、ウガンダへの域外拡大（19例）、診断・監視体制の重大な不備が国際的拡大リスクを示唆。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、エボラ発生の主要地は DRC（イトゥリ州・北キブ州・南キブ州）であり、ウガンダは域外拡大の確認地として記載されているが、発生地としては DRC のみを対象国として verified_locations に含める。公式統計では 650 例以上の確認患者と 130 名の死亡が報告されているが、実際の患者数はこれを上回る可能性がある。治療体制の逼迫と診断・接触者追跡体制の重大な不備が指摘されており、国際的支援の必要性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: U Kongu jedan od najvećih dnevnih skokova broja zaraženih od ebole
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In Congo, one of the largest daily jumps in the number of people infected with Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Kinshasa) shows one of the largest daily jumps. Total cases rise to 782, with 181 confirmed deaths and 29 additional fatalities. In the last 24 hours, 72 new infections were reported. The outbreak began about a month ago in the eastern Ituri province, which accounts for over 90% of cases, with spread to North Kivu and South Kivu and even into neighboring Uganda. Doctors Without Borders reports overwhelmed treatment centers, with many patients presenting late and numerous contacts not yet identified. The current outbreak is linked to the Bundibugyo variant, unlike earlier epidemics driven by the Zaire variant, which was not routinely tested at first. Authorities warn true case counts may be higher, and this could become the largest Ebola outbreak on record.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者の最大級の日増加を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常な急速増加、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境）、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確。WPRO基準も5項目全てに該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東部Ituri州での発生から複数州への拡大、およびウガンダへの越境を明記。72時間の新規感染72例は異常な速度。Bundibugyo variant による新規アウトブレイクという特異性。治療センターの過負荷、接触追跡不十分、実際の患者数が公式統計を上回る可能性がある点は管理可能性の低さを示唆。記録的規模への拡大予警あり。

article.articleHeadline: La RD del Congo eleva a 808 los casos de ébola confirmados, incluidas 192 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo raises the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 808, including 192 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches 808 confirmed cases and 192 deaths (case fatality 23.8%) as of June 15, 2026. Three eastern provinces—Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, and South Kivu—are affected, with 31 of 104 health zones hit; 363 people are in isolation. The outbreak began May 15 in Ituri near Uganda and South Sudan and has spread to the eastern provinces. Vigilance is urged; anyone with fever, vomiting, diarrhea, or other suspected Ebola symptoms should promptly seek care at the nearest health facility. Ongoing surveillance and a multi-province response are reported by the Ministry of Health in updates posted on X.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国がエボラ確定患者数を808人に引き上げ、192人の死亡を含む
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認された多発生（808確定症例、192死亡）、3州にわたる地域的拡大、ウガンダへの国際的拡散リスク、および公衆衛生への深刻な影響から、IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡散リスク）。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda（226074）およびSudan（366755）も含まれているが、サマリーの主題はコンゴ民主共和国内での発生であり、隣接国への拡散リスク言及にとどまるため、verified_locationsはDRCのみに限定。ウガンダおよびスーダンは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。高い致死率（23.8%）、継続的な伝播、多地域への拡大、国境を越えたリスクが確認される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola à Mambasa :le taux de guérison évalué à 50% - ACP
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola in Mambasa: the recovery rate estimated at 50% - ACP.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in Mambasa health zone shows a 50% recovery rate among those infected. Dr. Abedi Yunga, the zone medical officer, said another patient is progressing well and could be discharged. He stressed that early treatment remains a decisive factor for survival, noting that delayed presentation has been linked to higher mortality in other health zones. The zone has recorded 12 suspected Ebola cases since the start of this flare-up, including 3 confirmed cases and 1 death. Residents are urged to seek health care promptly at the first signs of illness to improve outcomes.

triage.headline_ja: マンバサでのエボラ出血熱：回復率は50%と評価される - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された発生事例であり、IHR基準（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に複数該当し、また重症度・流行の可能性があることからWPRO基準でも該当。フルのリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: マンバサはDRC東部の保健地区。記事は確認されたエボラ症例（3件）を報告。早期治療が生存の重要な要因として強調されており、保健システムの有効性に関する懸念がある。DRCの対象国リストへの該当により、verified_locationsに含めた。

article.articleHeadline: Hortolândia vistoria armadilhas contra Aedes aegypti montadas em residências do Jardim São Sebastião
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hortolândia inspects Aedes aegypti traps installed in homes in Jardim São Sebastião.
article.articleSummary: Hortolândia advances Aedes aegypti control with home-installed traps in Jardim São Sebastião as part of a national Ministry of Health pilot started in March last year. UVZ (Unit of Zoonosis Surveillance) teams revisit traps and replace screens, while continuing casa a casa inspections in Jardim Adelaide and Jardim Amanda to eliminate breeding sites. About 80% of breeding foci occur inside homes; residents are urged to grant entry, with teams badge-identified. Inquiries: (19) 3897-3312 or (19) 3897-5974. Dengue cases in the municipality this year: 1,847 notified, 109 positive, 0 deaths; Chikungunya: 25 notified, 0 positives; Zika: 0. Dengue vaccination is available at seven UBS (primary health units) with extended hours: until 17:30 at Amanda II, Dom Bruno Gamberini, Rosolém, Santa Clara; until 18:30 at Amanda I, Figueiras, Parque do Horto.

triage.headline_ja: ホルトランディア市、ジャルディム・サン・セバスチャン地区の住宅に設置されたネッタイシマカ対策トラップを視察
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルにおけるデング熱、ジカウイルス感染症、チクングニア熱の流行状況の継続的な監視。記事は主に蚊媒介感染症の予防・検査活動を報告しており、現在の地域での発生件数は限定的だが、監視体制の継続と情報更新が必要。
triage.notes: ブラジルのサンパウロ州ホルトランディア市における蚊媒介感染症（デング熱、チクングニア熱、ジカ）の継続的な監視活動。2026年上半年のデング熱通知件数1,847件、確定患者109件と報告されている。予防接種キャンペーンも展開中。当該地域での発生件数は比較的限定的であるため、現在のところフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）対象外だが、ブラジルのデング流行動向に関連して監視継続が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases hit 782 as DRC outbreak worsens
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 782 cases and 178 deaths, with the Bundibugyo Ebola virus driving transmission. The situation report notes 72 new confirmed cases, including 29 deaths, in the eastern Ituri and North Kivu provinces, with two new health zones—Nia-Nia (Ituri) and Mabalako (North Kivu)—now affected, bringing total zones to 31. The outbreak, declared May 15, has affected Ituri, North Kivu and South Kivu. As of Saturday, 359 patients are in isolation or receiving treatment, and 40 have recovered; 136 suspected cases include 49 deaths. A total of 6,275 contacts are under follow-up across the three provinces, but only 3,548 were reached (56.5% vs a 95% target). Obstacles include reluctance to post-mortem testing, limited treatment-centre capacity, weak contact tracing, shortages of infection prevention materials in North Kivu, weak alert reporting, and a $21.5 million funding gap.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ患者数が782人に達し、DRC発症状況が悪化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5つ全て該当。継続中のエボラ流行で死亡例が多く、複数州に拡大中、国際支援が必要。フルRRA実施が必要。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola virus（BDBV）による継続的な流行。782確定例・178死亡、136疑い例を含む。接触者追跡率が56.5%に留まり目標95%に達せず。北キブ州での治療施設容量不足、感染予防物資の不足、資金不足（2,150万米ドル）が報告されている。5月15日宣言の流行で3州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）に影響。

article.articleHeadline: Congo reporta gran aumento diario de casos de ébola, a un mes de declararse el brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo reports a large daily increase in Ebola cases, one month after the outbreak was declared.
article.articleSummary: Ituri province, eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, is the epicenter of an Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus, declared about a month earlier. As of 15 June 2026, authorities reported 72 new cases in 24 hours, bringing confirmed infections to 782 and deaths to 181 after 29 more fatalities; 40 people have recovered, for a case fatality rate of 23%. Contact tracing stands at 56%, down from the prior week, hindered by community resistance and rapid spread to new health zones. The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri (over 90% of cases) with cases in North and South Kivu and cross-border transmission to Uganda. Nearly a million people are displaced in Ituri, complicating contact tracing. WHO is intensifying testing, tracing, and treatment; Africa CDC and MSF are deploying expertise and lab support. The Zaire Ebola virus has a vaccine, but Bundibugyo remains the current outbreak driver.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴが大量の日次エボラ症例増加を報告、流行宣言から1ヶ月後
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する深刻なエボラ流行。782例の確定患者、181名の死亡、23%の致命率、国際的な越境感染（ウガンダ）を示す大規模なシグナル。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus（ブンディブギョエボラウイルス）による流行。越境感染はウガンダに及んでいるが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。コンタクトトレーシング率の低下（56%）、コミュニティの抵抗、大規模な人口移動（約100万人）が懸念材料。WHO、Africa CDC、MSFが対応を強化している。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola lan nhanh ở CHDC Congo, 181 người chết
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola spreads rapidly in the Democratic Republic of the Congo; 181 dead.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of June 14, 2026, with 72 new cases in the past 24 hours. This marks the 17th Ebola outbreak in the DRC, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain with no licensed vaccine or approved treatment. Cases are primarily in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, with cross-border transmission into Uganda. U.S. CDC models warn the outbreak could continue expanding, potentially rivaling the West Africa epidemic of 2014–2016, which killed over 11,000. Key challenges include difficulties obtaining samples from deceased individuals, limited treatment capacity, weak contact tracing (about 56%), funding gaps, and PPE shortages in health facilities. Epidemiologists are pursuing the so-called patient zero to understand transmission dynamics.

triage.headline_ja: エボラがコンゴ民主共和国で急速に拡大、181人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR Annex2基準で4つ全て該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響（782確認例、181死亡）、予想外の希少株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）、国際的拡大リスク（ウガンダへの越境伝播）、渡航・貿易制限リスクが明確である。フルRRAに進める必要がある。
triage.notes: 発生地域にはUganda（226074）とAngola（3351879）も列挙されているが、記事サマリーではDRCが主要な発生地であり、ウガンダは越境伝播の言及のため、DRCのみを対象国として検証。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。アンゴラも同様。希少株（Bundibugyo ebolavirus）と未承認治療という点で異常性が高い。西アフリカ2014-2016エボラ流行（11,000死以上）との比較言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: Bezerras de 3 a 8 meses terão vacinação obrigatória contra brucelose
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Heifer calves aged 3 to 8 months will have mandatory vaccination against brucellosis.
article.articleSummary: Brazil's Ministry of Agriculture (MAPA) instituted a National Campaign to vaccinate female cattle and buffaloes against brucellosis, targeting heifers aged 3 to 8 months nationwide. The measure, published in the DOU (Diário Oficial da União) on 2026-06-15, follows the National Program for Control and Eradication of Brucellosis and Tuberculosis in Animals. Vaccination windows are January–June (first semester) with proof to the state veterinary service due by July 10, 2026; and July–December (second semester) with proof due by January 10, 2027. The campaign is not mandatory in states classified as risk A for brucellosis; the specific states are not listed. States with preexisting campaigns may keep their own proof deadlines, provided vaccination aligns with the national calendar. Brucellosis affects bovines and buffaloes and can impair reproductive performance; vaccination of young females is a key control measure. The order was signed by Allan Rogério de Alvarenga, Acting Secretary of the SDA.

triage.headline_ja: 生後3～8ヶ月の子牛に対するブルセラ症の強制予防接種
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの家畜ブルセラ症予防接種キャンペーン公示であり、既知の病原体に対する公衆衛生的な防御措置であって、異常なアウトブレイク事象ではない。ヒト感染リスクが記事に記載されておらず、国際的な感染症危機の兆候もない。
triage.notes: 本記事は動物衛生（家畜防疫）の行政措置であり、ヒト感染症監視の対象外。ブルセラ症とTBは人獣共通感染症だが、本記事はあくまで家畜予防接種の方針報告であり、ヒト症例の発生報告ではない。

article.articleHeadline: Вирус Эболы попадет из Африки в Европу в течение месяца с вероятностью 90%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola virus will reach Europe from Africa within a month with a 90% probability.
article.articleSummary: June 15, 2026 — Ebola modeling by Japanese researchers suggests infected travelers from the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda could reach major international hubs within 30 days. Worst-case importation probabilities: Belgium 92%, France 91%, United Arab Emirates 88%, and Turkey 86%. The analysis highlights effective-distance hubs including Belgium, France, South Africa, Kenya, and the UAE as high-risk for 30‑day importation. The model uses data from 11,264 airports, 569,741 routes, and about 330 million passengers, illustrating potential rapid cross-border movement. It stresses that importation risk is not equivalent to local transmission risk and supports timely global monitoring. Separately, in Bombali macaques, a 'mild' Ebola strain is reported to infect but not kill, eliciting a strong immune response and potentially informing treatment development.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスはアフリカからヨーロッパに30日以内に90%の確率で到達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大リスク（IHR基準3つ該当）と、複数国への高い輸入リスク予測が示されており、国際的な公衆衛生脅威として評価される。WPROスクリーニング基準も複数該当。
triage.notes: 記事は、コンゴ民主共和国とウガンダからの感染旅行者によるヨーロッパ（ベルギー、フランス）やUAEへの輸入リスクをモデリング予測している。対象国リストではDRCのみが該当。ウガンダ、ケニア、南アフリカは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations から除外した。エボラ出血熱は致死性が高い感染症であり、国際的拡大リスク評価は極めて重要。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола стала угрожать Европе и Арабским Эмиратам
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola threatens Europe and the United Arab Emirates
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus remains the focus: a theoretical spread from Africa could reach major European and Asia-Pacific hubs within 30 days, with Belgian entry risk at 92%, France 91%, UAE 88%, and Turkey 86%, according to Japanese modelling. German researchers estimate up to 65% of infected passengers from Congo and Uganda are not identified at controls because symptoms may be absent at arrival. The average incubation is about eight days, during which an infected person can fly undetected by screening. Clinicians say the calculations are realistic but caution against panic; preparedness matters more than inevitable spread. Ebola transmits only through direct contact with bodily fluids of symptomatic patients, so the most likely scenario is sporadic imported cases via large transit hubs rather than sustained local transmission in Europe or Russia. Import provenance: Africa (Congo, Uganda).

triage.headline_ja: エボラがヨーロッパとアラブ首長国連邦を脅かす
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）、かつWPRO基準でも複数該当。DRCでの発生と多数国への国際的リスク評価により、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはアフリカ（コンゴ、ウガンダ）からのエボラ発生と、ヨーロッパ・中東・太平洋地域への理論的リスク評価について論じている。実際の感染発生が確認されている対象国はDRCのみ。その他の国（ベルギー、フランス、UAE、トルコなど）は渡航による『輸入リスク予測』の対象であり、実際の発生地ではないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみ含める。ウガンダはサマリーで言及されているが対象国リストに含まれないため除外。高い致死率と国際的航空ネットワークを経由した拡大可能性は、パンデミック準備体制の強化を求める重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: the recovery rate estimated at 50% in Mambasa - ACP
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Mambasa health zone, Ituri province, north-eastern Democratic Republic of Congo. As of June 15, 2026, the recovery rate among Ebola-affected individuals in Mambasa is estimated at 50%, according to Dr. Abedi Yunga, chief medical officer. A patient is progressing well, suggesting survivors are possible with timely care. Late hospital presentation in other zones is linked to higher mortality. Residents are urged to seek healthcare promptly at first suspicious symptoms. Since the outbreak began, Mambasa has 12 suspected cases, including 3 confirmed cases and 1 death. The statement underscores that early medical attention improves survival chances during this Ebola outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ熱：マンバサでの回復率は50%と推定 - ACP
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱の確認された集団発生（DRC北東部イトゥリ州マンバサ地区で3確定例、1死亡）。IHR基準4項目すべてに該当する高リスクイベント。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱はIHR基準の全項目に該当する国際的公衆衛生上の脅威。DRCは過去複数回の大規模エボラ流行国であり、国際的警戒態勢が必要。遅発受診による死亡率上昇の懸念あり。
