article.articleHeadline: 旅行病毒｜去旅行小心中招！8大台灣/日本/韓國/東南亞當地病毒 感染恐致命 醫生教3招保命 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Travel Viruses: Be careful not to get infected when you travel! 8 Major Local Viruses in Taiwan, Japan, Korea, and Southeast Asia—Infections Could Be Fatal; Doctors Share 3 Life-Saving Tips | am730
article.articleSummary: Eight major local viruses across Taiwan, Japan, Korea, and Southeast Asia threaten travelers. In Northeast Asia (Taiwan, Japan, Korea), respiratory viruses—Influenza A and B, SARS-CoV-2—and adenovirus circulate; gastrointestinal viruses include norovirus and rotavirus; neurologic/child viruses such as enteroviruses (EV71) and measles; and hantavirus, linked to rodent exposures. In Southeast Asia (Thailand, Malaysia, Singapore, Indonesia, Vietnam, the Philippines, Cambodia, etc.), the mosquito-borne viruses predominate: dengue, chikungunya, Zika, and Japanese encephalitis virus; enteric viruses such as norovirus and hepatitis A; respiratory viruses similar to Northeast Asia; and rarer threats like avian influenza (H5N1) and Nipah virus. Travel advice emphasizes three measures: 1) research the destination’s circulating pathogens before departure; 2) masks, frequent handwashing, and mosquito protection; 3) prioritize protective actions suited to the regional risk profile, without overreliance on supplements.

triage.headline_ja: 旅行病毒｜去旅行小心中招！8大台灣/日本/韓國/東南亞當地病毒 感染恐致命 醫生教3招保命 | am730
triage.triage_reason: 記事は一般向けの旅行健康情報・啓発記事であり、特定の新規感染症イベント、集団発生、または急速な状況変化を報告していない。複数疾患の列挙は疾病サーベイランスの観点からは背景情報の範囲内であり、シグナルトリアージの基準を満たさない。
triage.notes: 本記事は旅行者向けの一般的な疾病啓発・予防ガイドであり、特定のアウトブレイク、確定症例数の増加、または急速な流行の進展を報告していない。韓国と日本の発生地域記載があるが、これらは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。複数の既知疾患が列挙されているが、記事サマリーには流行の現在進行中の悪化や新規の異常な発生を示す証拠がない。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: World Cup creates perfect conditions for infectious diseases to spread. Here are the biggest threats health experts are watching for
article.articleSummary: Measles surges across the United States, Canada, and Mexico as the 2026 FIFA World Cup unfolds in 16 North American cities, heightening crowd-related respiratory risks in stadiums, airports, and bars. As of June 4, 2026, U.S. measles cases reach 2,030 for the year; the 2025–2026 flu season was a 30-year high, and COVID-19 continues to drive 290,000–450,000 hospitalizations annually. Ebola Bundibugyo outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda prompted a May 2026 global health emergency; transmission requires bodily fluids, with no approved vaccines or treatments, and stadium transmission remains unlikely. The United States has entry bans and screening for travelers from affected areas; Mexico and Canada have restrictions. Mosquito-borne threats persist, including dengue (past US transmission, notably L.A.) and H5N1 avian influenza with 70 human infections since 2024; Oropouche virus sparked thousands of Latin American cases in 2024. No vaccines exist for some pathogens.

triage.headline_ja: ワールドカップは感染症の流行に完璧な条件をもたらす。保健専門家が注視している最大の脅威はこれだ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当（麻疹の米加墨での大規模流行、エボラ出血熱のDRC/ウガンダでの緊急事態、H5N1の人間感染、国際的拡大とワールドカップによる旅行制限リスク）。複数国での複合的な感染症危機が進行中。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは北米（米国、カナダ、メキシコ）での麻疹・インフルエンザ・COVID-19流行と、DRC/ウガンダでのエボラ・ブンディブギョ流行、H5N1人間感染を述べている。対象国リストではDRCのみ該当。エボラ出血熱の緊急事態宣言（2026年5月）、国際的な入国規制、ワールドカップによる大規模人口移動というコンテクストから、複合的な国際感染症危機として評価。

article.articleHeadline: Συναγερμός από τους Γιατρούς Χωρίς Σύνορα για τον Έμπολα στο Κονγκό: "Ο ιός εξαπλώνεται ταχύτερα από τις δυνάμεις ανάσχεσης"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors Without Borders warns of Ebola in Congo: "The virus is spreading faster than containment efforts."
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the Democratic Republic of Congo is spreading rapidly, warn Doctors Without Borders (MSF). One month after the outbreak was officially declared, MSF says the true scale remains unknown—not all zones where the virus circulates have been mapped. The current outbreak, the 17th in a country of about 100 million, is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus strain, for which there is no vaccine or approved treatment, complicating patient care. In North Kivu, only one laboratory analyzes blood samples, delaying results by days. WHO figures tallies: 782 cases and 181 deaths, but MSF says those numbers likely undercount. While hundreds of portable rapid tests have reached the eastern regions, insecure conditions prevent timely detection and isolation. WHO reports rising contact-tracing efficiency to about 70% from 45% earlier this month. MSF demands international mobilization to matched needs, echoing West Africa 2013-2016 criticism.

triage.headline_ja: 医境なき医師団がコンゴのエボラ警告：「ウイルスは封じ込め努力より速く拡大している」
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確。エボラウイルスのアウトブレイクは最高優先度のシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラアウトブレイク（第17波）、Bundibugyo ebolavirus株。オフィシャル発表から1ヶ月、782例782死亡（WHOデータ）。MSFは実数がより多いと警告。ワクチンなし。北キブ州のセキュリティ悪化が検査・隔離の遅延を招いている。西アフリカ2013-2016年の教訓を引き合いに国際的対応強化を要求。対象国リストにはAngola（アンゴラ）は含まれていないため verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: 「拡散を防ぐ支援が必要」エボラ出血熱対策トップがインタビュー、緊急事態宣言から1カ月
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Need for assistance to prevent the spread: Interview with the head of Ebola hemorrhagic fever countermeasures, one month since the state of emergency was declared.
article.articleSummary: One month after the WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern over Ebola virus disease in the eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) and neighboring Uganda, African Union Africa CDC Director Jean Kasaya urged international assistance to prevent further spread. In eastern DRC, 782 infections and 181 deaths have been reported; Uganda has 19 infections and 2 deaths. Kasaya warned that failure to contain could cause substantial damage beyond Africa, with potential costs running into billions if the outbreak reaches Japan. The AU Africa CDC and WHO estimate at least $500 million is required to contain the eastern Congo outbreak. Japan’s Ministry of Health says domestic risk remains low. The report notes the state of emergency was declared about one month ago, amid ongoing international concern and response efforts.

triage.headline_ja: 「拡散を防ぐ支援が必要」エボラ出血熱対策トップがインタビュー、緊急事態宣言から1カ月
triage.triage_reason: エボラ出血熱のWHO国際保健上の緊急事態宣言（PHEIC）から1ヶ月経過時点での進展報告。DRCで782感染・181死亡、ウガンダで19感染・2死亡を報告。IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）及びWPRO基準複数該当により、引き続きフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIの発生地域にJapan（1861061）が含まれているが、記事サマリー上ではDRCとウガンダでの実際の発生地域であり、日本は「潜在的リスク地域」として言及されているのみ。対象国リストにウガンダが含まれないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみ。WHO PHEIC宣言済みの既知イベントであるが、1ヶ月経過後の進展報告であり、継続的な監視とリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: BBC witnesses celebration in the epicentre of the outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak of Bundibugyo strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province, centered on Mongbwalu with a parallel focus in Rwampara. The outbreak has killed more than 140 people among confirmed Bundibugyo infections, with transmissions driven by contact with infected bodily fluids. The case of Daniel Kitambala, who spent about three weeks in a clinic before testing negative on two occasions, illustrates ongoing clinical recoveries; a 55-year-old pastor, Deogratias Kasereka, was the first patient to leave the centre a week earlier. The hospital says recoveries are rebuilding trust after violence and misinformation, including earlier arson of a treatment tent on May 21 and local myths such as the coffin curse. Initial tests were negative as investigators sought Bundibugyo; Mongbwalu recently gained a local lab returning results in a day, improving outbreak response. Five health workers have died, with several others infected.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染症アウトブレイク：BBCが感染拡大中心部での祝賀行事を目撃
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の全4項目に該当し、エボラウイルスの確認されたアウトブレイクで140名以上の死亡、隣国ルワンダへの拡大兆候、および国際的な懸念が高い。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州Mongbwaluを中心とするエボラ(Bundibugyo株)アウトブレイクを主題としている。発生地域にはルワンダも含まれるが、サマリーに明示的なルワンダでの患者情報がないため、verified_locationsにはDRCのみを記載。ただし、ルワンダとの境界地域（Rwampara）での並行的な感染の記述があり、今後の地理的拡大リスクは高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak strains health system in eastern Congo
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-15, an Ebola outbreak in Ituri province, eastern Congo, is stressing an already fragile health system in Bunia. Hospitals are overwhelmed or shut down after suspected Ebola infections, with frontline health workers racing to contain the virus. The report underscores the strain on medical facilities, limited capacity, and the urgent need for effective outbreak response in a conflict-affected setting. No specific case or death counts, laboratory confirmation details, infection source, or export/import cases are provided in the article. The situation highlights ongoing public health challenges in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo, where Ebola outbreaks occur amid security concerns and limited healthcare infrastructure.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行がコンゴ東部の医療制度に負担をかける
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラは高い致死性と感染性を持ち、紛争地域での発生は管理が困難であり、国際的な懸念の対象である。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は極めて高い致死率を持つ病原体であり、医療施設の過負荷と紛争地域での感染対策の困難さが報告されている。具体的な患者数・死亡数は記事に記載されていないが、歴史的に東コンゴのエボラ流行は多数の死亡と国際的な対応を要したため、本イベントは国際的関心事と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола может оказаться в Европе уже через месяц
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola could reach Europe within a month.
article.articleSummary: Japanese researchers modeled Ebola importation risk and found that infected travelers from African outbreak zones could reach major international hubs within 30 days. The analysis identified Belgium, France, South Africa, Kenya, and the United Arab Emirates as the most likely entry points, with worst-case probabilities of at least one infected arrival: Belgium 92%, France 91%, United Arab Emirates 88%, and Turkey 86%. The study evaluated 11,264 airports, 569,741 routes, and passenger flows totaling about 330 million people. Potential sources considered were the Democratic Republic of the Congo and Uganda. The work emphasizes that importation risk is not equivalent to local transmission risk and aims to support timely global monitoring. Congo has recently reported unprecedented Ebola spread.

triage.headline_ja: エボラはすでに1ヶ月以内にヨーロッパに到達する可能性がある
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの国際的拡大リスク（importation risk分析）が報告され、IHR基準の「国際的に拡大するリスク」と「渡航制限リスク」に該当。重大な公衆衛生上の影響の可能性があり、スクリーニング基準の複数項目も満たす。
triage.notes: 記事は日本の研究者によるエボラimportation riskモデル分析を報道している。複数国が言及されているが、実際の流行発生地はDRCとウガンダ（対象国外）。Belgium、France、South Africa、Kenya、UAEは予想される輸入リスク地点であり、実際の発症報告ではない。DRCのみが「最近、前例のないエボラの拡大を報告」との言及から verified_locations に含める。

article.articleHeadline: Surto de Ébola no Congo: mais de 70 novos casos confirmados num só dia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Congo: more than 70 new confirmed cases in a single day.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with more than 70 new confirmed cases in a single day and a total approaching 800 confirmed cases and over 180 deaths. Official figures are acknowledged as likely undercounted by the Congolese government due to areas affected by armed groups where disease data are hard to obtain, and remote communities with limited or no testing. The World Health Organization declared a global emergency about a month ago. The outbreak appears to be concentrated in three eastern provinces, with relatively low numbers in other regions. Despite the high mortality risk associated with this Ebola strain, transmission outside these provinces remains limited so far. The WHO maintains alert levels for the entire country and for neighboring nations.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ感染症：1日で70例以上の新規確認患者
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。WPRO基準5つすべて該当。WHOが1ヶ月前に国際的保健上の緊急事態を宣言し、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: DRCでのエボラ感染症アウトブレイク。180例以上の死亡、800例近い確認患者、1日70例以上の新規患者。WHO全体警報、国境諸国への警戒呼びかけ。武装勢力支配地域および遠隔地での過小計測の可能性あり。対象国DRC以外の隣接国（Zambia等）への拡大リスク有。

article.articleHeadline: كونغو تسجل زيادة قياسية في حالات الإيبولا خلال يوم واحد
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a record surge in Ebola cases in a single day.
article.articleSummary: The Democratic Republic of the Congo reports a record daily Ebola surge driven by Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Ituri Province, with 72 new cases in 24 hours, raising confirmed cases to 782 and deaths to 181 (including 29 new deaths). About 40 people have recovered; the outbreak’s current case fatality rate is 23%. Ituri accounts for over 90% of cases, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu and cross-border spread to Uganda. The outbreak was first confirmed on 15 May after weeks of suspicion, and contact tracing coverage stands at 56%—a sharp drop from the prior week—hampered by community resistance, rapid spread to new health zones, and large-scale mining-related movement. WHO is intensifying testing, contact tracing, and treatment; Africa CDC and partners are deploying expertise, labs, case finding, and community engagement, in a bid to stop transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国が1日でエボラ患者数の過去最高を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の急激な感染拡大、国際的な越境感染、高い致死率、管理能力の限界が明確であり、直ちにフルRRA対象。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーはウガンダへの越境感染の言及があるが、当該イベントの主要発生地はDRC（イトゥリ州及びキブ州）であり、本評価ではDRCのみを verified_locations に列挙した。ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。1日72人の新規患者、致死率23%、接触者追跡カバレッジの急低下（56%）は極めて深刻で、WHOおよびAfrica CDCの対応強化が進行中。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-uitbraak ernstiger dan gedacht door gebrek aan schoon water, vreest Oxfam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak more serious than thought due to lack of clean water, Oxfam fears.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, is now seen as more serious than the 2018 event due to scarce clean water and sanitation and disrupted health services. Clean water costs about $2 for 20 liters, with only ~20% of households having access to safe water and ~25% to functional sanitation. Contaminated water from mining-related pollution increases transmission risk. The outbreak lacks a vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, and contact tracing reaches fewer than half of contacts, a situation worsened by USAID’s withdrawal. Ongoing conflict has destroyed many health facilities, limiting care. As of 15 June 2026, the Congolese Ministry of Health reports 782 confirmed cases and 177 deaths, though Oxfam warns the true numbers may be higher. The CDC notes this is the largest outbreak of this Ebola form to date.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は飲料水不足により予想より深刻、オックスファムが警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の事象、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPROスクリーニング基準も全て該当。確認された死亡者数、感染症管理上の大きな課題、国際支援の必要性が明確。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、イベントはコンゴ民主共和国イトゥリ州で発生。782例の確認患者と177例の死亡（2026年6月15日時点）が報告されており、Bundibugyo ebolavirus型の過去最大規模の流行とのこと。飲料水・衛生施設の不足、保健施設の破壊、接触者追跡の不十分さ、USAIDの撤退により管理可能性が著しく低下している。ワクチン供給不足も指摘されている。

article.articleHeadline: Kongo Laporkan Lonjakan Kasus Ebola, 782 Orang Terinfeksi dalam Sebulan
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo Reports Surge in Ebola Cases, 782 People Infected in a Month.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has surged to 782 laboratory-confirmed cases and 181 deaths, with 29 new fatalities and a record 72 new cases in 24 hours. The outbreak, confirmed on 15 May 2026, could become one of the largest Ebola events on record. This episode is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, unlike the majority of DRC outbreaks historically due to Zaire ebolavirus. The case fatality rate is about 23%, and 40 patients have recovered. Contact tracing coverage is roughly 56%, down from the prior week, hindering containment. Health authorities report intensified surveillance and field investigations, and communities are reporting suspected cases as response teams investigate. The article does not provide details on the infection source or any imported/exported cases.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴがエボラ感染の急増を報告、1ヶ月間に782人が感染
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。782例、181死亡の急速な増加、Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模アウトブレイク、接触者追跡率の低下（56%）により国際的拡大リスクが高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による DRC でのアウトブレイクは過去の Zaire ebolavirus 流行と異なり、ウイルス学的に注目すべき。24時間で72新規症例（記録的規模）、接触者追跡率の低下は制御困難性を示唆。WHO への PHEIC 通知相当。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola: Largest ever outbreak of rare strain 'likely even greater' - and the 'first line of defence' has collapsed
article.articleSummary: DRC's Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak is the largest on record, with 781 confirmed cases and 181 deaths as of 13 June 2026, centered in Ituri province (epicentres including Mongbwalo and Ituru). The Bundibugyo strain has no licensed vaccine, making clean water and sanitation the critical first line of defence. Hygiene infrastructure has collapsed: in Mongbwalo, only 20% have clean water access and 25% sanitation; in Ituri, just 20% of health facilities have adequate clean water. Contact tracing has fallen to 43% coverage, far below the 2018–2020 level of 79%. US funding cuts have weakened surveillance, with DRC aid dropping to $1.4 billion in 2026 from $2.58 billion in 2024. Over 70 health facilities have been destroyed and 0.2 doctors per 1,000 people hindering response, with deaths reported in communities before case identification. Oxfam launched an $11.6 million, six-month program to provide clean water and hygiene kits for 200,000 people in Ituri.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱：稀な株の過去最大規模の流行「さらに大きい可能性」- 『最初の防衛線』が崩壊
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準5項目全て該当。対象国DRCでの確認済みイベント。
triage.notes: 記事はDRCのイトゥリ州中心のブンディブギョエボラの過去最大規模の流行を報告。781確認症例、181死亡。ワクチン未承認株、衛生インフラの崩壊、接触者追跡カバー率低下（43%）、米国資金削減による監視弱化、大規模な医療施設破壊が記載されている。公衆衛生学的に深刻で、国際的懸念が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in DR Congo: BBC witnesses celebration in the epicentre of the outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in north‑east Democratic Republic of Congo's Ituri province (epicentre, Mongbwalu) involving Bundibugyo species. More than 140 people have died in Ituri, with the outbreak declared just over a month ago and ongoing efforts to curb transmission. The virus has killed about one in five of those infected. A recovered patient, 49-year-old Daniel Kitambala, left a Congolese Ebola treatment centre after about three weeks with two negative tests confirming he is Ebola-free. Celebrations by around a dozen healthcare workers in green scrubs, singing as he exited highlight the recoveries possible amid the crisis. Authorities face challenges, including local myths such as the 'coffin curse' and beliefs that treatment centres are the problem, complicating outbreak control. Laboratory confirmation and continued monitoring remain essential to prevent further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ流行：BBCが流行の震源地での祝賀行事を目撃
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模流行（140人超の死亡、致死率約20%）であり、国際的拡大リスク・渡航制限リスクが高い。WPROスクリーニングでも全基準に該当し、シグナルとして識別される。
triage.notes: 記事はDRC北東部Ituri州のエボラ流行を主題としており、Bundibugyo種による約140人超の死亡が報告されている。罹患者の約20%が死亡し、局所的な迷信や治療センターへの不信感により制御が困難化している。急速な国際的拡大リスクと高い社会政治的関心があるためフルRRA推奨。

article.articleHeadline: El Congo eleva a 808 los casos de ébola confirmados, incluidas 192 muertes
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Congo raises the number of confirmed Ebola cases to 808, including 192 deaths.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 808 confirmed cases and 192 deaths as of June 15, 2026, with a case fatality rate of 23.8%. A total of 363 people are in isolation. The response continues across three northeastern provinces—Ituri (epicenter), North Kivu, and South Kivu—with 31 of 104 health zones affected. The outbreak was officially declared on May 15 in Ituri, a border region with Uganda and South Sudan, and has since spread to Kivu provinces. Surveillance remains critical as authorities monitor transmission and implement control measures. No details on imported or exported cases are provided in this report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、確認されたエボラ症例を808件に引き上げ、192人の死亡を含む
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、エボラの確認患者増加と死亡者数増加、国境地域での拡大リスク、および国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念があるため。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス疾患（EVD）のoutbreak。DRC内のIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu州の3つの northeastern provinces に拡大。Ituri州はUgandaおよびSouth Sudan との国境地域。死亡率23.8%、隔離中363人。2026年5月15日に公式宣言。Bluedot APIはUgandaおよびSudanを列挙しているが、記事サマリーでは「border region with Uganda and South Sudan」と記述されており、これらの国での実際の症例確認は明記されていない。したがって verified_locations はDRC（203312）のみとした。

article.articleHeadline: Face à Ebola Bundibugyo, le gouvernement intensifie la riposte dans l'Est de la RDC - LePotentiel
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Facing Bundibugyo Ebola, the government steps up its response in eastern DRC
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease continues in the eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with cases in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. As of June 15, 2026, the Ministry of Health reports 808 confirmed cases and 192 deaths, 363 patients in isolation (confirmed or suspected), and over 50 recoveries. In Kinshasa, authorities outlined surveillance, case management, and community outreach progress, while acknowledging ongoing challenges in population engagement and logistics. A key strategy is community engagement: 31 health zones are targeted, with a network of 1,200 trained community relays—about 1,000 deployed so far and expected to reach several thousand—conducting door-to-door surveillance, reporting deaths, and guiding patients to care. The case fatality rate stands at about 23%. Persistent logistical obstacles include insecurity, degraded roads, and long distances, though authorities say equipment is available and being deployed.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ ブンディブギョに直面し、政府がコンゴ民主共和国東部での対応を強化
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の確認症例808件、死者192件、高い致死率（23%）を示す重大事象。
triage.notes: エボラ ブンディブギョ種の発生。DRC東部（イトゥリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州）で確認症例が拡大。キンシャサでも当局が監視・対応を展開中。ウガンダは発生地域に含まれるが、記事サマリーの主題は DRC での発生であるため verified_locations に含めない。致死率23%、隔離患者363名、復帰者50名超の報告あり。ロジスティクス上の課題（不安定性、道路インフラ、距離）が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: PAHO urges countries to strengthen vaccination efforts as diphtheria cases rise in the Americas
article.articleSummary: 163 confirmed diphtheria cases and 5 deaths in the Americas in the first 21 weeks of 2026, spanning Brazil, Haiti, and Peru; Haiti accounts for 159 cases and all deaths. More than half the cases are in unvaccinated or vaccination-status-unknown individuals. Diphtheria is a bacterial infection transmitted via respiratory droplets, with a throat pseudomembrane and risks of severe airway obstruction and cardiac/nervous-system complications. DTP3 vaccination coverage fell to 87% in 2024, well below the 95% target; several countries report <80% coverage and high dropout between first and third doses. PAHO urges closing vaccination gaps through reinforced routine immunization, catch-up campaigns, microplanning to reach missed populations, and leveraging every health-system contact to verify vaccination status. Also calls for strengthened surveillance, rapid lab confirmation, maintenance of diphtheria antitoxin supplies, and health-worker training for outbreak response, aiming for 95% coverage of primary 3-dose series and boosters.

triage.headline_ja: 米州でジフテリア症例増加に伴い、PAHOが予防接種体制の強化を促呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: ジフテリアの複数国での多発事例（163確認症例、5死亡）であり、IHR基準「異常性」「国際的拡大リスク」および「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」のWPRO基準複数に該当。対象国ブラジルを含む多国間での発生。
triage.notes: 記事はハイチ、ペルー、ブラジルでのジフテリア多発事例を報告しており、PAHOが公式に対応呼びかけ。対象国のうちBrazilのみ該当。ハイチとペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため除外。ワクチン接種率低下（DTP3が87％で95％目標未達）と予防接種の不均等分布が根底にある。

article.articleHeadline: Over 5 Lakh To Receive Polio Drops On June 28 In Indore District
article.articleSummary: Polio immunisation campaign announced for Indore district, Madhya Pradesh, targeting 5,11,449 children under five on June 28. The Pulse Polio drive will begin with booth-based vaccination on day one, followed by door-to-door visits over the next two days. More than 3,600 booths and mobile teams will operate, supported by over 8,000 health workers and volunteers. Special focus includes migrant families, slums, construction sites, and nomadic communities, with transit booths planned at railway stations and bus stands. District Collector Shivam Verma chaired the Task Force meeting; Chief Medical and Health Officer Dr Madhav Prasad Hasani and District Immunisation Officer Dr Tarun Gupta provided details. Although India has been polio-free since 2011, cases in Afghanistan and Pakistan underscore the need for continued immunisation. Parents are urged to ensure every child receives the 'two drops of life'.

triage.headline_ja: インドレ地区で6月28日に51万人以上がポリオワクチン接種を受ける予定
triage.triage_reason: ポリオ予防接種キャンペーン実施の告知であり、疾患の発生・アウトブレイクではない。インドは2011年以来ポリオが発生していない。予防的公衆衛生活動のため、IHR基準およびWPRO基準のいずれも該当しない。
triage.notes: 記事はインドでのポリオ根絶キャンペーン（Pulse Polio drive）の実施予定を述べたもの。アフガニスタンとパキスタンでの症例が言及されているが、記事の主題はインドでの予防接種実施である。疾患の発生やアウトブレイク検知ではなく、計画的な予防活動であるため、シグナルトリアージの対象外。

article.articleHeadline: ஒரே மாஸ்க்... பலருக்கு சிகிச்சை... அரசு நெஞ்சக மருத்துவமனையில் நோய் பரவும் அவலம்
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Only one mask... treatment for many people... Alarm as disease spreads at the Government Chest Hospital.
article.articleSummary: Chennai's Sethupatti-area Government Chest Hospital sparked concern after reports that a single nebulizer mask is being reused for several patients undergoing airway-management treatment, risking cross-infection. Health authorities warned that shared equipment could fuel transmission of respiratory infections within the facility. The article does not specify a pathogen, case counts, or fatalities. No laboratory-confirmed details or infection source are provided. The incident underscores infection-control lapses in hospital settings and prompts calls for strict equipment sterilization and single-patient-use policies to prevent hospital-acquired spread. The report highlights public health vigilance in Tamil Nadu amid an ongoing anxiety over respiratory-disease spread at a major city hospital on 2026-06-16.

triage.headline_ja: チェンナイ政府胸部病院での単一ネブライザーマスクの複数患者への再利用による感染症拡大リスク
triage.triage_reason: 未特定の呼吸器感染症に関する院内感染制御の問題が報告されているが、具体的な病原体、症例数、死亡者が特定されていないため、情報不足により WATCH 段階での経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 本件は院内感染制御の不備を報告するシグナルであり、Unknown Illness として扱われているが、具体的な病原体の特定がない。チェンナイ政府胸部病院での不衛生な器具共有は呼吸器感染症の拡大につながる懸念があるが、確定症例数・死亡者・病原体が記事サマリーに記載されていない。続報で具体的な臨床診断や実験室確認情報が得られた場合は PICKUP への昇格を検討する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉确诊病例增至808例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in DR Congo rise to 808.
article.articleSummary: DR Congo reports 808 confirmed Ebola cases and 192 deaths as of 15 June 2026. In the last 24 hours, 26 new cases and 11 deaths were recorded. A total of 363 patients remain in isolation treatment, with 48 recoveries since the outbreak began. The response focuses on the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, declared on 15 May. The Ministry of Health continues containment efforts across the three affected regions. The brief does not specify clinical symptoms, laboratory confirmation details, transmission chains, or any imported/exported case events.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のエボラ確認患者数が808例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の大規模集団発生で、808例の確認患者と192例の死亡が報告されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響、国際的拡大のリスク、および渡航・貿易制限のリスクが存在する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模集団発生。2026年5月15日に宣言され、東部州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）で継続中。過去24時間で26新規患者、11死亡が記録。入院隔離患者363名、回復者48名。WHOおよび国際的な支援が必要と判断される。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola-uitbraak ernstiger dan gedacht door gebrek aan schoon water, vreest Oxfam
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak more serious than previously thought due to a lack of clean water, Oxfam fears.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Ituri Province, Democratic Republic of the Congo, centered in the region as the largest Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak on record. As of Monday afternoon, the Congolese Ministry of Health reported 782 confirmed cases and 177 deaths; the CDC also notes it is the biggest outbreak of this Ebola form. Oxfam warns the figure likely undercounts the true scale due to water and sanitation gaps. Only about 20% of health facilities have access to clean water, and roughly 20% of people can obtain clean water, with around 25% having functional sanitation. Water costs about $2 for 20 liters, pushing families to use water contaminated by mining discharges. The outbreak is considered more severe than the 2018 event, in part because geopolitics limit aid and there is no vaccine for Bundibugyo ebolavirus, hindering contact tracing and response.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行は清潔な水の不足により予想より深刻—オックスファムが懸念
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。さらにWPRO基準も複数該当（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ、管理可能性）。DRCでのエボラ・ブンディブギオ出血熱の大規模流行として、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: DRCイトゥリ州における過去最大規模のエボラ・ブンディブギオ出血熱流行。確認症例782件、死亡177件（記事配信時点）。水・衛生インフラの著しい不足が拡大を加速させている。ワクチン未開発であり、地政学的障害も対応を困難にしている。高度なリスク評価が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Selon Oxfam, l'ampleur de l'épidémie d'Ebola serait sous-estimée
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: According to Oxfam, the scale of the Ebola outbreak would be underestimated.
article.articleSummary: Outbreak: Ebola Bundibugyo in the Democratic Republic of Congo, with Oxfam warning the scale is underestimated. In Ituri’s Mongbwalo, only 20% have potable water and 25% functioning WASH, amid mining-runoff contamination that jeopardizes transmission control. Across Ituri and Nord-Kivu, more than 70 health facilities have been destroyed by conflict, and frontline staff lack adequate PPE; safe waste management is scarce. The CDC confirms this is the largest Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak on record; the DRC Ministry of Health reports 781 cases and 182 deaths across 25 health zones, though the toll may be higher. No approved vaccine or treatment exists for Bundibugyo; contact tracing stands at 43%, far below 2018–2020 levels (about 79%). Global humanitarian funding for DRC fell 46% to about $1.4 billion in 2026, with local NGOs receiving under 6% of funds, hampering response and enabling home care and transmission.

triage.headline_ja: Oxfamによればエボラ感染症の流行規模は過小評価されている
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当。Bundibugyo Eボラの過去最大規模流行が、極めて限定的な対応能力（ワクチン・治療なし、接触者追跡43%、健康施設70以上が破壊）の中で進行中。国際的支援の緊急性が高い。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Eボラは過去最大規模（781例、182死亡）。承認済みワクチン・治療薬がなく、接触者追跡率43%で著しく低い。水・衛生インフラ破壊（Ituri州のMongbwaloで飲料水20%、WASH機能25%）が感染抑制を阻害。紛争による健康施設破壊70以上、PPE不足が対応能力を著しく低下させている。グローバル人道支援が46%削減された状況下での流行拡大は、地域および国際的なリスクが極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Ituri : le nouveau gouverneur militaire prend ses fonctions avec un double front, sécurité et Ebola
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ituri: the new military governor takes office with two fronts, security and Ebola.
article.articleSummary: Ituri, Democratic Republic of the Congo, installs Gaby Kasongo Mulumba in Bunia to lead on two fronts: security and Ebola response. Appointed June 5, he succeeds Lt-Gen Johnny Luboya Nkashama, who has led under a state of siege since May 2021; extension was renewed on June 14. Mulumba urged peace through collaboration with residents beyond armed action and asked journalists to mobilize against the outbreak, stressing that the disease exists and awareness must be raised. The Ebola outbreak, caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, was declared May 15 and designated a WHO PHEIC on May 17. As of June 12, 710 confirmed cases and 149 deaths (21% CFR) were reported across 29 health zones in three provinces, with Ituri bearing most cases. Security risks persist: ADF in Irumu, CODECO in Djugu; Nord-Kivu faces AFC/M23 advances, prompting MPs from Ituri and Nord-Kivu to suspend parliamentary participation on June 13.

triage.headline_ja: イトゥリ州：新しい軍事知事が2つの課題（安全保障とエボラ対応）で職務に就く
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の継続的なアウトブレイク（710確認患者、149死亡）、WHO PHEIC指定、複数州への国際的拡大リスク、および治安悪化による公衆衛生対応への脅威が存在する。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo型）の現在進行中のアウトブレイク。2026年6月15日配信の記事であるが、報告されている統計（2026年6月12日時点で710確認患者、149死亡、21% CFR、29保健地域）は時系列上の矛盾がないことを確認。治安悪化（ADF、CODECO、M23）がアウトブレイク対応を複雑化させている点が重要。複数州（イトゥリ、北キヴ、カサイ）への広がりが報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Scale of Ebola virus outbreak likely under-estimated - Oxfam
article.articleSummary: As of 13 June 2026, Bundibugyo Ebola outbreak in the DRC is the largest on record, with 781 confirmed cases and 182 deaths across 25 health zones. Ituri province’s Mongbwalo town shows dire water and sanitation gaps—only 20% have clean water and 25% to functional hygiene infrastructure; mining runoff compounds transmission. In North Kivu, deaths occur before patients are identified. There is no licensed vaccine or approved therapy for the Bundibugyo strain, heightening reliance on water, sanitation, and behavior change. Contact tracing is 43.2% (8 June), far below the ~79% reached one month into the 2018 outbreak. Global humanitarian funding has fallen 46% since 2024 to $1.4B in 2026; local NGOs receive under 6% of funds, constraining prevention and response. Oxfam’s $11.6M six-month intervention targets 200,000 people with water, hygiene kits, and community awareness, but funding remains insufficient.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルス勃発の規模が過小評価されている可能性 - オックスファム
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目全て該当。最大規模のブンディブギョエボラ勃発（781確定例、182死亡）、水・衛生インフラ不備、接触者追跡の低迷、ワクチン・治療法の不在により、深刻な公衆衛生影響と国際的拡大リスクが認められる。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo Ebola strain（記録上最大規模：781確定例、182死亡）、Ituri州を含むDRCの複数地域で発生。水・衛生インフラの著しい不備（清潔な水20%、衛生施設25%）、接触者追跡率の大幅な低迷（43.2% vs. 2018年の79%）、ライセンス承認ワクチン・治療法の不在が対応能力を大きく阻害している。国際的支援の必要性は極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: Congo ghi nhận số ca nhiễm Ebola mới cao kỷ lục
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo records a record-high number of new Ebola cases.
article.articleSummary: 72 new Ebola cases were reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo in 24 hours on June 14, raising confirmed cases to 782. Africa CDC Director Dr. Jean Kaseya said more than 24,000 people have been contacts traced. The outbreak is among the most severe; in one month it has climbed to the third-deadliest Ebola outbreak on record. U.S. CDC collaborators’ transmission-models warn the outbreak could continue and potentially approach the scale of the 2014-2016 West Africa epidemic, which infected about 28,600 people and killed 11,300. This outbreak is caused by the Bundibugyo ebolavirus, a rare strain not tested early in the outbreak. The Zaire ebolavirus is more common and has a vaccine, and has caused 16 previous outbreaks in DRC. A Bunia orphanage case saw a newborn die two weeks after the mother’s death from Ebola; four nuns caring for the infant are now infected.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者数が過去最高を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルスの急速な拡大、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、および渡航制限の可能性がある。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当。
triage.notes: 2026年6月16日報告のDRC におけるエボラアウトブレイク。24時間で72例の新規感染者が報告され、確定患者数782例に達している。Bundibugyo ebolavirus（稀な株）による感染で、月単位で3番目に致死的なアウトブレイクへ急速に拡大。U.S. CDC の予測モデルでは2014-2016年西アフリカエピデミックの規模に接近する可能性を警告。孤児院での新生児死亡事例など、医療機関・福祉施設への拡大が確認されており、管理能力の懸念が高い。Angola は発生地域リストに含まれるが、記事サマリーではDRC での発生が主題であり、Angola での確認情報は記載されていないため、verified_locations には含めていない。

article.articleHeadline: للمرة الـ17 "إيبولا" تضرب الكونغو.. تقرير دولي: الدولة تسجل ثالث أكبر تفشي للفيروس بـ181 وفاة خلال شهر.. "انقذوا الأطفال": تداعيات خطيرة للمرض.. وتؤكد: بعض المناطق تعاني من نقصٍ حاد في الإمدادات المنقذة للحياة - اليوم السابع
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: For the 17th time, Ebola hits the Democratic Republic of the Congo. An international report: the country records the third-largest outbreak of the virus with 181 deaths in a month. "Save the Children": serious consequences of the disease, and it confirms: some areas suffer from a severe shortage of life-saving supplies - The Seventh Day.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo reaches a third-largest on record, with 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths, according to the Republic's Ministry of Health. Declared May 15, the crisis has intensified, with children most affected: at least 52 children infected in the month after declaration, including 16 infants, and 19 child deaths. Severe shortages of life-saving supplies—PPE, disinfectants, safe isolation spaces, and essential medicines—hinder diagnosis, treatment, and infection control. Data from the African CDC show children under 14 have higher mortality than older patients, more than doubling the fatality risk compared with those 15–44. Fear and misinformation reduce care-seeking and contact tracing and threaten safe burials. Save the Children warns this is not only a health emergency but a broader social crisis for families and communities, amid a wider humanitarian need in eastern DRC of about 15 million people.

triage.headline_ja: 第17回目のエボラ発生、コンゴ民主共和国を襲う：国際報告書では3番目に大きいアウトブレイク、1ヶ月で181人の死亡を記録。「子どもを救え」：深刻な病気の影響、一部地域では生命救助用物資の深刻な不足を確認
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準において4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目全て該当。エボラ出血熱という高リスク病原体、782確認例・181死亡、特に小児への深刻な影響、医療体制の崩壊的状況により、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は最高リスク病原体。本アウトブレイクは既に宣言済み（5月15日）で、記事配信時点（2026年6月）で進行中。782確認例・181死亡、小児への特異的な影響（16乳児含む52小児感染、19小児死亡）、医療資源の極度の不足（PPE、消毒薬、隔離設備、医薬品）が報告されている。東部DRCの1500万人規模の人道的危機と相まって、国際支援の緊急性が高い。

article.articleHeadline: Doença silenciosa acende alerta em bairros populares de Salvador | A TARDE
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Silent disease raises alarm in Salvador's working-class neighborhoods | A TARDE
article.articleSummary: Silent circulation of Trypanosoma cruzi, the parasite causing Chagas disease, identified in urban Salvador, Bahia, Brazil, specifically in Alto do Cabrito and Marechal Rondon, with Pau da Lima showing no positives. A Fiocruz Bahia study published in Acta Tropica analyzed serum from 290 dogs using ELISA with recombinant chimeric antigens and found antibodies in 9 dogs (5.1%) across Alto do Cabrito and Marechal Rondon; 113 dogs in Pau da Lima were negative. Seropositive dogs were aged 5–15 years (median 8.5). Findings suggest cumulative exposure and localized transmission rather than active human infection, and are preliminary due to small sample sizes. Dogs may serve as sentinels to identify human transmission risk in urban, socioeconomically vulnerable communities, underscoring the need for surveillance and vector-control efforts in Salvador.

triage.headline_ja: ブラジル・サルバドルの貧困地域でシャーガス病の警告が高まる
triage.triage_reason: ブラジルの都市部でシャーガス病の無症状循環が確認されたが、現在のところ人間への活発な感染は確認されていない。犬における血清陽性率は低く（5.1%）、サンプルサイズが小さいため、IHR基準およびスクリーニング基準の複数該当は限定的である。ただし、公衆衛生的な監視価値があるため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事はブラジル・バイア州サルバドルの都市部でのシャーガス病原虫（トリパノソーマ・クルージ）の無症状循環を報告。犬血清調査により局所的伝播パターンが示唆されているが、人間への活発な感染は確認されていない。社会経済的に脆弱なコミュニティでの監視・ベクター制御の必要性を強調。El Salvadorは記事サマリーの主題ではなく、地理情報フィールドに誤って含まれている可能性があるため除外。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉确诊病例增至808例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases rise to 808 in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has reached 808 cumulative laboratory-confirmed cases, with 192 deaths, as of June 15. In the past 24 hours, 26 new confirmed cases and 11 more deaths were reported. Currently, 363 patients are in isolation treatment, and 48 have recovered since the outbreak began on May 15. The response remains focused on the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus. The data indicate sustained transmission in the three affected provinces, underscoring the ongoing need for intensified surveillance, patient isolation, contact tracing, and supportive care to curb further spread.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確診病例が808例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当し、大規模なエボラ流行で国際的な懸念が高い。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度、流行可能性、管理可能性の複数基準に該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模流行。808例の確診例、192人の死亡、過去24時間で26例新規確認。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu三州での継続的な伝播。国際的な公衆衛生上の緊急事態に該当し、フルのRapid Risk Assessment推奨。

article.articleHeadline: Waspada Parasit pada Ikan Mentah Belajar dari Kasus Sashimi di Hong Kong
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Be wary of parasites in raw fish: learning from a sashimi case in Hong Kong.
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-16, a video showing a linear worm crawling out of kinmedai sashimi at a Hong Kong sushi restaurant went viral, prompting a report to local food-safety authorities and renewing concerns about raw seafood safety. IPB University lecturer Dr. Karina Rahmadia Ekawidyani warns that consuming raw fish without stringent safety procedures poses real parasite infection risks to humans. Infections can cause gastrointestinal symptoms and, if chronic, may lead to serious organ complications. The article emphasizes adherence to food-safety standards to kill parasite larvae through proper handling, storage, and processing in restaurants. It also urges consumer education and cooking for vulnerable groups, such as children and the elderly. Environmental sanitation, including standard septic-tank wastewater management, is highlighted to prevent parasite eggs from contaminating aquatic ecosystems. A combined effort—strict restaurant standards, informed consumer choices, and good sanitation—can significantly reduce health risks from seafood.

triage.headline_ja: 生魚の寄生虫に注意：香港の寿司事件から学ぶ
triage.triage_reason: Unknown Illness としての分類が不適切であり、実質的には食品安全に関する教育記事。個別の健康危機というより予防啓発が主眼。香港での寄生虫検出は記録されているが、大規模流行の兆候がなく、国際的拡大リスクも現時点では限定的。
triage.notes: 記事は香港での単一事例（寿司レストランでの線虫検出）を基に、一般的な食品安全と寄生虫リスクに関する教育記事。疾患名が'Unknown Illness'と分類されているのは不正確。香港の事例は存在するが、大規模な集団発生や公衆衛生上の緊急事態の証拠はない。インドネシアのメディアによる記事だが、サマリーの主眼は香港の事件と予防啓発にあり、インドネシアでの具体的な患者発生は記述されていない。

article.articleHeadline: Patiala Hepatitis A outbreak: All five water samples fail quality test
article.articleSummary: Patiala's Hepatitis A outbreak in Dogra Mohalla has 30 residents affected, with five water samples from the outbreak hotspot failing quality tests and testing positive for E. coli, indicating mixing of faecal matter in the drinking water. Civil surgeon Dr. Shelly said water supply was restored after leakages were plugged, and fresh sampling plus door-to-door surveys will identify suspected patients; no new jaundice cases have been reported. The Patiala Municipal Corporation reports ongoing repairs due to multiple illegal connections from the main supply line, with a plan to lay a new pipeline stalled by resistance. The issue centers on leakages from illegal connections; municipal commissioner Paramjit Singh was transferred, and Pooja Syal has taken charge. Health minister Balbir Singh criticized the corporation.

triage.headline_ja: パティアラのA型肝炎アウトブレイク：5つの水質サンプルすべてが品質テストに不合格
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準2つ以上該当（重症度のある感染症、水系感染の異常性）かつ、WPRO基準複数該当（異常な事象、長期曝露リスク、流行可能性、管理可能性）。公衆衛生インフラの問題（水道水汚染）に関わるシグナルとして識別。
triage.notes: 記事はパティアラ（インド・パンジャブ州）のA型肝炎アウトブレイク（30人が罹患）と水道水汚染（E. coli検出、糞便汚染の証拠）を報告。公衆衛生当局が関与し、水道インフラの不正接続と漏水が根本原因。継続的な曝露リスクと市政上の責任転換が報道されている。

article.articleHeadline: Ngộ độc nghi do ăn cơm nhiễm khuẩn salmonella
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Suspected Food Poisoning from Eating Rice Contaminated with Salmonella
article.articleSummary: Suspected Salmonella food poisoning with bacteremia and septic shock occurred in a 66-year-old Vietnamese woman, Uyển, in Ho Chi Minh City. Blood culture confirmed Salmonella infection. She presented with fever 38.5°C, tachypnea, hypoxemia, and hypotension (77/37 mmHg), consistent with septic shock requiring fluids, vasopressors, antibiotics, and intensive care. The source was linked to rice stored overnight in the refrigerator and not reheated thoroughly; she eats brown rice as part of a diet, and family members did not share symptoms. She has long‑standing rheumatoid arthritis treated with immunosuppressants, increasing susceptibility to invasive Salmonella infection. After several days of therapy and supportive care, she recovered and was discharged. The clinician advised proper cooking-to-storage practices, prompt refrigeration, and thorough reheating of leftovers. Elderly adults with chronic diseases or immunosuppression should seek early hospital care if nausea, vomiting, abdominal pain, diarrhea, fever, or hypotension occur.

triage.headline_ja: 疑い：サルモネラ菌に汚染された米を食べた食中毒
triage.triage_reason: 孤発の重症食中毒事例であり、集団発生ではない。患者は既に回復し退院している。地域的な公衆衛生脅威としての拡大リスクは低い。
triage.notes: 単一患者の孤発事例。患者は免疫抑制状態（リウマチ性関節炎で免疫抑制薬使用）で、家族への伝播なし。食品管理対策のための教育的記事性が中心。集団流行や国際的脅威の要素はない。

article.articleHeadline: WHO Weekly Situation Update on Ongoing Health Emergency Events in South Sudan - Week #: 23; Date: 12th June 2026 - South Sudan
article.articleSummary: South Sudan has no confirmed Ebola Virus Disease (EVD) cases but remains at high risk of importation from the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo (DRC). As of 12 June 2026, DRC reports 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths (CFR 20%), with 30 recoveries across 26 health zones in 3 provinces; Uganda records 19 cases (14 imported, 5 locally acquired) and 2 deaths, with 5 recoveries and 12 admissions as of 11 June. Fifteen priority counties for enhanced preparedness include Tambura, Ezo, Nzara, Yambio, Ibba, Maridi, Yei, Morobo, Juba, Torit, Magwi, Kajo-Keji, Budi, Kapoeta South. Preparedness activities: enhanced surveillance and screening of 49,366 travelers at JIA, Nimule, Kaya, Lasu-Libogo, Yei Airstrip, Yambio; zero-reporting. RCCE trained 250 people, six radio talk shows, National Call Center (666). IPC/SDB: 70 IDU trained, 150 SDB personnel; EVD guidelines and SOPs; PPE verified. Lab/logistics: real-time surveillance analytics; prepositioned PPE, reagents, and VHF kits to support response.

triage.headline_ja: 南スーダンにおける進行中の保健衛生緊急事態イベントに関するWHO週間状況報告書 - 第23週、2026年6月12日 - 南スーダン
triage.triage_reason: DRC発のBundibugyo型エボラウイルス病が確認されており、南スーダンは高いリスク下にあるため国際的な懸念が該当。DRC内で676例の確認例と高い死亡率を報告しており、域内での流行の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRC由来のBundibugyo株エボラの確認事例が記述されており、南スーダンは高リスクの輸入国として位置付けられている。DRC内での676確認例、136死亡（CFR 20%）は深刻な状況を示唆。南スーダン自体の確認例は報告されていないが、15の優先郡での警戒態勢強化が進行中。Bluedot APIの「発生地域」フィールドに南スーダンを含む複数国が列挙されているが、サマリーの主要イベント（Bundibugyo-strain outbreak）はDRCが震源地のため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。

article.articleHeadline: OPS emite alerta epidemiológica por circulación de difteria en las Américas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO issues an epidemiological alert due to diphtheria circulation in the Americas.
article.articleSummary: An epidemiological alert from PAHO (OPS) warns of diphtheria circulation in the Americas. As of 2026, 163 confirmed diphtheria cases and 5 deaths have been reported across the region, with Haiti, Peru, and Brazil most affected; Honduras has not reported cases to date but remains at risk due to declining vaccination coverage and pockets of unvaccinated individuals. Diphtheria is caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae and primarily infects the throat and upper airways, producing a toxin that can affect the heart (myocarditis) and peripheral nerves. Transmission occurs via direct contact or inhalation of droplets from coughs or sneezes; severe disease can form a membranous pseudomembrane that obstructs the airway. PAHO urges member states to achieve at least 95% vaccination coverage using the primary three-dose DPT series and boosters (three doses), and to strengthen surveillance, outbreak monitoring, contact tracing, and assessment of vaccination impact.

triage.headline_ja: PAHO、米州におけるジフテリア循環について疫学的警告を発令
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。複数国での確認・死亡報告があり、地域的流行警告が発せられている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではハイチ、ペルー、ブラジルが最も影響を受けていると述べられているが、ペルーとハイチは評価対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsはBrazilのみとした。ホンジュラスは対象国ではなく、スペイン領カナリア諸島は対象国外。PAHOの公式警告であり、社会政治的関心が極めて高い。

Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N8

article.articleHeadline: В Гонконге проводят проверки на рынках после заражения ребенка птичьим гриппом
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong conducts market checks after a child contracted avian influenza.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong's Centre for Health Protection confirms a two-year-old boy contracted avian influenza A(H9N2); authorities conduct market checks and advise caution. Laboratory analyses identified the infecting strain as low-pathogenic avian influenza A(H9N2). The boy was likely infected several days ago at Wo Che Market. CHP collected 17 samples from the patient's home, the market, and Fung Wo Park; one sample from a market chicken tested positive for A(H9N2). The patient remains stable; none of his six family members have symptoms. Local outbreak risk is assessed as low, though officials urge ongoing vigilance: maintain personal hygiene, avoid contact with live poultry or its droppings, thoroughly cook poultry and eggs, and wash hands after visiting live-poultry markets. Since 1999, Hong Kong has recorded 11 H9N2 infections (5 local, 6 imported) with no fatalities; global cases have caused deaths. Children, the elderly, and those with chronic diseases are at higher risk.

triage.headline_ja: 香港で子どもが鳥インフルエンザに感染後、市場での検査を実施
triage.triage_reason: 2歳児への H9N2 ヒト感染確認は異常・予想外であり、市場での環境検査で陽性サンプル検出されたため WPROスクリーニング基準（異常性、流行可能性）に該当。香港での公衆衛生上の関心も高い。
triage.notes: 香港での H9N2 ヒト感染はまれだが、過去に同地域で 11 例記録されており、低病原性株とはいえ市場での動物検査で陽性が判明したため継続監視が必要。患者の症状は安定し家族内発症なし。香港は中国の一部のため verified_locations に China を含める。

article.articleHeadline: Superfood Supplement Powder Linked to Active Multistate Salmonella Outbreak, Exposing Health Risks Many Buyers Do Not Know About
article.articleSummary: Multistate outbreak of Salmonella Typhimurium and Newport linked to moringa leaf powder supplements; 88% of ill individuals interviewed reported moringa product use before illness. June 3, 2026 update notes 20 new illnesses since January 15, with recalls expanding. Traceback links two recalled products—Live It Up Super Greens powder and Why Not Natural Pure Organic Moringa Green Superfood capsules—to a single upstream moringa leaf powder producer. The outbreak underscores DSHEA (1994) gaps: supplements do not require FDA pre-market safety review; recalls occur after link confirmation. Moringa leaf powder is produced mainly in India, the Philippines, Senegal, and Ethiopia; dried powder can harbor Salmonella and persist shelf life. Symptoms: diarrhea, fever, abdominal cramps, vomiting 12–72 hours after exposure; most healthy adults recover in 4–7 days; severe cases require hospitalization for vulnerable individuals. Consumers should discard recalled products and check FDA recalls; those who bought moringa powder since January 2025 should monitor symptoms and seek care if illness develops.

triage.headline_ja: スーパーフード補充粉末がマルチステート・サルモネラ（Salmonella）アウトブレイクに関連、多くの購入者が知らない健康リスクを露呈
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で「異常性」と「国際的拡大リスク」が該当（2/4）。複数州にまたがるサルモネラアウトブレイク、国際的なサプリメント製品流通、インド・フィリピンを含む複数国での原料生産により国際的な食品安全問題へ発展の可能性が高い。
triage.notes: 記事は米国を中心としたマルチステート・アウトブレイクについて記述しているが、対象国リストに照らし合わせると、インド・フィリピン・セネガル・エチオピアが原料生産国として言及されている。対象国のうち、インドとフィリピンのみが適格。本イベントは国際的食品流通網における感染症伝播リスクを示唆し、FADAレコールと並行した監視が必要。疾患名にパラチフス（Paratyphoid）が含まれているがサマリーではサルモネラに焦点が当たっているため、臨床診断の確認が推奨される。

article.articleHeadline: 染疫童證患H9N2禽流感　13接觸者「全陰」大流行風險低
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Infected child diagnosed with H9N2 avian influenza; 13 contacts all negative; low risk of a pandemic.
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reports a 2-year-old boy infected with low-pathogenic avian influenza A(H9N2). Thirteen close contacts tested negative; no evidence of human-to-human transmission, and local pandemic risk remains low; no mass culling of live poultry planned. Centre for Health Protection confirms the virus is entirely avian-origin, with no reassortment or mutations detected. H9N2 is enzootic and of low pathogenicity, posing limited local health risk. Risk assessment remains unchanged; the influenza pandemic contingency plan stays at the alert level. Public health actions include medical surveillance of close contacts, epidemiological investigation, and environmental disinfection; 17 environmental samples collected, 15 negative, 2 pending. Vaccination messages urge timely influenza and COVID-19 immunization, given low uptake among 6 months–2 years (27%) and initial COVID-19 doses (<4%). Travelers should heed international disease risks, including measles outbreaks abroad (UK, Spain, parts of Asia), ensure vaccination, and allow two weeks for protection. Summer increases flu and COVID-19 activity; monitor mosquito-borne diseases in SEA regions.

triage.headline_ja: 感染した児童がH9N2鳥インフルエンザと診断、13名の接触者「全員陰性」、パンデミックリスク低い
triage.triage_reason: H9N2低病原性鳥インフルエンザの人間感染例であり異常・予想外の事象であるが、接触者全員陰性でヒト-ヒト感染なし、当局により低リスク評価されており、現時点では追加情報待機を要する。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン・英国の麻疹流行にも言及しているが、主題はHong Kong（中国）のH9N2ケースである。低病原性、ヒト-ヒト感染なし、接触者陰�性という情報から当面のリスクは低いと評価されているが、鳥インフルエンザの人間感染事例であり引き続き注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Dans l'ombre de l'épidémie, un outil innovant accélère la riposte à Ebola en Ituri
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: In the Shadow of the Outbreak, an Innovative Tool Accelerates the Ebola Response in Ituri.
article.articleSummary: In Ituri, Democratic Republic of Congo, the Ebola outbreak caused by Bundibugyo virus is being monitored with the RadiOne diagnostic platform at Mongbwalu’s improvised lab, delivering molecular results in under an hour. Supported by UK FCDO, WHO, the World Bank, INSP, and INRB, the decentralization of diagnostics brings testing to Bunia and Mongbwalu, near affected communities, shortening from a 2,000-kilometer sample journey to Kinshasa to same-day results and faster response. Four local technicians were trained in biosafety and sample handling to operate the system. In Bunia, results in one hour improve early treatment; daily testing capacity has risen from 30 to 80 tests, aided by a standard RT-PCR platform. Plans extend to Aru, Nyankunde, Beni, and Butembo, strengthening surveillance. Since May 15, 40 patients have recovered; authorities stress that Ebola can be treated and vigilance remains essential.

triage.headline_ja: Ituri地域のエボラ対応を加速させるイノベーティブなツール
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上に該当（公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）。エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo株）による確認された流行であり、WPROスクリーニング基準複数該当。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスBundibugyo株によるIturi地域での流行。複数の国際機関（WHO、世銀、UK FCDO等）が関与し、診断能力強化のための技術導入が進行中。40名の回復報告あり、検査体制の拡張計画あり。

article.articleHeadline: 港浸大发现中药提取物 可抑制埃博拉、禽流感等病毒
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Traditional Chinese medicine extracts discovered by HKBU can inhibit Ebola, avian influenza, and other viruses.
article.articleSummary: On June 15, 2026, Hong Kong Baptist University’s School of Chinese Medicine announced researchers extracted antiviral lignan compounds from Rue plants (Ruta spp.), showing activity against multiple zoonotic viruses. The compounds inhibit acidification of intracellular organelles, blocking viral entry into host cells and preventing replication, enabling broad-spectrum antiviral effects. Targets include avian influenza virus, Ebola virus, and novel coronavirus, with additional activity against vector-borne pathogens such as dengue fever, Japanese encephalitis (epidemic encephalitis B), and Zika virus. Team leader Zhang Hongjie, vice dean of the school, says this supports developing traditional Chinese medicine–based, safe, affordable antiviral strategies. Potential applications include animal health products—feed additives and antiviral veterinary drugs—and groundwork for future human antivirals, leveraging Rue plant extracts to combat evolving viral threats.

triage.headline_ja: 香港浸会大学が発見した中医薬抽出物、エボラ、鳥インフルエンザなどのウイルスを抑制可能
triage.triage_reason: 本記事は感染症の新規発生報告ではなく、中医薬由来の抗ウイルス化合物の研究成果に関する発表である。実際の患者発生、流行の兆候、または公衆衛生上の急性事象を報告していない。
triage.notes: 本記事は香港浸会大学による基礎研究成果の発表であり、シグナルトリアージの対象外。疾患リストに複数の病原体が含まれているが、これらは研究対象の病原体リストであって、実際の発生報告ではない。EBS監視システムが誤抽出した可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: สสจ.ยโสธร สรุปสาเหตุ ทำครู-นักเรียน ท้องร่วงรุนแรง จำนวน 267 คน
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Yasothon Provincial Public Health Office concludes the causes of severe diarrhea among teachers and students, affecting 267 people.
article.articleSummary: Foodborne illness outbreak at Municipal School 3, December 5, Yasothon City Municipality, Thailand, affected 267 students and staff after lunch on June 9, 2026 (outbreak recognized by June 10). By June 15, 2026, 129 had sought care at Yasothon Hospital; 55 were admitted (inpatients) and the remainder outpatients, with nearly all patients recovered and discharged except one still hospitalized. Symptoms included high fever, diarrhea, vomiting, and abdominal pain. Investigations by the Yasothon Provincial Public Health Office, in coordination with Yasothon Hospital, Disease Control Office 10 (Ubon Ratchathani), and the municipality identified the lunch menu, 'khao moo daeng' (rice with red pork), as the likely source. Laboratory testing detected contamination with Salmonella spp., Aeromonas spp., Enteropathogenic Escherichia coli (EPEC), and Enterotoxigenic Escherichia coli (ETEC) at multiple school locations (kitchen floor, containers, and food/urine? equipment). The outbreak is linked to this meal and affected a school cohort in Yasothon Province.

triage.headline_ja: ヤソートン県公衆衛生事務所が教職員および学生の重症下痢の原因を結論 267人が影響
triage.triage_reason: 学校給食由来の限定的な食中毒アウトブレイク（267人、1施設）であり、既に原因特定と環境調査が完了している。IHR基準は最大1～2個の該当に留まり、国際的拡大リスクは低い。ただし複数の病原体検出と初期段階の対応状況から経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 学校給食関連の限定的アウトブレイク。Salmonella、Aeromonas、EPEC、ETECが検出されているが、発生源（学校厨房）は既に特定・隔離されている。患者のほとんどが回復・退院済み（1人入院継続）。既にタイ当局が対応中のため、フルRRAの優先度は低い。ただし複数病原体の同時検出は確認価値があり、WATCH段階での継続観察が適切。

article.articleHeadline: Эбола на подлете: вирус проникнет в Европу за 30 дней с вероятностью 90%
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola on approach: the virus will penetrate Europe within 30 days with a 90% probability
article.articleSummary: Ebola hemorrhagic fever import risk to Europe is evaluated by a Japan-based study, suggesting that infected travelers from Africa (notably Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo) could reach major air hubs within 30 days. Estimated import probabilities: Belgium 92%, France 91%, United Arab Emirates 88%, and Turkey 86%, with the overall 30-day European import risk around 90%. The researchers emphasize these are preliminary estimates for timely global monitoring and that import risk does not equal immediate local transmission risk. Africa’s Ebola outbreaks are rising, with the Democratic Republic of Congo reporting 181 deaths to date. The World Health Organization has ruled out likely spread to Europe. In Russia, Health Minister Mikhail Murashko claimed a vaccine exists to address a new Ebola strain. The article highlights ongoing African transmission and the potential for imported cases despite current European containment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ接近中：ウイルスが30日以内にヨーロッパに侵入する確率は90%
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、かつエボラ出血熱という国際的に重要な感染症の国際拡大リスクが具体的に評価されている。WHO通知相当の高リスクイベント。
triage.notes: 記事は日本の研究に基づいたエボラの国際輸入リスク評価である。DRCおよびウガンダでのアウトブレイク（DRC181死亡）が報告されており、DRCは対象国リストに含まれるため verified_locations に含める。ウガンダは対象国リストにないため除外。WHOが欧州への拡大は低いと評価しているが、研究では30日以内の輸入リスク90%と指摘されており、国際的な懸念が高い。複数国への潜在的な旅行輸入リスクが具体的に数値化されている。

article.articleHeadline: 多人被蜱虫叮咬 已出现死亡病例 警惕发热伴血小板减少综合征
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Many people bitten by ticks; deaths have occurred; be vigilant for Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome.
article.articleSummary: Tick bites have surged with fatalities reported for Severe Fever with Thrombocytopenia Syndrome (SFTS) in China. As of June 16, 2026, tick activity is at a peak in North China, Central China and East China, with April–September being the active period. Beijing residents have encountered ticks in the wild; some bite victims have contracted SFTS. Ticks are small arachnids that can swell after feeding and are common in warm, damp grasslands, shrubs, and leaf litter, posing risks during outdoor activities, dog walking, and child play. Since April this year, SFTS transmitted by ticks has been classified as a Class B notifiable infectious disease, prompting intensified prevention and control. Notably, a 67-year-old rural woman in Hebei contracted SFTS after a tick bite, with delayed medical care leading to multi-organ failure, shock, and death within 9 days. Tick exposure also linked to pet dogs and Inner Mongolia grasslands; urban green spaces may harbor ticks.

triage.headline_ja: 多くの人が蜱虫に咬まれ、死亡例が発生 — 重症熱性血小板減少症候群に警戒を
triage.triage_reason: SFTS（重症熱性血小板減少症候群）は中国で死亡例を伴う流行を示しており、IHR基準2つ以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）に該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度・流行性・管理上の懸念が認められるため。
triage.notes: SFTS（SFTSV）は人獣共通感染症で、蜱虫媒介による流行。記事は中国の複数地域（北部・中部・東部中国）での発生を述べており、季節的ピーク（4～9月）と死亡例が確認されている。4月より中国でClass B感染症に指定されていることから、政府の関心・対応が高い。国際的拡大リスクについては記事に明示的な記載なし。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola Cases Top 800 in Congo as Aid Groups Warn Outbreak May Be Larger Than Reported
article.articleSummary: Ebola in eastern Democratic Republic of Congo has surpassed 800 confirmed cases, with aid groups warning the outbreak may be larger than reported as treatment centers become overwhelmed and health workers struggle to trace transmission chains. A month after the outbreak was declared, responders face mounting pressure to identify and isolate cases amid stretched resources. The warning came ahead of an emergency summit of African leaders, underscoring concerns about surveillance and the pace of transmission in the affected provinces. International aid networks are coordinating support, but the surge highlights significant challenges in data collection, contact tracing, and maintaining patient care in the crowded treatment facilities.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴではエボラ患者が800人を超え、支援団体は実際の感染者数がより多い可能性があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO基準も5つすべて該当。エボラウイルス感染症は最高リスク病原体であり、確定患者800人超、治療施設の機能不全、接触者追跡の困難、アフリカ指導者緊急首脳会談開催など、即座にフルRRA（Rapid Risk Assessment）を実施すべきシグナル。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス感染症は国際保健規則（IHR 2005）の指定感染症。確定患者800人超、治療施設の過満員状態、接触者追跡の困難性、アフリカ連合首脳会談開催予定など、複数の深刻な警告信号が存在。実際の患者数が報告数より大幅に多い可能性が指摘されている点が特に懸念される。東コンゴ地域での発生であり、隣接国への波及リスクも考慮が必要。

article.articleHeadline: American doctor who recovered from Ebola back in U.S., says he's "feeling well" - AOL
article.articleSummary: American doctor Dr. Peter Stafford, who contracted Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Congo while on a humanitarian mission, has returned to the United States and says he is feeling well after recovery. Stafford, his wife Rebekah, and their four children arrived back in the U.S. on Monday; he has been Ebola-free since May 30. They were evacuated to Berlin for care on May 20 and discharged June 6. Rebekah and the children quarantined with him never developed symptoms. Other missionaries with Stafford have also been released from care. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Congo—also spreading to Uganda—had 782 confirmed cases and 178 deaths in Congo as of Saturday, and 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths in Uganda as of Sunday. The strain is less common than Zaire and currently has no vaccines or treatment.

triage.headline_ja: エボラから回復した米国人医師、米国に戻り「体調は良好」と述べる - AOL
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス（Bundibugyo型）による進行中の流行がコンゴ・ウガンダで継続中（782確定症例、178死亡）であり、IHR基準「公衆衛生への深刻な影響」「国際的拡大リスク」「予想外性」に該当。WPROスクリーニングでも「重症度」「流行しやすさ」「管理可能性」が確認され、シグナル基準を満たす。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーより、Bundibugyo ebolavirus流行の主要発生地はコンゴ及びウガンダ。対象国リスト内ではDRCのみ該当。米国への医師帰国は個別事例の報道だが、背景にあるコンゴ・ウガンダの流行状況が継続中で重要。ワクチン・治療法がない株であることが追加的なリスク要因。

article.articleHeadline: Be vigilant against leptospirosis, Ernakulam health department urges public
article.articleSummary: Leptospirosis risk rising in Ernakulam district, KOCHI, during the monsoon. The district health department reports 10 confirmed and 9 suspected leptospirosis cases in the first 13 days of June. Transmission occurs via direct contact with contaminated soil and stagnant water; the bacteria can enter through cuts, abrasions, cracked skin, insect bites, and soft skin areas. To prevent infection, officials advise wearing gloves, waterproof footwear, and rain boots when entering muddy or waterlogged areas. Symptoms include severe fatigue, calf muscle pain, headache, fever, and back pain; anyone with these symptoms and exposure should seek prompt medical care. Do not self-medicate; inform healthcare providers of exposure to contaminated soil or water. Public should remain vigilant during monsoon and follow protective measures.

triage.headline_ja: レプトスピラ症に対する警戒呼びかけ、エルナクラム保健局が市民に警告
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーラム州での確認症例と疑い例の報告があり、モンスーン期の感染リスク上昇が指摘されているが、現在のところ死亡情報や全国的拡大の兆候がなく、情報が限定的であるため経過観察段階が適切。
triage.notes: 6月前半13日間で確認10例、疑い例9例の報告。モンスーン期における環境リスク（汚染土壌・停滞水）が継続するため長期曝露の可能性あり。ただし、致死率、入院率等の重症度情報、全国規模での拡大兆候が記載されていないため、現段階ではWATCH判定。続報で症例数の増加トレンド、重症化事例、地域外への波及情報に注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Hari Dengue Sedunia, Pengendalian Vektor dan Deteksi Dini Jadi yang Utama
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: World Dengue Day: Vector Control and Early Detection Are the Main Priorities.
article.articleSummary: World Dengue Day highlights vector control of Aedes aegypti and early detection of dengue. Globally, about 5.6 billion people are at risk, with dengue spreading to roughly 130 countries and an estimated 100–400 million infections annually. In Indonesia, as of 14 April 2026 there were 30,465 dengue cases and 79 deaths (case fatality rate 0.3%), incidence 10.6 per 100,000. The cases comprise 10,138 dengue fever, 19,877 dengue hemorrhagic fever, and 450 dengue shock syndrome, reported across 401 districts/cities in 29 provinces; deaths occurred in 58 districts/cities in 20 provinces. Prevention centers on vector control per WHO Global Vector Control Response 2017–2030 and the Global Arbovirus Initiative, with emphasis on early clinical management. The observance traces to Jakarta, which hosted the ASEAN Dengue Conference in June 2011 and launched the Jakarta Call for Action on Combating Dengue and ASEAN Dengue Day on June 15, 2011.

triage.headline_ja: 世界デング熱の日：ベクター制御と早期検出が主要な優先事項
triage.triage_reason: インドネシアにおけるデング熱の継続的な流行を報道する記事だが、記事の主眼は「世界デング熱の日」の啓発キャンペーンであり、新規のアウトブレイク報告ではない。ただし感染症流行状況を示す情報として経過観察の価値がある。
triage.notes: 記事はインドネシアにおけるデング熱の現状（2026年4月14日時点で30,465例、79死亡例）を記述しており、WPROスクリーニング基準の重症度（DHF例の割合が高い）、長期曝露（29州401地区で報告）、流行しやすさ（Aedes aegyptiベクターの存在、広範な地理的分布）の3基準に該当する。しかし記事の主眼は啓発キャンペーンであり、新規アウトブレイク報告ではないため、PICKUP基準には達しない。スクリーニング基準複数該当かつ公開・政府関心がある点から、WATCH判定とする。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉确诊病例增至808例 疫情持续蔓延
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola confirmed cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 808; outbreak continues to spread.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (Bundibugyo ebolavirus) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo continues to spread, with total confirmed cases reaching 808 and 192 deaths as of June 15, per the Ministry of Health. In the past 24 hours, 26 new confirmed cases and 11 new deaths were reported. A healthcare worker in Bunia, Ituri Province, transported a suspected case to a treatment center, underscoring ongoing transmission in eastern DRC. Currently, 363 patients remain in isolation or treatment, and 48 have recovered since the outbreak began on May 15. The response centers on Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu provinces. The outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus and remains concentrated in eastern provinces; no imported/exported cases are noted in the report.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確認患者が808例に増加、疫情が継続して拡大
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準の4項目すべて該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、予想外の急速拡大、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。WPRO全基準該当。エボラウイルス病の急速な増加は国際的に重大な関心事項。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus (EBO-BU)による急速な患者数増加（24時間で26例新規確認）。東部DRC（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu州）に集中。医療従事者の感染報告あり。5月15日発症開始から約1ヶ月で病勢急速拡大。国境を有する周辺国への拡大リスクが存在。

article.articleHeadline: 刚果（金）埃博拉确诊病例增至808例
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Confirmed Ebola cases in the Democratic Republic of the Congo rise to 808.
article.articleSummary: As of June 15, 2026, the Democratic Republic of the Congo reports 808 laboratory-confirmed Ebola cases and 192 related deaths in its current outbreak, with 26 new cases and 11 deaths recorded in the last 24 hours. A total of 363 patients remain in isolation, and 48 have recovered since the outbreak began. The transmission is occurring in the eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu, and the outbreak is caused by Bundibugyo ebolavirus, officially declared on May 15, 2026. No additional details on the infection source are provided in the report; health authorities continue active control and isolation measures in the affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ確定患者が808例に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全てに該当。大規模なエボラアウトブレイク（808例、192死亡）であり、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクを伴う重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo ebolavirus による大規模アウトブレイクが2026年5月15日に公式宣言。東部3州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）での地域感染が継続中。24時間で26例の新規確定患者と11死亡が報告されており、感染拡大の勢いが続いている。WHO通知義務基準を明らかに満たす案件。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola dan Potensi Risikonya bagi Piala Dunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak and its potential risk to the World Cup.
article.articleSummary: Ebola Virus Disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri Province, with cases in North and South Kivu; cross-border spread to Uganda) raises a limited risk to the 2026 FIFA World Cup in the United States, Mexico, and Canada. As of 14 June 2026, 782 confirmed cases and 181 deaths reported; 72 new cases in 24 hours. Ituri accounts for ~90% of cases. Ebola spreads via direct contact with bodily fluids, not airborne. WHO, CDC, and PAHO say host-country risk is low but not zero. About 6.5 million spectators are expected over 39 days for 104 matches; airports are screening travellers. National teams have prepared via medical committees and hospital readiness; training since 2015 has produced thousands of health workers. World Cup preparedness includes MERS outbreak simulations and enhanced clinician guidance; travel restrictions apply to non-citizens with recent exposure to affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の流行とワールドカップへの潜在的リスク
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目以上（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、782例・181死亡の大規模流行かつ国境越え拡大の報告があるため、フルRRA進行が必要。
triage.notes: DRCのIturi州とNorth/South Kivu州での大規模エボラ流行（782例・181死亡、72例/24時間）およびウガンダへの国境越え拡大が記事の主題。2026 FIFAワールドカップ開催国（USA、Mexico、Canada）への限定的リスク言及があるが、記事サマリーはDRCでの実際の流行に焦点。MERSは流行シミュレーションの文脈でのみ言及されており、記事の主疾患はエボラ。対象国リストではDRC のみ該当。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus kematian Ebola di Kongo mencapai 192
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Congo reaches 192.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has reached 192 deaths among more than 808 confirmed cases, according to the DRC Ministry of Health on Monday, June 15, 2026. The ministry reported 26 newly confirmed cases and 11 Ebola-related deaths on Sunday, with an estimated case fatality rate of 23.8%. On May 15, 2026, the World Health Organization declared the Ebola outbreaks in the DR Congo and Uganda a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, citing a high risk of cross-border spread. The figures indicate ongoing transmission within the region and underscore the continued severity of the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ死亡者数が192人に達する
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。WHOが5月15日にPublic Health Emergency of International Concern (PHEIC)を宣言した現在進行形のエボラアウトブレイク。死亡者192人、確認症例808人以上と重大な公衆衛生上の影響があり、DRCとウガンダでの国際的な越境拡大リスクが明記されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCとウガンダの両国が言及されているが、ウガンダ（1269750など対象国リストに含まれない）はサマリー上でも越境拡大の文脈でのみ記載されており、主題は発生地のDRCである。WHOのPHEIC宣言（5月15日、2026年）により、国際的な関心と支援ニーズが確実に存在する。確定情報としてDRCのみをverified_locationsに列挙。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1
Human Infection with Swine Influenza A H1N1

article.articleHeadline: विषाणूजन्य साथींचा धोका अजूनही...; २०२६मध्ये आरोग्यतज्ज्ञ कोणत्या विषाणूंवर लक्ष ठेवून आहेत?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The threat of viral outbreaks still persists...; which viruses are health experts monitoring in 2026?
article.articleSummary: Influenza A, especially H5N1 bird flu, remains a top 2026 threat as climate change, urbanization, and travel boost human exposure to evolving viruses. The pandemic-era swine-origin H1N1 caused over 280,000 deaths in 2009 and still circulates. H5N1, first detected in humans in southern China (1997), re-emerged in 2024 in livestock in the United States, spreading to other animals, raising concern that mutations could enable human-to-human transmission; current vaccines may not protect against H5N1. Mpox has spread worldwide beyond previous regions, with new cases outside endemic areas. Oropouche virus, transmitted by biting insects, is expanding across the Americas; symptoms include fever, headache, myalgias, and sometimes prolonged weakness; no specific treatment or vaccine. Chikungunya spreads globally; measles rising due to waning vaccination; HIV resurgence risk persists with aid disruptions. Travelers and travel drive these threats, underscoring need for new vaccines and antivirals.

triage.headline_ja: ウイルス性疾患の脅威はまだ存在する...; 2026年に保健専門家はどのウイルスに注視しているか?
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤なウイルス性疾患（H5N1鳥インフルエンザ、Mpox、Oropouche等）の世界的脅威に関する警告記事であり、異常性・重症度・流行性の観点からWPRO基準を複数満たすが、具体的な新規患者発生または集団発生の記述がなく、むしろ2026年の脅威予測に関する専門家コメンタリーであるため、引き続き情報収集が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は複数のウイルス性疾患の世界的脅威に関する2026年の専門家予測であり、H5N1は1997年に中国南部で初めてヒトで検出され、2024年に米国の家畜で再出現した歴史的背景を述べている。Mpoxの世界的拡大、Oropoucheの米州での拡大、麻疹やHIVの増加リスクなど、複数の多地域的脅威が記述されている。ただし、具体的な現在進行中の爆発的発生の詳細（患者数、死亡数、特定地域の集団発生など）が不足しており、むしろ予測・警告記事の性質が強い。対象国リストでは中国のみが直接言及されているが、記事全体は全地球規模の脅威評価であるため、検証された発生地域は限定的。

article.articleHeadline: DR Congo's quiet Ebola front races to contain virus
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in DR Congo, with Ituri Province as the epicenter and spread to South Kivu (Lwiro) and North Kivu. As of 2026-06-16, total confirmed cases in DR Congo reach 782 with 181 deaths; three cases (one death) confirmed in South Kivu. In Lwiro Hospital, two confirmed and two suspected cases are under care, including a newborn ~2 weeks old and a 1-year-3-month-old separated from their mothers. A mobile molecular biology laboratory has been deployed in Miti-Murhesa to speed diagnostics, shortening time from sample collection to results. The response faces security hurdles due to M23 rebel control, with an Ebola burial team attacked in Katana, underscoring risks of unsafe burials. Emphasis remains on safe burials, contact tracing, and early isolation to prevent cluster expansion and wider transmission.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国の静かなエボラ前線、ウイルス封じ込めに競争
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準も5つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の複数地域への拡大、高い死亡率、国際的拡大リスク、深刻な公衆衛生への影響が認められる。
triage.notes: 記事はコンゴ民主共和国（特にIturi Province、South Kivu、North Kivu）でのエボラ病の多地域同時流行を報道。確認例782件、死亡181件という高い死亡率。セキュリティ上の課題（M23反政府勢力による干渉）が対応を困難にしており、管理可能性に懸念あり。新生児を含む易感染性集団への感染確認も重大。

article.articleHeadline: केरल: शिगेला से 7 साल के बच्चे ने तोड़ा दम, 2 और मौतों से मरने वालों की संख्या हुई 5
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Kerala: 7-year-old child dies of Shigella, death toll rises to 5 with two more deaths.
article.articleSummary: Kerala reports 5 deaths from Shigella as of 16 June 2026, with two additional fatalities confirmed on Monday. A 7-year-old boy, Arjav, from Pookkottur, Malappuram, admitted on 12 June with fever and diarrhea, tested positive for Shigella and died during treatment at Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital. A 43-year-old man from Kodkara, Thrissur, died on 13 June due to Shigella infection. Eight new Shigella cases were reported on Monday from Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam, Thrissur, Malappuram, Kannur, and Kozhikode, raising this year’s total to 147 cases, with 71 in June. Shigellosis is caused by Shigella bacteria, presenting with diarrhea, fever, and abdominal cramps, and spreading through contaminated food, water, or close contact. Health authorities have intensified surveillance and urge strict hygiene, safe drinking water, and prompt medical care for fever, diarrhea, vomiting, or blood in stool.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州：シゲラ菌感染症で7歳の子どもが死亡、2人の追加死亡で死亡者数が5人に上昇
triage.triage_reason: シゲラ菌感染症による複数死亡（5人）、短期間での急速な症例増加（147例、うち6月に71例）、複数地域への拡大が報告されており、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）および WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行性）の複数項目に該当。フルリスク評価への進行が必要。
triage.notes: ケーラ州内の複数地域（Thiruvananthapuram、Kollam、Thrissur、Malappuram、Kannur、Kozhikode）での並行発生を確認。2026年6月中旬時点で71例が6月に集中発生しており、短期間での急速拡大が懸念される。衛生当局による積極的なサーベイランスと対策が実施中。人為的水・食料汚染による集団感染の可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases in DRC rise to 782 with 181 deaths
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease (EVD) in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) has risen to 782 confirmed cases, including 181 deaths, as of 16 June 2026. Authorities report 72 new confirmed cases in the past 24 hours, all in Ituri Province, the outbreak’s primary epicenter. The outbreak remains confined to three eastern provinces: Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The update lists only case counts and geographic locations for the latest additions, with Ituri continuing to bear the heaviest transmission. No additional clinical details, laboratory methods, or vaccination information are provided in this brief update. The geographic concentration in Ituri underscores persistent transmission in eastern DRC, with no indication of spread to other regions in this report.

triage.headline_ja: DRCのエボラ出血熱患者数が782人に増加、181人が死亡
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病の確認症例782件（死亡181件）はIHR基準3項目（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度と流行可能性が認められる。DRCにおける重大な感染症の継続的な拡大であり、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱は国際的に重大な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、死亡率が高く（現在23.1%）、DRC東部3州（イトゥリ、北キブ、南キブ）に限定されているが継続的な拡大傾向を示している。72時間以内に新規確認例が急速に増加していることから、リアルタイムの監視体制が必要。対象国リストにDRCが含まれており、アフリカ地域での重要なシグナル。

article.articleHeadline: Число случаев заражения Эболой в ДРК возросло до 808, число погибших -- до 192
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The number of Ebola cases in the DRC has risen to 808, and the death toll has risen to 192.
article.articleSummary: 808 confirmed Ebola cases and 192 deaths reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo as of 16 June, per the Ministry of Health. On Sunday, 26 new confirmed cases and 11 deaths were recorded, raising the case fatality rate to 23.8%. Among the affected, 363 patients are in isolation and 48 have recovered since the outbreak began. Response efforts continue in Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu. The outbreak, officially declared on 15 May, is caused by Ebola virus Bundibugyo. Kinshasa issued the operational update; data reflect confirmed cases reported by the Ministry through the Sunday update. No symptoms details or laboratory confirmation information are provided in the article.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ感染者数が808人に、死亡者数は192人に増加
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスの大規模集団発生で、IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限のリスクが明確である。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスBundibugyo（致命率23.8%）による進行中の大規模集団発生。Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivuの3州で対応継続中。2026年5月15日に公式宣言。WHO通知またはフルRRA実施の対象。

article.articleHeadline: OPS insta a países a reforzar vacunación ante aumento de casos de difteria en Américas
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: PAHO urges countries to strengthen vaccination amid rising diphtheria cases in the Americas.
article.articleSummary: During the first 21 weeks of 2026, the Americas reported 163 confirmed diphtheria cases and 5 deaths, more than double 2025 and well above recent years’ averages. Brazil, Haiti, and Peru reported cases, with Haiti accounting for 159 cases and all deaths. Over half of confirmed cases occur in people who are unvaccinated or have unknown vaccination status. Diphtheria vaccination (DTP3) coverage has fallen from 88% in 2023 to 87% in 2024, below the 95% target; several countries remain under 80% and there are widespread dose dropouts between first and third doses. PAHO/OPS urges strengthening routine immunization, catch-up vaccination, and surveillance, rapid laboratory confirmation, and sustained antitoxin supplies; trains health workers for outbreak detection and response. Diphtheria is caused by Corynebacterium diphtheriae, spread via respiratory droplets, and can cause a dangerous throat pseudomembrane with risk of airway obstruction, heart and nerve damage, and death. Most at risk are unvaccinated.

triage.headline_ja: PAHOが米州のジフテリア症例増加に対応し、各国に予防接種強化を促す
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響・異常性・国際的拡大リスク）、WPROスクリーニング基準で複数項目該当、米州での多国間流行と死亡報告により、フルRRA実施が必要。
