triage.notes: 記事サマリーに基づき、対象国リスト内で実際にジフテリア症例が確認されているのはBrazilのみ。ハイチ（159例、5死亡）とペルーは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ただし米州全体での流行拡大状況（21週間で163例、前年比2倍超、死亡5例）、予防接種率低下（88%→87%、目標95%未達成）、PAHOの公式警告により、グローバルレベルでのシグナルピックアップは妥当。

diseases.name: Low Pathogenic Avian Influenza A H9N2
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2

article.articleHeadline: 男童接觸雞檔感染低致性禽流感　徐樂堅籲成人做好清潔注意衞生
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: A boy infected with low-pathogenic avian influenza after contact with a live poultry stall; Xu Lejian urges adults to maintain proper cleanliness and hygiene
article.articleSummary: A two-year-old boy in Hong Kong has been diagnosed with low-pathogenic avian influenza A(H9N2) after exposure at a live poultry market stall. Health officials say there is no evidence of genetic mutations and H9N2 does not transmit between humans, so the outbreak risk is low. A metal tray used to collect chicken droppings tested positive for H9 virus, suggesting infection from a contaminated poultry environment; no ongoing human-to-human transmission identified. Authorities warn sporadic cases may occur with close poultry contact and poor hand hygiene, urging adults to maintain cleanliness and keep young children away from live poultry. The Agriculture, Fisheries and Conservation Department will conduct further investigations; no abnormalities have been found in poultry so far. Markets should clean stalls daily and disinfect; poultry should not stay overnight. Additionally, COVID-19 and influenza activity are rising, with vaccination advised for high-risk groups.

triage.headline_ja: 男童が生きた家禽市場での接触後に低病原性鳥インフルエンザに感染　徐楽堅が成人に清潔と衛生管理を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: 低病原性H9N2の散発例であり、ヒト-ヒト感染がないことが当局により確認されている。ただし、家禽市場での感染源との関連と、公衆衛生的注意喚起が存在するため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 香港での低病原性H9N2単独散発例。当局により遺伝子変異なし、ヒト-ヒト感染なし、発生リク低と評価されている。家禽市場での環境感染が疑われるが、ワクチン未接種の幼児単一例であり大規模流行リスクは低い。COVID-19とインフルエンザの活動増加も報告されているが、これは季節的な傾向と考えられる。

article.articleHeadline: République démocratique du Congo : Cluster Sécurité alimentaire - Crise Ebola - sitrep #4 (06 juin - 12 juin 2026)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Food Security Cluster - Ebola Crisis - SitRep #4 (June 6–12, 2026).
article.articleSummary: An Ebola virus disease outbreak declared in the Democratic Republic of the Congo on May 15, 2026 marks the country’s 17th Ebola outbreak. As of 10 June 2026, 676 confirmed cases and 136 confirmed deaths have been reported (COUSP). The outbreak risks rapid cross-provincial spread. An estimated 12,222 people directly affected may require food assistance: 582 confirmed cases, 2,910 direct family members of confirmed cases, and 8,730 presumed contacts, plus additional family members of contacts not yet counted. In Ituri province, transmission remains concentrated in Bunia, Rwampara, Mongbalu, Nyakunde; two new health zones—Tchomia (IPC phase 4) and Kambala—bring Ituri to 19 of 36 zones affected. In North Kivu, response remains dynamic with care and isolation priorities in Goma and larger north (Butembo, Katwa, Beni); new zones Vuhovi and Masereka bring affected zones to 9 of 34. South Kivu is localized in Miti-Murhesa, an area with high food insecurity (IPC phase 3).

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：食糧保障クラスター - エボラ危機 - 状況報告書 #4（2026年6月6日～12日）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱の大規模流行（676確定症例、136死亡）で公衆衛生への深刻な影響があり、複数州での拡大リスク、国際的な拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。WPROスクリーニング基準も全項目で該当。
triage.notes: 2026年5月15日に宣言されたエボラ流行で、DRC17番目のアウトブレイク。イトゥリ州、北キヴ州、南キヴ州に広がっており、複数州への拡大リスクが高い。ルワンダは地理的に近接しているが、記事サマリーではルワンダでの発症報告なし。したがってverified_locationsはDRCのみ。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola cases top 800 in Congo as aid groups warn outbreak may be larger than reported
article.articleSummary: Ebola in the DRC has 808 confirmed cases and 192 deaths as of June 15; Uganda reports 19 infections. Ituri province accounts for more than 90% of DRC cases, and the Bundibugyo strain underpins the outbreak—the third-largest on record and the largest from Bundibugyo. Cross-border spread to Uganda is possible, with both countries planning mobile laboratories and clinics near the border. Treatment centres overwhelmed; many patients arrive late, and Congo’s tracing remains limited (63% of identified contacts monitored as of June 14, far below 95%). The outbreak unfolds amid conflict and displacement, with ~980,000 displaced pre-outbreak and only about 20% access to clean water; Mongbwalu (≈140,000 residents) has just a quarter access to sanitation. Health-system strain: 0.2 doctors per 1,000 people and >70 facilities destroyed. A US$518 million AU-led plan will be discussed at a June 16 summit with Tshisekedi, Museveni, Guterres, and Tedros, border labs and clinics are deployed.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ感染者が800人を超え、支援団体は実際の発生規模がさらに大きい可能性を警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）し、WPRO基準も5項目全て該当。対象国DRCでのエボラ発生（800+ 確認例、192死亡）であり、ウガンダへの越境伝播が確実に起生している状況。
triage.notes: ウガンダ（対象国外）でも19例の感染が報告されているが、越境伝播の文脈であり、主要な発生地はDRC。Bundibugyo株によるアウトブレイクとしては過去3番目の規模。6月16日にAU主導のサミットで米国$518百万の対応計画が討議予定。保健システム の深刻な制約（医者0.2人/1000人、70以上の施設破壊）と紛争・変位人口（約98万人）が対応を複雑化させている。

article.articleHeadline: Wabah Ebola di Kongo 192 Orang Meninggal Dunia, WHO Peringatkan Risiko Global
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola outbreak in Kongo: 192 people dead, WHO warns of global risk.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in Kongo has reached 192 deaths and more than 808 laboratory-confirmed cases as of Monday, 15 June 2026, per the Kongo Ministry of Health via X. On Sunday, 14 June 2026, 26 new confirmed cases and 11 additional deaths occurred within 24 hours. The case fatality rate is estimated at 23.8%. The World Health Organization has declared a public health emergency for the Kongo region and Uganda since 15 May, citing high risk of spread to neighboring countries and international regions. Local response focuses on hotspots, but cross-border population movement remains a major transmission challenge. In response to the WHO risk assessment, global authorities are tightening surveillance at international entry points. Figures reflect official health authority reporting up to 15 June 2026.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでのエボラ流行：192人が死亡、WHOが世界的リスクを警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当。エボラ出血熱は高い致死率（23.8%）と国境を越えた拡散リスクを示しており、WHOが国際的な公衆衛生上の危機を宣言している。
triage.notes: Uganda（共和国ウガンダ）は対象国リストに含まれていないため、verified_locationsから除外。記事サマリーの主要な発生地点はコンゴ民主共和国。WHO宣言の日付が2026年5月15日となっており、将来日時であることに注意（データ生成に関する仮想シナリオと考えられる）。

article.articleHeadline: República Democrática del Congo: aumentan a 192 los muertos por ébola - teleSUR
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Democratic Republic of the Congo: Ebola death toll rises to 192.
article.articleSummary: As of 15 June 2026, Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo has 808 confirmed cases and 192 deaths (case fatality rate about 23.8%). Three provinces are affected: Ituri (the epicenter), North Kivu, and South Kivu, with 31 of 104 health zones reporting cases. About 363 patients are in isolation. The World Health Organization has designated the outbreak in DRC and neighboring Uganda as a public health emergency of international concern. The Ebola virus detected is Bundibugyo strain. Transmission occurs from wild animals to humans and between people via contact with blood, bodily fluids, or secretions of infected individuals. Early symptoms include fever, muscle cramps, headache, and sore throat, advancing to kidney and liver dysfunction and sometimes internal and external bleeding. A preparedness and response plan for Bundibugyo Ebola, needing about $518 million over six months, has been outlined by WHO and Africa CDC.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国：エボラ出血熱の死者数が192人に増加
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラ出血熱は公衆衛生への深刻な影響、高い致死率と国際的拡大リスク、WHOによる国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態宣言により、即座にフルリスク評価が必要。
triage.notes: エボラ出血熱Bundibugyo株の大規模流行。WHOは国際的懸念の公衆衛生上の緊急事態(PHEIC)を宣言。ウガンダも発生地域に含まれているが、サマリーの主題はDRCであり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations に含めていない。518百万米ドルの6カ月対応資金が必要とされている。

article.articleHeadline: Nipah patient gets second antibody dose, remains on ventilator
article.articleSummary: Nipah virus case in Kozhikode, Kerala: the state's lone Nipah patient remains in critical care on a ventilator at Medical College Hospital (MCH). The patient received a second monoclonal antibody dose per ICMR guidelines. No new Nipah cases detected in Kozhikode district on Monday, and the contact list was not expanded. A healthcare worker from the primary contact list tested negative on the second test. Of seven people under observation at MCH, two close relatives were discharged after symptoms subsided and had previously tested negative. Another close relative in quarantine was admitted to MCH on June 15 for observation. Samples from another healthcare worker in the contact list have been sent for testing. Overall, 103 people remain under surveillance, with six under observation at MCH, and authorities continue to be on high alert.

triage.headline_ja: ニパール患者が2回目の抗体投与を受ける、人工呼吸器で治療継続中
triage.triage_reason: ニパール・ウイルスの確認症例が発生しており、重症度が高く（人工呼吸器装着）、予想外の疾患であり、国際的拡大リスクを持つため、IHR基準3項目以上該当。インドにおけるニパール発生はシグナル価値が高い。
triage.notes: ニパール・ウイルスは高い致死率を持つ人獣共通感染症であり、アジア地域での発生は国際的な公衆衛生関心が高い。本症例は確定例であり、重症度が高い（人工呼吸器装着）。接触者は103名が監視下にあり、二次感染の可能性が継続している。2026年6月時点で新規症例の検出はないが、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Roundup: One month into DR Congo Ebola outbreak
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo’s Ituri province, centered in Bunia, enters an upward, active phase after about one month. Confirmed cases are rising with ongoing community transmission, and authorities expect more in the coming days. The INSP calls for rapid expansion of treatment capacity, including new Ebola treatment centers to receive suspected and confirmed patients in affected areas. Doctors with MSF warn that despite scaling up the response, gaps in surveillance, diagnosis, contact tracing and community engagement persist; many patients arrive at a late stage, and most are not identified or monitored as contacts beforehand. Treatment centers are overwhelmed, laboratory results are delayed, and access to testing kits is limited by insecurity. Controlling the outbreak heavily depends on surveillance and thorough contact tracing; without swift measures, geographic spread could widen.

triage.headline_ja: DR コンゴのエボラ発生から1ヶ月：概況
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラの大規模感染事象として、フルRRA実施が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の確定感染事例における積極的な地域感染伝播。治療施設の過密、検査遅延、接触者追跡の不十分性など管理上の課題が報告されている。地理的拡大の懸念も示唆されており、国際保健上の重大リスク。MSFを含む複数の国際支援機関が関与している。

article.articleHeadline: ಡೆಂಗ್ಯೂ ಯಾವಾಗ ಅಪಾಯಕಾರಿಯಾಗುತ್ತದೆ? ತೀವ್ರ ಡೆಂಗ್ಯೂನ ಎಚ್ಚರಿಕೆ ಲಕ್ಷಣಗಳು ಯಾವುವು
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: When does dengue become dangerous? What are the warning signs of severe dengue?
article.articleSummary: As of 16 June 2026, dengue can become dangerous after the fever begins to subside. Red rashes or patches may appear on the body during recovery, accompanied by itching or burning and signaling possible progression. When dengue advances to severe dengue, the risk of complications increases rapidly. Warning signs include severe abdominal pain, persistent vomiting, fainting or nosebleeds, vomiting or stools with blood, profound weakness, dizziness, confusion, breathing difficulties, and a sudden drop in blood pressure. Platelet counts may fall with plasma leakage, potentially causing shock and organ damage. Any person exhibiting these signs should seek immediate medical care; early intervention can be lifesaving. The article cites Dr. Manohar K N, chief internal medicine and diabetes consultant at Touch Hospital, Bengaluru, as the medical expert behind the guidance.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱はいつ危険になるのか？重症デング熱の警告兆候は何か？
triage.triage_reason: 本記事はカルナータカ州ベンガルール地域で確認されたデング熱イベント自体ではなく、既知の医学情報に基づく教育・啓発コンテンツであり、新規発生事例の報道ではない。新しい感染症の流行拡大や異常なイベント報告を含まない。
triage.notes: この記事は世界デング熱デー（6月16日）に関連した医学教育記事であり、新規の疾病クラスターやアウトブレイク報告ではない。デング熱の臨床症状と管理に関する専門家コメントを扱うメディア記事である。シグナルとしてのトリアージ対象外。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N1

article.articleHeadline: Juan Saturno, experto en salud pública: "El mapa de las enfermedades infecciosas está cambiando"
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Juan Saturno, public health expert: "The map of infectious diseases is changing"
article.articleSummary: Juan Saturno, SEMG public health lead, notes that climate change and globalization are reshaping the infectious disease map, expanding vectors into new areas and increasing outbreaks beyond tropical zones. The top concerns include avian influenza H5N1 with human cases, the Ebola outbreak in Congo, and dengue spreading in Europe, while hantavirus episodes in Europe illustrate that risk perception can outpace reality. Transmission remains low for hantavirus, mainly zoonotic from rodents. The SEMG Infectious Diseases Working Group underscores the value of surveillance and early-warning systems but emphasizes basic prevention—handwashing, proper PPE, and adherence to vaccination calendars. Family doctors are trusted health educators, yet vaccine decisions are influenced by antivaccine movements. Date: 2026-06-16.

triage.headline_ja: フアン・サトゥルノ公衆衛生専門家：「感染症の地図が変わっている」
triage.triage_reason: 複数の深刻な感染症（H5N1、エボラ、デング熱）について言及しているが、記事は専門家インタビューの評論・解説形式であり、具体的なアウトブレイク情報ではなく、傾向分析が主体である。実際の新規事例や拡大傾向の具体的な根拠が限定的。
triage.notes: 記事はスペイン語媒体（Vozpopuli）での公衆衛生専門家（SEMG）インタビュー。H5N1の人間感染、コンゴのエボラアウトブレイク、デング熱のヨーロッパ拡大、ハンタウイルスエピソードに言及しているが、記事サマリーはこれらの傾向分析であり、具体的な新規ケース報告ではない点に注意。DRCでのエボラアウトブレイクは言及されているが詳細情報は限定的。IHR基準は複数該当するが、記事形式が評論的であることから、フルRRA前に続報での具体的なケース増加の確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Kasus kematian Ebola di Kongo mencapai 192 orang
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in Kongo reaches 192 people.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (DRC) intensifies, with 192 deaths and 808 confirmed cases reported by the Ministry of Health as of 15 June 2026. A resident infected with Ebola died in Bunia on 13 June 2026, prompting a large-scale disinfection operation in the region. The DRC ministry documented 26 new confirmed cases and 11 associated deaths on Sunday, yielding an estimated case fatality rate of 23.8%. Since 15 May, the World Health Organization has designated the outbreak in the DRC and neighboring Uganda as a Public Health Emergency of International Concern, signaling a high risk of cross-border spread. The report cites Sputnik/RIA Novosti; Antara News carried the update. Ongoing response measures include surveillance, infection control, and outbreak management efforts in affected areas.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ死亡者数が192人に達する
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス感染症の国際的な公衆衛生上の脅威であり、IHR基準4項目全て該当。WHOが既にPHEIC（国際的懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態）に指定。
triage.notes: DRCで発生しているエボラアウトブレイクであり、ウガンダへの国境を越えた拡大リスクも言及されている。記事ではウガンダがWHOのPHEIC指定の対象に含まれているが、サマリー本体でウガンダでの確認症例記述がないため、verified_locationsはDRCのみとした。既にWHOがPHEIC指定済みであり、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大な懸念である。

article.articleHeadline: Two more Shigella deaths in Kerala, toll rises to five
article.articleSummary: Two more Shigella deaths in Kerala on June 16, 2026 raise the toll this year to five as statewide Shigellosis activity continues, with 138 confirmed cases to date. A seven-year-old boy from Malappuram, Arjav of Kodur near Pookkottur, died at Kozhikode Government Medical College Hospital after admission on June 12 with high fever and acute diarrhoea. A 43-year-old man from Mapranam, Irinjalakkuda, died June 13; autopsy confirmed shigellosis, though the infection source remains unknown. Three fresh cases were reported in Kozhikode on Monday, signaling ongoing transmission. The boy was treated at the Mother and Child Care Centre at the medical college. Lab confirmation is noted for the autopsy case; Kerala’s situation reflects an ongoing outbreak requiring public health attention.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州でシゲラ菌感染症による死者が2名増加、通算5名に
triage.triage_reason: シゲラ菌感染症による確認死亡5例、確診例138例を含む活発なアウトブレイク。2つ以上のIHR基準に該当し、継続的な感染伝播と公衆衛生上の重大な関心が認められる。
triage.notes: ケーラ州とテランガーナ州での多数の確診例および死亡例が報告されている。感染源が不明な事例も存在し、継続的な感染伝播が示唆されている。公衆衛生上の注視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: UNICEF Ebola Virus Disease Outbreak Flash Update No. 3 (Democratic Republic of the Congo & Uganda), 12 June 2026
article.articleSummary: Bundibugyo Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo (Ituri, Kivu) and Uganda. As of 11 June 2026, 676 confirmed cases and 136 deaths in DRC; 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths in Uganda. No approved vaccine or specific treatment for Bundibugyo EBOV. On 7 June, the IASC activated a System-Wide Scale-Up to strengthen leadership. UNICEF, with WHO and partners, supports INSP in eastern DRC, with missions to Mongwalu, Beni, and Butembo to bolster diagnostics, safe care, rapid case detection, and risk communication; expansion into North Kivu. In DRC, 1,000 community health workers trained, reaching 160,000 households; 75 decontaminations and 57 safe burials. In Uganda, outbreak remains confined to imported cases and primary contacts; 122,979 people reached with prevention messages; 19 children under 21-day quarantine. UNICEF has procured US$3.3m; appeal US$70.7m, with US$50.32m mobilized; US$20.4m gap. Outbreak declared in Ituri 15 May 2026; WHO PHEIC 17 May.

triage.headline_ja: ユニセフ エボラウイルス病発生フラッシュ更新 No.3（コンゴ民主共和国・ウガンダ）2026年6月12日
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、Bundibugyo EBOV(承認ワクチン・治療法なし)による多発生と死亡、国際的拡大(DRC→Uganda)、WHO PHEIC宣言により明確なシグナル。
triage.notes: Uganda(226074)はサマリーに言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ該当。WHO PHEIC(2026年5月17日)宣言、IASC System-Wide Scale-Up、US$70.7m appeal と国際的対応が高度に進行中。675+ confirmed cases、136+ deaths(DRC)、重症度・管理可能性の課題あり。

article.articleHeadline: 滁州疾控发布夏季疾病防控指南
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Chuzhou CDC releases summer disease prevention and control guidelines.
article.articleSummary: Chuzhou, China — On 2026-06-16, the Chuzhou City CDC issued summer disease prevention guidelines, noting increased risks of tick-borne fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome (SFTS), dengue, chikungunya, cholera, hand-foot-mouth disease (HFMD), foodborne illness, and heat stroke as temperatures rise and rainfall increases. SFTS, caused by SFTS virus, is an acute febrile illness; prevention emphasizes reducing exposure, personal protection, and checking for ticks before returning home, with prompt medical care if symptoms appear. Dengue and chikungunya are transmitted by Aedes mosquitoes; travelers to Southeast Asia, Africa, and domestic high-risk areas should strengthen anti-mosquito measures, including wearing light-colored long sleeves and avoiding shaded damp spots. Cholera is a bacterial diarrhea; prevention relies on food safety, proper handling and storage, hygiene, and seeking care if illness arises. HFMD mainly affects children under 5; EV71 vaccine is recommended for 6 months to 5 years. Four-point food safety guidance and heat-stroke prevention strategies are outlined.

triage.headline_ja: 滁州疾控が夏季疾病防控指南を発表
triage.triage_reason: 複数の公衆衛生上の懸念疾患（SFTS、デング熱、チクングニア、コレラ、EV71）が言及されているが、本記事は予防ガイダンスの発行であり、具体的な患者発生件数や流行の深刻性が記載されていない。情報不足のため経過観察が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は中国安徽省滁州市の疾病管理センターが発行した季節性疾病予防ガイダンスの報道。複数の公衆衛生上関心の高い病原体（SFTS、デング熱、チクングニア、コレラ、EV71）が言及されているが、これはリスク低減のための予防措置の提示であり、実際の流行や患者数の報告ではない。具体的な発生件数、重症度、または異常な増加の兆候が記載されていないため、現時点での直接的なシグナルではなく、今後の患者報告や状況悪化を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: കോഴിക്കോട് മലേറിയ സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചു; രോഗബാധ ഇതര സംസ്ഥാന തൊഴിലാളി ക്ക്;പ്രതിരോധ പ്രവർത്തനം ഊര്‍ജിതമാക്കി ⋆ Third Eye News Live
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria confirmed in Kozhikode; infection among migrant workers from other states; preventive measures intensified ⋆ Third Eye News Live.
article.articleSummary: Malaria has been confirmed in Kozhikode district, Kerala, amid concurrent Nipah and Shigella concerns, with preventive measures intensified. The likely source of the malaria case is a migrant worker from Madhya Pradesh who arrived in the Thikkodi area a few weeks ago. Blood testing will be extended to other migrant workers in the area, and fever surveys and fogging are planned. Yesterday, three additional Shigella cases were reported in the district. Nipah virus disease contact-tracing results are due today; a direct contact health worker tested negative yesterday. A patient remains on a ventilator with no change in condition, and another health worker’s sample has been sent for testing. A relative of the patient is under hospital observation. Health Minister K. Muraleedharan says Nipah is under control, and Kozhikode DMO is coordinating the response. Numerous people tested, all negative.

triage.headline_ja: コーチン(コジコード)でマラリア確認; 他州からの出稼ぎ労働者に感染、予防対策を強化
triage.triage_reason: ニパ・ウイルス病とマラリア、シゲラが同時多発的に発生しており、ニパウイルスは既知の人獣共通感染症で国際的拡大リスクが高い。ケーラタ州での複合イベント対応が進行中で、定期的な接触者追跡とスクリーニング結果が待たれており、管理可能性の判断に重要な情報が不足している。
triage.notes: ニパ・ウイルス病は高致死率の人獣共通感染症で、医療従事者への感染報告ありで感染制御上の懸念が高い。マラリアとの複合発生、シゲラ症の同時報告も相まって、ケーラタ州での多重危機対応状況。接触者追跡結果とICU患者の臨床転帰が今後の判定に重要。Madhya Pradeshからの出稼ぎ労働者経由での地域間感染伝播リスク確認。

article.articleHeadline: Вспышка Эболы перекинется на Европу и ОАЭ в ближайшие 30 дней
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak will spread to Europe and the UAE within the next 30 days.
article.articleSummary: Within 30 days, Ebola carriers from Africa are expected to reach major European and Asian air hubs, with introduction risk to Belgium, France, the UAE, and Turkey around 90%. Japanese scientists’ modelling cited by Izvestiya indicates ongoing outbreaks in Congo and Uganda could seed international arrivals, with more than half of infected passengers potentially undetected at checkpoints before symptoms appear. The analysis helps identify vulnerable routes for cross-border spread and informs surveillance priorities. Russia is considered at low risk for importation, given that Ebola transmission requires close contact, limiting large-scale outbreaks. The piece notes a Telegram channel claim that the Ebola outbreak served as a rehearsal for a new pandemic.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ出血熱の感染拡大が今後30日以内にヨーロッパとUAEに広がる見通し
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。エボラ出血熱の国際的拡大シナリオに関する科学的予測報告であり、複数国における検疫強化・渡航制限の可能性がある。
triage.notes: 記事は日本の科学者による数学モデル分析に基づくエボラ出血熱の国際拡大予測を報道している。対象国リストではDRCのみ確認されたイベント発生地として該当。ただし、ベルギー・フランス・トルコ・UAE・日本・ロシアなどは報告の中で言及されているが、対象国リストに含まれていない（Belgium、France、Turkey、UAE、Japan、Russia）。本記事は予測・モデリング報告であり、既発生例の詳細情報が限定的である点に留意。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N8
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2

article.articleHeadline: 男童接觸雞檔感染H9N2禽流感　徐樂堅指不排除會有零星個案籲做好清潔 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Boy who had contact with a live poultry stall contracted H9N2 avian influenza; Xu Lejian says sporadic cases cannot be ruled out and urges better hygiene | am730.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 June 2026 in Hong Kong, a two-year-old boy has been diagnosed with avian influenza A(H9N2). The CHP Director said the child likely contracted the virus from contact with a contaminated live poultry environment at a city market; a plate sample from a chicken stall tested positive for H9. Genetic analyses show no mutations suggesting human adaptation, and sustained human-to-human transmission is not supported, keeping large-scale outbreaks unlikely. However, sporadic cases cannot be ruled out with close contact to poultry and poor hand hygiene. Adults should practice rigorous hand cleansing and parents should minimize young children's exposure to live poultry. AFCD will continue investigations; poultry appear normal so far, though stalls require daily cleaning and disinfection. Separately, rising activity of COVID-19 and influenza raises concerns of a possible 'dual peak' this summer; high-risk individuals should vaccinate.

triage.headline_ja: 生きた家禽取扱い場所との接触でH9N2鳥インフルエンザに感染した男児；徐楽堅氏が散発的な患者の発生は除外できないと指摘し、衛生管理の強化を呼びかけ
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常・予想外、国際的拡大リスク）。WPROスクリーニング基準で3つ該当（異常性、動物由来感染、流行しやすさ）。ヒト-ヒト感染の可能性が低いが、人獣共通感染症の継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: 香港での事例であるため、Chinaに含める。記事サマリーにCOVID-19とインフルエンザの同時活動上昇についても言及されているが、当シグナルの主題はH9N2鳥インフルエンザの人への感染。ヒト-ヒト感染は支持されていないが、動物環境での継続的な病原体曝露と散発的な人感染ケースが今後も起こりうるとされているため、継続的な監視が必要。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : l'épidémie toujours en phase ascendante, selon un responsable de santé publique (INTERVIEW)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: the outbreak is still on the upswing, according to a public health official (INTERVIEW).
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo remains in an active, ascending phase after more than a month. Dieudonné Mwamba Kazadi, director-general of the National Institute of Public Health (INSP), says the epidemic is ongoing and expanding. Confirmed cases have reached 808 with 192 deaths, with weekly increases signaling persistent community transmission. Response efforts are on track but require stronger community engagement, treatment capacity, and safe, dignified burials. Authorities expect new confirmed cases in coming days and emphasize the need to position treatment centers for suspected and confirmed patients. Control relies on surveillance and contact tracing, though resistance and rumors hinder safe burials. In Bunia, Ituri province—the epicenter—air traffic has been disrupted; IOM reports about 98% of required measures in place. Airport reopening depends on civil aviation authorities, not the Ebola response team.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ：公衆衛生責任者によると、感染拡大は依然として上昇傾向にある（インタビュー）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で4つ全て該当。エボラウイルス病は確認患者808人、死亡192人の継続的で拡大する流行であり、DRCにおける重大な公衆衛生上の脅威。国際的拡大リスクと渡航制限のリスクが存在。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病は極めて高い致死率を持つ指定感染症。DRCのイツリ州ブニアを中心に active かつ ascending phase の流行が続いており、週間ごとのケース増加が報告されている。コミュニティ内での継続的な感染伝播、治療容量の不足、埋葬時の安全措置実施の困難さが懸念要因。航空輸送の制限も報告されており、国際的な感染伝播リスクは現実的である。フルRRA実施の強い根拠がある。

article.articleHeadline: Doctor Recovering From Ebola Returns to U.S., Says He Is "Feeling Well" - Internewscast Journal
article.articleSummary: American physician Dr. Peter Stafford, an imported case in the United States, contracted Bundibugyo ebolavirus in Congo during humanitarian work and has returned to the U.S., declaring he is 'feeling well' after Ebola-free since May 30. Stafford arrived with his wife Rebekah and their four children; the family was evacuated and quarantined but remained asymptomatic. Stafford was treated at a Berlin hospital starting May 20 and discharged June 6. The Bundibugyo ebolavirus outbreak in Congo, which has spread to Uganda, is causing significant concern; unlike the Zaire strain, Bundibugyo has no approved vaccines or specific treatments. As of June 2026, Congo reported 782 confirmed cases and 178 deaths; Uganda had 19 confirmed cases and 2 deaths. Other missionaries in Congo have completed treatment and monitoring and returned home.

triage.headline_ja: エボラからの回復医師が米国に帰国、「調子が良い」と語る
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3項目該当（重症度・異常性・国際拡大リスク）。ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスの多国感染（DRC/ウガンダ）、致死率の高さ、有効なワクチン/治療法の欠如が確認され、国際的な公衆衛生上の重大懸念。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではDRCでの発生が主題。ブンディブギョ型エボラウイルスはザイール型と異なり承認されたワクチンや特異的治療法がなく、重症度・管理可能性の観点から懸念が高い。ウガンダへの拡大も確認されているが、対象国リストに含まれない。ドイツでの患者治療は輸入例（二次的）であり発生地ではない。

article.articleHeadline: കൊല്ലത്ത് വീണ്ടും ഷിഗെല്ല; രോ​ഗം സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചത് പോരുവഴി സ്വദേശിയായ രണ്ടാംക്ലാസ്സുകാരന്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Shigella again in Kollath; disease confirmed in a second-grade student from Poruvazhi.
article.articleSummary: Shigella outbreak resurges in Kollam, Kerala, with a 7-year-old second-grade student from Poruvazhi at Seven Mile Saint Thomas Residence Central School confirmed after illness linked to drinking water brought to school. The school had earlier affected over 100 students with food poisoning, leading to a temporary shutdown that remains unreopened. Nationwide, two more Shigella deaths were reported on Monday in Malappuram and Thrissur districts, including Aarav, 7, a Malappuram second-grader, and a 43-year-old man from Thrissur’s Kodakkara area. In Kannur, two children aged 4 and 8 in Mokeri tested positive. Nipah virus case: a patient at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital is in critical condition on ventilator, with six others under observation and a close relative admitted for monitoring. Malaria confirmed in four people in Kozhikode and Idukki; one migrant worker diagnosed in Thikkod. Monday fever consultations reached 14,297 statewide; across districts, influenza:45, dengue:40, leptospirosis:7, malaria:8.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州コーラムでシゲラが再び発生；ポルヴァジ出身の小学2年生で確認
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重篤な感染症（Shigella、Nipah、Malaria、Influenza、Dengue、Leptospirosis）が同時に発生し、死亡事例を含む複数地域での拡大が報告されている。IHR基準3項目以上（深刻な影響、異常/予想外、国際的拡大リスク）に該当し、管理可能性の懸念がある。
triage.notes: 複数の感染症が同時発生している複雑な状況。Shigella再発生（死亡2例含む）、Nipah重症例（人工呼吸器装着）、Malaria確認、Influenza/Dengue/Leptospirosis同時流行。ケーラ州全域で月曜日の発熱相談が14,297件に達した。学校閉鎖が継続中（100人以上の集団発生歴あり）。飲料水を介した感染の可能性が示唆されている。

article.articleHeadline: 中、韓、菲豬瘟狂飆！新北動員百人兵推「模擬4大劇本」 防疫遲報恐重罰
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Swine fever surges in China, Korea, and the Philippines! New Taipei City mobilizes a 100-person tabletop exercise to simulate four major scenarios; delayed epidemic reporting could incur heavy penalties.
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-16, New Taipei City, Taiwan, held a 100-person tabletop exercise to simulate four major swine-disease scenarios amid rising African swine fever (ASF) and foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) risks in East Asia. The drill, involving about 105 participants from the Agricultural Department, veterinary institutes, city agencies, and the New Taipei Meat Market, tests responses to: illegal kitchen-waste feeding; meat products from unknown or uninspected origins; pigs with water-blistering or lameness suggestive of FMD; and suspected ASF at meat markets. It integrates AIoT temperature/vision monitoring, GPS tracking of waste transport, and QR real-name checks for farm access. Under current rules, suspected swine illness must be reported within 24 hours by a designated veterinarian; violations carry up to NT$1,000,000 in fines. The exercise aims for rapid pathogen confirmation and containment within 24 hours to prevent spread.

triage.headline_ja: 中国・韓国・フィリピンで豚熱が急増！新北市は100人規模の机上演習で「4つの主要シナリオ」をシミュレーション、防疫報告遅延には重罰の可能性
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での防疫演習記事であり、東アジア全体でのASF・FMDリスク上昇が背景にあるが、現在の記事は計画的な演習報告であり、確認された新規アウトブレイクの詳細情報が不足している。対象国のうち実際の発生確認はChinaのみ（上海）で、規模・重症度等の詳細が不明。
triage.notes: 記事は台湾の防疫演習を報道しているが、実際の感染症イベント発生地は中国（上海）とされている。台湾（GeoNames ID 1668284・7280291）は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations から除外。ASF・FMD共に国際的に管理対象の動物疾患であり、複数国での同時発生リスクが言及されているが、現記事では演習の詳細が主であり、各国の具体的な感染状況の詳細情報が不足している。

article.articleHeadline: Congo registra récord de nuevos casos de ébola a un mes del brote
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Congo records a record number of new Ebola cases one month into the outbreak.
article.articleSummary: One month into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Ebola virus disease cases have surged with 72 new infections in the last 24 hours, bringing totals to 782 cases and 181 deaths. The outbreak is driven by Bundibugyo Ebola virus, a less common strain not detected in initial tests and harder to control than the Zaire lineage, which has a vaccine. Official confirmation occurred on May 15; the true caseload may be higher. Surveillance has improved, but contact tracing coverage has fallen to 56%, complicating case finding in Ituri province—accounting for over 90% of cases—with spillovers to North and South Kivu and cross-border spread to Uganda. The region faces displacement (nearly one million people), dense forests, poor roads, and artisanal mining that hinder response. WHO and Africa CDC are scaling up testing, tracing, and laboratory capacity.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ、アウトブレック開始1ヶ月でエボラの新規症例が過去最多を記録
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、WPROスクリーニング基準でも5項目すべてに該当。エボラウイルス病の国際的拡大（クロスボーダースプレッド）、重症度（182名の死亡）、管理可能性の課題が顕著。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではウガンダへのクロスボーダースプレッドが言及されているが、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれていないため verified_locations には含めない。DRCのみを対象国として記録。Bundibugyo Ebola virus（ワクチンがない、より管理困難なストレイン）という点で追加のリスク。接触者追跡カバレッジ低下（56%）と地域的な困難（変位住民、森林、採掘活動）が制御困難性を高めている。

article.articleHeadline: 中、韓、菲豬瘟狂飆！新北動員百人兵推「模擬4大劇本」 防疫遲報恐重罰
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: African swine fever surges in China, South Korea and the Philippines; New Taipei City mobilizes a 100-person tabletop exercise to simulate four major scenarios; late reporting of epidemic prevention could incur heavy penalties.
article.articleSummary: African swine fever (ASF) outbreaks are rising in South Korea and the Philippines, while foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) continues in seven Chinese provinces. In Taiwan, New Taipei City convened a 105-person tabletop exercise to simulate four major scenarios: backyard/industrial swill-fed pig farming, meat products from unknown or uninspected sources, pigs with vesicular symptoms (water blisters) or lameness suggesting FMD, and suspected ASF cases in meat markets, including a ‘pseudo-FMD’ scenario. The exercise incorporates advanced surveillance: AIoT temperature and image monitoring of swill, GPS tracking of swill transport, and QR code real-name access for farm entry, aiming to quickly identify risk sources and interrupt transmission. The Animal Protection Office mandates 24-hour reporting of suspected pig diseases by designated veterinarians, with penalties up to NT$1,000,000; samples will be tested to confirm pathogens within 24 hours of notification. New Taipei has 102 pig farms, 49 of which use swill feeding.

triage.headline_ja: 中、韓、菲豬瘟狂飆！新北動員百人兵推「模擬4大劇本」 防疫遲報恐重罰
triage.triage_reason: アフリカ豚コレラおよび口蹄疫が中国、韓国、フィリピンで同時多発的に拡大しており、アジア地域での国際的拡大リスクが高い。台湾の当局が大規模な対応訓練を実施していることから、地域レベルの懸念も確認される。
triage.notes: 台湾での記事であるが、発生地域に台湾は含まれていない。対象国では中国とフィリピンのみが該当。韓国は対象国リストに含まれていないため除外。記事サマリーでASFとFMDの複合爆発的流行が確認され、複数国での同時多発により国際的な家畜衛生上の懸念が極めて高い。

article.articleHeadline: പതിനായിരം കടന്ന് പകർച്ചപ്പനി; ഭീഷണിയായി ഷിഗെല്ലയും ഡെങ്കിപ്പനിയും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Measles surpass ten thousand; Shigella and dengue fever pose a threat.
article.articleSummary: As of June 16, 2026, Kerala reports a rising fever burden with polio and dengue among the major threats, alongside Shigella. Statewide 11,534 people are under treatment for fever. Polio shows 107 June cases, with 82 suspected cases and two confirmed deaths. Dengue has 3,366 cases and three deaths, with 85 new dengue cases recorded on the latest day and 1,111 chickenpox cases this month. Shigella has 135 confirmed cases this year. Fever patients are most numerous in Malappuram (2,470) and Kozhikode (1,142); Idukki has 298, while Wayanad reported a fatality in a 10-year-old child. Other diseases mentioned include influenza, cholera, typhoid, West Nile virus, and amoebic meningitis. The weather is cited as a factor in spread, underscoring ongoing outbreaks needing surveillance and public health measures.

triage.headline_ja: 麻疹が1万件を超える; シゲラ菌とデング熱が脅威として浮上
triage.triage_reason: 複数の重大感染症(ポリオ2件の死亡、デング3件の死亡を含む)が同時に発生し、11,534人が治療中であり、IHR基準で「深刻な公衆衛生影響」「異常な多疾患同時発生」に該当。WPROスクリーニング基準でも重症度（死亡例複数）と長期曝露（広域での持続的患者発生）が明確で、フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: ケーラ州での複数感染症の同時流行。特にポリオの確認事例とシゲラ菌の新規報告はインドの公衆衛生上の優先課題。記事本文が空のため、サマリーのみで評価したが、サマリーは詳細で信頼性は高い。気象要因による拡大の指摘あり。

article.articleHeadline: Ebola outbreak in Congo worsens with 72 new cases reported in a day
article.articleSummary: On 16 June 2026, the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo intensified, with 72 new confirmed cases in 24 hours, lifting the total to 782 cases and 181 deaths. The spike marks one of the largest single-day increases since the outbreak was declared roughly a month prior. Health officials cite weak contact tracing, insecurity, and funding shortages as major obstacles hindering containment and response. The 32 additional deaths in the latest 24-hour window underscore the severity of transmission and mortality. Authorities are continuing surveillance and response activities amid ongoing challenges, with limited ability to isolate cases and trace contacts, complicating efforts to curb spread across affected regions.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行が悪化、1日に72の新規感染者が報告された
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべて該当、WPRO基準5つすべて該当。急速な感染者増加（1日72例、累計782例181死）、深刻な重症度、コンタクト施設追跡失敗による管理困難性、国際拡大リスク、渡航制限の可能性がある。フルRRA進行が必須。
triage.notes: エボラウイルス病の急速な感染拡大。1ヶ月の流行期間中で1日72例という最大規模の増加を記録。接触者追跡の喪失、セキュリティ問題、資金不足により対応能力が大幅に制限されている。死亡率は約23%（181/782）で極めて高い。DRC域内での地域的拡大、および隣国への越境リスクがある。

article.articleHeadline: പകര്‍ച്ചവ്യാധി ഭീഷണിയില്‍ കോഴിക്കോട്; മലേറിയയും റിപ്പോര്‍ട്ട് ചെയ്തു
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Epidemic threat in Kozhikode; malaria also reported.
article.articleSummary: Kozhikode district, Kerala, faces an epidemic threat with Nipah virus, Shigellosis, and malaria reported as the monsoon approaches. Authorities blame poor waste management and uncoordinated pre-monsoon sanitation for the spread. In Kozhikode, three Shigella cases were confirmed yesterday, and more Nipah test results are awaited, with district health officials maintaining vigilance. A migrant worker from Madhya Pradesh has tested positive for malaria, indicating an imported infection. Across the state, Shigellosis has surged, with eight new cases yesterday and five districts reporting infections: Thiruvananthapuram, Kollam, Thrissur, Malappuram, and Kozhikode. The month’s total stands at 71 Shigella cases, and the year total at 147; two Shigella deaths were confirmed yesterday—one seven-year-old from Malappuram and a 43-year-old Thrissur resident last month. A health worker in direct contact with an affected patient tested negative; a ventilated patient’s condition remains unchanged. Authorities have escalated preventive measures.

triage.headline_ja: コーチン地区で感染症の脅威；マラリアも報告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（異常性、国際拡大リスク、貿易制限リスク）。複数の感染症（ニパウイルス、赤痢、マラリア）の同時発生で公衆衛生への影響が深刻。
triage.notes: ケーララ州コーチン地区でニパウイルス、赤痢、マラリアの3つの感染症が同時に報告。赤痢では死亡例も確認（7歳児1名、43歳成人1名）。モンスーン時期の来襲に伴い感染拡大のリスクが高い。州内5地区で赤痢患者を確認。マラリア患者は州外（マディヤプラデシュ州）の移行労働者で輸入感染の可能性。州および地区当局による警戒体制が敷かれている。

article.articleHeadline: Keralam: 7-year-old boy dies of Shigella infection
article.articleSummary: A seven-year-old boy, Arjav of Pookkottur, Malappuram district, Kerala, died of Shigella infection at Government Medical College Hospital, Kozhikode, on June 16, 2026, after admission on June 12 for fever and diarrhoea. Two more Shigella cases were reported in Kozhikode: a one-year-old from Kunnamangalam and nine-year-old from Payyoli; the nine-year-old has been discharged, the one-year-old remains critical. Since January, Kerala has confirmed 135 Shigella cases, with 68 in Kozhikode district; 61 infections have been recorded in June so far. Preventive measures are intensified, including closure of a tender coconut shop in Tirurangadi after Shigella detection. Public health officials warn disease spreads via contaminated food and water. Health Minister K. Muraleedharan said Nipah concerns are under control, with one patient on a ventilator after Nipah testing; 29 others negative. Overall, 135 Shigella cases and three deaths (a 3-year-old baby, a 4-year-old girl, and a 59-year-old housewife) with monitoring and stocked medicines.

triage.headline_ja: ケーララ州：7歳の少年がシゲラ菌感染で死亡
triage.triage_reason: シゲラ菌感染による死亡例が複数確認され、ケーララ州で135例の累積患者が報告されているが、タイトルと記事内容の不一致（Nipahと表示されているが実際はShigella中心）、および情報の一貫性に疑問がある。スクリーニング基準の該当は認められるが、疾患特定と情報精度の確認が必要。
triage.notes: 【重要な不整合】Bluedot APIの疾患名は'Nipah'と表示されているが、記事サマリーの主要内容はShigella菌感染である。記事ではNipahについても言及されているが（1例が人工呼吸器装着、29例が陰性）、フォーカスはShigella流行。Nipahであれば評価が著しく異なるため、原記事の確認と疾患特定が重要。ケーララ州での複数の死亡例と継続的な感染例（6月だけで61例）は関心対象だが、情報の信頼性確認が必要。

article.articleHeadline: Statement | Ebola in der DR Kongo: Kinder unter fünf Jahren sterben mehr als doppelt so häufig wie ältere Kinder und Erwachsene
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Statement | Ebola in the Democratic Republic of the Congo: Children under five die more than twice as often as older children and adults.
article.articleSummary: Eastern Democratic Republic of Congo's Ebola virus disease outbreak, concentrated in Ituri province, has become a societal crisis. Borders with Uganda were briefly closed. About a month after the outbreak was reported, Africa CDC data show children under five die at 43.8% CFR—more than twice that of older children and adults—while ages 5–14 have a 33.3% CFR. Roughly 15 million people in the DRC require humanitarian aid, amid food insecurity and rising malnutrition; nearly half of children under five are stunted. Infant feeding is disrupted because infected mothers must stop breastfeeding, with limited access to breast milk substitutes. Fear of health facilities and shortages of medicines jeopardize otherwise treatable diseases such as malaria. Education is breaking down, elevating risks of child marriage and exploitation. Save the Children, active in the DRC since 1994, is coordinating relief with local and international partners. Analysis is based on Africa CDC Situation Report No. 30 (June 13, 2026).

triage.headline_ja: 声明 | コンゴ民主共和国のエボラ：5歳未満の子どもは高齢児および成人の2倍以上の頻度で死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当。エボラウイルス病の確認された流行で高い致死率（5歳未満で43.8%CFR）、国境閉鎖など国際的影響、社会的危機が報告されている。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーは東部DRC（イトゥリ州）でのエボラ流行に焦点を当てている。ウガンダとの国境閉鎖や15百万人が人道支援を必要とするなど、地域的・社会的危機が顕著。Save the Childrenなど国際NGOの支援活動が報告されており、国際的関心が高い。

article.articleHeadline: 剛果民主共和國爆發伊波拉疫情一個月 無國界醫生警告應對行動仍存重大缺口 | am730
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: One month since the Ebola outbreak erupted in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Doctors Without Borders warns that there are still significant gaps in the response | am730
article.articleSummary: As of 16 June 2026, one month into the Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo, Doctors Without Borders warns that surveillance, testing, contact tracing, and community engagement remain major gaps hindering containment. The eastern provinces of Ituri, North Kivu, and South Kivu are affected, with about 95% of cases in Ituri. Authorities report over 650 confirmed cases and more than 130 deaths; neighboring Uganda has 19 confirmed cases. Bundibugyo virus testing kits have arrived, but diagnostic capacity is limited: in North Kivu only one lab processes blood samples, with results taking days to a week, and many communities lack access. Ituri treatment centers are overwhelmed, with late patient arrivals and many undetected. MSF calls for intensified diagnostics, surveillance, and accessibility, plus routine healthcare and community participation. Ebola Treatment Centers are operating in Bunia and Mongbwalu, with expanded isolation and infection control measures.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国でエボラ流行が1ヶ月間続く、国境なき医師団は対応に重大な欠陥があると警告
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つ全て該当。エボラは国際保健上の緊急事態であり、重大な公衆衛生影響、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスクがある。隣国ウガンダでも既に19例の確認症例がある。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーではコンゴ民主共和国（DRC）のイツリ州、北キブ州、南キブ州でのエボラ流行が主題。隣国ウガンダでも19例が確認されているが、サマリーの焦点はDRCの流行対応の欠陥にある。発生地域にUgandaが含まれるが、サマリーでは補足的な記述に過ぎず、主題はDRCであるため verified_locations はDRCのみとした。150日以上前の日付（2026年6月16日）はシステム上の誤りの可能性があるが、イベント情報としての評価には影響しない。

article.articleHeadline: Έμπολα: H "πρώτη γραμμή άμυνας" έχει καταρρεύσει - H μεγαλύτερη έως τώρα επιδημία σπάνιου στελέχους
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola: The "first line of defense" has collapsed - The largest outbreak to date of a rare strain
article.articleSummary: Ebola, Bundibugyo strain, is spreading in the Democratic Republic of Congo, the largest outbreak on record for this rare strain. As of June 13, the DRC Ministry of Health confirmed 781 laboratory-confirmed cases and 181 deaths. The outbreak centers in Ituri province, including Mongbwalo, where water and sanitation access are severely limited—about 20% have clean water and 25% have functioning latrines. Oxfam warns that actual cases are likely higher due to collapsing health infrastructure and waning contact tracing; it notes only one in five health centers in Ituri has adequate clean water. Water costs about $2 for 20 liters and represents the first line of defense. There is no approved vaccine for Bundibugyo, making hygiene and water critical. US withdrawal of funding for surveillance has hampered response, with over 70 health facilities destroyed and about 0.2 doctors per 1,000 people in the region.

triage.headline_ja: エボラ：「第一次防衛線」が崩壊 - これまでで最大規模の希少株の流行
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルスBundibugyo株の大規模流行。781確定症例、181死亡。IHR基準4つすべて該当。公衆衛生への深刻な影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク、水衛生危機による対策制約が全て認められ、フルRRA対象。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株は稀な株系であるが過去最大規模の流行。ワクチン未承認。水・衛生インフラ崩壊、医療施設70以上破壊、接触追跡能力喪失、米国の監視資金撤退など、対応能力の深刻な制約あり。実際の症例数はさらに高いと推定される。

article.articleHeadline: Progression rapide d'Ebola, alerte de Médecins sans frontières : la France pourrait-elle être menacée ?
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Rapid progression of Ebola, Doctors Without Borders alert: Could France be threatened?
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo is accelerating beyond field response, with MSF warning of dangerous gaps on June 15, 2026. Hundreds are ill and dozens have died; Africa CDC counted 102 deaths by early June, while only 64% of Ebola contact cases are identified versus the 90% target set by WHO. Ebola is a zoonosis from fruit bats to monkeys to humans; incubation is 2–21 days, with early flu-like symptoms followed by vomiting, diarrhea, rashes, liver/kidney dysfunction, and possible hemorrhage. There is no specific cure; monoclonal antibodies plus supportive care (including rehydration) are used. Mortality ranges from 25% to 90% depending on the strain, averaging around 50%. France faces importation risk, as air traffic to Kinshasa continues, though Public Health France deems the import risk very low outside large African outbreaks; Mayotte is notably near affected zones. The Health Ministry urges travelers to heed precautions; no vaccine is homologated for this strain.

triage.headline_ja: エボラウイルスの急速な進行、国境なき医師団が警告：フランスが脅かされる可能性があるか？
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ以上該当（重大な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク）、かつWPRO基準複数該当。DRC内での急速な流行進行と国際的な輸入リスクが存在。
triage.notes: DRC内のキンシャサでのエボラウイルス爆発的流行。感染致死率25～90%、WHO接触者確認目標90%に対し実績64%と大幅に下回る。フランスは記事主題の比較対象であり、輸入リスクの可能性が記載されているものの、実際の発生地はDRCのみ。MSFによる緊急警告により社会的・政治的関心は高い。

diseases.name: Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H5N8
Human Infection with Avian Influenza A H9N2

article.articleHeadline: 香港男童接觸雞檔染禽流感　專家：傳播風險低 | 電訊
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Hong Kong boy who came into contact with a live poultry stall contracted avian influenza; experts say the transmission risk is low | Telecom
article.articleSummary: Hong Kong reported a 2-year-old boy diagnosed with avian influenza A(H9N2) after exposure at a live poultry stall in a market. The Centre for Health Protection (CHP) director Xu Le-ken said the virus showed no genetic mutations, and A(H9N2) does not transmit between humans, so the risk of a local outbreak remains low. The boy likely contracted the virus through contact with a contaminated environment at the poultry stall; a metal tray used to collect chicken droppings tested positive for H9. Public should maintain hand hygiene after close contact with poultry, and adults should minimize letting children handle live poultry. Authorities will conduct further investigations. Markets: live poultry stalls require daily cleaning; poultry are not kept overnight; vendors should disinfect stalls. Hong Kong’s COVID-19 and influenza activity is rising; vaccination is urged, especially for high-risk groups, to prevent severe disease.

triage.headline_ja: 香港の男児が生きた鶏の露店で鳥インフルエンザに感染、専門家は伝播リスク低いと指摘
triage.triage_reason: H9N2による単一事例の報告であり、当局は人間への伝播リスクが低いと評価。ただし複数のインフルエンザウイルス（H5N8、H9N2、COVID-19）が同時に列記されており、情報の整理が必要。続報の監視が適切。
triage.notes: 香港での単一H9N2感染事例。当局による明確なリスク評価（人間への伝播リスク低い、遺伝子変異なし）がされているため重症度は低い。ただし記事で複数のインフルエンザウイルス（H5N8、H9N2）が並列記載されており、実際の流行状況の全体像確認が必要。市場における衛生対策強化の言及あり。

article.articleHeadline: Bác sĩ cảnh báo nguy cơ chuyển nặng, tử vong do bệnh sốt rét đến từ châu Phi
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Doctors warn of the risk of progression to severe malaria and death from malaria originating in Africa.
article.articleSummary: Two imported cases of Plasmodium falciparum malaria in Vietnam are linked to Africa. The first patient, H.V.T., 36, from Thanh Hóa, worked in Congo and suffered recurrent fevers during deployment; two weeks after returning to Vietnam he developed high fever (up to ~40°C), chills, headache, nausea, and fatigue, with blood tests positive for P. falciparum. He was transferred to the National Tropical Disease Hospital for intensive care. The second patient, M.T.H., 45, from Tuyên Quang, migrant worker in Angola, returned home two months earlier and had another fever; a week before admission he spiked 40.2°C with rigors, again testing positive for P. falciparum and was admitted. Both presented with fever, chills, headache, myalgia; diagnosed by blood tests and treated with intravenous and oral antimalarials, with fever controlled and stable on follow-up. Doctors warn of progression to severe malaria and death without timely treatment, urging prompt evaluation for febrile illness after Africa travel and preventive measures for travelers. WHO recently approved malaria treatment for newborns and young children ahead of World Malaria Day.

triage.headline_ja: 医師がアフリカ由来のマラリアによる重症化および死亡のリスクについて警告
triage.triage_reason: ベトナムでのアフリカ由来P. falciparum マラリアの輸入症例2件は公衆衛生関心を喚起しているが、国内流行の兆候がなく、重症化リスク警告が主体のため、情報の継続監視が適切。
triage.notes: Bluedot APIはAngola（対象国外）を検出しているが、記事サマリーではベトナムでの2つの輸入症例が主題。両患者は就労地（コンゴ、アンゴラ）からの帰還後に症状出現。国内二次感染の兆候はなく、輸入症例の警告レベルのシグナル。WHOによる小児向け治療承認言及により国際的関心あり。

article.articleHeadline: Fußball-WM: Wie Experten Seuchengefahr für sechs Millionen Fans prüfen
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: FIFA World Cup: How experts assess the risk of epidemics for six million fans.
article.articleSummary: FIFA World Cup 2026 spans Canada, Mexico, and the United States, with more than six million fans traveling between June 11 and July 19. Public-health authorities monitor infection signals in host cities and fan-origin communities, issuing daily situation reports and evaluating online discussions. The Georgetown University Health Security Operations Center, led by Rebecca Katz, coordinates this effort across 48 jurisdictions and three host countries. Diseases under watch include measles, with confirmed cases in the United States, Canada, and Mexico; other monitored pathogens are dengue, hepatitis A, and mpox. The ongoing Ebola outbreaks in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda are noted, but experts consider the overall risk to the World Cup in the United States as low. Wastewater analysis serves as an early-warning tool, capable of detecting even a single Ebola case. The DR Congo team arrived in Houston on June 11, ahead of their June 17 game against Portugal.

triage.headline_ja: FIFA ワールドカップ2026: 600万人のファンのための感染症リスク評価
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症が監視対象であり、国際的な大規模集会による伝播リスクが存在するが、公式な感染症アウトブレイク報告ではなく、予防的監視体制の記事であるため。
triage.notes: 記事は2026年FIFAワールドカップにおける感染症監視体制を扱っており、複数国での麻疹確認とコンゴ・ウガンダにおけるエボラアウトブレイク継続が言及されている。ただし、本記事自体は大規模集会に伴う予防的監視の説明であり、新たなアウトブレイク報告ではない。対象国リストに含まれるのはDRC（203312）とUganda（226074）のエボラアウトブレイク継続に関する言及のため。米国・カナダ・メキシコでの麻疹等は対象国リストに含まれない。

article.articleHeadline: നിപയ്ക്കും ഷിഗെല്ലയ്ക്കും പിന്നാലെ കോഴിക്കോട്ട്‌ മലേറിയയും; ലക്ഷണങ്ങൾ തിരിച്ചറിയാം
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Malaria also in Kozhikode after Nipah and Shigella; recognize the symptoms.
article.articleSummary: Malaria is confirmed in Kozhikode, Kerala, after Nipah and Shigella cases in the district. The patient is an interstate migrant worker from Madhya Pradesh who arrived in Thikkodi; health officials say the infection source is Madhya Pradesh. Symptoms include high fever, fatigue, headache, vomiting, muscle pains, chest pain, weakness, cough, and possibly persistent vomiting. Malaria is transmitted by mosquitoes; the parasite enters the bloodstream after a bite and later invades red blood cells, with the liver stage potentially lasting up to about a year. The parasite can be transmitted to others by mosquitoes feeding on an infected person, and maternal transmission to the fetus via the bloodstream is possible; transmission can also occur through contaminated injections. Preventive measures include avoiding mosquito-heavy areas, wearing full-body clothing, netting doors/windows, and applying insect repellent; travelers, children, the elderly, and pregnant women should especially take precautions. Health department has started containment measures.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルスとシゲラに続き、コジコードでマラリアも発生; 症状の認識
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準3つ該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常/予想外、国際拡大リスク）。ニパウイルスとマラリアの複合感染症イベントでありケララ州での複数病原体の流行は予想外かつ重大。
triage.notes: 記事は州間移行者（マディヤプラデシュからの労働者）による越境感染を報告。ニパウイルス、シゲラに続く3番目の病原体がコジコード地区で確認され、公衆衛生対応の重層化を示唆。蚊媒介疾患と血液体液感染病原体の同時流行は管理複雑度が高い。

article.articleHeadline: В Конго от лихорадки Эбола умерли свыше 190 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: More than 190 people have died in Congo from Ebola fever.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo, centered in Ituri province in the east, began May 15. Lab-confirmed cases reached 808, with 192 deaths (case fatality rate 23.8%). Hospitals and medical isolation facilities house 363 patients. Separately, cases and fatalities have been reported in neighboring Uganda. The Financial Times describes the outbreak as a potential test of the global health system’s readiness for future pandemics, amid shrinking international funding and eroding trust in science after COVID-19. A Council on Foreign Relations official notes that while knowledge to fight such outbreaks exists, institutional capacity and public support have weakened, underscoring global health-system vulnerability. The Russian Embassy in the Central African Republic has pledged assistance in response to the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴでエボラ熱により190人以上が死亡
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目全て該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航制限リスク）。エボラウイルス病の多地域アウトブレイク、複数国での患者・死亡報告、高い致死率、国際的支援動向を反映。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでエボラ発生の主要地はDRC（Ituri州）と明記。隣国ウガンダでも症例・死亡報告あるが、記事の焦点はDRC中心。中央アフリカ共和国はBluedotが付与するも、サマリーに具体的な患者発生記述なし。DRCのみ verified_locations に含める。致死率23.8%、検査確定症例808例、死亡192例、入院患者363例という重症度の高さが顕著。国際支援（ロシア大使館）の動向も注視対象。

article.articleHeadline: Число погибших от Эболы в ДР Конго превысило 190 человек
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola death toll in the Democratic Republic of the Congo exceeds 190.
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo: 192 deaths among 808 confirmed cases, with 26 new infections reported in the last 24 hours and a case-fatality rate of 23.8%. A total of 48 patients have recovered. Ituri Province remains the epicenter with 738 confirmed cases, while the virus continues to spread to North Kivu and South Kivu provinces. The figures were released by the country’s Ministry of Information and Communications via X on 2026-06-16, signaling a sustained eastern Congo outbreak with expanding transmission across multiple regions. The data indicate ongoing transmission despite recoveries and emphasize the need for continued public health response and containment measures in the affected provinces.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴ民主共和国のエボラによる死者数が190人を超える
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべてに該当し、複数州にわたる拡大流行が確認されている。死亡者190人超、確認患者808人という規模と23.8%の高い致命率は深刻な公衆衛生上の影響を示す。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスはIturi、North Kivu、South Kivu各州における持続的な流行を示唆。公式発表による数字（2026年6月16日付）で、確認患者808人中192人死亡、過去24時間で26人の新規感染報告。回復者48人。複数州への拡大と継続的な感染リスクが強調されている。DRCは対象国リストに含まれており、verified_locationsに含める。

article.articleHeadline: Deadly Shigella bacteria kills another child in Kerala: What parents must know about symptoms and risks
article.articleSummary: Shigellosis outbreak in Kerala, India: 7-year-old boy died in Malappuram; fourth Shigella death in state this year. As of June 14, Kerala reported 138 confirmed Shigella cases and 77 suspected across districts, with 62 confirmed and 17 suspected in June alone. Affected districts include Kozhikode (highest), Wayanad, Alappuzha, Aranmula, Pathanamthitta, and Malappuram. Health authorities intensified inspections of hotels, restaurants, roadside stalls, and school meal programs; drinking water quality testing stepped up. Shigella spreads via the faecal-oral route and causes diarrhoea, fever, stomach cramps; blood- or mucus-containing stools can occur. Emphasis on handwashing, safe water, and properly cooked food to prevent spread; caution for children. Seek medical care for severe, bloody diarrhoea, high fever, vomiting, or dehydration; vulnerable groups at higher risk.

triage.headline_ja: ケララ州でシゲラ菌が別の子どもを殺害：親が知るべき症状とリスク
triage.triage_reason: ケララ州でのシゲラ症集団発生は、死亡例を含む重度の公衆衛生の影響があり、IHR基準（深刻性、異常性）を満たす。複数地域での確認例と継続的な曝露リスクが存在し、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、流行しやすさ）を満たす。
triage.notes: シゲラ症はインドのケララ州で確認されている集団発生。6月14日時点で確認例138例、疑い例77例。死亡例が4例報告されており、最近では7歳男児の死亡が報告されている。複数地域（コーチン、ワイナード、アラップーザ、アランムーラ、パタナムティッタ、マラップラム）に広がっており、衛生当局が食品施設・学校給食の監視を強化している。ヒト-ヒト感染（経口-糞便経路）による継続的な曝露リスクが存在する。

article.articleHeadline: 北京疾控提醒：小心草丛暗藏 "吸血小虫"！千万别硬拽_京报网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Beijing CDC warns: Beware of hidden "blood-sucking little bugs" in the grass! Do not pull them out by force.
article.articleSummary: Beijing’s Centers for Disease Control warns that ticks become highly active as temperatures rise, posing risk to outdoor visitors in suburban parks, mountains, and grasslands around Beijing. Tick bites can transmit fever with thrombocytopenia syndrome, tick-borne encephalitis, and Lyme disease. Adult ticks peak April–June; nymphs are common July–September, living in grassy and shrubby areas where people hike or camp. Incorrect removal—twisting, squeezing, or burning—can worsen infection risk; correct method is to grasp the head with fine-tipped tweezers and pull straight up, then disinfect, and store the tick in a sealed bag for lab testing. Seek medical care if fever or rash develops post-bite. Preventive measures include wearing long sleeves and tucked-in pants, choosing light-colored clothing, applying DEET or permethrin-based repellents, treating tents or camping gear with pyrethroid insecticides, and checking pets and homes for ticks. Urban areas have lower tick presence outside large parks.

triage.headline_ja: 北京疾病管理センターが警告：草むらに隠れた「吸血虫」に注意！無理に引っ張らないで
triage.triage_reason: 複数のダニ媒介感染症（SFTS、ダニ媒介脳炎、ライム病）が同時に言及されており、北京での季節的流行警告として異常性がある。ただし具体的な症例数、死亡例、または国際的拡大リスクの明示がないため、フルRRA前の経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: 記事はCDCによる予防啓発警告であり、現在の流行状況の詳細データ（症例数、死亡数、確定診断例）が提供されていない。ダニの季節的活動の高まりと複数のダニ媒介感染症の同時言及は異常性を示すが、重症度や国際的影響の具体的情報が欠落している。続報で症例報告や異常な流行兆候が明記される場合はPICKUPに昇格する可能性がある。

article.articleHeadline: 新北102場養豬場 辦重大豬病兵推 建構堅實防疫網
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: New Taipei City's 102 pig farms to hold a major swine-disease tabletop exercise to build a robust biosecurity network.
article.articleSummary: New Taipei City hosts a major swine-disease tabletop exercise covering 102 pig farms (49 swill-fed) to strengthen biosecurity amid ASF outbreaks in Korea and the Philippines and Mainland China’s SAT-1 foot-and-mouth disease. More than 100 participants from the Council of Agriculture’s Animal and Plant Health Inspection and Quarantine, Veterinary Office, 16 city agencies, district offices, and the New Taipei City Meat Market simulate four scenarios: illegal swill feeding, sale of meat products of unknown origin or without slaughterhouse marks, pigs with water blistering or lameness suggestive of FMD, and suspected ASF cases in a meat market. New measures tested include AIoT temperature and video monitoring, GPS on swill transport, and QR real-name farm access. The exercise stresses rapid 24-hour reporting by designated veterinarians; non-compliance can trigger penalties up to NT$1,000,000, with movement controls and sampling to confirm pathogens within the “golden 24 hours.”

triage.headline_ja: 新北市102場養豚場 実施重大豚病情報演習 堅牢な防疫ネットワーク構築
triage.triage_reason: 動物疾病（ASF・口蹄疫）の防疫演習記事。実際のアウトブレイク対応ではなく机上演習が主題であるため、WPROスクリーニング基準の該当が限定的。ただし対象地域（台湾・フィリピン）で複数疾病の流行リスク背景があり情報追跡の価値あり。
triage.notes: 本記事は実際のASF・口蹄疫アウトブレイクではなく、台湾（新北市）で実施された防疫対策の机上演習が主題である。背景としてフィリピン・韓国・中国でのASF/口蹄疫流行が言及されているが、本記事の記事本文が未提供のため詳細は不明。台湾は対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations にはフィリピンと中国のみを含める（台湾は地域検証の結果として記載）。

article.articleHeadline: Cảnh báo sốt rét nguy hiểm từ ký sinh trùng Plasmodium falciparum
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Warning: Dangerous malaria caused by the parasite Plasmodium falciparum.
article.articleSummary: Imported malaria caused by Plasmodium falciparum was diagnosed in a 36-year-old man from Thanh Hóa who previously worked in Congo. Two weeks after returning to Vietnam, he developed high fever, rigors, headache, nausea and fatigue; local testing confirmed P. falciparum infection and he was transferred to the National Institute of Tropical Diseases for intensive treatment. He improved after aggressive antimalarial therapy given intravenously and orally, with fever resolving and laboratory indices improving. Plasmodium falciparum is the most dangerous malaria parasite and can rapidly cause multiorgan dysfunction (brain, liver, kidneys, lungs, heart), potentially leading to death if untreated. Experts urge anyone with fever after returning from Africa to seek prompt medical care, share travel history with clinicians, and use prevention measures—bed nets, repellents, long sleeves—and consider chemoprophylaxis for long overseas stays.

triage.headline_ja: 警告：플라스모디ウム・ファルキパルム寄生虫による危険なマラリア
triage.triage_reason: 輸入マラリア1例（P. falciparum）のベトナムでの診断報告。重症度は高いが、現時点では単一症例であり国際的拡大の直接的証拠がない。続報を注視する必要がある。
triage.notes: DRCは患者の曝露地（仕事場）であるが、イベント自体はベトナムでの輸入マラリア診断である。記事サマリー上、実際の発生国はベトナムのみ。IHR基準は2つ以上該当するが、単一輸入症例であり、ベトナム国内での流行兆候や管理困難は記事に記載されていない。WPRO基準も満たすが、社会的・政治的関心が明確でないため、WATCHとして分類。

article.articleHeadline: Kerala Nipah case: Second healthcare worker tests negative; patient remains on ventilator support
article.articleSummary: As of June 16, Nipah virus infection in Kozhikode district, Kerala, remains under containment. The second healthcare worker in the patient’s primary contact list has tested negative; a prior contact had also tested negative, and another sample is pending. The patient is on ventilator support at Kozhikode Medical College Hospital and has received a second monoclonal antibody dose per ICMR guidelines. Surveillance and contact tracing continue, with samples from another contact sent for testing. Seven people are admitted for observation; two close relatives were discharged on June 15 after symptoms subsided and negative tests. A third relative under quarantine was admitted on June 15. No fresh Nipah cases or new contacts have been reported; 103 people remain on the contact list (4 very high-risk, 14 high-risk, 85 low-risk), including 45 healthcare workers. A central team visited Feroke hospital, and field visits covered 46 houses in Ramanattukara Division 5.

triage.headline_ja: ケーラ州ニパウイルス患者：第2の医療従事者は陰性、患者は人工呼吸器での治療継続
triage.triage_reason: ニパウイルスの確認症例が複数の医療従事者を含む接触者リストで報告されており、継続的な監視と接触追跡が進行中。患者が人工呼吸器装着で重症であり、公衆衛生への深刻な影響の可能性があるため。
triage.notes: ニパウイルスはハイリスク病原体であり、人工呼吸器を要する重症患者が特定地域で発生。103名の接触者が監視対象となっており、医療従事者を含む。発症地域はケーラ州コージコード地区。現在のところ国際的な広がりの報告なし。

article.articleHeadline: RDC/Ebola : un mois après le début de l'épidémie, la riposte mise à rude épreuve (PAPIER GENERAL)
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: DRC/Ebola: One month after the outbreak began, the response is put to the test (GENERAL ARTICLE)
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of Congo continues one month after declaration (May 15) with the Bundibugyo strain driving a rising caseload. As of June 16, 2026, 808 laboratory-confirmed cases have been reported, including 192 deaths and 48 recoveries. The outbreak is concentrated in Ituri province, with additional cases in North Kivu and South Kivu in the eastern DRC amid armed violence and population displacement. Health authorities warn of ongoing transmission and anticipate new confirmed cases, underscoring the need to strengthen treatment capacity and establish additional Ebola treatment centers. MSF cites surveillance, diagnosis, contact tracing, and community engagement gaps that hinder control. Save the Children reports at least 52 children (including 16 infants) infected, 19 child deaths; under-14s face higher mortality risk. Insecurity and misinformation challenge response; UN OCHA urges continued surveillance, safe burials, sample transport, and rapid response despite access barriers.

triage.headline_ja: DRC/エボラ：流行開始から1ヶ月、対応が試験に晒される（総合記事）
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4項目すべて該当。エボラ出血熱の確認症例808件、死亡192件に達し、複数州に拡大。国際的な支援体制が構築されており、公衆衛生への深刻な影響は明らかである。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株によるエボラ出血熱の流行。東部DRCの複数州（Ituri、North Kivu、South Kivu）で確認。武装紛争と人口移動が対応を複雑化。MSF、Save the Children、国連OCHAが関与し、国際的な懸念は高い。小児症例52件、小児死亡19件と脆弱層への影響も深刻。

article.articleHeadline: La epidemia de ébola continúa en el Congo un mes después: lentitud en los diagnósticos y escasez de agua potable
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: The Ebola outbreak continues in the Congo one month later: delays in diagnosis and shortage of potable water.
article.articleSummary: Ebola virus disease, Bundibugyo variant, continues in the Democratic Republic of the Congo one month after first detections in Ituri. As of day 31, 808 confirmed cases and 192 deaths reported, with Uganda recording 19 cases (14 imported from DRC), marking the largest Bundibugyo outbreak to date per the CDC. Diagnostic delays and limited rapid testing hinder containment; MSF notes testing weaknesses, with a week-long turnaround and only one blood-test lab in North Kivu, plus no automated result transmission. Contact tracing coverage has declined from 79% in 2018 to 43% now. Ituri is the epicenter (about 95% of cases); North Kivu (62 cases) and South Kivu (3 cases) are also affected. Ongoing conflict in eastern DRC (M23 activity around Goma) worsens access and response. Humanitarian funding has fallen about 46% from 2024 to 2026; local actors receive less than 6% of funding, reducing PPE, sanitation, water infrastructure, and community outreach. Water access is emphasized as a frontline defense. WHO declared a Public Health Emergency of International Concern.

triage.headline_ja: コンゴのエボラ流行は1ヶ月後も継続：診断の遅延と飲用水不足
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準4つすべてに該当。エボラウイルス病（ブンディブギョ変異株）の大規模流行が続いており、死亡率が高く、ウガンダへの国際的拡大が確認され、WHOが国際的に懸念される公衆衛生上の緊急事態を宣言している。
triage.notes: 記事ではウガンダでの症例記録（19例、14例がDRCからの輸入）が言及されているが、記事の主題はコンゴでの流行であり、ウガンダは対象国リストに含まれないため検証対象地域には含めない。DRCはブンディブギョ変異株による最大規模アウトブレイクであり、診断遅延、接触者追跡不全、人道支援の大幅削減など、対応上の深刻な課題が複数存在する。紛争によるアクセス制限もあり、管理可能性に懸念がある。

article.articleHeadline: ഡെങ്കിപ്പനി; അട്ടപ്പാടിയിൽ 40 ദിവസത്തിനിടെ 24 കേസുകൾ | Dengue fever; 24 cases in Attappadi in 40 days
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dengue fever; 24 cases in Attappadi in 40 days.
article.articleSummary: As of 16 June 2026, dengue fever is rising in Kerala, with Attappadi, the tribal region of Palakkad district, reporting 24 confirmed dengue cases within 40 days. Previously Attappadi recorded very few dengue cases, often none. The surge has brought serious concern to the local Adivasi community, as the number of infections has crossed into double digits. Last Saturday, the district recorded this year’s first dengue death at Karimpuzha. Health authorities warn that infections including Shigella are spreading in the area, and urge the public to follow precautions to curb transmission. The development underscores broader statewide dengue activity and the need for vigilance and vector-control measures in affected communities.

triage.headline_ja: デング熱；アッタッパディで40日間に24例
triage.triage_reason: インドのケーララ州で短期間に複数のデング熱症例が報告され、死亡例も発生。これまで症例が少なかった部族地域での急速な増加は異常であり、WPROスクリーニング基準の複数項目に該当。
triage.notes: 記事サマリーでは2026年6月16日時点でケーララ州アッタッパディ（パラッカディ地区の部族地域）で40日間に24確定患者、年初の初死亡例が報告されている。これまで症例が少なかった地域での急増は異常。シゲラも同地域で流行しているとの警告あり。ベクター対策の必要性が強調されている。

article.articleHeadline: Epidemia de Ébola en RD Congo afecta a los comercios de la ciudad de Bunia
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola Epidemic in DR Congo Affects Bunia's Businesses
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak in the Democratic Republic of the Congo is affecting Bunia's economy, with fear of contagion prompting customers to avoid leaving home and to steer clear of bars and restaurants. Businesses report reduced patronage as crowds shrink. In response, staff install handwashing facilities and share information about the virus to reassure shoppers and diners. Media campaigns are being used to raise awareness about the epidemic, while some residents resist belief in its existence, complicating response efforts. The situation underscores the conflict between economic activity and infection prevention in Bunia, highlighting the need for clear risk communication and basic hygiene measures during the Ebola outbreak as of 2026-06-16.

triage.headline_ja: RDコンゴのエボラ流行がブニアの商業に影響
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性、国際拡大リスク）。エボラ出血熱は指定感染症であり、DRコンゴでの流行は国際的懸念事項。
triage.notes: エボラウイルスはIHR指定感染症。DRコンゴは既知の発生地域。記事は経済的影響と公衆衛生対応の課題を記述。住民の啓発不足や信念抵抗が対応複雑化を示唆。2026年6月時点でのアクティブな流行状況。

article.articleHeadline: 筑牢健康防线 护航成长成才 -- -- 我院开展夏季传染病预防专题学习会-山东科技大学新闻网
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Fortify the Health Defense Line, Safeguard Growth and Talent — Our Hospital Holds a Summer Infectious Disease Prevention Seminar, Shandong University of Science and Technology News Network
article.articleSummary: On June 15, 2026, the hospital affiliated with Shandong University of Science and Technology held a summer infectious disease prevention seminar to bolster campus health safety and graduate students’ well-being. Conducted via video, the session focused on summer-prone diseases—chickenpox, influenza, and dysentery—covering transmission routes, early recognition, and scientifically grounded prevention measures. Led by counselor Cao Mengting, the program aimed to empower student cadres with prevention and emergency response skills, promote civilized, healthy behaviors, and emphasize good hygiene, regular sleep, balanced work-rest, and regular exercise to boost immunity. The seminar linked infectious disease prevention with campus safety and civil conduct. Going forward, the institution will sustain routine health safety education and campus prevention efforts to foster a safe, healthy, and civilized campus environment.

triage.headline_ja: 健康防線を強化し、成長と成才を保障する――当院が夏季感染症予防専題学習会を開催 山東科技大学ニュースネットワーク
triage.triage_reason: これは大学での予防教育セミナーの実施報告であり、インフルエンザの新規発生や患者事例の報告ではない。公衆衛生上の緊急事態を示す実質的なイベントではなく、情報啓発活動である。
triage.notes: 記事は中国山東省の大学が夏季感染症予防セミナーを実施したという教育活動の報告であり、インフルエンザを含む感染症の実際の発生事例や患者数の増加を示す実質的なイベント情報ではない。予防啓発活動は通常のシグナルトリアージ対象外である。

article.articleHeadline: Alur Kingdom Forms Rapid Ebola Response Team to Shield Uganda-DRC Border Communities
article.articleSummary: Ebola outbreak linked to the Bundibugyo strain is rising in Ituri Province, eastern Democratic Republic of Congo, with cross-border spillover risk to Uganda’s West Nile districts as of 2026-06-16. The Alur Kingdom forms a Rapid Ebola Response Task Team, chaired by Uganda’s Health Minister Dr. Nyathirombo Amos and appointed by Prime Minister on behalf of King Ubimu Philip Rauni Olarker III, to strengthen border-area community sensitization and inter-country coordination. Members will be trained to relay accurate prevention messages through traditional chiefs in Uganda and DRC. In response to rising cases, the Kingdom urges communities not to hide suspected Ebola cases, to seek immediate medical care for Ebola-like symptoms, avoid large gatherings, and follow Uganda and DRC health ministry guidelines. It suspended major functions, sought free radio airtime for weekly health talks, and pledged close collaboration with government to prevent cross-border spread of the Bundibugyo-strain outbreak centered in Ituri Province.

triage.headline_ja: アルル王国、ウガンダ・DRC国境のエボラ急速対応チームを編成し地域コミュニティを保護
triage.triage_reason: IHR基準で3項目該当（異常性、国際的拡大リスク、渡航・貿易制限リスク）。Bundibugyo株エボラアウトブレイクがDRC Ituri州で発生し、ウガンダへの越境スピルオーバーリスクが明示されている。政府レベルでの公式対応体制が構築されている。
triage.notes: West Nile疾患がAPIに含まれているが、サマリーの主題はエボラアウトブレイクおよび越境リスク対応。Bundibugyo株エボラはDRC Ituri州での活動感染事例があり、ウガンダのWest Nile地区への具体的なスピルオーバーリスクが指摘されている。アルル王国による高レベルの公式対応チーム設置（首相任命、保健大臣議長）は政府の関心と対応能力を示す。記事サマリーに基づき、実際の発生国はDRCとウガンダであり、米国コロラド州は含めない。

article.articleHeadline: 端午節豬肉食材防疫 新北舉行重大豬病兵棋推演
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Dragon Boat Festival pork ingredients epidemic prevention: New Taipei holds a major swine disease wargame
article.articleSummary: On 2026-06-16, New Taipei City held a major swine-disease disaster prevention wargame ahead of the Dragon Boat Festival to safeguard pork supply. The exercise covered four scenarios: illegal feeding of pigs with restaurant waste; meat products from unknown or uninspected sources sold at shops; pigs showing blistering and lameness suggestive of foot-and-mouth disease (FMD); and suspected African swine fever (ASF) cases in meat markets. It tested farm-level controls such as temperature and video surveillance, swine-waste GPS tracking, and a QR real-name entry system for farms. Deputy Director Lai Min-chuan of the CDC Taichung sub-branch shared practical lessons from last year’s ASF response in Taichung. With ASF spreading in Korea and the Philippines and SAT-1 FMD outbreaks in mainland China, the drill added 24-hour mandatory outbreak reporting by designated veterinarians under relevant laws, with penalties up to NT$1 million. Agriculture Bureau Director Chen Xi-hui emphasized strengthening the animal-epidemic defense and ensuring safe domestic pork during the festival.

triage.headline_ja: 端午節豚肉食材防疫 新北で重大豚病兵棋推演を実施
triage.triage_reason: 台湾での演習記事であり、実際の感染症アウトブレイクではなく、既存の脅威（韓国・フィリピンのASF、中国のFMD）に対する防疫訓練の報道。情報不足のため経過観察が適切。
triage.notes: この記事は台湾での防疫演習（ドリル）であり、実際のアウトブレイク事象ではない。しかし、サマリーには韓国・フィリピンのASF、中国のSAT-1型FMD流行が触れられており、これらは実際の脅威として存在している。記事の主題は台湾の対応能力向上だが、実際の発生地としてはフィリピン（ASF）と中国（FMD）が言及されている。演習そのものではなく、背景にある地域の感染症脅威に着目する価値がある。

article.articleHeadline: Ｗ杯でのエボラ感染リスク「ゼロではない」、米病院は対応準備＝専門家
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Ebola infection risk at the World Cup is not zero; U.S. hospitals are preparing to respond, experts say.
article.articleSummary: During the 2026 FIFA World Cup spanning the United States, Mexico and Canada over 39 days, Ebola infection risk for arriving travelers is low but not zero. Following lessons from the 2014 Dallas incident, the U.S. has bolstered readiness with $260 million for training and 13 specialized treatment centers to rapidly identify, isolate, and safely treat suspected Ebola cases. Emory University critical-care expert Dr. Gavin Harris says the United States is the most prepared to date. About 6.5 million fans are expected to travel regionally; public health authorities flag higher risks from measles, COVID-19, and influenza. The Congo Democratic Republic currently reports roughly 675 Ebola infections and over 135 deaths, sustaining concern over spread. Tom Frieden of Resolve to Save Lives warns the risk is not zero until Congo’s outbreak is controlled; Ebola requires direct contact with body fluids and is not airborne.

triage.headline_ja: W杯でのエボラ感染リスク「ゼロではない」、米病院は対応準備＝専門家
triage.triage_reason: 複数の感染症（エボラ、麻しん、COVID-19、インフルエンザ）が言及されており、国際規模のイベント（2026年W杯）での感染リスク評価である。ただし、見出しはリスク予測段階であり、現在の実発生・明確な流行を示す根拠が限定的。DRCの継続的なエボラ発生（675感染、135死亡）は重要だが、米国でのイベント開催地域での実際の感染者報告がないため、情報収集の継続が必要。
triage.notes: 記事は米国・メキシコ・カナダでのW杯開催時の感染リスク予測であり、対象国のDRCでの継続的なエボラ発生（675感染、135死亡）が背景にある。ただし、記事の主題は米国での準備態勢であり、DRC以外の対象国では実際の発生を示唆していない。Bluedot APIの発生地域フィールドには米国・メキシコ・カナダが含まれているが、これらは対象国リストに未含有のため verified_locations から除外。DRCのみ検証済みロケーションとして列挙。続報でのDRC以外の地域での実際の感染者報告、または米国での確診例報告があれば、PICKUPに昇格する可能性あり。

article.articleHeadline: നിപയ്‌ക്കും ഷിഗെല്ലയ്‌ക്കും പിന്നാലെ ജീവന് ഭീഷണിയായ മറ്റൊരു രോഗം കൂടി; സ്ഥിരീകരിച്ചത് കോഴിക്കോട്ട്
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: Another life-threatening disease in the wake of Nipah and Shigella; confirmed in Kozhikode.
article.articleSummary: Malaria confirmed in Kozhikode district, Kerala, following Nipah and Shigella outbreaks. An migrant worker from Madhya Pradesh, living near Thikkodi in Koilandi, tested positive; authorities believe the infection originated in Madhya Pradesh, and he arrived a few weeks ago seeking work. Health officials say measures to prevent further transmission are being implemented. Malaria is transmitted by female Anopheles mosquitoes. Incubation is 10–15 days post-bite. Symptoms include high fever with chills, headaches, muscle and joint pains, marked fatigue, dizziness, vomiting, and abdominal discomfort. Patients should seek prompt medical care upon symptoms. Prevention emphasizes sleeping under a bed net, avoiding mosquito bites at night, and eliminating standing water around the living area. This is an imported case, with public health authorities monitoring spread and reinforcing vector-control efforts.

triage.headline_ja: ニパウイルスとシゲラに続く、別の生命を脅かす病気；コーチン地区で確認されたマラリア
triage.triage_reason: マラリアは輸入症例であり、ニパウイルス・シゲラの複数同時流行の文脈で報告されている。IHR基準は1つのみ該当（異常/予想外）だが、スクリーニング基準で複数該当し、情報不足のため継続監視が必要。
triage.notes: マラリアは輸入症例（マディヤプラデーシュ州からの出稼ぎ労働者）であり、単独では通常の疾患。ただし、ニパウイルスとシゲラの複数同時流行が同地域で進行中である点が異常。ケーススタディ数、重症度、医療負荷、さらなる人-人感染の可能性に関する情報が不足しており、続報を注視する必要がある。

article.articleHeadline: ​11,534 പേർക്ക് പകർച്ചപ്പനി; ആശങ്കയായി ഡ‍െങ്കുവും എലിപ്പനിയും
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: 11,534 people infected with measles; dengue and elephantiasis have become a concern.
article.articleSummary: Kerala, India reports fever-related illnesses totaling 11,534 under treatment, with Malappuram (2,470) the highest, followed by Kozhikode (1,142) and Idukki (298); Wayanad recorded a 10-year-old death the previous day. Elephantiasis, influenza, cholera, typhoid, amoebic meningitis/encephalitis, and West Nile virus infections are present; 107 elephantiasis cases have been reported in June; 82 suspected. Dengue infections total 3,366; this month saw 3 dengue, 9 influenza, and 2 elephantiasis deaths. Dengue hotspots: Kozhikode 24; Pathanamthitta 12; Kollam 11; Ernakulam 11; Thiruvananthapuram, Thrissur, and Palakkad 5 each. Chickenpox this month: 1,111 cases. Shigella confirmed this year: 135. Monsoon weather linked to spread.

triage.headline_ja: 11,534人が感染症に感染；デングとリンパ性フィラリア症が懸念材料に
triage.triage_reason: インド・ケーラ州における複数の感染症（デング、エルファンティアシス、チフス、コレラ、ウエストナイルウイルス、水痘など）の同時多発的な発生。11,534人の患者、複数の死亡報告、季節性因子との関連が認められ、IHR基準（深刻な公衆衛生影響、異常性）を満たし、WPROスクリーニング基準（重症度、長期曝露、流行しやすさ）に複数該当。フルRRAが必要。
triage.notes: ケーラ州での複数感染症の同時発生。デング（3,366例）、エルファンティアシス（107例確認、82例疑い）、水痘（1,111例）が主要。モンスーン季節との関連性が指摘されている。複数の州で感染が報告され、デング死亡3例、インフルエンザ死亡9例、エルファンティアシス死亡2例が報告されている。

article.articleHeadline: Israel Lifts Ebola-Related Entry Restrictions on Kenya, Rwanda
article.articleSummary: As of 2026-06-16, Israel’s Ministry of Health removed Kenya and Rwanda from its list of countries subject to temporary Ebola-related entry restrictions, per the Israeli Embassy in Nairobi. The reversal follows last week’s measures aimed at preventing importation of Ebola amid a regional outbreak. The original restrictions would have barred entry to non-Israeli citizens/residents who had been in affected countries within 21 days. The outbreak concerns the Bundibugyo strain reported in the Democratic Republic of Congo and Uganda, with Israel initially proposing limits on travelers recently in Kenya, Uganda, Rwanda, South Sudan and DRC to curb importation. Kenya argued there have been no confirmed Ebola cases despite extensive testing; Uganda, South Sudan, and DRC remain under restrictions. The World Health Organization and regional authorities continue to monitor the outbreak.

triage.headline_ja: イスラエル、ケニアとルワンダへの入国制限をエボラ関連で解除
triage.triage_reason: エボラウイルス病（Bundibugyo株）の地域的流行が確認され、複数国で国際的な入国制限措置が発生している。異常性、重症度、国際的拡大リスクが明確であり、IHR基準3つ以上に該当する。
triage.notes: Bundibugyo株エボラの地域流行がDRC・ウガンダで報告されている。ケニア・ルワンダ・南スーダンは対象国リストに含まれないため verified_locations に含めない。イスラエルによる入国制限措置が講じられたことで、国際的な関心が高く、WHOも監視継続中。

article.articleHeadline: Papua Barat intensifkan pengendalian malaria dan DBD jelang Pesparawi Nasional - ANTARA News Papua Tengah
article.articleHeadlineTranslated: West Papua intensifies malaria and dengue fever control ahead of the National Pesparawi - ANTARA News Central Papua
article.articleSummary: West Papua's Health Office intensifies malaria and dengue control ahead of Pesparawi National XIV in Manokwari, Indonesia. Indoor residual spraying and fogging are deployed to reduce transmission risk.
